(75)krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi bka' bstan dpe sdur khang gis dpe bsdur zhus/krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang /
ci /(wa

mdo the/ lgozhi (75)0363 gang po la sogs pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa brgya pa/ 3sdom gyi tshigs su bcad pa dang po/ 3sdom gyi tshigs su bcad pa gnyis pa/ 80sdom gyi tshigs su bcad pa gsum pa/ 147sdom gyi tshigs su bcad pa bzhi pa/ 206sdom gyi tshigs su bcad pa lnga pa/ 278sdom gyi tshigs su bcad pa drug pa/ 329sdom gyi tshigs su bcad pa bdun pa/ 395sdom gyi tshigs su bcad pa brgyad pa/ 450sdom gyi tshigs su bcad pa dgu pa/ 518sdom gyi tshigs su bcad pa bcu pa/ 596rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de de ba tsan dras bsgyur te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(680) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(780)

0364 'phags pa sangs rgyas kyi rtogs pa brjod pa shes ldan gyi mdo / 781rgya gar gyi mkhan po bca ka ra sing ha dang /sarba tsā de ba dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(788) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(789)0365 phag mo'i rtogs pa brjod pa zhes bya ba'i mdo/ 790rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba bad de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(795) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(796)0366 ma ga dhā bzang mo'i rtogs pa brjod pa/ 797rgya gar gyi mkhan po dharma shrī bha dra dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba dge slong tshul khrims yon tan gyis bsgyur te/ sgra sgyur gyi lots+tsha ba chen po dge slong rin chen bzang pos bcos te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(815) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(819)

༄ga /gang po la sogs pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa brgya pa/sti༄7lha /rgya gar skad du/ puṇadza praṅgā0mu kha a bsre'o na sha ti geka /bod skad du/ gang po la sogs pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa brgya pa/ bam po dang poX thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sdom ni/ gang po bzang dang grags ldan ma/ /le lo can dang ded dpon 7rnams/ /zla ba che ba pad ma dang ske/ /pa:phul dang bdug pa dang / /rgyal po mjugs9)tu smos pa ste/ /'di ni sde tshan bsdus pa yin/ /ljongs shig tu bram ze gang po zhes bya ba zhig byung ste / de'i tshe sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la/ rgyal po rnams dang blon po chen po rnams dang / phyug po rnams dang / pho brang 'khor gyi 31mi rnams dang /tshong dpon rnams dang / ded dpon rnams dang / lha rnams dang / klu rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams dang / lha ma yin rnams dang / nam mkha' lding rnams dang / mi 'am ci rnams dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis bkur 75—3

ste 1byas/ bla mar byas/ ri mor byas/ mchod par7byas te/ lha dang /klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis mchod cing shes pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bsod nams chen po dang ldan pa/ na bza' dang / zhal zas dang / gzims cha dang / gdan dang / snyun gsos dang / sman zong rnams brnyes dpa/ sangs rgyas gsar du byung ste/ gsung rab kyi snying khusnye'athung ba'i dus la bab cing / lha dang mi man cadangagal yang dag par rab tu ston pa/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa/ rgyal po'i khab na 'od ma'i tshal bya ka lan da 6ka gnas pa na rten cing bzhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas/ ring por 5chum lon par 'jig rten thams cad du grags pas yongs su gang ngo / /de nas lho phyogs kyi ri bo zhes bya ba'i ljongs na bram ze che zhing mtho ba gang po zhes bya ba phyug cing nor mang la longs spyod che ba yongs su 'dzin pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ rnam thos kyi bu'i nor dang ldan pa/ rnam thos kyi bu'i nor dang 'gran pa zhig gnas so / /de yang dad pa dang ldan la dge zhing bsam pa bzang ba bdag⑧la phan pa dang ske/ gzhan la phan pa la zhugs pa/ snying rje che ba dngashe/ bdag nyid che ba / chos 'dod pa/ gtong ba la sred pa/ sbyin pa la dga' btso/ rab tu sbyin pa la mngon par dga' ba/ gtong ba chen po la gnas pa zhig ste/ des re zhig 17na rab tu byung ba thams cad la mchod sbyin byas nasa'i/ der mu stegs can la sogs pa stong phrag du mas zan 1gezos so/ /gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyal po gzugs can snying po 'khor dang bcas pa btul nas/ de btul 75—4

bas srog chags 'bum phrag mang po dul bar gyur pa de'i tshe/ rgyal po'i khab nas gang po'i nye du rnams lhags te/ gang po'i mdun du sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun gyi bsngags pa brjod do/ /de nas bram ze che zhing mtho ba gang pos bcom ldan 'das kyi yon tan thos nas dga' ba chen po thob par gyur to/ /de nas khang thog tu song nas rgyal po'i khab logs su kha bltas ①te 'dug nas pus7mo gnyis kyi lha nga sa la btsugs te/ me tog kyang gtor/ bdug pa dang chu yangasaphul nas bcom ldan 'das la gsol ba btab pa/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gi mchod sbyin la gshegs su gsol/ mchod sbyin gyi 'dun sa gzigs su gsol zhes byas so/ /de nas sangs rgyas rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi mthu dang / lha rnams kyi lha'i mthus me tog de dag bcom ldan 'das kyi steng du me tog gi khang par gyur te 'dug go/ /bdug56)pa ni sprin gyi mgo lta bur gyur to/ /chu ni be+e dūr+ya'i〈sdong bu lta'ubur gyur to/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos thal mo sbyar nas/ bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa spyan 'dren 'di ga las mchis lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/kun dga' bo lho phyogs kyi ri bo zhes bya ba'i ljongs na/ bram ze che zhing mtho ba gang po zhes bya ba 'dug pa der 'o 7bu cag 'dong dgos kyis 'o )dge slong dag chos shig /de nas bcom ldan 'das dge slong stong gis zhabs 'bring〈nyebyas nas lho phyogs kyi ri bo'i ljongs7rgyu zhing gshegs te/ bram ze che zhing mtho ba gang po'i mchod sbyin gyi 'dun sa dang nye ba zhig tu gshegs nas/ 'di snyam du dgongs te ngas bram ze gang po rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul gyis dad par bya'o snyam mo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong stong po de dag mi snang bar mdzad de/75—5

nyag gcig7)lhung bzed7dang chu snod phyag na bsnams nas/ gang po dang nye ba zhig tu gshegs so/ /de nas bram ze che zhing mtho ba gang pos bcom ldan 'das sku skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu (7rtsa gnyis kyis legs par brgyan pa/dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus mdzes par byas pa/ 'od 'dom gang gis brgyan pa/ nyi ma stong bas lhag pa'i 'od mnga' ba/ rin po che'i ri bo 'gro ba lta bu kun nas bzang ba mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang shin tu rings par bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du song ste bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das gshegs pa legs so/ /bcom ldan 'das bzhugs su gsol/ bdag la phan gdags pa'i slad du bshos gsol bar ci gnang zhes gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gal te khyod kyis yongs su btang na lhung bzed 'di'i nang du byin cig /de jenanas bram ze che zhing mtho ba gang po bram ze'i khye'u lnga brgyas g.yog byas pasazhes/ bcom ldan 'das la zhal zas rnam pa sna tshogs khur rinerab 7ridang / bshos dang / 'jams dang / bldag pa dang / bzhib pa la risasogs pas lhung bzed thuna'agengs par byed do/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang nyid kyi lhung bzed 1 rikyi nang nas dge slong stong 31/gi lhung bzedalo dag gi nang du zas de dag 'pho bar mdzad do/ /gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong stong gi lhung bzed 1 rnams gang bar thugs su chud pa de'i tshe nyid kyi lhung bzedarwastegang bar bstanamatsheto/ /de nas dge slong stong lhung bzedam gang ba zla ba tshes pa'i dbyibs lta bur 'khod pa bstan to/ /nam mkha' la gnas pa'i lha rnams kyis kyang / bcom ldan 'das dang dge slong stong gi lhung bzedamanyernams gang bar gyur to/ /zhes bya ba'i sgra brjod do/ /de nas cho 'phrul〈nyebastan pa des 75—6

bram ze che zhing mtho ba gang po dga' bar gyur nas/ dga' zhing mgu la rab tu dga' ste yinyerangs shing dga' ba dang yid bde bar gyur te/ sdong po rtsa ba nas bcad pa bzhin du bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la phyang/ 'tshal〈minas smon lam btab pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba dang sems bskyed pa dang sbyin parashebya ba'i chos yongs su gtong ba 'dis/ bdag 'jig rten long ba 'dren pa med cing yongs su 'dren pa med par sems can ma rgalasnyib rnams sgrol ba dang / ma grol ba rnams 'grolasnyib dang / dbugs ma phyin pal)rnams dbugs 'byin pa dang /yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams yongs su mya ngan las zlo ⑦ba'i sangs rgyas su gyur cig ces byas so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bram ze che zhing mtho ba gang po'i rgyu gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa dang las gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa mkhyen nas 'dzum pa mdzad do/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams gang gi tshe 'dzum pa mdzad pa'i chos nyid de de'i tshe zhal nas 'od zer sngon po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang / dkar po rnams byung nas5kyekha cig ni 'og tu 'gro'o/ /kha cig ni steng du 'gro'o/ /'og tu 'gro ba gang yin pa de dag ni sems can dmyal ba yang sos dang / thig nag dang / 'dus ('o)'joms dang / ngu 'bod dang / ngu 'bod chen po dang / tsha ba dang / rab tu tsha ba dang / mnar med pa dang / chu bur can dang / chu bur rdol dang /so thams thams dang / kyilastohud zer dang / a chu zer dang / ud pal ltar gas pa dang / pad ma ltar gas pa dang / pad ma ltar gas pa chen por song nas tsha ba'i sems can dmyal ba gang yin pa de dag tu ni bsil bar gyur te 'bab bo/ /grang ba'i sems can dmyal ba gang yin pa de dag tu ni dro bar gyur 75—7

te 'bab bo/ /de nas sems can de dag gi gnod pa'i khyad par rnams rtse0zhil bar gyur to/ /de nas de dag 'di snyam du sems te kye cikhubadag cag 'di nas shi 'phos sam 'on te gzhan du skyes sam snyam mo/ /de nas de dag dad pa bskyed pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das sprul pa 'gyed parashemadzad de/ de dag gis sprul pa mthong nas 'di snyam du sems te/ kye cis④bdag cag ni 'di nas kyang shi 'phos par kyang phyem gyur la gzhan du yang ma skyes mod kyi/ 'on kyang sngon ma byung ba'i sems can snang ba 'di'i mthus bdag cag gi gnod pa'i khyad par rnams rtse zhil bar gyur to snyam mo/ /de nas de dag sprul pa la sems mngon par dga' bar gyur nas sems can dmyal ba myong bar 'gyur ba'i las de zad de/lha dang mi rnams kyi nang du gang du bden pa rnams kyi snod du rung bar 'gyur ba der nying mtshams 'dzin par 'gyur rog/ /steng du 'gro ba gang yin pa de dag ni/ rgyal chen bzhi'i ris rnams dang sum cu rtsa gsum pa rnams dang /'thab bral rnams dang / dga' ldan rnams dang / 'phrul dga' rnams dang /gzhan 'phrul dbang byed rnamasa'ishedang / tshangs ris rnams dang /sti rangs pa'i mdun na 'don pa rnams dang / tshangs /ci )pa chen po rnams dang / 'od chung rnams dang / tshad med 'od rnams dang / 'od gsal rnams dang /dge chung rnams 117dang / tshad med dge shernams dang / dge rgyas rnams dang /sprin med rnams dang / bsod nams skyes rnams dang / 'bras bu che rnams dang ske/ mi che ba pho rnams dang / mi gdung bcarnams dang / gya nom snang rnams dang / shin tu mthong rnams dang / 'og min gyi lha rnams kyi bar du song nas mi rtag pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / stong pa dang bdag med pa'i 75—8

sgra sgrogs so/ /tshigs su bcad pa gnyis kyang rjodanyepar byed de/ nges par 'byung bshebartsam par gyis/ /sangs rgyas bstan la sbyor bar gyis/ /'dam bu'i khyim la glang chen bzhin/ /'chi bdag sde ni gzhom par gyis/ /gang zhig chos 'dul 'di nyid la/ /bag yod spyod par byed pa ni/ /skye ba'i 'khor ba rab spangs nas/ /sdug bsngal zad par byed par 'gyur/ /zhes rjod7par byed do/ /denas 'od zer de dag gis stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams bskor nas/ bcom ldan 'das nyid kyi phyi bzhin du 'brangs te gal te bcom ldan 'das kyis 'das pa'i las lung ston par bzhed na ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyi snam logs su mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /ma 'ongs pa'i las lung ston par bzhed na ni mdun logs su mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /sems can dmyal bar skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni zhabs kyi mthil du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /dud 'gror skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni zhabs kyi rting par mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /yi dgas su skye bar lung ston par bzhed na nisnyizhabs kyi mthe bor mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /mir skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni pus dunyamo gnyis su mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por lung ston par bzhed na ni phyag g.yon pa'i mthil du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /'khor spos sgyur ba'i rgyal por lung ston par bzhed na ni phyag g.yas pa'i mthil du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /lhar skye bar lung ston par bzhed na⑥ni lte bar mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /nyan thos kyi byang chub tur lung ston par bzhed na ni zhal du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub tu lung ston par bzhedatsha spun ni smin mtshams kyesu mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /bla na med pa yang dag par 75—9

rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung ston par bzhed na ni dbu'i gtsug tor7du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas 'od zer de dag gis bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum du 5bskor ba byas te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi dbu'i gtsug gtor du mi snang bar gyur toca/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos thal mo sbyar te bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ tshon sna stong gis spel ba sna tshogs can/ /mang po zhal gyi sgo nas byung bar gyur/ /de yis phyogs rnams kun tu snang bar bgyis6)/ /nyi ma shar bas ji ltar bgyis pa bzhin/ /yang tshigs su bcad de gsol ba/ rgod dang bral zhing rgyags dang 7)mi dgyesalo7)spangs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas 'gro ba dag gisnyidam pa'i rgyur gyur pa/ /rgyal ba dgra thub rnams ni rgyu rkyen ma mchis par /pad ma'i rtsa dang dung mdog lta bu'i 'dzum mi ston/ /brtan pos nyid kyi blo yis dus bab mkhyen lags na/ /dge sbyong rgyal dbang nyan pa7som nyi 'tshal ba rnams / /thub pa khyu mchog gi ni gsung mchog brtan pa dang / /bzang po dag gis the tshom 0skyes pa bsal nyurtabar gsol/ /rgya mtsho dang ni ri rgyal lta bur brtan pa yi/ ri/ /mgon po rdzogs sangs rgyas rnams gyin da hu)'dzum mi ston/ /gang gi don du dpa' ḍibo 'dzum pa ston mdzad pa/ /de ni khyod las skye bo phal chen 5nyan par 'tshal/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo de ni de bzhin no/ /de ni de bzhin te/ kun dga' bo de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams ni rgyu med rkyen med par 'dzum pa mi mdzad do1 / /kun dga' bo bram ze che zhing mtho ba 'dis nga la 'di lta bu'i bkur sti byas pa mthong ngam/ btsun pa mthong lags tunyeso/ /kun dga' bo bram ze che zhing mtho ba 'di 1khedage ba'i rtsa ba dang sems bskyed pa 75—10

dang sbyin par bya ba'i chos yongs su gtong ba 'dis bskal pa grangs med pa gsum gyis yang dag par bsgrub par bya ba'i byang chub yang dag par bsgrubs te/snying rje chen pos yongs su bsgos pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs par byas nas stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / ma 'dres pa'i dran pa nye bar gzhag0)pa gsum dang / snying rje chen po dang ldan pa'i yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang po bzang zhes bya bar gyur7te 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i sbyin par bya ba'isnyichos ni gang nga la sems mngon par dga' bar gyur pa 'di yin no/ /gang gi tshe bcomo ldan 'das kyis bram ze che zhing mtho ba gang po bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung bstan pa de'i tshe/ gang pos bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa zla ba gsum gyi bar du mchod sbyin gyi 'dun sar bshos gsol te/lhag par yang des dge ba'i rtsa9)ba rnam pa sna tshogs dag yang dgas)par bskyed pi do / /dge slong dag de bas na 'di ltar bslab par bya ste ston pa la bkur spyisti bya'o / /bla mar bya'o/ /ri mor bya'o/ /mchod par bya'o/ /ston pa la bkur 2)ste byas/ bla mar byas/ ri mor byas/ mchod pa byas nas brten te gnas par bya'o zhes dge slong khyed kyis de ltar bslab par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ dge slong de dag yi rangs te nyu)bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// //grags ldan ma zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la/ rgyal po rnams dang / blon po chen po rnams dang / phyug po rnams dang / pho brang 'khor gyi mi rnams dang / tshong dpon rnams dang / ded dpon rnams dang /75—11

lha rnams dang / klu rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams dang / lha ma yin rnams dang / nam mkha' lding rnams dang / mi 'am ci rnams dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis bkuratuste byas/ bla mar byas ri mor7byas mchod pa byas te③/lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis mchod cing shes pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bsod nams chen po dang ldan pa na bza'aphudang /zhal zas dang / gzims cha dang / gdan dang / snyun gsos dang / sman zong rnams brnyes pa/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa yangs pa can na spre'u rdzing gi 'gram gyi khang pa brtsegs pa'i gnas na rten cing bzhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das snga dro sham thabs dang chos gos gsol te lhung bzed ⑤bsnams nas/ dge slong gi tshogs kyis zhabs 'bring57byas te dge slong gi dge 'dun gyis mdun du bdar nas yangs pa can du bsod snyoms la gshegs so/ /yangs pa can du mthar gyis bsod snyoms la gshegs nas dmag dpon seng ge'i khyim ga la ba 7)der gshegs te byon nasalagadan bshams pa la bzhugs so/ /de nas dmag dpon seng ge'i mna'5shesam grags ldan ma zhes bya ba gzugs bzang zhing blta nyu )na sdug la mdzes pa zhig yod pa des bcom ldan 'das sku mtshan dang dpe byad 31rnam pa sna tshogs 'bar ba dang ldan pa mthong nas shin tu dga' ba thob par gyur to/ /des gyos po la dris pa bdag kyang 'di lta bu'i yon tan dang ldan par gyur pa'i༄2thabs 'ga' lta mchis sam/ de nas dmag dpon seng ge 'di snyam du sems te/ kye ma bu mo 'di ni rgya chen po la mos pa zhig ste/ gal te 'di5nyeskyen dang phrad na mini/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang 75—12

chub tu smon lam 'debs par 'gyur ro snyam du rig nas smras pa/ bu mo gal te rgyu yang dag par blangs te 'dug na ni khyod kyang bcom ldan 'das ci 'dra ba de lta bur 'gyur ro/ /de nas dmag dpon seng ges7grags ldan ma'i dad pa 'phel bar bya ba'i phyir/ dbyig dang / gser dang / rin po che mang du byin no/ /de nas grags ldan mas bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa phyi de nyinakhukhyim gyi nang du gdugs tshod la spyan drangs so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang de la phan gdags pa'i phyir gnang ngo / /de nas bu mo grags ldan mas gser dang / dngul dang / rin po che'i me tog rnams kyang57byed du bcug /spos dang / me tog phreng dang / byug pa mang po5gedag kyang bsags⑤/ zhal zas ro brgya dang ldan pa yang bshams nas bcom ldan 'das la phrin0gyis gdugs tshod bskul ba/ btsun pa gdugs tshod la bab ste bshos gsol ⑦lags na bcom ldan 'das kyis da de'i dus la bab par dgongs te gshegs su gsol zhes bskul to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi tshogs kyis zhabs 'bringasabyas te/ dge slong gi dge 'dun gyis mdun du bdar nas dmag dpon seng ge'i khyim ga la ba der gshegs te byon nas/ dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi gung la gdan bshams pa la bzhugs so/ /de nas bu mo grags ldan mas sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun bde bar bzhugs par rig nas rang gi lag nas zhal zas ro brgya dang ldan pas tshim par byas te/bcom ldan 'das la me tog dag gis gtor to/ /de nas me tog de dag 'di lta ste / sangs rgyas rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi mthu dang lha rnams kyi lha'i mthus/bcom ldan 'das kyi steng du rin po che'i khang pa dang khang pa brtsegasalo7pa rin po 75—13

che'i rgyal mtshan can mgar ba'am/ mgar ba'i slob ma legs par lobs pas kyang byed mi nus pa de lta bur gyur te 'dug go/ /de nas bu mo grags ldan mas lha dang mi dad par byed pa'i cho 'phrul shin tu rmad du byung ba de mthong nas/sdong po rtsa ba nas bcad pa bzhin du lus thams cad kyis bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshalatunas smon lam btab pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba dang / sems bskyed pa dang / sbyin par bya ba'i chos yongs su gtong ba 'dis/ bdag 'jig rten long ba 'dren pa med cing yongs su 'dren pa med par/ sems can ma rgaladza ba rnams sgrol ba dang / ma grol ba rnams 'grol ba dang / dbugs ma phyin pa rnams dbugs 'byin pa dang / yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams yongs su mya ngan las zlo ba'i gsangs rgyas su gyur cig ces byas so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bu mo grags ldan ma'i rgyu gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa dang / las gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa mkhyen nas 'dzum pa mdzad dom/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams gang gi tshe 'dzum pa mdzad pa'i chos nyid de/ de'i tshe de'i rtso)zhal nas 'od zer sngon po dang / ser po dang —/ dmar po dang / dkar po rnams byung risnyenas kha cig ni 'og tu 'gro'o/ /kha cig ni steng du 'gro'o/ /'og tu 'gro ba gang yin pa de dag ni sems can dmyal ba yang sos dang / thig nag dang / 'dus nya'ajoms dang / ngu 'bod dang / ngu 'bod chen po dang / tsha ba dang / rab tu tsha ba dang /mnar med pa dang / chu bur can dang / chu bur rdol dang / so thams thams medadang / kyi hud zer dang / a chu zer dang / ud pal ltar gas pa dang ske/ pad ma ltar gas pa dang /8) pad ma ltar gas pa chen por song nas 75—14

tsha ba'i sems can dmyal ba gang yin pa de dag tu ni0)bsil bar gyur te 'bab bo / /grang ba'i sems can dmyal ba gang yin pa de dag tu ni droragebar gyur te 'bab bo/ / des na〈misems can de dag gi gnod pa'i khyad par rnams rtse zhil bar gyur to0/ /de nas dene'udag 'di snyam du sems te/ kye ci bdag cag59)'di nas shi 'phos sam/ 'on te gzhan du skyes sam snyam mo/ /de nas de dag dad pa bskyed pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das sprul pa 'gyed par mdzad de9na/ de dag gis sprul pa mthong nas 'di snyam du sems te/ kye bdag cag ni 'di nas kyang shi 'phos par ma gyur la gzhan du yang ma skyes mod kyi/ 'on kyang sngon ma byung ba'i sems can snang ba 'di'i mthus bdag cag gi gnod pa'i khyad par rnams rtse zhil bar gyur to snyam mo/ /de nas de dag sprul pa la sems mngon par dga' bar gyur nas sems can ( dmyal ba myong bar 'gyur ba'i las delo1)zad de/lha dang mi rnams kyi nang du gang du bden pa rnams kyi snod du rung bar 'gyur ba der nying mtshams 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /steng du 'gro ba gang yin pa de dag ni rgyal chen bzhi'i ris rnams dang / sum cu rtsa gsum pa rnams dang / 'thab mi bral rnams dang / dga' ldan rnams dang / 'phrul dga' rnams dang /gzhan 'phrul dbang byed rnams dang / tshangs ris rnams nya1dang / tshangs pa'i mdun na 'don pa rnams dang / tshangs pa chen po rnams dang / 3ge'od chung rnams dang / tshad med 'od rnams dang / 'od gsal rnams dang / dge chung rnams dang / tshad med dge rnams dang / dge rgyas rnams dang / sprin med rnams dang / bsod nams skyes rnams dang / 'bras bu che rnams dang /mi che rnams dang / mi gdung rnams dang / gya rnam snang rnams dang / shin 75—15

tu mthong nyu)rnams dang / 'og min gyi57lha rnams kyi bar du song nas mi rtag pa dang ske/ sdug bsngal ba dang / stong pa dang / bdag med pa'i sgra sgrogs so/ /tshigs su bcad pa gnyis kyang rjod par byed de/ nges par 'byung ba brtsam par gyis / /sangs rgyas bstan la sbyor bar gyis/ /'dam bu'i khyim la glang chen bzhin / /'chi bdag sde ni gzhom par gyis/ /gang zhig chos 'dul 'di nyid la / /bag yod spyod par byed pa ni/ /skye ba'i 'khor ba rab spangs nas/ /sdug bsngalas zad par byed par 'gyur/ /zhes rjod par byed doge/ /de nas 'od zer de dag gis stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams bskor nas bcom ldan 'das nyid kyi phyi bzhin 'brangs te/snye/ gal te bcom ldan 'das kyis 'das pa'i las lung ston par bzhed na ni bcom ldan 'das kyi snam logs su mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /ma 'ongs pa'i las lung ston par bzhed na ni mdun 7logs su mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /sems can dmyal bar skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni zhabs kyi mthil du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /dud 'gror skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni zhabs kyi rting 58)par mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /yi dgas 9su skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni zhabs kyi mthe bor mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /mir skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni pus mo gnyis su mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /stobs kyi 11'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por lung ston par bzhed na ni phyag g.yon pa'i mthil du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por lung ston par bzhed na ni phyag g.yas pa'i mthil 7du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /lhar skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni lte bar mi snang bar 'gyur rol/ /nyan thos kyi byang chub tu lung ston par bzhed na ni zhal du mi snang bar 75—16

'gyur ro/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub tu lung ston par bzhed na ni smin mtshams su mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung ston par bzhed na ni dbu'i gtsug tor du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas 'od zer de dag gis bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas te/bcom ldan 'das kyi dbu'i gtsug tor du mi snang bar gyur to/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos thal mo sbyar te bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ tshon sna stong gis spel ba sna tshogs can/ /mang po41zhal gyi sgo nas byung bar gyur/ /de yis phyogs rnams kun tu snang bar bgyis/ /nyi ma shar bas ji ltar bgyis pa bzhin / /yang tshigs su bcad de gsol pa/ rgod dang bral zhing rgyags dang mi dgyes spangs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas 'gro ba dag gi dam pa'i rgyur gyur pa/ /rgyal ba dgra thub rnams ni rgyu rkyen ma mchis par / /pad ma'i rtsa dang dung mdog lta bu'i 'dzum mi stonaskye/ /brtan pos ( nyid kyi blo yis dus bab mkhyen lags na/ /dge sbyong rgyal dbang nyan pa som nyi 'tshal ba rnams/ /thub pa khyu mchog gi ni gsung mchog brtanar+sāpa dang / /bzang po dag gis the tsom kyiskyes pa bsal ri 7ribar gsol/ /rgya mtsho dang ni ri rgyal lta bur brtan 87pa yi/ /mgon po rdzogs sangs rgyas rnams gyin da smyo 'dzum mi ston/ /gang gi don du dpa' bo 'dzum pa ston mdzad pa/ /de ni khyod las 1 )skye bo phal chen 11nyan par 'tshal/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo de ni de bzhin no/ /de ni de bzhin te/ kun dga' bo de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams ni rgyu med rkyen med par 'dzum pa mi mdzad do/ /kun dga' bo bu mo grags ldan ma 'dis nga la 'di lta bu'i bkur 12ste byas pa 75—17

mthong ngam/ btsun pa mthong lags so/ /kun dga' bo7grags ldan ma 'di dge ba'i rtsa ba dang sems bskyed pa dang sbyin par bya ba'i chos yongs su gtong ba 'dis bskal pa (5)grangs med pa gsum gyis yang dag par bsgrub par bya ba'i byang chub yang dag par bsgrubs te/ snying rje chen pos yongs su bsgos pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs par byas nas/ stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / ma 'dres pa'i dran pa nye bar gzhag pa gsum dang /snying rje chen po dang ldan pa'i yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen ldan zhes bya bar 'gyur de 0'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i sbyin par bya ba'i chos ni gang nga ④la sems mngon par dga' bar gyur pane'u)'di yin no/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces ri0bka' stsal nas/ dge slong de dag yi rangs te 7ribacom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// //le lo can zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po rnams dang ske/ blon po chen po 48)rnams dang / phyug po rnams dang / pho brang 'khor gyi mi rnams dang / tshong dpon rnams dang / ded dpon rnams dang / lha rnams dang / klu rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams dang / lha ma yin rnams dang ske/ nam mkha' lding rnams dang / mi 'am ci rnams dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis bkur ri9ste byas/ bla mar byas/ ri mote/nge byas mchod pa nyabyas te lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang ske/ mi 'am ci dang 1 / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis mchod cing shes pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bsod nams chen po dang ldan pa/ na bza' dang /zhal zas dang / gzims cha dang / gdan dang / snyan gsos 3)dang / sman 75—18

zong rnams brnyes pa/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa mnyan du yod pa na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe mnyan du yod pa na tshong dpon phyug cing nor mang la longs spyod che ba yongs su 'dzin pa yangs shing 517rgya che ba/ rnam thos kyi bu'i nor dngaphuldan pa/ rnam thos kyi bu'i nor dang 'gran pa zhig gnas pa des rigs mnyam pa las chung ma blangs nas/ de de dang lhan cig tu rtse zhing dga' la dga' mgur ④spyod do/ /de rtse zhing dga' la dga' mgur 4)spyod kyang /bu yang med bu mo yang57med nas de lag pa la skom tshugs56bcas te/ bdag gi khyim nor du ma dang ldan du zin kyang bdag la bu yang med bu mo yang med pas/bdag 'das pa'i 'og tu ni bu med pa'i phyir ci bdog pa thams cad rgyal po dbang bar 'gyur ro snyam ste sems khong du mchud cing 'dug go/ /de nas dge sbyong dang / bram ze dang / ltas mkhan dang / mdza' 87bo dang / gnyen dang ske/ rtsa lag gzhan dag gis lha la gsol ba thob cig 9ces de la bsgo'o/ /'jig rten na yang gsol ba btab pa'i rgyus bu dang bu mo skye bar 'gyur ro zhes bya ba'i gtam de yod mod kyi/ de yang de lta boni ma yin te/ gal te gsol ba btab pa'i rgyus bu dang bu mo71skye bar 'gyur du zin na ni/2/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po bzhin du re re la yang bu stong stong yod par 'gyur ba'i rigs so/ /ye ni gnas gsum tshogs pa las bu dang bu mo skye bar 'gyur te/ gsum gang zhe na / pha ma gnyis 'dod chags langs te phrad pa dang / ma dus la bab cing zla mtshan dang ldan pa dang dri za 'ongs pa ste/ gnas 'di gsum tshogs pa las bu dang bu mo skye bar 'gyur 1snyen/ 'on kyang dge sbyong dang / bram ze rnams dang /75—19

ltas mkhan rnams dang / mdza' bo dang / gnyen dang / rtsa lag rnams kyis de la tho btsams 1)nas/ de bulamed de bu 'dod pa'i phyir gu langasnyedang chu lha dang ku be ra dang brgya byin dang tshangs pa la sogs pa dang / lha'i khyad par gzhan dag la yang gsol ba 'debs te/ 'di lta ste kun dga' ra ba'i lha dang ske/ nags tshal gyi lha dang / lam gyi bzhi mdo'i lha dang / sum mdo'i rigelha dang ske/ gtor ma len pa'i lha dang / lhan cig skyes pa dang chos 'thun pasnyipa dang rtag tu phyi bzhin 'brang ba'i lha rnams la yang gsol ba 'debs te de yang gsol ba 'debs pa lhur byed cing 'dug la/ sems can zhig kyang sems can gyi ris shig nas shi 'phos te de'i chung ma'i stor zhugs so/ /bud med mkhas pa'i rang bzhin can kha cig la ni thun mongaponam yin pa'i chos lnga yod de/ lnga gang zhe na/ skyes pa chags pa yang shes la ma chags pa yang shes pa dang / dus kyang shes la zla mtshan yang shes pa dang / bu chags pa shes pa dang gang las bu chags pa shes pa dang / khye'u yang shes la bu mo yang shes pa ste/ gal te khye'u yin na ni lto g.yas logs sum/rten cing gnas so/ /gal te bu mo yin na ni lto g.yon logs su rten cing gnas so/ /de nas de dga' ches nas khyim thabasnyel sbran pa jo bo bdag la sras chags te/ bdag gi rum g.yas logs na rten cing gnas pa las na/ khye'ur 'gyur bar nges kyis7dgyes pa bskyed du gsol zhes byas nas/ de yang dga' ches te77ro stod 3)ni bteg lag pa g.yas pa ni brkyang nas bdag gis yun ring po nas smon smon pa'i bu'i ngo mthong bar 'ong ngo ske/ /bdag gi bu rung bar shog shigatu /mi rung bar ma gyur cig /bdag gi bya ba dag byed par shog shigs /gsos pa'i lan phyir gso bar shog shig8 /75—20

nor skal la spyod par shog shig① /bdag gi rigs rgyud ring du gnas par shog shig② /bdag cag 'das te shi ba'i 'og tu yang bdag cag gi phyir mang gyiyang rung nyung yang rung ④ste/ sbyin pa dag byin ⑤la bsod nams dag byas nas/de gnyis gang dang gang du skyes shing 'gro ba der 'di song shig ces yon bsngo phyirabar shog shigashecesasnyedaga' ba'i tshig brjod do/ /des bu chags par rig nas bu'i rim gro bya ba'i phyir/ khang bzangasalo)kyi steng du nyam rangs su bzhag ste/grang ba'i tshe grang ba'i yo byad rnams dang / tsha ba'i tshe tsha ba'i yo byad rnams dang / sman pas bstan pa'i zas rnams dang / ha cang kha ba ma yin pa rnams dang / ha cang skyur ba ma yin pa rnams dang / ha cang lan tshwa〈 ༄che ba ma yin pa rnams dang / ha cang mngar51ba ma yin pa rnams dang / ha cang ro tsha ba ma yin pa rnams dang / ha cang bskarwagyeb ma yin pa rnams tetunye/ kha ba dang /skyur ba dang / lan nosnyadang / mngar skob dang / tsha ba dang / bska ba med pa'i zas rnams sten ⑩cing / do shal dang se mo dos lus rnam par bklubs 3 te lha'i bu mo dga' ba'i tshal na rnam par rgyu ba bzhin du khri'i steng nas khri'i steng dang ske/ khri'u'i〈nyesteng nas khri'u'i nya)steng du rgyu zhing 'og gim sdus gzhi la mi 'bab pa dang / des yid du mi 'ong ba'i sgra skad ci yang mi thos par byas so/ /de zla ba brgyad dam dgu lon pa dang bu byung ste/ khye'u gzugs bzang zhing bltamanyan sdug la mdzes pa zhig btsas ( nyenas de btsas pa'i tshe khyim gang gi mi thams cad (gedaga' bar gyur te de btsas pa'i btsas ston byas nas/ khye'u 'di'i ming ji skad gdags zhes ming 'dogs par byed de/ nye du rnams na re 'di btsas pa na khyim gang gi mi thams cad dga' bar gyur pas na de'i phyir khye'u 'di'i ming 75—21

dga' byed ces gdags so zhes zer nas de'i ming dga' byed ces btags so/ /de nas khye'u dga' byed pang na 'tsho ba'i ma ma gnyis dang / nu ma snun0)pa'i ma ma gnyis dang / dri ma 'khru ba'i ma ma gnyis dang / rtse ba'i ma ma gnyis te/ma ma brgyad la gtad nas de ma ma brgyad kyis 'o ma dang / zho dang / mar dang ske/ zhun mar dang / mar gyi nyings5)khu dang / gzhan yang yo byad kyi khyad par bzang ngo dgacog gis bskyed bsrings te/ mtsho'i nang gi pad ma bzhin du skyed cher cadrag par gyur to/ /de nas de gang gi tshe cher skyes te lo lnga'am drug lon pa de'i tshe/ le lo can mchog tu le lo che ba zhig tu gyur te mal dang stanalogalas kyang ldang mi 'dod do/ /de blo rno zhing gsal bas khyim gyi nang du 'dug bzhin du bstan bcos 6rnams bslabs so/ /de nas tshong dpon de 'di snyam du sems te bdag gis lha mnyes par byas nas bye/ brgya lam na lan gcig na bu skyes pa de yang le lo can mchog tu le lo che ba zhig tu gyur te mal dang stan las kyang mi ldang na 'di ltar lus tha mal par gyur kyang grum po bzhin du lnga re 'dug pa 'di 'dra ba'i bu lta ci dgos snyam mo/ /tshong dpon de yang rdzogs byed la dga' ste/ des mu stegs can gyi ston pa drug rang gi khyim du bos nas/ gal te khye'u 'dis de dag mthong na rjes 58bskyed de mal nas ldang ba tsam yang byed srid dam snyam pa dang / de nas khye'u le lo can gyis ston pa de dag mthong nasashimig gis kyang ma bltas na ldang ba'am gus par smra ba'am stan bstabs pa lta ci smosal/ de nas tshong dpon des gnas skabs de lta bus1 )mthong nas chesam3〉rab tu gdung bar gyur te lag pa la skom 12tshugs bcas nas 1 sems khong du chud cing 'dug go/ /de'i skabs su sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis ni 8mi 75—22

mkhyen pa'am/ mi gzigs pa'am/ mi rtogs7pa'am/ thugs su mi chud pa ci yang med la sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa/'jig rten la phan 'dogs pa la zhugs pa/ srung ba gcig dang ldan pa/gcig tu dpa' ba zla med pa/ gnyis su mi gsung ba/ zhi gnas dang lhag mthong la gnas pa/ rig pa gsum snang bar mdzad pa/ bslab pa gsum la legs par bslabs pa/ 'dul ba'i gzhi gsum la mkhas pa/ chu bo bzhi las rgal ②ba/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi'i zhabs kyi mthil shin tu brtan (kyepa/bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi la yun ring po nas 'dris par byas pa/ mi 'jigs pa bzhis mi 'jigs pa/ khyu mchog gi yang dag pa'i seng ge'i sgra chen po sgrogs pa/ yan lag lnga ④rnam par spangs pa/ 'gro ba lnga las yang dag par 'das pa/yan lag drug dang ldan pa/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs pa/ rtag tu gnas par bya ba drug la gnas pa/ byang chubastogekyi yan lag bdun gyi me tog gis phyug pa/ lam yan lag brgyad pa ston pa/ mthar gyis gnas pa'i5yesnyoms par 'jug pa dgu la mkhas pa/ stobs bcu'i stobs dang ldan pa/phyogs bcur grags pas kun tu rgyas pa/ brgya phrag bcu pa la dbang byed pa bas kyang ches khyad par du 'phags pa rnams ni chos nyid kyis nyin dus gsum mtshan dus gsum du sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis 'jig rten la gzigs te/ su ni rgyad su ni dar/ su ni phongs shinga'ame'adug /su ni nyam nga bar gyur/ su ni gnod pa dang ldan/ su ni phongs pa dang / nyam nga ba dang gnod pa dang ldan/su ni ngan song du gzhol/ su ni ngan song du 'bab/ su ni ngan song du bab/su ni ngas 98)ngan song nas phyung ste mtho ris dang / thar pa dang / 'bras bu la 75—23

gzhag par bya/ su ni 'dod pa'i 'dam du bying ba las lag nas drang bar bya/su ni 'phags pa'i nor bdun med pa las 'phags pa'i nor bdun gyi dbang phyug la dbang byed du gzhug par bya/ su ni dge ba'i rtsa ba rnamasatum bskyed pa rnamasashosalas bskyed par bya/ su ni dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams bskyed zin pa las yongs su smin par bya / su ni yongs su smin zin pa las rnam par grol bar bya snyam du ye shes gzigs pa 'jug go/ /'dir smras pa/ rgya mtsho chu srin rnams kyi gnas/ /dus rlabs ④yol bar 'gyur yang srid/ /gdul bar bya ba'i srasasnyirnams la/ /sangs rgyas dus las yol ba med/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis khye'u le lo can gyis nga mthong na brtson 'grus rtsom par 'gyur te/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi bar du sems yongs su 'gyur bar 'ong ngo snyam du gzigs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis mu stegs can rnams kyi rgyags pa dang / dregs pa gcad pa dang / khye'u'i dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa'i phyir 'od zer gser gyi kha dog can nyi ma stong gi 'od pas melhag pa dag bkyer ste/ de dag gisama'ikhyim de kun tu/snang bar byas so bskal pa stong du yongs su bsgoms pa'i byams pa'i 'od zer dag kyang bkye ste/ de dag gisalgede'i lus la phog ma thag tu rab tu sim lha par gyur nas/ su'i mthus bdag gi lus rab tu sim par byas snyam ste/ des phan tshun du bltas so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi tshogs kyis zhabs 'bring 8byas te khyim de'i nang du gshegs nas khye'u le lo can gyis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sku skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis brgyan pa/ dpe byad bzang po brgyadacacus mdzes par byas pa/ 'od 'dom gang gis brgyan pa/ nyi ma stong bas lhag 75—24

pa'i 'od mnga' ba/ rin po che'i ri bo 'gro ba lta7)bu kun nas bzang ba mthong ngo ske/ /mthong nas kyang mchog tu dga' bar gyur te 'phral la rang nyid langs nas bcom ldan 'das kyi lagadan bshams te bcom ldan 'das tshur gshegs /bcom ldan 'das gshegs pa legs so/ /bcom ldan 'das gdan bshams pa la bzhugs su gsol zhes de skad kyang smras so/ /de nas de'i pha ma dang nang mi rnams kyis sngon ma mthong ba'i gus par sgrim pa mthong nas mchog tu ya mtshan du gyur to/ /de nas khye'u le lo can gyis 55dga' zhing mdangs phyung ba'i mig dang ldan pas bcom ldan 'das kyi56)zhabs la phyag 'tshalashenas chos mnyan pa'i phyir spyan sngar 'dug ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyis de la le lo'i nyes pa dang brtson 'grus rtsom pa'i phan yon rnam pa du ma bka' stsal nas/ tsan dan gyi dbyug nigu zhig kyang de la byin te khye'u dbyug 0gu 'di rdungs shig ces bka' stsal to/ /de nas des dbyug 3 )gu de brdungs pa dang / sgra snyan pa thos par gyur la rin po che'i gter sna tshogs kyang mthong ngo / /de nas derwanya'adi snyam du sems de()/ kye ma brtson 'grus com pa la ni khyad par chen po de lta bu yod kyis1snyel/ bdag gis phyir zhing 0brtson 'grus brtsam 8par bya gor ma chag snyam nas des mnyan du yod par dril gyi ⑩sgra bsgrags 7te/ bdag nyid kyis ded dpon bya bar bsgrags nas rgya mtsho72chen po la lan drug rgal7)te gru'i don grub pas rin po che chen po〈 ) bsdus te/ bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa khyim gyi nang du bshos gsol nas/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu smon lam btab bo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis khye'u le lo can gyi rgyu gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa dang las gcig nas gcig tu 75—25

brgyud pa mkhyen nas 'dzum pa mdzad nyamado/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams gang gi tshe 'dzum pa mdzad pa'i chos nyid de de'i tshe zhal gyi sgo ②nas 'od zer sngon po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang / dkar po rnams byung nas kha cig ni 'og tu 'gro'o/ /kha cig ni steng du 'gro'o/ /'og tu 'gro ba gang yin pa de dag ni sems can dmyal ba yang sos dang / thig nag dang ske/ 'dus 'joms dang / ngu 'bod dang / ngu 'bod chen po dang /tsha ba dang / rab tu tsha ba dang / mnar med pa dang / chu bur can dang /chu bur rdol dang / so thams thams dang / kyi hud zer dang / a chu7zer dang ske/ ud pal ltar gas pa dang / pad ma ltar gas pa dang / pad ma ltar gas pa chen por song nas tsha ba'i sems can dmyal ba gang yin pa de dag tu ni bsil sribar gyur te 'bab bo/ /grang ba'i sems can dmyal ba gang yin pa de dag tu ni 'dro bar gyur te 'bab bo/ / des nasapesems can de dag gi gnod pa'i khyad par rnams cho8)rtse zhil bar gyur to1)/ /de nas de dag 'di snyam du sems te/ kye ci bdag cag 'di nas shi 'phos sam 'on te gzhan du skyes sam snyam mo/ /de nas de dag dad pa /tsho tshobaskyed pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das sprul pa 'gyed par mdzad de/ de dag gis sprul pa mthong nas 'di snyam du sems te/kye bdag cag ni hu1'di nas kyang shi 'phos par ma gyur la gzhan du yang ma skyes mod kyi/ 'on kyang sngon ma byung ba'i sems can snang ba 'di'i mthus/ bdag cag nyu gi gnod pa'i khyad par rnams rtse zhil bar gyur to snyam mo/ /de nas de dag sprul pa de 1lhal sems mngon par dga' bar gyur nas sems can dmyal ba myong bar 'gyur ba'i las de zad de lha dang mi rnams kyi nang du gang du bden pa 75—26

rnams kyi snod du rung bar 'gyur ba der nying mtshams 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /steng du 'gro ba gang yin pa de dag ni rgyal chen bzhi'i ris rnams dang sum cu rtsa gsum pa rnams dang / 'thab bral rnams dang / dga' ldan rnams dang /'phrul dga' rnams dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed rnams dang / tshangs ris rnams dang / tshangs pa'i mdun na 'don pa rnams dang / tshangs pa chen po rnams dang / 'od chung rnams dang / tshad med 'od rnams dang / 'od gsal rnams dang / dge chung rnams dang / tshad med dge rnams dang /dge rgyas rnams dang / sprin med rnams dang / bsod nams skyes rnams dang /'bras7bu che rnams dang / mi che rnams dang / mi gdungadzagernams dang / gya nom snang rnams dang / shin tu mthong rnams dang / 'og min gyi lha rnams kyi bar du song nas/ mi rtag pa dang / sdug bsngal ②ba dang / stong pa dang /bdag med pa'i sgra sgrogs so/ /tshigs su bcad pa gnyis kyang rjod par byed de/nges par 'byung ba brtsam ④par gyis/ /sangs rgyas bstan la sbyor bar gyis/ /'dam bu'i khyim la glangalo5)chen bzhin/ /'chi bdag sde ni gzhom par gyis6)/ /gang zhig chos 'dul 'di nyid la/ /bag yod spyod par byed pa ni/ /skye ba'i 'khor ba rab spangs nasabya / /sdug bsngal zad par byed par 'gyur/ /zhes rjod par byed do/ /de nas 'od zer de dag gis stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams bskor 'byenas/ bcom ldan 'das nyid kyi 7phyi bzhin 'brangs te⑩/ gal te bcom ldan 'das kyis 'das pa'i las lung ston par bzhed na ni bcom ldan 'das kyi snam logs su mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /ma 'ongs pa'i las lung ston par bzhed na ni mdun logs su mi snang bar 'gyur 75—27

ro / /sems can dmyal bar skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni zhabs kyi mthil du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /dud 'gror skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni zhabs kyi rting7)par mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /yi dgas su skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni zhabs kyi mthe bor mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /mir skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni pus mo gnyis su mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /stobs kyi 'khor losalgesgyur ba'i rgyal por lung ston par bzhed na ni phyag g.yon pa'i mthil du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por lung ston par bzhedasnyen ni phyag g.yas pa'i mthil du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /lhar skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni lte bar mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /nyan thos kyi byang chub tu lung ston par bzhed na ni zhal du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub tu lung ston par bzhed na ni smin mtshams cikyi mdzod spur rigami snang bar 'gyur ro/ /bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung ston par bzhed na ni dbu'i gtsug tor du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas 'od zer de dag gis bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi dbu'i gtsug tor du mi snang bar gyur to/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos thal mo sbyar te bcom ldan 4)'das la zhus pa/ tshon sna stong gis spel ba sna tshogs can/ /mang po zhal gyi sgo nas byung bar gyur/ / de yis9)phyogs rnams kun tu snang bar bgyis48)/ /nyi ma shar bas ji ltar bgyis pa bzhin/ /yang tshigs su bcad de gsol pa/ rgod dang bral zhing rgyags dang mi dgyes spangasamatho)pa yi/ /sangs rgyas 'gro ba dag gi sna byedam pa'i rgyur gyur pa/ /rgyal ba dgra thub rnams ni rgyu rkyen ma mchis par11/ /pad ma'i rtsa dang dung mdog lta bu'i 'dzum 75—28

mi ston/ /brtan pos7)nyid kyi blo yis dus bab mkhyen lags na/ /dge sbyong rgyal dbang nyan pa som nyi 'tshal ba rnams/ /thub pa khyu mchog gi ni gsung mchog brtan ⑤pa dang / /bzang po dag gis the tsom skyes pa bsal ⑧bar gsol/ /rgya mtsho dang ni ri rgyal lta bur brtan pa yi/ /mgon po rdzogs sangs rgyas rnams gyin dkyi'adzum mi ston/ /gang gi don du dpa' bo 'dzum pa ston mdzad pa/ /de ni khyod las skye bo phal chen5genyan par 'tshal/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo de ni de bzhin no/ /de ni de bzhin te/ kun dga' bo de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams ni (9)rgyu med rkyen med par 'dzum pa mi mdzad do/ /kun dga' bo khye'u le lo can 'dis nga la 'di lta bu'i bkur sti byas pa mthong ngam(pe/btsun pa mthong lags so/ /kun dga' bo khye'u le lo can 'dishedage ba'i rtsa ba dang ske/ sems bskyed pa dang / sbyin par bya ba'i chos yongs su gtong ba 'dis/ bskal pa grangs med pa gsum gyis yang dag par bsgrub par bya ba'i byang chub yang dag par bsgrubs te/ snying rje chen pose yongs su bsgos pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs par byas nas stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / ma 'dres pa'i dran pa nye b.ralo)gzhag nyu stapa gsum dang / snying rje chen po dang ldan pa'i yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas stobs dang / brtson 'grus dang / mthu rtsal dang shin tu ldan pa zhes bya bar 'gyur te/ 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i sbyin par bya ba'i chos ni gang nga71la mngon par dga' bar gyur pa 'di yin no/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ dge slong de dag yi rangs te /tsho bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la 75—29

mngon par bstod7do// // gang po la sogs pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa brgya pa/ bam po gnyis pa/②ded dpon zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po rnams dang /blon po chen po rnams dang / phyug po rnams dang / pho brangashe'akhor gyi mi rnams dang / tshong dpon rnams dang / ded dpon rnams dang / lha rnams dang ske/ klu rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams dang / lha ma yin rnams dang /nam mkha'adza4)lding rnams dang / mi 'am ci rnams dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis rin ba kur sti byas/ bla mar byas/ ri mo50byas/ mchod pa byas te/ lha dang ske/ klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang ske/ mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis mchod cing shes pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bsod nams chen po dang ldan pa/ na bza' dang /zhal zas dang / gzims cha dang / gdan dang / snyan gsos dang / sman zong rnams brnyes pa/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa mnyanatswadu yod pa na / rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe mnyan 40du yod pa na ded dpon chen po zhig rgya mtsho chen po'i nang du gru bub ste/ phyir 'ongs nas des lan gnyis lan gsum gyi bar du lha thams cad la gsol ba btab ste/ rgya mtsho chen po'i nang du zhugs na 'on kyang gruraṇi bub ste phyir 'ongs so/ /de nas de mi dga' ba chen po skyes nas de 'di snyam du sems te bdag gis thabs gang gis nor bsdu bar bya ba'i thabs ci yod snyam mo/ /yang de 'di snyam du sems te/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'di ni lha thams cad las kyang ches khyad par du 'phags tenyud / bdag la 75—30

phan pa dang gzhan la phan pa la zhugs pa/ thugs rje can bdag nyid chen po chos la gus pa/ skye dgu la mnyes gshin pa yin gyis①/ da ni bdag gis 'di la brten te yang rgya mtsho chen po'i nang du zhugs la gru'i don legs par grub ste〈phyir 'ongs nasal/ nor phyed kyis 'di la mchod pa bya'o snyam mo/ /des de ltar brtson 'grus byas te/ yang rgya mtsho chen po'i nang du zhugs pa dang sangs rgyas kyi mthus rin po che'i gling du phyin nas/ rin po che chen po bsdus te bde ba dang nye zho med par bdag gi khyim du phyin to/ /de ngal bso nas snod bzlugs na/des rin po che rnam pa sna tshogs mthong nas chags pa chen po skyes te/ bdag gis byarin po che 'di lta bu dag dge sbyong go gta ma la phyed ji ltar sbyin snyam du sems pa la zhugs te ma la bdag gis 'di rnams bdag gi chung ma'i lag tu zho'i bzhi cha gcig tu btsongs la/ bcom ldan 'das la spos dbul bar bya gor ma chag snyam mo/ /des zho'i bzhi cha gcig gis a gas ru'i spos nyos nas rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshalanyedu song ngo / /de nas shin tu ngo tsha ba ciskyebazhin du sgo gangam/3 du 'dug nas a garwanyerus bdugs hu so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis gang gis bdug pa de steng gi nam mkha' la yang dag par 'phags te mnyan du yod pa thams cad khyab par gyur nas sprin chen po'i mgo ltar 'dug par 'gyur ba de lta bu'i rdzu 'phrul mngon par 'du bya ba mdzad do/ /des lha dang mi dad par byed pa'i cho 'phrul shin tu rmad du byung ba de mthong nas dga' ba chen po skyes te/bdag gi sems la brgyad bkag nas/ gang bdag gis rin po che'i sgo nas/bcom ldan 'das kyi sku bslu ba 'di ni bdag gi cha ma yin no zhes byas so/ / de nas ⑩ded dpon des bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa 75—31

khyim gyi nang du bshos la spyan drangs so/ /de nas zhal zas bzang pos tshim par byas nas rin po che chen po dag gis gtor to/ /de nas rin po che de dag 'di lta ste/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi sangs rgyas7kyi mthu dang / lha rnams kyi lha'i mthus / bcom ldan 'das kyi dbu'i steng gi nam mkha' la 'phags nas/ rin po che'i khang 5pa dang khang pa brtsegs pa rin po che'i rgyal mtshan can mgar ba'am mgar ba'i slob ma legs par lobs pas kyang byed mi nus pa de lta bur gyur te 'dug go/ /de nas ded dpon des cho 'phrulasade mthong nas ched kyis dga' ba skyes te/ sdong po rtsa ba nas bcad pa bzhin du bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal canas smon lam btab pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba dang sems bskyed pa dang sbyin par bya ba'i chos 5)yongs su gtong ba 'dis bdag 'jig rten long ba 'dren pa med cing yongs su 'dren pa med par ⑥sems can ma bsgral ⑦ba rnams sgrol ba dang / ma grol ba rnams 'grol bsnyedang / dbugs ma phyin pa rnams dbugs 'byin pa dang / yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams yongs su mya ngan las zlo ba'i sangs rgyas su gyur cig tho ces byas so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis ded dpon de'i rgyu gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa dang /las gcig nas gcig du brgyud pa mkhyen nas 'dzum pa mdzad do/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 1 rnams gang gi tshe 'dzum pa mdzad pa'i chos nyid de de'i tshe zhal gyi sgo skyo nas 'od zer sngon po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang 12/ dkar po rnams byung nas/ kha cig ni 'og tu 'gro'o/ /kha cig ni steng du 'gro'o/ /'og tu 'gro ba gang yin pa de dag ni sems can dmyal ba yang sos dang / thig nag dang / 'dus5nye'ajoms dang / ngu 'bod dang / ngu 75—32

'bod chen po dang / tsha ba dang / rab tu tsha ba dang / mnar med pa dang /chu bur can dang / chu bur rdol dang / so thams thams0)dang / kyi hud zer dang / a chu7zer dang / ud pal ltar gas pa dang / pad ma ltar gas pa dang / pad ma ltar gas pa chen por song nas/ tsha ba'i sems can dmyal ba gang yin pa de dag tu ni7bsil bar gyur57te 'bab bo/ /grang ba'i sems can dmyal ba gang yin pa de55)dag tu ni dro bar gyur te 'bab bo/ /des na sems can de dag gi gnod pa'i khyad par rnams rtse zhil bar gyur to(6)/ /de nas de dag 'di snyam du sems te kye ci bdag cag 'di nas shi 'phos sam/'on te gzhan du skyes sam snyam mo/ /de nas de dag dad pa bskyed pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das sprul pa 'gyed par mdzad de/ de dag gis sprul pa mthong nas 'di snyam du sems te/ kye bdag cag ni 'di nas kyang shi 'phos par ma gyur la gzhan du yang ma skyes mod kyi/ 'on kyang sngon ma byung ba'i sems can snang ba 'di'i mthus bdag cag gi gnod 97pa'i khyad par rnams rtse zhil bar gyur to snyam mo/ /de nas de dag sprul pa la sems mngon par dga' bar gyur nas sems can dmyal ba myong bar 'gyur ba'i las de zad de/ lha dang mi rnams kyi nang du gang du bden pa rnams kyi snod du rung bar 'gyur ba 8)der nying mtshams 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /steng du 'gro ba gang yin pa de dag49ni rgyal chen bzhi'i ris rnams dang / sum cu rtsa gsum pa rnams dang / 'thab bral rnams dang /dga' ldan rnams dang / 'phrul dga' rnams dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed rnams dang / tshangs ris rnams dang / tshangs pa'i tshamadun na 'don pa rnams dang / tshangs pa chen po rnams dang / 'od chung rnams dang / tshad 75—33

rgyal ji lhar pham zhing skrag la rdugs te rab tu pham zhing rgyab kyis phyogs par gyur nas/ shing rta gcig pus mnyan du yod par song ngo zhes thos so thos nas kyang ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal ga la ba der song ste phyin nas ①rgyal po gsal rgyal la/ rgyal bar gyur cig sku tshe ring bar shog shig ces bstod nas smras pa/ lha ci'i slad du thugs ngan mdzad/ lha bdag gis jikhutsam gyis na shi da dung yang lha ji ltar dgyes mgur5gemadzad par 'gyur ba de tsam gyi gser lha la 'bul bar 'tshal lo zhes byas so/ /des de la gser gyi phung po chen po spungs te/der mi 'dug pas kyang mi 'greng ba mi mthong la/ 'greng bas kyang 'dug pa mi mthong ba zhig phul lo/ /de nas ko sa la'i rgyashā po gsal rgyal gyis bdag nyid kyi yul du rtog chen gyi mi kun du 45bkye ste mi de 'dag ci zer ba nyon cig ces byas so / /re zhig na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal na/ rgan po gnyis shig phan tshun gtam zer te pad ma'i ze ba zhes 7bya ba'i g.yul gyi (shedagra thabs yod de de la mi snar ma gang yin pa de dag ni g.yul gyi gdong zan du gtong ngo sti/ /'bring gang yin pa de dag ni bar du gzhoganyu ) /mi mchog tu dpa' ba71gang yin pa de dag ni rgyab tu gzhog go zhes zer ro/ /de nas de dag gis rgyal po la bsnyad nyugede ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis thos nas/ de bzhin du dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi go bskon nas rgyal po ma skyes dgra dang g.yul 'gyed pa'i phyir drangs so/ /de nasarwa ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis/ lus 'phags ma'i bu rgyal po ma skyes dgra'i glang po che'i tshogs thams cad kyang phrogs sos/ /rta pa'i tshogs dang / shing rta'i tshogs dang / dpung bu chung gi tshogs kyang phrogasatshamaso//lus 'phags ma'i bu rgyal po ma skyes dgra yang pham zhing skrag la rdugs te rab tu 75—74

pham zhing rgyab kyis bltas7)par gyur nas gson por bzung ste/ shing rta gcig la bskyon nas bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal ri te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas bcom ldan 'das la ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa rgyal po ma skyes dgra 'di ni yun ring po nas bdag gi 'khon7zla ma lags par 'khon gi du 'dzin pa dang / dgra zla ma lags par dgra bgyid pa lags mod kyi/ 'di ni bdag gi grogs po'i bu lags pa'i slad du/ bdag ni 'di 'gum ④par mi 'tshal te 'di gtangs46)bar 'tshal lo zhes gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang rgyal po chen po thongs shig ces bka' stsal nas/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad de bka' stsal pa/ rgyal bar gyur na 'khon⑧pa mang / /pham par gyur na sdug bsngal gnas/ /rgyal dang pham pa spangs na ni/ /nye bar zhi ste bde bar gnas/ /de nas 9ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag gis rgyal srid phyir thob pa 'di ni1 /tshong dpon 'di'i drin yin gyis 37bdag gis 'di la ci 'dod pa'i bya dga' sbyin pa'i skabs dbye'o snyam mo/ /de nas ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis tshong dpon de la ci 'dod pa'i bya dga' sbyin pa'i skabs phye na/ de na re bdag ci dga' ba'i bya dga' 'tshal gyis 12bdag zhag bdun gyi bar du ci dga' mgur 1 bgyid pa'i rgyal srid stsol cig ces byas so/ /de nas ko sa la'i 1 rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis bdag gi yul thams cad 8du dril bsgrags te/ nga'i rgyal srid zhag bdun gyi bar du tshong dpon la byin no zhes bsgo'o/ /re zhig na tshong dpon des sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun rnams dang / rgyal po gsal 75—75

rgyal 'khor dang bcas pa zhag bdun gyi bar du7gdugs tshod la spyan drangs so/ /yul 150shi dang kolagus la na skye bo'i tshogs ji snyed 'khod pa de dag la yang pho nya btang ste/ zhag bdun gyi bar du khyed khral thud med par ci dga' mgur 'khod cing rngo)bde ba la reg par gnas par gyis shig /'dir yang shog la sangs55)rgyas dang chos dang dgetso)'dun la skyabs su song shig bye /nga'i ston mo yang 'tshol 98)la de bzhin gshegs pa la bsnyen bkur gyis shig ces byas nas/des zhag bdun gyi bar du bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa la bkur ste chen pos bkur ste byas so/ /mi 'bum phrag mang po dag kyang bde 9)ba la btsud do/ /zhag bdun lon nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshalatsha1 cite/ sems la rtas nyunyapar byas nas smon lam btab pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba dang sems bskyed pa dang sbyin par bya ba'i chos yongs su gtong ba 'dis/bdag 'jig rten long ba 'dren pa med cing yongs su 'dren pa (rtemed par sems can ma rgal hu ba rnams sgrol ba dang / ma grol ba rnams7'grol ba dang /dbugs ma phyin pa rnams dbugs 'byin pa dang / yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams yongs su mya ngan las zlo ba'i sangs rgyas su gyur cig ces byas so / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshong dpon de'i rgyu gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa dang / las gcig nas 1zhegacig tu brgyud pa mkhyen nas 'dzum pa mdzad do/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams gang gi tshe 'dzum pa mdzad pa'i chos nyid de/ de'i tshe zhal nas 'od zer sngon po dang / ser po dang ske/ dmar po dang 7/ dkar po rnams byung nas kha cig ni 'og tu 'gro'o/ /kha cig ni steng du 'gro'o/ /'og tu 'gro ba gang yin pa de dag ni sems can 75—76

dmyal ba yang sos dang / thig nag dang / 'dus nyu)'joms dang / ngu 'bod dang / ngu 'bod chen po dang / tsha ba dang / rab tu tsha ba dang /mnar med pa dang / chu bur can dang / chu bur rdol dang / so thams thamasaphudang / kyi hud zer dang / a chur zer dang / ud pal ltar gas pa dang ske/ pad ma ltar gas pa dang / pad ma ltar gas pa chen por song nas tsha ba'i sems can dmyal ba gang yin pa de dag tu ni bsil bar gyur te 'bab bo /grang ba'i sems can dmyal ba gang yin pa de dag tu ni dro bar gyur te 'bab (4)bo/ /des na sems can de dag gi gnod pa'i khyad par rnams rtse zhil bar gyur to/ /de nas de dag 'di snyam du sems te/ kye ci bdag55)cag 'di nas shi 'phos sam/ 'on te gzhan du skyes sam snyam mo/ /de nas de dag dad pa bskyed pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das sprul pa 'gyed par mdzad de/ de dag gis sprul pa mthong nas 'di snyam du sems te/ kye bdag cag ni 'di nas kyang shi 'phos par ma gyur la/ gzhan du yang ma skyes mod kyi 'on kyang sngon ma byung ba'i sems can snang ba 'di'i 7mthus bdag cag gi gnod 2pa'i khyad par rnams rtse zhilashebar gyur to snyam lko phyo/ /de nas de dag sprul pa la sems 1nyamangon par dga' bar gyur nas/ sems can dmyal ba myong bar 'gyur ba'i 12las de zad de / lha dang mi rnams kyi nang du gang du bden pa rnams kyi snod du rung bar 'gyur〈khub der nying mtshams 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /steng du 'gro ba gang yin pa de dag ni rgyal chen bzhi'i ris rnams dang / sum cu rtsa gsum pa rnams dang /'thab bral rnams dang / dga' ldan rnams dang / 'phrul dga' rnams dang /gzhan 'phrul dbang byed rnams dang / tshangs ris rnams dang / tshangs pa'i 75—77

mdun na 'don7)pa rnams dang / tshangs pa chen po rnams dang / 'od chung rnams dang / tshad med 'od rnams dang / 'od gsal rnams dang / dge chung rnams dang / tshad med dge rnams dang / dge rgyas rnams dang / sprin med rnams dang / bsod nams skyes rnams dang / 'bras bu che rnams dang /mi che rnams dang / mi gdung rnams dang / gya rnam snang rnams dang / shin tu mthong rnams dang / 'og min gyi lha rnams kyi bar du song nas/ mi rtag pa dang ske/ sdug bsngal ba dang / stong pa dang / bdag med pa'i sgra sgrogs so/ /tshigs su bcad pa gnyis kyang rjod par byed de/ nges par 'byung bshebartsam par gyis/ /sangs rgyas bstan la sbyor bar gyis/ /'dam bu'i khyim la glang chen bzhin/ /'chi bdag sde ni gzhom par gyis/ /gang zhig chos 'dul 'di nyid la/ /bag yod spyod par byed pa ni/ /skye ba'i 'khor ba rab spangs nas/ /sdug bsngal zad par byed par 'gyur/ /zhes rjod par byed do/ /de nas 'od zer de dag gis stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams〈babaskor nas bcom ldan 'das nyid kyi phyi bzhin 'brangs te④kyi/ gal te bcom ldan 'das kyis 'das pa'i las lung ston par bzhed na ni bcom ldan 'das kyi snam logs su mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /ma 'ongs pa'i las lung ston par bzhed na ni mdun logs su mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /sems can dmyal bar skye bar5gelung ston par bzhed na ni zhabs kyi mthil du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /dud 'gror skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni zhabs kyi rting shisapar mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /yi dgas su skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni zhabs kyi mthe bor mi snang bar 'gyur rol/ /mir skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni pus mo gnyis su mi snang bar 'gyur 75—78

rol/ /stobs kyi 'khor los zur ba'i rgyal por lung ston par bzhed na ni phyag g.yon pa'i mthil du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por lung ston par bzhed na ni phyag g.yas pa'i mthil du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /lhar skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni lte bar mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /nyan thos kyi byang chub tu lung ston par bzhed na ni zhal du mi snang bar 'gyur ro6)/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub tu lung ston par bzhed na ni smin mtshams (9kyi mdzod spurasami snang bar 'gyur ro/ /bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung ston par bzhed na ni dbu'i gtsug tor du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas 'od zer de dag gis bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas te bcom ldan 'das kyi dbu'i gtsug tor du mi snang bar gyur to/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos thal mo sbyar te bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ tshon sna stong gis spel ba sna tshogs can/ /mang po zhal gyi sgo nas byung bar gyur/ /de yis phyogs rnams kun tu snang bar bgyis/ /nyi ma shar bas ji ltar bgyis pa bzhin/ /yang tshigs su bcad de gsol pa/ rgod dang bral zhing rgyags dang mi dgyes spangs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas 'gro ba dag gi 4kyidam pa'i rgyur gyur pa/ /rgyal ba dgra thub rnams ni rgyu rkyen ma mchis par/ /pad ma'i rtsa dang dung mdog lta bu'i 'dzum mi ston/ /brtan 5pos nyid kyi kyi blo yis dus bab mkhyen lags na / /dge sbyong rgyal dbang nyan pa som nyi 'tshal ba rnams/ /thub pa khyu mchog gi ni gsung mchog brtan58)pa dang / /bzang po dag gis the tsom skyes pa bsal labar gsol/ /rgya mtsho dang ni ri rgyal lta bur brtan pa yi/ /mgon po rdzogs sangs rgyas rnams gyin da 1 'dzum mi ston/ /gang gi don du dpa' bo 75—79

'dzum pa ston mdzad pa/ /de ni khyod las skye bo phal chen nyan par 'tshal/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo de ni de bzhin no/ /de nim1)de bzhin te/ kun dga' bo de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams ni7rgyu med rkyen med par 'dzum pa mi mdzad do / /kun dga' bo tshong dpon 'dis de bzhin gshegs pa nyan thos kyisnyedage 'dun dang bcas pa la 'di lta bu'i bkur ste byas pa dang skye bo phal po che dge ba la btsud pa mthong ngam/ btsun pa mthong lags so/ /kun dga' bo tshong dpon 'dis bdage ba'i rtsa ba dang sems bskyed pa dang / sbyin par bya ba'i chos yongs su gtong ba 'dis bskal pa grangs med pa gsum gyis yang dag par bsgrub par bya ba'i byang chub yang dag par bsgrubs te/ snying rje chen pos yongs su bsgos pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs par byas nas/ stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / ma 'dres pa'i dran pa nye bar gzhag pa gsum dang / snying rje chen po dang ldan pa'i yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 5nimi 'jigs sbyin zhes bya bar 'gyur yite/ 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i sbyin par bya ba'i chos ni gang nga la sems mngon par dga' bar gyur pa 'di yin no/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/dge slong de dag yi marangs te bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do/ /gang po la sogs pa'i rtogs pa brjod57pa brgya pa las/ sdom gyi tshigs su bcad pa dang po rdzogs sto ne+e// //sdom ni/ mnyan pa dang ni ka ba khrus/ /yams kyi nad dang cho 'phrul 75—80

dang | /lo lnga pa dang bstod0)mchog sbyin/ /ka shi ka dang lha yi zas/ /mnyan pa zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po rnams dang / blon po chen po rnams dang / phyug po rnams dang / pho brang 'khor gyi mi rnams dang /tshong dpon rnams dang / ded dpon rnams dang / lha rnams dang / klu rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams dang / lha ma yin rnams dang / nam mkha' lding rnams dang / mi 'am ci rnams dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis bkur ste byas/ bla mar byas/ ri mor byas/ mchod pa byas te/ lha dang / klu dang rka/ gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis mchod cing shes pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bsod nams chen po dang ldan pa/ na bza' dang / zhal zas dang ske/ gzims cha dang / gdan dang / snyun gsos dang / sman zong rnams brnyes pa/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa mnyan po du yod pa na chu klung khang ldan gyi 'jug ngogs mnyan pa'i grong na bzhugs so/ /de nas mnyan pa de dag bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der dong ste lhags nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal 5nas phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /phyogs gcig tu 'khodaponyenas mnyanam7)pa de dag la bcom ldan 'das kyis chos kyi gtam gyis yang dag par bstan/ yang dag par 'dzin du bcug /yang dag par gzengs stodaphun/ yang dag par dga' bar mdzad do/ /chos kyi gtam rnam grangs du mas yang dag par bstan/ yang dag par 'dzin du bcug /yang dag par gzengs bstoda'achi/ yang dag par dga' bar nyu mdzad nas cang mi gsung bar bzhugs so/ /de nas mnyan 17pa de dag stan las langs te bla 75—81

gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar 6)nas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la ②btsugs te/bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun dang thabs cig tu / chu klung khang ldan gyi 'gram du bdag cag gi der sang gdugs tshod gsol bar ci gnang / gru zam las kyang bsgral bar 'tshal lo zhes gsol nas /bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang mnyan cadapa rnams la cang mi gsung bas gnang ngo / /de nas mnyan 55)pa de dag gis chu klung khang ldan gyi 'gram rdo dang / gseg ma dang glu/ gyo mo med par byas te rgyal mtshan dang ba dan ni bsgreng / me tog sna tshogs ni gtor/ spos kyi snod dag gi54nang nas nim bdug pa gsol/ zhal zas bzang po ni bshams/ me tog mang po ni sta gon byas so/ /gru zam gyi steng yang me tog gi khang pa dag gis brgyanamatshanas/ bcom ldan 'das la phrin gyis gdugs 95tshod bskul ba/ btsun pa gdugs tshod la bab ste bshos lags na/bcom ldan 'das kyis da de'i dus la bab par dgongs te gshegs su gsol zhes bskul to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi tshogs kyis zhabs 'bring 1 byas te/ dge slong gi dge 'dun gyis mdun hu du bdar nas/ mnyan nyugepa'i grong 3 rig la ba der gshegs te byon nas/ dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi gung la gdan bshams khepa la bzhugs so/ /de nas mnyanasapa rnams kyis sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun rnams bde bar bzhugs par rig nas/rang gi lag nas bza' ba dang bca' ba gtsang ma bzang pos tshim par byas te ci bzhed pa bstabs so/ /rang gi lag nas bza' ba dang bca' ba gtsang ma bzang po rnam grangs du mas tshim par byas te ci bzhed pa bstabs nas bcom 75—82

ldan 'das bshosashegasol zin te bstsang52)sder ni gyu / phyag ni bcabs par rig nas/ stan ches dma' ba dag khyer te chos nyan 4pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'khod do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis mnyanas5)pa de dag gi bsam pa dang / bag la nyal ba dang / khams dang / rang bzhin thugs su chud nas 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi rtogs par 'gyur ba de lta bu'i chos bstan te/ de thos pas mnyan 6)pa du mas ni rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu thob bo/ /kha cig gis ni lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu thob bo/ /kha cig gis ni phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu thob bo/ /kha cig gis ni nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs nas/ dgra bcom pa nyidamu mngon sum du byas so/ /kha cig gis ni nyan thos kyi byang chub tu sems bskyedangon/do/ /kha cig gis ni rang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ /kha cig gis ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ /'khor de dag thams cad kyang sangs rgyas la gzhol ba dang / chos la 'bab pa dang / dge 'dun la bab 9)pa la bkod do / /de nas mnyan pa de dag gis bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun dang thabs cig tu bkur sti chen po dang ldan pas gru zam las bsgral to/ /dge slong (nye dag kyang sangs rgyas kyi mchod pa mthong bas sems dga' bar gyur te sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di dag gang du mdzad pa 31lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/dge slong dag de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyis sngon tshe rabs gzhan dag tu tshogs rnyed cing rkyen grub pa dang ldan te/ dba' rgal bzhin du byung 12la gdon mi za bar 'ong ba'i las rnams byas shing bsags te/ des na de bzhin gshegs pa la 75—83

'di lta bu'i mchod pa byas so/ /dge slong dag khyed nyan par 'dod dam/bcom ldan 'das nyan par 'tshal lags so/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa / skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur ba/ bla na med pa lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das shing rta skal ldan zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung ngo ske/ /de dgra bcom pa drug khri nyis stong gis zhabs 'bring7byas te/ ljongs rgyu zhing gshegs pa las gang gā'i 'gram du byonas nas/ de'i tshe ded dpon zhig 'khor brgya phrag du ma dang gang gā'i klung las 'gron ③po dag sgrol zhing 'dug go / /phyogs de na chom rkun50gyi 'jigs pa chen po yang yod do/ /de nas ded dpon gyis yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shing rta skal ldan dgra bcom pa drug khri nyis stong gis 5zham ring byas pa mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang sems dga' bar gyur te/ sems dga' bar gyur nas bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa/bdag gis thog ma kho nar bcom ldan 'das bsgral bar 'tshal lo/ /yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shing rta skal ldan gyis kyang ded dpon la cang mi gsung bas gnang ngo / /de nas ded dpon des yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shing rta skal ldan dgra bcom pa drug khri nyis stong gis zham ring byas pa 'byor pa chen po dang ldan pas po)gru zam las bsgral te zhal zas bzang pos kyang tshim par byas nas/ bla na med pa yang 47)dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu smon lam btab bo/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag khyed ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus na/ ded dpon du gyur pa gang yin pa de ni 75—84

nga yin te ngas yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shing rta skal ldan dgra bcom pa drug khri nyis stong gis zhabs 'bring 3)byas pa/ gru zam las bsgral ba dang /zhal zas bzang pos tshim par byas pa dang / smon lam btab pa'i las de'i rnam par smin pas ngas 'khor ba na bde ba chen po mtha' yas pa nyams su myong la / dasaltar bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa na yang / 'di lta bu'i mchod pa byas so/ /dge slong dag de bas na 'di ltar bslab par bya ste/ ston pa la bkur ste bya'o/ /bla mar bya'o/ /ri mor bya'o/ /mchod pa bya'o/ /ston pa la bkur ste byas/ bla mar byas/ ri mor byas/ mchod pa byas nas/ brten bte gnas par bya'o zhes dge slong khyed kyis de ltar bslab par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ dge slong de dag yi che)rangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// //ka ba zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po rnams dang /blon po chen po rnams dang / phyug po rnams dang / pho brang 'khor gyi mi rnams dang / tshong dpon rnams dang / ded dpon rnams dang / lha rnams dang / klu rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams dang / lha ma yin rnams dang /nam mkha' lding rnams dang / mi 'am ci rnams dang / lto 'phye 6chen po rnams kyis bkur ste byas/ bla mar byas/ ri mor byas/ mchod pa byas te/ lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang ske/ mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis mchod cing shes pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bsod nams chen po dang ldan pa/ na bza' dang /75—85

zhal zas dang / gzims cha dang / gdan dang / snyun gsos dang / sman zong rnams brnyes pa/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa ku ru'i ljongs rgyu zhing gshegs pa las ku ru'i grong khyer du byon te0)/ ku ru'i skye bo'i tshogs de dag kyang sangs rgyas kyis gdul bar 'gyur bar (kyesems rgya chen po dang ldan pa/sbyin pa la sred pa sha stag go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das 'di snyam du dgongs te/ngas lha'i dbang po brgya byin lha'i 'khor gyisarte5)bskor ba dgug go/ /'on kyangasnyide mthong bas 'di rnams kyi dge ba 'phel bar 'gyur ro snyam du dgongs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'jig rten pa'i dgongs pa bskyed de/ kye ma lha'i dbang po brgya byin lha'i tshogs kyis g.yog byas pas/ tsan dan sa mchog pa'i ka ba khyer te/ 'ongs na legs so snyam du dgongs nas/ dgongs pa bskyed pa'i mod la lha'i dbang po brgya byin lha'i tshogs kyis g.yog55)byas pa/ gang na las thams cad pa dang rgyal po chen po chubazhi dang / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / grul bum du mas g.yog byas pa dag lhags te tsan dan sa mchog pa'i ka ba khyer te 'ongs nas/ ha ha zhes ca co dang ga zha bton te skad chen po 7)phyung nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi phyir tsan dan sa mchog pa'i khang bzangs chos legs par byas so/ /de nas khang bzangs57der lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis/ bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi hu )dge 'dun dang bcas pa la/lha'i zhal zas dang / lha'i gzims cha dang / gdan dang / lha'i spos dang /me tog 31phreng ba dag gis bkur sti byas/ bla mar byas/ ri mor byas/mchod pa 1 byas so/ /de nas ku ru'i skye bo'i tshogs rnams kyis lha'i 'byor pa de dag mthong ba dang / mchog 1nyetu ya mtshan du gyur nas 'di snyam du sems te/75—86

'di ltar bcom ldan 'das la dbang po dang bcas pa'i lha rnams kyis mchod pa lasanyen/ 'jig rten na mchog yin pa lta snyam ste/ sems 'dun par gyur nas / bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du song ste bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshalashenas phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /phyogs gcig tu 'khod nas/ ku ru'i skye bo'i tshogs rnams khang bzangs /de la shin tu dga' ba skyes so/ /de nas bcom ldan5pa'adas kyis khang bzangs nade mi snang bar mdzad nas/ mi rtag pa nyid dang ldan pa'i 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi rtogs par 'gyur ba de lta bu'i chos bstan te/ de thos nas ku ru'i mi rnams las kha cig gis ni rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu thob bo/ /kha cig gis ni lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu thob bo/ /kha cig gis ni phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu thob bo/ /kha cig gis ni nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs nas dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sumatsha46)du byas so/ /kha cig gis ni nyan thos kyi byang chub tu sems bskyed 7)do/ /kha cig gis ni rang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ /kha cig gis ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ /'khor de dag thams cad kyang sangs rgyas la gzhol ba dang / chos la 'bab pa dang / dge 'dun la bab pa la bkod do/ /dge slong rnams kyang sangs rgyas kyi mchod pa mthong bas sems dga' bar gyur te/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di dag gang du mdzad lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyis sngon tshe rabs gzhan dgas tu tshogs rnyed cing rkyen grub pa dang ldan te/ dba' rgal bzhin du byung zlotshol/ gdon mi za bar 'ong ba'i las rnams byas shing bsags te/75—87

des na de bzhin gshegs pa la 'di lta bu'i mchod pa byas so/ /dge slong dag khyed nyan par 'dod dam/ bcom ldan 'das nyan par 'tshalashelags so/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i57kha lo sgyur ba/ bla na med pa lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das tshangs pa zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung ngo / /de nas yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas tshangs pa dgra bcom pa drug khri nyis stong gis zhabs 'bring50byas te/ ljongs rgyu zhing gshegs pa las rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor zhig tu byon nas/ rgyal rigs spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba'i rgyal pos yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas tshangs pa dgra bcom pa drug khri nyis stong gis zhabs 'bring ④byas pa ljongs rgyu zhing gshegs pa las/ bdag gi yul du byon to zhes thos so/ /thos nas kyang rgyal po'i 'byor pa chen po dang5ge/ rgyal po'i mthu chen pos bcom ldan 'das yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas tshangs pa ga la ba der song ste 0phyin nas/yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas tshangs pa'i zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshalakhute / phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas/ rgyal rigs spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba'i rgyal po/ bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub 'thob5separ byed pa'i chos rnams la yang dag par btsud do/ /de nas rgyal po de dga' bar gyur 9rinas stan las langs te bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud denyu )/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /hu7bcom ldan 'das la bdag gis na bza' dang 75—88

zhal zas dang / gzims cha dang / gdan dang 9) snyun gsos dang /sman zong rnams kyis bsnyen bkurasabagyi bar 'tshal na/ bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang thabs cig tu rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor 'dir zla ba gsum gyi bar du bzhugs par ci gnang / de nas yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas tshangs pas rgyal po la cang mi gsung bas gnang ngo / /de nas rgyal rigs spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba'i rgyal po des/ bcom ldan 'das kyi phyir tsan dan sa mchog pa'i khang bzangasam byed du bcug go/ /des de la na bza' dang rgyan rnam pa sna tshogs kyis brgyan nas/ me tog sna tshogs kyis ni gtor/ pog phor dag gis ni bdugs54 te/ bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa la phul nas/ zla ba gsum gyi bar du zhal zas bzang pos tshim par byas te/ na bza'i khyad par rnam pa sna tshogs 5phul nas/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yang smon lam btab bo/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag khyed ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus na rgyal rigs spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba'i rgyal por gyur pa gang yin pa de ni nga yin te/ ngas yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas tshangs pa la de lta bu'i mchod pa byas pa'i las kyi rnam par smin pa des na/ ngas 567'khor ba na bde ba chen po mtha' yas pa nyams su myong 7)la da 57ltar bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par lho)sangs rgyas pa na yang 'di lta bu'i mchod pa byas so/ /dge slong dag de bas na 'di ltar bslab par bya ste ston pa la bkur sti bya'o/ /bla mar bya'o/ /ri mor bya'o/ /mchod pa nya bya'o/ /ston pa la bkur ste byas/ bla mar byas/ ri mor byas/ mchod pa byas nas brten te 75—89

gnas par bya'o zhes dge slong khyod (7kyis de ltar bslab par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas chadage slong de dag yi snyurangs te/bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// // gang po la sogs pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa brgya pa/ bam po bzhi pa④/khrus zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la mirgyal po rnams dang /blon po chen po rnams dang / phyug po rnams dang / pho brang 'khor gyi mi rnams dang ske/ tshong dpon rnams dang / ded dpon rnams dang / lha rnams dang /klu rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams dang / lha ma yin rnams dang / nam mkha' lding rnams dang / mi 'am ci rnams dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis bkur ste byas/ bla mar byas/ ri mor byas/ mchod pa byas te/ lha dang /klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyisalamachod cing shes pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bsod nams chen po dang ldan pa/ na bza' dang / zhal zas dang / gzims cha dang / gdan dang / snyun gsos dang / sman zong rnams brnyes pa/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa mnyan du yod pa na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe mnyan du yod pa na 3)tshong pa lnga brgya tsam dgon pa'i lam du zhugs pa las de dag lam stor nas/ bye stongasam3)shig tu phyin te/ de dag lam gyi ngal bas dkos methag cing rgyags zad la/ nyi ma'i gung la nyi mtshan gyis gdungs nas/ nya skam 31la 1 bton pa bzhin du sa la 'gre 3)ldog ste sdug bsngal drag pa 1byudang / mi bzad pa dang / tsha ba dang / yid du mi 'ong ba'i tshor ba 75—90

myong bas①/ gu langasnyodang / chu lha dang / ku be ra dang / brgya byin la sogs pa lha stong snyed la so sor gsol ba 'debs kyang de las skyob par nus pa med do/ /de'i nang na⑧dge bsnyen sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i rgyus shes pa zhig yod de/ des tshong pa de dag la smras pa/ khyed sangs rgyas la skyabs su song shig /de nas thams cad kyis skad sdoms ④te skyabs su song ngo / /de'i skabs su sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis ni mi mkhyen pa'am/ mi gzigs pa'am/ misnyirtogs pa'am/ thugs su mi chud pa ci yang med la/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa 'jig rten la phan 'dogs pa la zhugs pa/ srung4ba gcig pa rtsomodang ldan pa/ gcig tu dpa' ba / zla med pa/ gnyis su mi gsung ba/ zhi gnas dang lhag mthong la gnas pa/ rig pa gsum snang bar mdzad pa/ bslab pa gsum la legs par bslabs pa/ 'dul ba'i gzhi gsum du la mkhas pa/ chu bo bzhi las rgal 9ba/rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa skyabazhi'i zhabs kyi mthil shin tu brtan pa/ bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi la yun ring po nas 'dris par byas pa/ mi 'jigs pa bzhis mi 'jigs pa/ khyu mchog gi yang dag pa'i seng ge'i sgra chen po sgrogs pa/ yan lag lnga rnam par spangs 11pa/ 'gro ba lnga las yang dag par 'das pa/ yan lag drug dang ldan pa/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs pa/ rtag tu gnas par bya ba drug la gnas pa/ byang chub kyi yan lag bdun gyi me tog gis phyug pa/ lam yan lag brgyad pa ston pa/ mthar gyis snyoms par 'jug pa dgu la mkhas pa/ stobs bcu'i stobs dang ldan pa/ phyogs bcur grags pas kun du rgyas pa/ brgya phrag bcu pa la dbang byed pa bas kyang ches khyad par du 75—91
