rnams dang / sum cu rtsa gsum pa rnams dang / 'thab bral rnams dang /dga' ldan rnams dang / 'phrul dga' rnams dang /(7 gzhan 'phrul dbang byed rnams dang / tshangs ris rnams dang / tshangs pa'i mdun⑧na 'don pashernams dang / tshangs pa chen po rnams dang / 'od chung rnams dang / tshad med 'od rnams dang / 'od gsal rnams dang / dge chung rnams dang /tshad med dge rnams dang / dge rgyas rnams dang / sprin med rnams dngasnyi/bsod nams skyes rnams dang / 'bras bu ches)rnams dang / mi che0rnams dang ske/ mi gdung rnams dang / gya nom snang rnams dang / shin tu mthong rnams dang / 'og min gyi lha rnams kyi bar du song nas/ mi rtag pa dang /sdug bsngal ba dang / stong pa dang / bdag med pa'i sgra sgrogs so/ /tshigs su bcad pa gnyis kyang rjod par byed degye/ nges par 'byung ba brtsamanyepar gyis / /sangs rgyas bstan la sbyoralo1)bar gyis/ /'dam bu'i khyim la glang chen bzhin / /'chi bdag sde ni gzhom par gyis/ gang zhig chos 'dul 'di nyid la / /bag yod spyod par skyo dzesabyed pa ni/ /skye ba'i 'khor ba rab spangs nas/ /sdug bsngal zad par byed par 'gyur/ /zhes rjod par byed do/ /de nas 'od zer de dag gis stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams bskor nas/bcom ldan 'das nyid kyi phyi bzhin 'brangs te(1/ gal te bcom ldan 'das kyis 'das pa'i las lung ston par bzhed na ni bcom ldan 'das kyi snam hu logs su mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /ma 'ongs pa'i las lung ston par bzhed na ni mdun logs su mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /sems can dmyal bar skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni zhabs kyi mthil du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /dud 'gror skye 75—142

bar lung ston par bzhed na ni zhabs kyi rting par mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /yi dgas su skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ①ni zhabs kyi mthe bor mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /mir skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni pus mo gnyis su mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /stobs7kyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por lung ston⑧par bzhed na ni phyag g.yon pa'i mthil du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por lung ston par bzhed na ni phyag g.yas pa'i mthil tu mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /lhar skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni lte bar mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /nyan thos kyi byang chub tu lung ston par bzhed na ni zhal du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub tu lung ston par bzhed na ni smin mtshams kyi mdzod spur gemi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung ston par bzhed na ni dbu'i gtsug tor du mi snang bar ba'agyur ro/ /de nas 'od zer de dag gis bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas te bcom ldan 'das kyi dbu'i gtsug tor du mi snang bar gyur to/ /de nas tshe dang ldanapo)pa kun dga' bos thal mo sbyar te bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ tshon sna stong gis spel ba sna tshogs can/ /mang po zhal gyi sgo nas byung bar gyur/ /de yis phyogs rnams kun tu snang bar bgyis/ /nyi ma shar bas ji ltar bgyis pa bzhin//yang tshigs su bcad de gsol pa/ rgod dang bral zhing rgyags dang mi dgyes tsho7)spangs pa yi / /sangs rgyas 'gro ba dag gi dam pa'i rgyur gyur pa/ /rgyal ba dgra thub rnams ni rgyu rkyen ma mchis par/ /pad ma'i rtsa dang dung mdog lta bu'i 'dzum mi ston/ /brtan pos nyid kyi blo yis dus bab mkhyen lags na/ /dge sbyong rgyal dbang nyan pa som nyi 'tshal ba rnams/ /thub pa khyu mchog gi ni gsung 75—143

mchog brtan pa dang / /bzang po dag gis the tshomanyeskyes pa bsal bar gsol/ /rgya mtsho dang ni ri rgyal lta bur brtan pa yi/ /mgon po rdzogs sangs rgyas rnams gyin dku'adzum mi ston/ /gang gi⑧don du dpa' bo 'dzum pa ston mdzad pa/ /de ni khyod las skye bo phal chen nyan par 'tshal/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo de ni de bzhin no/ /de ni de bzhin te/ kun dga' bo de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams ni rgyu med rkyen medasnyipar 'dzum pa mi mdzad do/ /kun dga' bo khyim bdag 'dis nga la 'di lta bu'i bkur sti byas pa mthong ngam/ btsun pa mthong lags so/ /kun dga' bo khyim bdag 'di dge ba'i rtsa ba dang sems bskyed pa dang sbyin par bya ba'irtsomachos yongs su gtong ba 'dis/ bskal pa grangs med pa gsum gyis yang dag par bsgrub par bya ba'i /byang chub yang dag par bsgrubs te57ri / snying rje chen pos yongs su bsgos pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs par byas nas/ stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa⑥bzhi dang / ma 'dres pa'i dran pa nye bar gzhag pa gsum dang / snying rje chen po dang ldan pa'i yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas lha'i zas sbyin zhes bya bar 'gyur57te 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i sbyin par bya ba'i chos ni gang nga la sems mngon par dga' bar gyur pa 'di yin no/ /skabs 'di ma ga d+ma'i rgyal po gzugs can snying po dang g.yog 'khor rnams kyis thos nas mchog tu ya mtshan du gyur totunye/ /de nas dge slong dag the tshom skyes te/ the tshom thams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ bcom ldan 'das khyim bdag 'dis bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa la lha dang 75—144

mi'i 'byor pa dag gis mchod pa bgyis pa la gzigs/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyis sngon tshe rabs gzhan dag tu tshogs rnyed cing rkyen grub pa dang ldan te dba' rgal bzhin du 'byung la/ gdon mi za bar 'ong ba'itulas de dag byas shing bsags〈kyepas na/nga ②nyid kyis las byas shing bsagasalgepa 'di dag gzhan su zhig gis nyams su myong bar 'gyur te/ dge slong dag las byas shing bsags pa rnams ni phyi rol gyi sa'i khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur/ chu'i khams dang / me'i khams dang / rlung gi khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur te/ las dge ba dang mi dge ba byas shing bsags ⑥pa rnams ni zin pa'i phung po dang khams dang skye mched rnams 'ba' zhig la rnam par smin par 47'gyur ro/ /lus can dag gi las rnams ni/ /bskal pa brgyar yang chud mi za/ /tshogs shing dus la bab pa na / /'bras bu nyid du smin par 'gyur/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu gdul bya'i52)kha lo sgyur ba/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang po zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung ngo //de nas yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang po ljongs rgyu zhing gshegs pa las rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor zhig tu byon te/ rgyal rigs spyi bo nas7dbang bskur ba'i rgyal po des/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang po ljongs rgyu zhing gshegs pa las rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor der byon to zhes thos so/ /thos nas kyang rgyal po'i 'byor pa chen po dang rgyal po'i mthu chen po dang ldan pas/75—145

yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang po ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang po'i zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshalanyete phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas rgyal rigs spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba'i rgyal po de yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang pos byang chub 'thobasho par byed pa'i chos rnams yang dag par 'dzin du bcug go/ /de nas rgyal rigs spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba'i rgyal po des/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas tshigang po nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa la5 )zla ba gsum gyi bar du na bza' dang / zhal zas dang / gzims cha dang / gdan dang /snyun gsos dang / sman zong rnams la spyan drangs so/ /yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang pos kyang cang mi gsung bas gnang ngo / /de nas rgyal rigs spyi bo nas dbang bskur geba'i rgyal po des yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang pos cang mi gsung bas gnang bar rig nas zla ba gsum gyi bar du na bza' dang / zhal zas dang / gzims cha dang / gdan dang / snyun gsos dang / sman zong rnams kyis bsnyen bkur byas so/ /bcom ldanamanya'adas kyi sku gzugs kyang rin po che las byas te(9ri/ sangs rgyas kyi dga' ston byas nas der srogaspobachags 'bum phrag du mamathonodad pa chen po thob stoḥ/ rgyu de dang rkyen des de dag yongs su mya ngan las 'das so/ /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems / de'i tshe de'i dus na rgyal por gyur pa gang yin pa de ni nga yin te/ngas yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang po la de lta bu'i mchod pa byas pa des na/ ngas 'khor ba na bde ba mtha' yas pa nyams su myong 17ste/ de nyid kyi rgyus da ltar de bzhin gshegs par gyur pa na yang nga la tshong dpon dang brgya 75—146

byin gyis 'di lta bu'i mchod pa byas so/ /dge slong dag de bas na 'di ltar bslab par bya ste/ ston pa la bkur ①ste bya'o/ /bla mar bya'o/ /ri mor bya'o / /mchod pa bya'o/ /ston pa lam bkur ste byas/ bla mar byas/ ri mor byas / mchod pa byas nas brten te gnas par bya'o zhes dge slong khyed kyis de ltar bslab par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas dge slong de dag yisarangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do/ /gang po la sogs pa'i snyirtogs pa brjodamanyapa brgya (6)pa las/ sdom gyi tshigs su bcad pa gnyis pa rdzogs so ge // // gang po la sogs pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa brgya pa bam po drug pa/(2) sdom ni/tsan dan dang ni pad ma dang / /de bzhin 'khor lo mgo bcu pa/ /mdog 'jam dang ni 'od bsil dang / /mnyan pa dang ni spos ngad ldang / /dri med gdangs snyan zhes bya ba/ /sde tshanashedag tu bstan pa yin/ /tsan dan zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po rnams dang / blon po chen po rnams dang / phyug po rnams dang / pho brang 'khor gyi mi rnams dang / tshong dpon rnams dang / ded dpon rnams dang / lha rnams dang / klu rnams dang ske/ gnod sbyin rnams dang / lha ma yin rnams dang / nam mkha' lding rnams dang / mi 'am ci rnams dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis bkur sti byas / bla mar byas/ ri mo byas/ mchod pa byas te/ lha dang / klu dang /gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang /lto 'phyemanyachen po rnams kyis mchod cing shes pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 75—147

bsod nams chen po dang ldan pa/ na bza' dang / zhal zas dang /gzims cha dang / gdan dang / snyan gsos dang / sman zong rnams brnyes pa/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa/ yul ma ga ṅgātun ljongs rgyu zhing gshegs pa las gang gā'i klung gi 'gram du byon to/ /de'i tshe gang gā'i klung gi⑧'gram nas thag mi ring ba zhig na⑧mchod rten zhig ral du gyur pa rlung dang nyi tshanasnyigyis bshig pa zhig 'dug pa de dge slong rnams kyis mthong nas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ bcom ldan 'das mchod rten 'di su'i lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rang sangs rgyas tsan dan zhes bya ba zhig byung ste de'i yin no/ /dge slong rnams kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das rang sangs rgyas tsan dan ga las byung lags/ ming ni ci las btags lags/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag khyedarnyurang sangs rgyas tsan dan ga las byung ba dang / ming ci las btags pa nyan par 'dod dam/gsol pa/ btsun pa mnyan7par 'tshal lags so/ /bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag 'o na legs par rab tu nyon la yid la zungasheshig dang ngas bshad do/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na/ grong khyer bā rā ṇa sbomanyen rgyal po tshangs byin ⑨zhes bya ba zhig rgyal po byed de/ de'i ring la 'byor pa dang /rgyas pa dang / bde ba dang / lo legs pa dang / skye bo dang / mi mang pos gang ba dang / rtsod pa dang 'thab pa zhi ba dang / 'khrug pa dang / nang 'khrug5medang / chom rkun dang / mu ge dang / nad rnams med pa dang /'bras sātswalu dang / bu ram shing dang / ba lang dang / ma te dang ldan pa〈pe'adug go/ /rgyal po de yang chos can chos dang ldan pa'i rgyal po chos bzhin du 75—148

rgyal po byed do/ /de bu med nas bu 'dod de gu lang dang / chu lha dang / ku be ra dang / brgya byin dang / tshangs pa la sogs pa dang / lha'i7khyad par gzhan dag la7yang gsol ba 'debs te 'di lta ste/ kun dga' ra ba'i lha dang / nags tshal gyi lha dang / lam gyi bzhi mdo'i lha dang / sum mdo'i lha dang ske/ gtor ma len pa'i lha dang / lhan cig skyes pashedang / chos 'thun pa dang / rtag tu phyi bzhin 'brang ba'i⑧lha rnams la yang gsol ba 'debs so/ /'jig rten na yang gsol ba btab pa'i rgyus bu dang bu mo7skye bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes bya ba'i gtam de yod mod kyi de yang de lta ni ma yin te/ gal te gsol ba btab pa'i rgyus bu dang bu mo skye bar 'gyur du zin na/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po bzhin du re re la yang bu stong stong yod par 'gyur ba'i rigs so/ /ye ni gnas gsum tshogs pa las bu dang bu mo skye bar 'gyur te gsum gang zhe na/pha ma gnyis 'dod chags langs te phrad pa dang / ma dus la bab cing zla mtshan dang ldan pa dang / dri za 'ongs pa ste gnas 'di gsum tshogs pa las bu dang bu mo skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de yang gsol ba 'debs pa lhur byed cing 'dug la desalgeskyed mos tshal gyi rdzing chen po zhig yod pa de'i nang nas kyang pad ma tshad las 'das ⑧par che ba zhig skyes te/ de nyin ⑨gcig bzhin du cher skye la kha ni mi 'bye brwanyezhig yod do/ /de nas kun dga' ra ba'i srung〈nyams rgyal po la gsol to/ /de nas rgyal pos kyang pad ma de legs par srungs shig ces bsgo'o/ /phyis re zhig na nyi ma 'char kur pad ma de kha bye nas pad ma de'i snying po la khye'u gzugs bzang zhing blta〈rten sdug la mdzes pa mdog bzang balgegaser gyi kha dog can mgo bo gdugs ltar 'dug pa/ lag pa ring ba/ dpralasnyiba'i dbyes che 75—149

ba / sna mtho ba/ sna legs pa/ smin ma stug pa/ lus skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis7legs par brgyan pa/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus mdzes par byas pa zhig skyil mo krungakhubacas shing 'dug ste/ de'i kha nas ni pad ma'i dri 'byung la/ lus las ni tsan dan gyi dri 'byung ngo / /de nas kun dga' ra ba'i srung〈nyams kyang rgyal po la gsol to/ /de nas rgyal po blon po dang btsun mo dang bcas pa skyed7mos tshal du dong nas/ khye'u des mthong ma thag tu rgyal po la smras pa/ yab tshur gshegs bdag ni khyod sras mi mnga' ba'i sras lags so/ /de nas rgyal po dga' zhing mgu la yisnyirangs nas smras pa/bu de ni khyod ji skad zer ba bzhin no/ /de nas rgyal po rdzing gi nang du zhugs nas / pad ma'i snying po las khye'u blangs te lag par bzhag go/ /de nas khye'u des gang dang gang du rkang pa bzhag pa de dang der pad ma dag byung ngo / /de nas de'i ming tsan dan zhes btags so/ /gang gi tshe khye'u tsan dan khad kyis cher skyes pa de'i tshe ⑦grong khyer gyi mi rnams kyis rgyal po la phyagasol pa/ lha bdag cag gi grong khyer 'dir dus ston byung na lha sras tsan dan btang ba'i rigs so/ /'on kyang nyu)bdag cag dang lhan cig tu dus ston myong bar 'gyur la gnas thams cad kyang pad mas brgyan par 'gyur lags so/ /rgyal pos smras pa de ltar bya'o/ /de nas tsan dan rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ blon po'i bu rnams kyis g.yog 'khor dang bcas pa/ rol mo'i sgra rnam pa sna tshogs byed cing grong khyer gyi dus ston myong bar bya ba'i phyir rgyal po'i pho brang nas phyi rol du byung /1ngo / /de nas de der 'gro ba na gom pa re re la pad ma bltam8na sdug cing yid 'phrog pa dag byung ste/ de dag larwa nyi ma'i 'od zer gyis phog ma thag tu 75—150

rnyis shing skams sel/ /de nas sems can dag pa bsam pa dge ba sngon sangs rgyas la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed bskyedakupa des de mthong nas tshul bzhin⑧yid la byed pa skyes te/ ji ltar pad ma 'di dag skyes pa'i mod la ni mdzes par ④'dug la nyi ma'i 'od zerasnyigyis gdungs pas7ni/ rnyis shing skam7par 'gyur ba de bzhin du lus 'di yang de dang 'dra'o snyam mo/ /de de ltar sems shing 'jal la nye bar rtog pa na/ byang chub kyi phyogs dang 'thun pa'i chos sum cu rtsa bdun mngon du gyur te/ des skye bo'i tshogs kyi nang na/ 'dug bzhin du rang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub mngon sum du byas so/ /de nas re zhig na gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha rnams kyis de la gos tshon can dag phul te de dag bgos nas/ nam mkha' la 'phags te cho tshon 'phrul rnam pa sna tshogs byas nas/ de mthong bas rgyal po dang blon po dang grong rdal gyi mi rnams dang bcas par 6)dga' ba chen po thob stekho/ dge ba'i rtsa ba rnam pa sna tshogs kyang bskyed do/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag rang sangs rgyas tsan dan ni de las byung ste/ ming yang de las btags so/ /dge slong rnams kyis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa rang sangs rgyas tsan dan gyis las gang dag bgyis shing bsags 11/na/ des〈rtede'i lus kyang dri bda'aphartel dbang po lngakheyang rno bar gyur lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/bcom ldan 'das 'od srung gi bstan pa la rab tu byung gho/ des der dbu skra dang sen mo'i mchod rten la spos chu'i dbang bskur ba yang phul/ me tog dag kyang btags te/ der rang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub kyi lam yang7bsgoms so/ /dge slong dag de bas na 'di ltar bslab par bya ste/ ston pa la bkur ste bya'o//75—151

bla mar bya'o/ /ri mo7bya'o/ /mchod pasabya'o/ /ston pa la bkur7lta byas/bla mar byas/ ri mosabyas/ mchod pa byas nas brten te gnas par bya'o zhes dge slong khyodakyikyis de ltar bslab par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ dge slong de dag yirnyurangs te bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// //pad ma zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po rnams dang /blon po chen po rnams dang / phyug po rnams dang / pho brang 'khor gyi mi rnams dang ske/ tshong dpon rnams dang / ded dpon rnams dang / lha rnams dang / klu rnams dang /⑦ gnod sbyin rnams dang / lha ma yin rnams dang /⑧nam mkha' lding rnams dang / mi 'am ci rnams dang7/ lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis bkur ste byas/ bla mar byas/ ri mo〈nyebyas/ mchod pa byas te/lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' sdingamoskyedang ske/ mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis mchod cing shes pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bsod nams chen po dang ldan pa/ na bza' dang /zhal zas dang / gzims cha dang / gdan dang / snyun gsos dang / sman zong rnams brnyes pa nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa mnyan du yod pa na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe yul dbus na 'khod pa rnams kyi lugs kyis na/ kun dga' ra ba'i srung〈nyem rnams kyis pad ma dag blangs te srang du song zhing 'tshong ngo ske/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das snga dro sham thabs dang chos gos gsol te lhung bzed bsnams nas mnyan du yod par bsod snyoms la gshegs so/ /bud med 75—152

cig kyang khye'u zhig pang na thogs te srang du song ba las khye'u des sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sku skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis legs par brgyan pa/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus mdzes par byas pa/ 'od 'dom gang gis brgyan pa/ nyi ma stong bas lhag pa'i 'od mnga' ba/ rin po che'i ri bo 'gro ba lta bu kun nas bzang ba mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang dga' ba skyes te blo thorashidu lag pa brkyang nas kun dga' ra ba'i srungasam las pad ma blangs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbu la bor ro/ /de nas pad ma de shing rta'i 'phang lalo tsam du gyur te steng gi nam mkha' la 'dug nas bcom ldan 'das gshegs na ni 'gro la gzhesasren ni sdod do⑤/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis pad ma rā ga'i mdog 'dra ba'i 'od zer dag bkye nas/ des mnyan du yod paraphuril gyis snang bar byas so/ /rgyu des na rgyal po dang blon po dang pho brang 'khor gyi mi rnams dad par byas so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'dzum pa mdzad do/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams gang gi7tshe 'dzum pa mdzad pa'i chos nyid de/ de'i tshe zhal nas 'od zer sngon po dang / ser po dang —/ dmar po dang / dkar po rnams byung nas kha cig ni 'og tu 'gro'o/ /kha cig ni steng du 'gro'o/ /'og tu 'gro ba gang yin pa de dag ni sems can dmyal ba yang sos dang / thig nag dang / 'dusasnyi'ajoms dang / pulge'abod dang / ngu 'bod chen po dang / tsha ba dang / rab tu tsha ba dang /mnar med pa dang / chu bur can dang / chu bur rdol7dang / so thams thams dang / kyi hud zer dang / a chu zer dang / ud pal ltar gas pa dang / pad ma ltar gas pa dang / pad ma ltar gas pa chen por song nas/75—153

tsha ba'i sems can dmyalapha3)ba gang yin pa de dag tu ni bsil bar gyur te 'bab bo / /grang ba'i sems can dmyal ba gang yin pa de dag tu ni dro bar gyur te 'bab bo/ / des na tsunosems can de dag gi gnod pa'i khyad par rnams rtse zhil bar gyur to/ /de nas de dag 'di snyam du sems te/ kye ci bdag cag 'di nas shi 'phos sam 'on te gzhan du skyes sam snyam mo/ /de nas de dag dad pa bskyed pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das sprul pa 'gyed par mdzad de/ de dag gis sprul pa mthong nas 'di snyam du sems te/ kye bdag cag ni 'di nas kyang shi 'phos par ma gyur la gzhan du yang ma skyesamacho mod kyi/ 'on kyang sngon ma byung ba'i sems can snang ba 'di'i mthus/ bdag cag gi gnod pa'i khyad par rnams rtse cazhil bar gyur to snyam mo/ /de nas de dag sprul pa la sems mngon par dga' bar gyur nas/ sems can dmyal bas49rtsong bar 'gyur ba'i las de zad de lha dang mi rnams 6)kyi nang du gang du bden pa rnams kyi snod du rung bar 'gyur ba der nying mtshamasamanya'adzin par 'gyur ro/ /steng du 'gro ba gang yin pa de dag ni rgyal chen bzhi'i ris rnams dang sum cu rtsa gsum pa rnams dang /'thab bral rnams dang / dga' ldan rnams dang / 'phrul dga' rnams dang /gzhan 'phrul dbang byed rnams dang / tshangs ris rnams dang / tshangs pa'i mdun nan 'don pa rnams dang / tshangs pa chen po rnams dang / 'od chung〈)rnams dang / tshad med 'od rnams dang / 'od gsal rnams dang / dge chung rnams dang / tshad med dge rnams dang / dge rgyas rnams dang / sprin med rnams dang / bsod nams skyes rnams dang / 'bras bu che rnams dang /mi che rnams dang / mi gdungs rnams dang / gya rnam snang 31rnams dang /75—154

shin tu mthong rnams dang / 'og min gyi lha rnams kyi bar du song nas mi rtag pa dang ske/ sdug bsngal ba dang / stong pa dang / bdag med pa'i sgra sgrogs so/ /tshigs su bcad pa gnyis kyang rjod par byed de/ nges par 'byung btubartsam par gyis/ /sangs rgyas bstan la sbyor b.radza gyis/ /'dam bu'i khyim la glang chen bzhin/ /'chi bdag sde ni gzhom par gyis/ /gang zhig chos 'dul 'di nyid la/ /bag yod spyod par byed pa ni/ /skye ba'i 'khor ba rab spangs nas/ /sdug bsngal zad par byed par 'gyur/ /zhes rjod par byed do/ /de nas 'od zer de dag gis stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams bskor nas bcom ldan 'das nyid kyi phyi bzhin 'brang ste/ gal te bcom ldan 'das kyis 'das pa'i las lung ston par bzhed na ni bcom ldan 'das kyi snam logs su mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /ma 'ongs pa'i las lung ston par bzhed na ni mdun logs su mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /sems can dmyal bar skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni zhabs kyi mthil du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /dud 'gror skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni zhabs kyi rting par mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /yi dgas su skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni zhabs kyi mthe bor mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /mir skye bar lung stonas par bzhed na ni pus mo gnyis su mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por lung ston par bzhed na ni phyag g.yon pa'i mthil du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por lung ston par bzhed na ni phyag g.yas pa'i mthil du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /lhar 4skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni lte bar mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /nyan thos kyi byang chub tu lung ston par bzhed na ni zhal du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /rang sangs 75—155

rgyas kyi byang chub tu lung ston par bzhed na ni sminatumatshams kyi mdzod spur7mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung ston par bzhed na ni dbu'i gtsug tor du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas 'od zer de dag gis bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas te bcom ldan 'das kyi smin mtshams50kyi mdzod spuratswami snang bar gyur to/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos thal mo sbyar te bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ tshon sna stong gis spel ba sna tshogs can/ /mang po zhal gyi sgo nas byung bar gyur/ /de yis phyogs rnams kun tu snang bar bgyis/ /nyi ma shar bas ji ltar bgyis pa bzhin / /yang tshigs su bcad bde gsol pa/ rgod dang bral zhing rgyags dang mi dgyes spangs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas 6)'gro ba dag gshedam nga/'i rgyur gyur pa/ /rgyal ba dgra thub rnams ni rgyu rkyen ma mchis par/ /pad ma'i rtsa dang dung mdog lta bu'i 'dzum mi ston/ /brtan pos nyid kyi5kyeblo yis dus bab mkhyen lags na/ /dge sbyong tshodargyal dbang nyan pa som nyi 'tshal ba rnams/ /thub pa khyu mchog gi ni gsung mchog brtan pa dang / /bzang po dag gis 31the tshom5nyeskyes pa bsalahūbar gsol/ /rgya mtsho dang ni ri rgyal lta bur brtan pa yi/ /mgon po rdzogs sangs rgyas rnams gyin da ge'adzum mi ston/ /gang gi don du dpa' bo 'dzum pa ston mdzad pa/ /de ni khyod las skye bo phal chen nyan par 'tshal/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo de ni de bzhin no/ /de ni de bzhin te / kun dga' bo 8de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams ni rgyu med rkyen med par 'dzum pa mi mdzad do/ /kun dga' bo khye'u 'di dad pa skyes pas de bzhin gshegs pa la pad ma 'thor ⑩ba 75—156

mthong ngam/ btsun pa mthong lags so/ /kun dga' bo khye'u 'di dge ba'i rtsa ba dang sems bskyed pa dang sbyin par bya ①ba'i chos yongs su gtong ba 'dis/bskal pa bcwakhelnga'i bar du log par ltung bar mi 'gyur te/ lha dang mi'i bde ba nyams su myong nas rang sangs rgyas pad ma'i bla ma zhes bya bar 'gyur te/de'i sbyin par bya ba'i chos ni gang nga la sems dga' bar gyur pa 'di yin no/ /dge slong dag de ②bas na 'di ltar bslab par bya ste/ sangs rgyas dang rang sangs rgyas dang nyan thos rnams la bkur ④ste bya'o zhes dge slong khyed kyis de ltar bslab par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/dge slong de dag yi rangs te bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// //'khor lo zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la/ rgyal po rnams dang / blon po chen po rnams dang / phyug po rnams dang / pho brang 'khor gyi mi rnams dang / tshong dpon rnams dang / ded dpon rnams dang / lha rnams dang / klulornams dang / gnod sbyin rnams dang / lha ma yin rnams dang ske/ namashemakha' lding rnams dang / mi 'am ci rnams dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis bkur ste byas/ bla mar byas/ ri mo7byas/ mchod pa byas te/lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis mchod cing shes pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bsod nams chen po dang ldan pa/ na bza' dngashe/zhal zas dang / gzims cha dang / gdan dang / snyun gsos dang / sman zong rnams brnyes pa/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa/ rgyal po'i khab 75—157

na 'od ma'i tshal bya ka lan da0)ka gnas pa na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshekhurgyal po'i khab nas ded dpon zhig rgya mtsho chen po'i nang du zhugs nas/ de'i chung ma lang tsho la bab pa de / khyim thab la gdung zhing yongs su yi chad la smre sngagasakyi'adon kyang de'i khyim thab ma 'ongs nas/ des sred med kyi bu la phyag 'tshalasnyite dam bcas pa/ gal te bdag gi khyim thab myur du 'ongs na bdag gis khyod la gser gyi 'khor lo dbul lo zhes byas so/ /de nas de'i khyim thab rgya mtsho chen po'i5canang nas myur du phyir 'khor te nye zho med par bde bar 'ongs so/ /de nas des gser gyi 'khor lo byed du bcug ste/ de bran mo'i7tshogs kyis bskor bas 'khor lo dang / spos dang / bdug50pa dngalo)/ me tog khyer te lha khang 7du chas so/ /de'i skabs su sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis ni mi mkhyen pa'am/ mi gzigs pa'am/ mi rtogs pa'am/ thugs su mi chud pa ci yang med la/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa/'jig rten la phan 'dogs pa la zhugs0spepa/ srung ba gcig pa dang ldan pa/gcig tu dpa' ba/ zla med pa/ gnyis su mi gsung ba/ zhi gnas dang lhag mthong la gnas pa/ rig pa gsum snang bar mdzad pa/ bslab pa gsum la legs par bslabs pa/ 'dul ba'i gzhi gsum la mkhas pa/ chu bo bzhilalas rgal nyugeb/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi'i zhabs kyi mthil shin tu brtan pa/bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi5gel yun ring po nas 'dris par byas pa/ mi 'jigs pa bzhis mi 'jigs pa/ khyu mchog gi yang dag pa'i seng ge'i sgra chen po sgrogs pa / yan lag lnga rnam par spangs pa/ 'gro ba lnga las yang dag par 'das pa/yan lag drug dang ldan pa/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs par byasalge75—158

pa/ rtag tu gnas par byatub drug la gnas pa/ byang chub kyi yan lag bdun gyi me tog gis phyug pa/ lam yan lag brgyad pa ston pa/ mthar gyis snyoms par 'jug pa dgu la mkhas pa/ stobs bcu'i stobs dang ldan pa/ phyogs bcur grags pas kun tu rgyas pa/ brgya phrag bcu pa (nyal dbang byed pa bas kyang ches khyad par du 'phags pa rnams ni chos nyid kyis nyin dus gsum mtshan dus gsum du sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis 'jig rten la gzigs te/ su ni rgyad/su ni dar/ su ni phongs shing 'dug /su ni nyam nga bar gyural/ su ni gnod pa dang ldan/ su ni phongs pa dang nyam nga bsredang gnod pa dang ldan/ su ni ngan song du gzhol/ su ni ngan song du 'bab⑤/ su ni ngan song du bab(7/su ni ngas ngan song nas phyung ste mtho ris dang thar pa dang 'bras bu la gzhag par bya/ su ni 'dod pa'i 'dam du bying ba las lag nas drang bar〈nyebya/ su ni 'phags pa'i nor bdun med pa las 'phags pa'i nor bdun gyi dbang phyug la dbang byed du gzhug par bya/ su ni dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams ma bskyed pa las bskyed par bya/ su ni dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams bskyed zin pa las yongs su smin par bya/ su ni yongs su smin zin pa las rnam par grol bar bya snyam du ye shes gzigs pa 'jug go/ /'dir smras pa/ rgya mtsho chu srin rnams kyi gnas/ /dus rlabs yol bar 'gyur yang srid/ /gdul bar bya ba'i sras rnams la/ /sangs rgyas dus las yol ba med/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis(pe/ bu mo des nga ⑩mthong na rang byang chub kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba skyed 31par 'gyur ro snyam du gzigs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das snga dropa sham thabs dang chos gos gsol te lhung bzed bsnams nas dge slong gi tshogs kyis zhabs 'bring hunyebyas te/75wa 159

dge slong gi dge 'dun gyis mdun du bdaranyenas rgyal po'i khab tu bsod snyoms la gshegs so/ /de nas bu mo des sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sku skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis legs paraphubargyan pa/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus mdzes par byas pa/ 'od 'dom gang gis brgyan pa/ nyi ma stong bas lhag pa'i 'od mnga' ba/ /rin po che'i ri bo 'gro ba lta bu kun nas bzang ba mthong ngo / /de nas mthong ba'i mod la dga' ba thob ste/ bcom ldan 'das la gser gyi 'khor lo dor bar byas so/ /de nas bran mos bkag ste 'di sred med kyi bu ma yin no( )zhes byas so/ /'on kyang de bkag bzhin du dad pa drag pos yid 'dun par gyur pasaX/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi steng du gser gyi 'khor lo bor ro/ /spos dang bdug⑧pa dang me tog kyang phul lo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'dzum pa mdzad do/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams gang gi tshe 'dzum pa mdzad7pa'i chos nyid de/ de'i tshe zhal nas 'od zer sngon po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang / dkar po rnams byung nas kha cig ni 'og tu 'gro'o/ /kha cig ni steng du 'gro'o/ /'og tu 'gro ba gang yin pa de dag ni sems can dmyal ba yang sos dang / thig nag dang / 'dus 'joms〈pedang / ngu 'bod dang / ngu 'bod chen po dang /tsha ba dang / rab tu tsha ba dang / mnar med pa dang / chu bur can dang /chu bur rdol dang / so thams thams dang / kyi hud zer dang / a chusazer dang ske/ ud pal ltar gas pa dang / pad ma ltar gas pa dang / padashem ltar gas pa chen por song nas/ tsha ba'i sems can dmyal ba gang yin pa de dag tu ni bsil bar gyur te 'bab bo/ /grang ba'i sems can dmyal ba gang 75—160

yin pa de dag tu ni dro bar gyur te 'bab bo/ /de nas sems can de dag gi gnod pa'i khyad par rnams rtse zhil bar gyur to①/ /de nas de dag 'di snyam du sems te/ kye ci bdag cag 'di nas shi 'phos sam 'on te gzhan du skyes sam snyam mo/ /de nas de dag dad pa bskyed pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das sprul pa 'gyed parasnyemadzad de/ de dag gis sprul pa mthong nas 'di snyam du sems te/kye bdag cag ni 'di nas kyang ⑧shi 'phos par ma gyur la gzhan du yang ma skyes mod kyi/ 'on kyang sngon ma byung ba'i sems can snang ba 'di'i mthus bdag cag gi gnod pa'i khyad par rnams rtse zhil bar gyur to snyam mo/ /de nas de dag sprul pa la sems mngon par dga' bar gyur nas/ sems can dmyal ba myong bar 'gyur ba'i las de zad de/ lha dang mi rnams kyi nang du gang du bden pa rnams kyi snod du rung bar 'gyur ba der nying mtshams 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /stong du 'gro ba gang yin pa de dag ni rgyal chen bzhi'i ris rnams dang / sum cu rtsa gsum pa rnams dang / 'thab bral rnams dang / dga' ldan rnams dang / 'phrul dga' rnams dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed rnams dang /tshangs ris rnams dang / tshangs pa'i rjomadun na 'don pa rnams dang /tshangs pa chen po rnams dang / 'od chung rnams dang / tshad med 'od rnams dang / 'od gsal rnams dang / dge chung rnams dang / tshad med dge rnams dang / dge rgyas rnams dang / sprin med rnams dang / bsod nams skyes rnams dang / 'bras bu che rnams dang / mi che rnams dang / mi gdungakhurnams dang / gya rnam snang rnams dang / shin tu mthong rnams dang / 'og min gyi lha rnams kyi bar du song nas/ mi rtag pa dang sdug bsngal ba dang stong pa 75—161

dang bdag med pa'i sgra sgrogs so/ /tshigs su bcad pa gnyis kyang rjod par byed de/nya)/ nges par 'byung ba brtsam par gyis/ /sangs rgyas bstan la sbyor bar gyis/ /'dam bu'i khyim la glang chen bzhin/ /'chi bdag sde ni gzhom par gyis/ /gang zhig chos 'dul 'di nyid la/ /bag yod spyod par byed pa ni//skye ba'i 'khor ba rab spangs nas/ /sdug bsngal zad par byed par 'gyur/ /zhes rjod par byed do/ /de nas 'od zer de dag gis stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams bskor nas/ bcom ldan 'das nyid kyi phyi bzhin 'brangs te( kyi/ gal te bcom ldan 'das kyis 'das pa'i las lungasaston par bzhed na ni bcom ldan 'das kyi snam logs su mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /ma 'ongs pa'i las lung ston par bzhed na ni mdun logs su mi snang bar 'gyur ro//sems can dmyal bar skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni zhabs kyi mthil du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /dud 'gror skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni zhabs kyi rting par mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /yi dgas su skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni zhabs kyi 4rimathe bor mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /mir skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni pus mo gnyis su mi 5snang bar 'gyur ro/ /stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por lung ston par bzhed na ni phyag g.yon pa'i mthil 56)du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por lung ston par bzhed na ni phyag g.yas pa'i mthil du mi snang bar tho'agyur ro/ /lhar skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni lte bar mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /nyan thos kyi byang chub tu lung ston par bzhed na ni zhal du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub tu lung ston par bzhed na ni smin mtshamasamachedakyi mdzod spur 1)mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /75—162

bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung ston par bzhed na ni dbu'i gtsug tor du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas 'od zer de dag gis bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas te bcom ldan 'das kyi smin mtshams7kyi mdzod spur7mi snang bar gyur to/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos thal mo sbyar te/ bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ tshon sna stong gis spel ba sna tshogs can/ /mang po zhal gyi sgo nas byung bar gyur / /de yis phyogs rnams kun tu snang bar bgyis/ /nyi ma shar bas ji ltar bgyis pa bzhin//yang tshigs su bcad de gsol pa/ rgod dang bral zhing rgyags dang mi5gedagyes spangs pa yon/ /sangs rgyas 'gro ba dag gi dam pa'i rgyuradzanyagyur pa/ /rgyal ba dgra thub rnams ni rgyu rkyen ma mchis par/ /pad ma'i rtsa dang dung mdog lta bu'i 'dzum mi ston/ /brtan pos nyid kyi blo yis dus bab mkhyen lags na/ /dge slong rgyal dbang nyan pa9)som nyi 'tshal ba rnams/ /thub pa khyu mchog gi ni gsung mchog brtan pa dang / /bzang po dag dur gis the tsom skyes pa bsal5khyabar gsol / /rgya mtsho dang ni ri rgyal lta bur brtan pa yi/ /mgon po rdzogs sangs rgyas rnams gyin da 'dzum mi ston/ /gang gi don du dpa' bo 'dzum pa ston mdzad pa/ /de ni khyod las skye bo phal chen nyan par 'tshal/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo de ni de bzhin no/ /de ni de bzhin te / kun dga' bo de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams ni rgyu med rkyen med par 'dzum pa (1mi mdzad do/ /kun dga' bo bu mo 'dis de bzhin gshegs pa la gser gyi 'khor lo bor ba mthong ngam / btsun pa mthong lags so/ /kun dga' bo bu mo 'di dge ba'i rtsa ba 75—163

dang sems bskyed pa dang sbyin par bya ba'i chos yongs su gtong ba 'dis/bskal pa bcwa dhilnga'i bar du log par ltung bar mi 'gyur te②/ lha dang mi'i bde ba nyams su myong nas rang sangs rgyas 'khor lo bla ma zhes bya bar 'gyur te de'i sbyin par bya ba'i chos ni gang nga la sems dga' bar gyur pa 'di yin no/ /dge slong dag de bas na 'di ltar bslab par bya ste sangs rgyas dang rang sangs rgyas dang nyan thos rnams la bkur ste bya'o zhes rgyadage slong khyod 0kyis de ltar bslab5nyepar bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nasame/dge slong de dag yi (nyerangs te bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod ༈// //mgo bcu pa zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po rnams dang / blon po chen po rnams dang / phyug po rnams dang / pho brang 'khor gyi mi rnams dang / tshong dpon rnams dang / ded dpon rnams dang / lha rnams dang / klu rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams dang / lha ma yin rnams dang / nam mkha' lding rnams dang / mi 'am ci rnams dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams hunyekyis bkur sti byas/ bla mar byas/ ri mo7byas/ mchod pa byas te/ lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis mchod cing shes pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bsod nams chen po dang ldan pa/ na bza' dang / zhal zas dang / gzims cha dang / gdan dang / snyan gsos dang / sman zong rnams brnyes pa nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa/yul ma ga dhā na tunyeljongs rgyu zhing gshegs pa las cigang gā'i 7klung gi 'gram du 75—164

byon to/ /de nas dge slong rnams kyis thag ring po zhig nas mchod rten rnyingatupa rlung dang nyi tshan gyis bshig⑧pa zhig 'dug pa de mthong ngo / /mthong nas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa mchod rten 'di su'i lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rang sangs rgyas mgo bcu pa'i yin no/ /dge slong rnams kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das rang sangs rgyas mgo bcu pa ga las byung lags/ ming ni ci las btagasashelags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag0khyed rang sangs rgyas mgo bcu pa gangakyilas byung ba dang ming ci las btags pa nyan par 'dod dam/ gsol pa/ btsun pa nyan par 'tshalakyilags so/ /bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag 'oshen legs par rab tu nyon la yid la zung7shig dang ngas bshad do/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na/ grong khyer bā rā ṇa sī na⑨/ rgyal po tshangs pas byin⑩zhes bya ba zhig rgyal po byed de/ de'i ring la 'byor pa dang / rgyas pa dang / bde ba dang / lo legs pa dang / skye bo dang mi mang pos gang ba dang / rtsod pa dang 'thab pa zhi ba dang / 'khrug pa dang / nang 'khrug dang /chom rkun dang / mu ge dang / nad rnams med pa dang / 'bras sātshwanyelu dang /bu ram shing dang / ba lang dang / ma he dang ldan par 'dug go/ /rgyal po de yang chos can chos dang ldan pa'i rgyal po zhig ste7chos bzhin du rgyal po byed do/ /de nas rgyal po de/ bu med nas bu 'dod de gu lang dang / chu lha dang /ku be ra dang / brgya byin dang / tshangs pa la sogs pa dang / lha'i khyad par gzhan dag la yang gsol ba 'debs te 'di lta 0ste/ kun dga' ra ba'i lha dang ske/ nags tshal gyi lha dang / lam gyi bzhi mdo'i lha dang / sum mdo'i7lha 75—165

dang / gtor ma len pa'i lha0)dang / lhan cig skyes pa dang / chos 'thunasapa dang / rtag tu phyi bzhin 'brang ba'i lha rnams la yang gsol ba 'debs so/ /'jig rten na yang gsol ba btab pa'i rgyus busadang bu mo skye bar 'gyur ro zhes bya ba'i gtam de yod mod kyi de yang de lta nimosnyam yin te/ gal te gsol ba btab pa'i rgyus bu dang bu mom42skye bar 'gyur du zin na ni ⑥'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po bzhin du re re la yang bu stong stong yod par 'gyur ba'i rigs so/ /ye ni gnas gsum tshogs pa las bu dang bu mo skye bar gyur ⑦te gsum gang zhe na/pha ma gnyis 'dod chags langs te phrad pa dang / ma dus la bab cing zla mtshan dang ldan pa dang / dri za 'ongs pa ste gnas 'di gsum tshogs pa las bu dang bu mo skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de yang gsol ba 'debs pa lhur byed cing 'dug la/de'i skyed 45)mos tshal gyi rdzing 9)chen po ud pa la dang / pad ma dang / ku mu da dang ske/ pad ma dkar 7pos gang ba/ 'gram ngang pa dang ngur pa dang zal〈nyemo la sogs pa bya sna tshogs kyis mdzes par byas pa zhig yod pa de'i nang nas kyang pad ma tshad las 'das par che ba zhig blo tol 1)du skyes te/ de nyin gcig bzhin du cher skye la kha ni mi 'bye ba zhig yod do/ /de nas kun dga' ra ba'i srung nyugems rgyal po la gsol to/ /de nas rgyal pos kyang pad ma de legs par srungs shig ces bsgo'o/ /phyis re zhig na nyi ma 'char kur pad ma de kha bye nas pad ma de'i snying po la khye'u gzugs bzang zhing blta na sdug la mdzes pa mdog bzang ba gser gyi kha dog can mgo bo gdugs ltar 'dug pa lag pa ring ba/dpral ba'i dbyes che ba/ sna mtho ba/ sna legs pa/ smin ma stug pa/ lus skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis legs par brgyan pa/ dpe byad 75—166

bzang po brgyad cus mdzes par byas pa zhig skyil mo krungatubacas shingakhu'adug ste/kun dga' ra ba'i srungaltems kyang rgyal po la gsol to/ /de nas rgyal pos thos nas blon po dang btsun mo dang bcasalgepa skyed7mos tshal du dong ste/ pad ma'i snying po la de lta bur mdzes shing7'dug pa mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang dga' zhing mgu la rab tu dga' ste yisherangs nas dga' ba dang / yid bde ba skyes te / rdzing gi nang du zhugasalgenas khye'u de blangs te bkur ste chen po dang ldan pas7rang gi pho brang du khyer nas/ dge sbyong dang bram ze dang mtshan mkhan dag la bsnyad de/ zhag bdun gsum nyi shu rtsalo) gcig gi bar du btsas ston rgyas par byas nas/ mgo bcu pa zhes ming btags so/ /de nas khye'u mgo bcu pa pang〈nyen 'tsho ba'i ma ma gnyis dang / nu ma snun pa'i ma ma gnyis dang /dri ma 'khru ba'i ma ma gnyis dang / rtse hunyeba'i ma ma gnyis te ma ma brgyad la gtad nas/ de ma ma brgyad kyis 'o ma dang / zho dang / mar dang / zhun mar dang / mar gyi snying khurwanyedang gzhan yang yo byad kyi khyad par bzang ngo cog gis bskyed bsrings te/ mtsho'i nang gi pad ma bzhin du skye drag par gyur to8/ /khye'u de yangadza8dad pa dang ldan la bsam pa bzang zhing dge ba/ bdag la phan pa dang gzhan la phan pa la zhugs pa/ snying rje che ba/ bdag nyid che ba/chos 'dod pa/ skye dgu la byams pa zhig ste/ des yab rgyal sa na 'dug na/kha na ma tho ba dang bcas pa dang kha na ma tho ba med ⑩pa'i las dag byed ྅nyepa mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang khye'u de mi dga' nas yab la gsol pa/ yab bdag legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu 'byung bar gnang bar mdzad du gsol zhes byas so/ /yab kyis kyang gnang ste de skra dang kha spu bregs 75—167

nas gos tshon can bgos te/ yang dag pa'i dad pas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung ngo / /de nas des lung mnos pa med par byang chub kyi phyogs dang 'thun pa'i chos sum cu rtsa bdun mngon du gyur te/ rang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub mngon sum du byas nas/ nam mkha' la 'phags te yab la cho 'phrul rnam pa sna tshogs bstan to/ /de nas yab kyis zla ba gsum gyi bar du bshos la spyan drangs so/ /de nas detulus thogs pas yongs su skyo nas cho 'phrul rnam pa sna tshogs bstan te/ shing zad pa'i me bzhin du mya ngan las 'das par song7ste de'i mchod rten 'di yin no/ /de nas dge slong rnams the tsom skyes te the tsom thams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa rang sangs rgyas mgo bcu pas las gang dag bgyis zhon ma'i mngal du ma skyes te/pad ma las skyes lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag mgo bcu pa nyid kyis bsngon tshe rabs gzhan dag tu tshogs rnyed cing rkyen grub pa dang ldan te/ dba' rgal bzhin du 'byung la gdon mi za bar 'ong ba'i las de dag byas shing bsags pas na/ mgo bcu pa nyid kyis las byas shing bsags pa de dag gzhan su zhig gis nyams su myong bar 'gyur te/ dge slong dag las byas shing bsags pa rnams ni phyi rol gyi sa'i khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur/ chu'i khams dang / me'i khams dang / rlung gi khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur te/ las dge ba dang mi dge ba rnams byas shing bsags pa rnams ni zin pa'i phungasapo dang khams dang skye mched rnams 'ba' zhig la rnam par smin par 'gyur ro/ /lus can dag gi las rnams ni/ /bskal pa brgyar yang chud mi za/ /tshogs shing dus la bab pa na/ /'bras bu 75—168

nyid du smin par 'gyur/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na bskal pa dgu bcu rtsa gcig pa ①la de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu gdul bya'i7kha lo sgyur ba/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnam par gzigs zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung ngo / /de nas yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs ②de/ rgyal po'i pho brang gnyen ldan zhes bya ba na durten cing bzhugs so/ /de nas yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs snga dro sham thabs dang chos gos gsol te lhung bzed bsnams nas dge slong gi tshogs kyis zham ring byas te/ dge slong gi dge 'dun gyisalgemadun du bdar nas rgyal po'i pho brang gnyen ldan du bsod snyoms la gshegs so/ /ded dpon zhig kyang pad ma khyer te srang du zhugs so/ /de nas des yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs sku skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis legs par brgyan pa/ dpe byadashebazang po brgyad cus mdzes par byas pa/'od 'dom gang gis brgyan pa/ nyi ma stong bas lhag pa'i 'od mnga' ba/ rin po che'i ri bo 'gro ba lta bu kun nas bzang ba mthong nas/ mthong ma thag tu pad ma de bcom ldan 'das kyi ⑧steng du bor te/ bor ma thag tu pad ma de bcom ldan 'das kyi steng du shing rta'i 'phang7lo tsam du gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das gshegs na ni 'gro la gzhes na ni sdod do/ /de nas re zhig na〈nyeyang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs kyis ded dpon de rang byang chub tu lung bstan to/ /de nas dga' zhing mgu la rab tu dga' nas rang gi 75—169

khyim du song ba dang / de'i skabs su de'i chung ma bu btsa' zhing 'dug ste skad ngan 'don0)nas/ des bran mo la de ci zhig ces dris so/ /des kyang de bzhin du bsnyad do/ /de nas ded dpon de mi dga' bar gyur nas smon lam btab pa/ bdag nam yang5mi'akhor ba na ma'i mngal du skye bar ma gyur cig ces52)byas so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag ji snyam du sems de'i tshe de'i dus na/ ded dpon du gyur pa gang yin pa de ni rang sangs rgyas mgo bcu pa de yin te/ dge ba'i rtsa ba des bskal pa dgu bcu rtsa gcig gi bar du nam yang ri rima'i mngal du ma skyes la/ srid pa tha ma la yang de'i 'byor pa de 'dra bar gyur to/ /dge slong dag de bas na 'di ltar bslab par bya ste / sangs rgyas dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / nyan thos rnams la bkur sti bya'o zhes dge slong khyed kyis de ltar bslab par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ dge slong de dag yidzad)rangs te bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// //mdog 'jam zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po rnams dang ske/ blon po chen po rnams yidang / phyug po rnams0dang / pho7brang 'khor gyi mi rnams dang / tshong dpon rnams dang / ded dpon rnams dang /lha rnams dang / klu rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams dang / lha ma yin rnams dang ske/ nam mkha' lding rnams dang / mi 'am ci rnams dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis bkur sti byas/ bla mar byas/ ri mo 7byas/ mchod pa byas te/lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang —/ mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis mchod cing shes pa'i 75—170

sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bsod nams chen po dang ldan pa/ na bza' dang /zhal zas dang / gzims cha dang / gdan dang / snyan gsos dang / sman zong rnams brnyes pa/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa mnyan du yod pa na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba natubazhugs so/ /de'i tshe mnyan du yod pa na tshong dpon phyug cing nor mang la longs spyod che ba nor dang yo byad mang ba bdag dbang ba mang ba mdza' bo dang blon po dang nye du dang rgan rabs mang ba zhig yod de/ khyim bdag de yang dad pa dang ldan la ③dge zhing bsam pa bzang ba/ bdag la phan pa dang gzhan la phan pa la zhugs pa/ snying rje che ba/ bdag nyid che ba/ chos 'dod pa zhig go/ /de nas de5nya'adi snyam du sems te/ longs spyod 'di dag ni chu zla lta bu'i rang bzhin can smig rgyu dang 'dra ba/ mi rtag pa/ mi brtan pa/ ther zug pa byam yin pa/ yid ⑥brtan du mi rung ba/ 'gyur ba'i chos can/gnod pa chen po lnga dang thun mong du 'dug pa yin gyisaphya/ bdag gis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa la cho ga dang ldan pa'i khrus gsol la zhu7zhal zas bzang pos tshim par byamatshegor ma chag snyam mo/ /de nas des bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa khrus gsol ba dang gdugs tshod gsol bar spyan drangs so/ /de nas de la phan gdags pa'i phyir/ bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi 3 ༷dge 'dun dang bcas pa dge slong gi tshogs kyis zhabs 'bring thotebyas te/ dge slong gi dge 'dun gyis mdun hunyadu bdar nas chomanyeg dang ldan pa'i khrus la gshegs so/ /de nas tshong dpon de til mar spos can khyer te bsro khang tsodu song nas bdag nyid kyis bcom ldan 75—171

'das nyan thos kyi 6)dge 'dun dang bcas pa la bsnyen bkur byas so/ /de nas gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa/ khrus gsol zin pa de'i tshe khyim bdag des bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa lari / rang gi lag nas bza' ba dang bca' ba gtsangasnyem bzang pos tshim par byas te ci bzhed pa bstabs so/ /rang gi lag nas bza' ba dang bca' ba gtsang rgu tam bzang po rnam grangs du mas tshim par byas te ci bzhed pa bstabs nas/ bcom ldan 'das bshos gsol zin te bstsang rgyasder ni gyurjo/phyag ni bcabs par 7)rig nas/ stan ches dma' ba zhig khyer te chos mnyan pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dug nas de la bcom ldan 'das kyisalgechos kyi thonagatam gyis yang dag par bstan/ yang dag par 'dzin du bcug /yang dag par gzengs stodatsha/ yang dag par dga' bar mdzad do/ /chos kyi gtam rnam grangs du ma 11yang dag par bstan/ yang dag par 'dzin du bcug /yang dag par bzangs nyugebastod/ yang dag par dga' bar mdzad nas cang mi gsung bar bzhugs so/ /de nas tshong dpon de dad pa rnyed nas sdong po rtsa ba nas bcad pa bzhin du bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal〈nyete sems la rtas par byas so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyisaca'adzum pa mdzad do / /'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams gang gi tshe 'dzum pa mdzad pa'i chos nyid de de'i tshe zhal nas 'od zer sngon po dang / ser po dang /dmar po dang / dkar po rnams byung nas kha cig ni 'og tu 'gro'o/ /kha cig ni steng du 'gro'o/ /'og tu 'gro ba gang yin pa de dag ni sems can dmyal ba yang sos dang / thig nag dang / 'dus 'joms5snyedang / ngu 'bod dang /75—172

ngu 'bod chen po dang / tsha ba dang / rab tu tsha ba dang / mnar med pa dang ske/ chu bur can dang / chu bur rdol dang / so thams thams dang / kyi hud zer dang / a chu7zer dang / ud pa la ltar gas pa dang / pad ma ltar gas pa dang / pad ma ltar gas pa chen por songasnyenas/ tsha ba'i sems can dmyal ba gang yin pa de dag tu ni bsil bar gyur te 'bab bo/ /grang ba'i sems can dmyal ba gang yin pa de dag tu ni drobabar gyur te 'bab bo/ /des na sems can de dag gi gnod pa'i khyad par rnams rtse zhil bar gyur to④/ /de nas sems can0de dag 'di snyam du sems te/ kye ci bdag cag 'di nas shi 'phos sam 'on te gzhan du skyes sam snyam mo/ /de nas de dag dad pa bskyed pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das sprul pa 'gyed par mdzad de/ de dag gis sprul pa mthong nas 'di snyam du sems te/ kye bdag cag ni ⑥'di nas kyang shi 'phos par ma gyur la/ gzhan du yang ma skyes mod kyi 'on kyang sngon ma byung ba'i sems can snang ba 'di'i mthus bdag cag ⑦gi gnod pa'i khyad par rnams gyertse zhil bar gyur to snyam mo/ /de nas de dag sprul pa la sems mngon par dga' bar gyur nas/ sems can dmyal ba myong bar 'gyur ba'i lasamatho)de zad de/ lha dang mi rnams kyi〈nyenang du gang du bden pa rnams kyi snod du rung bar 'gyur ba der nying mtshams 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /steng du 'gro batshwanyegang yin pa de dag ni rgyal chen bzhi'i (nyeris rnams dang / sum cu rtsa gsum pa rnams dang /'thab bral rnams dang / dga' ldan rnams dang / 'phrul dga' rnams dang /gzhan 'phrul dbang byed rnams dang / tshangs ris rnams dang / tshangs pa'i mdun7na 'don pa rnams dang / tshangs pa chen po rnams dang / 'od chung 75—173

rnams dang / tshad med 'od rnams dang / 'od gsal rnams dang / dge chung rnams dang / tshad med dge rnams dang / dge rgyas rnams dang / sprin med rnams dang / bsod nams skyes rnams dang / 'bras bu che rnams dang /mi che rnams dngas1)/ mi gdung rnams dang / gya nom snang rnams dang / shin tu mthong rnams dang / 'og min gyi lha rnams kyi bar du song nas mi rtag pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / stong pa dang / bdag med pa'i sgra sgrogs so/ /tshigs su bcad pa gnyis kyang rjod par byed de/ nges par 'byung bsnyebartsam par gyis(5)/ /sangs rgyas bstan la sbyor bar gyis/ /'dam bu'i khyim la glang chen bzhin/ /'chi bdag sde ni gzhom par gyis54sa/ /gang zhig chos 'dul 'di nyid la/ /bag yod spyod par byed pa ni/ /skye ba'i 'khor ba rab spangs nas/ /sdug bsngal zad 5)par byed par 'gyur/ /zhes rjod par byed do/ /de nas 'od zer de dag gis stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams bskor nasal/ bcom ldan 'das nyid kyi phyi bzhin 'brangs te )/ gal te bcom ldan 'das kyis 'das pa'i las lung ston par bzhed na ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyi snam logs su mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /ma 'ongs pa'i las lung ston par bzhed na ni mdun logs su mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /sems can dmyal bar skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni zhabs kyi mthil 7 du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /dud 'gror skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni zhabs kyi rting rin par mi snang bar 'gyur rol/ /yi dgas su skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni zhabs kyi mthe bor mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /mir skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni pus mo 9 gnyis su mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por lung ston par 75—174

bzhed na ni phyag g.yon pa'i mthil du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por lung ston par bzhed na ni phyag g.yas pa'i mthil du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /lhar skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni lte bar mi snang bar 'gyur ro / /nyan thos kyi byang chub tu lung ston par bzhed na ni zhal du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub tu lung ston par bzhed na ni smin mtshams57kyi mdzod spur〈mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung ston par bzhed na ni dbu'i gtsug tor du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas 'od zer de dag gis bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas te bcom ldan 'das kyi smin mtshams kyi mdzod spur5 )mi snang bar gyur7to/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos thal mo sbyar ba btud derte5kyibacom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ tshon sna stong gis spel ba sna tshogs can/ /mang po zhal gyi sgo nas byung bar gyur/ /de yis phyogs rnams kun tu snang bar bgyis//nyi ma shar bas ji ltar bgyis pa bzhin/ /yang tshigs su bcad de gsol pa/rgod dang bral zhing rgyags dang mi dgyes spangs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas 'gro ba dag gi dam pa'i rgyur gyur pa/ /rgyal ba dgra thub rnams ni rgyu rkyen ma mchis par/ /pad ma'i rtsa dang dung mdog lta bu'i 'dzum mi ston/ /brtan pos nyid kyi dziblo yis dus bab mkhyen lags na/ /dge sbyong 77rgyal dbang nyan pa som nyi 'tshal ba rnams/ /thub pa khyu mchog gis snyeni gsung mchog brtan pa dang / /bzang po dag gis the tshom tu)skyes pa bsal nyi bar gsol/ /rgya mtsho dang ni ri rgyal lta bur brtan pa yi/ /mgon po rdzogs sangs rgyas rnams gyin da /1'dzum mi ston/ /gang gi don du dpa' bo 'dzum pa ston mdzad pa/ /de ni khyod las skye bo /2phal 75—175

chen nyan par 'tshal/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo de ni de 3)bzhin no/ /de ni de bzhin te/ kun dga' bo de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams ni rgyu med rkyen med par 'dzum pa mi mdzad do/ /kun dga' bo tshong dpon 'dis nga la 'di lta bu'i bkur ste byas pa mthong ngam/ btsun pa mthong lags so/ /kun dga' bo tshong dpon 'di dge ba'i rtsa ba dang sems bskyed pa dang sbyin par bya ba'i ②chos yongs su gtong ba 'dis rang sangs rgyas mdog 'jam zhes bya bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i sbyin par bya ba'i chos ni gang nga la sems mngon par rin)dga' bar gyur pa 'di yin no/ /dge slong dag de bas na 'di ltar bslab par bya ste/ sangs rgyas dang rang sangs rgyas dang 4)nyan thos rnams la bkur sti bya'o zhes dge slong dag 5khyed kyis de ltar bslab par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ dge slong de dag yi rangs teridzi// bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// // gang po la sogs pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa brgya pa/ bam po bdun pa/⑦'od bsil zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas shebacom ldan 'das la rgyal po rnams dang ske/ blon po chen po rnams dang / phyug po rnams dang / pho brang 'khor gyi mi rnams dang / tshong dpon rnams dang / ded dpon rnams dang / lha rnams dang / klu rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams dang / lha ma yin rnams dang ske/ nam mkha' lding rnams dang / mi 'am ci rnams dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis bkur ste byas/ bla mar byas/ ri mo 1)byas/ mchod pa byas te/lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding 75—176

dang ske/ mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams0)kyis mchod cing shes pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bsod nams chen po dang ldan pa/ na bza' dang /zhal zas dang / gzims cha dang / gdan dang / snyun gsos dang / sman zong rnams brnyes pa/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa mnyan du yod pa na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyinasho gyi kun dga' ra bar na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe mnyan du yod pa na khyim bdag phyug cing nor mang la longs spyod che ba yongs su 'dzin pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ rnam thos kyi bu'i nor dang ldan pa/ rnam thos kyi bu'i nor dang 'gran57pa zhig yod de de yang dad pa dang ldan lasadage zhing bsam pa bzang ba4)/ bdag la phan pa dang gzhan dgalal phan pa la zhugs pa/ snying rje che ba/ bdag nyid che ba/ chos 'dod pa/skye dgu la byams pa zhig go/ /de nas de58)'di snyam du sems te longaris spyod 'di dag ni chu zla lta bu'i rang bzhin can/ glang po che'i rna ba ltar g.yo ba/ mi rtag pa/ mi0)brtan pa/ ther zug7 snam yin pa/ yid brtan du mi rung ba/'gyur ba'i chos can/ gnod pa chen po lnga dang thun mong du 'dug pa yin gyis hu1bdag gis longs spyod snying po med pa las snying po blang bar bya gor ma chag 32snyam mo / /des sos ku'i dus la bab pa na/ bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa gdugs tshod la spyan drangs nas/ khyim yang rdo dang /gseg ma dang / gyo mo med 3nyepar byas te/ tsan dan gyi chus ni chag chag btab / spos sna tshogs kyi snod ni bkramakha/ dri zhim po'i bdug pas ni bdugasatso / me tog sna tshogs kyis ni gtor/ me tog gi gdan rnams ni bshams so/ /de nas khu ba bsil ba'i btung ba rnams dang / khuramatshab dang /75—177

bshos rnams kyang sta 1rigon byas nas/ bcom ldan 'das la phrin ( gyis gdugs tshod la ribaskul ba/ btsun pa gdugs tshod la bab ste rtsibashos gsol5gelags na bcom ldan 'das kyis da de'i dus la bab par dgongs te gshegs su gsol zhes bskul ne/to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das snga dro sham thabasashedang chos gos gsol te lhung bzed bsnams nas dge slong gi tshogs kyis zhabs 'bring (7byas te/ dge slong gi dge 'dun gyis 9)mdun du bdar nas khyim bdag de'i khyim ga la ba der gshegs te byon nas/ dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi gung la gdan bshams pa la bzhugs so/ /de nas khyim bdag des tsho )sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun bde bar bzhugs par rig nas/ rang gi lag nas bza' ba dang bca' ba gtsang 11ma bzang pos nyu tshim par byas te/ ci bzhed pa bstabs so/ /rang gi lag nas bza' ba dang bca' ba gtsang ma bzang po rnam grangs du mas tshim par byas te ci bzhed pa bstabs hunyenas/bcom ldan 'das bshos gsol zin te bstsang 7sder ni gyu /snye/ phyag ni bcabs skyapar rig nas/ stan ches dma' ba zhig khyer te chos mnyan pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis khyim bdag de0rtechos kyi gtam gyis yang dag par bstan/ yang dag par 'dzin du bcug /yang dag par gzengs stod18/ yang dag par dga' bar mdzad do/ /chos kyi gtam rnam grangs du mas yang dag par bstan/ yang dag par 'dzin du bcug/ yang dag par gzengs bstod/19 yang dag par dga' bar mdzad nas cang mi gsung bar bzhugs so/ /de nas khyim bdag de dad pa rnyed nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi 2 zhabs la phyag 'tshal te sems la rtas ni1par byas so/ /de nas 75—178

bcom ldan 'das kyis 'dzum pa mdzad do/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams gang gi tshe 'dzum pas1mdzad pa'i chos nyid denano/ de'i tshe zhal nas 'od zer sngon po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang / dkar po rnams byung nas/ kha cig ni 'og tu 'gro'o/ /kha cig ni steng du 'gro'o/ /'og tu 'gro ba gang yin pa de dag ni sems can dmyal ba yang sos dang / thig nag dang ske/ 'dusadza 'joms dang / ngu 'bod dang / ngu 'bod chen po dang /tsha ba dang / rab tu tsha ba dang / mnar med pa dang / chu bur can dang /chu bur rdol dang / so thams thams dang / kyi 4)hud zer dang / a chumar zer dang ske/ ud pa la ltar gas pa dang / pad ma ltar gas pa dang / pad ma ltar gas pa chen por song nas/ tsha ba'i sems can dmyal ba gang yin pa de dag tu ni bsil bar gyur te 'bab bo/ /grang ba'i sems can dmyal ba gang yin pa de dag tu ni dro bar gyur te 'bab bo/ / des nas sems can de dag gi gnod pa'i khyad par rnams rtse zhil bar gyur to/ /de nas de dag 'di snyam du sems te/kye ci bdag cag 'di nas 77shi 'phos sam 'on testonagazhan du skyes sam snyam mo/ /de nas de dag dad pa bskyed 9)pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das sprul pa 'gyed par mdzad de/ de dag gis nyi sprul pa mthong nas 'di snyam du sems te/ kye bdag cag ni 'di nas kyang 17shi 'phos par ma gyur la 12gzhan du yang ma skyes mod kyi / 'on kyang sngon hu ma byung ba'i sems can snang ba 'di'i mthus bdag cag gisheganod pa'i khyad par rnams rtse zhil bar gyur to snyam mo/ /de nas de dag sprul pa la sems mngon par dga' bar gyur nas sems can dmyal ba myong bar 'gyur ba'i kyisnyelas de zad de/ lha dang mi rnams kyi nang du gang du bden pa 75—179

rnams kyi77)snod du rung bar 'gyur ba der nying mtshams5pa'adzin par 'gyur rokhru//steng du 'gro ba gang 4yin pa de dag ni rgyal chen bzhi'i ris rnams dang / sum cu rtsa gsum pa rnams dang / 'thab bral rnams dang / dga' ldan rnams dang ske/ 'phrul dga' rnams dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed rnams dang /tshangs ris rnams 5dang / tshangs pa'i mdun na 'don pa rnams dang /tshangs pa chen po rnams dang / 'od chung rnams dang / tshad med 'od rnams dang ske/ 'od gsal rnams dang / dge chung rnams dang / tshad med dge rnams dang / dge rgyas rnams dang 6/ sprin med rnams dang / bsod nams skyes rnams dang / 'bras bu che rnams dang / mi che rnams dang / mi gdung rnams dang / gya rnam snang rnams dang / shin tu mthong rnams dang / 'og min gyi lha rnams kyi bar du song nas mi rtag pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang /stong pa dang / bdag med pa'i sgra sgrogs so/ /tshigs su bcad pa gnyis kyang rjod par byed de/ nges par 'byung ba brtsam 47 par gyis/ /sangs rgyas bstan la sbyor bar gyis/ /'dam bu'i khyim la glang chen gshe)bzhin/ /'chi bdag sde ni gzhom par gyis/ /gang zhig chos 'dul 'di nyid la/ /bag yod spyod par byed pa ni/ /skye ba'i 'khor ba rab spangs nas/ /sdug bsngal zad par byed par 'gyur/ /zhes rjod par byed do/ /de nas 'od zer de dag gis stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams bskor nas bcom ldan 'das nyid kyi phyi bzhin 'brangs tega'ori/ gal te bcom ldan 'das kyis 'das pa'i las lung ston par bzhed na ni bcom ldan 'das kyi snam logs su mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /ma 'ongs pa'i las lung ston 'ipar bzhed na ni mdun logs su mi snang bar 75—180

'gyur ro/ /sems can dmyal bar skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni zhabs kyi mthil du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /dud 'gror skye bar lung stonas7par bzhed na ni zhabs kyi rting7par mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /yi dgas su skye bar lung stonas5)par bzhed na ni zhabs kyi mthe bor mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /mir skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni pus mo gnyis su mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por lung ston par bzhed na ni phyag g.yon pa'i mthil du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por lung ston par bzhed na ni phyag g.yas pa'i mthil du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /lhar skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni lte bar mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /nyan thos kyi byang chub tu lung ston par bzhed na5geni zhal du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub tu lung ⑤ston par bzhed na ⑥ni smin mtshams (7kyi mdzod spur ⑧mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung ston par bzhed na ni dbu'i gtsug tor0)du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ / de nas 'od zer de dag gis bcom ldan 'das laspyo ༷lan gsum bskor ba byas te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi smin mtshams kyi mdzod spur mi snang bar gyur to/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos thal mo sbyar te bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ tshon sna nya1stong gis spel ba sna tshogs can/ /mang po zhal gyi sgo nas byung bar gyur/ /de yis phyogs rnams kun tu snang bar bgyis/ /nyi ma shar bas ji ltar bgyis pa bzhin//yang tshigs su bcad pasnyigasol pa/ rgod dang bral zhing rgyags dang mi dgyesatshwa spangs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas 'gro ba dag gi dam pa'i rgyuraphagegyur pa/ /rgyal ba dgra thub rnams ni rgyu rkyen ma mchis par/ /pad ma'i rtsa dang dung mdog lta bu'i 75—181

'dzum mi ston/ /brtan pos nyid kyi blo yis dus bab mkhyen lags na/ /dge slong rgyal dbang nyan pa som 1 nyi 'tshal ba rnams/ /thub pa khyu tsamachog gi ni gsung mchog brtan pa dang / /bzang po dag gis the tshom risaskyes pa bsal bar gsol / /rgya mtsho dang ni ri rgyal lta bur brtan gepa yi/ /mgon po rdzogs sangs rgyas rnams gyin da pa'adzum mi ston/ /gang gi don du dpa' bo 'dzum pa ston mdzad pa/ /de ni khyod las skye bo phal chen sgo/nyan par 'tshal bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo de ni de bzhin no/ /de ni de bzhin te/ kun dga' bo de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams ni rgyu med rkyen med 7 par 'dzum pa mi mdzad do/ /kun dga' bo khyim bdag 'dis nga la 'di lta bu'i bkur ste byas pas3)mthong ngam/btsun pa mthong lags so/ /kun dga' bo khyim bdag 'di'i0)dge ba'i rtsa ba dang sems bskyed pa dang sbyin par bya ba'i chos yongs su gtong ba 'dis/ rang sangs rgyas 'od bsil zhes bya bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i sbyin par bya ba'i mchos ni gang nga la sems dad par byas pa 'di yin no/ /dge slong dag de bas na 'di ltar bslab par bya ste/ sangs rgyas dang rang sangs rgyas dang nyan thos rnams la bkur sti bya'o zhes dge slong khyed kyis de ltar bslab par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ dge slong de dag yi hunyerangs te bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// //mnyan pa zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po rnams dang ske/ blon po chen po rnams dang / phyug po rnams dang / pho brang 'khor 1gegyi mi rnams dang / tshong dpon rnams dang / ded dpon rnams dang / lha 75—182

rnams dang / klu rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams dang /② lha ma yin rnams dang ske/ nam mkha' lding rnams dang / mi 'am ci rnams dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis bkur sti byas/ bla mar byas/ ri motsha byas/ mchod pa byas te/lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dngadzab/ nam mkha' lding dang ske/ mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po9)rnams kyis mchod cing shes pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bsod nams chen po dang ldan pa/ na bza' dang /zhal zas dang / gzims cha dang / gdan dang / snyun gsos dang / sman zong rnams brnyes pa/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa/ yul ma ga sakyin ljongs rgyu zhing gshegs pa las gang gā'i klung gi 'gram du byon to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi tshogs kyis zhabs 'bringatshane)byas te/ dge slong gi dge 'dun gyis stimadun du bdar nas/ mnyan pa rnams ga la ba der gshegs te byon nas/ mnyan pa rnams la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /kye chu klung 'di las nga sgrol cig /mnyan pa rnams kyis gsol pa/ gru btsas 465 cig /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis mnyan pa de dag la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /nga yang sngon mnyan pa byed byed de ngas dga' bo ni 'dod chags kyi chu klung du lhung ba las bsgral/ sor phreng rin)ni zhe snang gi rgya mtshor lhung ba las bsgral / bram ze'i bu nga rgyal gyis khengs pa ni nga rgyal gyi rgya(mtshor lhung ba las bsgral / steng rgyas 3 'od srung ni gti mug gi rgya mtshor lhung ba las bsgral te 'on kyang ngas77gru btsas ma blangs so/ /de skad ces bka' stsal kyang bsgral bar khas ma blangs so/ /de nas mnyan pa zhig gis bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa yang thos/ gzugs phun sum tshogs pa de yang 75—183

mthong nas dad pa skyes te/ bdag gis bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa bsgral bar 'tshal lo zhes gsol to/ /de nas dge slong rnams grur zhugs pa dang bcom ldan 'das rdzu 'phrul gyis mnyan pa de bas kyang ches sngar pha rol gyi 'gram du zhugs tshotshopar gyur to/ /de nas mnyan pa des rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul ri de mthong nas sems dga' bar gyur te zhabs la mgo bosalgephyag 'tshal te / bcom ldan 'das kyis de la 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi rtogs par 'gyur ba de lta bu'i chos bstan te/ mnyan pa des de thos nas 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo mthon po nyi shu ye shes ⑤do rjes bcom nas/rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas so/ /des bden pa mthong nas dga' ba'i tshig lan gsum du brjod de/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag gi khrag dang mchi ma'i rgya mtsho bskams pa dang rtsori/ rus pa'ishel bsgral ba dang ske/ ngan song gi sgo rnams 9bcad pa dang / mtho ris dang / thar pa'i sgo rnams phye ba dang / bdag lha dang mi rnams kyi nang durtso/3 bzhag pa 'di lta bu ni〈lhabadag la phas kyang ma bgyis12/ mas kyang ma bgyis/ rgyal pos kyang ma bgyis/lha rnams kyis kyang ma bgyis/ nang mi dang gnyen gyi tshogs kyis kyang ma bgyis/sngon gyi mtshun sna rnams kyis kyang ma bgyis/ dge sbyongasadang bram ze rnams kyis kyang ma bgyis lags so/ /yang gsol pa/ nyes pa mang por ldan pa'i ngan song lam/ /shin tu mi bzad bukhyod kyi hu'amathu yis bcad/ /bsod nams rab ldan mtho ris 'gro ba phye/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i lam yang bdag gis thob/ /bdag gis de ring nyes pa spangs pa'i mig /shin tu rnam dag khyod las brten nas thob/ /bdag ni sdug bsngal rgya mtsho'i 1shepha rol rga'akhozu/ /'phags pa 75—184

dgyes pa'i zhi ba'i go 'phang thob/ /mi mchog dbang po mi dang lhas mchod pa/ /skye dang rga dang shi gyo)ba'i nad spangs pa/ /srid pa stong du mthong bar dka' ba lasal / /thub pa khyod ni deng mthong 'bras bu yod/ /de'i nang nas mnyan pa gcig cig 'gyod pa chen po skyes nas/ des bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal50te nyes pa bshags nas/ bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa bshos gyegasol to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'dzum pa mdzad do/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams gang gi tshe 'dzum pa mdzad pa'i chos nyid de/ de'i tshe zhal nas 'od zer sngon po dang / ser po dang ske/ dmar po dang / dkar po rnams byung nas kha cig ni 'og tu 'gro'o/ /kha cig ni steng du 'gro'o/ /'og tu 'gro ba gang yin pa de dag ni sems can dmyal ba yang sos dang / thig nag dang / 'dus 'joms sridang / ngu 'bod dang / ngu 'bod chen po dang / tsha ba dang / rab tu tsha ba dang /mnar med pa dang / chu bur can dang / chu bur rdol dang / so thams thams dang / kyi hud zer dang / a chu 4 zer dang / ud pa la ltar gas pa dang ske/ pad ma ltar gas pa dang / pad ma ltar gas pa chen por song nas tsha ba'i sems can dmyal ba gang yin pa de dag tu ni bsil bar gyur te 'bab bo/ /grang ba'i sems can dmyal ba gang yin pa de dag tu ni dro bar gyur te 'bab bo//des na sems can de dag gi gnod pa'i khyad par rnams rtse zhil bar gyur to/ / de nas mede dag 'di snyam du sems te/ kye ci bdag cag ni ⑧'di nas shi 'phos sam/ 'on te gzhan du skyes sam snyam mo/ /de nas de dag dad pa bskyed pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das sprul pa 'gyed par mdzad de/ de dag gis 75—185

sprul pa mthong nas 'di snyam du sems te/ kye bdag cag ni 'di nas kyang shi 'phos par ma gyur la gzhan du yang ma skyes mod kyi/ 'on kyang sngon ma byung ba'i sems can snang ba 'di'i mthus bdag cag gi gnod pa'i khyad par rnams7rtse zhil bar gyur to snyam mo/ /de nas de dag sprul pa la sems mngon par dga' bar gyur nas sems can dmyal ba myong bar 'gyur ba'i las de zad de lha dang mi rnams kyi nang du gang du bden pa rnams kyi snod du rung bar 'gyur ba der nying mtshams 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /steng du 'gro ba gang yin pa de dag ni rgyal chen bzhi'i ris rnams dang / sum cu rtsa gsum pa rnams dang / 'thab bral rnams dang ske/ dga' ldan rnams dang / 'phrul dga' rnams dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed rnams dang / tshangs ris rnams dang / tshangs pa'i mdun na 'don pa rnams dang / tshangs pa chen po rnams dang / 'od chung rnams dang /tshad med 'od rnams dang / 'od gsal rnams dang / dge chung rnams dang /tshad med dge rnams dang / dge rgyas rnams dang / sprin med rnams dang /bsod nams skyes rnams dang / 'bras bu che rnams dang / mi che rnams dang /mi gdung rnams dang / gya rnam snang rnams dang / shin tu mthong rnams dang /'og min gyi lha rnams kyi bar du song nas mi rtag pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang /stong pa dang / bdag med pa'i sgra sgrogs so/ /tshigs su bcad pa gnyis kyang rjod gepar byed deriX/ nges par 'byung ba brtsam par gyis/ /sangs rgyas bstan la sbyor bar gyis/ /'dam bu'i khyim la geglang chen bzhin/ /'chi bdag sde ni gzhom par gyis/ /gang zhig chos 'dul 'di nyid la/ /bag yod spyod par byed pa ni/ /skye ba'i 'khor ba rab spangs nas/ /sdug bsngal zad par byed 75—186

par 'gyur/ /zhes rjod par byed do/ /de nas 'od zer de dag gis stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams bskor nas bcom ldan 'das nyid kyi phyi bzhin 'brangs te①/ gal te bcom ldan 'das7kyis 'das pa'i las lung ston par bzhed na ni bcom ldan 'das kyi snam logs su mi snang bar 'gyur rol/ /ma 'ongs pa'i las lung ston par bzhed na ni mdun logs su mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /sems can dmyal bar skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni zhabs kyi mthil du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /dud 'gror skye0)bar lung ston par bzhed na ni zhabs kyi rting par mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /yi dgas su skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni zhabs kyi mthe bor mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /mir skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni pus mo gnyis su mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por lung ston par bzhed na ni phyag g.yon pa'i mthil du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por lung ston par bzhed na ni phyag g.yas pa'i mthil du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /lhar skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni lte bar mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /nyan thos kyi byang chub tu lung ston par bzhed na ni zhal du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub tu lung ston par bzhed na ni smin mtshams kyi mdzod spur mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung ston par bzhed na ni dbu'i gtsug tor du )du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas 'od zer de dag gis bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas te bcom ldan 'das kyi smin mtshams kyi mdzod spur5ltami snang bar gyur tsito/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos thal mo sbyar te/ bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ tshon sna stong gis spel ba sna 75—187

tshogs can/ /mang po zhal gyi sgo nas byung bar gyur/ /de yis phyogs rnams kun tu snang bar bgyis6)/ /nyi ma shar bas ji ltar bgyis pa bzhin/ /yang tshigs su bcad de gsol pa/ rgod dang bral zhing rgyags dang mi dgyes spangs pa yi / /sangs rgyas 'gro ba dag gi dam pa'i rgyur gyur pa/ /rgyal ba dgra thub rnams ni rgyu rkyen ma mchis par/ /pad ma'i rtsa dang dung mdog lta bu'i 'dzum mi ston/ /brtan pos58)nyid kyi blo yis dus bab mkhyen lags na/ /dge sbyong rgyal dbang nyan pa som nyi 'tshal ba rnams/ /thub pa khyu mchog gi ni gsung mchog brtan pa dang / /bzang po dag gis the tshom grubaskyes pa bsal bar gsol/ /rgya mtsho dang ni ri rgyal lta bur brtan pa yi/ /mgon po rdzogs sangs rgyas rnams gyin dam na'adzum mi ston/ /gang gi don du dpa' bo 'dzum pa ston mdzad pa/ /de ni khyod las skye bo phal chen nyan par 'tshal/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo de ni de bzhin no/ / kun dga' bo5nyede ni de bzhin te / kun dga' bo de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams ni rgyu med rkyen med par 'dzum pa mi mdzad do/ /kun dga' bo mnyan pa 'dis nga la sems dga' ba bskyed pa mthong ngam/ btsun pa mthong lags so/ /kun dga' bo mnyan pa 'dis4)dge ba'i rtsa ba dang sems bskyed pa dngashe/ sbyin par bya ba'i chos yongs su gtong ba 'dis/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus na rang sangs rgyas 'khor ba rgal ⑧zhes bya bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i sbyin par bya ba'i chos ni gang nga la sems dad par byas pa 'di yin no/ /dge slong skyedag de bas na 'di ltar bslab par bya 'iste/ sangs rgyas dang rang sangs rgyas dang nyan thos rnams la bkur57ste bya'o zhes dge slong khyod kyis nya de ltar bslab par bya'o/ /75—188

bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ dge slong de dag yi yonyerangs te bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// //spos kyi ngad ldang7zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po rnams dang / blon po chen po rnams dang / phyug po rnams dang / pho brang 'khor gyi mi rnams dang / tshong dpon rnams dang / ded dpon rnams dang /lha rnams dang / klu rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams dang / lha ma yin rnams dang / nam mkha' lding rnams dang / mi 'am ci rnams dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis bkur ste byas/ bla mar byas/ ri mo7byas/ mchod pa byas te/lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis mchod cing shes pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bsod nams chen po dang ldan pa/ na bza' dang /zhal zas dang / gzims cha dang / gdan dang / snyan gsos dang / sman zong rnams brnyes pa/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa rgyal po'i khab na 'od ma'i tshal bya ka lan da ka gnas pa na rten cing bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe yul dbus na 'khod pa'i yul mi rnams kyis 3)lugs kyis na phal cher byug pa (ge)sna tshogs kyi lus skudamartso)par byed do/ /de nas re zhig na khyim bdag gi bu zhig yod pa de'i bran mo dad pa dang ldan la()dge zhing bsam pa bzang ba zhig yod pa de'i7tsan dan dmar po bdar zhing 'dug go/ /bcom ldan 'das kyang snga dro sham thabs dang chos gos gsol te lhung bzed bsnams nas dge slong gi tshogs kyis zhabs 'bring〈nyebyas te/ dge slong gi dge 'dun gyis mdun du bdar nas rgyal po'i khab tu bsod snyoms la gshegs so/ /de nas bu mo des sangs rgyas 75—189

bcom ldan 'das sku skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis legs par brgyan pa/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus mdzes par byas pa/ 'od 'dom gang gis brgyan pa/ nyi ma stong bas lhag pa'i 'od mnga' bturin po che'i ri bo 'gro ba lta bu kun nas bzang ba mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang bu mo de dad pa chen po5 skyes so/ /de nas de' ——)dad pa rnyed nas 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag gis54)'di lta bu'i zhing rnyed kyang dbul ba'i nyes pas bcom ldan 'das la bkur sti byed mi nus na bdag gi5ge'atsho ba 'di 'dra ba ci dgos snyam mo/ /de nas des rang gi srog la yang ma bltas57te/ lag pa gnyi ga57tsan dan dmar pos byugs nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la bskus (kyeso/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis she)kyang rdzu 'phrul gyis rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer ril gyis tsan dan gyi dris gang bar mdzad do/ /de nas bu mo des cho 'phrul de mthong nas sems dga' bar gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal tshanas sems la rtas par byas te/ bdag dge ba'i rtsa ba dang sems bskyed pa dang sbyin par bya ba'i chos yongs su gtong ba 'dis rang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub mngon sum du byed par gyur cig nyu 7ces byas so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'dzum pa mdzad do/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams gang gi tshe 'dzum pa mdzad pa'i chos nyid de/ de'i tshe zhal nas 'od zer sngon po dang / ser po dang ske/ dmar po dang / dkar po rnams byung nas kha cig ni 'og tu 'gro'o/ /kha cig ni steng du 'gro'o/ /'og tu 'gro ba gang yin pa de dag ni sems can dmyal ba yang sos dang / thig nag dang / 'dus nyu 'joms dang / ngu 'bod nyusnyedang / ngu 'bod chen po dang / tsha ba dang / rab tu tsha ba dang /75—190

mnar med pa dang / chu bur can dang / chu bur rdol dang / so thams7)thams dang / kyi hud zer dang / a chu zer dang / ud pa la ltar gas pa dang ske/ pad ma ltar gas pa dang / pad ma ltar gas pa chen por song nas tsha ba'i sems can dmyal ba gang yin pa de dag tu ni bsil bar gyur te 'bab bo /grang ba'i sems can dmyal ba gang yin pa de dag tu ni dro bar gyur te 'bab bo/ /des na sems can de dag gisaganod pa'i khyad par rnams rtse zhil bar gyur to/ /de nas de dag 'di snyam du sems te/ kye ci bdag cag 'di nas shi 'phos sam 'on te gzhan⑧du skyes sam snyam mo/ /de nas de dag dad pa bskyed5gi)pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das sprul pa 'gyed par mdzad de(5)/ de dag gis sprul pa mthong nas 'di snyam du sems te/ kye ci bdag cag ni 'di nas kyang shi 'phos par ma gyur la gzhan du yang ma skyes mod kyi/ 'on kyang sngon ma byung ba'i sems can snang ba 'di'i mthus/ bdag cag gi po)gnod pa'i khyad par rnams rtse zhil bar gyur to snyam mo/ /de nas de dag sprul pa la sems mngon par dga' bar gyur nas sems can dmyal ba myong bar 'gyur ba'i las de zad de/ lha dang mi rnams kyi nang du gang du bden 71pa rnams kyi snod du rung bar 'gyur ba der nying mtshamasapo)'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /steng du 'gro ba gang yin pa de dag ni rgyal chen bzhi'i ris rnams dang / sum cu rtsa gsum pa rnams dang / 'thab bral rnams dang / dga' ldan rnams dang / 'phrul dga' rnams dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed rnams dang / tshangs ris rnams dang / tshangs pa'i mdun she)na 'don pa rnams dang / tshangs pa chen po rnams dang / 'od chung rnams dang ske/ tshad med 'od rnams dang / 'od gsal rnams dang / dge chung 75—191
