rnams dang / tshad med dge rnams dang / dge rgyas rnams dang / sprin med rnams dang / bsod nams skyes rnams dang / 'bras bu che rnams dang / mi che rnams dang / mi gdung7)rnams dang / gya rnam snang rnams dang / shin tu mthong rnams dang / 'og min gyi lha rnams kyi bar du song nas mi rtag pa dang /sdug bsngal ba dang / stong pa dang / bdag med pa'i sgra sgrogs so/ /tshigs su bcad pa gnyis kyang rjod par byed de/ nges par 'byung ba brtsam par ②gyis / /sangs rgyas bstan la sbyor bar gyis/ /'dam bu'i khyim la glang chen bzhin / /'chi bdag sde ni gzhom par gyis/ /gang zhigasachos 'dul 'di nyid la/ /bag yod spyod par byed pa ni/ /skye ba'i 'khor ba rab spangs nas/ /sdug bsngal zad par byed par 'gyur/ /zhes rjod par byed do / /de nas 'od zer de dag gis stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams bskor nas/bcom ldan 'das nyid kyi phyi bzhin 'brangs techos ri/ gal te bcom ldan 'das kyis 'das pa'i las lung ston par bzhed na ni bcom ldan 'das kyi snam logs su mi snang 47/bar 'gyur ro/ /ma 'ongs pa'i las lung0)ston par bzhed na ni mdun logs su mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /sems can dmyal bar skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni zhabs kyi mthil du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /dud 'gror skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni zhabs kyi rting par mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /yi dgas su skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni zhabs kyi mthe bor mi snang bar ⑨'gyur ro/ /mir skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni pus mo gnyis su mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /stobs kyi pa'akhor los sgyur hu1ba'i rgyal por lung ston par bzhed na ni phyag g.yon pa'i mthil du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal 75—192

por lung ston par bzhed na ni phyag g.yas pa'i mthil du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /lhar skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni lte bar mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /nyan thos kyi byang chub tu lung ston par bzhed na ni zhal du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub tu lung ston par bzhed na ni smin mtshams kyi mdzod spur7)mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung ston par bzhed na ni dbu'i gtsug tor du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas 'od zer de dag gis bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas te bcom ldan 'das kyi smin mtshamasashekyi mdzod spuramag —)mi snang bar gyur to/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos thal mo sbyar te/ bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ tshon sna stong gis spel ba sna tshogs can/ /mang po zhal gyi sgo nas byung bar gyur/ /de yis phyogs rnams kun tu snang bar bgyis/ /nyi ma shar bas ji ltar bgyis pa bzhin / /yang tshigs su bcad de gsol pa/ rgod dang bral zhing rgyags dang mi dgyes spangs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas 'gro ba dag gi dam pa'i rgyur gyur pa/ /rgyal ba dgra thub rnams ni rgyu rkyen ma mchis par/ /pad ma'i rtsa dang dung mdog lta bu'i 'dzum mi ston/ / brtan pos na)nyid kyi blo yis dus bab mkhyen lags na/ /dge sbyong rgyal dbang nyan pa som nyi 'tshal ba rnams/ /thub pa khyu mchog gi ni gsung mchog brtan pa dang / /bzang po dag gis the tshom 55)skyes pa bsal bar gsol / /rgya mtsho dang ni ri rgyal lta bur brtan pa yi/ /mgon po rdzogs sangs rgyas rnams gyin da5ye'adzum mi ston/ /gang gi don du dpa' bo 'dzum pa ston mdzad pa/ /de ni khyod las skye bo phal chen nyan par 'tshal/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo de ni de bzhin no/ /de ni de bzhin 75—193

te / kun dga' bo de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams ni rgyu med rkyen med par 'dzum pa mi mdzad do/ /kun dga' bo bu mo 'dis nga la 'di lta bu'i bkur sti byas pa mthong ngam/ btsun pa mthong lags so/ /kun dga' bo bu mo 'di dge ba'i rtsa ba dang sems bskyed7pa dang sbyin par bya ba'i chos yongs su gtong ba 'dis ma 'ongs pa'i dus na rang sangs rgyas spos kyi ngad ldang ri zhes bya bar 'gyur ros/ /de'i sbyin par bya ba'i chos ni gang nga la sems dang bar rtsodabyas pa 'di yin no/ /dge slong dag de bas na 'di ltar bslab par bya ste/ sangs rgyas dang rang sangs rgyas dang nyan thos rnams la bkur ste bya'o zhes dge slong khyed rig kyis de ltar bslab par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ dge slong de dag yi 45)rangs te bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// //dri ma med pa zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po rnams dang ske/ blon po chen po ri rnams dang / phyug po rnams dang / pho brang 'khor gyi mi rnams dang / tshong dpon rnams dang / ded dpon rnams dang / lha rnams dang / klu rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams dang / lha ma yin rnams dang ske/ nam mkha' lding rnams dang / mi 'am ci rnams dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis bkur ste byas/ bla mar byas/ ri mo rin)byas/ mchod pa byas te/lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang ske/ mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis mchod cing shes pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bsod nams chen po dang ldan pa/ na bza' dang /zhal zas dang / gzims cha dang / gdan dang / snyan gsos dang / sman 75—194

zong rnams brnyes pa nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa mnyan du0)yod pa na/rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe mnyan du yod pa na kun dga' ra ba'i srungasam zhig yod de / des so shing zhig khyer te mnyan du yod par song ngo / /ltas mkhan zhig kyang sgomageka na 'dug ste/ desan re so shing 'di su za ba de tshon)ni zas ro brgya dang ldan pa za bar 'gyur ro zhes zer ro/ /de nas kun dga' ra ba'i srungam3)mas tshig de thos nas 'di snyam du sems te/ so shing 'di gang la byin na de'i rgyus bdag cher bkur bar 'gyur zhig gu5)snyam mo/ /yang de 'di snyam du sems te/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'di ni rgyu ba dang mi rgyu ba'i 'jig rten na bsod nams kyi zhing dupo/'gro ba 'bras bu yod pa yin gyis9)/ bdag gis 'di sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la dbul lo snyam mo/ /de nas kun dga' ra ba'i srung ma des the )so shing de khyer nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas kun dga' ra ba'i srung 37ma des/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag la thugs brtse rteba'i slad du tshemasatshwa shing 'di 7bzhes su gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis kun dga' ra ba'i srung (snyem la phan gdags pa'i phyir phyag rko/lhagaser gyi kha dog can glang po che'i sna ltar 'dug pa brkyangal tshonas bzhes so/ /bzhes nas kyang de kun dga' ra ba'i srung72ma'i mdun du gsol to/ /gsol nas kyang so shing de sa la btsugs so/ /de nas btsugs pa'i mod de 36kho na'i skad cig la yal ga tsho pyadang / lo ma dang / me tog dang / 'bras bu phun sum 75—195

tshogs pa'i shing n+ya gro dha0)chen po chu zhengashegab pa zhig tu gyur te/ de'i grib ma la bcom ldan 'das bzhugs nas lha dang mi du ma la chos bstan57to/ /de nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyisam )zhal zas ro brgya dang ldan pa gsol to/ /de nas kun dga' ra ba'i srung 55rim de/ bcom ldan 'das kyi cho 'phrul gyis sems dad par byas nas/ sdong po rtsa ba nas bcad pa bzhin du zhabs la phyag 'tshal te smon lam btab pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis bdag rang byang chub mngon sum du byed par gyur cig ces byas so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'dzum pa mdzad do/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams gang gi tshe 'dzum pa mdzad pa'i chos nyid de/ de'i tshe zhal nas 'od zer sngon po dang / ser po dang ske/ dmar po dang / dkar po rnams byung nas kha cig ni 'og tu 'gro'o/ /kha cig ni steng phyi du 'gro'o/ /'og tu 'gro ba gang yin pa de dag ni sems can dmyal ba yang sos dang / thig nag dang / 'dus 'jomasamachadang / ngu 'bod dang / ngu 'bod chen po dang / tsha ba dang / rab tu tsha ba dang /mnar med pa dang / chu bur can dang / chu bur rdol5kyedang / so thams thams dang / kyi hud zer dang / a chu (zer dang / ud pal ltar gas pa dang ske/ pad ma ltar gas pa dang / pad ma ltar gas pa chen por song nas tsha ba'i sems can dmyal ba gang yin pa de dag tu ni bsil bar gyur te 'bab bo/ /grang ba'i sems can dmyal ba gang yin pa de dag tu ni dro bar gyur te 'bab bo/ /des na sems can de dag gi gnod pa'i khyad par rnams rtse zhil bar gyur to3ge ༷/ /de nas de dag 'di snyam du sems te/ kye ci bdag cag 'di nas shi 'phos sam/'on te gzhan du skyes sam snyam mo/ /de nas de dag dad pa bskyed 37pa'i phyir/75—196

bcom ldan 'das sprul pa 'gyed par 3)mdzad de/ de dag gis sprul pa mthong nas 'di snyam du sems te/ kye bdag cag ni 'di nas kyang shi 'phos par ma gyur la gzhan du yang ma skyes med kyi 'on kyang sngon ma byung ba'i sems can snang ba 'di'i mthus bdag cag gi gnod pa'i khyad par rnams rtse zhil bar gyur to snyam mo/ /de nas de dag sprul pa la sems mngon par dga' bar gyur nas sems can dmyal ba myong bar 'gyur ba'i las de zad de lha dang mi rnams kyi nang du gang du bden pa rnams kyi snod du rung bar 'gyur ba der nying mtshams 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /steng du 'gro ba gang yin pa de dag tum ni rgyal chen bzhi'i ris rnams dang / sum cu rtsa gsum pa rnams dang / 'thab bral rnams dang /dga' ldan rnams dang / 'phrul dga' rnams dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed rnams dang / tshangs ris rnams dang / tshangs pa'i mdun na 'don pa rnams dang ske/ tshangs pa chen po rnams dang / 'od chung rnams dang / tshad med 'od rnams dang / 'od gsal rnams dang / dge chung rnams dang / tshad med dge rnams dang / dge rgyas rnams dang / sprin med rnams dang / bsod nams skyes rnams dang / 'bras bu che rnams dang / mi che rnams dang / mi gdung rnams dang / gya rnam snang rnams dang / shin tu mthong rnams dang /(7'og min gyi lha rnams kyi bar du song nas/ mi rtag pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang ske/ stong pa dang / bdag med pa'i sgra sgrogs so/ /tshigs su bcad pa gnyis kyang rjod par byed de⑩/ nges par 'byung ba brtsam7par gyis/ /sangs rgyas bstan la sbyor bar gyis/ cho/'dam bu'i khyim la glang chen bzhin/ /'chi bdag sde ni gzhom par gyis(6)/ /gang zhig chos 'dul 'di nyid la/ /bag yod 75—197

spyod par byed pa ni/ / skye ba'i0'khor ba rab spangs nas/ /sdug bsngal zad par byed par 'gyur/ /zhes rjod par byed do/ /de nas 'od zer de dag gis stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams bskor nas bcom ldan 'das nyid kyi phyi bzhin 'brangs te(mi/ gal te bcom ldan 'das kyis 'das pa'i las lung ston par bzhed na ni bcom ldan 'das kyi snam logs su mi snang bar 'gyur ro / /ma 'ongs pa'i las lung ston par bzhed na ni mdun logs su mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /sems can dmyal bar skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni zhabs kyi mthil du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /dud 'gror skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni zhabs kyi ci nirting par mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /yi dgas su skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni zhabs kyi mthe bor mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /mir skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni pus mo gnyis su mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por lung ston par bzhed na ni phyag g.yon pa'i mthil du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por lung ston par bzhed na ni phyag g.yas pa'i mthil du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /lhar skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni lte bar mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /nyan thos kyi byang chub tu lung ston par bzhed na ni zhal du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub tu lung ston par bzhed na ni smin mtshams kyi mdzod spurar+sāmi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung ston par bzhed na ni dbu'i gtsugamatshetor du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas 'od zer de dag gis bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas te bcom ldan 'das kyi smin mtshams kyi mdzod spur )mi snang bar gyur to/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun 75—198

dga' bos thal mo sbyar te bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ tshon sna stong gis spel ba sna tshogs can/ /mang po zhal gyi sgo nas byung bar gyur/ /de yis phyogs rnams kun tu snang bar bgyis/ /nyi ma shar bas ①ji ltar bgyis pa bzhin / /yang tshigs su bcad de gsol pa/ rgod dang bral zhing rgyags dang mi dgyes spangs pa yis/ /sangs rgyas 'gro ba dag gi dam pa'i rgyur gyur pa/ /rgyal ba dgra thub rnams ni rgyu rkyen ma mchis par/ /pad ma'i rtsa dang dung mdog lta bu'i 'dzum mi ston/ /brtan pos genyid kyi blo yis dus bab mkhyen lags na/ /dge sbyong rgyal dbang nyan pa som nyi 'tshal ba rnams/ /thub pa khyu mchog gi ni gsung mchog brtan ⑤pa dang / /bzang po dag gis the tshom yiskyes pa bsal bar gsol / /rgya mtsho dang ni ri rgyal lta bur brtan ri7pa yi/ /mgon po rdzogs sangs rgyas rnams gyin da52'dzum mi ston/ /gang gi don du dpa' bo 'dzum pa ston mdzad pa/ /de ni khyod las skye bo phal chenas7nyan par 'tshal/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo de ni de bzhin no/ /de ni de bzhin te/ kun dga' bo de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams ni/ rgyu med rkyen med par 'dzum pa mi mdzad dom/ / kun dga' bo lha rikun dga' ra ba'i srung tunyam 'dis nga la 'di lta bu'i bkur ste byas pa mthong ngam/ btsun pa mthong lags so/ /kun dga' bo kun dga' ra ba'i srung〈nyem 'dil dge ba'i rtsa ba dang sems bskyed pa dang sbyin par bya ba'i chos yongs su gtong ba 'dis bskal pa bcu gsum gyi bar du log par ltung bar mi 'gyur te srid pa tha ma dang / gnas tha ma dang / lus tha ma dang /bdag gi ngo bo tha ma la thob pa ni mi7rang sangs rgyas dri ma med pa zhes bya bar 75—199

'gyur ro/ /de'i sbyin par bya ba'i chos ni gang nga la sems dad par byas pa 'di yin no/ /dge slong dag de bas na 'di ltar bslab par bya ste/ sangs rgyas dang rang sangs rgyas dang nyan thos rnams la bkur ste bya'o zhes dge slong khyed kyis de ltar bslab par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas / dge slong 6)de dag yi tshogurangs te bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// //gdangs snyan ces bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po rnams dang / blon po chen po rnams dang / phyug po rnams dang / pho brang 'khor gyi mi rnams dang / tshong dpon rnams dang / ded dpon rnams dang /lha rnams dang / klu rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams dang / lha ma yin rnams dang /rin nam mkha' lding rnams dang / mi 'am ci rnams dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis bkur ste byas/ bla mar byas/ ri mosang)byas/ mchod pa byas te/ lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis mchod cing shes pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bsod nams chen po dang ldan pa/ nasnyebaza' dang / zhal zas dang / gzims cha dang / gdan dang / snyun gsos dang / sman zong rnams brnyes pa/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa mnyan du yod pa na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das snga dro sham thabs dang chos gos gsol te lhung bzed bsnams nas mnyan du ④yod par bsod ⑧snyoms la gshegs so/ /mdza' sde she)bo mang po zhig kyang chang gis ra ro zhing 75—200

myos nas pi bangatudang / gling bu dang / rdza rnga dang / ngosaskum rnams dang /rol mo'i sgra rnam pa sna tshogs byed de/ gar byed glu len la me tog ud pa la dang / pad ma dang / ku mu da dang / pad ma dkar50po dang / par shi ka la sogs pa me tog gi phreng5geb mang po yang mgul du btags nas/ gos khyad par du 'phags pa dag bgos te mnyan du yod pa'i phyi rol tu byung ngo / /de nas mdza' sde bo deshedag gis bcom ldan 'das sku skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis legs par brgyan pa/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus mdzes par byas pa/ 'od 'dom gang gis brgyan pa/ nyi ma stong bas lhag pa'i 'od mnga' ba/ rin po che'i ri bo 'gro ba lta bu kun nas bzang ba mthong ngopon/ /mthong ma thag tu de dag chang gis ra ro ba de las sangs par gyur to/ /de nas ra ro bas nyalas sangs nas sems dga' zhing dad par ④gyur te/ gar7dang glu dang rol mo'i sgra rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la bsnyen bkur byas so/ /ud pa la sngon po rnams kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi steng du gtor te/ de dag bcom ldan 'das kyi steng du khang huX ripa brtsegs pa sngon po dang khang pa sngon po dang gdugs sngon po lta bur gyur te 'dug nas/ de dag bcom ldan 'das gshegs na ni 'gro la gzhes tsho/nyan ni sdod do/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang 'od sngon po dag bkye ste/ 'od de dag gis mnyan du yod pa nor bum an da rnyil gyi mdog 'dra bar 'dug par byas so/ /de nas mdza' sde bo de dag bcom ldan 'das la dad pa skyes te sems la rtas par byas nas/ dge ba'i rtsa ba dang sems bskyed pa dang sbyin par bya ba'i chos 'dis bdag cag rang byang chub mngon sum du byed par gyur cig ces byas so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'dzum pa 75—201

mdzad do/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams gang gi0)tshe 'dzum pa mdzad pa'i chos nyid de/ de'i tshe zhal nas 'od zer sngon po dang / ser po dang ske/ dmar po dang / dkar po rnams byung nas kha cig ni 'og tu 'gro'o/ /kha cig ni steng du 'gro'o/ /'og tu 'gro ba tshosarigang yin pa de dag ni sems can dmyal ba yang sos dang / thig nag dang / 'dus 'jomasasridang / ngu 'bod dang / ngu 'bod chen po dang / tsha ba dang / rab tu tsha ba dang /mnar med pa dang / chu bur can dang / chu bur rdol dang / so thamasalgethams dang / kyi 5)hud zer dang / a chu 6 zer dang / ud pal ltar gas pa dang / pad ma ltar gas pa dang / pad ma ltar gas pa chen por song nas/tsha ba'i sems can dmyal ba gang yin pa de dag tu ni bsil bar gyur te 'babatsobo / /grang ba'i sems can dmyal ba gang yin pa de dag tu ni dros(gyebar gyur te 'bab bo/ / des na 9)sems can de dag gi gnod pa'i khyad par rnams rtse zhil bar gyur to/ /de nas de dag 'di snyam du sems te/ kye ci bdag cag sko'adi nas shi 'phos sam 1 'on te gzhan du skyes sam snyam mo/ /de nas de dag dad pa bskyed pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das sprul pa 'gyed par mdzad de/ de dag gis sprul pa mthong nas 'di snyam du sems te/ kye /2bdag cag ni 'di nas kyang shi 'phos par ma gyur la gzhan du yang ma skyes mod kyi/ 'on kyang sngon ma byung ba'i sems can snang ba 'di'i mthus bdag cag gi gnod pa'i khyad par rnams rtse zhil bar gyur to snyam mo/ /de nas de hu dag sprul pa la sems mngon par dga' bar gyur nas sems can dmyal ba myong bar 'gyur ba'i nyustelas de zad de/ lha dang mi rnams kyi nang du gang du bden pa rnams kyi snod du rung bar 'gyur ba 75—202

der nying mtshams 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /steng du 'gro ba gang yin pa de dag ni rgyal chen bzhi'i ris rnams dang / sum cu rtsa gsum pa7rnams dang / 'thab bral rnams dang / dga' ldan rnams dang / 'phrul dga' rnams dang /gzhan 'phrul dbang byed rnams dang / tshangs ris rnams dang / tshangs pa'i mdun na 'don pa rnams dang / tshangs pa chen po rnams dang / 'od chung rnams dang / tshad med 'od rnams dang / 'od gsal rnams dang / dge chung rnams dang / tshad med dge rnams dang / dge rgyas rnams dang / sprin med rnams dang / bsod nams skyes rnams dang / 'bras bu che rnams dang /mi che rnams dang / mi gdung rnams dang / gya rnam snangarka rnams dang / shin tu mthong rnams dang / 'og min gyi lha rnams kyi bar du song nas mi rtag pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / stong pa dang /ri) bdag med pa'i sgra sgrogs so/ /tshigs su bcad pa gnyis kyang rjod par byed de/ nges par 'byung ba brtsam par gyis/ /sangs rgyas bstan la sbyor bar gyis/ /'dam bu'i khyim la glang chen bzhin/ /'chibaskabadag sde ni gzhom par gyis/ /gang zhig chos 'dul 'di nyid la/ /bag yod spyod par byed pa ni/ /skye ba'i 'khor ba rab spangs nas/ /sdug bsngal bsal bar5gebyed par 'gyur/ /zhes rjod par byed do/ /de nas 'od zer de dag gis stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams bskor nas bcom ldan 'das nyid kyi phyi bzhin 'brangs te'u/ gal te bcom ldan 'das kyis 'das pa'i las lung ston par bzhed na ni bcom ldan 'das kyi snam logs su mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /ma 'ongs pa'i las lung ston par bzhed na ni mdun logs su mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /sems can dmyal bar skye b.ralo1)lung 75—203

ston par bzhed na ni zhabs kyi mthil du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /dud 'gror skye bar ①lung ston par bzhed na ni zhabs kyi rting par mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /yi dgas su skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni zhabs kyi mthe bor mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /miradza skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni pus mo gnyis su mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por lung ston par bzhed na ni phyag g.yon pa'i mthil du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por lung ston par bzhed na ni phyag g.yas pa'i mthil du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /lhar skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni lte bar mi snang bar 'gyur ro / /nyan thos kyi byang chub tu lung ston par bzhed na ni zhal du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub tu lung ston par bzhed na ni smin mtshams kyi mdzod spur mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /bla na med pa'i⑧yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung ston par bzhed na ni dbu'i gtsug tor du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas 'od zer de dag gis bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas te/④ bcom ldan 'das kyi smin mtshams kyi mdzod spurasami snang bar gyurar noto/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos thal mo sbyar te bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ tshon sna stong gis spel ba sna tshogs can/ /mang po zhal gyi sgo nas byung bar gyur/ /de yis phyogs rnams kun tu snang bar bgyis/ /nyi ma shar bas ji ltar bgyis pa bzhin/ /yang 9)tshigs su bcad de gsol pa/rgod dang bral zhing rgyags dang mi dgyes gsaspangs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas 'gro ba dag gi shedam pa'i rgyur gyur pa/ /rgyal ba dgra thub rnams ni rgyu rkyen ma mchis par / /pad ma'i rtsa dang dung mdog nyu lta bu'i 'dzum mi ston/ /brtan77pos 75—204

nyid kyi blo yis dus bab mkhyen lags na/ /dge sbyong rgyal dbang nyan pa som nyi 'tshal ba rnams/ /thub pa khyu mchog gi ni gsung mchog brtan pa dang / /bzang po dag gis the tsom skyes pa bsal bar gsol/ /rgya mtsho dang ni ri rgyal lta bur brtan pa yi/ /mgon po rdzogs sangs rgyas rnams gyin da7)'dzum mi ston/ /gang gi don du dpa' bo 'dzum pa ston mdzad pa/ /de ni khyod las skye bo phal chen nyan par 'tshal/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo de ni de bzhin no/ /de ni de bzhin te/ kun dga' bo de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams ni rgyu med rkyen med par 'dzum7pa mi mdzad do/ /kun dga' bo mdza' sde bo 'di rnams kyisasheng la 'di lta bu'i bkur sti byas pa mthong ngam/ btsun pa mthong lags so/ /kun dga' bo mdza' sde bo 'di rnams dge ba'i rtsa ba dang sems bskyed pa dang sbyin par bya ba'i chos yongs su gtong ba 'dis bskal pa nyi shu'i bar du log par ltung bar mi 'gyur te/ srid pa tha ma dang / gnas tha ma dang / lus tha ma dang / bdag gi ngo bo tha ma thob pa na/ rang sangs rgyas gdangs snyan()zhes bya ba5nyasha stag tu 'gyur ro/ /de dag gi sbyin par bya ba'i chos ni gang nga rimul sems dang bar7byas pa 'di yin no/ /dge slong dag de lta bas na 'di ltar bslabate⑨par bya sto) / sangs rgyas dang rang sangs rgyas dang nyan thos rnams la bkur sti bya'o zhes dge slong dag71khyed kyis de ltar bslab par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ dge slong de dag yirwanyerangs te bcom ldan7'das kyis gsungs pa lasamangon par bstod do// //gang po la sogs pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa brgya pa las/ sdom gyi tshigs su 75—205

bcad pa gsum pa rdzogs sa)// // gang po la sogs pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa brgya pa/ bam po brgyad pa/②sdom ni/ pad ma dang ni kham re dang / /chos skyong de bzhin zhi ldan dang / /gzugs bzang mdza' bo'i bu mo dang / /ri bong dang ni chos tshol dang / /mgon med zas sbyin rab bzang ba/ /sde tshan dag tu bstan pa yin / /pad ma zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po rnams dang / blon po chen porang)rnams dang / phyug po rnams dang / pho brang 'khor gyi mi rnams dang ske/ tshong dpon rnams dang / ded dpon rnams dang / lha rnams dang /klu rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams dang / lha ma yin rnams dang / nam mkha' lding rnams dang / mi 'am ci rnams dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis bkur ste byas/ bla mar byas/ ri mo ribabyas/ mchod pa byas te/ lha dang /klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / sto 'phye chen po rnams kyis mchod cing shes pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bsod nams chen po dang ldan pa/ na bza' dang / zhal zas dang / gzims cha dang / gdan dang / snyun gsos dang / sman zong rnams brnyes pa/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa mnyan du yod pa na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /de nas ston kyi dus kyi tshe dge slong dag skya rbab ser po'i nad kyis thebs te lus rid cing lus nyams46)chung bar gyur to/ /bcom ldan 'das ni snyan mi mnga' zhing gnod pa med la snyan gyis btab pa med de stobs dang ldan 75—206

no / /de nas dge slong rnams kyis de mthong nas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/btsun pa dge slong kha cig ni gdon57gyi nad skya rbab ser pos thebs te lus rid cing lus nyam7chung bar gyur/ bcom ldan 'das ni snyan mi mnga' zhing gnod pa ma mchis te/ stobs dang ldan zhing rang bzhin gyis snyun mi mnga' la pho ba'i drod snyoms shing 'ju ba dang ldan pa la gzigs/ bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyis/ sngon tshe rabs gzhan dag tu tshogs rnyed cing rkyen grub pa dang ldan te dba' rgal bzhin du 'byung la/ gdon mi za bar 'ong ba'i las de dag byas shing bsags pas na/ nga nyid kyis las byas shing bsagasalgepa de dag gzhan su zhig gis nyams su myong bar 'gyur te/ dge slong dag las byas shing bsags pa rnams ni phyi rol gyi sa'i khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur/ chu'i khams dang / me'i khams dang / rlung gi khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur te/ las dge ba dang mi dge ba byas shing bsags tshong)pa rnams ni zin pa'i phung po dang khams dang skye mched rnams 'ba' 3)zhig la rnam par smin par 'gyur ro/ /lus can dag gi las rnams ni/ /bskal pa brgyar yang chud mi za/ /tshogs shing dus la bab pa na/ /'bras bu nyid du smin par 'gyur/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na/ grong khyer bā rā ṇa sī na/ rgyal po pad ma zhes bya ba rgyal po byed de/ de'i ring la 'byor pa dang ske/ rgyas pa dang / bde ba dang / lo legs pa dang / skye bo dang mi mang pos gang ba dang / 'thab pa dang / rtsod pa zhi ba dang / 'khrug pa dang /nang9)'khrugashedang / chom rkun 5shernyodang / mu ge dang / nad rnams med pa dang ske/ 'bras sā77lu dang / bu ram shing dang / ba lang dang / ma he dang 75—207

ldan par 'dug ste/ gnod pa med cing tsher ma dkrugs7la bu gcig pa la bya ba bzhin du rgyal srid bskyangs so/ /rgyal po de yang dad pa dang ldan la dge zhing bsam pa bzang ba dngas/ bdag la phan pa dang gzhan la phan pa la zhugs pa/snying rje che ba/ bdag nyid che ba/ chos 'dod pa skye dgu la byams pa thams cad sbyin pal/ thams cad yongs su gtong ba/ chags pa med par yongs su gtong ba/ gtong ba chen po la gnas pa zhig go/ /de'i tshe bā rā ṇa sīr dusalgedang dus tshigs ma snyoms5gepa las mi nad chen po byung ste/ sems can phal cher skya rbab kyi nad kyis btab bo/ /de nas rgyal pos de dag mthong nas snying rje skyed〈cade/ /bdag gis 'di dag yongs su bskyab par bya zhing gso bar bya'o snyam mo/ /de nas yul thams cad na sman pa 'khodasapa rnams bsdus te/ bsgo nas sems can de dag gi 49nand kyi gzhi dang gnas dang snga nas gzhi yod pa rtogs nas/ de'i 'og tu bdag nyid kyis gso ba dang sman thams cad bsdu bar byas so/ /de nas gsos te/ nor dang sman dang nad g.yog dang ldan par byas kyang yun ring mo hunyezhig lon gyi bar du sems can de dag gso ma nus sol/ /de nas rgyal pos sman pa thams cad bkug ste 32gus par byas nas/ kye ci'i phyir sems can 'di dag gso dka' bar gyur ces smras so/ /de nas sman pa rnams kyis dpyad de yon tan dang nyes pa gros 'thun par gsol pa/ lha dus ma snyoms yipa dang khams ma snyoms 9pa las gyur pa lags pas/ legs par tshem rtogs mod kyi lha tso'on kyang sman sna gcig mchis te/ nya ro hi ta zhes bgyi ba zhig mchis lo3tshe/ gal te rnyed na ni des gso bar nus lags so/ /de nas rgyal po nya ro hi ta tsho/shekun tu tshol ba la zhugs te des tshol ba'i mi mang po bkye 75—208

nas btsal7kyang ma rnyed do/ /de nas de dag gis rgyal po la gsol to/ /de nas7phyi zhig na rgyal po 'chag tu gshegs pa dang / nad pa de dag kyang gcig tu 'dus te 'khod nas rgyal po la gsol pa/ rgyal po chen po bdag cag nad 'di las yongs su bskyab cing srog stsal du gsol/ de nas rgyal pos nad pa rnams kyi tshig snying rje rje skad zer zhing / sdug sdug skad zer la gti zhing smra ba'i tshig thos nas snying rjes7snying bskyod de/ 'chi ma 'dzag cing ngu bzhin du⑥byung nas bsams pa/ bdag gis gzhan sdug bsngal gyis gzir ba rnams zhi bar byed kyang ma nus na bdag gi 'tsho ba 'di lta bu dang rgyal srid kyisadabang phyug 'di 'dra ba ci dgos snyam mo/ /de snyam du bsams56)nas/ rgyal pos nor phal po che yongs su gtong ba byas te/ bu thu bo rgyal por bcug nas nye du dang skye bo rnams la nyes pa bshags 9)te/ pho brang 'khor gyi mi dang blon po rnams la bstod nas/ nad pa sdugashepa rnams dbugs phyung ste brtul zhugs yan lag brgyad pa yang dag par blangs nas khang bzangs kyi steng du song ste/ bdugasngo )pa dang / me tog dang / spos dang / me tog phreng77dang / byug pa rnams gtor nas sharatshwa phyogs su kha bltas 12te smon lam btab pa/ bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig gang gis sems can rnams shin tu phongs par gyur te/ nad kyis yongs su gzir ba tsomathong nas bdag gis rang gi srog phangs pa yongs su btang ba'i bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig 'dis bdag chu klung zlog 8byed 'di'i nang du nya ro nyi tar skye bar shog shig ces smras nas khang bzangs kyi7steng nas bdag nyid kyis mchongs hunyeso/ /der lhung ba'i mod la shi nas chu klung zlog byed kyi nang du nya bo che ro hi ta zhes bya bar skyes so/ /de nas lha rnams kyis yul 75—209

thams cad du chu klungatsha1)zlog byed kyi nang du nya bo che ro hi ta zhes bya bsheskyes pa de ni/ nad tshabs po ches gzir nas yun ring du lon pa rnams kyi bdud rtsi dang 'dra'o zhes sgra bsgrags geso/ /de nas thos ma thag tu skye bo phal po ches lag nasrematshon cha thogs nas skon pa khyer te dong nas/ nya de gson por mtshon cha rnon po rnam pa sna tshogs kyis55sha rnams gcod pa la zhugs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' de yang de ltar lus gcod56)pa na/ sems can de dag la byams pas khyab par byas nas gdong mchi ma dron po 'dzag ste/ des bsams pa bdag gi sha khrag gis sems can 'di dag bde bar 'gyur ba 'di ni/ bdag gis rnyed pa legs par rnyed do snyam nas/ de lta bu'i tshul gyis lo bcu gnyis kyi bar du rang gi sha khrag gis sems can de dag tshim par byas te/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las kyang sems ma log go/ /gang gi tshe sems can de dag gi nad de zhi bar gyur pa de'i tshe nya bo che ro hi ta des sgra bsgrags gyepa/ kye sems can dag khyedam9)nyon cig /nga ni rgyal po pad ma zhes bya ba de yin te ngas khyed kyi don du rang gi srog yongs su btang nas lus 'di lta bu blangs pa yin gyisal / nga la /7sems dga' bar gyis shig dang gang gi tshe nga bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang 1 chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba de'i tshe/yang khyed nad las gtan du yongs su thar bar bya ste/ mya ngan las 'das pa gzha' gsang / gi mthar thug pa grub pa dang bde ba la dgod par bya'o zhes byas sol/ /de skad thos nas/ skye bo'i tshogs 8de dag dang / rgyal po dang / blon po dang / pho brang 'khor gyi mi rnams kyis dad pa rnyed de/ me tog dang / me tog phreng mdang / byug /zhepa dag gis mchod nas smon lam btab pa/ shin tu 75—210

dka' ba byed pa khyod gang gi tshe bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu stimangon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba de'i tshe bdag cag khyodasakyi nyan thos su gyur cig ces byas so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag 0ji snyam du sems de'i tshe de'i dus na rgyal po pad ma zhes bya bar gyur pa gang yin pa de ni nga yin te/ ngas de lta bu'i yongs su gtong ba byas pa des na nga 'khor ba na 'khor ba'i tshe bde ba mtha' yas pa nyams su myong bar gyur la/da ltar bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa na yang / pho ba'i drod snyoms geshing 'ju ba dang ldan55)te/ desam byen ngas zos pa dang 'thungs pa dang / 'chos pa dang myangs pa rnams legs par bde bar zhu bar gyur 7 te/ nga nad med cing gnod pa med la nad med pa'i⑧rang bzhin can du gyur to/ /dge slong dag de bas na 'di ltar bslabs kyipar bya stetshodzha bye/ sems can thams cad la snying rje bsgom par bya'o zhes dge slong khyed kyis de ltar bslab par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ dge slong de dag yi0lharangs te bcom ldan 'das kyis 3glegasungs pa la mngon par bstod do// //kham phonyere zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po rnams dang ske/ blon po chen po7rnams dang / phyug po rnams dang / pho brang 'khor gyi mi rnams dang / tshong dpon rnams dang / ded dpon rnams dang / lha rnams dang / klu rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams dang / lha ma yin rnams dang ske/ nam mkha' lding rnams dang / mi 'am ci rnams dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis bkur sti byas/ bla mar byas/ ri mo byas/ mchod patsha byas te/75—211

lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang ske/ mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis mchod cing shes pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bsod nams nyu)chen po dang ldan pa/ na bza' dang ske/ zhal zas dang / gzims cha dang / gdan dang / snyunashegasos dang ske/ sman zong rnams brnyes pa nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa mnyan du yod pa na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /der bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag gal te ji ltar ngas sbyin pa'i 'bras bu yang shes la / sbyin pa'i bgo bsha'i 'bras bu rnam par smin pa yang shes pa bzhin du sems can rnams kyis kyang / sbyin pa'i 'bras bu yang shes la/ sbyin pa'i bgo⑧bsha'i 'bras bu rnam par smin ri pa yang shes su zin na ni/ de lta na khamasagyi tha ma dang kham 7gyi mjug lus pa gang yin pa de las kyang gal te yon gnas len pa po rnyed na/ de la rtsonam byin nam/ bgo bsha'amanyem byas kyi bar du za bar mi byed la/ de dag gi sems kyang ser sna skyes pas kun nas dkris7shing 'dug par mi 'gyur ba zhig na ji ltar ngas sbyin pa'i 'bras bu yang shes la/ sbyin pa'i bgo bsha'i 'bras bu rnam par smin pa yang tsho )shes pa bzhin du/ sems can rnams kyis kyang sbyin pa'i 'bras bu yang mi shes la/ sbyin pa'i bgo bsha'i 'bras bu rnam par smin pa yang mi shes pas na/ de'i phyir de dag ni kun tu 'dzin pa'i sems kyis ma byin pa'am bgo bsha'41ma byas par za bar byed la/ de dag gi sems kyang ser sna skyes pas kun nas dkris / shing 'dug go/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal 1rtete/ bde bar gshegs pas de skad ces 75—212

gsungs nas gzhan yang ston pas 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /bgo bsha'0)dag gi rnam par smin/ /ji ltar don ces〈kye'agyur ba des/ /drang srong chen pos gsungs pa bzhin/ /sems can rnams kyis shes na ni/ /ma sbyinasabar du mi za zhing / /ser sna can du mi 'gyur la/ /de dag kun tu 'dzin pa'i sems/ / nam yangasaskye bar mi 'gyur na/ /gang phyir byis pa gti mug gis/ /bsgribs pa rnams kyis ma shes pa/ /de phyir kun tu 'dzin sems kyis/ /rtag tu mas5)byin za bar byed/ /de dag ser sna skyes nas kyang / /sems ni kun nas dkris9)shing 'dug /gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis mdo 'di bka' stsal pa de'i tshe/dge slong dag the com skyes te/ the tsom thams cad gcod pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis sbyin pa'i bsngags pa yang bka' stsal la/ sbyin pa'i bgo bsha'i 'bras bu rnam par smin pa yang bka' stsal pa ni ngo mtshar lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de bzhin gshegs pas sbyin pa'i bsngags pa yang brjod la/sbyin pa'i bgo bsha'i 'bras bu rnam par smin pa yang brjod pa 'di lta la ngo mtshar che ba ci yod/ ngasashe'adas pa'i dus na slong ba'i phyir bdag za ba'i kham khar 'ongs zin pa las kyang yongs su btang ba de/ legs par rab tu nyon la yid la zung7shig dang ngas bshad do/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na grong khyer bā rā ṇa 'i〈nyen rgyal po tshangs pas byinamanyazhes bya ba rgyal po byed de/ de'i ring la 'byor pa dang / rgyas pa dang / bde ba dang /6) lo legs pa dang / skye borwanyedang / mi mang pos yongs susagang ba dang / rtsod0nyepa dang 'thab pa zhi ba tshadang / 'khrug pa dang / nang nyu 'khrug dang / chom 75—213

rkun dang / mu ge dang / nad rnams med pa dang / 'bras sā7lu dang / bu ram shing dang / ba lang dang / ma he dang ldanarwa par 'dug ste/ gnod pa med cing tsher ma dkrugs gu)la ca)bu gcig pa la bya ba bzhin du rgyal srid bskyangs sol/ /rgyal po de yang dad pa dang ldan la dge zhing bsam pa5snyenabazang ba/ bdag la phan pa dang gzhan la phan pa las6)zhugs pa/ snying rje che ba/ bdag nyid che ba / chos 'dodamachos)pa/ skye dgu la byams pa thams cad sbyin pa thams cad yongs sum gtong ba/ chags pa med par yongs su gtong ba/ gtongadzakhyab chen po la gnas pa zhig go/ /phyis re zhig na mu ge'i bar gyi bskal pa dang 'dra bar mu ge chen po byung 'ingo / /de nas skye bo'i tshogs mu ge'i 1nyadus ma yin par 'chi bas 'jigs pa bkres shing lkog ma dang 'gram pa zhom pa/ yi dgas kyi hu)lus 'dra ba de dag 'dus shing tshogs la gcig tu 'phungs te/ rgyal po'i thad du dong nas rgyal bar gyur cig /sku tshe ring bar shog shig ces bstod de smras pa / lha bdag cag mu ge'i 'jigs pa 'di las yongs su skyob nyu3cing / srog stsal du gsol zhes byas so/ /de nas rgyal pos mdzod pa la bos te/ kwa yerdzobamadzod pa mdzod na zas dang skom mabadag cag dang skye bo'i tshogs 'di rnams kyi chog par yod dam zhes byas so/ /de thos nas mdzod srungasatson re brtsis te lha la gsol bar 'tshal lo zhes byas so/ /de nas rtsis mkhas pa rnams kyis brtsisatson / 'di srid cig gi bar du yul na 'khod pa thams cad ni nyin gcig bzhin kham re re 'tshal la/rte/ rgyal po ni 3 rizhal kham gnyis gnyisamatshegasol ba mchis so zhes gsol to/ /de nas rgyal pos skye bo'i tshogs rnams ni la bos te bsgo ba/'o na khyed nyinapas gcig bzhin du rgyal po'i pho brang du shog la/ kham re re 39zos 75—214

nas dengs0)shig ces byas so/ /de nas de dag nyin gcig bzhin du lhags te/mi res50kham re zos nas gar dga' bar 'dong bar byed do/ /de nas bram ze gzhan zhig rtsis de'i nang du ma zhen te/ gzhan las gtam thos nas rgyal po la smras pa/ lha rtsis mdzad ( cinapar yul mi'i 3)nang du bdag gis thos kyis ⑤bdag la'ang khamakhegacig po de stsol cig ces byas so/ /de nas rgyal pos bdag nyid kham gnyis za ba las kham gcig bram ze la byin nas/ kham gcig ni yul mi dang thang mnyam parasheza bar byed do/ /lha'i dbang po brgya byin ni 'og ma la shes pa'i mthong ba 'jug ste/ de 'di snyam du sems te/ kye ma yul bā rā ṇa sri'un / rgyal po byed pa de ni shin tu dka' ba byed cing 'dug gisapo)de bdag gis bgam par bya'o snyam mo/ /de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis bdag nyid bram ze'i cha lugs su sprul te/ gro0kāl bab pa'i tshe/ rgyal po'i thad du song nas rgyal bar gyur cig sku tshe ring bar shog shig ces bstod nas smras pa/ lha bdag bkres kyis 3gelha nyid kyi zhal kham gcig po des bdag la phan gdags par gsol / de nas rgyal pos rang gi srog yongs su gtang bar chad nas/ snying rjes bdag gi kham gcig po de bram ze la byin nas smyung bar ༷/nye'adug ste/ de lta bu'i tshul gyis zhag drug gi bar du zan bcad do/ /'on kyang skye bo phal po che de dag zan za ba mthong nasamasamachog tu dga' bar sems so/ /de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis rgyal po de shin tu dka' ba byed pa mthong nas bram ze'i cha lugs mi snang bar byas te/ rang gi gzugs su 'dug nas rgyal po la bstod pa / rgyal po chen po legs so/ / ma nyes so khyed 8dka' ba la zhugs pa 'dis bdag dga' bar gyur to/ /skye dgu skyong ba 'di lta bu yod pa las na skye bo'i 75—215

tshogs 'di dag ni mgon yod pa yin no/ / da sa0)bon thams cad thob cig ces yul phyogs su bsgodza shig dang bdag gis zhag bdun na/ gang gis 'bru rnams rgyal bar 'gyur ba de lta bu'i dbang chen gyi char dbab par bya'o zhes byas sol/ /rgyal pos kyang de bzhin du byed du bcug go/ /brgya byin gyis kyang de lta bu'i dbang chen gyi char phab ste/ des na mu ge de chabazlog ste lo legs par gyur to / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/de'i tshe de'i dus na rgyal po tshangs pas byin zhes bya bar gyur pa gang yin pa de ni nga yin de ri/ ngas de lta bu'i mu ge byung ciltan yang rang gi srog yongs su btang ste de lta bu'i sbyin pa dag byin (6)no/ /dge slong dag de bas na 'di ltar bslab par bya ste sbyin pa dag sbyin no/ /bsod nams dag bya'o zhes dge slong khyed kyis de ltar bslab par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/dge slong de dag yi rimarangs te bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// //chos skyong zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po rnams dang ske/ blon po chen po rnams dang / phyug po rnams dang / pho brang 'khor gyi mi rnams dang / tshong50dpon rnams dang / ded dpon rnams dang / lha rnams0)dang / klu rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams dang / lha〈nyem yin rnams dang / nam mkha' lding rnams dang / mi 'am ci rnams dang 9) lto 'bye chen po rnams kyis 8bkur ste byas/ bla mar byas/ ri mo7byas/ mchod pa byas te/ lhabadang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / salgem yin dang /nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 15'phye chen po rnams kyis mchod 75—216

cing shes pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bsod nams chen po dang ldan pa/na bza' dang zhal zas dang gzims cha dang gdan dang snyun gsos dang sman zong rnams brnyes pa/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa rgyal po'i khab na 'od ma'i tshal bya ka lan da ka gnas pa na rten cing bzhugs so/ /gang gi tshe mi blun po lhas7sbyin gyis/ bcom ldan 'das bgrongs pa'i phyir②/ glang po che nor skyong yang btangs/ dug gi phye mas kyang gtor④/ gshed ma'i mi yang bkye ste / de bcom ldan 'das la yun ring po nas gshed ma dang dgra dang mi mdza' bar gyur la/ bcom ldan 'das ni de la byams pa'i dgongs pa dang phan pa'i dgongs pa dang thugs brtse ba'i dgongs pa (6)nye bar gnas par gyur pa de'i tshe/dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di ltar lha ⑦phyin 'di ni bcom ldan 'das bgrongs (gupa'i slad du brtson par bgyid la/bcom ldan 'das ni 'di la byams pa'i dgongs pa dang phan pa'i dgongs pa dang thugs brtse ba'i dgongs pas nye bar gnas pa la gzigs/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag da ltar de bzhin gshegs pa 'dod chags dang bral ba/ zhe snang dang bral ba/ gti mug dang bral ba/ skye ba dang / rga ba dang / na ba dang / 'chi ba dang / mya ngan dang / smre sngags 'don pa dang / sdugashebasngal ba dang / yid mi bde ba dang / 'khrug pa rnams las yongs su grol ba thams cad mkhyen pa/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa/ye shes dang shes bya thams cad la mnga' brnyes zin pa 'di ltarwatel ngo mtshar che ba ci yod/ 'das pa'i dus na 'dod chags dang bcas pa/ zhe snang dang bcas pal/ gti mug dang bcas pa na/ na sopo gzhon pa'i tshe gsod du 'ongs pa na 75—217

yang / ngas7'di la sems snang ba ma byas pa de legs par rab tu nyon la yid la zungasashig dang ngas bshad do/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na / grong khyer bā rā ṇa gshen rgyal po tshangs pas byin zhes bya ba rgyal po byed de/de'i ring la 'byor pa dang / rgyas pa dang / bde ba dang / lo legs pa dang /skye bo dang mi mang pos yongs su gang ba dngase/ 'thab pa dang / rtsodasnyipa zhi ba dang / 'khrug pa dang / nang 'khrug dang / chom rkun dang / mu ge dang /nad rnams med pa dang / 'bras sā57lu dang / bu ram shing dang / ba lang dang —/ ma te shedang ldan par 'dug ste/ gnod pa med cing tsher ma dkrugasashel bu gcig pa la bya ba bzhin du rgyal srid bskyangs so/ /rgyal po de yang dad pa dang ldan la 3)dge zhing bsam pa bzang ba bdag la phan pa dang gzhan la phan pa la zhugs pa/ snying5)rje che ba/ bdag nyid che ba/ chos 'dod pa/ skye dgu la byams pa/ thams cad sbyin pa/(ge thams cad yongs su gtong ba/chags pa med par yongs su gtong ba zhig ste gtong ba chen po la gnas so/ /rgyal po de la btsun mo blo ngan ma zhes bya ba gtum zhing khro la gzu lums can zhig yod de/ bu gcig pa chos skyong zhes bya ba yang blo ngan ma de nyid las〈nyebatsas so / /gzhon nu chos skyong de yang dad pa dang ldan la/ dge zhing bsam pa bzang ba/ bdag la phan pa dang gzhan la phan pa la zhugs pa/ snying rje che ba/bdag nyid che ba/ chos 'dod pa/ skye dgu la byams pa zhig stetsho/ de yang bā rā ṇa sī tson gnas pa'i bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams kyis mthong na sdug cing phangs la snying du sdug cing yid du 'ong bar bya ba yin no/ /de nas de mkhan po'i thad du song nas byis pa dag dang lhan cig tu yi ge slob bo/ /phyis re zhig 75—218

na rgyal po dpyid kyi dus kyi7tshe/ shing rnams me tog rgyas pa dang / ngang pa dang ske/ khrung khrung dang / rma bya dang / ne tso dang / ri skegs dang / khu byug dang / shang shang te'u rnams skad 'byin pa'i nags khrod du/ btsun mo dam pa dang bcas pa'i btsun ②mo'i 'khor gyis zhabs 'bring ③byas te skyed ④mos tshal gyi sar song ste/ skyed ⑤mos tshal de na/ rgyal po btsun mo'i 'khor dang lhan cig rtse ba las btsun mo blo ngan ma phrag dog dang khro bas non te 'khrugs so/ /rgyal pos ni de la skom 'thungs pa'i phyed bskur ba dang / de 'khrugs pas rgyal po la phrin spring ba gal te bdag khyod kyis 'thungs pa'i phyed 'thung bar gyur na/ bdag bu'i khrag 'thung bar gyur cig ces byas so/ /'dod pa sten pa la ni sdig pa'i las mi bya ba ci yang med de/ de nas rgyal po tshangs pas byin chos can yin mod kyi/ 'dod pa'i 'dod chags kyi kun nas dkris ⑦pa med par gyur nas/ btsun mo'i 'khor gyis phe'u btab kyang khro ba'i me 'bar te/ de rje7thur khros nas/ khyed deng 6)la khye'u chos skyong gi mgul5) ba chod de de la khrag lud 3glecig ces bsgo'o/ /de nas khye'u chos skyong byis pa'i grwa 32khang na 'dug pas thos nas/ ngus te 'di skad du 'khor ba na sems can mi 'thun pa ni tha chad yin te 'di ltar khro ba'i dbang gis rang gi lus las byung ba'i bu yang gsod par byed do zhes smras so/ /de nas khye'u chos skyong rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan te/ yab kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal〈nyenas gsol ba/ yab cig pa'o ( )'tshal la hunyeni bu sdug la bdag gis kyang nongs pa ma bgyis na bdag mi dgum par ci gnang / rgyal pos bka' stsal pa/ bu sdug gal te khyod kyi mas bzod na ni ngas kyang bzod par bya'o/ /de nas chos skyong ngu zhingasnyima'i thad du 75—219

song ste rkang pa la phyag 'tshalanyenas thal mo sbyar te/ yum bzod pa mdzod la bdag gsodakhudu ma stsal cig /ces smras so/ /de skad du snying rje rje skad zer zhing sdug sdug skad zer la/ gti zhing zla ba'i tshig thos kyang des bzod pa ma byas so/ /de nas gshed ma rnams kyis mtshon rnon pos khye'u chos skyong gi mgul pa bcad de/ btsun mo blo ngan ma la khrag blud na 'on kyang blo ngan ma 'gyod pa yang med do/ /khye'u chos skyong ni pha ma dang gshed ma rnams la sems dga' ba bskyed nas shi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag ji snyamashedu sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus na khye'u chos skyong zhes bya bar gyur pa gang yin pa de ni nga yin no/ /btsun mo blo ngan ma ni lhas byinasre'adi kho na yin te de'i tshe nga dugashed ma'i lag tu song ba na yang 'di la byams pa'i sems bskyed la/da ltar nga la gsad7par brtson pashen yang nga 'di la byams par sems phan par sems/ snying brtse bar sems so/ /dge slong dag de bas na 'di ltar bslab par bya ste/ sems can thams cad la byams pa'i sems bsgom par bya'o zhes dge slong khyed kyis de ltar bslab par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas dge slong de dag yi ga byerangs te bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// //zhi ldan zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po rnams dang /blon po chen po rnams dang / phyug po rnams dang / pho brang 'khor gyi mi rnams dang / tshong dpon rnams dang / ded dpon rnams dang / lha rnams dang / klu rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams dang / lha ma yin rnams dang /nam mkha' lding rnams dang / mi 'am ci rnams dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams 75—220

kyisatubakur sti byas/ bla mar byas/ ri mosabyas/ mchod pa byas te/ lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis mchod cing shes pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bsod nams chen po dang ldan pa/ na⑧bza' dang / zhal zas dang / gzims cha dang / gdan dang / snyun gsos dang /sman zong rnams brnyes pa/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa mnyan du yod pa na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe mnyan⑧du yod pa na dge slong dag 'dus pa chen po gnyis su gyur te/ gcig ni dbyar zla 'bring po la dbyar gnas par dam 'cha'oX/ /gcig ni ston zla tha chungs stinya'i bar du dbyar gnas par dam 'cha' ste/ der dge slong dag lhung bzed rnams kha dog sgyur bar byedakhuchos gos7'khru zhing btso blagatshwanye byed tshem bu rnams 'drubasngo)par byed do/ /de nas re zhig na dge slong zhig chos gos 'drub tunyepar 'dod de 4)khab kyi mig tu skud pa gzhug mkhenas nas snying rje rje skad zer zhing sdug sdug skad zer la gti zhing matsoste/ 'jig rten na7bsod nams 'dod pa su yod/ 'jig rten na bsod nams 'dod pa su yod ces zer ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyang de dang thag mi ring ba zhig na 'chag sa na 'chag cing bzhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis glang po che'i sna lta bu'i phyag brkyang nas/ gdangs〈nyezab cing snyan la zur phyin pa dang bya ka la ping ku'i skad lta bur yid du hu 'ong ba rnga bo che'i sgra 4)ltar snyan pa'i gsung gis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong nga ni 'jig rten na (2 bsod nams 'dod pa'o/ /de nas dge slong des bcom ldan 'das kyis gsung yan 75—221

lag lnga dang ldan pa thos nas gus par bsgrimamanyupas la gor du bcom ldan 'das kyi phyag nas bzung ste rang gi mgo bosnyil bzhag (minas smras pa/ bcom ldan 'das khyod kyi phyag 'dis bskal pa grangs med pa gsum gyi bar du sbyin pa dang /tshul khrims dang / bzod pa dang / brtson 'grus dang / bsam gtan dang /shes rab bsags na/ 'on kyang da dung bcom ldan 'das 'di skad du dge slong nga ni 'jig rten na bsodasnyinams 'dod pa'o zhes gsung ngam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong nga ni bsod nams kyis chog mi shes te/dge slong ngas ni bsod nams kyi ro myong bas na de'i phyir nga bsod nams kyis 6)chog mi shes so/ /de nas dge slong dag the tshom skyes te⑩the tsom thams cad gcod pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ bcom ldan 'das bsod nams kyi 'du byed rnams kyis chog mi mkhyen pa ni ngo mtshar lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag da ltar de bzhin gshegs pa 'dod chags dang bral ba/ zhe snang dang bral ba gti mug dang bral ba/ skye ba dang ske/ rga ba dang / na ba dang / 'chi ba dang / mya ngan dang / smre sngags 'don pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / yid mi bde ba dang / 'khrug pa las yongs su grol ba/ thams cad mkhyen pa/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa ye shes dang shes7bya thams cad la mnga' brnyesalazin pa 'di lta bulo)la ngo mtshar che ba ci yod/ 'das pa'i dus na 'dod chags dang bcas pa/ zhe snang dang bcas pa / gti mug dang bcas pa/ skye ba dang / rga ba dang / na ba dang / 'chi ba dang / mya ngan dang / smre sngags 'don pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang /yid mi bde ba dang / 'khrug pa rnams las yongs su ma grol ba'i tshe/ nga 75—222

bsod nams kyi 'du byed rnams kyis chog mi shes pa de legs par rab tu nyon la yid la zunganyeshig dang ngas bshad do/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na/ rgyal po'i pho brang zhi ba'i sgra chen⑧zhes bya ba na/ rgyal po zhi ldan zhes bya ba rgyal po byed de/ de'i ring la 'byor pa dang / rgyas pa dang / bde ba dang / lo legs pa dang / skye bo dang mi mang pos gang ba dang / rtsodasapa dang ske/ 'thab pa zhi ba dang / 'khrug pa dang / nang 'khrugasnyedang / chom rkun dang / mu ge dang / nad rnams med pa dang / 'bras sā0lu dang / bu ram shing dang / ba lang dngakhu/ ma he dang ldan par 'dug ste/ gnod pa med cing tsher ma dkrugasasnyel bu gcig pa la bya ba bzhin du rgyal srid bskyangs so//rgyal po de yang dad pa dang ldan la/ dge zhing bsam pa bzang ba/ bdag la phan pa dang gzhan la phan pa la zhugs pa/ snying rje che ba/ bdag nyid che ba/chos 'dod pa/ skye dgu la byams pa thams cad sbyin pa thams cad yongs su gtong ba/ chags pa med par yongs su gtong ba/ gtong ba chen po la gnas pa zhig go/ /de nas de nang par sngar langs te mchod sbyin gyi 'dun khang du song nas zas 'dod pa rnams la ni zas sbyin par byed del/ skom7'dod pa rnams la ni skom sbyin par byed/ gos 'dod pa rnams la ni gos sbyin par byed cing /nor dang / 'bru dang / 'gronatshwanyebu dang / gser dang / nor bu〈nyedang /mu tig dang / be+e drur+ya〈nyedang / dung dang / man shel dang / byi7ru rnamasalgeyongs su gtong bar byed do/ /'on kyang de bsod nams kyi 'du byed rnams kyis chog mi shes so/ /de btsun mo'i 'khor du song nas btsun mo'i 'khor la zas dang skom sbyin par byed do/ /bu rnams dang / blon po rnams dang /75—223

dpa' bo dang / ru mchog dang grong rdal gyi mi rnams dang / yulatumi rnams la zas dang skom7sbyin par byed do/ /de nas rgyal po zhi ldan 'di snyam du sems te / bdag gis mi rnams ni tshim par byas na srog chags phra mo rnams lus pa de dag ci zhig gis tshim par bya snyam mo/ /des bdog pa thams cad yongs su btang chabs gos ya ④gcig tsam gyon par zad de lus nyi tshe las dupar gyur nas bsams pa/ srog chags phra mo rnams la ni rang gi lus sbyin par bya'o snyam mo / /des7lus bzhogs nas gang na sha sbrang dang sbrang bu mchu ringasakyil sogs pa yod pa der lus bor te 'dug nas bu gcig pa sdug pa la bya ba bzhin du khrag gis tshim par byas so/ /lha'i dbang po brgya byin ni 'og ma la shes pa'i mthong ba 'jug ste de 'di snyam du sems te/ ci sergyal po zhi ldan 'di sems can rnams kyi don du 'di ltar byed dam/ 'on te snying rjes byed cig gu snyam nas bdag gis 'di bgam59)par bya'o snyam mo/ /de nas bya rgod stang zil bcag pa'i 'phro lta bu dang snag tsa'i〈nyamadog can lta bur bdag nyid sprul te/ rgyal po zhi ldan gyi thad du song nas mchus mig bru hunyebar gzas na yang hunyergyal po de skrag par ni ma gyur gyi/ byams pa'i mig chen pos bya rgod de la bltas nas smras pa/ bu nga'i lus las gang 'dod pa las ci dga' mgur〈stegyis shig ces byas so/ /de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin dga' bar gyur te/ bram ze'i cha lugs su sprul nas rgyal po zhi ldan gyi mdun du 'greng ste smras pa/ rgyal po legs kyis7khyod kyi mig gnyis nga la byin cig rgyal pos smras pa/ kye bram ze nga'i lus 7'di la 'gog pa su yang med kyis hu)ci 'dod pa khyer cig ces byas so/ /de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin lhag par dga' bar gyur nas bram ze'i cha lugs mi snang〈nyebar byas te/75—224

rang gi gzugs su 'dug nas rgyal po la sgroshib bskyed de smras pa/ kye rgyal po legs so legs so/ /khyod kyi blo shin tu nges solakhyod kyi smon lam bskyod du med do / /sems can rnams la khyod kyi snying rje chen po'i rgyun⑧'bab par gyur to/ /khyod 'jigs par bya ba'i chos rnams la 'di ltar 'jigs pa med pa las na khyodakyiring po mi thogs par brtson pa 'dis/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro zhes byas so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus na rgyal po zhi ldan du gyur pa gang yin pa7de ni nga yin te/ de'i tshe yang nga bsod nams mngon par 'du byed pa rnams kyis chog ma7shes na da ltar lta ci smos/ dge slong dag de bas na 'di ltar bslab par bya ste sbyin pa dag sbyin no/ /bsod nams dag bya'o zhes dge slong khyed kyis de ltar bslab par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ dge slong de dag yi〈snarangs te bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// //gzugs bzang zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po rnams dang / blon po chen po rnams dang / phyug po rnams skyedang / pho brang 'khor gyi mi rnams dang / tshong dpon rnams dang / ded dpon rnams dang /lha rnams dang / klu0rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams dang / lha ma yin rnams dang / nam mkha' lding rnams dang / mi 'am ci rnams dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis bkur sti byas/ bla mar byas/ ri mor byas/ mchod pa byas te/ lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang /she ) lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis〈homachod 75—225

cing shes pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bsod nams chen po dang ldan pa/na bza' dang / zhal zas dang / gzims cha dang / gdan dang / snyun gsos dang / sman zong rnams brnyesalgepa/ nyan thos kyisnyedage 'dun dang bcas pa/ mnyan du yod pa na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal khyim bdag mgon medasazas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba nasnyibazhugs so/ /gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das nang du yang dag 'jog las bzhengs nas/ 'khor bzhi po rnams la sbrang bu'i sbrang rtsi ma bskol ⑤ba dang 'dra ba'i chos ro dang ldan no cog bshad sto/ /'khorashebargya phrag du mas kyang dbang po rnams mi g.yo bar bcom ldan 'das la chos ro dang ldan no cog mnyan pa de'i tshe dge slong dag the tsom skyes te/ the tsom thams cad gcod pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa sems can 'di rnams chos rin po che'i snod du yang gyur tel/ gus par mnyan par sems pa la gzigs/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de bzhin gshegs pas ji ltar gus pa bskyed de chos mnyan pa dang bzung ba de legs par rab tu nyon la yid la zungasheshig dang ngas bshad do/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na grong khyer bā rā ṇa sī tunye na rgyal po gzugs bzang zhes bya ba zhig rgyal po byed de de'i ring la 'byor pa dang / rgyas pa dang / bde ba dang / lo legs pa dang / skye bo dang mi mang pos gang ba dang ske/ 'thab pa dang / rtsod57pa zhi ba dang / 'khrug pa dang / nang 'khrug dang ske/ chom rkun dang / mu ge dang / nad rnams med pa dang / 'bras sā7lu dang / bu ram shingatshwanyedang / ba lang dngatshwaste/ ma he dang ldan par 'dug ste / gnod pa med cing tsher ma dkrugs la78bu gcig pa la7bya ba bzhin du 75—226

rgyal srid bskyangs so/ /rgyal po de yang dad pa dang ldan la dge zhing bsam pa bzang ba bdag la phan pa dang gzhan la7phan pa la zhugs pa/ snying rje che ba/bdag nyid che ba/ chos 'dod pal/ skye dgu la byams pa/ thams cad sbyin pa / thams cad yongs su gtong ba/ chags pa med par yongs su gtong ba/gtong ba chen po la gnas pa zhig go/ /de nas rgyal po de la btsun mo mdzes ldan ma zhes bya ba gzugs bzang zhing blta na sdug la mdzes pa yan lag dang nying lag thams cad dang ldan pa zhig yod do/ /bu gcig pa mdzes ldan zhes bya ba sdug cing phongasakhul snying du sdug cing yidabadu 'ong ba/ bzodakyipa dang ldan pa/mi 'thun pa med pa zhig kyang yod do/ /de nas phyi zhig na rgyal po gzugs bzang chos 'dod par gyur nas des blon po thams cad bsogs te ༅smras pa/yul gyi gtso bo dag nga chos 'dod kyis9)nga'i chos tshol cig ces bsgo'o/ /de nas blon po de dag gis thal mo sbyar te gsol pa/ rgyal po chen po chos ni dkon te sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byung na gdod chos 'byung ngo zhes gda'o/ /de nas rgyal posalgegaser 'bum yod pa'i snod rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo la btags te/ yul thams cad du dril bsgrags nas nga'i yul na chos smra ba gang yin pa de la gser 'bum yod pa'i snod 'di sbyin no/ /bkur sti chen pos kyang bkur ①zhing bstod par bya'o zhes kyang byas so/ /de nas yun ring po zhig lon kyang chos smra ba su yang mi snang ngo / /de nas rgyal po chos kyi phyir gdung zhing yi chad do/ /lha'i dbang po brgya byin ni 'og ma la shes pa'i mthong ba 'jug ste/ des rgyal po chos kyi phyir phongs shing 'dug pa mthong nas de 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag gis rgyal po gzugs bzang bgam par bya'o snyam mo/ /de nas bdag nyid gnod 75—227

sbyin rkang7)lag dang mig mi sdug pa zhig tu sprul nas/ rgyal po 'khor du ma'i⑧nang na 'dug pa la 'di skad ces smrasakyiso/ /ci khyod chos 'dod ce na/ ngas khyod la chos bstan ④rto/ /de nas rgyal pos chos kyi sgra thos pas dga' zhing mchog tu dga' ba skyes nas gnod sbyin la 'di skad ces smras so/ /gsang ba pa chos smos shigashengs mnyan par bya'o/ /gnod sbyin gyis smras pa/ kye ma rgyal po chen po bde zhing 'khod pa ni chos smra bar byed kyi nga ni bkres kyis rje zan byin cig /de nas rgyal pos de thos nas/ zho shas 'tsho ba rnams la 'di'i bza' ba dang bca' ba'i rnam pa dag 'on cig ces bsgo'o/ /gnod sbyin gyis smras pa / nga ni 'phral la bsad pa'i sha dang khrag za zhing 'thung ba yin gyis mgu gcig pa mdzes ldan 'di nga la byin cig /de nas rgyal pos de thos nas mchog tu mi dga' bar gyur te/ brgya lam na lan cig deng lta zhig chos kyi sgra dang phrad na de yang rin thang gdab tu med pas nyo dgos so snyam mo/ /de nas gzhon nu mdzes ldan gyis de thos nas yab kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal te gsol pa/ lha bzod pa mdzad de lha'i dgongs pa rdzogs par mdzad la bdag gsang ba pa'i ⑨zas su stsal bar gsol (4 )zhes byas so/ /de nas rgyal pos bu gcig pa sdug cing phangs la snying du sdug cing yid du 'ong ba bzod57pa dang ldan pa mi 'thun pa med pa de chos kyi don du gnod sbyin la byin no/ /de nas gnod sbyin gyis rang gi rdzu 'phrul gyi stobs kyis rgyal po dang 'khor rnams la khye'u'i tsoyan lag dang nying lag rnams so sor bcad cing bcad cing〈nyezas pa dang khrag kyang 'thungs par bstan to/ /rgyal po desatshwanyemathong na chos 'dod pa'i phyir mi dga' bar ma gyur to/ /de nas gnod sbyin gyis rgyal po la smras pa/ rgyal po nga ma 'grangs 75—228

kyisam7yang byin cig ces byas so/ /rgyal pos de la snying du sdug pa'i chung ma yang byinaphuno/ /de nas de yang thabs de kho na ltar zos par bstanasheto/ /de nas yang rgyal po la smras pa/ kye rgyal po nga da dung ma 'grangasasheso/ /de nas rgyal pos gnod sbyin la smras pa/ bu ngas bu gcig pa dang sdug pa'i chung ma yang byin zin na yang ci 'dod/ gnod sbyin gyis smras pa/ rang gi lus nga la byin cig dang des na nga 'grangs par 'gyur ro/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ gal te rang gi lus khyod la byin na ngas ji ltar chos mnyan gyisatso/ sngar nga la chos jisnyeston dang ngas chos thos pa'i sti'og tu rang gi lus yongs su gtang (nye bar bya'o zhes byas so/ /de nas gnod sbyin (nyegyis rgyal po dam gyi 'og tu bcug nas 'khor brgya hunyephrag du ma'i mdun du chos bstan pa/ sdug pa dag las〈nyemya ngan skye/ /sdug pa dgashelas 'jigs pa skye/ /'jigs pa dag las rnam grol rnams / /mya ngan med na ga la 'jigs/ /de nas rgyal pos7tshigs su bcad pa 'di thos ma thag tu yid rab tu sim par gyur te/ dbang po dga' zhing yid bde ba skyes nas gnod sbyin la smras pa/ gnod sbyin nga'i lus 'di ji dga' bar gyis shig ces byas so/ /de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis rgyal po de bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las lhun po bzhin du mi g.yo bar rig nas/ gnod sbyin gyi gzugs mi snang bar byas te/ rang gi gzugs su 'dug nas dga' zhing mdangs phyung ba'i mig dang ldan pas lag pa ya gcig gis7ni bu bzung ya gcig gis ni chung ma bzung nas rgyal po spro ba bskyed de smras pal/ skyes bu dam pa legs so legs so/ /khyod kyi go cha brtan gyis brtson pa 'dis ring po mi thogs par bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub 75—229

mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /khyod kyi sdug pa'i mi dang phrad pa yang 'di yin no zhes byas7so/ /de nas rgyal pos lha'i dbang po brgya byin la 'di skad ces smras so/ /ko⑧shi ka bdag gi chos kyi bsam pa yongs su rdzogs par byas pa legs so legs so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag ji snyam du sems de'i tshe de'i dus na rgyal po gzugs bzang zhes bya bar gyur pa gang yin pa de ni〈kyeng yin no/ /gzhon nu mdzes7ldan ni kun dga' bo yinasnyino/ /mdzes ldan ma ni grags 'dzin ma yin no/ /dge slong dag de'i tshe yang ngas chos kyi phyir gnyen sdug pa yongs su gtong ba dang rang gi srog yongs su gtong ba byas na da ltar lta ci smos/ dge slong dag de bas na 'di ltar bslab par bya ste/ chos la bkur ste bya'o/ /bla mar bya'o/ /ri mor bya'o/ /mchod pa bya'o/ /chos la bkur sti byas/ bla mar byasaX/ ri mor byas/ mchod pa byas nas brten te gnas par bya'o zhes ⑦dge slong khyod7kyis de ltar bslab par bya'o / /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ dge slong de dag yisherangs te bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// // gang po la sogs pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa brgya pa/ bam po dgu pa/(nye mdza' bo'i bu mo zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po rnams dang ske/ blon po chen po rnams dang / phyug po rnams dang / pho brang 'khor gyi mi rnams dang / tshong dpon rnams dang / ded dpon rnams dang / lha rnams dang / klu rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams dang / lha ma yin rnams dang ske/ nam mkha' lding rnams dang / mi 'am ci rnams dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis bkur sti byas/ bla mar byas/ ri mor byas/ mchod pa byas 75—230

te①la/ lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis mchod cing shes pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bsod nams chen po dang ldan pa/ na⑧bza' dang / zhal zas dang / gzims cha dang / gdan dang / snyun gsos dang / sman zong rnams brnyesalgepa nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa mnyan du yod pa na⑧rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /der bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag khyim gang dag na pha ma gnyis la legs par ri mo byed pa dang legs par mchod pa byed pa dang legs par g.yog byed pa'i khyim de dag ni tshangs pa dang ldan pa yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ dge slong dag rigs kyi bu'i pha ma gnyis ni rigs pa'i sgo nas tshangs pa dang 'dra ba'i phyir ro/ /dge slong dag khyim gang dag na pha phyim gnyis la legs par ri mo byed pa dang legs par mchod pa byed pa dang legs par g.yog byed pa'i khyim de dag ni slob dpon dang ldan pa yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rigs kyi bu'i pha ma gnyis ni rigs pa'i sgo nas slob dpon dang 'dra ba'i phyir ro/ /dge slong dag khyim gang dag na pha ma gnyis la legs par ri mo byed pa dang legs par mchod pa byed pa dang legs par g.yog byed pa'i khyim de dag ni kun tu sbyin pa'i 'os su gyur pa dang ldan pa yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ dge slong dag rigs kyi bu'i pha ma gnyis ni rigs pa'i sgo nas kun tu sbyin pa'i 'os su gyur pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /dge slong dag khyim gang dag na pha ma gnyis la legs par ri mo byed pa dang legs par mchod pa byed pa dang legs par g.yog byed pa'i khyim de dag ni 75—231

me dang ldan pa yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na①/ dge slong dag rigs kyi bu'i pha ma gnyis ni rigs pa'i sgo nas me dang 'dra ba'i phyir ro/ /dge slong dag khyim gang dag na pha ma gnyis la legs par ri mo byed pa dang legs par mchod pa byed pa snodang legs par g.yog byed7pa'i khyim de dag ni lha dang ldan pa yin rnam/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ dge slong dag rigs kyi bu'i pha ma gnyis ni7rigs pa'i sgo nas lha dang 'dra ba'i phyir ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal te/ bde bar gshegs pas de skadasnyigasungs nas gzhan yang ston pas 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /pha ma gnyis ni tshangs pa ste/ /de bzhin dang po'i slob dpon yin/ /bu yi kun sbyin 'os gyur pa/ /mi yang yin la lha yang yin/ /de phyir de gnyis phyag gi gnas/ /dril ba dang ni khrus rnams dang ske/ /rkang pa dag kyang bkru ba dang / /yang na zas dang skom rnams dang / /gos dang mal cha stan rnams kyis/ /mkhas pa dag gis bkur ste bya/ /pha ma dag la bkur byas pa/ /des na mkhas pa de dag ni/ /'dir yang smad par mi 'gyurakhel/ /shi na'ang mtho ris dga' bar 'gyur/ /gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis mdo 'di bka' stsal pa de'i tshe/ dge slong dag the tsom skyes te the tsom thams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das pha ma la sri ⑧zhu che ba'i bsngags pa gsungs pa ①ni ngo mtshar lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag da ltar de bzhin gshegs pa 'dod chags dang bral ba/ zhe sdang dang bral ba/ gti mug dang bral ba/ skye ba dang / rga ba dang / na ba dang / 'chi ba dang / mya ngan dang / smre sngags 'don pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / yid mi bde ba 75—232

dang / 'khrug pa rnams las yongs su grol ba thams cad mkhyen pa/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa/ ye shes dang shes bya thams cad la mnga' brnyes zin pa na / pha ma la sri zhu che ba'i bsngags pa brjod pa 'di lta la ngo mtshar che ba ci yod/'das pa'i dus na nga 'dod chags dang bcas pa/ zhe sdang dang bcas pa/gti mug dang bcas pa/ skye ba dang / rga ba dang / na ba dang / 'chi ba dang ske/ mya ngan dang / smre sngags 'don pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / yid mi bde ba dang / 'khrug pa rnams las yongs su ma grol ba'i tshe ma la gnod pa chung ngu byas pas kyang sdug bsngal chen po myong bar gyur la/ bkur sti chung ngu byas pas kyang bde ba chen po myong bar gyur pa de legs par rab tu nyon la yid la zung7shig dang / ngas bshad do/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na grong khyer bā rā ṇa sī ②na ded dpon mdza' bo zhes bya ba phyug cing nor mang la longs spyod che ba g.yongs su 'dzin pa yangs shing rgya che ba rnam thos kyi bu'i nor dang ldan pa rnam thos kyi bu'i nor dang 'gran pa zhig gnas pa des rigs mnyam pa las chung ma blangs nas/ de de ④dang lhan cig tu rtse zhing dga' la dga' mgur spyod do/ /de rtse zhing dga' la7dga' mgurashespyod pa las bu dag byung yang shi bar gyur te/ de lag pa la skomasatshugs bcas nas bdag gi khyim nor du ma dang ldan du zin kyang bdag la bu yang med bu mo yang med pas bdag shi ba'i la'og tu ni bu med pa'i phyir ci bdog pa thams cad rgyal po dbang bar 'gyur ro snyam ste7sems khong durwatechud cing 'dug go/ /de nas de la kha cig gis gdams ngag bstan pa/ gal te khyod kyi bu byung bar gyur na de la bu mo'i ming thogs shig dang de ltar byas na de yun ring du 'tsho bar 'gyur ro 75—233

zhes byas so/ /de bu7med de bu 'dod pa'i phyir gu lang dang / chu lha dang /ku be ra dang / brgya byin dang / tshangs pa la sogs pa dang lha'i khyad par gzhan dag la yang gsol ba 'debs te 'di lta ste/ kun dga' ra ba'i lha dang /nags tshal gyi lha dang / lam gyi bzhi mdo'i lha dang / sum mdo'i lha dang /gtor ma len pa'i lha dang / lhan cig skyes pa'i lha〈dang / chos 'thun pa pa dang ske/ rtag tu phyi bzhin 'brang ba'i lha rnams la yang gsol ba 'debs la/'jig rten na yang gsol ba btab pa'i rgyus bu dang bu mo skye bar 'gyur ro zhes bya ba'i gtam de yod mod kyi de yang de lta ni ma yin te/ gal te gsol ba btab pa'i rgyus bu dang bu mo skye bar 'gyur du zin na/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po bzhin du re re la yang bu stong stong yod par 'gyur ba'i rigs so/ /ye ni gnas gsum tshogs pa las bu dang bu mo skye bar 'gyur te gsum gang zhe na pha ma gnyis 'dod chags langs te phrad pa dang ma dus la bab cing zla mtshan dang ldan pa dang dri za 'ongs pa ste gnas 'di gsum tshogs pa las bu dang bu mo skye bar 'gyur ro//de nas de yang gsol ba 'debs pa lhur byed cing 'dug la/ sems can zhig kyang sems can gyi ris shig nas shi 'phos nas de'i chung ma'i stor zhugs so/ /bud medasamakhas pa'i rang bzhin can kha cig la ni thun mong ma yin pa'i chos lnga yod de/ lnga gang zhe na/ skyes pa chags pa yang shes la/ ma chags pa yang shes pa dang / dus kyang shes la zla mtshan yang shes pa dang / bu chags pa yang shes pa dang / gang las bu chags pa shes pa dang / khye'u yang shes la bu mo yang shes pa ste/ gal te khye'u yin na ni lto g.yas logs su rten cing gnas so/ /gal te bu mo yin na ni lto g.yon logs su rten cing gnas so/ /de dga' ches 75—234

nas khyim thab la sbran7pa jo bo bdag la sras chags te/ bdag gi rum g.yas logs na rten cing gnas pa las na khye'ur 'gyur bar nges kyisashedagyes pa bskyed du gsol zhes byas so/ /de yang dga' ches te ro stod ni bteg lag pa g.yas pa ni brkyang phyinas bdag gis yun ring po nas smon smon pa'i bu'i ngo mthong bar 'ong ngo / /bdag gi bu rung bar gyur cig /mi rung bar ma gyur cig /gsosalgen bdag gi bya ba dag byed par shog shig /gsos pa'i lan phyir gso bar shog shig /nor skal la spyod par shog shig /bdag gi rigs rgyud ring du gnas par shog shig /bdag cag 'das te shi ba'i 'og tu yang bdag0cag gi phyir mang yang rung nyung yang rung ste sbyin pa dag byin la/ bsod nams dag byas nas / de gnyis gang dang gang du skyes shing 'gro ba der 'di song shig0ces yon bsngoshebar shog ciganyeces dga' ba'i tshig brjod dokhye/ /de nas des bu chags par rig7nas bu'i rim gro bya ba'i phyir/ khang bzangs kyi57steng du nyam rangs su bzhag ste grang ba'i tshe grang ba'i yo byad rnams dang / tsha ba'i tshe tsha ba'i yo byad rnams dang / sman pas bstan pa'i zas rnams dang / ha cang kha ba ma yin pa rnams dang / ha cang skyur ba ma yin pa rnams dang / ha cang lan tshwa〈nyeche ba ma yin pa rnams dang / ha cang mngar ba ma yin pa rnams dang / ha cang ro tsha ba ma yin pa rnams dang / ha cang bska ba ma yin pa rnams te kha ba dang /skyur〈nyeb dang / lan tshwa dang / mngarasnyib dang / tsha ba dang / bska ba med pa'i zas rnams kyis brten 8cing / do shal dang se tsomo dos lus rnam par bklubs 7te/ lha'i bu mo dga' ba'i tshal na rnam par rgyu ba bzhin du khri'i steng nas〈nyekhri'i steng dang khri'u'i〈nyesteng nas khri'u'i bye steng du rgyu zhing 'og gi5nyes gzhi la 75—235

mi 'bab pa dang / des yid du mi 'ong ba'i sgra skad ci yang mi thos par byas so//de nas de zla ba brgyad dam dgu lon pa dang bu byung ste/ khye'u gzugs bzang zhing blta ①na sdug la mdzes pa mdog bzang ba gser gyi kha dog can mgo bo gdugs ltar 'dug pa/ lag pa ring ba/ dpral ba'i dbyes che ba/ sna mtho ba / sna legs pa/ smin ma stug⑧pa/ yan lag dang nyingasalag thams cadakyidang ldan pa zhig btsas nas⑤/ de btsas pa'i btsas ston byas nas khye'u'i ming ji skad gdags zhes ming 'dogs par byed de/ nye du rnams na re khye'u 'di mdza' bo'i bu yin la bu mo'ang7yin pas na/ de'i phyir khye'u 'di'i ming nishemadza' bo'i bu mo zhes bya'o zhes zer ro/ /de nas khye'u mdza' bo'i bu mo pang na 'tsho ba'i ma ma gnyis dang / nu ma snun pa'i ma ma gnyis dang / dri ma 'khru ba'i ma ma gnyis dang / rtse ba'i ma ma gnyis te ma ma brgyad la gtad nas/ ma ma brgyad kyis 'o ma dang / zho dang / mar dang / zhun mar dang / mar gyi nying5nyekhu dang gzhan yang yo byad kyi khyad par bzang ngo cog gis bskyed bsrings te / mtsho'i nang gi pad ma bzhin du skye drag par gyur to/ /de'i pha ni rgya mtsho chen por song nas de nyid du shi'o/ /de nas gang gi tshe mdza' bo'i bu mo cher skyes pa de'i tshe ma la smras pa/ yum bdag gi pha sngon las ji lta bu zhig gis 'tsho bar gyur/ bdag gis kyang de'i rjes su de dang 'dra bar bgyi 'tshal lo/ /de nas mas bsams pa/ gal te bdag gis 'di la rgya mtsho chen po'i tshong pa byed byed do zhes byas na ni/ 'di yang brgya la rgya mtsho chen por song nas7de nyid du 'chi bar 'ong ngo snyam nas smras pa/ bu khyod kyi pha ni sngon yul tshong pa byed byed kyis khyod kyang 'dod na yul tshong pa7)gyis shig ces byas so/ /de nas des 75—236

yul tshong pa'i las byas na dang po'i nyin par kār ṣā pa khotubazhi rnyed de/ de ma la byin nas yum ②'dis dge sbyong dang bram ze dang sdug cing phongs pa dang bkren ①pa rnams la sbyin pa mdzod cig 0ces byas so/ /de nas re zhig na gzhan zhig na re khyod kyi pha spos kyi tshong pa ⑤byed byed do zhes byas pa dang /des yul tshong pa'i las btang stekyispos kyi tshong byas so/ /de nas kār ṣā pa ṇashe brgyad rnyed de/ de dag kyang des ma la byin no/ /de nas re zhig na gzhan zhig na re khyod kyi pha gser dngul gyi tshong pa byed byed do zhes byas pa dang / des sposashe'atshong ba btang ste/ gser dngashedangul gyi tshong byas so/ /de nas dang po'i nyin par kār ṣā pa ṇa bcu drug rnyed detunye/ de dag kyang des ma la byin no / /de nas byi7de nyin par kār ṣā pa ṇa hunyesum cu rtsa gnyis rnyed de de dag kyangasnyides ma la byin no/ /de nas re zhig na gser dngul gyi tshong pa phraganyedog gi rang bzhin can dag gis khye'u de gnas thams cad kyi nyo tshong gi rgyus shes par rig nas smras pa/ mdza' bo'i bu mo khyod kyi pha ni rgya mtsho chen po'i tshong pa byed byed na/ ci khyod la chos ma yin pa'i 'tsho ba 'di ci dgos khyod sus sems can ngan pa'i nyo tshong gi las byed du bcug ces byas so/ /de nas de gser dngul gyi tshong pa'i tshig gis bskul nas ma'i thad du song ste smras pa/ yum bdag gi pha sngon rgya mtsho chen po'i tshong pa byed byed ces de skad grags〈nyepas/ bdag kyang rgya mtsho chen po'i nang du mchi7)'tshal gyis5snyeganang bar mdzod cig /mas smras pa bu gcig de ni bden med kyi/ 'on kyang khyod byis pa yin la bu gcig palakyeyang yin gyisalge nga bor te rgya mtsho chen po'i nang du ma 'gro shig /de nas de mi dge ba'i bshes gnyen phrag dog gi rang bzhin can dag gis brid pas ldog tu ma 75—237

btub nas/ des ma'i tshig ma mnyan te grong khyer bā rā ṇa sīratudril bsgrags nas/ kye bā rā ṇa gli⑧na gnas pa'i tshong pa rnams khyed nyon cig /ded dpon mdza' bo'i bu mo rgya mtsho chen po'i nang du 'gro bar chad kyis7khyed kyi nang nas ded dpon mdza' bo'i bu mo dang lhan cig tu sho gam mi dgos pa dngakyil gcan gyi btsas mi dgos pa dang 0gru btsas 0mi dgos par rgya mtsho chen po'i nang du 'gro 'dod pa de ⑦dag rgya mtsho chen por 'gro ba'i zong sta gon gyis shig ces byas nas dge mtshan dang bkra shis dang bde legs su 'gyur ba rnams byas te / g.yog 'khor tshong pa lnga brgya dang lhan cig chas te/ shing rta dang / khur dang ske/ sgye dang / skon⑧pa dang / rnga mo dang / ba lang dang / bong bu dag gis rgya mtsho chen por 'gro ba'i zong bskyas so/ /de'i ma ni snying byams pas ci bya gtol med nas mchi ma 'dzag cing ngu bzhin phyung ste rkang pa la 'jus nas bu gcig nga bor te rgya mtsho chen po'i nang du ma 'gro shig ces byas so/ /de ltar snying rje rje7skad zer zhing sdug sdug skad zer la gti zhing sprekheba'i skad phyung yang des brtul57te ma'i mgo bo la rdog pas bsnunatshwanyenas 'gronatsopo rnams dang chas so/ /de nas mas smras pa/ bu khyod kyis las 'di'i rnam par smin pa myong bar ma gyur cig ces byas7so/ /de nas re zhig na des grong rdal dang /yul 'khor dang / rgyal po'i pho brang dang / yul po che de7dag mthong nas/rgya mtsho chen po'i 'gram du phyin to/ /de nas des kār ṣā pa ṇa lnga brgyas gru nyos nas zho shas 'tsho ba rnam pa lnga ste gru pa dang / chu 'phyag pa dang / mnyan57pa dang / byi'u zul5)mkhan dang / ru skya 'dzin pa rnams kyang khrid de lan gsum dril bsgrags nas rgya mtsho chen po'i nang du zhugs so/ /de nas re zhig na 75—238

gru de nya'i rigs chu srin ma ka ras7ma rung bar byas te bub par byas so/ /de nas mdza' bo'i bu mos spang leb gcig la〈zin nas skam la phyin to/ /de nas skam la song song nas thag ring po zhig nas grong khyer longs spyodasabyed ces bya ba mthong nas/ de de'i logs su song ba dang re zhig na de'i nang nas lha'i bu mo gzugs bzang zhing blta na sdug la mdzes pa bzhi7zhig byung nas/ de dag na re mdza' bo'i bu mo tshur spyon khyod byon pa legs so/ /'di dag ni bdag cag gi zas gzhag pa'i khang pa dang / skom gzhag pa'i khang pa dang / gos gzhagashepa'i khang pa dang / gzims khang lags te/ nor bucadang / mu tig dang /bai drur+ya7dang / dung dang / man shel dang / byirwanyerucadang / gser dngul rnam pa sna tshogs kyis gang ba lags kyis5stetshur spyon dang longs spyad par bgyi'o zhes zer nas/ de de (nyedag dang lhan cig tu lo du mar dga' ba myong ste/'di ltar de ni bsod nams byed byed pa dang dge ba byed byed pa dang / rdzu 'phrul che ba dang mthu che ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas de'i lho phyogs kyi lam du song ba las 'gror mi ster nas/ de lho phyogs kyi lam der 'gror mi ster ba dang lhag par yang der 'gro 'dod par gyur nas re zhig na yang lho phyogs su song ba dang grong khyer rtag tu myos zhes bya ba mthong ste de de'i sgor phyin pa dang re zhig na de'i nang nas kyang lha'i bu mo ches gzugs bzang zhing ches blta yin sdug la ches mdzes pa brgyad byung nas de dag na re mdza' bo'i bu mo tshur spyon khyod byon pa legs so/ /'di dag ni bdag cag gi zas gzhag pa'i khang pa dang / skom gzhag pa'i khang pa dang / gos gzhag pa'i khang pa dang gzims khang lags te/nor bu dang / mu tig dang / be+e drur+ya〈nyedang / dung dang / man shel dang /75—239

byi ru dang / gser dngul rnam pa sna tshogs kyis gang ba lags kyisashetshur spyon dang7longs spyadasapar bgyi'o zhes zer nas/ de de0dag dang lhan cig tu lo du mar dga' ba myong ste/ 'di ltar de ni bsod nams byed byed pa dang dge ba byed byed pa dang rdzu 'phrul che ba dang mthu che ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas de'i yangasalho phyogs kyi lam du song ba las 'gror mi ster nas/ de lho phyogs kyi lam der 'gror mi ster ba dang lhag par yang der 'gro 'dod par gyur nas re zhig na yang lho phyogs su song ba dang grong khyer dga' byed ces bya ba mthong ste/ de de'i sgor phyin pa dang re zhig na de'i nang nas kyang lha'i bu mo ches gzugs bzang zhing7blta7na sdug la ches mdzes pa bcu drug byung nas de dag na re mdza' bo'i bu mo tshur spyon khyod byon pa legs so/ /'di dag⑧ni bdag cag gi zas gzhag pa'i khang pa dang / skom gzhag7pa'i khang pa dang / gos gzhag pa'i khang pa dang /gzims khang lags te/ nor bu dang / mu tig dang / be+e dūr+ya〈nyedang /dung dang / man shel dang / byi7ru dang / gser dngul rnam pa sna tshogs kyis gang ba lags kyis7)tshur spyon dang longs spyad7par bgyi'o/ /zhes zer nas / de de dag dang lhan cig tu lo du mar dga' ba myong ste/ 'di ltar de ni bsod nams byed byed pa dang dge ba byed byed pa dang rdzu 'phrul che ba dang mthu che ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas de'i yang8lho phyogs kyi lam du song ba las 'gror mi ster nas de lho phyogs kyi lam der 'gror mi ster ba dang lhag par yang de 'gro7'dod par gyur nas/ re zhig na yang lho phyogs su song ba dang khang bzangs〈nyetshangs pa'i bla ma zhes bya ba mthong ste/ de de'i sgor phyin pa dang re zhig na de'i nang nas kyang lha'i bu mo ches gzugs bzang zhing ches blta5nyen sdug 75—240
