slong de la smras pa/ dge slong bdag gi0)bum pa 'gribs su 'ong gis/ gal te khyod shi na yang chu mi sbyin no zhes byas so/ /de nas dge slong de skom gyis gdungs bzhin du re thag chad nas song ngo / /de nas bu mo de ser sna kun tu bsten57cing bsgoms te/ mang du byas pa de lta bus shi nas yi dgas su skyes te/de lta bu'i sdug bsngal drag pa dang mi bzad pa dang tsha ①ba dang yid du mi 'ong ba'i tshor ba myong zhing 'dug go/ /mod gal gyi bu de bas na 'di ltar bslab par bya ste/ ser sna spang bar bya ba'i phyir brtson par bya'o zhes mod gal gyi bu khyod kyis de ltar bslab par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas / tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po dang lha dang lha ma yin dang nam mkha' lding dang mi 'am ci dang lto 'phye chen po gzhan dag kyang yi ④rangs te/bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungasalgepa la mngon par bstod do// // gang po la sogs pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa brgya pa/ bam po bcu gcig pas phyi sa'i snod7ces bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po rnams dang / blon po chen po rnams dang / phyug po rnams dang / pho brang 'khor gyi mi rnams dang / tshong dpon rnams dang / ded dpon rnams dang /lha rnams dang / klu rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams dang / lha ma yin rnams dang ske/ nam mkha' lding rnams dang / mi 'am ci rnams dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis bkur sti byas/ bla mar byas/ ri mor byas/ mchod pasabyas te / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis mchod cing shes pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bsod nams chen po dang ldan pa/ na bza' dang /75—290

zhal zas dngashe/ gzims cha dang / gdan dang / snyun gsos dang / sman zong rnams brnyes pa/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa rgyal po'i khab na 'od ma'i tshal bya ka lan da ka gnas pa na rten cing bzhugs so/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po snga dro sham7thabs dang chos gos bgos57nas lhung bzed thogs te rgyal po'i khab tu bsod snyoms la song nas rgyal po'i khab tu bsod snyoms byas te/ zan zos nas zas phyis len pa spangs te lhung bzed dang chos gos bzhag nas/ bya rgod kyi phung po'i ri ga la ba der song ste phyin nas bya rgod kyi phung po'i ri la 'dzegs te/ nyin par gnas pa'i phyir shing zhig stigi drung du rten cing 'dug go/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos yi dgas mo sdong dum me reg (ge'adra la gcer bur 'dug cing rang gi spas yog pa/lto ni ri tsam la kha ni7khab kyi mig tsam ste/ 'bar zhing rab tu 'bar la kun tu rab tu 'bar te me lce gcig tu 'bar nas tshig cing nyam thag pa'i skad 'byin la/ sdug bsngal drag pa dang mi bzad pa dang tsha ba dang yid du mi 'ong ba'i tshor ba myong ba phyi sa bzhin du dri nga zhing mchog tu dri nga ba zas su phyi sasheza la de yang bde blag tu mi rnyed pa zhig mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang tshe dang ldan pa med gal gyi bu chen po mi dga' bar gyur nas yi dgas mo la dris pa/ khyod kyis sngon sdig pa ci zhig byas na des 'di lta bu'i 'bras bu myong zhing 'dug /yi dgas mos smras pa/ btsun pa mod gal gyi bu chen po bdag ni sdig pa byed byed pa yin te / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la don 'di zhus shig dang de khyedamachonyal bdag gi las kyi rnam pa lung ston par 'gyur te/ de thos na sems can gzhan dag kyang sdig pa'i las spong bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi 75—291

bu chen po bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ngo / /de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das nang du yang dag 'jog las bzhengs nas/ 'khor bzhi po rnams la sbrang bu'i sbrang rtsi ma bskol ba dang 'dralaba'i chos ro dang ldan no cog ston te/ 'khor brgya phrag du ma yang dbang po rnams mi g.yo bar bcom ldan 'das las chos ro dang ldan no cog nyan par byed do/ /de nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni gsong por gsung ba snyan par gsung ba tshur shog 'ongs pa legs so zhes gsung ba sngar 'dzum pa yin te/ der bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /mod gal gyi bu tshur shog /khyod 'ongs pa legs so/ /khyod da gzodalo)ga las 'ongs/ mod gal gyi kyibus gsol pa/ btsun pa bdag ni yi dgas kyi nang du rgyu zhing mchimabyamachi ba las der bdag gis yi dgas mo sdong dum me reg 42'dra la/ gcerakhebur mchis shing rang gi spas yog pa/ lto ni ri tsam la kha ni khab kyi mig tsam ste/'bar zhing rab tu 'bar la shin ⑦tu rab tu 'bar te me lce gcig tu 'bar nas tshig cing nyam thag pa'i skad 'byin lonye/ sdug bsngal drag pa dngamatsho'o/mi bzad pa dang tsha ba dang yid du mi 'ong ba'i tshor ba myong ba dang des mthong ba tsam gyis chu klung dang khron pa rnams skam par 'gyur ba dang / gang gi tshe char 'bab pa de'i tshe de'i steng du me stag 'phro ba'i mdag ma'i char 'bab pa dang / phyi sa bzhin dum trīdri nga zhing mchog tu dri nga ba zas su phyi sa nyu1)'tshal la/ de yang bde blag tu mi rnyed pa zhigatshwaremathong lags so/ /yang gsol pa/ nyam thag skad kyang 'byin par byed(nye/ /sdug bsngal tshor ba nyams su myong / /gang na phyi sa'i gnas yod pa / /der ni sdug bzhin rgyug par bgyid/ /phyi sa bza' 'am btung snyam na/ /75—292

de yang bde blag rnyed mi 'gyur/ /de yis mi yi nyu)'jig rten du/ /sdig pa rab 'jigs ci bgyis na/ /des na sdug bsngal mi'adi 'dra ba/ /'jigs su rung ba nyams su myong / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mod gal gyi bu yi dgas mo de ni sdig pa byed byed pa yin no/ /de'i las kyi rnam pa nyan par 'dod dam/ btsun pa mnyan dpar 'tshal lags so/ /mod gal gyi bu 'o na legs par rab tu50nyon la7yid la zung 6shig dang ngas bshad do/ /mod gal gyi bu sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na grong khyer bā rā ṇa sī 3)na rang sangs rgyas sdug cing phongs pa la snying brtse ba bas mtha'i gnas mal gyis 'tsho ba zhig yod la/de yang nad bu can zhig ste bā rā ṇa sīr 2bsod snyoms la song ngo / /re zhig na de la sman pas 'thun pa'i zas bstan nas de tshong dpon zhig rje 'dug pa ga la ba nyi rider song ba dang / tshong 3tshe/dpon des kyang mthong nas dris pa/ 'phags pa khyod ci bzhed/ des smras pa/ 'thun pa'i kha zas 'dod do/ /de nas tshong dpon des 'phags pa la kha zas 'thun pa phul cig ces nyi mna' ma la bsgo'o/ /de nas de'i mna' ma ser sna skyes te/ gal te bdag gis deng 'di la kha zas sbyin〈nyedu zin na sang yang 'ong bar 'gyur ro snyam nas/ phyogs gcig tu song ste lhung bzed phyi sas bkang nas steng 'bras can nya gyis bkab ste rang sangs rgyas de la phul lo/ /nyan thos dang 15rang sangs rgyas rnams ni ma dgongs kyi bar du shes pa'i mthong ba mi 'jug ste des blangs so/ /blangs nas tshor te/ 'di dri nga ba las na 'disatsha phyi sas bkang gor ma chag go 1 snyam mo/ /de nas bdag nyid chen po des de ga zhig tu bor nas song ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mod gal gyi bu de78ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus na tshong 75—293

dpon gyi mna' mar gyur patugang yin pa de ni yi dgas mo 'di yin te/ des sdig pa'i las de lta bu byas nas/ de phyin cadashertag tu sems can dmyal ba dang ske/ dud 'gro dang / yi dgas rnams su skyes te'urtag tu zas su phyi sa7za bar gyur to/ /mod gal gyi bu de bas na ser sna spang ba la brtson par bya ste/ci nas yi dgas mo de'i nyes pa de lta bu dag 'ong bar mi 'gyur ba de ltar mod gal gyi bu khyod kyis bslab par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces5ge bka' stsal nasayi/ tshe dang ldan pa med gal gyi bu dang lha dang lha ma yin dang nam mkha' lding dang mi 'am ci dang lto 'phye gachen po la ⑧sogs pa gzhan dag kyang yi perangs te(2/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// //mod gal gyi bu zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po rnams dang / blon po chen po rnams dang / phyug po rnams dang / pho brang 'khor gyi mi rnams dang / tshong dpon rnams dang / ded dpon rnams dang /lha rnams dang / klu rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams dang / lha ma yin rnams dang ske/ nam mkha' lding rnams dang / mi 'am ci rnams dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis bkur sti byas/ bla mar byas/ ri mor byas/ mchod pa byas te / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis〈nyamachod cing shes pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bsod nams chen po dang tunyeldan pa/ na bza' dang / zhal zas dang / gzims cha dang / gdan dang / snyan gsos dang / sman zong rnams brnyes〈nyepa/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang 75—294

bcas pa rgyal po'i khab na 'od ma'i tshal bya ka lan da ka gnas pa na rten cing bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe0)rgyal po'i khab kyi ni pha rol 'od ma'i tshal gyi〈 tshu rol/de'i bar skabs na yi dgas mo (gesdong dum me reg ge/'dra la gcer bur 'dug cing rang gi skras yog pa/ lto ni ri tsam la kha ni khab kyi mig tsam ste/ 'bar zhing rab tu 'bar la kun tu rab tu 'bar te 5)/ me lce gcig tu 'bar nas tshig cing nyam thag pa'i skad 'byin la/ sdug bsngal drag pa56)dang mi bzad pa dang tsha ba dang yid du mi 'ong ba'i tshor 7)ba nyams su myong ba lnga brgya khu khyus lding ba bzhin du nam mkha' la 'khor te gang du yang 'dug sa mi rnyed do/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu 2)snga dro sham thabs dang chos gos bgos te lhung bzed thogs nas rgyal po'i khab tu bsod snyoms la song ba dang des yi dgas de dag mthong ngo / /yi dgas de dag gis kyang tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po mthong ngo / /de nas de dag gcig tu 'dril nas tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po'i thad du dong ste phyin shesanas/ snying rje rje skad zer zhing sdug sdug skad zer la gti tshizhing smra bar tshig 'thun par smras pa/ btsun pa mod gal gyi bu bdag cag ni rgyal po'i khab tu tshong dpon lnga brgyar gyur te/ bdag cag ser sna can 'jungs pa yo byad rnams la kun tu 'dzin par gyur nas/ bdag cag nyid kyis kyang sbyin pa ma byin 3skyel/ gzhan dag sbyin pa byed pa la yang bgegs byas so/ /sbyin pa'i gnas rnams la yang yi dgas kyi tshig lta bus mang du spyos te khyed7ni yi dgas su skyes pa bzhin du gzhan gyi khyim phyi nyug pa'o 12zhes byas so/ /des na bdag cag shi ba'i 'og tu 'di lta bu'i yi dgas su skyes so/ /btsun pa mod gal gyi bu chen po de bas na bdag cag gi nye du rgyal po'i khab na gnas pa de 75—295

dag la/ bdag cag gi las kyi rnam pa ①shes par mdzod la dad pa dris te/sangs rgyas lamachi)sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun bshos gsol nas/ bdag cag gi slad du yon gyi rabs 'don par gsol cig /'on kyangakhubadag cag yi dgas kyi skye gnas nas thar kyang srid do zhes gsungs shig /de nas tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bus kyang yi dgas rnams la cang mi smra bas khas blangs so/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bus de dag gi⑥nye du rnams kyi khyim khyimasadu dad pa dris nas phyi de nyin sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun bshos la spyan drangs so/ /yi dgas rnams la yang sbran te/ (6)bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun dang bcas pa bshos la spyan drangs kyis57khyed kyang der shogapo)shig ces byas so/ /de dag gi nye du rnams la yang khyed kyang shog 97shig dang /nye du'i mchod ston byed pa der yi dgas de dag mthong bar 'gyur ro zhes byas so / /de nas tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu nyid mchod ston gyi zhal tamu )byed pa la zhugs so/ /de nas nam langs71rinas zhal zas bshams te/ gdugs tshod la bab na yi dgas de dag mi snang ngo / /de nas tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos nyugelha'i mig gis yi dgas de dag bsams na yul ma ga ṅgādza thog thag7sten yang mi snang la/ mthar gyis gling bzhi'i bar du bltas na yang de na yang mi snang ngo / /de nas ji srid du de'i ye shes mthong ba 'jug pa de srid du bltas kyang de na yang mi snang ngo / /de nas tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po mi dga' bar gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gi sbyin bdag de rnams mi gda' lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mod gal gyi bu thong tshal khyod mi dgar skyam byed cig /nyan 75—296

thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sa las 'das pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams tshad med pa dag yod de/ de dag tu las kyi rlung gis 'phangs mod kyi/ 'on kyang mod gal gyi bu deng de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs la ltos shig /thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes gzigs pa mngon par bya'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rnam par 'phrul pa yang bstan gyis gaṇ+ḍi rdungs 17shig /de nas gaṇ+ḍi brdungs〈 pa dang dge slong gi dge 'dun thams cad kyang 'dus/ yi dgas kyi nye du rnams dang yi dgas mthong bar 'dod pa'i sems can gzhan dag kyang ltad mo la lhags gete 'dus so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis ci nas yi dgas rnams kyis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa bshos gsol ba mthong bar 'gyur ba dang / bdag cag gi phyir nye du rnams kyis sangs rgyas la gisasogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun rnams bshos gsol zhing 'khod do snyam du dran pa rnyed par 'gyur ba de lta bu'i rdzu 'phrul bstan to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis gsung yan lag lnga dang ldan pas yon gyi rabs gsungs pa/ sbyin pa 'di yi bsod nams gang / /de ni yi dgas phyi bzhin song 5ge/ /yi dgas 'jig rten rab 'jigs las/ /de dag myur du thar gyur cig /ces gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis gzhi de las brten nas rine de dang 'thun pa'i chos bstan te/ de thos nas srog chags 'bum phrag du mas ser sna'i dri ma spangs te bden pa mthong bar gyur to/ /yi dgas de dag kyang bcom ldan 'das la sems dga' bar gyur te/ shi nas sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha yul bzang por skyes so/ /lha'i bu'am lha'i bu mo skyes nas ring po ma lon pa ni chos nyid kyis sems rnam pa gsum skye bar 'gyur te/ gang nas shi 75—297

'phos / gang du skyes/ las gang gis skyes snyam mo/ /de nas yi dgas las shi 'phos pa dang sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha'i ①yul bzang por skyes pa dang /bcom ldan 'das la sems dga' bar gyur pa〈de dag gis mthong ngo de nas sngon yi dgas su gyur pa'i lha'i bu de dag 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag cag zhag lon te gzod7bcom ldan 'das bltasnyiba'i phyir 'gro ba ni bdag cag gi cha ma yin gyis den/ bdag cag zhag ma lon par bcom ldan 'das la blta ba'i phyir 'dong ngo snyam mo/ /de nas sngon yi dgas su gyur pa'i lha'i bu rna cha gdub kor dag cing 'gul ba ⑧thogs pa/ lus do shal dang se mo dos brgyan pa / nor bu sna tshogs kyis spras pa'i cod pan can lus gur gum dang / ta mnyela'i lo ma dang / spro47ka la lamanyasogs pas byugs pa de rnams kyis/ de nyid kyi mtshan mo lha'i me tog ud pa la dang / pad ma dang / ku mu datshwanyedang /pad ma dkar hunyepo dang / man dā rarwasternams kyis thu ba bkang ste/ 'od ma'i tshal bya ka lan da ka gnas pa kho ra khor yug 'od chen pos snang bar byas nas/bcom ldan 'das la me togs3gegis gtor te/ chos mnyan pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'dasam kyi spyan sngar 'khod do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis sngon yi dgas su gyur pa'i lha'i bu rnams kyi bsam pa dang bag la nyal dang / khams dang rang bzhin thugs su chud nas/ de dang 'thun pa'i chos bstan te/ de thos nas sngon yi dgas su gyur pa'i lha'i hu)bu de dag gis khyad par chen po thob bo/ /de dag tshong pa khe spogs phyin pa bzhin du gyur te(she/ bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas nas de nyid du mi snang bar gyur to/ /der bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po la bka' stsal pa/ mod gal gyi 75—298

bu khyod ①kyis yi dgas mang po dag lha'i nang du bkod nas de dag kyang mdang sumakhunga'i thad du 'ongs te/ de dag la ngas chos bstan nas de dag gis rnyed par bya ba rnyed de mthong bar 'gyur ba rnyed nas dong ba de ni/ /khyod kyis zhal ta byas pa 'bras bu yod par gyur te legs so legs so/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos ③de dag gi nye du rnams la yang shes par byas te/de dag gis thos nas mchog tu ya mtshan du gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das la sems dga' bar gyur nas bkur sti byas so/ /mod gal gyi bu de bas na khyod kyis ci nas yi dgas de dag gi nyes pa de lta bu dag mi 'byung bar bya ba'i phyir ser sna spang dub la brtson par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po dang lha dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang /(nye sto 'phye chen po la7sogs pa gzhan dag kyang yi7rangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// //chu smad ces bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po rnams dang /blon po chen po rnams dang / phyug po rnams dang ga/ pho brang 'khor gyi mi rnams dang / tshong dpon rnams dang / ded dpon rnams dang / lha rnams dang / klu rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams dang / lha ma yin rnams dang /nam mkha' lding rnams dang / mi 'am ci rnams dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis bkur sti byas/ bla mar byas/ ri mor byas/ mchod pa byas te/ lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto7'phye chen po rnams kyis mchod cing shes pa'i 75—299

sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bsod nams chen po dang ldan pa/ na bza' dang /zhal zas dang / gzims cha dang / gdan dang / snyun gsos dang / sman zong rnams brnyes pa/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa rgyal po'i khab na 'od ma'i tshal bya ka lan da ka gnas pa0)na rten cing bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer na tshong dpon phyug cing nor mang la longs spyod che ba yongs su 'dzin pa yangs shing rgya che ba rnamaho thos kyi bu'i nor dang ldan pa/ rnam thos kyi bu'i nor dang 'gran pa zhig gnas pa des rigs mnyam pa las chung ma blangs te / de de dang lhan cig tu rtse zhing dga' kyil dga' mgur ④spyod do/ /de rtse zhing dga' la dga' mgur ci(spyod pa las chung ma la bu chags nas de zla ba brgyad dam dgu lon pa dang bu byung ste/ khye'u zhig btsas nas de btsas pa'i btsas ston byas te/ khye'u 'di'i ming ji skad gdags5nyuzhes ming 'dogs par byed de/ de nye 7du rnams na re khye'u 'di rgyu skar chu smad la btsas pas na de'i phyir ming chu smad ces gdags so zhes zer nas de'i ming chu smad ces btags so//de nas khye'u chu smad bskyed bsrings te 58)cher skyes nas/ de'i pha shi ba dang rang gi khyim gyi bdag por gyur to/ /de nas des tshong 'dus 59)bkram nas nyo 'tshong tsobyed cing nyo 'tshong (1 gis 'tsho bar byed pa las de 32nyin gcig bzhin du bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du song ste/ de /lhabacom ldan 'das mthong ba dang dam pa'i chos thos pas bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la dad par gyur nas de rab tu 'byung ba'i sems skyes te/ des ma la gsol ba btab pa/ yum bdag bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la rab tu 'byung gis /nyeganang bar mdzod cig /de nas de'i mas smras pa/ bu khyod ni bu gcig pa yin gyis78bdag ji srid 'tsho'i bar 75—300

rab tu ma byung7shig /bdag shi ba'i 'og tu ci bya ba byos shig ces zer ro/ /chu smad des kyang ci rnyed7pa de dag thams cad ma la byin te/ yum 'dis dge sbyong dang bram ze dang sdug cing phongs ①pa dang bkren pa rnams la sbyin pa dag gyis shig ces byas so/ /de'i ma de ni brkamar④nichags can 'jungs pa yo byad rnams kun tu 'dzin pa zhig ste kār ṣā pa kho5gede dag sbas nas/ dge slong dang bram ze gang dag zas 'dod de khyim der 'ongs pa de dag la rgyashezhing khyed ni yi dgas su skyes pa bzhin du khyim phyi nyug cing slong ngo zhes zer ro/ /bu de la yang slu bar byed de/ bdag gis nyin gcig bzhin du dge slong 'di snyed 'di snyed ⑤cig la zan byin no ⑨zhes zer ro/ /phyis re zhig na de shi ba dang de yi dgas su skyes nas bu chu smad ma dang bral ba'i mya ngan byed do/ /sbyin pa dag sbyin ⑩zhing bsod nams dag byas nas bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la rab tu byung ngo / /des brtson pa dang bsgrub pa dang 'bad pas phol mig lnga pa'i 'khor ba'i 'khor lo 'di nyid g.yo zhing mi brtan par rig nas/ 'du byed kyi rnam pa thams cad snyilamanyab dang / ltung ba dang / rnam par 'thoratshwa)ba dang / rnam par 'jig〈nyepa'i chos can yin par rtsad chod de8/ nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs nas dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas te/ dgra bcom pa khams gsum pa'i 'dod chags dang bral bar gyur nas gser dang bong bar mnyam pa/nam mkha' dang lag mthil du 'dra ba'i sems dang ldan pa/ tsan dan sbangs pa bzhin du bsil bar gyur pa/ rig pas sgo nga'i sbubs bcom pa rig pa dang mngon par shes pa dang so so yang dag par rig pa thob pa/ srid pa'i rnyed pa dang chags pa dang bkur ste la mi lta ba tsodabang po dang nye dbang dang tsobacas 75—301

pa'i lha rnams kyis 0)mchod cing rjed ②pa dang gus par smra ba'i gnas su gyur nas / des7chu klung gang gā'i 'gram du lo ma'i spyil po byas te bsam gtan byed do/ /de'i ma yi dgas kyi 'jig rten du skyes pa de yang sdong dum me regashe'adra la gcer bur 'dug cing rang gi spas yog pa/ lto ni ri tsam la kha ni khab kyi mig tsam ste/ 'bar zhing rab tu 'bar la kun tu rab tu7'bar te me lce gcig tu 'bar nas/ tshig cing nyam thag pa'i skad 'byin te/ tshe dang ldan pa chu smad kyi thad du song nas re skyozhig na mechu smad kyis yi dgas mo de mthong nas dris pa/ 'di kho na 'dra ba khyod su zhig /yi dgas mos smras pa/ bu gcig gang las btsas pa yi/ /byams pa'i ma ni bdag yin te/ /zas dang skomasadang bral ba yi/ /yi dgas rnams kyi nang du skyes/ /bdag ni shi ba'i dus 'das nas/ /lo grangs nyi shu lnga lon te/ /chu yi bgashekyang ma mthong na/ /kha zas lta zhig ga la mthong / /'bras bur 3 )ldan pa'i shing rnams kyi/ / drung song hunyede dag 'bras med 'gyur/ /gang ba'i mtsho 'gram bdag song yang / /de dag kyang ni skam par 'gyur/ /btsun hu pa'i shing drung bde ba lags/ /khyod kyi snod nang chu yang bsil/ /bkren pa bdag la thugs rje skyed/ /skom gyis gdungs kyisarwa chab stsol cig /de nas chu smad kyis ma la smras pa/ yum khyod mir gyur pa'i tshe bdag gis sbyin pa dag sbyin zhing bsod nams dag byed du ma bcug gam/yi dgas mos smras pa/ bu gcig bdag ni ser snas non pas sbyin pa dag kyang ma byin bsod nams dag kyang ma byas te/ nor rnyed pa de dag thams cad sdig pa'i sems kyis dong du sbas so/ /bu gcig de bas na dad pa dris la bdag gi phyir sangs rgyas la nyu9sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun bshos gsol nas yon gyi 75—302

rabs 'don par gsol cig /'on kyang7bdag yi dgas kyi skye gnas nas thar yangasasrid do/ /chu smad kyis7smras pa/ de ltar bgyi yisashekhyod kyang gral dpon gyi mdun du 'dug shig⑤ /yi dgas mos smras pa/ bu gcig bdag nikyigacer bur 'dug pas ngo tsha ste ngos mi thub bo/ /chu smad kyis smras pa/ yum khyod gang gi tshe sdig pa byed pa de'i tshe ngo mi tsha na da ltar 'bras bu myong ba'i tshe ci'i phyir ngo tsha/ yi dgas mos smras pa/ 'o na de bzhin du 'ong bar bya'o/ /de nas gachu smad kyis nye du rnams kyi khyim khyim du dad pa dris nas phyi de nyin sangs rgyas la ⑧sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun bshos la spyan drangs nas/gdugs tshod la bab pa na sangs rgyas lashesogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun dag kyang 'dus/ yi dgas mo de yang gral dpon gyi mdun du 'dug ste/ srog chags 'bum phrag du ma 'dus7)pa rnams kyis yi dgas mo de mthong ngo de dag gis yi dgas mo de'i lus mi sdug pa mthong nas shin tu skyo ba skyes te(rte/bcom ldan 'das la sems dga' bar gyur to/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa chu smad kyis sangs rgyas la7sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun zhal zas bzang pos tshim par byas nas/ yi dgas mo'i phyir yon gyi rabs gdon par gsol to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das nyid kyis gsung yan lag lnga dang ldan pas sbyin pa'i rabs gsungs pa/ sbyin pa 'di yi bsod nams gang / /de ni yi dgas phyi bzhin song / /yi dgas 'jig rten rab 'jigs las/ /de ni myur du thar gyur cig /ces gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis gzhi de las brten nas yi dgas mo de dang skye bo mang po la de dang 'thun pa'i chos bstan te/srog chags 'bum phrag du mas desathos nas bden pa mthong bar gyur to/ /yi 75—303

dgas mo de yang sems dga' bar gyur7te shi nas yi dgas rdzu 'phrul chen mor skyes so/ /tshe dang ldan pa chu smad kyis kyangasheyi dgas rdzu 'phrul chen mor skyes par shes so/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa chu smad kyis smras pa/ yum dasheni mthu yod kyis7sbyin pa yongs su gtang ba dag gyis7shig /yi dgas rdzu 'phrul chen mos smras pa/ bu gcig bdag ni sbyin pa la dga' ba med de mi nus so/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa chu smad kyis yi dgas rdzu 'phrul chen mo la smras pa/ chags pa'i mun pas mig ni rab bsgribs te/ /khyod kyis yi dgas 'jig rten bsgrubs pa yi/ /khyod kyi rus bu chen po sha med pa/ /rus pa pagasalgepa skyi rnams da dung 'dug /ces byas so/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa chu smad kyis lan mang du spyos nas smras pa dang5me/ de'isnyi'og tu de las ras zung cig thob bo/ /de nas chu smad kyis dge 'dun la phul te⑨/ gang gis dge 'dun las ras zung cig nyos5glepa'i dge slong des gos kyi gdang shel bzhag go/ /de nas yi dgas mo de mtshan mo 'ongs nas brkus〈nyeso/ /de nas dge slong des tshe dang ldan pa chu smad la bsnyad hustenas chu smad song ste yi dgas mo spyos nas phyir bkug ste byin no/ /de bzhin du lan gsum gyi 8bar du dge slong de las brkus77nas/ tshe dang ldan pa chu smad kyis phyir bkug ste 1nyebyin pa dang / dge slong des kyang de gshegs7nyenas/ phyogs bzhi'i dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi phyir stan la glan57to/ /de nas des5) phyin chad ma brkus51so/ /de bas na sems can rnams la de ltar ser snas mtho〈nye'atsham par byed pa mthong nas/ ci nas kyang〈 nyeyi dgas mo de'i nyes pa de lta bu dag 'byung bar mi 'gyur bar bya ba'i phyir ser sna spang ba la brtson par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ dge 75wa 304

slong de dag dang / lha dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po la tu)sogs pa gzhan dag kyang yi (mirangs te/bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// //dmus long zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po rnams dang ske/ blon po chen po rnams dang / phyug po rnams dang / pho brang 'khor gyi mi rnams dang / tshong dpon rnams dang / ded dpon rnams dang / lha rnams dang / klu rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams dang / lha ma yin rnams dang ske/ nam mkha' lding rnams dang / mi 'am ci rnams dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis bkur sti byas/ bla mar byas/ ri mor byas/ mchod pa5nyebyas te/ lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis mchod cing shes pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bsod nams chen po dang ldan pa/ na bza' dang /zhal zas dang / gzims cha dang / gdan dang / snyun gsos dang / sman zong rnams brnyes pa/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa mnyan du yod pa na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba ④na bzhugs so/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa dga' byed snga dro sham thabs dang chos gosasnyibagos te/ lhung bzed thogs nas mnyan du yod par bsod snyoms la song ngo / /mnyan du yod par bsod snyoms byas nas 6)zan zos te zas phyis len pa spangs nas/ lhung bzed dang chos gos bzhag steng7yi dgas kyi yul dusnyirgyu zhing song ba las/ tshe dang ldan pa dga' byed kyis yi dgas mo sdong dum me regashe'adra la dmus long du 'dug pa rang gi〈 )spas yog pa lto ni ri tsam la kha ni 75—305

khab kyi mig tsam ste/ dur khrod bzhin du dri nga ba khwa dang bya rgod dang khyi dang wa rnams kyis bskor nas phyogs kun nas sha bcad cing bcad cing za ba dang /de gnad la bab ste dkos7thag nas nyam thag pa'i skad 'byin te/ sdug bsngal drag pa〈kyedang mi bzad pa dang / tsha ba dang / yid du mi 'ong ba myong zhing 'dug pa zhig mthong ngo / /de nas tshe dang ldan pa dga' byed mi dga' bar gyur nas dris pa/ sring mo khyod kyis sngon sdig pa'i las ci zhig byas na bdes 'di lta bu'i sdug bsngal myong zhing 'dug④ /yi dgas mos smras pa/ nyi ma shar ba na sgron ma mi dgos kyisa')/ bcom ldan 'das la don 'di zhus shig dang de khyodarnyul bdag gi las kyi rnam pa57lung ston par 'gyur te/ de thos na sems can gzhan dgasakyang sdig pa spong bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa dga' byed bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ngo / /de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das nang du yang dag 'jog las bzhengs nas/ 'khor bzhi po rnams la sbrang bu'i sbrang rtsi ma bskol stib dang 'dra ba'i 7chos ro dang ldan no cog ston te hunye'akhor brgya phrag du ma yang dbang po rnams mi g.yo bar bcom ldan 'das las chos ro dang ldan no cog nyan par byed do/ /de nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni gsong por gsung ba snyan par gsung ba tshur shog 'ongs pa legs so zhes gsung brwa sngar 'dzum pa yin te/ der bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa dga'atshwanyebyed la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /dga' byed tshur shog khyod 'ongs pa legs so/ /khyod da gzodachag las 'ongs/ dga' byed kyis gsol pa / btsun pa bdag ni yi dgas rgyu ba'i nang nas mchis te/ der bdag gis yi dgas mo sdong dum me reg mi'adra la dmus long du mchis pa rang gi spas yog 75—306

pa/ lto ni ri tsam la kha ni khab kyi mig tsam ste/ dur khrod bzhin du dri nga ba7)khusnyedang bya rgod dang khyi dang wa rnams kyis bskor nas phyogs kun nas sha bkum zhing bkum zhing 'tshal ba dang / de gnad la bab5kyeste dkos57thag nas nyam thag pa'i skad 'byin te/ sdug bsngal drag pa dang mi bzad pa dang tsha ba dang yid du mi 'ong ba myong zhing mchis pa zhig mthong lags so/ /yang gsol pa/lus chen ri bo mthon po 'dra ba la/ /mchu dang lkog ma skam zhing shin tu sdug /rang gi spas ni gdong yog gcer bar ri'u)mchis/ /mchu sgo phra khab mig 'dra rab tu rid⑥/ /de ltar gcer bu spas yog pa/ /rus pa'i 'khrul〈pe'akhor bsgreng ba bzhin/ /thod pa thogs shing mi bzad la/ /ngu zhing kun tu rgyug5nyepar bgyid/ /bkres pa dang ni skom pa yis/ /dub cing sdug bsngal dag gisatunyen/ /nyam thag skad kyang 'byin par bgyid/ /sdug bsngal tshor ba nyams su myong / /de yis mi yi 'jig rten du/ /rab 'jigs sdig pa ci bgyis na/ /des na sdug bsngal 'di 'dra ba/ /'jigs su rung ba myong bar 'gyurayi/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dga' byed yi dgas mo de ni sdig pa'i las byed byed pa yin no/ /de'i las kyi rnam par smin 31pa nyan par 'dod dam/btsun pa mnyananyepar 'tshal lags so/ /dga' byed 'o na legs par rab tu nyon la yid la zung〈nyeshig dang ngas bshad do/ /dga' byed sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na bskal pa bzang po 'di nyid la skye dgu'i tshe lo nyi khri thub pa na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu gdul bya'i kha lo sgyur ba/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa 75—307

sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'od srunganyezhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung ste/ de grong khyer bā rā ṇa r+sāshen drang srong smra ba ri dgas kyi nags na rten cing bzhugs so / /de nas grong khyer bā rā ṇa sī desnyen tshong dpon gyi bu mo zhig 'dug pa de chos 'dod de/ des chos thos nas 'khor ba la nyes par ltasnyib dang / mya ngan las 'das pa la yon tan du lta bar gyur te/ des pha ma la gsol nas bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la rab tu byung ngo / /de nas de'i phyir nye du rnams kyis dge slong ma'i gtsug lag khang byas nas/ de de na slob pa dang mi slob pa'i dge slong ma dag dang lhan cig tu gnas pa las re zhig na des bag med pa'i dbang gis bslab pa'i gzhi55)la lhod par byas so/ /de nas dge slong ma rnams kyis tshul khrims 'chal pa'i phyir bskrad do/ /de nas des sbyin bdag khyim bdag rnams dad pas nges par 'bul ba'angasregacod du bcug /slob pa dang mi slob pa'i dge slong ma rnams kyi bsngags pa ma yin pa yang brjod/ dge slong tshul khrims dang ldan pa gang yin pa de dag mthong na yang mig btsums te 'dug go/ /dga' byed ji snyam du sems/ tshong dpon gyi bu mo gang yin pa de ni yi dgas mo 'di yin te/ des gtsug lag khang la ser sna byas pa des ni yi dgas su skyes so/ /des nar〈ma bcad pa des ni khwa dang bya rgod dang khyi dang wa rnams kyis bskor to/ /des 3 slob pa dang mi slob pa'i7dge slong ma rnams kyi bsngags pa ma yin pa brjod pas ni de'i lus dri nga bar gyur to/ /dge slong tshul khrims dang ldan pa rnams mthong na mig btsums pas ni dmus long du gyur to / /dga' byed de ltar na las gcig tu nges par gnag pa rnams ni rnam par smin pa yang gcig tu nges par gnag〈nyapar 'gyur ro/ /las gcig tu nges 75—308

par dkar ba rnams ni rnam par smin pa yang gcig tu nges par dkar bar 'gyur ro/ /las 'drenatum rnams ni rnam par smin pa yang 'dren⑧mar 'gyur ro/ /dga' byed de bas na las gcig tu nges par gnag pa rnams dang 'drenashem rnams spangs la/ las gcig tu nges par dkar ba rnamasasre'aba' zhig la gtad par bya ste dga' byed khyod kyis de ltar bslab par bya'o/ /chos kyi rnamapo)grangs 'di bstan pa na srog chags sa yas bden pa mthong bar gyur to/ /der bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag ser sna dang ngag gi nyes par spyod pa'i nyes dmigs de dag dang gzhan dag kyang rtogs nas / ser sna dang ngag gi nyes parashespyod pa spangasnyeba'i phyir brtson par bya ste/dge slong khyedakyikyis de ltar bslab par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ dge slong de dag dang / lha dang / lha ma yin dang /nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po larwa )sogs pa gzhan dag kyang yi hurangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// //tshong dpon zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po rnams dang / blon po chen po 8rnams dang / phyug po rnams dang / pho brang 'khor gyi mi rnams dang / tshong dpon rnams dang / ded dpon rnams dang / lha rnams dang / klu rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams dang / lha ma yin rnams dang ske/ nam mkha' lding rnams dang / mi 'am ci rnams dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis bkur ste byas/ bla mar byas/ ri mor byas/ mchod pa byas te / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang / nam 75—309

mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / sto 'phye chen po rnams kyis mchod cing shes pa'i sangs rgyas hu)bcom ldan 'das bsod nams chen po dang ldan pa na bza' dang / zhal zas dang / gzims cha dang / gdan dang / snyan gsos dang / sman zong rnams brnyes pa/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas gemanyan du yod pa na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gegyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe mnyan du yod pa na/ tshong dpon phyug cing nor mang la longs spyod che ba/ yongs su 'dzin pa yangs0shing rgya che ba / rnam thos kyi bu'i nor dang ldan pa/ rnam thos kyi bu'i nor dang 'gran pa zhig gnas te/ de phyi zhig na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal du song ngo / /de nas des sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sku skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis legs par brgyan pa/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus mdzes par byas pa/'od 'dom gang gis brgyan pa/ nyi ma stong bas lhag pa'i 'od mnga' ba rin po che'i ri bo 'gro ba lta bu kun nas bzang ba mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos (5)phyag 'tshal (7te chos mnyan pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dug nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis de la 'khor ba las skyo bar 'gyur ba'i chos bstan te/ de thos nas 'khor ba la〈nyes par lta ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa la yon tan du lta bar 'gyur bte/ bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la rab tu byung nas kun la grags pa dang bsod nams chen po dang ldan par gyur te/ gos dang zas dang / mal cha dang / stan dang /nad gsos dang / sman zong rnams rnyed par gyur to/ /des yongs su bzung ba'i yotswabyad rnyed do cog gsogashepar byed de/des tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod 75—310

pa rnams la bgo bsha' ①ma byas so/ /de nas ser sna kun tu sten (1cing bsgoms te mang du byas pa des na rang gi yo byad la lhag par zhen bzhin du shi nas rang gi gnas khang du yi dgas su skyes so/ /de nas de'i tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa rnams kyis gaṇ+ḍi mjug0med pa brdungs nas rus bu phyir phyungasango //de nas de'i rus bu la rus bu'i mchod pa byas nas phyir gtsug lag khang 57du ltags so/ /de nas gnas khang gi sgo phye ste/ chos gos dang lhung bzed g.yar snga 'grim 7pa la zhugs pa dang / re zhig na yi dgas rkang lag dang mig mi sdug la lus mchog tu 'jigs pa〈chos gos dang lhung bzed 'dzin cing 'dug pa de mthong ngo / /de ltar mi sdug pa de mthong nas dge slong dag mi dga' bar gyur te / bcom ldan 'das la gsol to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das ༄7kyis rigs kyi bu de la phan gdags pa dang slob ma'i tshogs rnams skyo ba skyed nyu)pa dang ser sna'i rnam par smin pa mi sdug pa yang dag par bstan pa'i phyir dge slong gi tshogs kyis zham ring tsobyas te/ dge slong gi dge 'dun gyis mdun du bdar te gnas der gshegs so/ /de nas des sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sku skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis legs par brgyan pa/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus mdzes par byas pa/ 'od 'dom gang gis brgyan pa/ nyi ma stong bas lhag pa'i 'od mnga' ba/ rin po che'i ri bo 'gro ba lta bu kun nas bzang ba hunyemathong nas/ mthong ma thag tu de bcom ldan 'das la sems dga' ba skyes te mngo tsha nyugebar gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis char sprin gyi 'brug sgra lta bur zab pa dang / rnga sgra lta bu'i gsung gis yi dgas de spyos te bzhin bzangasalge khyod nyid kyis bdag nyid phung ba'i phyir chos gosacadang lhung bzed 'di bsgrubs 75—311

te/ des na7yi dgas su skyes pa yin gyisashed yang nga la sems dga' bar gyis la yo byad 'di la yang sems ma chags par byos dang legs so/ /'di las kyang shi nas sems can dmyal ba rnams su skyes re / de nas yi dgas des chos gos dang lhung bzed dge 'dun la phul nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal7te nyes pa bshagasasheso/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis yi dgas kyi phyir yon gyi rabs gsungs pa/ sbyin pa 'di yirnyubasod nams gang / /de ni yi dgas phyi bzhin song / /yi dgas 'jig rten rab 'jigs las/ /de ni myur du thar ④gyur cig /de nas yi dgas de bcom ldan 'das la sems dga' b.rashegyur te/ shi nas yi dgas rdzu 'phrul chen por skyes so/ /de nas yi dgas rdzu 'phrul chen po rna cha gdub kor7dag cing 'gul ba thogs pa lus do shal dang se mo dos brgyan pa/ nor bu sna tshogs kyis spras pa'i cod pan can7lus gur gum dang ta〈sem la'i lo ma dang spro ka la sogs pas byugs pa des de nyid kyi mtshan mo lha'i me tog ud pa la dang / pad ma dang / ku mu da dang /pad ma dkar ④po dang / man dā ra〈nyernams kyis thu ba bkang ste/ 'od ma'i tshal bya ka lan da ka gnas pa kho ra khor yug 'od chen pos snang bar byas nasayi/bcom ldan 'das la me tog gis gtor te rkyu 7chos mnyan pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang de la de dang 'thun pa'i chos bstan te/ de thos nas dga' ba skyes te song ngo / /de'i tshe dge slong srod dang tho rangs mi nyal bar brtson pa lhur byed pa la gnas pa de dag gis/ bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du snang ba chen po byung ba mthong ngo / /de mthong nas the com skyes te sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ bcom ldan 75—312

'das ci lags/ mdang sum mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pa'am lha'i dbang po brgya byin nam/ 'jig rten skyong ba bzhi bcom ldan 'das la blta ba'i slad du mchisatulags sam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag mi mjed kyi bdag po'am lha'i dbang po brgya byin nam 'jig rten skyong ba bzhi nga la blta ba'i phyir 'ongs pa ma yin gyi/ yi dgas de shi nas yi dgas rdzu 'phrul chen por skyes te/ de mdang sum nga'i thad du 'ongs nas ngas de la chos bstan te de dga' ba skyes nas song ngo / /dge slong dag de bas na ci nas tshong dpon las yi dgas su gyur pa de'i nyes pa de lta bu 'byung ༷bar mi 'gyur bar ser sna spang ba la brtson par bya ste dge slong khyed kyis de ltar bslab par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas dge slong de dag dang / lha dang /lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po la mesogs pa gzhan dag kyang yi phyirangs te bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// //bu zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po rnams dang /blon po chen po rnams dang / phyug po rnams dang / pho brang 'khor gyi mi rnams dang ske/ tshong dpon rnams dang / ded dpon rnams dang / lha rnams dang /klu rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams dang / lha ma yin rnams dang / nam mkha' lding rnams dang / mi 'am ci rnams dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyisayi/bkur sti byas/ bla mar byas/ ri mor byas/ mchod pa dzobyas te/ lha dang /klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis mchod cing shes pa'i sangs rgyas 75—313

bcom ldan 'das bsod nams chen po dang ldan pa/ na bza' dang / zhal zas dang / gzims chatudang / gdan dang / snyun gsos dang / sman zong rnams brnyes pa/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa rgyal po'i khab na 'od ma'i tshal bya ka lan da ka gnas pa na rten cing bzhugs so/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa 'dam bu sbyin gyi bu snga dro sham thabs dang chos gos bgosashete/ lhung bzed thogs nas rgyal po'i khab tu bsod snyoms la song ngo / /rgyal po'i khab tu bsod snyoms byas nas zan zos te zas phyis len pa spangs nas chos gos dang lhung bzed ge bzhag ste/ yi5gedags kyi yul du7rgyu zhing song ba dang / des bya rgod kyi phung po'i ri'i nye 'khor56)du yi dgas mo gshin rje'i sring mo 'dra bsnyel/lus khrag gis bsgosam1)pa/ dur khrod na 'dug5) bzhin du keng5)rus kyis bskor ba / nyin mo dang mtshan mo bu lnga lnga btsa' zhing de lta bu'i sdug bsngal myong la/bu la byams pa yod bzhin du de bkres pas nyen nas de dag za zhing 'dug pa zhig mthong ngo / /de nas gnas brtan 'dam bu sbyin gyi bus de la dris pa khyod kyis sngon las ci zhig byas na/ des 'di lta bu'i sdug bsngal myong zhing 'dug /yi dgas mos smras pa/ nyi ma shar ba na sgron ma mi dgos kyisatso/ bcom ldan 'das la don 'di zhus shig dang / de khyedatshwanyel bdag gi las kyi rnam pa lung ston par 'gyur temi/ de thos nas hunyesems can gzhan dag kyang sdig pa'i las spong bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa 'dam bu sbyin gyi bu/ bcom ldan 'das〈nyeg la ba der song ngo / /de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das nang du yang dag 'jog las bzhengs nas/ 'khor bzhi po rnams la sbrang bu'i sbrang7rtsi ma bskol ba dang 'dra ba'i chos ro dang (bye ldan no cog ston te/ 'khor brgya phrag du ma yang 75—314

dbang po rnams mi g.yo bar bcom ldan 'das las chos ro dang ldan no cog nyan par byed do/ /de nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni gsong por gsung ba snyan par gsung ba tshur shog 'ongs pa legs so zhes gsung ba sngar 'dzum pa yin te/ der bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa 'dam bu sbyin gyi bu la bka' stsal pa/ 'dam bu sbyin gyi bu tshur shog khyod 'ongs pa legs so/ /khyod da gzod ①ga las 'ongs/ 'dam bu sbyin gyi bus gsol pa/ btsun ②pa bcom ldan 'das ②bdag ni yi dgas kyi nang du mchi mchi ba las slar mchis te/der bdag gis yi dgas mo gshin rje'i sring mo 'dra badzabal/ lus khrag gis bsgos pa/ dur khrod na gnas pa bzhin du kengasarus kyis bskor ba zhig mthong lags so/ /yang gsol pa/ bdag ni nyin bzhin bu lnga btsa'/ /mtshan yang de bzhin lnga btsa' ste/ /btsas nas de dag zos na yang / /'grangasalgepar mi 'gyur zhes mchi na/ /de yis mi yi5) 'jig rten du/ /rab 'jigs sdig pa ci bgyis na/ /des na5)sdug bsngal 'di 'dra ba/ /'jigs su rung ba myong bar gyur(nye/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'dam bumanyesbyin gyi bu yi dgas mo de ni sdig pa'i las byed byed pa yin no/ /de'i77las kyi rnam pa7nyan par 'dod dam/ btsun pa mnyan par 'tshal lags so/ /'dam bu sbyin gyi bu 'o na legs par rab tu nyon la yid la zung5)shig dang ngas bshad do/ /'dam bu sbyin gyi bu sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na/ grong khyer bā rā ṇa 5nyen tshong dpon phyug cing / nor mang la longs spyod che ba yongs su 'dzin pa yangs shing rgya che ba rnam thos kyi bu'i nor dang ldan pa/ rnam thos kyi bu'i nor dang 'gran pa zhig gnas pa des rigs mnyam pa las chung ma blangs 75—315

nas / de de dang lhan cig tu rtse zhing dga' la dga' mgur7spyod rdo7rtse zhing dga' la dga' mgur (7spyod kyang bu yang med bu mo yang med de de ④lag pa la skom phyetshugs bcas nas bdag gi khyim nor du ma dang ldan du zin kyang bu yang med bu mo yang med pas/ bdag 'das pa'i 'og tu ni bu med pa'i phyir ci bdog pa thams cad rgyal po dbang bar 'gyur ro/ /snyam ste sems khong dukhuchud cing 'dug go/ /de nas budashemed de bu 'dod pa'i phyir gu lang dang /chu lha dang / ku be ra dang / brgya byin dang / tshangs pa lalosogs pa dang lha'i khyad par gzhan dag la yang gsol ba 'debs te/ 'di lta ste kun dga' ra ba'i lha dang nags tshal gyi lha dang lam gyi bzhi mdo'i lha dang / sum mdo'i7lha dang / gtor ma len pa'i lha dang / lhan cig skyes pa dang chos 'thun pa pa dang rtag tu phyi bzhin 'brang ba'i lha rnams la yang gsol ba 'debs la/'jig rten na yang gsol ba btab pa'i rgyus bu dang bu mo skye bar 'gyur ro zhes bya ba'i gtam de yod mod kyi de yang de lta ni ma yin te/ gal te gsol ba btab pa'i rgyus bu dang bu mo skye bar 'gyur du zin na/ 'khor los sgyur 7ba'i rgyal po bzhin du re re la01yang bu stong stong yod par 'gyur ba'i〈nyerigs so/ /ye ni gnas gsum tshogs pa las bu dang bu mo skye bar 'gyur te/ gsum gang zhe na / pha ma gnyis 'dod chags langs te phrad pa dang / ma dus la bab cing zla5nyematshan dang ldan pa dang / dri za 'ongs pa ste/ gnas 'dichagasum tshogs pa las bu dang bu mo skye bar 'gyur tem/ des lha mnyes par byas kyang bu yang ma byung bu mo yang ma byung nas de'i blo 'di lta bu dgam skyes te/ ma la bdag gis chun tu ma zhig blangs na/ brgya la bu yod par 'gyur tunyelta srid dam snyam ste/75—316

des rigs mnyam pa las chunatum blangs te②/ de de dang lhan cig tu rtse zhing dga' la dga' mgurakhuspyod do/ /de rtse zhing dga' la dga' mgurarnyuspyod pa las phyi zhig na bu chags par gyur nas/ de dga' zhing mgu la rab tu dga' nas khyim thab la sbran pa/ jo bo bdag la sras chags te bdag gi rum g.yas logs na rten cing gnas pa las na/ khye'ur 'byungasnyibar nges kyis dgyes pa bskyed du gsol zhes byas so/ /de yang dga' ches te ro stod57ni bteg /lag pa g.yas pa ni brkyang nas/ /bdag gis yun ring po nas smon smon pa'i busango mthong bar 'ong ngo / /bdag gi 0bu rung bar shog cig /mi rung bar ma gyur cig /bdag gi bya ba dag5) byed par shog cig /gsos pa'i lan phyir gso51bar shog cig /nor skal la spyod par shog cig /bdag gi rigs rgyud ring du gnas par shog cig /bdag cag 'das te shi ba'i 'og tu yang bdag cag gi phyir mang yang rung nyung yang rung ste/ sbyin pa dag byin la bsod nams dag byas nas/ de gnyis gang dang gang du skyes shing 'gro ba der 'di song shig ces yon bsngo 8bar shog cig ces dga' ba'i tshig brjod do/ /de nas des bu chags par rig nas bu'i rim gro bya ba'i phyir khang bzangs kyi tunyesteng du nyam rangs su bzhag ste/ grang ba'i tshe grang ba'i yo byad rnams dang / tsha ba'i tshe tsha ba'i yo byad rnams dang / sman pas bstan pa'i zas rnams dang / ha cang kha ba ma yin pa rnams dang / ha cang skyur ba ma yin pa rnams dang / ha cang lan tshwa che7ba ma yin pa rnams dang / ha cang mngar 8ba ma yin pa rnams dang ske/ ha cang ro tsha ba ma yin pa rnams dang / ha cang bska ba ma yin pa rnams dang / kha ba dang / skyur ba dang / lan no7dang / mngaratshwa)ba dang /75—317

tsha ba dang / bska ba med pa'i zas rnams kyis bsten cing / do shal dang se mo dos7lus rnam par bklubs7te/ lha'i bu mo dga' ba'i tshal na rnam par rgyu ba bzhin du/ khri'i steng nas khri'i steng5sedang khri'u'i steng nas7khri'u'i steng du rgyu zhing 'og gi sa gzhi la mi 'bab pa dang / des yid du mi 'ong ba'i sgra skad ci yang mi thos par byas so/ /de nas chung ma snga ma des de bkur zhing gces par byed pa mthong nas phrag dog skyes te bsamasalgepa/ gal te 'di las bu btsas par gyur na ni bdag la gnod pa byed par 'gyur gyisayi/ ci nas de'i thabs shig bya dgos snyam mo/ /'dod pa lasasheyongs su bsten pa la ni sdig pa'i las mi bya ba'i bag ci yang med de/ mi sdug pa'i 'gro ba'i g.yangashesar kha ltasalo)pa des yid rtonasngo )du bcug nas/ gang 'thungs pa tsam gyis nyon mongs ma de'i bu 'phyil hunyebar 'gyur ba de lta bu'i mngal rlug pa'i rtsi byin no/ /de nas chung ma phyi ma des nye du thams cad bsdus nas chung ma snga ma de zhal lcerwanyel bkug ste/ khyod kyis bdag yid rton du bcug nas〈snyemangal rlug pa'i rtsi byin te des bdag gi bu 'phyil 7to zhes byas so/ /de nas chung ma snga ma des nye du rnams kyi nang du mna'algebor te/ gal te bdag gis khyod la mngal rlug pa'i rtsi byin par gyur na bdag yi dgas mor gyur te/ bu byung ngo cog za bar shog cig ces7so/ /'dam bu sbyin gyi bu ji snyam du sems/ tshong dpon gyi chung mar gyur pa gang yin pa de ni yi dgas mo de yin te/ des sngon phrag dog byas pa des na yi dgas mor skyes so/ /des brdzun byas te mna' bor ba'i las kyi rnam par smin pa des nisngo nyin mo dang mtshan 37mo bu lnga lnga btsa' zhing za bar gyur to/ /'dam bu sbyin gyi bu de bas na khyod kyis ngag gi nyes pa spang ba la brtson par bya ste/ ci 75—318

nas yi dgas mo de'i nyes pa de lta bu dag 'byung bar mi 'gyur ba de ltar 'dam bu sbyin gyi bu khyod kyis bslab par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nasal/ tshe dang ldan pa 'dam bu sbyin gyi bu dang / lha dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha'5gelding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phyeshechen po la sogs pa gzhan dag kyang yi rangs te(ge/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// // gang po la sogs pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa brgya pa bam po bcu gnyis paX phyi sa khung zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po rnams dang ske/ blon po chen po rnams dang / phyug po rnams dang / pho brang 'khor gyi mi rnams dang / tshong dpon rnams dang / ded dpon rnams dang / lha rnams dang / klu rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams dang / lha ma yin rnams dang ske/ nam mkha' lding rnams dang / mi 'am ci rnams dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis bkur sti byas/ bla mar byas/ ri mor byas/ mchod pa byas te/lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang ske/ mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis mchod cing shes pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bsod nams chen po dang ldan pa/ na bza' dang /zhal zas dang / gzims cha dang / gdan dang / snyun gsos dang / sman zong rnams brnyes pa/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa yangs pa can na spre'u rdzing gi 'gram gyir+sā)khang pa brtsegs pa'i gnas na rten cing bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe yangs pa can na grong khyer gyi tso'obs zhig gi nang na yi dgas zas su skyugs pa za ba/ bor ba za ba ngar snabs dang gcin gyis 'tsho ba rnag dang khrag 75—319

dang phyi sa za ba mi bzad pa rang bzhin gyis sdug bsngal banyelnga brgya gnas so/ /yang smras pa/ skyugs pa za zhing bor ba za/ /ngar snabasalgegacin gyis 'tsho ba dang ske/ /rnag khrag dang ni phyi sa za/ /mi bzad rang bzhin sdug cing 'dug /yangs pa can de na bram ze zhig kyang 'dug ste/ des rigs mnyam pa las chung ma blangs nas/ de de dang lhan cig tu rtse zhingasnyedaga' la dga' mgur0spyod do / /de rtse zhing dga' la dga' mgurasaspyod pa las chung ma la bu chags nas de'i lus dri nga bar gyur to/ /de nas bram ze des mtshan mkhan rnams bkug ste dris na/ de dag na re 'di ni lto na khye'u 'dug pa de'i mthu yin no zhes zer ro//re zhig na de zla ba brgyad dam dgu lon pa dang bu byung ste khye'u mdog ngan zhing blta 6)na mi sdug la ④byad ngan pa da)lus mi gtsang bas bsgos pa dri nga ba zhig btsas so/ /delo)mchog tu mi sdug mod kyi byams pa'i dbang gis sbrel bas pha ma gnyis kyis gsos so/ /de mi gtsang ba'i gnas rnams 'ba' zhig tu dga' la phyag dar gyi phung po dang phyi sa khung du skra 'bal zhing khar5)mi gtsang ba 'dzud lha nas de'i ming phyi sa khung phyi sa khung〈nyezhes bya bar gyur to/ /re zhig na de phan tshun du 'khyam pa las 'od srung rdzogs byed kyis mthong nas de 'di snyam du sems te/ 'di de lta bu'i gnas rnams su dga' ba las nacha'adi ni gor ma chag 8par grub pa'i skyes bu zhig yin gyis tsobadag gis 'di〈nyerab tu dbyung ngo snyam mo/ /des de rab tu phyung nas gcer bur 'khyam zhing 'dug la5)legs pa byed pa la yang gnas so/ /de nas de 'khyam zhing song ba las yangs pa can gyi 'obs kyi nang5)na yi dgas lnga brgya 'khod pa rnams mthong nas de sngon gyi las kyi nye rnam par smin pa dang 'brel pas grong khyer gyi 'obs de'i nang du song nas de dag 75—320

dang lhan cig 'dus shing phrad de dga' bar gyur nas grogs por gyur to/ /phyis re zhig na khye'u phyi sa khung don zhig la brel te yangs pa can du song ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyang grong khyer gyi 'obs der byon nas/ yi dgas de dag gis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sku skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis legs par brgyan pa/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus mdzes par byas pa/'od 'dom gang gis brgyan pa/ nyi ma stong bas lhag pa'inye'od mnga' ba rin po che'i ri bo 'gro ba lta bu kun nas bzang ba mthong ngo / /mthong ma thag tu bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshalaphunas/ bcom ldan 'das bdag cag phongs lags so/ /⑧bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ khyed cis phongasaX / yi dgas rnams kyis smras pa/ bcom ldan 'das bdag cag ni skom lags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis phyag sor lnga las yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i chu'i rgyun lnga phab ste/ des yi dgas lnga brgya po de dag tshim par mdzad do/ /de nas de dag bcom ldan 'das la sems dga' bar gyur te shi nas sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha yul bzang por skyes so/ /lha'i bu'am lha'i bu mo skyes nas ring po ma lon pa'i ⑤chos nyid kyis sems rnam pa gsum skye bar 'gyurabate / gang nas shi 'phos gang du skyes las gang gis skyes snyam mo/ /de nas yi dgas las shi 'phos pa dang / sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha〈7yul bzang por skyes pa dang bcom ldan 'das la sems dga' bar gyur par de dag gis mthong ngo / /de nas sngon yi dgas su gyur pa'i lha'i bu de dag 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag cag zhag lon te gzod ⑧bcom ldan 'das la blta ba'i phyir 'gro ba ni bdag gi7cha ma yin gyis(nye / bdag cag zhag ma lon par bcom ldan 'das la blta ba'i 75—321

phyir 'dong ngo snyam phro/ /de nas sngon yi dgas su gyur pa'i lha'i bu rna cha gdub korashedag cing 'gul7ba thogs pa/ lus do shal dang se mo dos brgyan pa/nor bu sna tshogs kyis spras pa'i cod pan canakhulus gur gum dang ta ma la'i lo ma dang spro8)ka la sogs pas byugs pa de rnams kyis de nyidakyikyi mtshan mo lha'i me tog ud pa la dang / pad ma dang / ku mu da dang / pad ma dkar po dang /man rā〈perashernams kyis thu ba bkang ste/ khang pa brtsegasalgepa'i gnas thams cad 'od chen pos snang bar byas nas/ bcom ldan 'das la me tog gis gtor te / chos mnyan pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'khod do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis sngon yi dgas su gyur pa'i lha'i bu rnams kyi bsam pa dang bag la nyal dang khams dang rang bzhin thugs sutshwakye chud nas/ 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi rtogs par 'gyur ba de lta bu'i chos bstan te(te/ de thos nas lha'i bu lnga brgyas 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo mthon po nyi shu ye shes rdo rjes bcom nas/ rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu thob stonye/ de dag gis bden pa mthong nas tshong pa khe spogs phyin pa dang zhing pa 'bru rgyal bar gyur (nyepa dang dpa' bo g.yul las rgyal ba dang nad pa nad thams cad las thar ba bzhin du 'byor pa7 stegang gis/ bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du lhags pa'i 'byor pa de nyid kyis/ bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas nas rang gi gnas su dong ngo / /de nas khye'u phyi sa khung grong khyer gyi 'obs su 'ongs pa dang yi dgas de dag02ma mthong ngo / /de nas tshol ba la zhugs te de de dag yongs su tshol bas skyo bar gyur〈nyel de dag ni ma rnyed do/ /de'i skabs su sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis ni mi mkhyen pa'am/ mi gzigs pa'am/ mi rtogs 75—322

pa'am/ thugs su mi chud pa7ci yang med la/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa②/ 'jig rten la phan 'dogs pa la zhugs pa/srung ba gcig pa dang ldan pa gcig tu dpa' ba zla med pasheganyis su mi gsung ba zhi gnas dang lhag mthong la gnas pa/ rig pa gsum snang bar mdzad pa/bslab pa gsum la7legs par bslabs pa/ 'dul ba'i gzhi gsum la mkhas pa/ chu bo bzhi las rgal0)ba/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi'i zhabs kyi mthil shin tu brtan pa/ bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi la yun ring po nas 'dris par byas pa/ mi 'jigs pa bzhis mi 'jigs pa/ khyu mchog gi yang dag pa'i seng ge'i sgra chen po sgrogs pa/ yan lag lnga rnam par spadas pa/ 'gro ba lnga las yang dag par 'das pa/ yan lag drug dang ldan pa/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs pa/ rtag tu gnas par bya ba drug la gnas pa/ byang chub kyi yan lag bdun gyi me tog gis phyug pa/ lam yan lag brgyad pa ston pa/mthar gyis gnas pa'i7snyoms par 'jug pa dgu la mkhas pa/ stobs bcu'i stobs dang ldan pa/ phyogs bcur grags pas kun tu rgyas pa/ brgya phrag bcu pa la dbang byed pa bas7ches khyad par du 'phags pa rnams ni/ chos nyid kyis nyin dus gsum mtshan dus gsum du sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis 'jig rten la gzigs te/ su ni rgyad/ su ni dar/ su ni phongs shing 'dug /su ni nyam nga bar gyuradu/ su ni gnod pa dang ldan/ su ni phongs pa dang nyam nga ba dang gnod pa dang ldan/ su ni ngan song du gzhol/ su ni ngan song du 'bab/ su ni ngan song du bab/ su ni ngas ngan song nasalo1)phyung ste/ mtho ris dang thar pa dang 'bras bu la gzhag par bya/ su ni 'dod pa'i 'dam du7) bying ba las 75—323

lag nas drang bar bya①/ su ni 'phags pa'i nor bdun med pa las 'phags pa'i nor bdun gyi dbang phyug la dbang byed du gzhug par bya/ su ni dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams ma bskyed pa las〈bskyed par bya/ su ni dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams bskyed zin pa las yongs su smin par bya/ su ni yongs su smin zin⑧pa las rnam par grol bar bya snyam du ye shes gzigs pa 'jug go/ /'dir smras pa/rgya mtsho chu srin rnams kyi gnas/ /dus rlabs yol bar 'gyur yang srid/ /gdul bar bya ba'i sras rnams la/ /sangs rgyas dus las yol ba med/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu phyi sa khung la phan gdags pa'i phyir/ snga dro sham thabs dang chos gos gsol te lhung bzed bsnams nas dge slong gi tshogs kyis zham ring byas te/ dge slong gi dge 'dun gyisalgemadun du bdar nas yangs pa can du bsod snyoms la gshegs pa dang / re zhig na mthar gyis bsod snyoms bskor te/ srang du gshegs na phyi sa khung yang phan tshun 'khor 'khor ⑤te bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'greng ngo / /de nas des sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sku skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis legs par brgyan pa/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus mdzes par byas pa/ 'od 'dom gang gis brgyan pa/ nyi ma stong bas lhag pa'i 'od mnga' ba/ rin po che'i ri bo 'gro ba lta bu kun nas bzang ba mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang de'i mod la des bcom ldan 'das la sems dga' bar byas so/ /de dga' ba skyes nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal nyete thal mo sbyar nas gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das gal te sems can bdag cag lta bu yang legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba 'di la rab tu 'byung ba mchis te/ chud par 'gyurashen 75—324

bdaganyekyang rab tu 'byung bar 'tshal lo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa sems can rnams kyi 4gyebasam pa dang bag la nyal bsnyemakhyen pas de shin tu skal ba dang ldan par thugs su chud nas phyag glangasnyipo che'i sna lta bu gser gyi kha dog can brkyang5geste/ 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /dge slong tshur shog tshangs par spyad pa spyod cig /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal pa'i mod la skra dang kha spu ni bregs nas zhag ⑦bdun lon pa tsam du gyur/ spyod lam ni bsnyen par rdzogasapo)nas/ lo brgya lon pa lta bur 'dug par gyur pa⑨/ lag na ni lhung bzed dang chu snod thogs par gyur to/ /'dir smras pa/ de bzhin gshegs pas tshur zhes 0bka' stsal pas/ /de ni mgo bregs lus la snam sbyar gyon/ /sangs rgyas kyi ni dgongs pas gos bgos〈stonas / /mod la dbang po rab tu zhi bar gnas/ /de nas5)bcom ldan 'das kyis de la yid la byed pa'i lung phog ste/ des brtson pa dang bsgrubatshwanyepa dang 'bad pas phol mig lnga pa'i 'khor ba'i 'khor lo 'di nyid g.yo zhing mi brtanasapar rig nas 'du byed kyi rnamadza8pa thams cad snyilasab dang / lhung〈nyeb dang /rnam par 'thor ba dang / rnam par 'jig pa'i chos can yin par rtsad chod detunye/nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs nas dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas te/dgra bcom pa khams gsum pa'i 'dod chags dang bral 17bar gyur nas gser dang bong bar mnyam pa/ nam mkha' dang lag mthil du 'dra ba'i sems dang ldan pa/ tsan dan sbangs pa lta bur bsil bar gyur pa/ rig pas sgo nga'i sbubs bcom pa/ rig pa dang mngon par shes pa dang so so yang dag par rig pa thob pa/ srid pa'i rnyed pa dang chags pa dang bkur sti la rgyab kyis phyogs 75—325

pa / dbang po dang nye dbang dang bcas pa'i lha rnams kyis mchod cing rjed7pa dang gus par smra ba'i gnas su gyur to/ /de dgra bcom pa nyid thob zin na yang ngan pa lasridaga' bar gyur nas/ der bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag 'di lta ste/ nga'i⑧dge slong phyi sa khung 'di ni nga'i nyan thos kyi dge slong ngan ngon la mos pa rnams kyi mchog yin no/ /de nas7dge slong dag /the tsom skyes te/ the tsom thams cad gcod pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa gnas brtan phyi sa khung gis las ci bgyis na des 'di lta bu'i sdug bsngal myong bar gyurakyilags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag phyi sa khung nyid kyis sngon tshe rabs gzhan dag tu tshogs rnyed cing rkyen grub pa dang ldan te/ dba' rgal bzhin du 'byung ⑥la gdon mi za bar 'ong ba'i las de dag byas shing bsags pas na/ phyi sa khung nyid kyis las byas shing bsags pa de dag gzhan su zhig gis nyams su myong bar 'gyur te/ dge slong dag las byas shing bsags patsornams ni phyi rol gyi sa'i khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur/ chu'i khams dang me'i khams dang rlung gi khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur te/ las dge ba dang mi dge ba byas shing bsags ⑧pa rnams ni zin pa'i phung po dang khams dang skye mched rnams 'ba'aphrozhig la smin par 'gyur ro/ /lus can dag gi 7las rnams ni/ /bskal pa brgyar yang chud mi za/ /tshogs shing dus la bab pa na/ /'bras bu nyid du min par 'gyur/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na/ bskal pa bzang po 'di nyid la skye dgu'i tshe lo bzhi khri thub pa na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 75—326

rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/skyes bu gdul7bya'i kha lo sgyur ba/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'khor ba 'jig ces bya ba 'jig rten du byung ste④/de rgyal po'i pho brang mdzes ldan zhes bya ba na rten cing bzhugs so/ /de'i tshemasargyal po'i pho dubrang der khyim bdag cig gis gtsug (5)lag khang zhig brtsigs te/der phyogs dang yul sna tshogs na gnas pa'i dge slong dag 'ong btso)dang 'gro ba dang gnas par sems so/ /gtsug lag khang de na so so'i skye bo'i dge slong zhig gnas te/ de yang gnas la shin tu ser sna ches1)ba zhig ste dge slong gsar du 'ong ba rnams mthong na tshig pa za zhing 'khrug la gnod sems byed de/ zhul zhul por 'dug cing ni'akhrug pa skyed par byed do/ /dge slong〈stegang dag gtsug lag khang de nas gud du 'gro ba de dag mthong na ni/ shas cher dga' zhing mchog tu dga' la skyel57zhing smra bar byed do/ /phyis 3)re zhig natshwanyeg zhig gi boyul nas dge slong dgra bcom pa zhig 'ongs so/ /gtsug lag khang gi bdag po de yang phyir mi 'ong ba yin te/ des spyod lam gyi sgo nas dgra bcom pa yin paraphamashes so/ /de nas dga' ba skyes te phyi de 7nyin dge slong gi dge 'dun dang bcas par cho ga dang ldan pa'i khrus dang bshos la spyan drangs so/ /dge slong gzhi hunyeb de ni de na med pa las re zhig na phyi de 38nyin cho ga dang ldan pa'i khrus kyang phul/ bshos kyang bshams pa las 19dge slong gzhi ba de yang 'ongs te/de yang cho ga dang ldan pa'i khrus sar song nas/ gtsug lag khang gi bdag po khyed5) rings su byung ste/ dge slong gsar du0sto'ongs pa'i byi dor byed cing 'dug pa mthong ngo / /de nas de phrag dog skyes nas/ des snang ba'i sems 75wa 327

kyis ngag gi las rtsub po smras te/ dge slong khyed ni lus mi gtsang bas byugs kyang sla'i ①sbyin bdag 'di lta bu chabasnyen bkur len pa ni de lta ma yin no zhes byas so/ /de nas dgra bcom pa des nyon mongs pashe'adi las ches mi bzad pa'i ④spal ba can du 'gyur phyin mi rung ngo snyam nas cang mi zer dubar dang du blangs so/ /re zhig na tshogs par gyur te drokhul bab pa na dge slong gzhi ba des dgra bcom pa la khyod kyis sdang ba'i sems bskyed do zhes zer ba thos so /thos nas kyang de 'gyod pa skyes so/ /de nas dge slong dgra bcom pa de'i rkang pa la phyag 'tshal te/ 'phags pa bdag gis khyod la tshig rtsub po smras pa de bzod parashegasol lo zhes byas so/ /de nas dgra bcom pa des de'i dad pa bskyed pa'i phyir nam mkha' la 'phags nas cholo)'phrul rnam pa sna tshogs bstan to/ /de nas lhag par yang 'gyod pa skyes te/ de nas de'i mdun du las kyi nyes pa de mthol zhing bshags te shad kyis sbyangs so/ /'on kyang des mthar thug pa'i ye shes bskyed ni ma nus so/ /de nas re zhig na 'chi ba'i〈nyedus la bab pa dang des smon lam btab pa/ bdag gis dgra bcom pa la sdang ba'i sems bskyed pa dang / ngag gi las rtsub po smras pasnyigang yin pa'i〈nyelas de'i rnam par smin pa ni bdag gisasamyong bar ma gyur cig /bdag gis bklagatshwanyepa dang / kha ton byas pa dang sbyin pa dang sbyin pa chen po dag byin pa dang dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur byas pa'i las kyi rnam par smin pa gang yin pa des ni ma 'ongs pa'i dus sunye / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyes par byed par〈nyeshog cig5)ces byas sol/ /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus na dge slong gzhi bar gyur pa gang yin pa de ni phyi sa khung 'di nyid yin te/ des dgra bcom pa la 75—328

ngag gi las rtsub po smras pa'i las kyi rnam par smin pa des na 'khor ba na sdug bsngal mtha' yas pa myong bar gyur te/ las de nyid kyi lhag ma lus pas de ltar srid pa tha ma la bab pa'i tshe yang / 'di ltar dri nga zhing mchog tu dri nga bar gyur la mi gtsang ba dang snyag snyig la dga' bar gyur to/ /des0)kha ton ④byas pa dang ske/ phung po la mkhas pa dang / khams la mkhas pa dang / skye mched la mkhas pa dang / rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba la mkhas pa dang / gnas dang gnas ma yin pa la mkhas par byas pa des ni nga'i bstan pa la rab tu byung nas nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs te dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas so//dge slong dag de lta bas na 'di ltar bslab par bya ste/ ser sna spang ba la brtson khupar bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ phyi sa khung so so'i skye bor gyur pa'i mnyes pa gang yin pa de dag 'byung bar mi 'gyur ba dang / des dgra bcom pa nyid thob pa'i yon tan gyi tshogs 'di lta bur 'gyur ba'i phyir te/ dge slong khyod zho)kyis de ltar bslab par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/dge slong de dag dang lha dang lha ma yin dang nam mkha' lding dang mi 'am ci dang lto 'phye chen po la sogs pa gzhan dag kyang yi 95)rangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do/ /rtogs pa brjod pa brgya pa las sdom gyi tshigs su bcad pa lnga pa rdzogs sa)// //sdom ni/ sbrul nag dang ni zla ba dang / /sā spul dang ni dpal ldan ma/ /gos dang ne tso pho nya dang / /ma he dang ni gso sbyongarwa tshodang / /ngang pa tha mar brjod pa yin/ /sbrul nag po zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la 75—329

rgyal po rnams dang / blon po chen po rnams dang / phyug po rnams dang / pho brang 'khor gyi mi rnams dang /① tshong dpon rnams dang / ded dpon rnams dang ske/ lha rnams dang / klu rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams dang / lha ma yin rnams dang / nam mkha' lding rnams dang / mi 'am ci rnams dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis bkur ste byas/ bla mar byas/ ri mokhubyas/ mchod pa byas te lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis mchod cing shes pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bsod nams chen po dang ldan pa/ na bza' dang / zhal zas dang / gzims cha dang / gdan dang / snyun gsos dang / sman zong rnams ③brnyes pa/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa rgyal po'i khab na 'od ma'i tshal bya7ka lan da ka gnas pa na rten cing bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer na khyim bdag phyug cing nor mang la longs spyod che ba/ yongs su 'dzin pa yangs shing rgya che ba rnam thos kyi bu'i nor dang ldan pa/ rnam thos kyi bu'i nor dang 'gran pa zhig yod de/ de yang ser sna can 'jungs pa/ yo byad rnams kun tu 'dzin pa/ khu la yang gtor ma mi sterasnyib zhig ste/ des dge sbyong dang bram ze dang sdug cing phongasakyipa dang bkren pa dag mthong na sems sdang bar byed do/ /de nas des rang gi skyedakyimos tshal du gsera'agedangul gyi phung po chen po sbas te bzhag nas/ de de la chags te lhag par zhen bzhin du shi'o/ /de shi nas de nyid kyi steng du sbrul gdug pa sbrul nag po chen po mig gdug pa zhig tu skyes so/ /de nas skyed7mos tshal der skye bo'i tshogs gang song ba de dag bltas pa tsam gyis gsod par byed 75—330

do/ /rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer thog thag tu yang che ge mo'i skyed7mos tshal du song ba de dag thams cad brlag par 'gyur ro zhes sgra grag par gyur to/ /skye bo'i tshogs kyis kyang rgyal po gzugs can snying〈po la gsol to/ /de nas rgyal po gzugs can snying po 'di snyam du sems te/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ma gtogs pashede 'dul nus pa gzhan su zhig yod snyam mo/ /de nas rgyal po gzugs can snying po skye bo mang po'i 'khor dang bcas pa/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nasadu/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal7te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug nasargya/ bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyal po gzugs can snying po la chos kyi dugatam gyis yang dag par bstan/ yang dag par 'dzin du bcug /yang dag par gzengs stod⑨/yang dag par dga' bar mdzad do/ /chos kyi gtam rnam grangs du mas yang dag par bstan/ yang dag par 'dzin du bcug /yang dag par gzengs bstod⑩ / yang dag par dga' bar mdzad nas cang mi gsung bar bzhugs so/ /de nas rgyal po gzugs can snying po stan (nyalas langs te/ bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzarngo5nyenas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab 'di na skyedatshwanyemos tshal ga ge mo zhig na sbrul gdug pa/ sbrul nag po chen po 0mig gdug pa zhig mchis te/ skye bo mang po brlag par bgyid lags na/ bcom ldan 'das kyis thugs brtse ba'i slad du de gdul bar gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyal po gzugs can snying po la cang mi gsung bas gnang ngo / /de nas rgyal po gzugs 75—331

can snying po bcom ldan 'das kyis cang mi gsung bas ①gnang bar rig nas/bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal7te stan las langs nas song ngo ske/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de nyid kyi mtshan mo 'das nas snga dro sham thabs dang chos gos gsol te lhung bzed bsnams nas skyed7mos tshalasnyig la ba der gshegs te byon nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'od zer5snyegaser gyi kha dog can nyi ma stong gi 'od pas lhag 46pa dag bkye ste/ de dag gis skyed mos tshal de dag thams cad snang bar byas so/ /bskal pa stong gi bar du yongs su bsgomasalgepa'i byams pa'i 'od zer dag kyang bkye ste/ de dag gis de'i lus la phog ma thag tu rab tu sim par gyur to/ /de nas sbrul gdug pa des phan tshun du bltas te su'i mthus bdag gi ri9)lus sim par gyur zhig gu snyam pa dang / /des sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sku skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis legs par brgyan pa/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus mdzes par byas pa/'od 'dom gang gis brgyan pa/ nyi ma stong bas lhag pa'i 'od mnga' ba/ rin po che'i ri bo 'gro ba lta bu kun nas bzang ba mthong ngo / /mthong ma thag tu des bcom ldan 'das la dad pa'i sems skyed hu )de/ dad pa'i sems dang ldan par gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis de dang 'thun pa'i chos bstan te/ bzhin bzangs 11khyod nyid kyis rdzas 'di bsgrubs pa des na khyod sbrul gdug par lhung bar byas so/ /da yang nga la dad pa'i sems skyedatshwanyel gter 'di la yang sems ma chags par byos dang legs so/ /'di nas shi 'phos nas kyang sems can dmyal bar skye sa renyan/ de nas gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis de tshe rabs dran par mdzad pa de'i tshe de rnyijus so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe 75—332

tshigs su bcad de bka' stsal pa/ khyod ni dud 'gror skyes pa la/ /da ni nga yis ci byar med/ /mi khom par ni skyes zin gyis6)/ /don med ngus pas ci la phan / /'dir ni rgyal ba snying rje can/ /nga la dad pa'i sems skyedakhul/ /dud 'gro'i skye gnas spangs na legs/ /'on kyang ri mtho ris 'gro bar 'gyur/ /de nas re zhig na bcom ldan 'das kyis sbrul de lhung bzed kyi nang du bcug ste/'od ma'i tshal du bsnams so/ /de'i skabs su rgyal po dang yul ma ga ṅgā'i7skye bo'i tshogs kyis sbrul gdug pa de bcom ldan 'das kyis ji ltar btul ba thos so//de nas sbrul gdug pa des phyirang gi lus la smad khyede kha 'tshos nas bcom ldan 'das la sems dga' bar gyur te shi nas/ sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha yul bzang por skyes so/ /lha'i bu'am lha'i busamo skyes nas ring po ma lon pa ni chos nyid kyis sems rnam pa gsum skye bar 'gyur te/ gang nas shi 'phos gang du skyes las gang gis skyes snyam mo/ /de nas sbrul gdug pa las shi 'phos pa dngashesum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha yul bzang por skyes pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la sems dga' bar gyur par5) des mthong ngo / /de nas sngon sbrul gdug par gyur pa'i lha'i bu de tunye'adi snyam du sems te/ bdag zhag lon nas gzod kṛ gyebacom ldan 'das blta ba'i phyir 'gro ba ni bdag gi cha ma yin gyis(nye/ bdag zhag ma lon7par bcom ldan 'das la blta ba'i phyir 'gro'o snyam mo/ /de nas sngon tu)sbrul gdug par gyur pa'i lha'i bu rna cha gdub kor dag cing 'gul ba (nyathogs pa/ lus do shal dang sem tshomo dos brgyan pa/ nor bu sna tshogs kyis spras pa'i cod pan can/ /lus gur gum dang ta ma la'i lo ma dang smṛ 17)la sogs pas byugs pa des de nyid kyi mtshan mo lha'i me tog ud pa la dang / pad ma 75—333

dang ske/ ku mu da dang / pad ma dkar po dang / man 'onyer rnams kyis thu ba bkang ste/ 'od ma'i tshal bya ka lan da ka gnas pa thams cad 'od chen pos snang bar byas nas/ bcom ldan 'das la me tog gis gtor te chos mnyan pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis sngon sbrul gdug par gyur pa'i lha'i bu'i bsam pa dang / bag la nyal〈pedang /khams dang / rang bzhin thugs su chud nas 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi rtogs par 'gyur ba de lta bu'i chos bstan te/ de thos nas sngon sbrul gdug par gyur pa'i lha'i bus7'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo mthon po nyi shu ye shes rdo rjes bcom nas rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu thob ste/ des bden pa mthong nas dga' ba'i tshig tu brjod pa/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag gi khrag dang mchi ma'i rgya mtsho bskams ri47pa dang / rus pa'i la5gebasgral ba dang / ngan song gi sgo rnams bcad pa dang / mtho ris dang thar pa'i sgo rnams phye ba dang /bdag lha dang mi rnams kyi nang du bzhag pa 'di lta bu ni bdag la phas kyang ma bgyis / mas kyang ma bgyis/ rgyal pos kyang ma bgyis/ lha rnams kyis kyang ma bgyis/ nang mi 56)dang gnyen gyi (1)tshogs kyis kyang ma bgyis/ sngon gyi mtshun rnams kyis kyang ma bgyis/ dge sbyong gedang bram ze rnams kyis kyang ma bgyis lags so/ /yang smras pa/ nyes pa mang por ldan pa'i ngan song lam/ /shin tu mi bzad khyod kyi mthu yis bcad/ /bsod spunams rab77ldan mtho ris 'grol nyab phye/ /mya ngan 32'das pa'i lam yang bdag gis thob/ /bdag gis de ring nyes pa spangs pa'i mig /shin tu rnam dag khyod las brten nas thob/ /bdag ni sdug bsngal rgya mtsho pha rol rgalahunye/ /'phags pa dgyesalgepa'i zhi ba'i go 'phang 75—334

thob/ /mi mchog dbang po mi dang lhas mchod pa/ /skye dang rga dang 'chi7ba'i nad spangs pa/ /srid pa stong du mthong bar dka' ba yis②/ /thub pa khyedasnyeni deng mthong 'bras bu yod/ /de nas do shal 'chang ba dga'7gyur te/ /btud cing zhabs gnyis la ni phyag 'tshal nas/ /dgra thub la ni bskor ba byas nas kyang / / lha yipo)'jig rten kha bltasapo)lha yul song / /de nas sngon sbrul gdug par gyur pa'i lha'i bu de tshong pa khe spogs phyin pa dang / zhing pa 'bru rgyal bar gyur pa dang dpa' bo g.yul las rgyal ba dang nad pa nad thams cad las thar ba bzhin du 'byor pa gang gis bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du 'ongs pa'i 'byor pa de nyid kyis/ de nyid kyi mtshan mo rgyal po gzugs can snying po'i thad du song nas/ rgyal po'i pho brang thams cad 'od chen pos snang bar byas te/rgyal po bslangashenas 'di skad ces smras so/ /rgyal po chen po longs nyal te ci bya/de nas rgyal po sad de/ 'od chen po de dang lha'i bu de mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang dga' zhing mgu ste khyod su zhig ces dris so/ /de na re bdag ni skyedasamos tshal der bcom ldan 'das kyis sbrul gdug pa btul te shi nas sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha yul bzang por skyes pa yin te/ bcom ldan 'das la yang bdag gis bsnyen bkur byas nas bden pa mthong bar gyur to/ /dpo)bdag gis khyod la bstan gyis khyod song la skyed tu )mos tshal de'i phyogs ga ge mo zhig nas gter chen po phyung la bdag gi phyir/ bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa bshos gsol te yon gyi rabs kyang gdon par gsol cig /de nas rgyal po gzugs can snying pos lha'i bu la cang misngo1zer bar〈2khas blangs so/ /de nas sngon sbrul gdug par gyur pa'i lha'i bus rgyal posarwanyecang mi zer bas khas 75—335

blangs par rig nas/ de nyid du mi snang bar gyur to/ /de nas rgyal po gzugs can snying pos de nyid kyi mtshan mo yul ma ga ṅgā'i 6)pho brang 'khor gyi mi dang yul mi rnams la bsgo nas skyed ②mos tshal der song ste gter phyung ninas/bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa zla ba gsum gyi bar du bshosalgegasol te/ bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ bcom ldan 'das sngon sbrul gdug par gyur pa'i lha'i bus las gang dag bgyis na/ des sbrul gdug par skyes lags/ las gang dag bgyis na des lha'i nang du skyes nas bden pa mthong bar gyur lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ des shas cher chags pa bskyed de/ dge sbyong dang bram ze dang sdug cing phongs pa dang bkren pa rnams la sdang ba'i sems bskyed pa des ni sbrul gdug par skyes so/ /nga la sems dga' bar byas pa des ni lha'i nang du skyes so/ /yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung 4)gi ring la dge bsnyen du gyur te⑦/ skyabs su song ba dang bslab pa'i gzhi blangs pa des ni bden pa mthong bar gyur to/ /rgyal po chen po de bas na ser sna spang ba'i zhu)phyir brtson par byas te(9)/ ci nas sbrul gdug par gyur pa'i nyes pa de lta bu dag 'byung bar mi 'gyur ba dang / de nyid lha'i bur gyur pa'i yon tan gyi tshogs de dag lta bur 'gyur bar rgyal po chen pocakhyod kyis bslab par bya'o/ /de nas rgyal po gzugs can snying posarwatebacom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod de rjes su yi rangs nyunyenas/ bcom ldan hu 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te stanasalas langs nas song ngo /bcom ldan 'das kyis de7skad ces bka' stsal nas dge slong de dag yi rangs te / bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// //75—336

zla ba zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po rnams dang /blon po chen po rnams dang / phyug po rnams dang / pho brang 'khor gyi mi rnams dang ske/ tshong dpon rnams dang / ded dpon rnams dang / lha rnams dang /klu rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams dang / lha ma yin rnams dang / nam mkha' lding rnams dang / mi 'am ci rnams dang /3) lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis bkur sti byas/ bla mar byas/ ri mo5)byas/ mchod pa 55)byas te/ lha dang ske/ klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang ske/ mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis mchod cing shes pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bsod nams chen po dang ldan pa na bza' dang /zhal zas dang / gzims che)cha dang / gdan gedang / snyun gsos dang /sman zong rnams brnyes pa/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa mnyan du yod pa na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe mnyan du yod pa nams bram ze zhing pa41zhig 'dug pa des rigs mnyam pa las chung ma blangs te/ de de 58)dang lhan cig tu rtse zhing dga' la dga' mgurayo)spyod do/ /de rtse zhing dga' la dga' mgur spyod 3) pa las chung ma la bu chags nas de zla ba brgyad dam dgu lon pa dang bu byung ste khye'u gzugs bzang zhing / blta hunyan sdug la mdzes pa skye bo thams cad kyi mig sim par byed pa zhig btsas so/ /de yang bram ze des dka'02bas rnyedamanyepa yin te/de la bu dang bumanyemo gzhan yang med nas de bskyed bsrings te cher poskyes nas de 'jig rten thams cad sim par byed pa'i phyir bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams kyis khye'u de'i ming zla ba zhes btags so/ /de nas bram ze'i khye'u zla ba grong khyer 75—337

thams cad du brgyud de bskor nas①/ bram ze de yang khye'u de la lhag par byams par gyur te/ 'chag pa dang 'dug pa dang nyal ba dag gi tshe yang rtag tu legs par bsrung ba lhur byed cing 'dug go/ /bram ze de'i khyim yangakhukhyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin dang nye ba zhig na 'dug go/ /de nas bram ze'i khye'ushede khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin dang bsten nas rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal du song ste/ sangs rgyas kyi gsung thos nas/ desasebacom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la dad pa rnyed do/ /de yang tshe thung ste shi nas sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha yul bzang por skyes so/ /lha'i bu'am lha'i bu mo skyes nas ring po ma lon pa ni chos nyid kyis/ sems rnam pa gsum skye bar 'gyur te/ gang nas shi 'phos gang du skyes las gang gis skyes snyam mo/ /de nas mi las shi 'phos pa dang sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha yul bzang por⑩skyes pa dang / bcom ldan 'das lashesems dga' bar gyur pa7des mthong ngo / /de nas sngon bram zer gyur pa'i lha'i bu 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag zhag lon nas gzod bcom ldan 'das blta ba'i phyir 'gro ba ni bdag gi57cha ma yin gyis(nye/ bdag zhag ma lon par bcom ldan 'das la blta ba'i phyir 'gro'o snyam mo/ /de nas sngon bram zer gyur pa'i lha'i bu rna cha gdub kor〈nyedag cing 'gul bakhethogs pa lus do shal dang se mo dos brgyan pa/ nor bu sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa'i cod pan can lus gur gum dang ta ma la'i lo ma dang spro tsoka la sogs pas byugs pa des de nyid kyi mtshan mo lha'i me tog ud pal dang / pad ma dang / ku mu da dang / pad ma dkar7po dang / man drarwanyer rnams kyis thu banyebakang ste/ rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal thams cad 'od chen pos snang bar byas nas bcom ldan 'das la me tog 75—338
