gis gtor te①/ chos mnyan pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dug go//de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis sngon bram zer gyur pa'i lha'i bu'i bsam pa dang bag la nyal dang khams dang rang bzhin thugs su chud nas/ 'phags pa'i bden bsnyebazhi rtogs par 'gyur ba de lta bu'i chos stonas te/ de thos nas sngon bram zer gyur pa'i lha'i bus 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo mthon po nyi shu ye shes rdo rjes bcom nas rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu thob ste/ des bden pa mthong nas dga' ba'i tshig lan gsum du ④brjod de/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag gi khrag dang mchi ma'i rgya mtsho bskams pa dang / rus pa'i lasabasgral ba dang / ngan song gi sgo rnams bcad pa dang / mtho ris dang thar pa'i sgo rnams phye ba dang bdag lha dang mi rnams kyi nang du bzhag pa 'di lta bu ni bdag la phas kyang ma bgyis/ mas kyang ma bgyis/ rgyal pos kyang ma bgyis/lha rnams kyis kyang ma bgyis/ nang mi dang gnyen 3)gyi tshogs kyis kyang ma bgyis/sngon gyi mtshun rnams kyis kyang ma bgyis/ dge sbyong dang bram ze rnams kyis kyang ma bgyis lags7so/ /yang smras pa/ nyes pa mang por ldan pa'i ngan song lam/ /shin tu mi bzad khyod kyi5snyemathu yis bcad/ /bsod nams rabatso)ldan mtho ris 'gro ba rtsedzo / /mya ngan 'das pa'i lam yang bdag gis thob/ /bdag gis de ring nyes pa spangs pa'i mig /shin tu rnam dag khyod las brtenas37nas thob/ /bdag ni sdug bsngal rgya mtsho'isahu pha rol rgal/nye/ /'phags pa dgyes pa'i zhi ba'i go 'phang thob/ /mitswamachog78dbang po lha dang mis mchod pa/ /skye dang rga dang 'chi ba'i nad spangs pa/ /srid pa stong du mthong bar dka' ba a8//thub pa khyod ni deng mthong 'bras bu yod/ /de nas do shal 'phyang ba dga' gyur5nye75—339

tel/ /btud cing zhabs gnyis la ni phyag 'tshalanyenas/ /dgra thub la ni bskor ba byas nas kyang / /lha yi 'jig rten kha ltas lha yul songashe/ /de nas sngon bram zer gyur pa'i lha'i bu de tshong pa khe spogs phyin pa dang zhing pa 'bru rgyal bar gyur pa dang dpa' bo g.yul las rgyal ba dang nad pa nad thams cad las thar ba bzhin du 'byor pa gang gis bcom ldan 'das kyilathad du 'ongs pa'i 'byor pa de nyid kyis rang gi gnas su song ngo / /dge slong dag ni srod dang tho ras7mi nyal bar brtson pa lhur byed pa la gnas te/ de dag gis bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du snang ba chen po byung ba ⑤mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang the tshom 6)skyes te the tshom thams cad gcod pashesangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ mdang sum mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pa'am/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin nam/ 'jig rten skyong ba bzhi bcom ldan 'das la blta ba'i slad du mchis lags sam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag mi mjed nikyi bdag po tshangs pa'am/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin namakhya/'jig rten skyong ba bzhi nga la blta ba'i phyir 'ongs pa ma yin gyi/ bram ze'i bu7gcig pa de tshe thung ste shi nas/ de nga la51sems dga' bar gyur te/ sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha yul bzang por skyes nas/ de mdang 3 sum nga'i thad du 'ongs te / ngas de la chos bstan nas bden pa mthong bar gyur te rang gi gnas su song ngo / /de'i skabs su bram ze des bu gcig pa sdug cing phangasarwanyel snying du sdug cing yid du 'ong ba dang / bzod pa dang ldan pa dang mi 'thun pa med pa de dur khrod du khyer nas pang par bzhag ste kyi hud bu/ kyi hud bu thu bo/ kyi hud bu gcig nyu cizhes zer zhing 'bod de8/ de'i nye du rnams kyis de ltar 75—340

bcugs7kyang bslang ma nus nas de khwa dang / chun lag dang / bya rgod dang wa rnams kyis ni bskor/ /bud med skra bshig57pa dgashedang ni 'grogs/ skye bo mang pos ni blta zhing 'dug go/ /de nas de'i bu lhar skyes pas pha smre sngags 'don pa mthong nas snying rjes snying bskyod de/ pha'i mya ngan bsal ba'i phyir bdag nyid drang srong gi cha lugs su sprul nas/ dur khrod kyi 'dab tu dka' thub lnga byed cing 'dug go/ /de nas bram ze des drang srong de la (9dris pa/kye'i7drang srong chen po khyod dka' thub 'dis ci zhig sgrub/ drang srong gis smras pa / nga ni rgyal srid sgrub ste/ nga'i gser gyi shing rta rin po che56)sna tshogs kyis spras pa nyi ma dang zla ba gnyis kyis〈pezhing rta'i 'khor lo byas la/ 'jig rten skyong ba bzhis ni mdun nas 'dren te/ shing rta de la yang 3)zhon zhing sa chen po 'di bskor bar 'dod do/ /bram zes smras pa/ gal te lo brgya tham pa'i bar/ /rgyun du dka' thub spyad byas te/ /dka' thub mchog ni tsho'o spyad byas kyang / /gnas de khyod kyis re mi 'thobatu )/ /drang srong gis smras pa/ khyod kyang shi ba'i khog pa mchog tu mnam zhing 37mi gtsang ba'i ro shing 'dra bar gyur pa 'dis ci zhig sgrub/ bram zes smras pa/ sdug pa'i bu gcig pa shi ste de sgrub72bo/ /drang srong gis smras pa/ gal te lo brgya tham pa'i bar/ /rgyun du ngu ba'i las byas kyang | /bu de khyod kyis re mi thob/ /khyod ni ngusatshwa kyang ci la phan/ /de nas bram ze de7drang srong gi tshig bden no snyam nas dad pa skyes so/ /dad pa skyes nas khyod su zhig ces dris sonya/ /de nas drang srong gis/cha lugs de mi snang bar byas nas/ rang gi cha nyu 7lugs su 'dug ste/ pha la smras pa/ bdag7)ni khyod kyi bu gcig pa de yin te bcom ldan 'das la sems dga' bar gyur nas shi 75—341

ste / sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha yul bzang por skyes nas/ khyod kyi mya ngan bsal ba'i phyir 'dir 'ongs so/ /yab khyod tshur spyon/ bcom ldan 'das la skyabs su bzhud cig dang / khyed7kyang 'khor ba las 'da' bar gyur kyangashesrid do/ /de nas bram ze des shi ba'i rus bu bor nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal ①te/chos mnyanas)pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de la 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi rtogs par 'gyur ba de lta bu'i chos bstan pa mdzad dephyi/ de thos nas bram ze des 'jig tshogasakyil lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo mthon po nyi shu ye shes rdo rjes bcomasnyenas rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu thob bo/ /des mtho bar 'gyur ba thob cing༅rnyed pa thob nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal7te lan gsum bskor7ba byas te song ngo ske/ /de nas dge slong dag tu)the tshom tunyeskyes te/ the tshom ④thams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ bcom ldan 'das lha'i bu 'dis 'di ltar pha'i tunyemya ngan bsal nas bden pa mthong ba la yang bzhag pa la tunyegazigs/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag da ltar 'dis bden pa mthong nas pha yongs su bskyabs (nyepa 'di lta la ngo mtshar che ba ci yod/'dis ni 'das pa'i dus na so so'i skye bor 'dug pa'i tshe yang pha gsadanyepa la thug pa la tsho/)lan gsum skyabs byas te/ de legs par rab tu nyon la yid la zung5)shig dang ngas bshad do/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na grong khyer bā rā ṇa sī ten gzhan gyi chung ma la byi bshebyed pa zhig yod de/ de'i bu ni dad pa dang ldan lamanyedage zhing bsam pa bzang ba mi rnams shin tu 'grang 75—342

ba zhig go/ /de nas re zhigatun de'i phas rkun po byas nas/ rgyal posalgegashed ma rnams la sodakhucig ces bsgo'o/ /de nas bus lan gsum gyi bar du rgyal po la gsol nas srog phangasalgepa byin no/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dusakyin gzhan gyi chung ma la byi ba byed pa gang yin pa de ni bram ze 'di yin no/ /byi ba byed pa'i bu gang yin pa de ni bram ze'i khye'u 'di yin no/ /dge slong rnams kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das las ci zhig bgyis na des pha dang bu gnyis ku bden pa mthong bar gyur lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gi ring la de gnyis /snyedage bsnyen7du gyur te/ skyabs su song ba dang bslab pa'i gzhi blangs pas na de'i phyir de ltar bden pa mthong bar gyur to/ /dge slong dag de bas na 'du byed thams cad mi rtag pa dang chos thams cad bdag med pa dang mya ngan las 'das pa ni zhi ba'o snyam du mya ngan las 'das pa la 'bad par bya stote/ dge slong khyed〈nyekyis de ltar bslab par bya'o / /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ dge slong de dag dang lha dang lha ma yin dang nam mkha' lding dang mi 'am ci dang lto 'phye chen po la sogs pa gzhan dag kyang yi rangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// //sārnyul zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po rnams dang /blon po chen po rnams dang / phyug po rnams dang / pho brang 'khor gyi mi rnams dang / tshong dpon rnams dang / ded dpon rnams dang / lha rnams dang /klu rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams dang / lha ma yin rnams dang / nam 75—343

mkha' lding rnams dang / mi 'am ci rnams dang / lto 'phyeshechen po rnams kyis bkur sti byas②/ bla mar byas/ ri mosabyas/ mchod pa byas te/ lha dang /klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / sto 'phye chen po rnams kyis mchod cing shes pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bsod nams chen po dang ldan pa/ /na bza' dang / zhal zas dang / gzims cha dang / gdan dang / snyun0gsos dang / sman zong rnams brnyes pa/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa mnyan du yod pa na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mikhyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe mnyan du yod par r+sākyil gcog pa zhes bya ba'i dus ston byung ste/ der srog chags 'bum phrag du ma 'dus nas shing sārnyula'i mesatog blangs te rtse zhing dga' la dga' mgur 7spyod do/ /de nas re zhig na tshong dpon gyi bu mo zhig gis sātshwanye la'i me tog blangs51te/ mnyan du yod pa'i nang du song ba dang bcom ldan 'das kyang dge slong gi tshogs kyis zhabs 'bring tunyebyas te(3/ dge slong gi dge 'dun gyis mdun du bdar nas/ mnyan du yod par bsod snyoms mdzad de slar gshegs nas/ bu mo des sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sku skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis legs par brgyan〈kye pa / dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus mdzes par byas pa/ 'od 'dom gang gis brgyanasnyipa/ nyi ma stong bas lhag pa'i 'od mnga' ba/ rin po che'i ri bo 'gro ba lta bu kun nas bzang ba mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang dga' ba skyes te/bcom ldan 'das la sā yila'i me tog gis gtor to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la bskor ba byas te/ phyir logasngo tshonas khyim du dgos pa'i phyir yang gzhan 75—344

dag blang ngo snyam pa dang / re zhig na de sātula'i shing la 'dzegasalgepa las lhungalaste shi nas bcom ldan 'das la bsnyenas)bkur byas nas⑥/ sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha'i yul bzang por skyes so/ /de nas re zhig na lus dang gzhal med khang sārnyula'i me tog gis brgyan te/ lha'i 'dunam1nyesa'i nang du song ngo / /de'i tshe lha'i dbang po brgya byin yang lha'i 'dunasanyu )sa chos bzang na lha'i tshogs kyi nang na sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun gyi bsngags hu7pa brjod cing 'dug pa las/lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis lha'i bu mo lus dang gzhal med khang sātshwanyela'i me tog gis brgyan pa dge ba'i rtsa ba 'bar ba de mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang de la tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ ci phyir khyod kyi7lus mdog dag pa'i gser 'dra pad ma ud pal lta bur gyur/ /'di na lus dpal mtshungs med khyod kyi lus las 'od byungakhe'adi dag ci las gyur/ /ci yi phyir na khyod tshekyi bzhin mdog pad ma rgyas 'dra gser mdog lta bur gyur/ /las rnams gang gi tsha/na'abras bu myong gyur 'di ni lha mo khyod kyis bdag la smros/ /lha mos smras pa/ mtshan mchog dag gis rgyas pa yonye/ /mi yi nyi ma nyan thos bcas(7/ /sā tri )la'i me tog rdul med pa/ /bzang po dag gis legs par gtor/ /las dge de 'dra byas pa'i phyir/ /bdag ni lhag par mngon du mdzes/ /bzhin mdog pad ma zla ba ltar/ /rnam dag 'od ldan blta na sdug /brgya byin gyis smras pa/ kye ma yon tan nyid kyi zhing / /nyes pa thams cad rnam spangs pa/ /mtho ris sdug par skye ba'i phyir/ /de la khyod kyis sa bon btab/ /bzhin mdzes pad〈skyema'i 'dab (nyem yangs pa 'dra ba'i mig ldan ma/ /bud med mchog rnams kyis ni gang la bkur ste byas pa yi/ /sangs rgyas pad ma rgyas pa'i 'dab5nyeyangs 'dra 75—345

ba'i spyan mnga' ba/ /gser mchog phung po lta bur mdangs dkar de la su mi mchod/ /lha'i bu'am lha'i bu mo skyes nas ring po ma lon pa ninyechos nyid kyis sems rnam pa gsum skye bar 'gyur te/ gang nas shi 'phos/ gang du skyes/las gang gis skyes snyam mo/ /de nas mi⑧las shi 'phos pa dang sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha yul bzang por skyes pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la sems dga' bar gyur par des mthong ngo / /de nas lha'i bu mo de 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag zhag lon nas gzod7bcom ldan 'das la blta ba'i phyir 'gro ba ni bdag gi cha ma yin gyis⑤/ bdag zhag ma lon par bcom ldan 'das la blta ba'i phyir 'gro'o snyam mo/ /de nas lha'i bu mo rna cha gdub kor dag cing 'gul bakhuthogs pa / lus do shal dang se mo dos brgyan pa/ nor bu rin po che sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa'i cod pan can/ lus gur gumasnyedang ta ma la'i lo ma dang 57ka la sogs pas byugs7) pa de/ lha'i bu mo 'bum phrag du mas g.yog byas nas de nyid kyi mtshan mo sā hunyala'i me tog gi gzhal 8med khang de nyid de 8dang bcas pas bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du song ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das la me tog gis gtor te/ chos mnyan pa'i phyir/ bcom ldan 'das kyi7spyan sngar 'dug go / / de nasatsobacom ldan 'das kyis lha'i bu mo de'i bsam pa dang / bag la nyal dang / khams dang / rang bzhin thugs su chud nas/ 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi rtogs par 'gyur ba de lta bu'i chos bstan te/ de thos nas lha'i bu mo des 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo mthon po nyi shu ye shes rdo rjes bcom nas rgyun du zhugs〈nyepa'i 'bras bu thob ste/ des bden pa mthong nas dga' ba'i tshig lan gsum brjod de/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag 75—346

gi khrag dang mchi ma'i rgya mtsho bskams pa dang / rus pa'i latubasgral ba dang /ngan song gi sgo rnams bcad pa dang / mtho ris dang thar pa'i sgo rnams phye ba dang / bdag lha dang mi rnams kyi nang du bzhag pa 'di lta bu ni bdag la phas kyang ma bgyis/ mas kyang ma bgyis/ rgyal pos kyang ma bgyis/ lha rnams kyis kyang ma bgyis/② nang mi dang gnyen gyi tshogs kyis kyang ma bgyis/ sngon gyi mtshun rnams kyis kyang ma bgyis/ dge sbyong dang bram ze rnams kyis kyang ma bgyis lags so/ /yang smras pa/ nyes pa mang por ldan pa'i ngan song lam/ /shin tu mi bzad khyod kyi mthu yis bcad/ /bsodakunams rab ldan mtho ris 'gro ba phye/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i lam yang bdag gis thob/ /bdag gis de ring nyes pa spangs pa'i mig /shin tu rnam dag khyod lasasnyibarten nas thob/ /bdag ni sdug bsngal rgya mtsho7pa rol rga'akho/ /'phags pa dgyes pa'i zhi ba'i go 'phangasathob/ /mi mchog dbang po lha dang mis7mchod pa/ /skye dang rga⑩dang 'chi ba'i nad spangs payi/ /srid pa stong du mthong bar dka' ba tso/ /thub pa khyod ni deng mthong 'bras bu yod/ /de nas do shal 'phyang ba dga' gyur7te/ /btud cing zhabs gnyis la ni phyag 'tshalasnyanas/ /dgra thub la ni bskor ba byasalgenas kyang / / lha yi 'jig rten kha bltas〈nyelha yul song / /de nas lha'i bu mo de tshong pa khe spogs phyin pa dang / zhing pa 'bru rgyal bar gyur pa dang /dpa' bo g.yul las rgyal ba dang / nad pa nad thams cad las thar ba bzhin du/ 'byor〈nyepa gang gis bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du 'ongs pa'i 'byor pa de nyid kyis rang gi gnas su song ngo / /dge slong dag ni srod dang tho ras7mi nyal bar brtson pa lhur byed ⑥ pa la gnas te de dag gis bcom ldan 'das kyi 75—347

thad du snang ba chen po byung ba mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang the tshomanyeskyes te theri tshom thams cad gcod pa (gyesangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ mdang suma'i mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pa'am lha'i dbang po brgya byin nam/ 'jig rten skyong ba bzhi bcom ldan 'das la blta ba'i slad du mchis lags sam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pa'am lha'i dbang po brgya byin nam 'jig rten skyong ba bzhi nga la blta ba'i phyir 'ongs pa ma yin no/ /bu mo gang gis lam khar me tog gis gtor ba de khyod kyis mthong ngam/ btsun pa mthong lags so/ /de ni nga la sems dga' ba bskyed nas shi ste/ sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha yul bzang por skyes nas de tsu)nga'i thad du 'ongs te/ ngas de la chos bstan nas bden pa mthong bar gyur te/ rang gi gnas su song ngo / /dge slong dag de bas na 'di ltar bslab par bya stenano/ ston pa la bkur sti bya'o/ /bla mar bya'o/ /ri mor bya'o / /mchod pa ri7bya'o/ /ston pa la bkur ste byas/ bla mar byas/ ri mor byas / mchod pa byas9)nas brten te gnas par bya'o zhes dge slong khyod7kyis de ltar bslab par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/dge slong de dag yi ⑨rangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod nyu3 do// // gang po la sogs pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa brgya pa nyu1bam 3)po bcu gsum pa / dpal ldan ma zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po rnams dang / blon po chen po rnams dang / phyug po rnams dang / pho brang 'khor gyi mi rnams dang / tshong dpon rnams dang / ded dpon rnams dang /75—348

lha rnams dang / klu rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams dang / lha ma yin rnams dang / nam mkha' lding rnams dang / mi 'am ci rnams dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis bkur sti byas/ bla mar byas/ ri mor byas/ mchod pa byas te①/ lha dang/ klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis mchod cing shes pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bsod nams chen po dang ldan pa/ na bza' dang / zhal zas dang gzims cha dang / gdan dang / snyan gsos dang / sman zongakhurnams brnyes pa/ nyan⑧thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa rgyal po'i khab na 'od ma'i tshal bya ka lan da ka gnas pa na rten cing bzhugs so//de'i tshe rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer na rgyal po gzugs can snying po rgyal po byed de/de'i ring la 'byor pa dang / rgyas pa dang / bde ba dang / lo legs pa dang /skye bo dang mi mang pos gang ba dang / rtsod0)pa dang / 'thab pa zhi ba dang /'khrug pa dang / nang 'khrug dang / chom rkun dang / mu ge dang / nad rnams med pa dang / 'bras sā〈lu dang / bu ram shing dang / ba lang dang /ma he dang ldan par 'dug ste/ gnod pa med cing tsher ma dkrugs7la bu gcig pa la bya ba bzhin du rgyal srid bskyangs so/ /de nas gang gi tshe rgyal po gzugs can snying pos bcom ldan 'das las bden pa mthong ba de'i tshe btsun mo'i 'khor dang bcas te/ dus phyagasum du bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du 'gro'o//de nas rgyal po gzugs can snying po phyi zhig na dpyid kyi dus la ⑧bab pa'i tshe/shing ljon pa rnams me tog rgyas la ngang pa dang / khrung khrung dang / rma bya dang /ne tso dang / ri skegs dang / khu byugatenyu)dang / shang shang te'u rnams skad 75—349

'byin pa'i nags khrod na/ skyed7mos tshal gyi sar btsun mo dam pa dang btsun mo'i⑧'khor dang bcas te dong nas/ der btsun mo'i 'khor gyis rgyal po la gsol pa/ lha bdag cag ni gdugs gcig bzhin du bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du mchi ba'i〈mirngo mi thogs rtsorin/ lha btsun mo'i 'khor gyi nang 'dir de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbu skra dang sen 6)mo'i mchod rten brtsigs te zhal bsro dubar ci gnang ske/ 'on kyang〈pebadag cagasnyigis de la rgyun du mar me dang / bdugashepa dang ske/ me tog dang / spos dang / me tog phreng dang / byug pa dang /gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dag gis bkur sti bgyi'o zhes gsol to/ /de nas re zhig na rgyal po gzugs can snying pos/ bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das bdag la dbu skra dang sen mo stsal du gsol / 'on tang 37bdag gis mchis7brang 'khor du de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten brtsigs te/ zhal bsrolanyebar bgyi'o zhes gsol to/ /de nas re zhig na bcom ldan 'das kyis yidabu skra dang sen mo byin nas rgyal po gzugs can snying po btsun mo'imatso'akhor dang bcas pas/ btsun mo'i 'khor gyi nang du bkur sti chen po dang ldan pas de bzhin gshegs ⑩pa'i dbu skra dang sen mo'i mchod rten brtsigs te zhal bsros hurtenas/ de la btsun mo'i 'khor gyis mar me dang ske/ bdug02pa dang / me tog dang / spos dang / me tog phreng dang /byug pa dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dag gis kyang mchod pa byed do/ /de nas gang gi5)tshe rgyal po ma skyes dgra lha sbyin gyis rbad de / yab chos dang ldan pa chos bzhin du rgyal po byed pa bsad nas rang rgyal por zhugs pa de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das5)kyi bstan pa la sbyin par bya ba'i chos 75—350

thams cad bcad de①/ su yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten lakhubakur sti ma byed cigasheces khrims kyang bcas so/ /de nas gang gi tshe tshes bcwakhelnga la skabs 'byed pa'i dus la bab pa de'i tshe dbu skra dang sen mo'i mchod rten de la su yang phyag dar byed pa'am/ mar me dang / bdug7pa dang / me tog dbul7ba med do/ /de nas btsun mo'i⑧'khor gyis dbu skra dang sen mo'i mchod rten de de lta bur gyur pa yang mthong / rgyal po gzugs can snying po yang dran nas/ snying rje rje skad du ngu zhing kyi hud chos dang ldan pa'i rgyal po dang bral bas bdag cag bsod nams las 'gribs so zhes 'dzer tol/ /de'i nang nas btsun mo dpal ldan ma zhes bya ba des rang gi srog dang bsdos te/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan rjes su dran nas/ dbu skra dang sen mo'i mchod rten la phyag dar byas te/ mar me'i phreng ba dngar to/ /de nas re zhig na rgyal po ma skyes dgra khang pa brtsegs pa'i steng du byung ste/ snang ba chen po de mthong nas 'di ci zhig ces dris pa dang / re zhig na gzhan zhig gis dpal ldan mas dbu skra dang sen mo'i mchod rten la mar me'i phreng 37ba dngar ba lags so zhes byas so/ /de nas dpal ldan ma bkug ste ci'i phyir khyod kyis rgyal po'i bka' bcag5nyeces smras na/ de na re bdag gis khyod kyis rtebaka' bcag tu lags kyang bdag gis chos dang ldan pa'i rgyal po gzugs can snying po'i bka' ma bcag go zhes zer ro/ /de nas de khros nas 'khor lo 'phangs te bsad do/ /de nas tustebacom ldan 'das la sems dga' bar gyur te shi nas sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha yul bzang por skyes so/ /de'i tshe lha mdun ma zhig kyang 'dus nas lha'i bu7mo dpal ldan ma lha'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor snang ba kho ra khor yug tu dpag tshad gcig yod pa 75—351

dang ldan pa de lha'i 'dun sa'inyenang du song ngo / /de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis snang ba chen po de dang lha'i 'od dpag tshad gcig pa mthong nas dris pa/ci'i phyir khyod kyilalus mdog dag pa'i gser 'dra pad ma ud pal lta bur gyur//'di na lus dpal mtshungs med khyod kyi lus las 'od 'byung 'di dag ci las gyur / /(kyi ci yilo8)phyir na khyod kyi bzhinasnyimadog pad ma rgyas 'dra gser mdog lta bur gyur/ /las rnams gang gis7'bras bu myong gyur 'di ni lha mo khyod kyis bdag la smros/ /lha mos smras pa/ 'jig rten gsum mgon 'gro ba'i sgron gcig po/ /mtshan mchog rnams kyis phyug pa'i sangs rgyas mthong / /smra mchog nyon mongs mun pa sel ba la/ /mun pa sel ba'i mar me yon tu phul/ /zla ba'i 'od zer mdog (she)dang 'dra ba'i 'od/ /mthong nas thub la snying nas dad pa skyesaXn/ /'od zer mthong nas dga' bar gyur pa yis/ /ston pa smra ba'i mchog la phyag kyang bgyis/ /las dge de 'dra byas pa'i phyir/ /bdag ni lhag par mngon tu mdzes/ /bzhin mdog pad ma zla ba ltar/ /rnam dag 'od ldan blta na sdug3 bye /brgya byin gyis smras pa/ kye ma yon tan nyid kyi〈spezhing / /nyes pa thams cad rnam spangs pa/ /mtho ris sdug par skye ba'i phyir/ /de la khyod kyis sa bon btab/ /bzhin mdzes pad ma'i 'dabarwanyam yangs pa 'dra ba'i mig ldan ma/ /bud med mchog rnams kyis ni gang la bkur sti byas pa yikho/ /sangs rgyas pad ma rgyas pa'i 'dab78yangs 'dra ba'i spyan mnga' ba/ /gser mchog phung po lta bur mdangs dkar78de la su mi mchod/ /lha'i bu'am lha'i bu mo skyes nas ring po ma lon pa ni chos nyid kyis sems rnam pa gsum skye bar 'gyur te/ gang nas shi 'phos gang du skyes las gang gis skyes snyam mo/ /de 75—352

nas mi las shi 'phos pa dang sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha yul bzang por skyes pa dang la/ bcom ldan 'das la sems dga' bar gyur par7des mthong ngo / /de nas lha'i bu mo dpal ldan ma 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag zhag lon nas gzod ②bcom ldan 'das la blta ba'i phyir 'gro ba ni bdag gi cha ma yin gyis /bdag zhag ma lon par bcom ldan 'das la7blta ba'i phyir 'gro'o snyam mo/ /de nas lha'i bu mo dpal ldan ma lha'i 'od kyi snang bas gang ba des ⑤de nyid kyi mtshan mo lha'i me tog ud pa la dang / pad ma dang / ku mu da dang / pad ma dkar po dang / man drasher rnams kyis thu ba bkang ste/ rgyal po'i khab bya ka lan da ka gnas pa thams cad 'od chen pos snang bar byas nas/ bcom ldan 'das la me tog gis gtor te/ chos mnyan pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis lha'i bu mo dpal ldan ma'i bsam pa dang bag la nyal ⑧dang khams dang rang bzhin thugs su chud nas/'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi rtogs par gyur pa phyo)de lta bu'i chos bstan te/ de thos nas lha'i bu mo dpal ldan mas 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo mthon po nyi shu ye shes rdo rjes bcom nas/ rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu thob ste/ des bden pa mthong nas dga' ba'i tshig lan gsum brjod dekyi/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag gi khrag dang mchi ma'i〈1rgya mtsho bskams〈nyepa dang / rus pa'i la7bsgral ba dang / ngan song gi sgo rnams bcad pa dang mtho ris dang thar pa'i sgo rnams phye ba dang / bdag lharwastedang mi rnams kyi nang du bzhag pa 'di lta bu ni bdag la phas kyang ma bgyis/ mas kyang ma bgyis/ rgyal pos kyang ma bgyis/ lha rnams kyis kyang ma bgyis/ nang mi dang gnyen gyi tshogs 75—353

rnams7kyis kyang ma bgyis/ sngon gyi mtshun rnams kyis7kyang ma bgyis/ dge sbyong dang bram ze rnams kyis kyang ma bgyis lags so/ /yang smras pa/ nyes pa mang por ldan pa'i ngan song lam/ /shin tu mi bzad khyod kyi mthukhuyis bcad//bsod nams rab ldan mtho ris 'gro ba phye/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i lam yang bdag gis thob/ /bdag gis de ring nyes pa spangs pa'i mig /shin tu rnam dag khyod las brten nas thob(0/ /bdag ni sdug bsngal rgya mtsho pha rol rgalas/ /'phags pa dgyes pa'i zhi ba'i go 'phang 'thobaskyo/ /mi mchog dbang po mi dang lhas mchod pa/ /skye dang rga dang 'chi ba'i nad spangs pa/ /srid pa stong du mthong bar dka' ba yi/ /thub pa khyod ni deng mthong 'bras bu yod/ /de nas do shal 'phyang ba dga' gyur te/ /btudasacing zhabs gnyis la ni phyag 'tshal7nas / /dgra thub la ni bskor ba byas nas kyang / /lha yi 'jig rten kha bltas lha yul song / /de nas lha'i bu mo dpal ldan ma/ tshong pa khe spogs phyin pa dang ske/ zhing pa hu1'bru rgyal bar gyur pa dang / dpa'algebo g.yul las rgyal ba dang ske/ nad pa nad thams cad las thar ba bzhin du 'byor pa gang gis bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du 'ongs pa'i 'byor pa de nyid kyis rang gi gnas su song ngo / /dge slong dag ni srod dang tho ras〈nyemi nyal bar brtson pa lhur byed pa la gnas te/ de dag gis bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du snang ba chen po byung ba mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang the tshom skyes te the tshom thams cad gcod pahūsangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags mdang sum mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pa'am/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin nam/ 'jig rten skyong ba bzhi bcom ldan 'das la blta ba'i slad du mchis lags sam/75—354

bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pa'am lha'i dbang po brgya byin nam hu)'jig rten skyong ba bzhi nga la blta ba'i phyir 'ongs pa ma yin gyi/ rgyal po gzugs can snying po'i btsun mo dpal ldan ma zhes bya bas rang gi srog dang bsdos te/ sangs rgyas kyi yon7tan rjes su dran nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbu skra ③dang sen mo'i mchod rten la mar me'i phreng ba dngar nas/ rgyal po ma skyes dgra khros pas bsad de/ de nga la dga' ba'i sems bskyed nas shi ste sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha yul bzang por skyes nas/ deng mdangasasum nga'i thad du 'ongs te⑦/ ngas de la chos bstan nas bden pa mthong bar gyur te rangashegi gnas su song ngo / /dge slong dag de bas na⑧'di ltar bslab par bya stenya/ ston pa la bkur ste bya'o/ /bla mar bya'o/ /ri mor bya'o/ /mchod pa bya'o/ /ston pa la bkur sti byas/ bla mar byas/ri mor byas/ /mchod pa byas nas brten te gnas par bya'o zhes dge slong khyodalo)kyis de ltar bslab par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ dge slong de dag yi rangs te bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pasnyil mngon par bstod7do// //gos zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po rnams dang /blon po chen po rnams dang / phyug po rnams dang / pho brang 'khor gyi mi rnams dang / tshong dpon rnams dang / ded dpon rnams dang / lha rnams dang /klu rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams dang / lha ma yin rnams dang / nam mkha' lding rnams dang / mi 'am ci rnams dang / lto 'phyechachen po rnams kyis bkur sti byas/ bla mar byas/ ri mor byas/ mchod pa〈nyebyas te/ lha dang /75—355

klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phyeshechen po rnams kyis mchod cing shes pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bsod nams chen po dang ldan pa/ na bza' dang / zhal zas dang / gzims cha dang / gdan dang / snyun gsosashedang / sman zong rnams brnyes pa/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa mnyan du yod pa na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na⑧bzhugs so/ /de nas gang gi tshe khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis/ sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun la rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal phul te④/mthar gyis gser srang gebye ba phrag brgya bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la phul ba de'i tse de'i blo skyes pa ma la bdag sbyin pa dag sbyin zhing bsod nams dag byed pa 'di lta la ngo mtshar che ba ci yod kyisaX/ bdag gis skye bo dbul po rnams la phan dugadags pa'i phyir mnyan du yod pa na gnas pa'i skye bo rnams dad pa bsdus te/ bcom ldan 'das7)nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa la bsnyen bkur ⑩bya'o/ /de ltar byas pa dang bdag gis skye bo mang po la yang phan gdags par gyur〈nyal/ bsod nams mang po yang bskyed par 'gyur ro〈nyesnyam mo / /de nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis ji ltar bsams pa de/rgyal po la gsol nas/ rgyal pos kyang mnyan du yod pa thams cad du dril bsgrags te/ mnyan du yod pa na gnas pa'i pho brang 'khor gyi mi khyed rnams nyon cig /deng nas zhag bdun na khyim bdag mgon〈nyemed zas sbyin gyis/de bzhin gshegs pa'i nyan thos rnams kyi phyir glang po che la zhon te/ dad pa sdud par 'dod kyis 7khyed gang gis ji tsam yongs su gtang 8bar bya ba de 75—356

yongs su gtang bar gyis shig ces bsgo'o/ /de nas re zhig na zhag bdun lon pa dang khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin glang po che la zhon te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i7nyan thos rnams kyi phyir dad pa sdud pa la zhugs te/ der gang dag la ji tsam bdog pa de dag de tsam sbyin par byed de②/ kha cig ni mgul gyi se mo do sbyin par byed/ kha cig ni gdu〈kyebu sbyin par byed④/ kha cig ni dpung rgyan sbyin par byed/ kha cig ni gser gyi phrengakheb sbyin par byed/ kha cig ni sor gdubashekyi rgyan sbyin par byed/ kha cig ni mu tig gi do shal sbyin par byed/ kha cig ni gser sbyin par byed/ kha cig ni dngul sbyin par byed/ kha cig ni tha na zhi'i brgyad cha tsam yang sbyin par byed do/ /khyim bdag de yang gzhan⑧la phan gdags pa'i7phyir len par byed do/ /de nas re zhig na bud med shin tu dbul mo zhig gis7sha thang ste/ zla ba gsum gyis ras yug cig rnyed nas des ras de gyon te srang du zhugs pa dang / desarwatekhyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin dung 'bud cing rnga zlum brdung yonyebazhin du rgyang nas 'ongs pa tunyemathong nas des dge bsnyen zhig la dris pa ji ste/ khyim bdag 'di phyug cing nor mang la longs spyod che ste/ gter sa'i 'og tu sbas pa rnams kyang mthong na/ci'i phyir 'di gzhan gyi khyim nas slong zhing skor (hebar byed ces byas pa dang /dge bsnyen de na re gzhan la phan gdags pa'i phyir tekhegang dag bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa/ bshos gsol mi nus pa de dag gi don du phan 'dogs par byed de/ ci nas mang po nyi 7bsdongs te bcom ldan 'das la dbul tunyedu 'jug tu)go zhes zer ro/ /de nas bu mo de'i blo skyes pa/'o na bdag ni bsod nams ma byas pa yin la/ bdag gcig pus bcom ldan 75—357

'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa bshos gsol ba'i mthu bdag la med kyis①/ bdag gis 'di la cung zad dbul bar bya gor ma chag snyam mo/ /de nas bdag nyid la ci bdog ces bltas na ras yug gcig ma gtogs pa ②gzhan ci yang ma mthong ste/ /des7bsams pa gal te bdag 'di na 'dug bzhin du ras 'di phul na ni bdag gcer bur 'byung gis bdag khang thog tu song la ras dor ro snyam mo/ /de nas de khang thog tu song nas rangasnyigi lus las ras phud de/ khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyi7steng du bor ba dang /khyim bdag des ④kyang 'phrigs te/ 'dis khang thog nas bor ba las na/'di la nor de las med gor ma chag snyam nas rang gi g.yog rnams la bsgonyeb/khyed dong7la ras 'di sus bor ba ltos shig ces byas nas/ de dag gis bltas pa dang re zhig na bu mo de tsog tsog por 'dug pa mthong ngo / /de nas de dag gis dris pa dang / de nas7 bcom ldan 'das kyi5)yon tan brjod pa bdag gis thos nas dbul ba'i 'jigs pas skrag ste bdag gis gos rnyed pa de de bzhin gshegs pa la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun la phul lo zhes zer ro/ /de nas de dag gis khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin la byas so/ /de nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin mchog tu ngo mtshar du gyur nas/ bu mo de la gos dang rgyan rnam pa sna tshogs bskon to/ /de nas de tshe thung ste shi nas sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha yul bzang por skyes te/ skyes ma thag tu lha'i bu dang7lha'i bu mo gzhan su la yang med pa de lta bu'i gos (nyedag de la byung ngo / /lha'i bu'am lha'i bu mo skyes nas ring po ma lon pa ni chos nyid kyis sems rnam pa gsum skye bar 'gyur te/ gang nas shi 'phos gang du skyes las gang gis skyes7snyam mo/ /75—358

de nas mi las shi 'phos pa dang sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha yul bzang por7skyes pa dang bcom ldanakhu'adas la ras phul bar des mthong ngo / /de nas sngon ras 'bul 'bul ③ba'i lha'i bu mo rna cha gdub kor ④dag cing 'gul ba ⑧thogs pa/lus do shal dang se mo dos brgyan pa/ nor bu rin po che sna tshogs kyis brgyanakhupa'i cod pan can/ lus gur gumadzanyadang ta ma la'i lo ma dang 57ka la sogs pas byugs pa des/ de nyid kyi mtshan mo lha'i me tog ud5)pa la dang / pad ma dang / ku mu dacadang / pad ma dkar po dang / man dā ra rnams kyis thu ba bkang ste/ rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal thams cad 'od chen pos snang bar byas nasatso/ bcom ldan 'das la me tog gis gtor te/ chos mnyan pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das7kyis sngon ras 'bul 'bul ba'i lha'i bu mo'i bsam pa dang bag la nyal dang khams dang rang bzhin thugs su chud nas/ 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi rtogs par 'gyur ba de lta bu'i chos bstan te/ de thos nas sngon ras 'bul 'bul ba'i lha'i bu mos 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo mthon po nyi shu ye shes rdo rjes bcom nas rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu thob ste/ des bden pa mthong nas dga' ba'i tshig lan gsum du brjod de/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag gi khrag dang mchi ma'i rgya mtsho bskams pa dang / rus pa'i la7bsgral ba dang / ngan song gi sgo rnams bcad〈nyepa dang / mtho ris dang thar pa'i sgo rnams phye ba dang / bdag lha dang mi rnams kyi nang du bzhag pa 'di lta bu ni bdag la phas kyang ma bgyis/ mas kyang ma bgyis/ rgyal pos kyang ma bgyis/lha rnams kyis kyang ma bgyis/ nang mi dang gnyen gyi tshogs kyis kyang ma bgyis/75—359

sngon gyi mtshun rnams kyis kyang ma bgyis/ /dge sbyong dang bram ze rnams kyis kyang ma bgyis lags so/ /yang smras pa/ nyes pa mang por7ldan pa'i ngan song lam / /shin tu mi bzad khyod kyi mthu yis bcad/ /bsod nams rab ldan mtho ris 'gro ba phye/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i lam yang bdag gis thob/ /bdag gis de ring nyes pa spangs pa'i mig /shin tu rnam dag khyod lasakhubarten nas thobaske/ /bdag ni〈bsdug bsngal rgya mtsho'ikyipha rol rga'akhya/ /'phags pa dgyes pa zhi ba'i go 'phang thob/ /mi mchog dbang po mi dang lhas mchod pa/ /skye dang rga dang 'chi ba'i nad spangs pa/ /srid pa stong0du mthong bar dka'akhub yinya/ /thub pa khyod ni deng mthong 'bras bu yod/ /de nas do shal 'phyang ba dga' gyur te/ /btud cing zhabs gnyis la ni phyag 'tshal nasabya/ /dgra thub larwa)ni bskor ba byas nas〈nyekyang / /lha yi 'jig rten kha bltas7lha yul song / /de nas sngon ras 'bul 'bul ba'i lha'i bu mo de tshong pa khe spogs phyin pa dang /zhing pa 'bru rgyal bar gyur pa dang / dpa' bo g.yul las rgyal ba dang /nad pa nad thams cad las thar ba bzhin du 'byor pa gang gis/ bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du 'ongs pa'i 'byor pa de nyid kyis rang gisnyiganas su song ngo / /dge slong dag ni srod dang tho ras 8mi nyal bar brtson pa lhur byed pa la gnas te/de dag gis bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du snang ba chen po byung ba mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang the tshom〈nyeskyes te the tshom thams cad gcod pa〈nyesangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags mdang sum mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pa'am lha'i dbang po brgya byin nam 'jig rten skyong ba bzhi bcom ldan 'das la blta〈 )ba'i slad du mchis lags sam/ bcom ldan 'das 75—360

kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pa'am/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin nam 'jig rten skyong ba bzhi nga la blta ba'i phyir 'ongs pa ma yin gyi②/ ras 'bul 'bul ba'i bud med de khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin dad pa sdud7par byed pa laphuras phul nas shi ste/ sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha yul bzang por skyes nas/ de mdang sumasnyinga'i thad du 'ongs te ngas 55)de la chos bstan nas/ bden pa mthong bar gyur te rang gi gnas su song ngo / /dge slong dag de bas na 'di ltar bslab par bya ste/ sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun rnams la bkur snyi bya'i ⑥bkur sti med par mi bya'o zhes zho)dge slong dag⑧khyed kyis de ltar bslab par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas dge slong de dag yinyerangs te bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// //ne tso zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po rnams dang /blon po chen po rnams dang / phyug po rnams dang / pho brang 'khor gyi mi rnams dang / tshong dpon rnams dang / ded dpon rnams dang / lha rnams dang /klu rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams dang / lha ma yin rnams dang / nam mkha' lding rnams dang / mi 'am ci rnams dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams 3 〉kyis bkur ste byas/ bla mar byas/ ri mor byas/ mchod pa byas te/ lha dang /klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang /nya1 nam mkha' lding dang /mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis mchod cing shes pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bsod nams chen po dang5)ldan pa/ na bza' dang / zhal zas dang / gzims cha dang / gdan dang / snyun gsos dang / sman zong 75—361

rnams brnyesalgepa/ nyan⑧thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa mnyan du yod pa na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer na rgyal po gzugs can snying po rgyal po byed de/ de'i ring la 'byor pa dang / rgyas pa dang / bde ba dang /lo legs pa dang / skye bo dang mi mang posalgegang ba dang / rtsodakyipa dang /'thab pa zhi ba dang / 'khrug pa dang / nang 'khrugashedang / chom rkun dang /mu ge dang / nad rnams med pa dang / 'bras sā lu dang / bu ram shing dang ske/ ba lang dang / ma he dang ldan par 'dugakhuste/ gnod pa med cing tsher ma dkrugs la/ bu gcig pa la bya ba bzhin du rgyal srid bskyangs so/ /rgyal po de yang dad ⑧pa dang ldan la dge 0zhing bsam pa bzang ba ⑩bdag la phan pa dang gzhan la phan pa la zhugs te/ snying rje che ba/ bdag nyid che ba/chos 'dod pa(rta/ skye dgu la byams pa zhig go/ /de nas re zhig na bcom ldan 'das mthong bar smon te/ lag pa la skom tshugs bcas nas sems khong du chud cing 'dug go/ /de nas blon po rnams kyis smras pa/ lha ci'i〈nyeslad du thugs ngan mdzad8/ rgyal pos smras pa/ ngas skyebacom ldan 'das ring zhig ma mthong ngo / /ngas bde bar gshegs pa ring zhig ma mthong ngo / /da ni bcom ldan 'das mthong bar 'dod do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das nyin par gnas pa la zhugs pasatso/ lha'i snyan rnam par dag pa mi las 'das pas rgyal po gzugs can snying po smon pa gsan to/ /de'i skabs su sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis ni mi mkhyen pa'am mi gzigs pa'am mi rtogs pa'am thugs su mi chud parwa 7ci yang med la/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po dang 75—362

ldan pa/ 'jig rten la phan 'dogs pa la zhugs pa/ srung ba gcig pa dang ldan pa/ ①gcig tu dpa' ba/ zla med pa/ gnyis su mi gsung ba/ zhi gnas dang lhag mthong la gnas pa/ rig pa gsum snang bar mdzad pa/bslab pa gsum la legs par bslabs pa/ 'dul ba'i gzhi gsum la mkhas pa/chu bo bzhi las rgal ②ba/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi'i'abazhabs kyi mthil shin tu brtan pa/ bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi la yun ring po nas 'dris par byas pa dngas/ mi 'jigs pa bzhis mi 'jigs pa/ khyu mchog gi yang dag pa'i seng ge'i sgra chen po sgrogs pa/ yan lag lnga rnam par spangs pa/ 'gro ba lnga las yang dag par 'das pa/ yan lag drug dang ldan pa/ pha rol tu phyin pa drugasu yongs su rdzogs pa/ rtag tu gnas par bya ba drug la gnas pa/ byang chub kyi yan lag bdun gyi me tog gis (nyuphyug pa/ lam yan lag brgyad pa ston pa/mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu la gnas pa/ /stobs bcu'i stobs dang ldan pa/ phyogs bcuras47)grags pas kun tus rgyas pa/ brgya phrag bcu pa ⑨la dbang byed pa bas kyang ches 7khyad par du 'phags pa rnams ni chos nyid kyis nyin (1dus gsum mtshan dus gsum du sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis 'jig rtenarwagyel gzigs te/ su ni rgyad/ su ni dar/ su ni phongs7)shing 'dug /su ni nyamasang bar gyur/ su ni gnod pa dang ldan/ su ni phongs pa dngathinyam tsong ba dang gnod pa dang ldan/ su ni ngan song du gzhol/ su ni ngan song du 'bab/ su ni ngan song du bab/ su ni ngas ngan song nas kyi phyung ste/mtho ris dang thar pa dang 'bras bu la gzhag par 18bya/ su ni 'dod pa'i 'dam du bying ba las lag nas drang bar bya/ su ni 'phags pa'i nor bdun 75—363

med pa las/ 'phags pa'i nor bdun gyi dbang phyug la dbang byed7du gzhug⑧par bya/ su ni dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams malcebaskyed pa las bskyed par bya/ su ni dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams bskyed zin pa las yongs su smin par bya/ su ni yongs su smin zin pa las rnam par grol bar bya snyam5bdu ye shes gzigs pa 'jug go/ /'dir smras pa/ rgya mtsho chu srin rnams kyi gnas/ /dus rlabs yol bar 'gyur yang srid/ /gdul bar bya ba'i sras rnams la/ /sangs rgyas dus las yol ba medam/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rgyal po gzugs can snying po la phan gdags pa'i phyir/ dbyar zla ba dugegasum 'das nas chos gos mdzad de chos gos zin nas chos gos gsol te lhung bzed bsnams nas ljongs rgyu zhing mthar gyis gshegs pa las nags khrod cig tu byon pa dang / nags khrod de na ne tso mi skad shes pa zhig gnas te/ desamathabacom ldan 'das thag ring po zhig nas mthong ngo / /de nas shin tu rings par song ste/ bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa / bcom ldan 'das tshur 3)gshegs/ bcom ldan 'das gshegs pa legs so legs so/ /bdag la phan gdags su gsol/ nags khrod 'di kho nar gshegs dgongs gdab par gsol zhes byas so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das ne tso de la phan gdags pa'i phyir shing gang la ne tso gnas pa ⑧de'i drung du rtswa'i gdan bting nas skyil mo krung ci'ibacas te bzhugs so/ /nyan thos chen po rnams ni shing gzhan hu )dag gi drung du 'khod do/ /de nas ne tsos bcom ldan 'das dang nyan thos rnams la mi'am/ mi ma yin pa'am/ gnod sbyin nam/ srin po'amam/ ri nya dgas sam gcan gzan nyunyeganod pa byed du dogs te/ mtshan thog thag nags khrod de na phan tshun skor bar〈nyebyed do/ /de nas nam langasalge75—364

pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas nas bzod pa gsol te/ bcom ldan 'das bdag ni dud 'gro'i skye gnas su skyes pa lags pas/bdag la bcom ldan 'das mchod pa'i rgyu ci yang ma mchis na bzod pa mdzad du gsol/ /de lta lags kyis kyang bdag sngon du mchis te/ rgyal po gzugs can snying po la bcom ldan 'das gshegs so zhes sbran par 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de ltar gyis shig /de nas re zhig na de bcom ldan 'das kyi sngon du chas te mthar gyis rgyal po'i7thad du phyin to/ /de'i tshe rgyal po gzugs can snying po ni khang bzangs kyi steng ②na bud med 'ba' zhig dang sil snyan gyis rtse zhing dga' la dga' mgurashespyod do/ /de nas ne tso mi skad shes pa des rgyal po la smras pa/ kye rgyal po khyod semakhyen par mdzod cig /bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa khyod kyisayul du gshegs lags kyisadu/ lha lakhyod kyis bshos sta nigon mdzad pa'i rigs so zhes byas so/ /de nas rgyal po shin tu rings par khang bzangs kyi7steng nas babs te(3 /blon po chen po'i tshogs kyis gzes 'bring51byas te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi gdan rnams bshams nas gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan rnams dang ske/ bdug pa dang / spos dang / me tog rnam pa sna tshogs kyis bcom ldan 'das7bsu'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa/ bkur ste chen po dang ldan pas nang du spyan drangs nas zhal zas bzang pos tshim par byas so/ /de nas ne tso de 'di snyam du sems te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi (nyenyan thos kyi dge 'dun gyi 'byor pa 'di dag thams cad ni bdag gi yon tan (steyin no snyam du rig nas dga' zhing mgu la yi (nyerangs te/75—365

rab tu dga' zhing dga' ba dang yid bde ba skyes nas rgyal po'i mdun logs su phan tshun du7lding ba las khras khyer te bsad do/ /bcom ldan 'das la sems dga' ba bskyed de7shi bas ni sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha yul bzang por skyes so/ / lha'i bu'amashelha'i bu mo skyes nas ring po ma lon pa ni chos nyid kyis sems rnam pa gsum skye bar 'gyur te/ gang nas shi 'phos/ gang du skyes/ las gang gis skyes snyamakhemo/ /de nas dud 'gro las shirnya'aphos pa dang sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha yul bzang por skyes pa dang bcom ldan 'das la sems dga' bar gyur pa des mthong ngo / /de nas sngon ne tsor gyur pa7lha'i bu 'di snyam du sems te/bdag zhag lon nas gzod bcom ldan 'das blta ba'i phyir 'gro ba ni/ bdag gi cha ma yin gyis 3)bdag zhag ma lon par bcom ldan 'das la blta ba'i phyir 'gro'o snyam mo/ /de nas sngon ne tsor gyur pa7lha'i bu rna cha gdub kor dag cing 'gul ba thogs pa/ lus do shal dang se mo dos brgyan pa/ nor bu rin po che sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa'i cod pan can (bye lus gur gum tunyedang ta ma la'i lo ma dang spro4)ka la sogs pas byugs pa des/ de nyid kyi mtshan mo lha'i me tog ud pa la dang / pad ma dang / ku5)mu da dang / pad ma dkar po dang / man 'okher mirnams kyis thu ba bkang ste/ rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal thams cad 'od chen pos snang bar byas nas/ bcom ldan 'das la me tog gis gtor te chos mnyanam pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tu sngon ne tsor gyur pa'i lha'i bu'i (nyabasam pa dang bag la nyal dang khams dang rang bzhin thugs su chud nas 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi rtogs par 'gyur ba de lta bu'i chos bstan te/ de thos nas sngon ne tsor5)gyur pa'i lha'i 75—366

bus 'jig tshogs la lta7ba'i ri'i rtse mo mthon po nyi shu ye shes rdo rjes bcom nas rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu thob ste/ des bden pa mthong nas/ dga' ba'i tshig lan gsum brjod de②/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag gi khrag dang mchi ma'i rgya mtsho bskams pa dang / rus pa'i la7bsgral ba dang / ngan song gi sgo rnams bcad pa dang / mtho risasredang thar pa'i sgo rnams phye ba dang /bdag lha dang mi rnams kyi nang du bzhag pa 'di lta bu ni bdag la pas kyang ma bgyis/ mas kyang ma bgyis/ rgyal pos kyang ma bgyis/ lha rnams kyis kyang ma bgyis/ nang mi dang gnyen gyi tshogs rnams kyis kyang ma bgyis/⑤ sngon gyi mtshun rnams kyis kyang ma bgyis/ dge sbyong dang bram ze rnams kyis kyang ma bgyis lags so/ /yang smras pa/ nyes pa mang por ldan pa'i ngan song lam/ /shin tu mi bzad khyod kyis mthu yis ⑦bcad/ /bsod nams rab ldan mtho ris 'gro ba phye/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i lam yang bdag gis thob/ /bdag gis de ring nyes pa spangs pa'i mig /shin tu rnamasnyidag khyod las brten7nas thob/ /bdag ni sdug bsngal rgya mtsho pha rol rga'akho/ /'phags pa dgyes pa71zhi ba'i go 'phang thob/ /mi mchog dbang po mi dang lhas mchod pa/ /skye dang rga dang 'chi ba'i nad spangs pa/ /srid pa stong du mthong bar dka' ba 4)/ /thub pa khyod ni deng mthong 'bras bu yod/ /de nas do shal 'phyang ba dga' gyur te / /btud cing zhabs gnyis la ni phyag 'tshal5nyenas/ /dgra thub la ni bskor ba byas nas kyang / /lha yi 'jig rten kha bltas 8lha yul song / /de nas sngon ne tsor gyur pa'i lha'i bu de tshong pa khe spogs phyin pa dang / zhing pa 'bru rgyal bar gyur pa dang / dpa' bo g.yul las rgyal ba dang / nad pa nad thams 75—367

cad las thar ba bzhin du 'byor pa gang gis/ bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du 'ongs pa'i 'byor pa de nyid kyis rang gi gnas su song ngo / /dge slong dag ni srod dang tho ras mi7nyal bar brtson pa lhur byed pa la gnas te/ de dag gis bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du snang ba chen po byung ba mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang the tshom7skyes te the tshom thams cad gcod pashesangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ mdang sum mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pa'am/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin nam 'jig rten skyong ba bzhi bcom ldan 'das la blta〈geba'i slad du mchis lags sam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pa'am lha'i dbang po brgya byin nam 'jig rten skyong ba bzhi nga la blta ba'i phyir 'ongs pa ma yin no/ /ne tso gang gis nga nags khrod der nub mo'i dgongs mal la spyan drangs pa de khyodakyikyis5nyamathong ngam/ dge slong rnams kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das mthong lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa⑦/ dge slong dag ne tso de nyid shi nas sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha yul bzang por skyes pa de7yin no/ /dge slong rnams kyis gsol pa/ btsun pa sngon ne tsor gyur pa'i lha'i7bus las gang dag bgyis na/ des ne tsor skyes lags(kye / las gang dag bgyis na des lha'i nang du skyes te bden palatemathong bar gyur lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sngon ne tsor gyur pa'i lha'i bus tshogs rnyed cing rkyen grub pa dang ldan te/ dba' rgal bzhin du byung5)la gdon mi za5)bar 'ong ba'i las de dag byas shing bsags pas na/ sngon ne tsor gyur pa'i lha'i bus las byas shing bsags pa de dag gzhan su zhig gis nyams su myong bar 'gyur te/ dge slong 75—368

dag las byas shing bsags pa rnams ni phyi rol gyi sa'i khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur/ chu'i khams dang / me'i ①khams dang ②/ rlung gi khams la rnam par〈smin par mi 'gyur te/ las dge ba dang mi dge ba byas shing bsags pa rnams ni/ zin pa'i phung po dang khams dang skye mched rnams 'ba' zhig la rnam par smin par 'gyur ro/ /lus can dag gisnyilas rnams ni/ /bskal pa brgyar yang chud mi za/ /tshogs shing dus la bab pa na/ /'bras bu nyid du smin par 'gyur/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na/bskal pa bzang po 'di nyid la skye dgu'i tshe lo nyi khri thub pa na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa skyes bu gdula'ad)bya'i kha lo sgyur ba/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'od srung4)zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung ste/ de grong khyer bā rā ṇa r+sāshen rten cing bzhugs so/ /de nas re zhig na de napo)dge bsnyen cig 'dug pa des bslab pa stod par byas te las de'i rnam par smin pas ni ne tsor skyes so/ /nga la sems dga' bar byas pa des ni lhar skyes so/ /des bslab pa'i gzhi lhag ma rnams bsrungs pa des ni bden pa mthong bar gyur〈1to/ /dge slong dag de ltar na las (nyegacig tu nges par gnag pa rnams ni rnam par smin pa yang gcig tu nges par gnag par 'gyur ro/ /las gcig tu nges par dkar ba rnams ni rnam par srin pa yang gcig tu nges par dkar bar 'gyur ro//las 'dren ma rnams ni rnam par smin pa yang 'dren mar 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag de bas na las gcig tu nges par gnag pa rnams dang las 'dren 9/nyem 75—369

rnams spangs la las gcig tu nges par dkar ba rnams 'ba' zhig la gtad par bya ste/ dge slong dag khyodashekyis de ltar bslab par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ dge slong de dag yikhurangs te bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bston⑧do// //pho nya zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po rnams dang /blon po chen po rnams dang phyug po rnams dang / pho brang 'khor gyi mi rnams dang /tshong dpon rnams dang / ded dpon rnams dang / lha rnams dang / klu rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams dang / lha ma yin rnams dang / nam mkha' lding rnams dang / mi 'am ci rnams dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis bkur ste byas/ bla mar byas/ ri mor byas/ mchod pa0byas te/ lha dang klu dang ske/ gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis mchod cing shes pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bsod nams chen po dang ldan pa/ na bza' dang / zhal zas dang ske/ gzims cha dang / gdan dang / snyun gsos dang / sman zong rnams brnyes pa/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa rgyal po'i khab na 'od ma'i tshal bya ka lan da ka gnas par dbyar gnas par dam dubacas so de nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal ga la ba der song ste phyin nas rgyal po la rgyal bar gyur cig /sku tshe ring bar shog shig ces bstodakyinas gsol ba btab pa/ lha mkhyen par mdzad du gsol/ bdag gis bcom ldan 'das yun ring mo zhig tu ma mthong stenya/ bdag ni bcom ldan 'das mthong bar 'tshal bas skom lags so/ /bdag ni bcom ldan 'das 75—370

mthong bar 'tshal lo zhes byas so/ /de nas rgyal pos khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin la smras pa/ khyim bdag bcom ldan 'das detud ltar gang du dbyar gnas par7bzhed pa khyod kyis ci thos/ mgon med zas sbyin gyis smras pa/lha bdag gis7bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab tu dbyar gnas par dam bzhes so zhes thos lags so/ /de nas kosas la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal dang / khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin dul sogs pa pho brang 'khor gyi mi dang yul mi dang dublon po rnams kyis mi zhig pho nyar bkug stekhya/ kye mi khyod tshur shog /bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song la/ der phyin nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tsholashel/ bdag cag gi mchid nas/ bcom ldan 'das gnod pa chung ngam/ nyam nga ba nyung ngam/ bskyod pa yang ngam 'tsho 'am/stobs dang ldan nam/ bde ba dang ldan nam/ mi bde ba mi mnga' 'am/bde ba la reg par gnas sam zhes gsol la/ 'di skad du btsun pa ko sa la'i rgyal po dang mnyan du yod pa na gnas pa pho brang 'khor gyi mi rnams bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal mthong bar 'tshal te/ bdag cag gis bcom ldan 'das yun ring mo zhig tu ma mthong bas/ bdag cag ni bcom ldan 'das mthong bar 'tshal bas skom lags so/ /bdag cag ni bcom ldan 'das mthong bar 'tshal na thugs brtserwateba'i slad du/ bcom ldan 'das mnyan du yod par gshegs su gsol zhes mchi'o zhes gsol cig ces bsgo'o/ /de nas mi des ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal dang / blon po dang / pho brang 'khor kyi mi dang / yul mi rnams kyis bsgo ba bzhin du mnyan te/ rgyal po'i khab tu song nas/ mthar gyis song song ba las rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer du phyin to/ /de nas rgyal po'i 75—371

khab kyi grong khyer thams cad du bltas nas bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshalanyete/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa mkhyen par mdzad du gsol/ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal dang mnyan du yod pa na gnas pa'i pho brang 'khor kyi mi rnams bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal7te/ bcom ldan 'das gnod pa chungakhungam/ nyam nga ba nyungasnyingam/ bskyod pa yang ngam/'tsho'am / stobs dang ldan nam/ bde ba dang ldan nam/ mi bde ba mi mnga' 'am/ bde ba la reg par gnas sam zhes mchi'o/ /'di skad du bdag cag gis bcom ldan 'das ring mo zhig tu ma mthong ste/ bdag cag ni bcom ldan 'das mthong bar 'tshal bas skom lags so/ /bdag cag ni bcom ldan 'das mthong bar 'tshal na/ thugs brtse ba'i slad du bcom ldan 'das mnyan du yod par gshegs su gsol zhes kyang mchi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kye gal te nga rgyal po gzugs can snying pos 'gror ster na 'gro bar bya'o/ /de nas pho nya des rgyal po gzugs can snying po la gsol nas/bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gshegs par rgyal po gzugs can snying pos dad pa stsal lags na/ bcom ldan 'das kyis da de'i dus la bab par dgongs te gshegs su gsol zhes bskul to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis mi de la cang mi gsung bas gnang ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das dbyar zla gsum 'dasalgenas/ chos gos mdzad de chos gos zin nas chos gos gsol te/ lhung bzed bsnams nas zhabs 'bring 'khor mang po dag dang mnyan du yod pa7logs su chas te gshegs so/ /pho nya yang shing rta 75—372

la zhon te chas so/ /de nas des sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das zhabs kyis gshegs pa mthong nas shing rta las babs te/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de tilogs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to / /thugs brtse ba'i slad du bdag gi shing rta bcom ldan 'das kyis bzhes su gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rdzu 'phrul rkang pa'i shing rta dang ske/ /yang dag stsol la ngatshanaciganas nas / /nyon mongs tsheram3)mas ma snad par / /sa steng kun tu rgyu bar byed/ /pho nyas gsol 5pa/ bcom ldan 'das ni rdzu 'phrul gyi zhabs kyis gshegs pa lags kyis kyang / bdag la phan gdags pa dang thugs brtse ba'i slad du bcibs su gsol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das pho nya la phan gdags pa'i phyir rdzu 'phrul gyis shing rta'i steng du bzhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das shing rta la bcibs bzhin du mnyan du yod par byon nas pho nyas kyang rgyal po la sbran to/ /de nas rgyal po dang / blon po dang / pho brang 'khor gyi mi dang / yul mi rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das bsu nas/ chos nyanam kyipa'i phyir de'i mtshan mo rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal de nyid du 'khod do / /pho nya de ni tshe thung ste chos thos pa'i 'og tu de nyid kyi mtshan mo shi ste/ de shi nas sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha yul bzang por skyes so/ /lha'i bu'am lha'i bu mo skyes nas ring po ma lon pa ni chos nyid kyis sems rnam pa gsum skye bar 'gyur te/gang nas shi 'phos/ gang du skyes/ las gang gis skyes snyam mo/ /de nas mi las shi 'phos pa dang / sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha yul bzang por skyes pa dang /bcom ldan 'das la sems dga' bar gyur pa des mthong ngo / /de nas sngon pho nyar gyur pa'i lha'i bu de 'di snyam du sems te bdag zhag lon nas gzod 875—373

bcom ldan 'das la blta ba'i phyir 'gro ba ni bdag gi ⑨cha ma yin gyis②/bdag zhag ma lon par bcom ldan 'das la bltakhuba'i phyir 'gro'o snyam mo/ /de nas sngon pho nyar gyur pa'i lha'i bu rna cha gdub kor dag cing 'gul ba thogs pa/ lus do shal dang se mo dos brgyan pa/ nor bu rin po che sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa'i cod pan can/ lus gur gum dang ta ma la'i lo ma dang spro ka la sogs pas byugs pa/ des de nyid kyi mtshan mo lha'i me tog ud pa la dang /ku mu da dang / pad ma dang pad ma dkar po dang / man dā rashernams kyis thu ba bkang stege/ rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal thams cad 'od chen pos snang bar byas nas/ bcom ldan 'das la me tog gis gtor te chos mnyan pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis sngon pho nyar gyur pa'i lha'i bu'ishebasam pa dang / bag la nyal dang / khams dang /rang bzhin thugs su chud nas/ 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi rtogs par 'gyur ba de lta bu'i chos ⑩bstan te/ de thos nas sngon pho nyar gyur pa'i lha'i bus 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo mthon po nyi shu ye shes rdo rjes bcom nas rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu thob ste/ des bden pa mthong nas dga' ba'i tshig lan gsum du〈nyebarjod de/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag gi khrag dang /mchi ma'i rgya mtsho bskams pa dang / rus pa'i la〈nyebasgral ba dang / ngan song gi sgo rnams bcad pa dang / mtho ris dang thar pa'i sgo rnams phye ba dang bdag lha dang mi rnams kyi nang du bzhag pa 'di lta bu ni bdag la phas kyang ma bgyis/mas kyang ma bgyis/ rgyal pos kyang ma bgyis/ lha rnams kyis kyang ma bgyis/nang mi dang gnyenatshwanyegyi tshogs rnams7kyis kyang ma bgyis/ sngon gyi mtshun 75—374

rnams kyis kyang ma bgyis/ dge sbyong dang bram ze rnams kyis kyang ma bgyis lags so/ /yang smras pa/ nyes pa mang por ldan pa'i ngan song lam/ /shin tu mi bzad khyod kyi mthu yis bcad/ /bsod nams rab ldan mtho ris 'gro ba phye/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i lam yang bdag gis thob/ /bdag gis de ring nyes pa spangs pa'i mig /shin tu rnam dag khyod las brtenatunas thob/ /bdag ni sdug⑧bsngal rgya mtsho'i⑧pa rol rga'akho/ /'phags pa dgyes pa'i zhi ba'i go 'phang thob/ /mi mchog dbang po mi dang lhas mchod pa/ /skye dang rga dang 'chi ba'i nad spangs pa/ /srid pa stong du mthong bar dka' ba yi/ /thub pa khyod ni deng mthong 'bras bu yod/ /de nas do shal 'phyang ba dga' gyur te/ /btud cing zhabs gnyis la ni phyag 'tshalashenas/ /dgra thub la ni bskor ba byas nas kyang / / lha yisnyi'ajig rten kha bltas7lha yul song / /de nas sngon pho nyar gyur pa'i lha'i bu de tshong pa khe spogs phyin pa dang / zhing pa 'bru rgyal bar gyur pa dang / dpa' bo g.yul las rgyal ba dang / nad pa nad thams cad las thar ba bzhin du 'byor pa gang gis/ bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du 'ongs pa'i 'byor pa de nyid kyis rang gi gnas su song ngo / /de nas ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal khang bzangs kyi steng na 'dug pas snang ba chen po de mthong nas nam langasarwaskrepa dang bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags mdang sum mi mjed〈nyekyi bdag po tshangs pa'am/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin nam/ 'jig rten skyong ba bzhi bcom ldan 'das la blta 3)ba'i slad du mchis lags sam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rgyal po chen po mi mjed7kyi bdag po tshangs pa'am/ lha'i dbang po brgya〈nyebyin nam/ 'jig 75—375

rten skyong ba bzhi nga la blta ba'i phyir 'ongs pa ma yin gyis①/ khyod kyi pho nya de nga la sems dga' bar gyur nas shi ste7sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha yul bzang por skyes nas de mdang sum nga'i thad du 'ongs te/ ngas de la chos bstan tekhubaden pa mthong bar gyur te rang gi gnas su song ngo / /de nas rgyal po de ngo mtshar du gyur nas kye ma sangs rgyas kye ma chos kye ma dge 'dun 'di dag la ni chung ngu zhig byas7kyang rnam par smin pa chen por 'gyur ro zhes smras so/ /de nas ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod cing rjes su yi rangs tedu/ bcom ldan 'das kyikhuzhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshalasnyenas/ stan las langs te song ngo / /der bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag 'di gsum ni mchog tu gdags pa yin te/ gsum gang zhe na/ sangs rgyas mchog tu gdags pa dang /chos mchog tu gdags pa dang / dge 'dun mchog tu gdags pa'o/ /sangs rgyas mchog tu gdags pa gang zhe na/ sems can rkang med rnams sam/ rkang gnyis rnams sam/ rkang bzhi rnams sam/ rkang mangs7rnams sam/gzugs can rnams sam/ gzugs can ma yin pa rnams sam/ 'du shes can rnams sam/ 'du shes can ma yin pa rnams sam/ 'du shes yod pa yang ma yin 'du shes med pa yang ma yin pa gang yang rung ste/ de dag gi nang na ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mchog yin par bstan to/ /sangs rgyas la mngon par dga' ba su yang rung ba de dag ni mchog la mngon par dga' ba yin te/ mchog la mngon par dga' ba de dag ni (ternam par smin pa yang lha rnams kyi nang du lhar gyur pa rnams sam/75—376

mi rnams kyi nang du mir gyur pa rnams kyi mchog 'ba' zhig tu 'gyur b.rasheshes par bya ste/ 'di ni sangs rgyas mchog tu gdags pa zhes bya'o(ge/ /chos mchog tu gdags pa gang zhe na/ 'dus byas sam 'dus ma byas kyisachos rnams gang yang rung ste/ de dag gi nang na ni 'dod chags dang bral ba'i chos mchog yin par ston to/ /chos la mngon par dga' ba su yang rung ba de dag ni mchog la mngon par dga' ba yin te/ mchog la mngon par dga' ba de dag gi⑧rnam par min pa yang lha rnams kyi nang du lhar gyur pa rnams sam mi rnams kyi nang du mir gyur pa rnams kyi mchog 'ba' zhig tu 'gyur bar shes par bya ste/ 'di ni chos mchog tu gdags pa7zhes bya'o/ /dge 'dun mchog tu gdags pa gang zhe na tshogs sam/ 'dus pa'am/ mang po'am/ 'khor gang yang rung ste/ de dag gi nang na ni de bzhin gshegasalgepa'i nyan thos kyi dge 'dunashemachog yin par bstan te⑩/ dge 'dun la mngon par dga' ba su yang rung ba de dag ni mchog la mngon par dga' ba yin te/ mchog la mngon par dga' ba de dag gi ni〈ternam par smin pa yang lha rnams kyi nang du lhar gyur pa rnams sam/ mi rnams kyi nang du mir gyur pa rnams kyi (snyemachog 'ba' zhig tu 'gyur bar (2shes par bya ste/ 'di ni dge 'dun mchog tu gdags pa zhes bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas dge slong de dag yisarangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// // gang po la sogs pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa brgya pa/3ge bam po bcu bzhi pa/ma he zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po rnams dang /blon po chen po rnams dang / phyug7po rnams dang / pho brang 'khor gyi mi 75—377

rnams dang / tshongatudapon rnams dang / ded dpon rnams dang sa lha rnams dang / klu rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams dang / lha ma yin rnams dang / nam mkha' lding rnams dang / mi 'am ci rnams dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis bkur ste byas/ bla mar byas/ ri mor byas/ mchod pa ①byas te/ lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis mchod cing shes pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bsod nams chen po dang ldan pa/ na bza' dang /zhal zas dang / gzims cha dang / gdan dang / snyun gsos dang / sman zong rnams brnyes pa/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa/ ko sa la'i ljongs rgyu zhing gshegs pa las nags khrod cig tu byon pa dngasnyi/ nags khrod de na ma he'i52gyu chen po dang ma he rdzi lnga brgya 'khod do/ /de nas re zhig na de'i nang na ma he stobs dang ldan zhing stobs kyi mchog dang ldan pa zhig yod de/de mi gzhan dag gi dri tshor na phyi bzhin rgyug par byed do/ /bcom ldan 'das kyang phyogs der gshegs so/ /de nas ma hesherdzi rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa thag ring po zhig nas mthong ngo / /de nas de dag gis skad cherasnyibos te/ bcom ldan 'das 'di na ma he ma rungs pa mchis kyisal/ shul 'dir mi gshegs su gsol zhes byas so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kye ngas 'dir 7dus la bab par shes kyis khyed (nyesnying ma chung shig /de nas ma he des bcom ldan 'das thag ring mo7zhig nas mthong ba dang rnga ma ldang du gzar nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der brgyugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi mdun logs su seng ge ral pa can 75—378

ral pa g.yengs pa lnga sprul te①/ glo g.yas g.yon du mi'uchen po lnga sprul to/ /steng du ni lcags kyi pha bongasachen po zhig sprul to/ /de nas ma he des phyogs kun tu 'jigs pa chen po mthong nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs drung du song ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyi0zhabs la lces bldags nas5gezhum pa'i bzhin gyis bcom ldan 'das la bltas so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de la/ des brda duphrad pa'i skad du bzhin bzangs ⑦'di ltar 'du byed thams cad ni ⑧mi rtag pa'o/ /chos thams cad ni bdag med pa'o/ /mya ngan las 'das pa ni zhi ba'oshezhes chos tshig gsum bstan nas/ tshe rabs kyang dran par mdzad de de〈nyethos nas ngus so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe tshigs su bcad de bka' stsal pa8/ khyod ni dud 'gror skyes pa la/ /da ni nga〈nyeyis ci byar yod/ /mi khom par ni skyes zin gyisaspu/ /don med ngus pas ci la phan/ /'dir ni rgyal ba snying rje can/ /nga la dad pa'i sems bskyed5gel/ /dud 'gro'i skye gnas spangs na legs/ /'on kyang mtho7ris 'gro bar 'gyur/ /de nas ma he ma rungs pa des rang gi lus〈nyel dmad7de kha 'tshos nas/ dud 'gro'i skye gnas su skyes pa'i srog chags 6)rnams ni me'i drod che bas de skyen ( )par shi ste/sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha yul bzang por skyes so/ /lha'i bu'am lha'i bu mo skyes nas ring po ma lon pa ni chos nyid kyis sems rnam pa gsum skye bar 'gyur te/gang nas shi 'phos tegang du skyes/ las gang gis skyes snyam mo/ /de nas dud 'gro las shi 'phos nyepa dang sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha yul bzang por skyes pa dang bcom ldan 'das la sems dga' bar gyur pa des mthong ngo / /de nas sngon ma hor gyur pa'i lha'i bu deke 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag zhag lon nas gzod ste75—379

bcom ldan 'das la blta ba'i phyir 'gro ba ni bdag gi cha ma yin gyis②/bdag zhag ma lon par bcom ldan 'das la blta ba'i phyir 'gro'o snyam mos/ /de nas sngon ma hor gyur pa'i lha'i bu rna cha gdub kor dag cing 'gulasab thogs pa / lus do shal dang se mo dos brgyan pa/ nor bu rin po che sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa'i cod pan can lus gur gum5gedang / ta ma la'i lo ma dang / sprosaka la sogs pas byugs pa ⑥des de nyid kyi 9)mtshan mo lha'i me tog ud pa la dang ske/ pad ma dang / ku mu da dang / pad ma dkar po dang / man dā ra bsnyernams kyis thu ba bkang ste/ nags khrod de dag thams cad 'od chen pos〈snang bar byas nas bcom ldan 'das la me tog gis〈 )gtor te/ chos mnyan pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis sngon ma hor gyur pa'i lha'i bu'i bsam pa dang bag la nyal dang khams dang rang bzhin thugs su chud nas/ 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi rtogs par 'gyur ba de lta bu'i chos bstan te/ de thos nas sngon ma hor gyur pa'i lha'i bus 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo mthon po nyi shu ye shes rdo rjes bcom nas rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu thob ste/ des bden pa mthong nas dga' ba'i tshig lan gsum du brjod de/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag gi khrag dang mchi ma'i rgya mtsho bskams pa dang / rus pa'i lamanyabasgral ba dang / ngan song gi sgo rnams bcad pa dang / mtho ris dang thar pa'i sgo rnams phye ba dang / bdag lha dang mi rnams kyi nang du bzhag tsho pa 'di lta bu ni bdag la phas kyang ma bgyis/mas kyang ma bgyis/rte/ rgyal pos kyang ma bgyis/ lha rnams kyis kyang ma bgyis/nang mi dang gnyen gyi tshogs rnams kyis kyang ma bgyis sngon gyi mtshun rnams kyis 75—380

kyang ma bgyis/ dge sbyong dang bram ze rnams kyis kyang ma bgyis lags so/ /yang smras pa/ nyes pa mang por ldan pa'i ngan song lam/ /shin tu mi bzadatukhyod kyi mthu yis bcad/ /bsod nams rab ldan mtho ris 'gro ba phye/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i lam yang bdagashegis thob/ /bdag gis de ring nyes pa spangs pa'i mig /shin tu rnam dag khyod lasaphubarten nas thob/ /bdag ni sdug bsngal rgya mtshokhupha rol rga'aji/ /'phags pa dgyes pa7zhi ba'i go 'phang thob /mi mchog dbang po mi dang lhas mchod pa/ /skye dang rga dang 'chi ba'i nad spangs pa/ /srid pa stong du mthong bar dka' ba yi/ /thub pa khyod ni deng ⑦mthong 'bras bu yod/ /de nas do shal 'phyang ba dga' gyur7te/ khatud cing zhabs gnyis la ni phyag 'tshal nas/ /dgra thub la ni bskor ba byas na~X kyang / / lha yishe'ajig rten kha bltas lha yul song / /de nas sngon ma hor gyur pa'i lha'i bu de tshong pa khe spogs phyin pa dang zhing pa 'bru rgyal bar gyur pa dang dpa' bo g.yul las rgyal ba dang nad pa nad thams cad las thar ba bzhin du 'byor pa gang gis bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du 'ongs pa'i 'byor pa de nyid kyis rang gi gnas su song ngo / /de nas ma he rdzi de dag gis snang ba chen po de mthong ngo / /de mthong nas the tshom7skyes te the tshom thams cad gcod pa〈nyesangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ bcom ldan 'das mdang sum bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du mchis te/ lha'i 'od kyis snang bar bgyis5nyepa de su zhig lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ khyod7kyi ma he de nga la sems dga' bar gyur te shi nas sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha yul bzang por skyes te⑩/ de mdang sum nga'i thad du 'ongs nas ngas de la chos bstan te/ bden pa mthong bar gyur 75—381

nas rang gi gnas su song ngo / /de nas ma hetuji de dag⑧mchog tu ya mtshan du gyur te ngo mtshar to/ /dud 'gro'i skye gnas su skyes pa 'di yang dge ba'i bshes gnyen bcom ldan 'das dang phrad nas lha'i nang du skyes te/ bden pa mthong bar gyur na bdagashecag gis ci ste khyad par thob par mi 'gyur snyam mo/ /de nas de dag gis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa zhal zas bzang pos tshim par byas nas bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du rab tu byung ste/ de dag gis brtson pa dang bsgrub pa dang 'bad pas nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs nas dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas so/ /de nas dge slong dag the tshom ༷skyes te the tshom ⑤thams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'dasapo)la zhus pa/ btsun pa sngon ma hor gyur pa'i lha'i bus lasalgegang dag bgyis na des ma ter skyes lags las gang dag bgyis na des lha'i nang du skyes te bden pa mthong bar gyur lags/ ma tekhudzi 'di〈rnams kyis ni las ci bgyis na des ma he rdzir gyur lags/ las gang bgyis pas ni rab tu byung nas dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du bgyis lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag 'di dag nyid kyis sngon tshe rabs gzhan dag tu tshogs rnyed cing rkyen grub pa dang ldan te/ dba' rgal bzhin du byung la gdon mi za bar 'ongs pa'i〈nyalas de dag byas shing bsagasalgepas na/ de dag nyid kyis yonyelas byas shing bsagasatshwanyepa de dag gzhan su zhig gis nyams su myong bar 'gyur te/ dge slong dag las byas shing bsags pa rnams ni/ phyi rol gyi sa'i khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur/ chu'i khams dang / me'i khams dang ske/ rlung gi khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur te/ las dge ba dang mi 75—382

dge ba byas shing bsags pa rnams ni/ zin pa'i phung po dang khams dang skye mched rnams 'ba' zhig la rnam par smin par 'gyur ro/ /lus can dag gitulas rnams7ni/ /bskal pa brgyar yang chud mi za/ /tshogs shing dus la bab pa na/ /'bras bu nyid du smin par 'gyur/ /dge slong dag7sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na/ bskal pa bzang po 'di nyid la skye dgu'i tshe lo nyi khri thub pa na / de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/skyes bu gdul bya'i kha lo sgyur ba/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'od srung zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung ste/ de grong khyer bā rā ṇa 5snyen drang srong smra ba ri dgas kyi nagasalgen rten cing bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe dge slong dag gtan la 'bebs par byed pa na/ dge slong sde snod gsum pa zhig 'khor lnga brgya dang gtan la 'bebs pa'i nang na 'dug go/ /de'i nang na slob pa dang mi slob pa'i dge slong dag kyang yod de/ de dgashesde snod gsum pa la 'dri bar byed la/ des7ni lan ma thebs pa dang / de khros nas ngag gi las rtsub po phyung ste/ nags kyi ma he dang 'dra ba 'di dag ci shes zhes byas jo9/ /de'i slob ma rnams kyis kyang ma he rdzi dang 'dra ba 'di dag ci shes zhes smras so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ dge slong sde snod gsum pa gang yin pa de nyid ma te 'di yin no/ /slob ma de dag ni ma he rdzi 'di dag yin te/ las des na tshe rabs lnga brgyar ma hor skyes so/ /slob ma rnams kyang ma he rdzi lnga brgyar gyur to/ /nga la sems dga' bar gyur pa des ni ⑩lhar skyes so/ /dge slong gi dngos po thob ste 75—383

tshul khrims bsrungs pas ①ni bden pa mthong ba dang dgra bcom ②nyid mngon sum du byas so/ /dge slong dag de bas na ngag gi nyes pa spang ba'irnyuphyir 'bad par bya ste/ ci nas ma he dang ma he rdzi rnams kyi nyes pa de lta bu dgakyi'abyung bar mi 'gyur ba dang / lha'i bu de'i yon tan gyi tshogs de lta bu thob par 'gyur b.rasnyedage slong khyoda'adzi )kyis de ltar bslab par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ dge slong de dag yi rangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs rin pa la mngon par bstod do// // bsnyen gnas zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po rnams dang ske/ blon po chen po rnams dang / phyug po rnams dang / pho brang 'khor gyi mi rnams dngas 9)/ tshong dpon rnams dang / ded dpon rnams dang / lha rnams dang / klu rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams dang / lha ma yin rnams dang ske/ nam mkha' lding rnams dang / mi 'am ci rnams dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis bkur sti byas/ bla mar byas/ ri mor byas/ mchod pa byas tehunya / lha dang / klu nyurtedang / gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha'aphanyesding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phyetshwanyechen po rnams kyis mchod cing shes pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan ge'adas bsod nams chen po dang ldan pa/ na bza' dang / zhal zas dang / gzims chacadang / gdan dang / snyan gsos dang / sman zong rnams brnyes pa/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa mnyan du yod pa na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal khyim bdagalanamagon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha'i nang na lha'i bu bsnyen gnas zhes bya ba zhig yod de/ de chos mnyan stepa'i phyir rtag tu 75—384

bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du 'gro'o/ /de nas phyis re zhig na lha'i bu bsnyen gnas g.yog 'khoranyelnga brgya dang bcas pa/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshalasate/ chos mnyan⑧pa'i phyir phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis lha'i bu bsnyen gnas kyi bsam pa dang / bag la nyal551dang / khams dang /rang bzhin thugs su chud nas 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi rtogs par 'gyur ba de lta bu'i chos bstan te/ de thos nas lha'i bu bsnyen gnas kyis56)'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo mthon po nyi shu ye shes rdo rjes bcom nas rgyun (7)du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu thob ste/ des bden pa mthong nas dga' ba'i tshig lan gsum dus brjod de/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag gi khrag dang mchi7)ma'i rgya mtsho bskams pa dang / rus pa'i la bsgral ba dang / ngan song gi sgo rnams bcad pa dang / mtho ris dang thar pa'i sgo rnams phye ba dang / bdag lha dang mi rnams kyi7nang du bzhag pa 'di lta bu ni bdag la pas kyang ma bgyis/ mas kyang ma bgyis/ rgyal pos kyang ma bgyis/ lha rnams kyis kyang ma bgyis/nang mi dang gnyen gyi tshogs rnams kyis kyang ma bgyis/ sngon gyi mtshun rnams kyis kyang ma bgyis/ dge sbyong dang bram ze rnams kyis kyang ma bgyis lags so/ /yang smras pa/ nyes pa mang por ldan pa'i ngan song lam/ /shin tu mi bzad khyod kyi mthu yis bcad/ /bsod nams rab ldan mtho ris 'gro ba phye/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i lam yang bdag gis thob/ /bdag gis de ring nyes pa spangs pa'i mig /shin tu rnam dag khyod las /rmibarten nas thob/ /bdag ni sdug bsngal rgya mtsho pha rol rgalarnye/ /'phags pa dgyes pa nyu zhi ba'i go 'phang thob/ /75—385

mi mchog dbang po mi dang lhas mchod pa/ /skye dang rga dang 'chi ba'i nad spangs pa / /srid pa stong du mthong bar dka' ba yi/ /thub pa khyod ni deng mthong 'bras bu7yod/ /de nas do shal 'phyang ba dga' gyurashete/ /btud cing zhabs gnyis la ni phyag 'tshalashenas/ /dgra thub la ni bskor ba byas nas kyang // lha yi0'jig rten kha bltas lha'uyul song / /de nas lha'i bu7bsnyen gnas tshong pa khe spogs phyin pa dang zhing pa 'bru rgyal bar gyur pa dang / dpa' bo g.yul las rgyal ba dang / nad pa nad thams cad las thar ba bzhin du 'byor pa gang gis bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du 'ongs pa'i 'byor pa de nyid kyis rang gi gnas su song ngo / /de'i tshe dge slong dag srod dang tho ras7mi nyal bar brtson pa nilhur byed pa ⑨la gnas te ⑩de dag gis bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du snang ba chen po byung ba mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang the com skyes te the tsom thams cad gcod pa71ri/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags / mdang sum mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pa'am lha'i dbang po brgya byin nam 'jig rten skyong ba bzhi bcom ldan 'das la blta ba'i slad du mchis lags sam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pa'am lha'i dbang po brgya byin nam 'jig rten skyong ba bzhi nga la blta7ba'i phyir 'ongs pa ma yin gyi/ lha'i bu bsnyen gnas g.yog 'khor lnga brgya dang bcas pa nga la blta ba'i phyir 'ongs te ngas de la chos bstan nas bden pa mthong bar gyur te/ rang gi gnas su song ngo / /de nas dge slong de dag the tsom skyes〈9te the tsom thams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa lha'i bu bsnyen gnas ga las byung lags/ ming ni ci 75—386

las btags lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag khyedatunyan par 'dod dam/ gsol pa/ btsun pa nyan par 'tshal lags so/ /bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag 'o na legs par rab tu nyon la yid la zungasheshig dngasangs bshad do/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na/bskal pa bzang po 'di nyid la skye dgu'i stim lo nyi khri thub pa na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu gdul bya'i kha lo sgyur ba/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'od srung zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung ste/ de grong khyer bā rā ṇa sri0na drang srong smra ba ri dgas kyi nags na rten cing bzhugs so/ /phyis re zhig na rgyal po kṛ bī57bcom ldan 'das la blta ba dang bsnyen bkur bya ba'i phyir song ngo / /de nas re zhig na bram ze gnyis drang srong smra b.rashedon zhig la song ba dang / de gnyis kyis rgyal po de rgyal po'i 'byor pa chen po dang rgyal po'i mthu stobs dang ldan pa mthong ngo / /de nas de gnyis rgyal srid la 'dod pa skyes nas/ de gnyis kyis dge bsnyen zhig la dris pa(1/ kye sangs rgyas kyi dge bsnyen las ci zhig byas na/ des ci bsams rtepa dang ci 'dod pa de dag thams cad 'grub par 'gyur zhes byas so/ /dge bsnyen gyis smras pa/gang gis bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad pa yongs su dag par bsrungs pa de'i ni ci bsams pa dang ci 'dod pa de dag thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro zhes byas so/ /de nas bram ze de gnyis kyis khyim bdag chu stod las bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad pa blangs te bsrungs so/ /de nasnyigacig gis ni yongs su dag par 75—387

bsrungs te/ de nas7shi nas rgyal po kṛ khri'ikhubur skyes te de'i bu'i⑧ming legs skyes zhes btags nas pha shi ba'i 'og tu de rgyal por bcug go/ /cig shos kyis ni bsnyen gnas nyams par byas te de ni shi nas klu'i nang du skyes tedu/de'i steng du nyin gcig bzhin du lan bdun bdun bye tshan bab ste des rus pa 'ba' zhig lus par byed do/ /de nas de 'di snyam du sems te/ 'di las gang gi⑧'bras bu yin/ 'di las gang gi5nya'abras bu7rnam par smin pa yin na/des bdag gisala'adi lta bu'i sdug bsngal myong zhing 'dug snyam mo/ /de nas des bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa/ bdag gis blangs pa las bslab pa lhod par byas pa des 'di lta bu'i sdug bsngal bdag gis nyams su myong la / gang gis blangs te bsrungs pa des ni7rgyal srid thob par gyur to snyam mo / /yang de 'di snyam du sems te(lha/ datshwa yang bdag gis bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa〈gebasrung bar bya'o/ /'on kyangasnyibadag klu'i skye gnas las thar bar 'gyur yang srid do snyam mo/ /de nas bram ze'i cha lugs su bdag nyid sprul nas/ rgyal po'i thad du 'ongs te phyin nas/ rgyal po la rgyal bar gyurarwanyecig /sku tshe ring bar shog cig ces bstod nas smras pa/ rgyal po chen po bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa bdag la 'tshal gyis (nyelha bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa stsal77du gsol/ gal te ma stsal te na gdon mi 'tshal bar lha'i dbu tshal pa bdun du 'gas par 'gyur ro zhes byas nas de nyid du mi snang bar gyur to/ /de nas rgyal po 'jigs shing skrag ste/ mi dga' la skyi bung zhes byas nas gser 'bum yod pa'i snod (nyergyal mtshan gyi rtse mo la btags te/ bdag gi yul thams cad du dril bsgrags nas/ su nga la bsnyen 75—388
