gnas yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa ston pa de la gser 'bum 'di sbyin no/ /bkur ste chen pos kyang bkur b.ranyebya'o zhes bsgo'o/ /de nas re zhig na shing mkhan gyi bu mo bud med rgan mo zhig 'dug pa des/ rgyal po la ka ba zhig bstan te/ sngon bdag gi pha rtag tu ka ba 'di la spos dang / bdug pa dang / me tog gis mchod pa bgyid na/ 'di phyung ste gzigs shigasaces byas so/ /de nas rgyal pos zham ringasab rnams la ka ba 'di phyungasnyishig ces bsgo'o')/ /de nas rgyal po'i zhabs 'bring7rnams kyis ka ba de phyung ba dang / de'i 'og nas bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa dang / dge bsnyen gyi bslab pa'i gzhi lnga dang byang chub kyi phyogs dang 'thun pa'i chos sum cu rtsa bdun gser gyi glegs bam la bris pa zhig rnyed do/ /de nas rgyal pos klu de la bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa zhig7bris te byin to0/ /drang srong smra ba nachaganas pa'i drang srong khri nyis stong gis kyang byang chub kyi phyogs dang 'thun pa'i chos sum cu rtsa bdun mngon sum du byas so/ /klu des kyang bsnyenarwa1gnas yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa bsrungs nas thang la phyung〈nyeste lus bor nas de〈nyekha 'tshos mite 'dug go/ /de nas desnyishi ste g.yog 'khor lnga brgya dang bcas te/ sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha yul bzang por skyes so/ /dge slong dag bsnyen gnas ni de las byung ste ming yang de las btags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/dge slong de dag yi0 1rangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// //ngang pa zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 3she'adas la rgyal po rnams dang ske/ blon po chen po rnams dang / phyug po rnams dang / pho brang 'khor gyi 75—389

mi rnams dang / tshong dpon rnams dang / ded dpon rnams dang / lha rnams dang / klu rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams dang / lha ma yin rnams dang ske/ nam mkha' lding rnams dang / mi 'am ci rnams dang / sto 'phye chen po rnams kyis bkur sti byas/ bla mar byas/ ri mor byas/ mchod pa byas te/ lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis mchod cing shes pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bsodatunams chen po dang ldan pa/ na bza' dang ske/ zhal zas dang / gzims cha dang / gdan dang / snyun gsos dang /sman zong rnams brnyes pa/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa mnyan du yod pa na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe mnyan du yod pa na ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal rgyal po byed de/ de'i ring la 'byor pa dang / rgyas pa dang / bde ba dang /lo legs pa dang / skye bo dang / mi mang pos gang ba dang / rtsodasnyepa dang /'thab pa zhi ba dang / 'khrug pa dang / nang 'khrug dang / chom rkunasadang /mu ge dang / nad rnams med pa dang / 'bras sā0lu dang / bu ram shing dang ske/ ba lang dang / ma he dang ldan par 'dug ste/ gnod pa med cing tsher ma dkrugs la bu gcig pa la bya ba bzhin du rgyal srid bskyangs0so/ /phyis re zhig na ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal bcom ldan 'das la blta ba dang bsnyen bkur7bya ba'i phyir rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal du song ba dang / pañcakhula'i rgyal pos / ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal la ngang pa lnga ⑧brgya skyes su bskur te/gang gi tshe rgyal po rgyal bu 0rgyal byed kyi tshal du song ba de'i tshe ngang pa lnga brgya po 75—390

de dag phul7lo/ /de nas rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis ngang pa de dag la mi 'jigasashon)pa byin te/ rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal de nyid du btangasanas/ gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das nyan thos chen po'i 'khor dang bcas pa bshos gsol zhing bzhugs pa de'i tshe/ ngang pa de dag bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du 'gro la/bcom ldan 'das dang nyan thos chen po de dag gis kyang de rnams la khyos ④ma byin te/ de dag gis zos nas tshim zhing mgu lapo)dbang po brtas7te 'khod do/ /gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das nang du yang dag 'jog lasashebazhengs nas/'khor bzhi po de dag la chos ston pa de'i tshe/ ngang pa de dag bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du dong ste chos nyan par byed do/ /de nas de dag tshe thung ste/ shi nas sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha yul bzangasapor skyes so/ /lha'i bu'am lha'i bu mo skyes nas ring po ma lon pa ni chos nyid kyis7sems rnam pa gsum skye b.ral )'gyur te/gang nas shi 'phos/ gang du skyes/ las gang gis skyes snyam mo/ /de nas ngang pa las shi 'phos pa dang sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha yul bzang por skyes parwamedang /bcom ldan 'das la sems dga' bar gyur pa de dag gis mthong ngo / /de nas sngon ngang par gyur pa'i lha'i bu rnams 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag cag zhag lon nas gzod tsobacom ldan 'das la blta ba'i phyir 'gro ba ni bdag cag tunyegi cha ma yin gyis8/ bdag cagasnyizhag ma lon par bcom ldan 'das la blta ba'i phyir 'gro'o snyam mo/ /de nas sngon ngang par gyur pa'i lha'i bu rna cha gdub kor dag cing 'gul ⑩ba thogs pa/ lus do shal dang se mo dos brgyan pa/nor bu rin po che sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa'i cod pan can/ lus gur gum hunyedang / ta ma la'i lo ma dang / spro ka la sogs pas byugs pa de dag gis de 75—391

nyid kyi mtshan mo lha'i me tog ud pa la dang / pad ma dang / ku mu da dang /pad ma dkar 71)po dang / man dra'i )ra rnams kyis ①thu ba bkang ste/ rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal thams cad 'od chen pos snang bar byas nas/ bcom ldan 'das la me togashegis gtor te57chos mnyan55)pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'khod do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis sngon ngang par gyur pa'i lha'i bu rnams kyi bsamadza pa dang bag la nyal5nyedang khams dang rang bzhin thugs su chud nas/ 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi rtogs par 'gyur ba de lta bu'i chos bstan te/ de thos nas sngon ngang par gyur pa'i lha'i bu rnams kyis/ 'jig tshogs la lta7ba'i ri'i rtse mo mthonatshwa )po nyi shu ye shes rdo rjes bcom nas rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu thob ste/ de dag gis bden pa mthong nas dga' ba'i tshig lan gsum du7)brjod de/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyisatshwanyebadag cag7)gi khrag dang mchi ma'i rgya mtsho bskams pa dang / rus pa'i la7bsgral ba dang /ngan song gi sgo rnams 49bcad pa dang / mtho ris dang thar pa'i sgo rnams phye ba dang/ bdag cag lha dang mi'i〈nyenang du bzhagarwanyepa 'di lta bus0ni bdag cag la phas kyang ṅge bgyis/ mas kyang ma bgyis/ rgyal pos kyang ma bgyis/ lha rnams kyis kyang ma bgyis/ nang mi dang gnyen gyi tshogs rnamasalge kyis kyang ma bgyis / sngon gyi mtshun rnams kyis kyang ma bgyis/ dge sbyong dang bram ze rnams kyis kyang ma bgyis lags so/ /yang smras pa/ nyes pa mang por ldan pa'i ngan song lam/ /shin tu mi bzad khyod kyi mthu yis bcad/ /bsod nams rab ldan mtho ris 'gro ba phye/ /mya ngan 'das lam bdag cag rnams kyis thob/ /bdag cag de ring nyes pa spangs pa'i mig /shin tu rnamadza medag 75—392

khyod las7brten nas thob/ /bdag cag sdug bsngal rgya mtsholomipha rol rga'akho/ /'phags pa dgyes pa'i zhi ba'i go 'phang thob/ /mi mchog dbang po lha dang mis mchod pa/ /skye dang rga dang 'chi ba'i nad spangs pa/ /srid pa stong du mthong bar dga'achab yi/ /thub pa khyod ni deng mthong 'bras bu yod/ /de nas do shal 'phyang rnams dga' gyur te/ /btud cing zhabs gnyis la ni phyag 'tshal menas/ /dgra thub la ni bskor ba byas nas kyang / / lha yi (nya'ajig rten kha bltas7lha yul song / /de nas sngon ngang par gyur pa'i lha'i bu rnams tshong pa khe spogs phyin pa dang zhing pa 'bru rgyal bar gyur pa dang dpa' bo g.yul las rgyal ba dang nad pa nad thams cad las thar ba bzhin du 'byor pa gang gis/bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du lhags pa'i 'byor pa de nyid kyis rang gi gnas su songarwanyengo / /de'i tshe dge slong srod dang tho ras7)mi nyal bar brtson pa lhur byed pa la gnas te/ de dag gis bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du snang ba chen po byung ba mthong ngo / /mthong bas〈nyekyang the tsom skyes te/ the tsom thams cad gcod parwa rmosangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ mdang sum mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pa'am/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin nam/'jig rten skyong ba bzhi bcom ldan 'das la blta ba'i slad du mchis lags sam/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pa'am/ lha'i dbang po brgyas3)byin nam/ 'jig rten skyong ba bzhi nga la bltarwa snaba'i phyir 'ongs pa ma yin no/ /dge slong dag ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis/ ngang pa lnga brgya 'dir btang ba khyod kyis mthong ngam/ btsun pa mthong lags so/ /bka' stsal pa/ de dag nga la sems dga' bar gyur te/75—393

shi nas sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha yul bzang7por skyes te/ de dag mdang sum nga'i thad du lhags nas de dag la ngas7chos bstan te bden pa mthong bar gyur nas rang gi ③gnas su dong ngo ④/ /de nas dge slong dag the tsom skyes te the tsom thams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa sngon ngang par gyur pa'i lha'i bu rnams kyis las gang dag bgyis na des ngang par skyes lags/ las gang dag bgyis na des lha'i nang du skyes te bden pa mthong lags / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag 'di dag nyid kyis sngon tshe rabs gzhan dag tu tshogs rnyed cing rkyen grub pa dang ldan te/dba' rgal bzhin du 'byung la gdon mi za bar 'ong ba'i las de dag byas shing bsags pas na/ sngon ngang par gyur pa'i lha'i bu rnams kyis las byas shing bsags pa de dag gzhan su zhig gis nyams su myong bar 'gyur te/ dge slong dag las byas shing bsags pa rnams ni phyi rol gyi sa'i khams la rnam0par smin par mi 'gyur/ chu'i khams dang / me'i khams dang / rlung gi khams la rnam par smin par mishe'agyur te/ las dge ba dang mi dge ba byas shing bsags pa rnams ni zin pa'i phung po dang khams dang skye mched rnams 'ba' zhig la rnam par smin par 'gyur ro/ /lus can dag gi ⑧las rnams ni/ /bskal pa brgyar yang chud mi za/ /tshogs shing dus la bab pa na/ /'bras bu nyid du smin par 'gyur/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na/ bskal pa bzang po 'di nyid la skyesnyidagu'i tshe lo nyi khri thub pa na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/bde bar gshegs pa 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu gdul5nyebya'i kha lo sgyur ba/75—394

bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'od srung zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung ste/ de grong khyer bā rā ṇa sri0)na drang srong smra ba ri dgas kyi nags na rten cing bzhugasasheso/ /de'i tshe 'di dag rab tu byung ba las bslab pa la lhod par byas pa des ni ngang par skyes so/ /nga la sems dga' bar byas pa des ni lhar skyes so/ /bslab pa lhag mashernams bsrungs pa des ni bden pa mthong bar gyur to/ /dge slong dag de bsalgen las gcig tu nges par gnag pa rnams ni rnam par smin pa yang gcig tu nges par gnag par 'gyur ro/ /las gcig tu nges par dkarasnyib rnams7ni rnam par smin pa yang gcig tu nges par dkar bar 'gyur ro/ /las 'dren ma rnams ni rnam par smin pa yang 'dren mar 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag de bas na las gcig tu nges par gnag pa rnams dang las 'dren ma rnams spangs la/ las gcig tu nges par dkar ba rnams 'ba' zhig la gtad par bya ste/ dge slong dag khyodasnyekyis de ltar bslab par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas / dge slong de dag yisherangs te bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do/ / gang po la sogs pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa brgya pa las sdom gyi tshigs su bcad pa drug pa rdzogs sotsho// //sdom ni/ gser 'od dang ni dri zhim dang / /byad bzang0)stobs ldan sdu5nyegu dang / /pad ma mig dang rnga sgra dang / /bu dang nyi ma gyad pa dngas/ /gser 'od ces bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po rnams dang /blon po chen po rnams dang / phyug po rnams dang / pho brang 'khor gyi mi rnams 75—395

dang ske/ tshong dpon rnams dang / ded dpon rnams dang / lha rnams dang /klu rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams dang ①/ lha ma yin rnams dang / nam mkha' lding rnams dang / mi 'am ci rnams dang / sto 'phye chen po rnams kyis bkur stistogebyas/ bla mar byas/ ri mor byas/ mchod pa byas te/ lha dang /klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis mchod cing shes pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bsod nams chen po dang7ldan pa/ na bza' dang / zhal zas dang / gzims cha dang / gdan dang / snyun gsosasridang / sman zong rnams brnyes pa/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa ser skya'i〈ge)gnas namasno)shing n+ya gro ṅgā'i 7kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe ser skya'i⑧gnas na shākya phyug cing nor mang la5she)longs spyod che ba/ yongs su 'dzin pa yangs shing rgya che ba rnam thos kyi bu'i nor dang ldan pa/ rnam thos kyi bu'i nor dang 'gran pa zhig gnas pa des/ rigs mnyam pa las chung ma blangs nas de de dang lhan cig tu rtse zhing dga' la dga' mgur spyod do/ /de rtse zhing dga' la dga' mgur spyod pa las chung ma la bu chags nas de zla ba brgyad dam dgu lon pa dang bu byung ste khye'u gzugs bzang zhing blta 1 )na sdug la mdzes pa mi'i (1kha dog las ni 'das lha'i kha dog ni ma thob pa 'dzam bu chu bo'i gser gyi mdog 'dra ba zhig btsas te/ de'i gser gyi 'od kyis grong khyer ser skya'i gnas thams cad snang bar byas so/ /de nas pha ma dang sems can gzhan dag gis de mthong nas ltad mo la lhags te sems can gyi khyad par 'di lta bu ni (nyag las 'ongs zhig51nyegu zhes mchog tu ngo mtshar du gyur nas sems pa la zhugs so/ /de 75wa 396

nas7de btsas pa'ikhubatsas ston byas nas khye'u 'di'i ming ji skad gdags zhes ming 'dogs par byed de/ nye du rnams na re 'di btsas pa na grong khyer ser skya'i gnas thams cad gser gyi 'od kyis snang bar byas pas na / de'i phyir khye'u 'di'i ming gser 'od ces gdags so zhes zer ro/ /de nas khye'ushegaser 'od pang na 'tsho ba'i ma ma gnyis dang / nu ma snun pa'i ma ma gnyis dang /dri ma 'khurnyuba'i ma ma gnyis dang / rtse ba'i ma ma gnyis te ma ma brgyad la gtad dunas/ de ma ma brgyad kyis 'o ma dang / zho dang / mar dang / zhun mar dang /⑦ mar gyi nying5ni khu dang / gzhan yangalo)yo byad kyi khyad par bzang ngo cog gis bskyed bsrings te mtsho'i nang gi pad ma bzhin du skye drag par gyur to/ /de yang mkhas shing gsal la yid gzhungs pa dang / dad pa dang ldan la dge zhing bsam pa bzang ba(gle/ bdag dang gzhan la phan pa la zhugs pa / snying rje can bdag nyid che ba/ chos 'dod pa zhig go/ /phyis re zhig na/8de byad gzugs kyis7)rgyags pas myos te grong khyer gyi phyi rol na rtse zhing 'dug go / /shākya mang po dag cig kyang shing n+ya gro d+ma'i0kun dga' ra bar dong ngo / /de nas khye'u gser 'od kyis mthong nas dris pa khyodasngogegar 'dong / de dag gis smras pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la blta ba'i phyir shing n+ya gro d+ma'i hu 7kun dga' ra bar 'gro'o/ /de nas khye'u gser 'od kyis sangs rgyas zhes bya ba thos te / sngon ma thos pa'i ming thos nas spu thams cad zing zhes byas te/ mchog tu ngo mtshar du gyur nas de 'di snyam du sems te/ ma la bdag kyang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das blta ba'i phyir 'gro gor ma chag nyu)snyam nas de yang shing n+ya gro d+ma'i ‘/)kun dga' ra bar song ba dang / khye'u gser 'od kyis sangs rgyas 75—397

bcom ldan 'das sku skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis legs par brgyan pa/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus mdzes par byas pa/ 'od 'dom gang gis brgyan pa/ nyi ma stong bas lhag pa'i 'od mnga' ba/ rin po che'i ri bo 'gro ba lta bu7kun nas bzang ba mthong nas/ mthong ma thag tu byad gzugs kyis rgyags57pa med par gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshalasanas/ chos mnyan pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de la chos bstan nas/ desasrechos de thos pa dang rab tu 'byung bar 'dod par gyur to/ /de nas re zhig na pha ma la gsol nas / bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du song ste phyin nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal57te/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bdag〈87legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu byung7ba dang bsnyen par rdzogs shing dge slong gi dngos po 'thob tu rung na bdag kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du tshangs par spyod pa spyad par 'tshal lo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis phyag gser gyi kha dog can glang po che'i sna ltar 'dug pa brkyang nas / khye'u gser 'od la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /gzhon nu tshur shog tshangs par spyod cig /7de skad ces bka' stsal pa'i mod la skra dang kha spu bregs nas zhag bdun lon pa tsam du gyur/ spyod lam ni bsnyen par rdzogs nas lo brgya lon pa lta bur 'dug par gyur/ lag na ni lhung bzed dang chu snod thogs par gyur to/ /'dir smras pa/ de bzhin gshegs pas tshur zhes bka' stsal pas/ /de ni mgo bregs lus la snam sbyar gyon/ /sangs rgyas kyi ni 75—398

dgongs pas gosatubagos nas/ /mod la dbang po rab tu zhi bar gnas/ /de nas7bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dug nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis de la yid la byed pa'i lung phog ste/ des brtson pa dang bsgrub pa dang 'bad pas phol mig lnga pa'i 'khor ba'i 'khor lo 'di nyid g.yo zhing mi brtan par rig nas/'du byed kyi rnam pa thams cad snyilasab dang / ltung ba dang / rnam par 'thor ba dang / rnam par 'jig pa'i chos can yin par rtsad chod de/ nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs nas dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas te/ dgra bcom pa khams gsum pa'i 'dod chags dang bral bar gyur nas/ gser dang bong bar mnyam pa/ nam mkha' dang lag mthilasadu 'dra ba'i sems dang ldan pa / tsan dan sbangs pa lta bur bsil bar gyur pa/ rig pas sgo nga'i sbubs bcom pa/ rig pa dang mngon par shes pa dang so so yang dag par rig pa thob pa / srid pa'i rnyed pa dang chags pa dang bkur ste la mi lta ba⑤/ dbang po dang nye dbang dang bcas pa'i lha 0rnams kyis mchod cing rjedakyipa dang gus par smra ba'i gnas su gyur to/ /de nas dge slong dag the tsom skyes te the com thams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa gser 'od kyis las gang dag bgyisalgen/ des 'di ltar gzugs bzang zhing blta7na sdug la mdzes pa dang rab tu byung nas dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du bgyis lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag gser 'od nyid kyis sngon (1tshe rabs gzhan dag tu tshogs rnyed cing rkyen grub pa dang ldan te/dba' rgal bzhin 8du byung tunyel gdon mi za bar 'ong ba'i las de dag byas shing bsags pas na/ gser 'od nyid kyis las byas shing bsags pa de dag gzhan 75—399

su zhig gis nyams su myong bar 'gyur te/ dge slong dag las byas shing bsags pa rnams ni phyi rol gyi sa'i khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur/ chu'i khams dang ske/ me'i khams dang / rlung gi khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur te/las dge ba dang mi dge ba byas shing bsags pa rnams ni zin pa'i phung po dang khams dang skye mched rnams 'ba' zhig la rnam par smin par 'gyur ro/ /lus can dag gi las rnams ni/ /bskal pa brgyar yang chud mi za/ /tshogs shing dus la bab pa na/ /'bras bu nyid du smin par 'gyur/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na bskal pa dgu bcu rtsa gcig pa la/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu gdul bya'i7)kha lo sgyur mib/ bla na med pa lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnam par gzigs zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung ste/ de rgyal po'i pho brang gnyen ldan na rten cing bzhugs pa las re zhig na yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs/ sangs rgyas kyi phrinam las thams cad mdzad nas/ shing zad pa'i me bzhin du phung po'i lhag ma med pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su yongs su chamya ngan las 'das so/ /de nas rgyal po gnyen yodapo)kyis/ bcom ldan 'das kyi sku gdung lapo)sku gdung gi mchod pa byas nas/ rin po che sna bzhi las rinabyas pa'i mchod rten kho ra khor yug tu dpag tshad gcig yod la/ 'phang du rgyang grags gcig yod pa zhig brtsigasalgete / mchod rten gyi dus ston yang lugs btod do/ /de nas re zhig na khyim bdag cig mchod rten gyi dus ston byed pa der song ba las mchod rten de las 75—400

gser gyi me long zhig lhung ba des mthong nas/ des de'i rna ba'i gong rgyan du bcos nas/ mchod rten de la btags7te/ spos dang / bdug pa dang /me tog gis mchod nas zhabs la phyag 'tshal te smon lam btab pa/ bdag gis kyang yon tan 'di lta bu dag thob par gyur cig /ston pa 'di lta bu mnyes par byed par gyur cig /mi mnyes parasngo byed par ma gyur cig ces byas sol/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/de'i tshe de'i dus na khyim bdag tu gyur pa gang yin pa de ni khye'u gser 'od 'di yin te/ des yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs kyi mchod rten la bkur sti byas pa des na 'di lta burasabyad gzugs kyi 3)khyad par can du gyur to/ /smon lam btab pa des ni tshe 'di la dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sumapodu byas so/ /dge slong dag de ltar na/ las gcig tu nges par gnag pa rnams ni/ rnam par smin pa yang gcig tu nges par gnag par 'gyur ro/ /las gcig tu nges par dkar7ba rnams ni rnam par smin pa yang gcig tu nges par dkar bar 'gyur ro/ /las 'dren5sem rnams ni rnam par smin pa yang 'dren7mar 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag de bas na las gcig tu nges par gnag pa rnams dang las 'dren7ma rnamasam/nyaspangs la/ las gcig tu nges par dkar ba rnams 'ba' zhig la gtad par bya ste/ dge slong khyod 1)kyis de ltar bslab par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/dge slong de dag yi tsorangs te bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// //dri zhim zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po rnams dang /75—401

blon po chen po7rnams dang / phyug po rnams dngakhu/ pho brang 'khor gyi mi rnams dang / tshong dpon rnams dang / ded dpon rnams dang / lha rnams dang ske/ klu rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams dang / lha ma yin rnams dang /nam mkha' lding rnams dang / mi 'am ci rnams dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis bkur sti byas/ bla mar byas/ ri mor byas/ mchod pa byas te / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang /② mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis mchod cing shes pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bsod nams chen po dang ldan pa/ na bza' dang / zhal zas dang / gzims cha dang / gdan dang / snyan gsos dang / sman zong rnams brnyes pa/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa yul ser skya'i gnas na⑧shing n+ya gro ṅgā'irnyukun dga' ra ba na bzhugasalgesol/ /de'i tshe ser skya'i gnas na khyim bdag phyug cing nor mang la longs spyod che ba yongs su 'dzin pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ rnam thos kyi bu'i nor dang ldan pa/rnam thos kyi bu'i nor dang 'gran pa zhig gnas pa des rigs mnyam pa las chung ma blangs nas/ de de dang lhan cig tu rtse zhing dga' la dga' mgurashespyod do/ /de rtse zhing dga' la dga' mgur spyod pa las chung ma la bu chags nas/ de zla ba brgyad dam dgu lon pa dang bu byung ste/ khye'u gzugs bzang zhing blta na ⑩sdug la mdzes pa zhigatshwanyemi'i kha dog las ni 'das/ lha'i kha dog ni ma thob pa zhig btsas te/ de'i kha nas me tog ud pa la'i dri 'byung 'kho/ lus thams cad las〈nyeni tsan dan gyi dri 'byung7ngo / /de nas desnyibatsas pa'i btsas ston byas nas khye'u 'di'i (nyeming ji skad gdags zhes ming 'dogs par byed de/75—402

de'itunye du rnams na re 'di'i kha nas ud pa la'i dri byungasal/ lus thams cad nas tsan dan gyi dri byung ②bas na de'i phyir khye'u 'di'i ming dri zhim zhes gdags so zhes zer ro/ /de nas khye'u dri zhim pangasnyin 'tsho ba'i ma ma gnyis dang / nu ma snun pa'i ma ma gnyis dang / dri ma 'khru ba'i ma ma gnyis dang /rtse ba'i ma ma gnyis te ma ma brgyad la gtad nas/ de ma ma brgyad kyisasnyi'o ma dang / zho dang / mar dang / zhun mar dang / mar gyi nying74 dang /gzhan yang yo byad kyi khyad par bzang ngo cog gis bskyed bsrings te/ mtsho'i nang gi pad ma bzhin du skye drag par gyurakhuto/ /de yang sngon gyi rgyu'i0)stobs kyi shugs kyis dad pa dang ldan la/ dge zhing bsam pa bzang la yo)bdag dang gzhan la phan pa la zhugs pa/ snying rje can/ bdag nyid che 'kho/ chos 'dod pa zhig ste/ gang gi tshe khye'u5)dri zhim zhing〈nyedapung rgyan dang mgul pa'i do shal dang gdu bus brgyan te srang gi nang du zhugs pa de'i tshe/ tsan dan gyi dri bsunganyegis grong khyer thams cad khyab par gyur te④/ skye botsomang pos kyang lha'i spos kyi dri tshor nas mchog tu ya mtshan du 'dzin te/ 'di skad du/ kye ma bsod nams dag gi mthu zhes zer ro)/ /phyis re zhig na〈nyekhye'u dri zhim 3)rgya gro d+ma'i0 kun dga' ra bar song ngo / /de nas des sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sku skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa (teganyis kyis legs par brgyan pa/dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus mdzes par byas pa/ 'od 'dom gang gis brgyan pa / nyi ma stong bas lhag pa'i 'od mnga' ba/ rin po che'i ri bo 'gro ba lta bu kun nas bzang ba mthong nas/ mthong ma thag tu des bcom ldan 'das la sems dga' ba bskyed5 nyedo/ /dga' ba bskyed nas kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi 75—403

zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshalatute/ chos mnyan50pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i⑧bsam pa dang /bag la nyalashedang / khams dang / rang bzhin thugs su chud nas/ 'phags pa'i bden5⑧pa bzhi rtogs par 'gyur ba de lta bu'i chos bstan te/ de thos nas khye'u dri zhim gyis 'jigalo/tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo mthon po nyi shu ye shes rdo rjes gebacom nas rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas te/ desapo dze tshabaden pa mthong nas pha ma la gsol te bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la rab tu byung ngo / /des brtson pa dang bsgrub pa dang 'bad pas phol mig lnga pa'i 'khor ba'i 'khor lo 'di nyid g.yo zhing mi brtan hunye par rig nas/ 'du byed kyi rnam pa thams cad snyil7)ba dang / lhung ba dang / rnam par 'thor ba dang / rnam par 'jig pa'i chos can yin par rtsad chod de/ nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs nas dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas te/ dgra bcom pa khams gsum pa'i 'dod chags dang bral bar gyur nas gser dang bong bar mnyam pa/nam mkha' dang lag mthil hu du 'dra ba'i sems dang ldan pa/ tsan dan sbangs pa lta bur bsil bar gyur pa/ rig pas sgo nga'i sbubs bcom pa/ rig pa dang mngon par shes pa dang so so yang dag par rig pa thob pa/ srid pa'i rnyed pa dang chags pa dang bkur sti la mi lta ba/ dbang po dang nye dbang dang bcas pa'i lha rnams kyis mchod cing rjedam/rtepa dang gus par smra ba'i gnas su gyur to/ /de nas dge slong dag the tsom skyes te/ the tsom thams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa dri zhim gyis las gang dag bgyis na/des 'di'itswakha nas ni ud pa la'i dri 'byung la/ lus thams cad nas ni tsan 75—404

dan gyi dri 'byung bar 'gyurashelags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/dge slong dag dri zhim nyid kyis sngon tshe rabs gzhan dag tu tshogs rnyed cing rkyen grub pa dang ldan te/ dba' rgal bzhin du byungashel/ gdon mi za bar 'ong ba'i las de dag byas shing bsags pas na/ dri zhim nyid kyis las byas shing bsags pa de dag gzhan su zhig gis nyams su myong bar 'gyur te/ dge slong dag las byas shing bsags pa rnams ni phyi rol gyi sa'i khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur/ chu'i khams dang / me'i khams dang / rlung gi khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur te/ las dge ba dang mi dge ba byas shing bsags par rnams ni zin pa'i phung po dang / khams dang / skye mched rnams 'ba' zhig la rnam par smin par 'gyur ro/ /lus can dag gi las rnams ni/ /bskal pa brgyar yang chud mi za/ /tshogs shing dus la bab pa na/ /'bras bu nyid du smin par 'gyur/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na/ bskal pa dgu bcu rtsa gcig pa la de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa skyes bu gdul bya'i kha lo sgyurasnyib/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnam par gzigs zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung ste/ de rgyal po'i pho brang gnyen ldan na rten cing bzhugs pa las re zhig na/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs sangs rgyas kyi phrin las thams cad mdzad nas/ shing zad pa'i me bzhin du phung po'i lhag ma med pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su yongs su mya ngan las 'das sol/ /de nas rgyal po gnyen yod kyis bcom ldan 'das kyi sku gdung la sku 75—405

gdung gi mchod pa byas nas/ rin po che sna bzhi las byas pa'i mchod rten kho ra khor yug tu dpag tshad gcig yod la/ 'phang du rgyang grags gcig yod pa zhig brtsigs te/ mchod rten gyi dus ston yang lugs btode7do/ /khyim bdag gcig gis kyang de la dad pa bskyedakunas/ spos dang byug pa rnam bsnyesna tshogs phul te/ bdug0pa dang me tog gis mchod nas smon lam btab pa/dge ba'i rtsa ba dang sems bskyed pa dang sbyin par bya ba'i chos yongs su gtong ba 'dis na/ bdag gis kyang yon tan 'di lta bu dag thob par gyur cig /ston pa 'di lta busamanyes par byed par gyur cig /mi mnyes par byed par ma gyur cig ces byas so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus na khyim bdag tu gyur pa gang yin pa de ni khye'u dri zhim 'di yin te/ des yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs kyi mchod rten la bkur sti byas pa des na 'di lta bur dri zhim por gyur to / /smon lam btab pa des ni tshe 'di la dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas sol/ /dge slong dag de ltar na las gcig tu nges par gnag pa rnams ni rnam par smin pa yang gcig tu nges par gnag par 'gyur ro/ / las gcig tu nges par dkar ba rnams ni rnam par smin pa yang gcig tu nges par dkar bar 'gyur ro/ /dulas 'dren7ma rnams ni rnam par smin pa yang7'dren mar 'gyur ro/ (nyedage slong dag de bas na las gcig tu nges par gnag pa rnamasalgedang las 'dren ma rnams spangs la/ las gcig tu nges par dkar ba rnams 'ba' zhig la gtad par bya ste/ dge slong khyod〈nyekyis de ltar bslab par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas dge slong de dag yi rangs 75—406

te①/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// // gang po la sogs pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa brgya pa/② bam po bcwakhelnga pa/byad bzangakhuzhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po rnams dang ske/ blon po chen po rnams dang / phyug po rnams dang / pho brang 'khor gyi mi rnams dang / tshong dpon rnams dang / ded dpon rnams dang / lha rnams dang / klu rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams dang / lha ma yin rnams dang ske/ nam mkha' lding rnams dang / mi 'am ci rnams dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis bkur sti byas/ bla mar byas/ ri mor byas/ mchod pa byas te/ lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis mchod cing shes pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bsod nams chen po dang ldan pa/ nas6)bza' dang ske/ zhal zas dang / gzims cha dang / gdan dang / snyan gsos dang /sman zong rnams brnyes pa/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa ser gaskya'i gnas na shing n+ya gro d+ma'i⑧kun dga' ra bshen bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe ser skya'i gnas na/ shākya phyug cing nor5) mang la longs spyod che ba yongs su 'dzin pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ rnam thos kyi〈nyebu'i nor dang ldan pa/ rnam thos kyi7)bu'i nor dang 'gran pa zhig gnas pa de(nye/ rigs mnyam pa las chungasam blangs nas de de dang lhan cig tu rtse zhing dga' la dga' mgur spyod do/ / de rtse 8zhing dga' la dga' mgur spyod pa las chung ma la bu chags nas/ de zla ba brgyad dam dgu lon pa dang bu byung ste/ khye'u gzugs bzang zhing blta snyan sdug la mdzes pa mi'i kha dog las ni 'das/ lha'i kha dog ni ma thob pa/ lus byad 75—407

dpe med la mdog 'jam pa/ lus kyi bdunatumatho ba/ che bar grags pa zhig⑧btsas so/ /de nas de btsas pa'i btsas ston byas nas / khye'u 'di'i ming ji skad gdags zhes ming 'dogs par byed de/ nye du rnams na re 'di'i lus dpe med pas na de'i phyir khye'u 'di'i ming byad bzangatsha )zhes gdags so zhes zer ro /de nas khye'u byad bzangakepang na 'tsho ba'i ma ma gnyis dang / nu ma snun pa'i ma ma gnyis dang / dri ma 'khru ba'i ma ma gnyis dang / rtse ba'i ma ma gnyis te/ma ma brgyad la gtad 6)nas/ de ma ma brgyad kyisaphye'o ma dang / zho dang /mar dang / zhun mar dang52)/ mar gyi nying khu ⑨dang / gzhan yang yo byad kyi khyad par bzang ngo cog gis bskyed bsrings te mtsho'i nang gi pad ma bzhin du skye drag par gyur to/ /de yang dad pa dang ldan la dge batshwa )bsam pa bzang ba/bdag dang gzhan la phan pa la zhugs pa/ snying rje can bdag nyid che ba chos 'dod pa zhig ste/ 'jig rten thams cad dang tha na mi ma yin pa rnams kyis kyang mchod cing rjedamanyapa dang gus par smra ba'i gnas su gyur to/ /des sa phyogs gang du gom pa bor ba de dag kyang gtsang mar gyur te/ de ltar bsod nams dang ldan zhing che bar grags so/ /phyis re zhig na de shing n+ya gro d+ma'i7kun dga' ra bar song ba dang / des sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sku skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis legs par brgyan pa/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus mdzes par byas pa/ 'od 'dom gang gis brgyan pa/ nyi ma stong bas lhag pa'i 'od mnga' ba/ rin po che'i ri bo 'gro ba lta bu kun nas bzang ba mthong nas/ mthong ma thag tu des bcom ldan 'das la sems dga' ba bskyed do / /dga' ba bskyed tsho/nyenas kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal te/75—408

chos mnyanatupa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i bsam pa dang bag la nyal ②dang khams dang rang bzhin thugs su chud nas/ 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi rtogs par 'gyur ba de lta bu'i chos bstan te/ de thos nas khye'u byad bzang gisam ni'ajig tshogs la lta 3)ba'i ri'i rtse mo mthon po nyi shu ye shes rdo rjes bcom nas rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas te/ des bden pa mthong nas pha ma la gsol te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la rab tu byung ngo / /des brtsonasapa dang / bsgrub pa dang ske/ 'bad pas phol mig lnga pa'i 'khor ba'i 'khor lo 'di nyid g.yo zhing mi 6brtan par rig nas/ 'du byed kyi rnam pa thams cad snyil 57)ba dang / ltung ba dang ske/ rnam par 'thor ba dang / rnam par 'jig pa'i chos can yin par rtsad chod de/ nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs nas dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas te/ dgra bcom pa khams gsum pa'i 'dod chags dang bral bar gyur nas gser dang bong bar mnyam pa/ nam mkha' dang lag mthil sa du 'dra ba'i sems dang ldan pa/ tsan dan sbangs pa lta bur bsil bar gyur pa/ rig pas sgo nga'i sbubs bcom pa/ rig pa dang / mngon par shes pa dang so so yang dag par rig pa thob pa/ srid pa'i rnyed pa dang chags pa dang bkur ste la mi lta ba dbang po dang nye dbang dang bcas pa'i lha rnams kyis 1)mchod cing rjed sna snapa dang gus par smra ba'i gnas su gyur to/ /de nas dge slong rnams the tsom skyes te / the tsom thams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/btsun pa byad bzang gis71las gang dag bgyis na/ des 'di'i 12lus 'di lta bur gyur la dgra bcom pa nyid thob par gyur lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 75wa 409

bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag byad bzang7nyid kyis/ sngon tshe rabs gzhan dag tu tshogs rnyed ①cing rkyen grub pa dang ldan te dba' rgal bzhin du byung rgyal/gdon mi za bar 'ong ba'i las de dag byas shing bsags pas na byad bzang rjonyid kyis las byas shing 6)bsags pa de dag gzhan su zhig gis stinyams su myong bar 'gyur te/ dge slong dag las byas shing bsags pa rnams ni phyi rol gyi sa'i khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur/ chu'i khams dang / me'i khams dang ske/ rlung gi khams la rnam7par smin par mi 'gyur te las dge ba dang mi dge ba byas shing bsags pa rnams ni zin pa'i phung po dang / khams dang /skye mched rnams 'ba' zhig la rnam par smin par 'gyur ro/ /lus can dag gi⑧las rnams ni/ /bskal pa brgyar yang chud mi za/ /tshogs shing dus la bab pa na / /'bras bu nyid du smin par 'gyur/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na/ bskal pa dgu bcu rtsa gcig pa la de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu gdul bya'i7kha lo sgyur ba / bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnam par gzigs zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung ste/ de rgyal po'i pho brang gnyen ldan na rten cing bzhugs pa las/ re zhig na yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs sangs rgyas kyi phrin7)las thams cad mdzad nas/ shing zad pa'i me bzhin du phung po'i lhag ma med pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i (nyedabyings su yongs surwanyemya ngan las 'das soyi/ /de nas rgyal po gnyen yod kyis bcom ldan 'das kyi sku gdung la/ sku gdung gi mchod pa byas nas/ rin 75—410

po che sna bzhi las byas pa'i mchod rten kho ra khor yug tu dpag tshad gcig7yod la/ 'phang du rgyang grags gcig yod pa zhig brtsigs te/ der rgyal po gnyen yod gnyen gyi tshogs dang bcas pa dang / blon po'i tshogs kyis zhabs 'bringasabyas pas mchod rten gyi dus ston byas so/ /phyis re zhig na⑧nyi ma gcig cig /mi dbul po zhig mchod rten gyi 'khor sa'i nang du song nas des de la〈peme tog rnyis pa dag dang / mchod rten rdul gyis yog pa dag mthong ngo de nas des sangs rgyas kyi yon tan rjes su dran nas dad pa skyes te/ phyags ma blangs nas mchod rten yang phyags me tog rnyis pa yang bsal7to/ /de nas mchod rten la rdul med cing dri ma med pa mthong nas/ dga' bsnyeskyes te zhabs la phyag 'tshal7nas/ smon lam btab pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba dang sems bskyed pa 'dis na bdag gis kyang yon tan 'di lta bu dag thob par gyur cig /ston pa 'di lta bu mnyes par byed par gyur cig /mi mnyes par byed par ma gyur cig ces byas so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus na mi dbul por gyur pa gang yin pa de ni/ byad bzang7'di yin te/ des mchod rten la phyag dar byas pas na byad gzugs bzang por gyur to/ /smon lam btab pa des ni7tshe 'di nyid la dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas so/ /dge slong dag de ltar narwanyelas gcig tunyenges par gnag pa rnams ni rnam par smin pa ⑩yang gcig tu nges par gnag par 'gyur ro/ /las gcig tu nges par dkar ba rnams ni rnam par smin pa yang gcig tu nges par dkar bar 'gyur ro/ /las 'dren ma rnams ni rnam par smin pa yang 'dren mar 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag de bas na las gcig 75—411

tu nges par gnag pa rnams dang las 'dren nyu/ma rnams spangs la/ las gcig tu nges par dkar dunab rnams 'ba' zhig la gtadam par bya ste/ dge slong khyodakhukyis de ltar bslab par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas dge slong de dag yi ⑧rangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// //stobs ldan zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po rnams dang ske/ blon po chen po rnams dang / phyug po rnams dang / pho brang 'khor gyi mi rnams dang / tshong dpon rnams dang / ded dpon rnams dang / lha rnams dang / klu rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams dang / lha ma yin rnams dang ske/ nam mkha' lding rnams dang / mi 'am ci rnams dang / sto 'phye chen po rnams kyis bkur sti byas/ bla mar byas/ ri mor byas/ mchod pa byas te/ lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis mchod cing shes pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bsod nams chen po dang ldan pa/ na bza' dang / zhal zas dang / gzims cha dang / gdon dang / snyan gsos dang / sman zong rnams brnyes pa/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa ser skya'i gnas na shing n+ya gro ṅgā'i 6)kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe ser skya'i gnas na shākya phyug cing nor mang la/ longs spyod che ba yongs su 'dzin pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ rnam thos kyi bu'i nor dang ldan pa/ rnam thos kyi bu'i nor dang 'gran pa zhig gnas pa des rigs mnyam pa las chung ma blangs nas / de de dang lhan cig tu rtse zhing dga' la dga' mgur spyod do/ /de rtse 75—412

zhing dga' la dga' mgur spyod hu)pa las chung ma la bu chags nas/ de zla ba brgyad dam dgu lon pa dang bu byung ste/ khye'u gzugs bzang zhing blta ②na sdug la mdzes pa/ stobs kyi shugs gzhan las 'phags pa zhig btsas so/ /de nas de btsas pa'i btsas ston byas nas/ khye'u 'di'i ming ji skad gdags50zhes ming 'dogs par byed debya/ nye du rnams na re khye'u 'dis)stobs kyi shugs dang ldan pas na/ de'i phyir khye'u 'di'i ming stobs ldan zhes gdags so zhes zer ro/ /de nas khye'u stobs ldan pang na 'tsho ba'i ma ma gnyis dang / nu ma snun pa'i ma ma gnyis dang / dri ma 'khru ba'i ma ma gnyis dang / rtse ba'i ma ma gnyis te ma ma brgyad la gtad nas/ de ma ma brgyad kyisapo 'o ma dang / zho dang ske/ mar dang / zhun mar dang / mar gyi nyinga'apekhu dang / gzhan yang yo byad kyi khyad par bzang ngo cog gis bskyed bsrings te mtsho'i nang gi pad ma bzhin du skye drag par gyur to/ /de yang dad bsnyedang ldan la dge zhing bsam pa bzang la/ bdag la phan pa dang / gzhan la phan pa〈tshol zhugs pa snying rje can bdag nyid che ba chos 'dod pa zhig go/ /de nas phyis re zhig na/ de shing n+ya gro d+ma'i kun dga' ra bar song ba dang / des 31sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sku skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis legs par brgyan pa/dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus mdzes par byas pa/ 'od 'dom gang gis brgyan pa/ nyi ma stong bas lhag pa'i 'od mnga' ba/ rin po che'i ri bo 'gro ba lta bu kun nas bzang ba mthong nas/ mthong ma thag tu des bcom ldan 'das la sems dga' batshwanyebaskyed do/ /dga' ba bskyed nas kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal〈nyete/ chos mnyan pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 75—413

'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i bsam pa dang / bag la nyalatudang ske/ khams dang / rang bzhin thugs su chud nas/ 'phagasalgepa'i bden pa bzhi rtogs par 'gyur ba de lta bu'i chos bstan te/ de thos nas khye'u stobs ldan gyis 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ②ri'i rtse mo mthon po nyi shu ye shes rdo rjes bcom nas rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas te des bden pa mthong nas/ pha ma la gsol te bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la rab tu byung ste/des brtson pa dang / bsgrub pa dang / 'bad pas phol mig lnga pa'i 'khor ba'i 'khor lo 'di nyid g.yo zhing mi brtan⑧par rig nas/ 'du byed kyi rnam pa thams cad snyilapo)ba dang / ltung ba dang / rnam par 'thor ba dang / rnam par 'jig pa'i chos can yin par rtsad mechod de/ nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs nas/ dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas te/ dgra bcom pa khams gsum pa'i 'dod chags dang bral bar gyurashenas/ gser dang bong bar mnyam pa/ nam mkha' dang lag mthil du 'dra ba'i sems dang ldan pa/ tsan dan sbangs pa lta bur bsil bar gyur pa/ rigashepas sgo nga'i sbubs bcom pa/rig pa dang mngon par shes pa dang so so yang dag par rig pa thob pa dang tunye /srid pa'i rnyed pa dang chags pa dang bkur sti la mi lta ba dngarwanye/ dbang po dang nye〈rtedabang dang bcas pa'i lha rnams kyis mchod cing rjed5nyepa dang gus par smra ba'i gnas su gyur to/ /de nas dge slong dag the tsom skyes te/ the tsom thams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa stobs ldan kyis las gang dgasabagyis na/ des 'di'i lus7stobs dang ldan par gyur la dgra bcom pa nyid thob par gyur lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' 75—414

stsal pa/ dge slong dag stobs ldan nyid kyis/ sngon tshe rabs gzhan dag tu tshogs rnyed cing rkyen grub pa dang ldan te/ dba' rgal bzhin du byungatul gdonasami za bar 'ong ba'i las de dag byas shing bsags pas na/ stobs ldan nyid kyis las byas shing bsags pa de dag gzhan su zhig gis nyams su myong bar 'gyur te/ dge slong dgashelas byas shing bsags pa rnams ni phyi rol gyi sa'i khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur/ chu'i khams dang / me'i khams dang /rlung gi khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur te/ las dge ba dang mi dge ba byas shing bsags pa rnams ni zin pa'i phung po dang khams dang skye mched rnams 'ba' zhig la rnam par smin par 'gyur teX/ lus can dag gi las rnams ni//bskal pa brgyar yang chud mi za/ /tshogs shing dus la bab pa na/ /'bras bu nyid du smin par 'gyur/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na/bskal pa dgu bcu rtsa gcig pa la de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu gdul bya'i kha lo sgyur ba/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ④ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnam par gzigs zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung ste/ de rgyal po'i pho brang gnyen ldan na rten 7cing bzhugs pa las/ re zhig na yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs sangs rgyas kyi phrin las thams cad mdzad nas/ shing zad pa'i me bzhin du phung po'i lhag ma med pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su yongs su rtemya ngan las 'das so de nas rgyal po gnyen yod kyis bcom ldan 'das de'i sku gdung la7sku gdung gi mchod pa byas nas/ rin po che sna bzhi las〈nyebyas pa'i 75—415

mchod rten kho ra khor yug tu dpag tshad gcig yod la 'phang du rgyang grags gcig yod pa zhig brtsigs te/ mchod rten gyi dus ston byed pa der skye bo phal po ches glu blangs gar byas pas mchod rten rdul gyis0)yog par gyur to/ /phyisalgere zhig na khyim bdag cig mchod rten gyi 'khor sa'i snyunang du song ba dang des mchod rten gyi 'khor sadzasngu)rdul gyis yog pa mthong ngo / /de nas khyim bdag des sangs rgyas kyi yon tan rjes su dran nas dad pa skyes te/ spos kyi sde55)gu til mar dang sbyar ba phul nasal)smon lam btab pa/ bdag gis kyang yon tan 'di lta bu dag thob par gyur cig /ston pa 'di lta bu dag mnyes par byed par gyur cig /mi mnyes9)par byed par ma gyur cig52)ces byas so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag ji snyam du59)sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus na khyim bdag tu gyur pa gang yin pa de ni stobs ldan 'di yin te/ des bcom ldan 'das rnam par gzigs kyi mchod rten la bkur ste byas pa des na stobs dang ldan par gyur to/ /smon lam btab pa des ni da ltar7 )dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas so/ /dge slong dag de ltar na hunyalas gcig tu nges par gnag pa rnams ni rnam par smin pa yang gcig tu nges par gnag par 'gyur ro/ /las gcig tu nges par dkar ba rnams ni rnam par smin pa yang gcig tu nges par dkar bar 'gyur ro/ /las 'dren 512ma rnams ni rnam par smin pa yang 'dren nyusnyemar 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag de bas na las gcig tu nges par gnag pa rnams dang las 'dren rim rnams spangs la/ las gcig tu nges par dkar ba rnams 'ba' zhig la gtad par bya ste/ dge slong khyodam kyis de ltar bslab par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas 75wa 416

dge slong de dag yinyerangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// //sdukugu zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po rnams dang /blon po chen po rnams dang / phyug po rnams dang / pho brang 'khor gyi mi rnams dang ske/ tshong dpon rnams dang / ded dpon rnams dang / lha rnams dang /klu rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams dang / lha ma yin rnams dang / nam mkha' lding rnams dang / mi 'am ci rnams dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis bkur ste byas/ bla mar byas/ ri mor byas/ mchod pa byas te/ lha du dang /klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis mchod cing shes pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bsodasnyinams chen po dang ldan pa/ na bza' dang / zhal zas dang / gzims cha dang / gdan cig)dang / snyan gsos dang56)/ sman zong rnams brnyes pa/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa ser skya'i57)gnas natshan)shing n+ya gro d+ma'i〈)kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe ser skya'i gnas na shākya phyug cing nor mang la longs spyod che ba/ yongs su 'dzin pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ rnam thos kyi bu'i nor dang ldan pa/ rnam thos kyi bu'i nor dang 'gran pa zhig gnas pa des rigs mnyam pa las chung ma blangs nas/ de de dang lhan cig tu rtse zhing dga' la dga' mgur spyod do/ /de rtse zhing dga' la dga' mgur spyod pa las chung ma la bu chags nas/ de zla ba brgyad dam dgu lon pa dang bu byung ste/ khye'u gzugs bzang zhing blta 7na sdug la mdzes pa/che bar grags pa mthong na dga' ba zhig btsas te de btsas pa na/ grong khyer 75—417

ser skya'ishiganas thams cad grags pas rgyas par gyur to/ /de nas de btsas pa'i btsas ston byas nas ⑧khye'u 'di'i ming ji skad gdags zhes ming 'dogs par byed de nye du rnams na re khye'u 'di btsas ma thag tu skye bo thams cad kyi snying du sdug pas na/ de'i phyir7khye'u 'di'i ming sdu༄gu zhes gdags so zhes zer ro/ /de nas khye'u sdusagu pang na 'tsho ba'i ma ma gnyis dang / nu ma snun pa'i ma ma gnyis dang / dri ma 'khru ba'i ma ma gnyis dang / rtse ba'i ma ma gnyis te ma ma brgyad la gtad nas/ de ma ma brgyad kyisarnyu'o ma dang / zho dang /mar dang / zhun mar dang / mar gyi nying khu dang / gzhan yang yo byad kyi khyad par bzang ngo cog gis bskyed bsrings te mtsho'i nang gi pad ma bzhin du skye drag5nyepar gyur to/ /de yang dad pa dang ldan la dge zhing bsam pa bzang ba/bdag la phan pa dang gzhan la phan pa la zhugs pa snying rje can ⑨bdag nyid che ba/ chos 'dod pa/ gtong ba la sred pa/ sbyin pa la dga' ba/ rab tu sbyin pa la mngon par dga' ba/ gtong ba chen po la gnas pa zhig ste/ des dge sbyong dang bram ze dang bkren pa dang sdug cing longs pa rnams tshul sbyin pa rnam pa sna tshogs gtong bas sdud par byed do/ /de nas phyis re zhig na khye'u sdulogu shing n+ya gro ṅgā'i〈nyekun dga' ra bar song ba dang / des sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sku skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis legs par ⑩brgyan pa / dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus mdzes par byas pa/ 'od 'dom gang gis brgyan pa/ nyi ma stong bas lhag pa'i bya'od mnga' ba/ rin po che'i ri bo 'gro ba lta bu kun nas bzang ba mthong nas/ mthong ma thag tu des bcom ldan 'das la sems dga' ba bskyed do/ /dga' ba bskyed nas kyang bcom ldan 75—418

'das kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal ①te chos mnyan ②pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i bsam pa dang /bag la nyalasadang / khams dang / rang bzhin thugs su chud nas/ 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi rtogs par 'gyur ba de lta bu'i chos bstan te/ de thos nas khye'u sdu dugus 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo mthon po nyi shu ye shes rdo rjes bcom nas/ rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas te/ des bden pa mthong nas pha ma la gsol te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la rab tu 'byungasnyingo / /des brtson7pa dang bsgrub pa dang 'bad pas phol mig lnga pa'i 'khor ba'i 'khor lo 'di nyid g.yo zhing mi brtan5myo)par rig nas/ 'du byed kyi rnam pa7thams cad snyilalo)ba dang / ltung ba dang rnam par 'thor ba dang /rnam par 'jig pa'i chos can yin par rtsad chod de/ nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs nas dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas te/ dgra bcom pa khams gsum pa'i 'dod chags dang bral bar gyur nas/ gser dang bong bar mnyam pa/ nam mkha' dang lag mthil5) du 'dra ba'i sems dang ldan pa/ tsan dan sbangs pa lta bur bsil bar gyur pa/ rig pas sgo nga'i sbubs bcom pa(nya/rig pa dang / mngon par shes pa dang / so so yang dgal par rig pa thob pa/sridamanyepa'i rnyed pa dang chags pa dang bkur sti la mi lta ba/ dbang po dang nye dbang dang bcas pa'i lha rnams kyis mchod cing rjed mipa dang gus par smra ba'i gnas su gyur to/ /de nas dge slong dag the com skyes te/ the com thams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa sdulagus las gang dag bgyis na/ des 'di grags pa chen po dang ldan pa dang sdug cing yid dusri75—419

'ong bar gyur la/ rab tu byung nas dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du bgyis lagasal/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag sdu ①gu nyid kyis sngon tshe rabs gzhan dag tu tshogs rnyed cing rkyen grub pa dang ldan te/dba' rgal bzhin du byung la/ gdon mi za bar 'ong ba'i las de dag ②byas shing bsags pas na/ sdu zhudagu nyid kyis ④las byas shing bsags pa de dag gzhan su zhig gis nyams su myong bar 'gyur te/ dge slong dag las byas shing bsags pa rnams ni phyi rol gyi sa'i khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur rol/ /chu'i khams dang / me'i khams dang / rlung gi khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur teyi/ las dge ba dang ⑦mi dge ba byas shing bsags pa rnams ni/zin pa'i phung po dang / khams dang / skye mched rnams 'ba' zhig la rnam par smin par 'gyur ro/ /lus can dag gi5nyelas rnams ni/ /bskal pa brgyar yang chud mi za/ /tshogs shing dus la bab pa na/ /'bras bu nyid du smin par 'gyur / /dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na bskal pa dgu bcu rtsa gcig pa la de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa6)/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu gdul bya'i mkha lo sgyur71ba/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnam par gzigs zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung ste/ de rgyal po'i pho brang gnyen ldan na rten cing bzhugs pa las/ re zhig na yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs sangs rgyas kyi phrin yonyelas thams cad mdzad nas/ shing zad pa'i me bzhin du phung po'i lhag ma med pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su yongs su mya ngan 75—420

las 'das so/ /de nas rgyal po gnyenatuyod kyis/ bcom ldan 'das de'i sku gdung la sku gdung gi mchod pa byas nas/ rin po che sna bzhishelas byas pa'i mchod rten kho ra khor yug tu dpag tshad gcig yod la/ 'phang du rgyang grags gcig yod pa zhig brtsigs so/ /de nas phyis re zhig na dpyid kyi dus su shing rnams me tog rgyas te me tog rnam pa sna tshogs byung kheb na/ khyim bdag gcigatswa)gis rgyal po la gsol bge/ bdag57ni lha dang lhan cig tu bcom ldan 'das rnam par gzigs kyi mchod rten la me tog gdags par 'tshal lo/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ de ltar gyis shig /de nas khyim bdag de dang / rgyal po dang /blon po dang / zhabs 'bring ba rnams kyis dril bsgrags te/ me tog rnam pa sna tshogs staponigon byas nas/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par gzigs kyi mchod rten la me tog btags〈nyete/ der srog chags 'bum phrag du mas sems dga' ba skyes〈nyenas/ dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams yang dag par bskyed do/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus na khyim bdag tu gyur pa gang yin pa de ni sdus3)gu 'di yin te/ des skye bo phal po che dang lhan cig tu dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams bskyed pa des na12/ skye bo phal po che'i snying du sdug cing nya )yid du 'ong ba'i rgyur 'gyur la/ rgyu de nyid kyis na blta na sdug cing mdzes par gyur tenya / dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas sol/ /dge slong dag de ltar na las gcig tu nges par gnag nyi pa rnams ni rnam par smin pa yang gcig tu nges par gnag par 'gyur ro/ /las gcig tu nges par dkar ba rnams ni rnam par smin pa yang gcig tu nges par dkar bar 'gyur ro/ /las 'drenatshwa)ma rnams ni rnam par smin pa yang 'drenatshwa )mar 'gyur 75—421

rol/ /dge slong dag de bas na las gcig tu nges par gnag pa rnams dang las 'drenatum rnams spangs la las gcig tu nges par dkar ba rnams 'ba' zhig la gtad par bya ste/ dge slong khyodasakyis de ltar bslab par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas dge slong de dag yisherangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// //pad ma'i mig ces bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po rnams dang / blon po chen po rnams dang / phyug po rnams dang / pho brang 'khor gyi mi rnams dang / tshong dpon rnams dang / ded dpon rnams dang /lha rnams dang / klu rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams dang / lha ma yin rnams dang ske/ nam mkha' lding rnams dang / mi 'am ci rnams dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis bkur ste byas/ bla mar byas/ ri mo byas/ mchod pa byas te/lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang ske/ mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis mchod cing shes pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bsod nams chen po dang ldan pa/ na bza' dang /zhal zas dang / gzims cha dang / gdan dang / snyun gsos dang / sman zong rnams brnyes pa/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dngakhebacas pa ser skya'i gnas na shing n+ya gro ṅgā'i57kun dga'atsho)ra ba na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe ser skya'i7gnas na shākya phyug cing nor mang btute/ longs spyod che ba/ yongs su 'dzin pa/yangs〈nyeshing rgyal che ba/ rnam thos kyi bu'i nor dang ldan pa/ rnam thos kyisabu'i nor dang 'gran pa zhig gnas pa des rigs mnyam pa las chung ma blangs nas / de de dang lhan cig tu rtse zhing dga' lasnyidaga' mgur spyod do/ /de rtse 75—422

zhing dga' la dga' mgur spyod pa las chung ma la bu chags nas de zla ba brgyad dam dgu lon pa dang bu byung ste/ khye'u gzugs bzang zhing blta0)na sdug la mdzes pa mig pad ma sngon po 'dra ba/ mgo bo la lha'i nor bu rin po che mthon ka thogs pa zhig btsas te/ des grong khyer ser skya'i gnas thams cad nor bu mthon ku'i kha dog can du byas so/ /de nas de btsas pa'i btsas ston byas nas/khye'u 'di'i ming ji skad gdags zhes ming 'dogs par byed de/ nye du rnams na re khye'u 'disamig pad mnyedangasnyi'adra bas na/ de'i phyir khye'u 'di'i ming pad ma'i mig ces gdags so zhes zer ro/ /de nas khye'u pad ma'i mig pang na 'tsho ba'i ma ma gnyis dang / nu ma snun pa'i ma ma gnyisam3)dang dri ma 'khru ba'i ma ma gnyis dang / rtse ba'i ma ma gnyis te/ de〈nem ma brgyad la gtad nas/ de ma ma brgyad kyisakhu'o ma dang / zho dang / mar dang / zhun mar dang / mar gyi nying khunyedang / gzhan yang yo byad kyi khyad par bzang ngo cog gis bskyed bsrings te mtsho'ishenang gi pad ma bzhin du skye drag par gyur to/ /de yang dad pa dang ldan la/ dge zhing bsam pa bzang ba/ bdag la phan pa dang gzhan la phan pa la zhugs pa/ snying rje can bdag nyid che ba/ chos 'dod pa/gtong ba la sred pa/ sbyin pa la dga' ba/ rab tu sbyin pa la mngon par dga' ba/ gtong ba chen po la gnas pa zhig ste/ de gang dang gang du 'gro ba de dang der lha dang mi rnams kyis mchod cing rjedas11do/ /de nas phyi zhig na khye'u pad ma'i mig shing n+ya gro ṅgā'i〈nyekun dga' ra bar song ba dang / des sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sku skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis legs par brgyan pa/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus mdzes par byas pa/ 'od 75—423

'dom gang gis brgyan pa/ nyi ma stong bas lhag pa'i 'od mnga' ba/ rin po che'i ri bo 'gro ba lta bu kun nas bzang ba mthong ngo / /mthong ma thag tu des bcom ldan 'das la sems dga' ba bskyed do/ /dga' ba bskyed nas kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal nya)te/ chos mnyan pa'i phyir/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i bsam pa dang 2ni/ bag la nyal dang / khams dang / rang bzhin thugs su chud nas/'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi rtogs par 'gyur ba de lta bu'i chos bstan te/ de thos nas khye'u pad ma'i mig gis 'jig tshogs la ltamad)ba'i ri'i rtse mo mthon po nyi shu ye shes rdo rjes bcom nas rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngonamanganadu byas te des bden pa mthong nas sbyin pa dang rab tu sbyin pa dag byin te/ dge slongasnyidang /bram ze dang / bkren pa dang / sdug cing phongs pa rnams tshim par byas nas pha ma la gsol te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la rab tu byung ste/ des brtson pa dang / bsgrub pa dang / 'bad pas phol mig lnga pa'i 'khor ba'i 'khor lo 'di nyid g.yo zhing mi brtan par rig nas/ 'du byed kyi rnam pa thams cad snyil 6ba dang / ltung ba dang / rnam par 'thor ba dang / rnam par 'jig pa'i chos can yin par rtsad chod de ri/ nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs nas dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas te/ dgra bcom pa khams gsum pa'i 'dod chags dang bral bar gyur nas gser dang bong bar mnyam pa/nam mkha' dang lag mthil 8)du 'dra ba'i sems dang ldan pa/ tsan dan sbangs pa lta bur bsil bar gyur pa/ rig pas sgo nga'i sbubasam9)bcom pa/ rig pa dang mngon par shes pa dang so so yang dag par rig pa thob pa/ srid pa'i rnyed 75—424

pa dang / chags pa dang / bkur sti la mi lta ba/ dbang po dang nye dbang dang bcas pa'i lha rnams kyisatumachod cing rjed7pa dang gus par smra ba'i gnas su gyur to/ /de nas re zhig na de bsod snyoms la song ba dang / skye bo phal po ches de la bltas nas ngo mtshar〈kyebar gyur to(ge/ /de nas pad ma'i mig bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du song nas/ bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis ci nas bdag gi nor bu rin po che ma mchis par mdzad du gsol/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ bu 'di ni las las skyes pa yin pas na nor bu rin po chesamed par bya mi nus so/ /de lta mod kyis7ci nas dad pa dang ldan pa rnams kyis ni mthong la/ ma dad pa rnams kyis ni9)mi mthong bar bya'o / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de bzhin du mdzad do/ /de nas dge slong (shedag the tsom skyes te the tsom thams cad gcod pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa pad ma'i mig gis las gang dag bgyis na/des 'di che bar grags pa dang dgra bcom pa nyid thob par gyur lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ pad ma'i mig nyid kyis sngon tshe rabs gzhan dag du tshogs rnyed cing rkyen grub pa dang ldan te dba' rgal bzhin du byung 5tshol/gdon mi za bar 'ong ba'i las de dag byas shing bsags pas na/ pad ma'i mig nyid kyis las byas shingaloste bsags pa de dag gzhan 37su zhig gis nyams su myong bar 'gyur te/ dge slong dag las byas shing bsags pa rnams ni phyi rol gyi sa'i khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur/ chu'i khams dang / me'i khams dang ske/ rlung gi khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur te/ las dge ba dang mi dge ba byas shing bsags pa rnams ni zin pa'i phung po dang khams dang skye mched 75—425

rnams 'ba' zhig la rnam par smin par 'gyur ro/ /lus can dag gi las rnams ni/ /bskal pa brgyar yang chud mi za/ /tshogs shing dus la bab pa na/ /'bras bu nyid du smin par 'gyur/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na / bskal pa dgu bcu rtsa gcig pa la de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu gdul bya'i0)kha lo sgyur ba/ bla na med pa lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnam par gzigs zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung ste de rgyal po'i pho brang gnyen ldan na rten cing bzhugs pa las(kye/ re zhig na yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs sangs rgyas kyi phrinamasalas thams cad mdzad nas/ shing zad pa'i me bzhin du phung po 44lhag ma med pa'i mya ngan las (gye'adas pa'i dbyings su yongs su mya ngan las 'das so/ /de nas rgyal po gnyen ༄nyayod kyis/ bcom ldan 'das de'i sku gdung la sku gdung gi mchod pa byas nas/ rin po che sna bzhi las byas pa'i mchod rten kho ra khor yug tu dpag tshad gcig yod la/ 'phang du rgyang grags gcig yod pa zhig brtsigs te na/ der〈srog chags 'bum phrag du mas bkur sti byas nas mtho ris dang thar par 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas re zhig na/ ded dpon zhig rgya mtsho chen po'i gru'i don grub ste/ phyir 'ongs nas des de'i nang nas nor bu rin po che yo)mthon ka chen po zhig khyer te 'ongs te/ des 9bcom ldan 'das kyi mchod rten mthong nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan rjes su dran te/ nor bu rin po che de bcom ldan 'das rnam par gzigs kyi mchod rten gyi char khab 31la btags nas/ de'i mthus 75—426

phyogs dang phyogs mtshams7thams cad mthon ku'i mdog7lta burashe'adug par byas so/ /me tog pad ma dag gis kyang mchod pa byas nas/ smon lam btab pa/ bdag gis kyang yon tan 'di lta bu dag thob par gyur cig④ /ston pa 'di lta bu mnyes par byed par gyur cig mi mnyes 0par byed par ma gyur cig ces byas so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus na ded dpon du gyur pa gang yin pa de ni pad ma'i mig 'di 0yin te/ des bcom ldan 'das rnam par gzigs kyi mchod rten la nor bu rin po che btags pa'i las de'i rnam par smin pas 'di'i mgo bo las nor bu rin po che byung ngo / /pad ma sngon po dag gis mchod pa byas pa des ni/mig pad ma sngon po lta bur gyur to/ /smon lam btab pa des ni tshe 'di nyidakyil dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas so/ /dge slong dag de ltar na las gcig tu nges par gnag pa rnams ni/ rnam par smin pa yang gcig tu nges par gnag par 'gyur ro/ /las gcig tu nges par dkar ba rnams ni rnam par smin pa yangashegacig tu nges par dkar bar 'gyur ro/ /las 'drenamagum rnams ni rnam par smin pa yang 'dren mar 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag de bas na las gcig tu nges par gnag pa rnams dang las 'dren〈nyem rnams spangs la/las gcig tu nges par dkar ba rnams 'ba' zhig la gtad par bya ste/ dge slong dag khyod ⑩kyis de ltar bslab par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ dge slong de dag yinerangs te bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// //rnga sgra zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po rnams dang /75—427

blon po chen po rnams dang / phyug po rnams dang / pho brang 'khor gyi mi rnams dang ske/ tshong dpon rnams dang / ded dpon rnams dang / lha rnams dang /klu rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams dang / lha ma yin rnams dang / nam mkha' lding rnams dang / mi 'am ci rnams dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis bkur sti byas/ bla mar byas/ ri mo0)byas/ mchod pa byas te/ lha dang /klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis mchod cing shes pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bsod nams chen po dang ldan pa/ na bza' dang / zhal zas dang / gzims cha dang / gdan dang / snyun gsos dang / sman〈mizong rnams brnyes pa/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa/ ser skya'i⑧gnas na shing n+ya gro ṅgā'i 4 kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs sriso/ /de'i tshe ser skya'i (6)gnas na shākya phyug cing ri7tshonor mang la longs spyod che ba/ yongs su 'dzin pa/yangs shing rgya che ba/ rnam thos kyi bu'i nor dang ldan pa/3) rnam thos kyi bu'i nor dang 'gran pa zhig gnas pa des/ rigs mnyam pa las chung ma blangs nas/de de dang lhan cig tu rtse zhing dga' la dga' mgur spyod do/ /de rtse zhing dga' la dga' mgur spyod pa las chung ma la bu chags nas/ de zla ba brgyad7)dam dgu lon pa dang bu byung ste khye'u gzugs bzang zhing blta nyu na sdug la mdzes pa che bar grags pa/ bya ka la ping ka ltar skad snyan pa/ rnga sgra ltar gdangs snyan pa zhig btsas so/ /de nas de btsas pa'i btsas stonas31byas nas/ khye'u 'di'i ming ji skad gdags zhes ming 'dogs par byed de/ nye du rnams na re khye'u 'di rnga sgra lta bu'i gdangs dang ldan pas na/ de'i phyir khye'u 'di'i ming 3)rnga sgra 75—428

zhes gdags so zhes zer ro/ /de nas khye'u rnga sgra pang na 'tsho ba'i ma ma gnyis dang ske/ nu ma snun pa'i ma ma gnyis dang / dri ma 'khru ba'i ma ma gnyis dang /rtse ba'i ma ma gnyis te/ de0)ma ma brgyad la gtad nas/ de ma ma brgyad kyis ②'o ma dang / zho dang / mar dang / zhun mar dang / mar gyi nying ③khu dang /gzhan yang yo byad kyi khyad par (7bzang ngo cog gis bskyed bsrings te mtsho'i (nyenang gi pad ma bzhin du skye drag par gyur to/ /de yang dad pa dang ldan la dge zhing bsam pa bzang ba/ bdag la phan pa dang gzhan la phan pa la zhugs pa/snying rje can bdag nyid che ba/ chos 'dod pa/ gdutong ba la sred pa/ sbyin pa la dga' ba/ rab tu sbyin pa la mngon par dga' ba/ gtong ba chen po la gnas pa zhig go/ /de nas phyi zhig na khye'u rnga sgra shing n+ya gro ṅgā'i56)kun dga' ra bar song ba dang / des sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sku skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis legs par brgyan pa/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus mdzes par byas pa 'od 'dom gang gis brgyan pa nyi ma stong bas lhag pa'i 'od mnga' ba/ rin po che'i ri bo 'gro ba lta bu kun nas bzang ba mthong nas/mthong ma thag tu des50bcom ldan 'das la sems dga' ba bskyedamatshedo/ /dga' ba bskyed nas kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal hu )te/ chos mnyan pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i bsam pa dang / bag la nyal dang / khams dang / rang bzhin thugs su chud nas/ 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi rtogs par 'gyur ba de lta bu'i chos bstan pa mdzad de/ de thos〈nyanas khye'u rnga sgras 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo mthon po nyi shu ye shes rdo rjes bcom nas rgyun du zhugs pa'i 75—429

'bras bu mngon sum du byas te/ des7)bden pa mthong nas sbyin pa dang rab tu sbyin pa dag byin te/ dge slong gedang bram ze dang bkren pa da/ sdug cing phongs7pa rnams tshim par byas nas pha ma la gsol te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la rab tu byung ngo / /des brtson pa dang bsgrub pa dang 'bad pas phol mig lnga pa'i 'khor ba'i 'khor lo 'di nyid g.yo zhing mi brtan ④par rig nasal/ 'du byed kyi rnam pa thams cad snyilamathab dang ltung ba dang rnam par 'thor ba dang rnam par 'jig pa'i chos can yin par rtsad chod de⑥/ nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs nas dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum ⑦du byas te/dgra bcom pa khams gsum pa'i 'dod chags dang bral bar gyurashenas gser dang bong bar mnyam pa6)/ nam mkha' dang lag mthil the )du 'dra ba'i sems dang ldan pa/ tsan dan sbangs pa lta bur bsil bar 31gyur pa/ rig pas sgo nga'i sbubs bcom pa/ rig pa dang mngon par shes pa dang so so yang dag par rig pa thob pa/ srid pa'i rnyed pa dang chags pa dang bkur sti la mi lta tunyeb/dbang po dang nye dbang dang bcas pa'i lha rnams kyis mchod cing rjed ⑩pa dang gus par smra ba'i gnas su gyur to/ /de nas dge slong dag the tsom skyes te/the tsom thams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa rnga sgras las gang dag 7bgyis na/ des 'di gzugs bzang zhing bltasnyin sdug la mdzes par gyur te/ dgra bcom pa nyid kyang thob par gyur lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rnga sgra nyid kyis sngon tshe rabs gzhan dag tu tshogs rnyed cing rkyen grub pa dang ldan te/ dba' rgal bzhin du 'byung la gdon mi za bar 'ong ba'i las de dag byas shing bsags pas na rnga sgra nyid kyis las 75—430

byas shing bsags pa de dag gzhan su zhig gis nyams su myong bar 'gyur te/dge slong dag las byas shing bsags pa rnams ni phyi rol gyi sa'i khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur/ chu'i khams dang me'i khams dang rlung gi khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur te/ las dge ba dang mi dge ba byas shing bsags pa rnams ni zin pa'i phung po dang / khams dang skye mched rnams 'ba' zhig la rnam par min par 'gyur ro/ /lus can dag gi las rnams ni/ /bskal pa brgyar yang chud mi za/ /tshogs shing dus la bab pa na/ /'bras bu nyid du smin par 'gyur/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na bskal pa dgu bcu rtsa gcig pa la/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu gdul bya'i7kha lo sgyur ba/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnam par gzigs zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung ste/ de rgyal po'i pho brang gnyen ldan na rten cingasnyibazhugs pa lasal/ re zhig na yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs sangs rgyas kyi phrinasrelas thams cad mdzad nas/ shing zad pa'i me bzhin du phung po'i lhag ma med pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su yongs su mya ngan las 'das so/ /de nas rgyal po gnyen yod kyis/ bcom ldan 'das de'i sku gdung la sku gdung gi mchod pa byas nas/ rin po che sna bzhi las9)byas pa'i mchod rten kho ra khor yug tu dpag tshad gcig yod la/ 'phang du rgyang grags gcig yod pa zhig brtsigs teni/ der srog chags 'bum phrag du mas bkur sti byas nas mtho ris dang thar par 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas re zhig na khyim 75—431

bdag cig gis rol mo'i cha byad0)rnam pa sna tshogs dang mi las rol mo bslabs te / mchod rten desal phul nas de dag mchod rten de la nyin gcig bzhin du rol mo'i sgra'i52)khyad par dag gis bkur sti byed do/ /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus na khyim bdag tu gyur pa gang yin pa de ni rnga sgra 'di yin te/ des bcom ldan 'das rnam par gzigs kyi mchod rten la rol mo'i sgra'i 0)cha byad 5rnam pa (6)sna tshogs phul ba des na rnga sgra lta bu'i gdangs can du gyur la/ rgyu de nyid kyis na da ltar dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas so/ /dge slong dag de ltar na las gcig tu nges par gnag pa rnams ni rnam par smin pa yang gcig tu nges par gnag par 'gyur ro/ /las gcig tu nges par dkar ba rnams ni rnam par smin pa yang gcig tu nges par dkar bar 'gyur ro//las 'dren ma rnams ni rnam par smin pa yang 'dren mar 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag de bas na las gcig tu nges par gnag pa rnams dang las 'dren ma rnams spangs la/ las gcig tu nges par dkar ba rnams 'ba'abazhig la gtad par bya ste/ dge slong khyod 8)kyis de ltar bslab par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ dge slong de dag yisaphyorangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// //7bu zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po rnams dang /blon po chen po rnams dang / phyug po rnams dang / pho brang 'khor gyi mi rnams dang ske/ tshong dpon rnams dang / ded dpon rnams dang / lha rnams dang /klu rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams dang / lha ma yin rnams dang / nam mkha' lding rnams dang / mi 'am ci rnams dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis 75—432

bkur sti byas/ bla mar byas/ ri mo ①byas/ mchod pa byas te/ lha dang /klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci rnamasasnyedang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis mchod cing shes pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bsod nams chen po dang ldan pa/ na bza' dang /zhal zas dang / gzims cha dang / gdan dang / snyan gsos dang / sman zong rnams brnyes pa/ nyan thos kyi5)dge 'dun dang bcas pa ser skya'isnyiganas na0shing n+ya gro d+ma'i kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe ser skya'i gnas na shākya phyug cing nor mang la longs spyod che ba/ yongs su 'dzin pa yangs shing rgya che ba rnam thos kyi bu'i nor dang ldan pa/ rnam thos kyi7bu'i nor dang 'gran pa zhig gnas pa des/ rigs mnyam pa las chung ma blangs nas de de dang lhan nicig tu rtse zhing dga' la dga' mgur spyod do/ /de rtse zhing dga' la dga' mgural )spyod pa las chung ma la5)bu chags nas/ de zla ba brgyad dam dgu lon te bu btsas na hu sha snag bu chen po zhig byung ste/ pha ma dang khyim de na tunyeganas pa tsogazhan dag dang g.yog 'khor dang nye du rnams kyis de mthong nas 'di lta bu btsas pa ci yin zhes mi dga' bar gyur to/ /de nas re zhig na khyim bdag de mya ngan gyi khang bur zhugs te/ lag pa la skom tshugs bcas nas sems khong du chud cing7'dug ste 'di ci yin/ su la bsnyad par bya / shes pa su yod snyam mo de nas de'i blo skyes pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'di ni thams cad mkhyen pa thams cad gzigs pa yin te()/ des mkhyen gyis (nyesangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la bsnyad par bya'o snyam nas/ de bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste〈nyephyin nas bcom ldan 'das la zhus5) so/ /75—433

bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ khyim bdag khyod ma 'jigs shig ma 'jigs shig /sha snag bu de ras bal legs par rmelatuba'i nang du chugashel zhag bdun gyi bar du nyin gcig kyang dus gsum gsumadzabadu lag pas0brims te/'o mas kyangs45)yang dang yang du gtor cig dang de'i 'og tu rdol te/ bu brgya 'byung bar 'gyur la de dag thams cad tshan po che'i stobs dang ldan par 'gyur thoyoske/ /de nas khyim bdag des de thos nas mchog tu ya mtshan du gyur te/bsams pa bdag gis bu de (8)lta bu dag 'byung bar 'gyur ba ni bdag gis rnyed pa legs par rnyed do snyamalo)nas des de bzhin du byas pa dang / zhag bdun lon pa dang ⑩sha snag bu de rdol nas bu brgya byung ste/ thams cad kyang gzugs bzang zhing blta (men sdug la mdzes pa yan lag dang nying lag thams cad dang ldan pa/ tshan po che'i〈nyestobs dang ldan pa sha stag go/ /de nas re zhig na mthar gyis bskyed bsrings /nyenas cher skyes pa dang / de dag thams cad byad gzugs dang lang tsho'itsha8rgyags pas dregs te/ phan tshun 'khyam pa las shing n+ya gro d+ma'i78kun dga' ra bar song ba dang / de dag gis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sku skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis legs par brgyan pa/dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus mdzes par byas pa/ 'od 'dom gang gis brgyan pa/ nyi ma stong bas lhag pa'i 'od mnga' ba rin po che'i ri bo 'gro ba lta bu kun nas bzang ba mthong nas/ mthong ma thag tu de dag gis bcom ldan 'das la sems dga' ba bskyedamatshado/ /dga' ba bskyed nas kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal te/ chos nyan shepa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'khod do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis〈nyede dag gi bsam pa dang /75—434

bag la nyal dang / khams dang / rang bzhin thugs su chud nas/ 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi rtogs par 'gyur ba de lta bu'i chos bstan pa mdzad de/ de thos nas thams cad kyis 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo mthon po nyi shu ye shes rdo rjes ①bcom nas rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas te/de dag gis bden pa mthong nas pha ma la gsol te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la rab tu byung ngo / /de dgashethams cad kyis brtson pa dang bsgrub〈mipa dang 'bad pas phol mig lnga pa'i 'khor ba'i 'khor lo 'di nyid g.yo zhing mi brtan par rig nas 'du byed kyi rnam pa thams cad snyilasnyib dang ltung ba dang rnam par 'thor ba dang rnam par 'jig pa'i chos can yin par rtsad chod de/nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs nas dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas te/dgra bcom pa khams gsum pa'i 'dod chags dang bral bar gyur nas/ gser dang bong bar mnyam pa/ nam mkha' dang lag mthil du 'dra ba'i sems dang ldan pa/ tsan dan sbangs pa lta bur bsil bar gyur pa/ rig pas sgo nga'i sbubs ⑦bcom pa/ rig pa dang mngon par shes pa dang so so yang dag par rig pa thob pa/ srid pa'i rnyed pa dang chags pa dang bkur ste la mi lta ba/dbang po dang nye dbang dang bcas pa'i lha rnams kyis mchod cing rjedashepa dang gus par smra ba'i gnas su gyur to/ /de nas dge slong dag the com skyes te/ the tsom thams cad gcod pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ⑨la zhus pa/btsun pa gzhon nu brgya po 'di dag gis las gang dag bgyis〈nyen/ des spun du gyur la tshan po che'i stobs dang ldan par gyur lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'di rnams kyis5)sngon tshe rabs gzhan dag tu tshogs rnyed cing 75—435

rkyen grub pa dang ldan te/ dba' rgal bzhin du byungatul gdon mi za bar 'ong ba'i 6)las de dag byas shing bsags pas na/ 'di dag nyid kyis las byas shing bsags pa7de dag gzhan su zhig gis nyams su myong bar 'gyur te/ dge slong dag las byas shing bsags pa rnams ni phyi rol gyi sa'i khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur/ chu'i khams dang / me'i khams dang / rlung gi khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur te/ las dge ba dang mi dge ba byas shing bsags pa rnams ni zin pa'i phung po dang khams dang skye mched rnams 'ba' zhig la rnam par smin par 'gyur ro/ /lus can dag gi las rnams ni/ /bskal pa brgyar yang chud mi za/ /tshogs shing dus la bab pa na/ /'bras bu nyid du smin par 'gyur/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na/ bskal pa dgu bcu rtsa gcig pa la de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu gdul bya'i che)kha lo sgyurams ba/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa(ge/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnam par gzigs zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung ste/ de rgyal po'i pho brang gnyen ldan na rten cing bzhugs pa las / re zhig na yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs kyisashesangs rgyas kyi phrinasalas thams cad mdzad nas/ shing zad pa'i me bzhin du phung po'i lhag ma med pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su yongs su mya ngan las 'das so/ /de nas rgyal po gnyen yod kyis/ bcom ldan 'das de'i sku gdung la0)sku gdung gi mchod pa byas nas/ rin po che sna bzhi las byas pa'i mchod rten kho ra khor yug tu dpag tshad gcig yod la/ 'phang du rgyang grags 75—436

gcig yod pa zhig brtsigs te/ der srog chags 'bum phrag du mas bkur ste byas nas mtho ris dang thar par 'gro bar 'gyur ro①/ /de nas re zhig na mdza' sde bo ②brgya phyi rol tu byung ba dang de dag gis mchod rten de mthong nas/de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan rjes su dran te/ de dag gis7lhan cig tu til mar spos can gyis byugs nas/ me tog dang me tog phreng dang mar me dbul ba dag gis kyangasnyibasnyen bkur byas nas lhan cig tu smon lam btab pa/bdag cag gang dang gang du skyes pa de dang der spun du gyur te/ lhan cig tu lto gcig kho na nas 'byungasnyibar gyur cig /tshan po che'i stobs kyi shugs thob pa dang byad gzugs dang ldan par gyur cig /ma 'ongs pa'i dus na yang yang9)dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams mnyes par byed par gyur cig /mi mnyes par byed par ma gyur cig ces7byas so/ /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus na mdza' sde bor〈)gyur pa gang yin pa de dag ni tshan po che 'di dag yin te/ de dag gis lhan cig tu mchod rten de7la bkur sti byas pa des na 'di ltar lhan cig tu skyes te/ tshan po che'i stobs kyi shugs thob par gyur to/ /smon lam btab pa des ni megacig tu 'thunaphanyepar〈nyerab tu byung nas dgra bcom pa nyid thob par gyur toskyo/ /dge slong dag de ltar na las gcig tu nges par gnag pa rnams ni rnam par smin pa7yang gcig tu nges par gnag par 7'gyur ro/ /las gcig tu nges par dkar ba rnams ni rnam par smin pa yang gcig tu nges par dkar bar 'gyur ro/ /las 'dren mtshwa)rnams ni rnam par smin pa yang 'drenatshwanyemar 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag de bas na las gcig tu nges par gnag pa rnams dang las 'dren〈 ) ma rnams spangs la/ las 75—437

gcig tu nges par dkar ba rnams 'ba' zhig la gtad par bya ste/ dge slong khyod7kyis de ltar bslab par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nasal/ dge slong desadag yisnyirangs te bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// // gang po la sogs pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa brgya pasnyibam po bcu drug pa/ nyi ma zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po rnams dang / blon po chen po rnams dang / phyug po rnams dang / pho brang 'khor gyi mi rnams dang /tshong dpon rnams dang / ded dpon rnams dang / lha rnams dang / klu rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams dang / lhasam yin rnams dang / nam mkha' lding rnams dang / mi 'am ci rnams dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis bkur ste byas/ bla mar byas/ ri moshebyas/ mchod pa byas te/ lha dang /klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis mchod cing shes pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bsod nams mechen po dang ldan pa/ na bza' dang / zhal zas dang / gzims cha dang / gdan dang / snyun gsos dang / sman zong rnams brnyes pa/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang〈snabacas pa/ yul ser skya'i gnas na shing n+ya gro d+ma'im kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe ser skya'iloganas na/ shākya〈nyephyug cing nor mang la longs spyod che ba/ yongs su 'dzin pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ rnam thos kyi bu'i nor dang ldan pa/ rnam thos kyi bu'i nor dang 'gran pa zhig gnas pa des rigs mnyam pa las chung ma blangs nas/de de dang lhan cig tu rtse zhing dga' la dga' mgur spyod do/ /de rtse zhing dga' 75—438
