la dga' mgur spyod pa las chung ma la bu chags nas/ de zla ba brgyad dam dgu lon pa dang bu byung ste khye'u gzugs bzang zhing blta7na sdug la mdzes pa nor bu rin po che mgo bo la thogs pa zhig btsas nas/ de las kho ra khor yug tu nyi ma'i 'od zer lta bu 'phro ste/ de'i snang bas mtshan mo grong khyer ser skya'i gnas thams cad khyab par gyur pas nyin mo bzhin du snang bar byas so/ /de nas pha ma dang khyim de na gnas pa'i g.yog 'khor rnams dang nye du rnams dang ser skya'i gnas na 'khod pa'i shākya rnams kyis de mthong nas/ ya mtshan du gyur te dga' bas rgyas so/ /de nas de btsas pa'i btsas ston byas nas/ khye'u 'di'i ming ji skad gdags zhes ming 'dogasalgepar byed de/ nye du rnams na re khye'u 'di btsas ma thag tu grong khyer ser skya'i gnas thams cad nyi ma bzhin du snang bar byas pasasnyen/ de'i phyir khye'u 'di'i ming nyi ma zhes gdags so zhesasnyizer ro/ / de nas khye'u nyi ma pang na 'tsho ba'i ma ma gnyis dang / nu ma snun pa'i ma ma gnyis dang / dri ma 'khru ba'i ma marnyuganyis dang / rtse ba'i ma ma gnyis te ma ma brgyad la gtad nas/ de ma ma brgyad kyisashe'o ma dang / zho dang / mar dang / zhun mar dang zha mar gyi nying〈khu dang / gzhan yang yo byad kyi khyad par bzang ngo cog gis bskyed bsrings te mtsho'i nang gi pad ma bzhin du skye drag par gyur to/ /de yang dad pa dang ldan la dge zhing bsam pa bzang ba/bdag la phan pa dang gzhan la phan pa la zhugs pa snying rje can/ bdag nyid che ba/ chos 'dod pa/ skye dgu la byams pa/ gtong ba la sred pa/ sbyin pa la dga' ba/ rab tu sbyin pa la mngon par dga' ba gtong ba chen po la gnas pa zhig go/ /de nas phyis re zhig na/ khye'u nyi ma shing n+ya gro ṅgā'i〈nyekun dga' ra 75—439

bar7song ba dang / des sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sku skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis ②legs par labargyan pa/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus mdzes par byas pa/ 'od 'dom gang gis brgyan pa/ nyi ma stong bas lhag pa'i 'od mnga' ba/ rin po che'i ri bo 'gro ba lta bu kun nas bzang ba mthong nas/ mthong ma thag tu des5nyebacom ldan 'das la sems dga' bkyibaskyed do/ /dga' ba bskyed nas kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal7)te / chos mnyan pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das kyisaspyan sngar 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i bsam pa dang bag la nyal dang khams dang rang bzhin thugs su chud nas/ 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi rtogs par 'gyur ba de lta bu'i chos bstan te/ de thos nas/phyog khye'u nyi mas 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo mthon po nyi shu ye shes rdo rjes bcom nas rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas te/ des bden pa mthong nas sbyin pa dang rab tu sbyin pa dag byin te/ dge sbyong dang / bram ze dang / bkren pa dang / sdug cing phongs nyu1pa rnams tshim par byas nas pha ma la gsol te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la rab tu byung ngo / /des sgrubartson pa dang bsgrub pa dang 'bad pas phol mig lnga pa'i 'khor ba'i 'khor lo 'di nyid g.yo zhing mi brtan par rig nas/'du byed kyi rnam pa thams cad snyil 13ba dang / ltung ba dang / rnam par 'thoralo7ba dang / rnam par 'jig pa'i chos can yin par rtsad chod de/ nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs nas dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum (nyedu byas te/dgra bcom pa khams gsum pa'i 'dod chags dang bral bar gyur nas/ gser dang bong bar mnyam pa/ nam mkha' dang lag mthil du 'dra ba'i sems dang 75wa 440

ldan pa/ tsan dan sbangs pa lta bur bsil bar gyur pa/ rig pas sgo nga'i sbubs bcom pa/ rig pa dang mngon par shes pa dang so so yang dag par rig pa thob pa/ srid pa'i rnyed pa dang chags pa dang bkur ste la mi lta ba/ dbang po dang nye dbang dang bcas pa'i lha rnams kyis mchod cing rjed nyu1pa dang gus par smra ba'i gnas su gyur to/ /de nas gang gi tshe tshe dang ldan pa nyi ma bsod snyoms la 'gro ba ②de'i tshe bram ze dang khyim bdag ma dad pa rnams 'phya ③zhing smod la lkogashe'aphyas byed de/ de 'di ltar nor bu rin po che mgo bo la thogs nas / lam po che dang srang dang bzhi mdo dang / sum mdo dag tu 'khyam pa las na⑦/ shākya'i bu'i dge sbyong rnams kyi dge sbyong gi tshul ni tshig pa'o/ /bram ze'i tshul ni tshig pa'o zhes 'dzer7to/ /de nas de shin tu ngo tsha bar gyur nas / bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal te⑨/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis ci nas bdag gi nor bu rin po che ma mchis par mdzad du gsol / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ bu 'di ni las las skyes pa yin pas na med par byar mi nus so/ /de lta mod kyi ci nas dad pa dang ldan pa rnams kyis ni hunyamathong la/ ma dad pa rnams kyis ni7)mi mthong bar bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis7de bzhin du mdzad do/ /de nas dge slong dag the tsom skyes te/ the tsom thams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsunasapa nyi mas las gang dag bgyisashin/ des 'di che bar grags pa dang dgra bcom pa nyid thob par gyur lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis57bka' stsal pa/ nyi ma nyid kyis zesngon tshe rabs gzhan dag tu tshogs rnyed cing 75—441

rkyen grub pa dang ldan te/ dba' rgal bzhin du byungatul gdon mi za bar 'ong ba'i las de dag byas shing bsags pas na②/ nyi ma nyid kyis las byas shing bsags pa de dag gzhan su zhig57gis nyams su myong bar 'gyur te/ dge slong dag las byas shing bsags pa rnams ni phyi rol gyi sa'i khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur/ chu'i khams dang / me'i khams dang / rlung gi khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur te/ las dge ba dang mi dge ba byas shing bsags pa rnams ni zin pa'i phung po dang khams dang skye ④mched rnams du'aba' zhig la rnam par smin par 'gyur ro/ /lus can dag gi las rnams ni/ /bskal pa brgyar yang chud mi za/ /tshogs shing dus la bab pa na/ /'bras bu nyid du smin par 'gyur/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na/ bskal pa dgu bcu rtsa (6)gcig pa la de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu gdul bya'i7kha lo sgyurarnyub/ bla na med pa lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnam par gzigs zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung ste/ de7rgyal po'i pho brang gnyen ldan na rten cing bzhugs pa las/ re zhig na yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs sangs rgyas kyi phrin7 las thams cad mdzad nas shing zad pa'i me bzhin du phung po'i lhag ma med pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su yongs su mya ngan las 'das so/ /de nas rgyal po gnyen yod kyis/ bcom ldan 'das de'i sku gdung la5)sku gdung gi mchod pa byas nas/ rin po che sna bzhi las byas pa'i mchod rten kho ra khor yug tu dpag tshad gcig yod la 'phang du rgyang grags gcig yod 75—442

pa zhig brtsigs te/ der srog chags 'bum phrag du mas bkur sti byas nas mtho ris dang thar par 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ / de nasatumachod rten de'i mchod pa la bab pa na②/ bram ze dang khyim bdag dad pa dang ldan pa rnams kyis spos dang /me tog phrengasredang / byug pa rnam pa sna tshogs dang / gdugs dang /④ rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / rol mo'i sgra rnams kyis mchod pa byed do/ /de nas re zhig na mi zhig rgyal po dang rgyan pos7rtses nas skugs su nor bu rin po che me shel zhig thob po/ /de nas de dad pa bskyed nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par gzigs kyi mchod rten gyi char khabasnyel btags te/ zhabs la phyag 'tshal7nas smon lam btab pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba dang sems bskyed pa dang sbyin par bya ba'i chos yongs su gtong ba 'dis na bdag gis kyang 'di lta bu'i yon tan dag thob par gyur cig /ston pa 'di lta bu mnyes par byed par gyur cig /mi mnyes par byed par ma gyur cig /nor bu rin po che 'di lta bu yang spyi bo la thogs bzhin du ma'i lto nas 'byung bar gyurarwanyecig ces byas so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus na cho lo la dor sgyu byed pa gang yin pa de ni nyi ma 'di nyid yin te/ des7bcom ldan 'das rnam par gzigs kyi mchod rten la bkur sti byas pa dang /nor bu rin po che btags5)pa des na/ 'di'ichamago bo las nor bu rin po che byung la rgyu de nyid kyis gzugs bzang zhing blta (nyen sdug la mdzes par gyur te/dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas so/ /dge slong dag de ltar na las gcig tu nges par gnag pa rnams ni rnam par smin pa yang gcig tu nges par gnag par 'gyur ro/ /las gcig tu nges par dkar ba rnams ni rnam par smin pa 75—443

yang gcig tu nges par dkar bar 'gyur ro/ /las 'drenatum rnams ni rnam par smin pa yang 'drenasamar 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag de bas na las gcig tu nges par gnag pa rnams dang / las 'drenasnyem rnams spangs la/ las gcig tu nges par dkar ba rnams 'ba' zhig la gtad par bya ste/ dge slong khyod kyis de ltar bslab par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ dge slong de 4)dag yi〈perangs te bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// //gyad kyi ba dan zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po rnams dang / blon po chen po rnams dang / phyug po rnams dang / pho brang 'khor gyi mi rnams dang / tshong dpon rnams dang / ded dpon rnams dang /lha rnams dang / klu rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams dang / lha ma yin rnams dang ske/ nam mkha' lding rnams dang / mi 'am ci rnams dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis bkur ste byas/ bla mar byas/ ri mo9)byas/ mchod pa byas te/lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang ske/ mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis mchod cing shes pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bsod nams chen po dang ldan pa/ na bza' dang /zhal zas dang / gzims cha dang / gdan dang / snyan gsos dang / sman zong rnams brnyes pa/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa yul ser skya'i gnas na shing n+ya gro ṅgā'i 7kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe ser skya'i gnas na shākya phyug cing nor mang la longs spyod che ba/ yongs su 'dzin pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ rnam thos kyi bu'i nor dang ldan pa/ rnam thos kyi bu'i 75—444

nor dang 'gran pa zhig gnas pa des rigs mnyam pa las chung ma blangs nas/de de dang lhan cig tu rtse zhing dga' la dga' mgur spyod do/ /de rtse zhing dga' la dga' mgur spyod pa las chung ma la bu chags nas/ de zla ba brgyad dam dgu lon pa dang bu byung ste khye'u gzugs bzang zhing blta0)na sdug la mdzes pa mi'i kha dog las ni 'das/ lha'i kha dog ni ma thob pa zhig btsas te/ gang gi tshe khye'u de btsas pa de'i tshe lha rnams kyis kho ra khor yug nas lha'i ba dan dag bsgrengs sonya/ /lha'i rol mo'i cha byad dag kyang brdungs so/ /lha'i me tog ud pa lasnyedang / pad ma dang / ku mu da dang / pad ma dkar po rnams kyis kyang gtor te/ ser skya'i gnas kyi grong khyer thams cad du grags pas rgyas par gyur to/ /khyim thams cad du yang de'i phyir ba dan bsgrengs li/ /de nas de btsas pa'i btsas ston byas nas/ khye'u 'di'i ming ji skad gdags zhes ming 'dogasalgepar byed de/ nye du rnams na re khye'u 'di btsas pa na 'jig rten thams cad na grags pas rgyas pas7na/ de'i phyir khye'u 'di'i ming snyan grags zhes gdags so zhes zer ro/ /de nas khye'u snyan grags pang na 'tsho ba'i ma ma gnyis dang / nu ma snun pa'i ma ma gnyis dang / dri ma 'khru ba'i ma ma gnyis dang / rtse ba'i ma ma gnyis te ma ma brgyad la gtad nas/ de ma ma brgyad kyis 'o ma dang / zho dang / mar dang / zhun mar dang / mar7gyi nying khu dang / gzhan yang yo byad kyi khyad par bzang ngo cog gis bskyed bsrings te mtsho'i nang gi pad ma bzhin du skye drag par gyur tetunye/ de yang dad pa dang ldan la dge zhing bsam pa bzang ba bdag la phan pa dang / gzhan la phan pa la zhugs pa/ snying rje can/ bdag nyid che ba/ chos 'dod pa zhig 75—445

gol/ /de nas phyis re zhig na khye'u snyan grags shing n+ya gro d+ma'i7kun dga' ra bar song ba dang / desashesangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sku skyes0bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis legs par brgyan pa/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus mdzes par byas pa/ 'od 'dom gang gis brgyan9)pa/ nyi ma stong bas lhag pa'i 'od mnga' ba/ rin po che'i ri bo 'gro ba lta bu kun nas bzang ba mthong nas / mthong ma thag tu des bcom ldan 'das la sems dga' ba bskyedakyido/ /dga' ba bskyed nas kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal7te/ chos mnyan pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i bsam pa dang bag la nyal dang khams dang rang bzhin thugs su chud nas/ 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi rtogs par 'gyur bsnyede lta bu'i chos bstan to7)/ /de thos tsonas khye'u snyan grags kyis 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo mthon po nyi shu ye shes rdo rjes bcom nas/ rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu thob ste des bden pa mthong nas/ sbyin pa dang rab tu sbyin pa dag byin5)te/ dge sbyong dang bram ze dang bkren pa dang sdug cing tunyephongs pa rnams tshim par byas nas pha ma la gsol te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la rab tu byung ngo / /des brtson pa dang / bsgrub pa dang / 'bad pas phol mig lnga pa'i 'khor ba'i 'khor lo 'di nyid g.yo zhing mi brtan par rig nas/ 'du byed kyi rnam pa thams cad snyil 51snyeb dang / ltung ba dang / rnam par 'thor ba dang / rnam par 'jig pa'i chos can yin par rtsad chod de/ nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs nas dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas te/ dgra bcom pa khams gsum pa'i 'dod chags tsodang bral bar gyur nas/ gser dang bong bar 75wa 446

mnyam pa/ nam mkha' dang lag mthil du 'dra ba'i sems dang ldan pa/ tsan dan sbangs pa lta bur bsilatubar gyur pa/ rig pas sgo nga'i sbubs bcom pa rig pa dang mngon par shes pa dang so so yang dag par rig pa thob pa/ srid palarnyed pa dang chags pa dang bkur sti la mi lta ba/ dbang po dang nye dbang dang bcas pa'i lha rnams kyis mchod cing rjedakhupa dang gus par smra ba'i gnas su gyer to/ /de yang gsol ba btab ste phul ba'i gos spyod de / gsol ba btab ste phul ba ma yin pa ni nyung du spyod do④/ /gsol ba btab ste phul ba'i zas dang mal cha dang stan dang nad gsos dang sman zong spyod de0/ gsol ba btab ste phul ba ma yin pa ni nyung du spyod do/ /de nas dge slong dag the tsom skyes te'u/ the tsom thams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa / btsun pa snyan grags kyis las gang dag bgyis na/ des btsas ma thag tu lha rnams kyis ba dan bsgrengs nas/ 'jig rten du grags pas rgyas par gyur la/ rab tu byung nas dgra bcom pa nyid thob par gyur lags/ cibacom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag snyan grags nyid kyis sngon tshe rabs gzhan dag tu tshogs rnyed cing rkyen grub pa dang ldan te/ dba' rgal bzhin du byung ⑧la gdon mi za bar 'ong ba'i las de dag byas shing bsags pas na⑨/snyan grags nyid kyis las byas shing bsags pa de dag gzhan su zhig gis7nyams su myong bar 'gyur te/ dge slong dag las byas shing bsags pa rnams7)ni/phyi rol gyi sa'i khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur/ chu'i khams dang /me'i khams dang / rlung gi khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur te/ las dge ba dang mi dge ba byas shing bsags pa rnams ni/ zin pa'i phung po dang 75—447

khams dang skye mched rnams 'ba' zhig la rnam par smin par 'gyur ro/ /lus can dag gi0)las rnams ni/ /bskal pa brgyar yang chud mi za/ /tshogs shing dus la bab pa na/ /'bras bu nyid du smin par 'gyur/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na/ bskal pa dgu bcu rtsa gcig pa la de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu gdul bya'i50kha lo sgyur ba/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnam par gzigs zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung ste/ de rgyal po'i pho brang gnyen ldan na rten cing bzhugs pa las/ re zhig na yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigasashesangs rgyas kyi phrinakyilas thams cad mdzad nas/ shing zad pa'i me bzhin du phung po'i lhag ma med pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su yongs su mya ngan las 'das so/ /de nas rgyal po gnyen yod kyis bcom ldan 'das de'i sku gdung la sku gdung gi mchod pa byas nas / rin po che sna bzhi las byas pa'i mchod rten kho ra khor yug tu dpag tshad gcig yod la/ 'phang du rgyang grags gcig yod pa zhig brtsigs te/ der srog chags 'bum phrag du mas bkur ste byas nas mtho ris dang thar par 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas re zhig na rgyal po gnyen yod kyis mchod rten de la dus ston byas nas/ mchod rten gyi dus ston byed pa der gyad 'gyed pa rnams kyisakyib dan dag sgreng9)ngo / /de nas re zhig na rgyal po'i gyad gcig gis gyad gcig non pa dang / des gyad kyi ba dan thob nas des de blangs te/ srog chags 'bum phrag du ma'i 'khor dang bcas pas ⑧rol mo'i sgra rnam pa sna tshogs len 75—448

cing ske/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par gzigs kyi mchod rten ga la ba der song ste phyin nas bcom ldan 'das kyi yon tan dran par byas te/ ba dan de mchod rten gyi steng gi srog shing la btags nas smon lam btab pa/ bdag gis kyang yon tan 'di lta bu dag thob par gyur cig /ston pa 'di lta bu bdag gis mnyes par byed par gyur cig /mi mnyes7par byed par ma gyur cig ces byas so/ /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus na gyad du gyur pa gang yin pa de ni snyan grags 'di yin te/ des ②bcom ldan 'das rnam par gzigs kyi mchod rten la bsnyen bkur byas pa des na 'khor ba na ①bde ba mtha' yas pa dumyong bar gyur la/ rgyu de nyid kyis da ⑤ltar yang dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas so/ /dge slong dag de ltar na las gcig tu nges par gnag pa rnams ni rnam par smin pa yang gcig tu nges par gnag par 'gyur ro/ /las gcig tu nges par dkar ba rnams ni rnam par smin pa yang gcig tu nges par dkar bar 'gyur ro/ /las 'dren ma rnams ni rnam par smin pa yang 'dren mar 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag de bas na las gcig tu nges par gnag pa rnams dang las 'dren risam rnams spangs la/ las gcig tu nges par dkar ba rnams 'ba' zhig la gtad par bya ste/ dge slong khyod0)kyis de ltar bslab par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/dge slong de dag yi kyirangs te bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do/ /gang po la sogs pa'itsha/stortogs pa brjod7)pa brgya pa las/ rtogs pa brjod (nyepa sna tshogs zhes bya ba ste/ sdom gyi tshigs su bcad 8pa bdun pa rdzogs sonya// //75wa 449

mdzes ldan ma dang mu tig dang / /ka tsang phyag la bde byed ma/ /mi sdug sde tshan bcad de bstan/ /'od bzang ma zhes bya ba ni/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po rnams dang / blon po chen po rnams dang / phyug po rnams dang ske/ pho brang 'khor gyi mi rnams dang / tshong dpon rnams dang / ded dpon rnams dang / lha rnams dang / klu rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams dang ske/ lha ma yin rnams dang / nam mkha' lding rnams dang / mi 'am ci rnams dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis bkur ste byas/ bla mar byas ri mo5)byas/ mchod pa byas te/ lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis mchod cing shes pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bsod nams chen po dang ldan pa/ na bza' dang / zhal zas dang / gzims cha dang /gdan dang / snyun gsos dang / sman zong rnams brnyes pa/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa/ mnyan du yod pa na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe mnyan du yod pa na/ tshong dpon phyug cing nor mang la longs spyod che ba yongs su 'dzin pa yangs shing rgya che ba rnam thos kyi bu'i nor dang ldan pa/ rnam thos kyi bu'i nor dang 'gran pa zhig gnas pa des/ rigs mnyam pa las chung ma blangs nasal/ de de dang lhan cig tu rtse zhing dga' la dga' mgur spyod do/ /de rtse zhing dga' la dga' mgur ④spyod pa las chung ma la bu chags nas de zla ba brgyad 75—450

dam dgu lon pa dang bu byung ste/ bu mo gzugs bzang zhing blta7na sdug la mdzes pa lha'i rgyan gyis bklubs ②pa nor bu rin po che mgul na thogs pa zhig btsas te/ de lasarnyu'od byung ba des mnyan du yod pa thams cad snang bar byas so/ /de nas de btsas pa'i btsas ston byas nas/ bu mo 'di'i ming ji skad gdags zhes ming 'dogs par byed de/ nye du rnams na re bu mo 'di btsas ma thag tu nor bu rin po che'i0'od kyis mnyan du yod pa thams cad snang bar byas pasakyin/ de'i phyir bu mo 'di'i ming 'od bzang ma zhes gdags so zhes zer ro/ /de nas bu mo 'od bzang ma pang na 'tshokhuba'i ma ma gnyis dngas/nu ma7snun pa'i ma ma gnyis dang / dri ma 'khru ba'i ma ma gnyis dang / rtse ba'i ma ma gnyis te/ ma ma brgyad la gtad nas7/ de ma ma brgyad kyis〈nya'o ma dang / zho dang / mar dang / zhun mar dang / mar gyi nying khu〈nyedang /gzhan yang yo byad kyi khyad par bzang ngo cog gis bskyed bsrings te mtsho'i nang gi pad ma bzhin du skye drag par gyur to8/ /bu mo de yang dad pa dang ldan la dge zhing bsam pa bzang 'kho/ bdag la phan pa dang gzhan la phan pa la zhugs pa zhig ste/ de la slongasnyib su dang su 'ongs kyang rung ba de dang de dag la mgul nas rgyan bkrol te sbyin par byed do/ /byin nas kyang yang rgyan7'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas gang gi tshe bu mo de mthar gyis chen mor gyur pa de'i tshe rgyal po'i bu rnams dang / blon po'i bu rnams dang / tshong dpon gyi bu mang po dag de slong du 'ong ngo / /de nas de dag gis gnod par gyur nas/de'i pha lag pa la rkomatshwa)tshugs bcas te bsams7)pa/ gal te gcig la byin na ni gzhan rnams bdag gi dgrar 'gyur ro snyam nas/ sems khong dukyi chud cing 75—451

'dug go/ /de nas re zhig na bu mo des pha sems khong du7chud pa mthong nas/smras pa/ yab ci zhig gis sems khong du7chud cing bzhugs/ de nas desalgede'i don rgyas par bsnyad do/ /de nas7bu mo de na re yab thugs ngan ma mdzad cig dang / da ste zhag bdun na bdag nyid kyis khyim thab 'damasapar 'tshal lo zhes zer ro/ /de nas tshong dpon des rgyal po gsal rgyal la gsol nasalgemanyan du yod par dril bsgrags te/ da ste zhag bdun na bu mo 'od bzang ma rang nyid (bekhyim thab 'dam par chad kyis khyed kyis ⑧bya ba gang yin pa de gyis shig ces byas so/ /de nas zhag bdun lon pa dang bu mo 'od bzang ma shing rta la zhon te lachos gos tshon can gyi rgyal mtshan bsgreng nas/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi sku gzugs ri mor bris te bstod pa 'don cing sung du zhugs so/ /de nas der rgyal po'i bu rnams dang / blon po'i bu rnams dang / tshong dpon gyi bu rnams de la yid smon byed cing lta ba de dag la gtam rnam pa sna tshogs kyis shad kyis byang bar bshad de/ bdag gis khyed la gang gi sgo nas kyang sku brnyas ni mi 'tshal (nyan yong ye bdag 'dod pa rnams la don du gnyer ba ma lags pa kho naratshwa bas so/ /bdag ni sangs rgyas la skyabs su song ste/ de'i thad du rab tu 'byung ngo zhes byas nas de dag phyir log go/ / bu mo〈nye'od bzang ma yang bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du song nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshalasate/ chos mnyan pa'i hunyephyir bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i bsam pa dang / bag la nyal dang ske/ khams dang / rang bzhin thugs su chud nas/ 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi rtogs par 'gyur batshwanyede lta bu'i chos bstan te/ de thos nas bu mo 'od 75—452

bzang mas 'jig tshogs la lta7ba'i〈ri'i rtse mo mthon po nyi shu ye shes rdo rjes bcom nas rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu thob ste/ des bden57pa mthong nas mngon par shes pa yang bsgrubs so/ /de nas bu mo 'od bzang ma stan las langs te bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar ④nas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bdag kyang legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu byungasnyib dang / bsnyen par rdzogs shing dge slong ma'i dngos po 'thob tu rung na bdag kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du tshangs par spyod pa spyad ⑦par 'tshal lo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis (kyebastan pa 'di la gdul 6)bar bya ba mang po dag des 'dren par 'gyur bar thugs su chud nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ bu mo song la 'khor rnams kyang ltos shig /de nas bu mo 'od bzang ma rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal nas byung ste mang po 'dus pa'i nang du song ba dang / der so so nas bsams pa/ 'di mthus dbrog par bya'o snyam stetsho/ de dag gis de bzung〈nyebar byas so/ /de nas bu mo 'od bzang ma de dag gis bsnyagasal)pa dang /ngang pa'i rgyal po 'dab ma brkyang ba bzhin du nam mkha' la mngon par 'phags te cho 'phrul rnam pa sna tshogs bstan to/ /so so'i miskye bo rnams ni rdzu 'phrul gyis myur du dad par byed de de nas de dag gis lha dang mi rnams dad par byed pa'i cho 'phrul de mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang spu zingasnyizhes byas nas sdong po rtsa ba nas bcad pa bzhin du rkang pa la phyag 'tshal nas gsol ba btab pa/ sru mar spyonatsomar spyon khyod kyis chos5)'di lta bu dag7mngon sum5 )du byas pa las 75—453

na/ khyod 'dod pa spyod pa 'di ni mi srid do zhes byas so/ /de nas bu mo 'od bzang ma nam mkha' las babs nas skye bo phal po che'i gung la 'dug ste/ gang thos pas srog chags 'bum phrag du mas bden pa mthong bar 'gyur ba de lta bu'i chos bstan to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis denyeskye dgu'i bdag mo chen mo la gtad de50des desherab tu phyung ste bsnyen par rdzogs par byas so/ /de nas des brtson pa dang / bsgrub pa dang / 'bad pas phol mig lnga pa'i 'khor ba'isnyi'akhor lo 'di nyid g.yo zhing mi brtan⑧par rig nas 'du byed kyi rnam pa thams cad snyil7ba dang / ltung ba dang / rnam par 'thor ba dang / rnam par 'jig pa'i chos can yin par rtsad chod de/ nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs nas dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas te/ dgra bcom pa khams gsum pa'i 'dod chags dang bral bar gyur nas gser dang bong bar mnyam pa/nam mkha' dang lag mthil57du 'dra ba'i sems dang ldan pa/ tsan dan sbangs pa lta bur bsil bar gyur pa rig pas sgo nga'i sbubs bcom pa/ rig pa dang mngon par shes pa dang so so yang dag par rig pa thob pa/ srid pa'i rnyed pa dang chags pa dang bkur sti la mi lta ba/ dbang po dang nye dbang dang bcas pa'i lha rnams kyis mchod cing rjed ④pa dang gus par smra ba'i gnas su gyur to/ /de nas dge slong dag the tsom skyes te the tsom thams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa 'od bzang gisashelas gang dag bgyis na / des gzugs bzang zhing blta tson sdug la mdzes pa dang / mgul pa nas kyang nor bu rin po che byung la rab tu byung nas dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du bgyis lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag 'od 75—454

bzang ma7nyid kyis sngon tshe rabs gzhan dag⑧ku tshogs rnyed cing rkyen grub pa dang ldan te/ dba' rgal bzhin du byungasal gdon mi za bar 'ong ba'isnyilas de dag byas shing bsags pas na/ 'od bzang ma nyid kyis las byas shing bsagasalgepa de dag gzhan su zhig gis nyams su myong bar 'gyur te/ dge slong dag las byas shing bsags pa rnams ni/ phyi rol gyi sa'i khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur/ chu'i khams dang / me'i khams dang / rlung gi khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur te/ las dge ba dang mi dge ba byas shing bsags pa rnams ni zin pa'i phung po dang khams dang skye mched rnams 'ba' zhig la rnam par smin par 'gyur ro/ /lus can dag gi las rnams ni/ /bskal pa brgyar yang chud mi za/ /tshogs shing dus la bab pa na/ /'bras bu nyid du smin par 'gyur/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na/ bskal pa dgu bcu rtsa gcig pa la de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu gdul bya'i7kha lo sgyur ba/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnam par gzigs zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung ste/ de rgyal po'i pho brang gnyen ldan na rten cing bzhugs pa las/ re zhig nasheyang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs sangs rgyas kyi phrin⑧las thams cad mdzad nas/ shing zad pa'i me bzhin du phung po'i lhag ma med pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su yongs su mya ngan las 'das so/ /de nas rgyal po gnyen yod kyis/ bcom ldan 'das de'i sku gdung la sku gdung gi⑥mchod pa byas nas/ rin po che sna bzhi las byas pa'i 75—455

mchod rten kho ra khor yug tu dpag tshad gcig yod la/ 'phang du rgyang grags gcig yod pa zhig brtsigs so/ /de nas re zhig na rgyal po gnyen yod kyi btsun mo dam pa0)rgas nas rgyan rnam pa sna tshogs lus las bkrol te mchod rten de la phul lo/ /de nas zhabs la phyag 'tshal5mite smon lam btab pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba dang sems bskyed lapa dang sbyin par bya ba'i chos yongs su gtong ba 'disalgen bdag gis kyang dgra bcom pa nyid thob par gyur cig ces byas so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus na rgyal po gnyen yod kyi btsun mo dam par gyur pa gang yin pa de ni 'od bzang ma 'di yin te/ des bcom ldan 'das rnam par gzigs kyi mchod rten la rgyan rnam pa bsna tshogs btags pa desakhen gzugs bzang zhing blta na sdug la mdzes pa dang / yan lag dang nying lag thams cad dang ldan par gyur te(kye / smon lam btab pa des ni da ltar dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas sol/ /dge slong dag de ltar na las gcig tu nges par gnag pa rnams ni rnam par smin pa yang gcig tu nges par gnag par 'gyur ro/ /las gcig tu nges par dkar ba rnams ni rnam par smin pa yang gcig tu nges par dkar bar 'gyur ro/ /las 'dren ma rnams ni rnam par smin pa yang 'dren mar 'gyur ro//dge slong dag de lta labs na las gcig tu nges par gnag pa rnams dang las 'dren ma rnams spangs la/ las gcig tu nges par dkar ba rnams 'ba' zhig la gtad par bya ste/ dge slong khyodamatshekyis de ltar bslab par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ dge slong de dag yi7rangs te bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// //75—456

rab sdug ma zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po rnams dang / blon po chen po rnams dang / phyug po rnams dang / pho brang 'khor gyi mi rnams dang / tshong dpon rnams dang / ded dpon rnams dang / lha rnams dang / klu rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams dang / lha ma yin rnams dang / nam mkha' lding rnams dang / mi 'am ci rnams dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis bkur sti byas/ bla mar byas/ ri mo0)byas/ mchod pa byas te/lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang ske/ mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis mchod cing shes pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bsod nams chen po dngasaldan pa/ na bza' dang ske/ zhal zas dang / gzims cha dang / gdan dang / snyun gsos dang /sman zong rnams brnyes pa/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa mnyan du yod pa na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyi chung ma la bu chags nas/ de zla ba brgyad dam dgu lon pa dngas/ bu byung ste bu mo gzugs bzang zhing blta na sdug la mdzes pa yan lag dang nying lag thams cad dang ldan pa/ mnyan du yod pa na gnas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs rnamasasnyikyi snying du rab tu sdug pa zhig btsas so/ /de nas de btsas pa'i btsas ston byas nas/bu mo 'di'i ming ji skad gdags zhes ming 'dogs par byed de/ nye du rnams na re bu mo 'di skye bo thams cad kyi snying du sdug pas na de'i phyir bu mo 'di'i ming rab sdug ma zhes gdags so zhes zer ro/ /de yang tshe rabs dran te/ btsas ma thag tu tshigs su bcad gshesmras pa/ sbyin pa byin pa mang nyung ci yang rung / /75—457

zhing gi khyad par gzhitulas 'phel bar 'gyur/ /desaphyir mkhas pas bsgrims te 'jig rten du/ /dad pas lha mi5skyedabang phyug sangs rgyas sbyin/ /de nas de'i pha ma dang gzhan yang khyim de na gnas pa rnams kyis tshig brjod pa de0thos nas skrag cing dngangs7te mi dga' bar gyur la/ skyi bung zhes byasalgenas smras pa kye ma bu7mo 'di ni sha za mo zhig go/ /des smras pa/ yum bdag ni sha za mo yang ma lags/ srin mo yang ma lags kyi(kye/ bdag ni bu mo lags te sbyin pa dag sbyin par 'tshal lo/ /de nas de'i mas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin la bu mo de ⑨'di skad mchi'o/ /zhes bsnyadatshwa) do/ /de nas khyim bdag de dga' zhing mgu la rab tu dga' nas/ bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun dang bcas pa khyim gyi nang du bshos gsol te/ de'i phyir sbyin pa'i〈nyerabs gdon du bcug go/ /de nas gang gi tshe bu mo de mthar gyis lo bdun lon pa de'i tshe pha ma la gsol te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la rab tu byung nas/ de dge slong ma thams cad la sdug pa dang / phongasalgepa dang / snying du sdug pa dang /yid du 'ong bar gyur to/ /re zhig na de'i tshe mu ge'i bar gyi bskal pa dang 'dra ba'i mu ge chen po byung nas/ der srog chags 'bum phrag du ma bza' ba dang btung ba med pas shi'o/ /de nas der bcom ldan 'das kyis/ tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bosal bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo7khyod song la rab sdug ma la nga na re 'khor bzhi po rnams la khyod kyis zla ba gsum gyi bar du gos dang /zas dang / mal cha dang / stan dang / nad gsos dang / sman thong rnams phul cig ces gyis shig /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo rab sdug ma'i thad du song7nas smras pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyisnyizhal nas khyod kyis 'khor 75wa 458

bzhi po rnams7zla ba gsum gyi bar du gos dang / zas dang / mal cha dang /stan dang / nad gsos dang / sman zong rnams phul cig ces bka' stsal to/ /de nas rab sdug mas thal mo sbyar te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' spyi bos mnos nas bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes smras so/ /de nas rab sdug ma spyod yul gyi grong blta ba'i phyir mnyan du yod par chas so/ /de nas re zhig na khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis gtam de thos nas shin tu rings par rab sdug ma'i mdun⑧du song ste smras pa/ rab sdug ma gar 'gro/ des smras pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal to①/ /zla ba gsum gyi bar du zhal ta ba'i las byed par bskos so/ /mgon med zas sbyin gyis smras pa/ khyod kyi de dag thams cad bdag gis sbyar gyis khyod kyis bya mi dgos so/ /rab sdug mas smras pa/gal te yab bden pa mthong ba lags la sa'i 'og thog dag tu sbas pa'i gter rnams kyang mngon du gzigs na/ sbyar ba 'di la ngo mtshar che ba ci mchis/'on kyang bdag ni skye bo dbul po la phan gdags pa'i slad du zhal ta bgyid do/ /de bzhin du dge bsnyen lnga brgya dang / btsun mo phreng〈rgyud ma dang / rgyal rigs kyi bu mo dbyar tshul ma dang / btsun mo 'khor gyi bla drang srong sbyin dang /gna' mi dang ri dgas 'dzin gyi ma sa ga dang / rgyal po gsal rgyal rnams7kyis kyang skabs phye ste/ khyod kyis bya mi dgos so zhes byas so/ /de nas nags khung du song nas der mi ma yin pa mi'i ⑨cha lugs can dag gis kyang skabs phye'o/ /de ltar skabs phye nas kyang / des5) bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa zla ba gsum gyi bar du na bza' dang / zhal zas dang /gzims cha dang / gdan dang / snyun gsos dang / sman zong rnams kyis 75wa 459

bsnyen bkur byas so/ /des zla ba gsum po de nyid kyi skabs su brtson pa dang bsgrub pa 3)dang 'bad pas phol mig lnga pa'i 'khor ba'i⑧'khor lo 'di nyid g.yo zhing mi brtan par rig nas/ 'du byed kyi rnam pa thams cad snyilakhub dang /ltung ba dang / rnam par 'thor ba dang / rnam par 'jig pa'i chos can yin par rtsad chod de/ nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs nas dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas te/ dgra bcom pa khams gsum pa'i 'dod chags dang bral bar gyur nas/ gser dang bong bar mnyam pa/ nam mkha' dang lag mthilakyidu 'dra ba'i sems dang ldan pa.e/ tsan dan sbangs pa lta bur bsil7bar gyur pa / rig pas sgo nga'i sbubs bcom pa/ rig pa dang mngon par shes pa dang so so yang dag paramartso)rig pa thob pa/ srid pa'i rnyed pa dang / chags pa dang /bkur sti la rin)mi lta ba/ dbang po dang / nye dbang dang bcas pa'i lha rnams kyis mchod cing rjed rtenapa dang gus par smra ba'i gnas su gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das zla ba gsum 'das pa dang / chos gos mdzad de chos gos zin nas chos gos gsol te lhung bzed hu )bsnams nas/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang thabs /1cig tu mnyan du yod pa nas rgyal po'i khab tu chas te gshegs so/ /de nas rab sdug mas bcom ldan 'das dang lam du phrad nas 'o brgyal〈nyemi 'tshal zhes gsol to/ /de nas re zhig na nags khung chu dang ldan pa zhig tu phyin nas dro la bab na rgyags nyunyekyang med nas/ bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa bzhugs par gsol to/ /de nas lhung bzed lag pa g.yon pa la bzhag ste/ tshig tu smras pa/ gal te bsod nams dag gi rnam par smin pa geyod ce na/ bdag gi lhung bzed bza' ba dang bca' ba la 75wa 460

sogs pa rnam pa sna tshogs kyis gang bar gyur cig ces byas so/ /de nas lhas lha'i bdud rtsis bkang ngo / /de nas rab sdug gis gral rims bzhin dunyedage slong gi dge 'dun thams cad kyi lhung bzed rnams zhal zas kyis bkang nas/der bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag nga'i nyan thosasakyi dge slong ma bsod nams byas pa rnams kyi mchog ni 'di lta ste dge slong ma rab sdug ma 'disayin no/ /de nas dge slong dag the tsom skyes te/the tsom thams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa rab sdug mas las gang dag bgyis na des phyug po'i rigs su skyes te gzugs bzang zhing bltasan sdug la mdzes pa dang / skye bo thams cad kyisasnyibakur la rab tu byung nas dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum bgyis lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag rab sdug ma7nyid kyis sngon tshe rabs gzhan dag tu tshogs rnyed7cing rkyen grub pa dang ldan te/ dba' rgal bzhin du byung ( )la gdon mi za bar 'ong ba'i las de dag byas shing bsags pas na/rab sdug ma nyid kyis (nyalas byas shing bsags pa de dag gzhan su zhig gis nyams su myong bar 'gyur te/ dge slong dag las byas shing bsags pa rnams ni phyi rol gyi sa'i khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur/ chu'i khams dang /me'i khams dang / rlung gi khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur te/ las dge ba dang mi dge ba byas shing bsags pa rnams ni zin pa'i phung po dang /khams dang / skye mched rnams 'ba' zhig la rnam par smin par 'gyur ro/ /lus can dag gi las rnams ni/ /bskal pa brgyar yang chud mi za/ /tshogs shing dus la bab pa na/ /'bras bu nyid du smin par 'gyur/ /dge slong dag 75—461

sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na/ bskal pa bzang po 'di nyid la skye dgu'i tshe lo nyi khri thub pa na yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa / bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu gdul bya'i7kha lo sgyuratshageb/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'od srung zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung ste/ de grong khyer bā rā ṇa sri'un drang srong smra ba ri dgas4kyi nags na rten cing bzhugs soX/ /de nas yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung snga dro sham thabs dang chos gos gsol te lhung bzed bsnams nas/ dge slong gi tshogs kyis zhabs 'bring0byas te/mdun du bdar munonas bā rā ṇa sīr chos/bsod snyoms la gshegs pa dang / re zhig na tshong dpon zhig g.yog 'khor dang bcas te skyedaspyo)mos tshal du song nas bza' ba dang bca' ba mang po dag kyang tsokhyer ro/ /de nas re zhig na de'i mngag gzhug 31ma bu mo zhig 'bras chan nyugegyi gzeb khyer te jo7bo'i phyi bzhin du 'gro ba las bu mo mngag gzhug tsom des/ bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa lam khar mthong nas de dga' bar gyur te blo skyes pa/bdag la jo /2bos lan gnyis su bran mor byar ci yod kyis7bdag gis bcom ldan 'das bshos gsol gor ma chag snyam mo/ /de nas des gsadasngo 7pa dang /bcing ba dang brdeg pa dang bsdos nyusnyenas 'bras chan hu)gyi gzeb phye ste/ bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa zhal zas sna tshogs kyis tshim par byas so/ /de nas tshong dpon gyi thad du song ba dang / re zhig na tshong dpon gyis 3 ribu mo 'bras chan ri 7gyi gzeba'i rtede ga re zhes dris so/ /des smras pa bdag gis bcom ldan 'das yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung la 75—462

zhal zas phul lo zhes byas pa dang / tshong dpon gyis de thos nas mchog tu ya mtshan du gyur to/ /de nas de dga' zhing mgu la rab tu dga' nas smras pa bu mo khyod ①deng phyin cad bran mo ②las phyung gis gsong shig /khyod kyis bdag gnyid kyis log pa na mel tshe byas pa yin no zhes smras so/ /de nas desaskong)thal mo sbyar te khyim bdag la gsol pa/ bdag bcom ldan 'das kyisnyibastan pa la rab tu 'byung bar ci gnang zhes byas so/ /de nas khyim bdag des lhung bzed dang chos gos kyang byin nas/ de jomanyabos byin pa'i lhung bzed dang chos gos khyer te bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la rab tu byung nasal/ des bcom ldan 'das 'od srung gi gsung rab la lo dgu stong gi bar medu zhal ta ba'i las byas te / 'bras chan7dang / skyo ma dang / thug pa btung ba dang / rtag res 'khor dang / mgron du bod pa dang / mar me'i phreng ba dang / chos gos sra brkyang rnams dang / sbyin pa dang rab tu sbyin pa rnams kyang phul tetunye/ smon lam btab pa/ bdag gis dka' bas bsgrubs te/ bcom ldan 'das 'od srung la sbyin pa dang rab tu sbyin pa dag phul ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba dang sems bskyed pa dang sbyin par bya ba'i chos yongs su gtong ba 'dis na/ bdag bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i gsung rab la rab tu 'byung ba thob par gyur cig ces byas so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus na bu mo mngag gzhugatshwa mar gyur pa gang yin pa de ni rab sdug ma 'di yin te/ des bcom ldan 'das 'od srung la zhal zas phul ba des na phyug po'i rigs su skyes te/ gzugs bzang zhing blta5rten sdug la mdzes pa dang skye bo thams cad kyis bkur bar gyur to/ /smon lam btab pa des ni 75—463

da51)ltar dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas so/ /dge slong dag de ltar na⑧las gcig tu nges par gnag pa rnams ni rnam par smin pa yang gcig tu nges par gnag par 'gyur ro/ /las gcig tu nges par dkar ba rnams ni rnam par smin pa yang gcig tu nges par dkar bar 'gyur ro/ /las 'dren⑧ma rnams ni rnam par smin pa yang 'drena'agemar 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag de bas na las gcig tu nges par gnag pa rnams dang / las 'dren ma rnams spangs la / las gcig tu nges par dkar ba rnams 'ba' zhig la gtad par bya ste/dge slong khyodam6)kyis de ltar bslab par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces 7)bka' stsal nas/ dge slong de dag yi0)rangs te bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// //dkar mo zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po rnams dang ske/ blon po chen po rnams dang / phyug po rnams dang / pho brang 'khor gyi mi rnams dang / tshong dpon rnams dang / ded dpon rnams dang / lha rnams dang / klu rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams dang / lha ma yin rnams dang ske/ nam mkha' lding rnams dang / mi 'am ci rnams dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis bkur sti byas/ bla mar byas/ ri mo ⑨byas/ mchod pa byas te/lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang ske/ mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis mchod cing shes pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bsod nams chen po dang ldan pa/ na bza' dang /zhal zas dang / gzims cha dang / gdan dang / snyan gsos dang / sman zong rnams brnyes pa/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa ser skya'i gnas〈spe75—464

shing n+ya gro ṅgā'i7kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe meshākya rnams kyi nang na shākya snar ma zhes bya ba phyug cing nor mang la longs spyod che ba/ yongs su 'dzin pa yangs shing rgya che ba rnam thos kyi bu'i nor51dang ldan pa/ rnam thos kyi5gebu'i nor dang 'gran pa zhig gnas pa des/ rigs mnyam pa las chung mas45)blangs nas/ de de dang lhan cig tu rtse zhing dga' la dga' mgur57spyod do/ /deshertse zhing dga' la dga' mgur spyad5bkyang / bu yang med bu mo yang med dekelag pa la skom tshugs7bcas nas bsams pa bdag gis khyim hukyenor du ma dang ldan du zin kyang / bdag la bu yang med/ bu mo yang med pas bdag 'das pa'i 'og tu ni bu med pa'i phyir ci bdog pa thams cad rgyal po dbang bar 'gyur ro snyam ste sems khong du〈nyechud cing 'dug go/ /de nas dge sbyong dang /bram ze dang / ltas mkhan dang / mdza' bo dang / gnyen dang / rtsa lag gzhan dag gis lha la gsol ba thob cig ces de la bsgo'o/ /de nas de bu 1gemed de bu 'dod pas gu lang dang / chu lha dang / ku be ra dang / brgya byin dang ske/ tshangs pa la sogs pa dang / lha'i khyad par gzhan dag la yang gsol ba 'debs te/ 'di lta ste/ kun dga' ra ba'i lha dang / nags tshal gyi lha dang / lam gyi bzhi mdo'i lha dang / sum mdo'i lha dang / gtor ma len pa'i lha dang / lhan cig skyes pa dngas/ chos 'thun pa snyedang / rtag tu phyimatshabazhin 'brang ba'i lha rnams la yang gsol ba 'debs so/ /'jig rten na (nyeyang gsol ba btab pa'i rgyus bu dang bu mo skye bar 'gyur ro zhes bya ba'i gtam yod med kyi de yang de lta ni ma yin te/ gal te gsol ba btab pa'i rgyus bu dang bu mo skye bar 'gyur du zin na/ 'khor los7)sgyur ba'i rgyal po bzhin du re 75wa 465

re la yang bu stong stong yod par 'gyur ba'i rigs so/ /ye ni gnas gsum tshogs pa las bu dang bu mo skye bar 'gyur te/ gsum gang zhe na/ pha matu'adod chags langs te/ phradas pa dang / ma dus la bab cing zla mtshan dang ldan pa dang / dri za 'ongs pa ste gnas 'di gsum tshogs pa las bu dang bu mo skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas de yang gsol ba 'debs57 —)pa lhur byed cing 'dug la / sems can zhig kyang sems can gyi ris shig nas shi 'phos te/ de'i chung ma'i stor zhugs nas des khyim thab la sbran to(pe/ /de nas khyim thab kyis smras pa/bzang mo gal te budza khye'u zhig btsas na ni legs/ de ma yin te bu mo zhig btsas na ni de nyid dang bcas te khyod khyim nas bskrad de gtong dungo / /de nas re zhig na de 7zla ba brgyad dam dgu lon pa dang bu byung ste/ bu mo gzugs bzang zhing bltas na sdug la mdzes pa mi'i kha dog las ni 'das/ lha'i kha dog ni ma thob pa gos dkar posanyu7)gyon pa mngal gyi dri mas ma gos pa zhig btsas so/ /de nas re zhig na shākya snar mas khyod kyi chung ma la bu byung ste bu mo zhig btsas so zhes thos pa dang de khros te nang du song ngo / /de nas de'i chung mas lha'i gos gyon pa'i bu mo phul lo/ /de nas shākya snar mas bu mo mthong nas mchog tu ya mtshan du gyur te/ de 1 )btsas pa'i btsas ston byas nas bu mo 'di'i ()ming ji skad gdags /rtezhes ming 'dogs par byed de/ nye du rnams na re 'di gos dkar po nyugegyon bzhin du btsas pas na/ de'i phyir bu mo 'di'i ming dkar mor gdags so zhes zer ro/ /de nas bu mo dkar mo pang na 'tsho ba'i ma ma gnyis dang ske/ nu ma snun pa'i ma ma gnyis dang / dri ma 'khru ba'i ma ma gnyis dngacha/rtse ba'i ma ma gnyis te ma ma brgyad la gtad nas/ de ma ma brgyad kyis7'o ma 75—466

dang / zho dang / mar dang 9 zhun mar dang / mar gyi nying khu dngashe/gzhan yang yo byad kyi khyad par bzang ngo cogasnyigis bskyed bsrings te/ mtsho'i nang gi pad ma bzhin du skye drag par gyur to/ /bu mo dkar mo ji tsam du skye ba de tsam dushegos de dag kyang skye ste dri ma can du yang mi 'gyur la/ de'i lus la yang dri mas gos par mi 'gyur ro/ /de nas gang gi tshe bu mo dkar mo mthar gyis chen mor gyur pa de'i tshe/ rgyal po'ir+sā)bu rnams dang / ④tshong dpon gyi bu mang posadag de slong du 'ong ngo / /de nas de dag gis gnod par gyur nas de'i pha lag pa la rkom tshugs7bcas te bsams pa/ gal te gcig la byin na ni gzhan rnams bdag gi dgrar 'gyur ro snyam nas sems khong du 7chud cing 'dug go/ /de nas re zhig na bu mo des pha sems khong du51chud cing 'dug pa mthong nas/ smras pa/ yab ci zhig gis sems khong durwa)chud cing bzhugs/de nas des〈nyede'i don rgyas par bsnyad7do/ /de nas bu mo na re yab thugs ngan ma mdzad cig /bdag ni 'dod pa la don du gnyer ba ma lags te/bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la rab tu 'byung gis(nye/ yab kyis bdag la gnang bar mdzad du gsol/ /de nas re zhig na desalgepa ma gnyis la gsol nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la rab tu byung ste/ gos gang dag gyon te btsas pa de dag nyid chos gos lnga tshang bar gyur to/ /de nas des brtson pa dang / sbyor ba dang / 'bad pas phol mig lnga pa'i 'khor ba'i 'khor / 7lo 'di nyid g.yo zhing mi brtan par rig nas/ 'du byed kyi rnam pa thams cad snyilamanyeb dang ltung ba dang rnam par 'thor ba dang rnam par 'jig pa'i chos can yin par rtsad chod de/ /nyon mongs patshwanyethams cad spangs nas/ dgra bcom pa 75—467

nyid mngon sum du byas te/ dgra bcom pa khams gsum pa'i 'dod chags dang bral bar gyur nas/ gser dang bong bar mnyam pa/ nam mkha' dang lag mthil0)du 'dra ba'i sems dang ldan pa/ tsan dan sbangs pa lta bur bsil bar gyur pa/ rig pas sgo nga'i sbubs bcom pa/ rig pa dang mngon par shes pa dang so so yang dag par rig pa thob pa/ srid pa'i rnyedab pa dang / chags pa dang ske/ bkur sti la mi ltar ba/ dbang po dang nye5ngudabang dngasnyibacas pa'i lha rnams kyis mchod cing rjedapo)pa dang gus par smra ba'i gnas su gyur to/ /de nas dge slong dag the tsom skyes te/ the tsom thams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa dkar mos las gang dag bgyis na desashephyug po'i rigs su skyes te/ gzugs bzang zhing bltamamen sdug la mdzes pa dang gos dkar po (9)gyon pa dang rab tu byung nas dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du bgyis lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag dkar mo nyid kyis sngon tshe rabs gzhan dag tu tshogs rnyed cing rkyen grub pa dang ldan te/dba' rgal bzhin du byung 11la gdon mi za bar /nya'ong ba'i las de dag byas shing bsags pas na/ dkar mo nyid kyis las byas shing bsags pa de dag gzhan su zhig gis nyams su myong bar 'gyur te/ dge slong dag las byas shing bsags pa rnams ni phyi rol gyi sa'i khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur/ chu'i khams dang ske/ me'i khams dang / rlung gi khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur te/las dge ba dang mi dge ba byas shing bsags pa rnams ni zin pa'i phung po dang /khams dang / skye nyugemached rnams 'ba' zhig la rnam par smin par 'gyur ro/ /lus can dag gi tsolas rnams ni/ /bskal pa brgyar yang chud mi za/ /tshogs 75wa 468

shing dus la bab pa na/ /'bras bu nyid du smin par 'gyur/ /dge slong dag sngon byung btu'adas pa'i dus na bskal pa bzang po 'di nyid la/ skye dgu'i tshe lo nyi khri thub pa na yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu gdul bya'ishekha lo sgyur ba/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'od srung zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung ste/ de grong khyer bā rā ṇa sīr na drang srong smra ba ri dgas kyi nags na rten cing bzhugs so/ /de nas re zhig na tshong dpon gyi chung ma dad pa dang ldan la dge zhing bsam pa bzang ba zhig 4 'dug pasadrang srong smra bar don zhig lasasong ngo / /de nas des sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sku skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis legs par brgyan pa/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus mdzes par byas pa/ 'od 'dom gang gis brgyan pa/ nyi ma stong bas lhag pa'i 'od mnga' ba/ rin po che'i ri bo 'gro ba lta ⑦bu kun nas bzang ba mthong nas mthong ma thag tu bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshalashete/ chos mnyan7pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das 'od srung gis de la chos bstan nas des dad pa rnyed de⑩/ bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa khyim gyi nang du bshos gsol nas/ dge slong gi dge 'dun la chos gos sra brkyang phul lo/ /de nas mthar gyis pha ma la gsol te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la rab tu byung ngo / /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/de'i tshe de'i dus na tshong dpon gyi chung mar gyur pa gang yin pa de ni dge slong ma dkar mo 'di yin te/ des dge slong gi dge 'dun la chos gos sra brkyang phul 75—469

ba des na gos dkar ponyegyon bzhin du btsas so/ /tshangs par spyod pa'i gnas bsrungs pa des ni tshe 'di la dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas so/ /dge slong dag de ltar na ②las gcig tu nges par gnag pa rnams ni rnam par smin pa yang gcig tu nges par gnag par 'gyur ro/ /las gcig tu nges par dkar ba rnams ni rnam par min pa yang gcig tu nges par dkar bar 'gyur ro//las 'dren50ma rnams ni rnam par smin pa yang 'drenasnyimar 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag de bas na las gcig tu nges par gnag pa rnams dang las 'drenasam rnams spangs la/ las gcig tu nges par dkar ba rnams 'ba' zhig la gtad par bya ste/ dge slong khyod56)kyis de ltar bslabalgepar bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad (nyeces bka' stsal nas dge slong de dag yi ⑨rangs te/bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// // gang po la sogs pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa brgya pa/ bam po bcu bdun pasazla ba zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po rnams dang /blon po chen po rnams dang / phyug po rnams dang / pho brang 'khor gyi mi rnams dang / tshong dpon rnams dang / ded dpon rnams dang / lha rnams dang /klu rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams dang / lha ma yin rnams dang / nam mkha' lding rnams dang / mi 'am ci rnams dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis bkur sti byas/ bla mar byas/ ri mor byas/ mchod pa byas te/ lha dang /klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis mchod cing shes pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bsod nams chen po dang ldan pa/ na bza' dang / zhal 75—470

zas dang / gzims cha dang / gdan dang / snyan gsos dang / sman zong rnams brnyes pa/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa mnyanamanyu)du yod pa na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshalasnyomagon med zas sbyinasagyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so / /de'i tshe mnyan du yod pa na bram ze phyug cing nor mang la longs spyod che ba/yongs su 'dzin pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ rnam thos kyi bu'i nor dang ldan pa/rnam thos kyi bu'i nor dang 'gran pa zhig gnas so/ /de yang rig57byed gsum gyi mthar phyin te/ ming gi rnam grangs dang / shes gsal dang bcas pa dang yi ge'isnyirab tu dbye ba dang lnga pa ste gtam rgyud dang bcas pa rnams tshig re re nas brda sprod nus pa zhig go/ /de nas de bram ze'i khye'u lnga brgya bram ze'i sngags 'don pa'i slob dpon byed do/ /de nas des bu dgos pa'i phyir rigs mnyam pa las chung ma blangs nas/ de de dang lhan cig tu rtse zhing dga' la dga' mgur spyod do/ /de rtse zhingashedaga' la dga' mgurashespyod pa las chung ma la bu chags nas/ de zla ba brgyad dam dgu lon pa dang / bu byung ste bu mo gzugs bzang zhing blta na sdug la mdzes pa71yan lag dang nying lag thams cad dang ldan pa zhig btsas so/ /de nas de btsas pa'i btsas72ston byas nas/bu 0mo 'di'i ming ji skad gdags zhes ming 'dogs par byed dethu/ nye du ci rnams na re bdag cag gi bu tsha phal cher7zla ba zhes 'dogs pas na de'i phyir bu mo 'di'i ming zla ba zhes gdags so zhes zer ro/ /de nas bu mo zla ba pang na 'tsho ba'i ma ma gnyis dang / nu ma snun pa'i ma ma gnyis dang / dri ma 'khru ba'i ma ma gnyis dang / rtse ba'i ma ma gnyis te/ ma ma brgyad la gtad nas/de ma ma brgyad kyis 'o ma dang / zho dang / mar dang / zhun mar dang /75wa 471

mar gyi nying0)khu dang / gzhan yang yo byad kyi khyad par bzang ngo cog gis bskyed bsrings te/ mtsho'i chanang gi pad ma bzhin du skye drag par gyur to/ /de nas bu mo zla ba mthar gyis chen mor gyur pa dang / de mkhas shing gsal la yid gzhungs pa dang / bya ba la mkhas padza kyidang / dran pa dang ldan pa dang /thos pa 'dzin par gyuratswato/ /de nas re zhig na de'i pha bram ze'i khye'u rnams la sngags7slob pa na des rimathos pa tsam gyis lobs so/ /thos nas kyang bstan bcos571de dag ltag 'og50sbyor zhing 'chad nus so/ /de nas de'i grags pas mnyan7)du yod pa thams cad rgyas par gyur to/ /mu stegs can dag kyang nyin gcig bzhin du de la blta nyu1/ba'i phyir 'ongs te/ de dang lhan cig tu gtan la 'bebs par byed do/ /de nas gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lha mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa de'i tshe mnyan du yod par gshegs nas/ mkhas pa rnams dang mkhas par bgrang7ba de dag gephal cher bcom ldan 'das la blta 8ba'i phyir der 'dong bar 0byed do/ /de nas 7de dag mi snang nas nang mi rnams la smras pa kye ci'i phyir de bstan bcos nyusheshes pa dag mi 'ong〈pe/ 'di la rgyu ci zhig yod/ de dag gis smras pa/ bcom ldan 'das thams cad mkhyen pa shākya thub pa 'dir gshegs te/de dag thams cad de la gzhol bar gyur to/ /de nas sangs rgyas zhes bya ba'i sgra sngon ma byung ba thos nas/ de spu thams cad zing zhes byas so/ /de nas bu mo zla bas sangs rgyas zhes bya ba'i sgra thos nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du song ngo / /de nas des sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sku skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis 3)legs par brgyan pa/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus 75—472

mdzes par byas pa/ 'od 'dom gang gis brgyan pa/ nyi ma stong bas lhag pa'i 'od mnga' ba/ rin po che'i ri bo 'gro ba lta bu kun nas bzang ba mthong77nas/mthong ma thag tu bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshalamachosate/ /chos mnyan pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis ③bu mo zla ba'i bsam pa dang bag la nyal byadang khams dang rang bzhin thugs su chud nas 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi rtogs par 'gyur ba de lta bu'i chos bstan te/ de thos nas bu mo zla bas 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo mthon po nyi shu ye shes rdo rjes bcom nas⑥/ rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas te/ des bden pa mthong nas skye dgu'i bdag mo chen mo'i thad du rab tu byung ngo / /de nas des brtson pa dang bsgrub pa dang 'bad pas phol mig lnga pa'i 'khor ba'i 'khor lo 'di nyid g.yo zhing mi brtan par rig nas/'du byed kyi rnam pa thams cad snyil tshob dang / ltung ba dang / rnam par 'thorasnyib dang / rnam par 'jig pa'i chos can yin par rtsad chod de/ nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs nas dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas te/ dgra bcom pa khams gsum pa'i 'dod chags dang bral bar gyur nas/ gser dang bong bar mnyam pa/ nam mkha' dang lag mthil du 'dra ba'i sems dang ldan pa/tsan dan sbangs pa lta bur bsil bar gyur pa/ rig pas sgo nga'i sbubs bcom pa⑨ske/ rig pa dang mngon par shes pa dang so so yang dag par rig pa thob pa/srid pa'i rnyed pa dang chags pa dang bkur sti la mi lta ba/ dbang po dang nye dbang dang bcas pa'i lha rnams kyis mchod cing rjed 7pa dang gus par smra ba'i gnas su gyur to/ /de nas gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la/75—473

dge slong dag khyed cag gis zla ba phyed phyed cing so sor thar pa'i mdo bshad pa gdon par gyis shig ces bka' stsal pa①/ /de'i tshe skye dgu'i bdag mo chen mos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis so sor thar pa'i mdo lung dbog tu gsol/ bde bar gshegs pas so sor thar pa'i mdo lung dbog tu gsol/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de bzhin gshegs pasnyeyang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni dge slong ma la tshig re re nas chos kyi lung dbog⑧par mi mdzad de/ gal te khyedasnyilas lan cig smras pas 'dzin nus pa 'ga'abazhig yod na ni ngas lung dbog go/ /de nas de'i tshe dge slong ma zla ba 'khor de nyid kyi nang57du 'dus par gyur te 'dug go/ /de nas dge slong ma zla ba stanashelas langs te/ bcom ldan 'dasalgeg la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /lan cig bka' stsal pas bdag gis gzung spubar 'tshal na/ bcom ldan 'das kyis so sor thar pa'i mdo lung dbog tu gsol/ bde bar gshegs pas so sor thar pa'i mdo lung dbog tu gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyas par lung dbog pa mdzad nas/lan cig bka' stsal pas dge slong ma zla bas lobs so/ /der bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ nga'i nyan thos kyi dge slong ma mang du thos pa rnams dang / thos pa 'dzin pa rnams kyi mchog ni 'di lta ste/dge slong ma zla ba 'di yin no/ /de nas dge slong dag the tsom skyes te/ the tsom thams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa dge slong ma zla bas las gang dag bgyis shing bsags pa des na phyug po'i rigs su skyes te/ gzugs bzang zhing blta hunyen sdug la mdzes pa dang thos pa 'dzin 75—474

par gyuratulags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag zla ba nyid kyis sngon tshe rabs gzhan dag tu tshogs rnyed cing rkyen grub pa dang ldan te/dba' rgal bzhin du byung ②la gdon mi za bar 'ong ba'i las de dag byas shing bsags pas na/ zla ba nyid kyis las byas shing bsags pa de dag gzhan su zhig gis nyams su myong bar 'gyur te/ dge slong dag las byas shing bsags pa rnams ni phyi rol gyi sa'i khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur/ chu'i khams dang / me'i khams dang / rlung gi khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur te/las dge ba dang mi dge ba byas shing bsags pa rnams ni zin pa'i phung po dang khams dang skye mched rnams 'ba' zhig la rnam par smin par 'gyur ro/ /lus can dag gi las rnams ni/ /bskal pa brgyar yang chud mi za/ /tshogs shing dus la bab pa na/ /'bras bu nyid du smin par 'gyur/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na/ bskal pashebazang po 'di nyid la skye dgu'i tshe lo nyi khri thub pa na/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu gdul bya'i kha lo sgyur ba/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'od srung zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung ste/ de grong khyer bā rā ṇa r+sāshen drang srong smra ba ri dgas kyi nags na rten cing bzhugs so/ /de nas re zhig na bram ze'i bu mo zhig bcom ldan 'das 'od srung gi bstan pa la rab tu byung ngo / /des de la lung mnos te bslabs nas kha ton tu7byas te phung po la mkhas pa dang / khams la mkhas pa dang / skye mchedakyil mkhas pa dang /rten cing 'brel par byung〈nyeb la mkhas pa dang gnas dang gnas ma yin pa〈nyal 75—475

mkhas par byas so/ /mthar thug pa'i ye shes ni bskyed 3)ma nus so/ /de mkhan mo gang las rab tu byung ba de ni bcom ldan 'das 'od srung gisashethos pa 'dzin pa rnams kyi mchog tu bstan to/ /de nas dge slong ma de 'chi ③ba'i tshe smon lam btab pa/ ji ltar bdag gisalgemakhan mo thos pa 'dzin pa rnams kyi mchog tu bstan pa de bzhin du/ bdag kyang ma 'ongs pa'i dus na/ bcom ldan 'das 'od srung gis bram ze'i khye'u bla ma la bram ze'i khye'u khyodakyiskye dgu'i tshe lo brgya thub pa na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa zhes bya bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes lung bstanashepa gang yin pa'i bcom ldan 'das de'i bstan pa la rab tu 'byung7ste/ bcom ldan 'das 9)shākya thub pas bdag thos pa 'dzin pa rnams kyi mchog tu ston par gyur cig ces byas so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus na bram ze'i bu mor gyur pa gang yin pa de ni dge slong ma zla ba 'di yin te des smon lam btab pa des na thos pa 'dzin pa rnams kyi mchog tu bstan to/ /des der lung mnos te/ bslabs nas kha ton (me du byas pa des ci deni da ltar dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum5nyedu byas so/ /dge slong dag de ltar na las gcig tu nges par gnag pa rnams ni rnam par smin pa yang gcig tu nges par gnag par 'gyur ro/ /las gcig tu nges par dkar ba rnams ni gernam par smin pa yang gcig tu nges par dkar bar 'gyur ro/ /las 'dren tsham rnams ni rnam par smin pa yang 'dren mar 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag nyu de bas na las gcig tu nges par gnag pa rnams dang las 'drenatsom rnams spangs la/ las gcig tu nges par dkar ba rnams 'ba' zhig la 75—476

gtad par bya ste/ dge slong dag khyed ①kyis de ltar bslab par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ dge slong de dag yi ②rangs te bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// //ud pa la zhes bya bsheni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po rnams dang / blon po chen po rnams dang / phyug po rnams dang / pho brang 'khor gyi mi rnams dang / tshong dpon rnams dang / ded dpon rnams dang / lha rnams dang / klu rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams dang / lha ma yin rnams dang / nam mkha' lding rnams dang / mi 'am ci rnams dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis bkur sti byas/ bla mar byas/ ri mor byas/ mchod patshadakyibyas te/ lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis mchod cing shes pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bsod nams chen po dang ldan pa/ na bza' dang / zhal zas dang / gzims cha dang / gdan dang / snyun gsos dang / sman zong rnams brnyes pa/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa/ rgyal po'i khab na 'od ma'i tshal bya ka lan da ka gnas pa na rten cing bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe rgyal po'i khab kyi gong khyer na klu'i rgyal po ri bo dang yid 'ong gnyis phrad pa zhes bya ba'i dus ston byung ste/ der grong khyer chen po drug po thams cad nas skye bo mang po 'du'o/ /de nas re zhig na lho phyogs nas/ zlos gar mkhan gyi slob dpon zhig 'ongs pa de'i bu mo ud pa la zhes bya ba gzugs bzang zhing blta phyin sdug la mdzes pa yan lag dang nying lag thams cad dang ldan pa/ lang tsho dang nad med pa'i rgyags pas dregs pa zhig yod de/ de 75—477

gangatugi tshe ltad mo ba'imathunang du 'ong bsnyede'i tshe/ ltad mo ba thams cad kyis yidatswasmon byed cing lta bar byed de(she/ gang so sor rtog pa'i shas chung ba de dag gi'ang56)yid 'phrog par byed do/ /der gang gi tshe dus ston byung ba de'i tshe rdzogs byed la sogs pa ston pa drug kyang 'ong ngo / /de nas bu mo ud pa las skye bo mang po la smras pa/ kye rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer na mira'ugyur pa'i nang na bdag dang byad gzugs kyis mnyam pa'am/ khyad par du 'phags pa de lta bu 'ga'apha)lta yod dam/ skye bo mang pos smras pa/ dge sbyong gi ta ma 'khor dang bcas pa yod do/ /ud pa las smras pa/ ci de mi yin nam 'on te lha yin/ skye bo mang pos smras pa/ mi ni yin mod kyi/ de ni thams cad mkhyen pa yin no/ /de nas tshig de thos nas ud pa la rgyan thams cad kyis bklubasalgete bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du song ngo / /song nas kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngaraca'adug ste/ gar byed cing glu len la hu rol mo byed do/ /bud med kyi mtshan ma rnams dang / bud med kyi rtags rnams dang / bud med kyi brda rnams dang / bud med kyi rtsed mo rnams kyang ston par byed do/ /der dge slong 'dod chags dang ma bral ba gang yin pa de dag ni des ci bya gtol med par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong 'dod chags kyi shas che ba'i rnams nyunyegadul ba dang ud pa la'i byad gzugs dngakhelang tshos rgyags pa bsal tsho/nyeba'i phyir rdzu 'phrul mngon par 'du mdzad pa gang gis ud pa la rgas shing 'khogs pa hu)la mgo skya ba dang so rto du )zhing phyam dgu ()bo ltar sgur bar (nye'agyur ba de lta bu'isko ༄rdzu 'phrul mngon par 'du mdzad do/ /de nas de ltar sprul pa'i mod la ud pa las bdag nyid mi sdug par mthong nas byad gzugs dang 75—478

lang tshos rgyags pa de med par gyur to/ /dge slong 'dod chags kyi shas che ba rnams kyang skyo bar gyur to/ /de nas ud pa la rgyags pa med par gyur nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te①/ bcom ldan 'das la gsol ba btab pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag ci nas rnag can gyi lus 'di las tshegs chung ②dus yongs su grol bar 'gyur ba de lta bu'i chos bstan du gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis ud pa la dang dge slong 'dod chags dang ma bral ba de dag gi bsam pa dang bag la nyal dang khams dang rang bzhin thugs su chud nas/ 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi rtogs par 'gyur ba de lta bu'i chos bstan te/ de thos nas kha cig gis gi⑧'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo mthon po nyi shu ye shes rdo rjes bcom nas rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas so/ /kha cig gis ni lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas so/ /kha cig gis ni phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas so/ /kha cig gis ni rab tu byung ste nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs nas dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas so/ /ud pa la yang dad pa rnyed nas bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du rab tu byung ste/ des brtson pa dang / bsgrub pa dang / 'bad pasamachophol mig lnga pa'i 'khor ba'i 'khor lo 'di nyid g.yo zhing mi brtan par rig nas 'du byed kyi rnam pa thams cad snyilasnyib dang / ltung ba dang / rnam par 'thor ba dang / rnam par 'jig pa'i chos can yin par rtsad chod de(6)/ nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs nas/ dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas te⑦/de ⑧dgra bcom pa khams gsum pa'i 'dod chags dang bral bar gyur nas/gser dang bong bar mnyam pa/ nam mkha' dang lag mthil 7du mnyam pa'i (3 75—479

sems dang ldan pa/ tsan dan sbangs pa lta bur bsil bar gyur pa/ rigatupas sgo nga'i sbubs bcom pa/ rig pa dang mngon par shes pa dang so so yang dag par rig pa thob pa srid pa'i〈pernyed pa dang / chags pa dang / bkur steshel mi lta ba dang54)/ dbang po dang / nye dbang dang bcas pa'i lha rnams kyis mchod cing rjed (5)pa dang gus par smra ba'i gnas su gyur to④/ /zlos gar mkhan de dag gis 97kyang skyo bar gyur pa de nyid kyis nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs nas dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas so/ /de nas dge slong dag the tsom skyes te/ the tsom thams cad gcod pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis zlos gar mkhan gyi bu mo ud pa la byad gzugs dang lang52)tshos rgyags pa las rga bas skyo bar mdzad nas/ gzha' gsang gi mthar thug pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i bar dag 0tu bzhag ⑩pa ni ngo mtshar lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag da ltar ngarwa1/'dod chags dang bral ba/ zhe snang dang bral ba/ gti mug dang bral ba / skye ba dang / rga ba dang / na ba dang / 'chi ba dang / mya ngan dang /smre sngags 'don pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / yid mi bde ba dang /'khrug pa rnams las yongs su grol ba thams cad mkhyen pa/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa/ ye shes dang shes bya thams cad la dbang thob zin pa'i tshe/ bu mo ud pa la byad gzugs dang / lang tsho'i〈rgyags pas dregs pal)las rga bas skyo bar byas nas/ gzha' gsang gi mthar thug pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i bar du bzhag pa 'di lta la ngo mtshar che ba ci yod de/ 'das pa'i dus na 'dod chags dang bcas pa/ zhe sdang dngamatshebacas pa/ gti mug dang bcas pa skye 75—480

ba dang / rga ba dang / na ba dang / 'chi ba dang / mya ngan dang / smre sngags 'don pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / yid mi bde ba dang / 'khrug pa rnams las yongs7su ma grol〈khub na yang ngas7bu mo ud pa la rga bas skyo bar byas nas/ brtul zhugs kyi gnas lnga la bzhag pa de legs par rab tu nyon la54)yid la zung shig dang ngas bshad do/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na grong khyer bā rā ṇa 5snyun rgyal po tshangs pas byin zhes bya ba zhig rgyal po byed de/ de'i ring la 'byor pa dang / rgyas pa dang / bde ba dang / lo legs pa dang / skye bo dang / mi mang pos gang ba dngashe/ rtsod pa dang /'thab pa zhi ba dang / 'khrug pa dang / nang 'khrug dang / chom rkun dang /mu ge dang / nad rnams med pa dang / 'bras sā7lu dang / bu ram shing dang ske/ ba lang dang / ma he dang ldan par 'dug ste/ gnod pa med cing tsher ma dkrugasashel bu gcig pa la bya ba bzhin du rgyal srid bskyangs so/ /de nas re zhig na rgyal po de btsun mo dang lhan cig tu rtse zhing dga' la dga' mgur7)spyod do/ /de rtse zhing dga' la dga' mgur7)spyod pa las phyis btsun mo la bu chags nas/ de zla ba brgyad dam dgu lon pa dang bu byung ste/ khye'u gzugs bzang zhing blta na sdug la mdzes pa〈nyemadog bzang ba/ gser gyi kha dog can mgo bo gdugs ltar 'dug pa/ lag pa ring ba/ dpral ba'i dbyes che ba/ sna mtho ba/ sna legs pa/ smin ma stug pa/ yan lag dang nying lag thams cad dang ldan pa zhig btsas so/ /de nas de btsas pa'i btsas ston byas nas khye'u 'di'i ming ji skad gdags zhes ming 'dogs par byed de skunye du rnams na re 'di'ikheyab yulam ka shi'i〈nyergyal po yin la/ 'di yang 75—481

gzugs bzang zhing blta na sdug la mdzes pas na/ de'i phyir khye'u 'di'i ming ka shi 6)mdzes ldan zhes gdags so zhes zer ro/ /de nas khye'u ka shi mdzes ldan pang na ②'tsho ba'i ma ma gnyis dang / nu ma snun pa'i ma ma gnyis dang / dri ma 'khru ba'i7ma ma gnyis dang / rtse ba'i ma ma gnyis te/ ma ma brgyad la gtad nas/ de ma ma brgyad kyis ge'o ma dang / zho dang / mar dang / zhun mar dang / mar gyi nying ri khu dang / gzhan yang yo byad kyi khyad par bzang ngo cog gis bskyed bsrings te/ mtsho'imagyenang gi pad ma bzhin du skye drag par gyur to7)/ /de nas gang gi tshe de cher skyes pa de'i tshe rgyal tshab tu dbang bskur to/ /de nas des brgyal po byed pa na17/ nyes pa du ma dang ldan zhing gnod pa du ma'i rtsa ba yin par rig nas drang srong rnams kyi nang du rab tu byung ngo / /de yang gangs kyi spusal zhig na gnas te/ 'bras bu dang / rtsa ba dang / chus 'tsho zhing ri dgas kyi g.yang71)gzhi dang shing shun gyon la me'i sbyin sreg byed do/ /phyis re zhig na 'bras bu dang rtsa ba'i phyir ri'i sul zhig tu song ba dang / re zhig na der mi 'am ci'i bu mo zhig gis drang srong gzhon nu de mthong nas chags par gyur te/ gar byed cing glu len la rol mo byed do/ /bud med kyi mtshan ma rnams dang / bud med kyi rtags rnams dang / bud med kyi brda rnams dang /the bud med kyi rtsed mo rnams kyang ston par byed do/ /de nas re zhig na drang srong ka shi mdzes ldan gyis bu mo de la chos bshad de che zhe ()khyod rgas te/khyod kyi nga ro dang po ni snyan 8cing mnyen la mjug ni ra ra (nyepor gyur to zhes byas so/ /de nas des7chos de lta bu bstan te/ de thos nas mi 'am ci'i bu mo'i byad gzugs kyis /nyergyags pas3)med par gyur to/ /de nas de dad pa skyes 75wa 482

nas smon lam btab pa/ gang gi tshe khyod bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba de'i tshe/ bdag khyod kyi slob mar gyur cig ces byas so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus na drang srong gzhon nur gyur pa gang yin pa de ni nga yin no/ /mi 'am ci'i bu mo de ni ud pa la 'di nyid yin no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la dge slong rnams kyis zhus pa btsun pa ud pa las las gang dag bgyis na des gzugs bzang zhing blta stin sdug la mdzes par gyur (9lags/ las gang dag bgyis na des dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du bgyis lags / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag ud pa la nyid kyis sngon tshe rabs gzhan dag tu tshogs rnyed cing rkyen grub pa dang ldan te/dba' rgal bzhin du byung ②la gdon mi za bar 'ong ba'i las de dag byas shing bsags pas na/ ud pa la nyid kyisasrelas byas shing bsags pa de dag gzhan su zhig gis nyams su myong bar 'gyur te/ dge slong dag las byas shing 'u)bsags pa rnams ni phyi rol gyi sa'i khams la rnam ⑥par smin par mi 'gyur(7/chu'i khams dang / me'i khams dang / rlung gi khams la rnam par〈smin par mi 'gyur te/ las dge ba dang las7mi dge ba byas shing bsags pa rnams ni zin pa'i phung po dang / khams dang / skye mched rnams 'ba' zhig la rnam par smin par 'gyur ro/ /lus can dag gi las rnams ni/ /bskal pa brgyar yang chud mi za/ /tshogs shing dus la bab pa na/ /'bras bu nyid du smin par 'gyur / /dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na/ bskal pa bzang po 'di nyid la skye dgu'i tshe lo bzhi khri thub pa na/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs 75—483

rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu gdul bya'i nye)kha lo sgyur ba/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'khor ba 'jig ces bya ba 'jig rten du byung ste/ de rgyal po'i pho brang mdzes ldan na rten cing bzhugs so/ /de nas re zhig na lho phyogs nas zlos gar mkhan gyi slob dpon zhig 'ongs so/ /der gang gi tshe rgyal po mdzes pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bden pa mthong bar mdzad pa de'i tshes// zlos gar mkhan gyi slob dpon la bsgo ba/ nga'i⑧mdun du sangs rgyas kyi zlos garam4)gyi gar thabs gyis shig ces byas nas/ de dag gis rgyal po de'i5de/bka' spyi bos mnos te/ lha bka'57bzhin 'tshal lo zhes byas so/ /de nas sangs rgyas kyi zlos gar sbyar te legs par sbyangs nas/ rgyal po'i blon po'i tshogs dang bcas pa'i mdun du zlos gar gyi gar thabs byas so/ /de nas der57zlos gar mkhan gyi gar gyi5geslob dpon nyid ni/ sangs rgyas kyi cha lugs kyis nang du 'ongs so/ /zlos gar mkhan gzhan rnams ni dge slong gi cha lugs kyis nang du 'ongs so/ /de nas rgyal po dga' zhing mgu la rab tu dga' nas/zlos gar mkhan gyi slob dpon la sogs pa zlos gar mkhan gyi tshogs rnams la nor gyi phung po chen po byin no/ /de nas de dag bcom ldan 'das kyishebastan pa la dad pa rnyed nas/ sbyin pa dang / rab tu sbyin pa dag byin nas yang dag pa'i smon lam btab pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba dang sems bskyed pa dang71sbyin par bya ba'i chos yongs su gtong ba 'dis na/ bdag cag kyang ma 'ongs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams mnyes par byed par gyur cig /mi mnyes par byed par ma gyur cig ces byas so/ /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ zlos gar mkhan gang 75wa 484

yin pa de dag ni ud pa la la7sogs pa 'di dag yin te/ 'di dag gis der smon lam btab pa des nisnyed ltar dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas so/ /dge slong dag de ltar na las gcig tu nges par gnag pa rnams ni rnam par smin pasayang gcig tu nges par gnag par 'gyur ro/ /las gcig tu nges par dkar ba rnams ni rnam par smin pa yang gcig tu nges par dkar bar 'gyur ro//las 'drenasnyim rnams ni rnam par smin pa yang 'dren mar 'gyur bsnye/ /dge slong dag de bas na/ las gcig tu nges par gnag pa rnams dang las 'drenam nim rnams spangs la/ las gcig tu nges par dkar ba rnams 'ba' zhig la gtad par bya ste/ dge slong khyod kyis de ltar bslab par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas dge slong de dag yis rangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// //⑨mdzes ldan ma zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po rnams dang / blon po chen po rnams dang / phyug po rnams dang / pho brang 'khor gyi mi rnams dang / tshong dpon rnams dang / ded dpon rnams dang /lha rnams dang / klu rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams dang / lha ma yin rnams dang / nam mkha' lding rnams dang / mi 'am ci rnams dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis bkur sti byas/ bla mar byas/ ri mor byas/ mchod pa byas te/ lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis /stomachod cing shes pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bsod nams chen po dang ldan pa/ na bza' dang / zhal zas dang / gzims cha dang / gdan dang / snyun gsos dang /75—485

sman zong rnams brnyes pa/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa/ bā rā ṇa gshen drang srong smra bsnyeri dgas kyi nags na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe grong khyer bā rā ṇa 5⑧na rgyal po tshangs pas7byin rgyal po byed dephyi/ de'i ring la 'byor pa dang ske/ rgyas pa dang / bde ba dang / lo legs pa dang / skye bo dang / mi mang pos gang ba dang / rtsod pa dang / 'thab pa zhi ba dang / 'khrug pa dang / nang 'khrug dang / chom rkun dang / mu ge dang / nad rnams med pa dang ske/ 'bras sā57lu dang / bu ram shing dang / ba lang dang / ma he dang ldan par 'dug ste/ gnod pa med cing tsher ma dkrugs5kyel bu gcig pa la bya ba bzhin du rgyal srid bskyangasam13)so/ /de nas re zhig na rgyal po de btsun mo dang lhan cig tu rtse zhing dga' la dga' mgur spyod do/ /de rtse zhing dga' la dga' mgur07spyod pa las/ phyis btsun mo la bu chags nas/ de zla ba brgyad dam dgu lon pa dang bu byung ste/ bu mo gzugs bzang zhing blta7na sdug la mdzes pa yan lag dang nying lag thams cad dang ldan pa zhig btsas so/ /de nas de btsas pa'i btsas ston byas nas/ bu mo 'di'i ming ji skad gdags zhes ming 'dogs par byed dekyi/ nye du rnams na re bu mo 'di ka shi'i rgyal po'i bu mo yin la byad gzugs kyang bzang bas/ de'i phyir bu mo 'di'i ming ka shi mdzes ldan ma zhes gdags so zhes zer ro/ /de nas bu mo ka shi mdzes ldan ma pang na 'tsho ba'i ma ma gnyis dang / nu ma snun pa'i ma ma gnyis dang / dri ma 'khru ba'itshasam ma gnyis dang / rtsechaba'i ma ma gnyis te/ ma ma brgyad la gtad nas/de ma ma brgyad kyis7'o ma dang / zho dang / mar dang / zhun mar dang /mar gyi nying tunyekhu dang / gzhan yang yo byad kyi khyad par bzang ngo cog gis 75—486

bskyed bsrings7te mtsho'i nang gi pad ma bzhin du skye drag par gyur to/ /de nas gang gi tshe bu mo ka shi mdzes ldan ma chen mor gyur pa de'i tshe nyi 'og gi⑧rgyal po drug gis rgyal po tshangs pas byin la pho nya btang steni/ khyod kyi bu mo btsas zhes bdag gis thos kyis dugazhan la mnyesbyin par bdag gi bu la byin cig ces spring ngo / /de nas rgyal po tshangs pas byin mya ngan gyi khang bur7zhugs nas lag pa la skom tshugs7bcas te bsams pa/ gal te gcig la byin na ni gzhan rnams ni ⑧bdag gi dgrar 'gyur ro snyam nas sems khong du 0chud cing 'dug go / /de nas re zhig na bu mo ka shi mdzes ldan ma rgyan thams cad kyis bklubs nyu ltete pa'i thad du song ba dang des pha mya ngan gyis 47non pa mthong hunyenas dris pa/yab5)ci'i slad du mya ngan mdzad/ de nas phas kyang de la ji ltar gyur pa bsnyad doci| /de nas bu mo ka shi mardzas ldan mas pha7la smras pa/ yab nyi 'og gi rgyal po7rnams la da ste zhag bdun na bu mo ka shi mdzes ldan ma rang nyid kyi khyim thab 'dam par chad kyis/ khyod kyis ⑩bya ba gang yin pa 9/)de gyis shig ces pho nya gtang5)du gsol zhes byas so/ /de nas zhag bdun lon pa dang nyi 'og gi rgyal po drug po de ( )rnams 'dus so/ /bu mo ka shi mdzes ldan ma yang shing rta la zhon te chos gos tshon can gyi ba dan bsgreng nas/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi sku0 gzugs lag na thogs te rgyal po 'dus pa'i nang du song nas smras pa/ kye nyi 'og gi rgyal po rnams gson cig /bdag ni khyedamanyekyi gzugs dang / lang tsho dang / rigs dang / longs spyod dang / dbang phyug la mi sems kyi bdag ni 'dod pa rnams la don du gnyer ba ma lags te/ bdag ni ras 'di la sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi sku gzugs bris pa gang yin pa de'i slob ma 75—487

lags te/ de'i bstan pa la rab tu 'byung ngo zhes byas nas drang srong smra bar song stetsho)/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshalasnyenas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bdag legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu 'byung nib dang / bsnyen par rdzogs shing dge slong ma'i dngos po 'thobasnyitu rung na/ bdag kyang bcom ldanasnyi'adas kyi thad du tshangs par spyod pa spyad parakhe'atshal lo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'dasashekyis skye dgu'i bdag mo chen mosal gtad do/ /de nas desalo)kyang de rab tu phyung ste bsnyen par rdzogs par byas nas/ des brtson pa dang / bsgrub pa dang /'bad pas phol mig lnga pa'i 'khor ba'i 'khor lo 'di nyid g.yo zhing mi brtan5)par rig nas/ 'du byed kyi rnam pa thams cad snyil〈nyeb dang / ltung ba dang /rnam par 'thor ba dang / rnam par 'jig pa'i chos can yin par rtsad chod de/nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs nas dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas te/dgra bcom pa khams gsum pa'i 'dod chags dang bral bar gyur nas gser dang bong bar mnyam pa/ nam mkha' dang lag mthil7du 'dra ba'i sems dang ldan pa / tsan dan sbangs pa lta bur bsil bar gyur pa/ rig pas sgo nga'i sbubs bcom pa/ rig pa dang mngon par shes pa dang so so yang dag par rig pa thob pa / srid pa'i rnyed pa dang chags pa dang bkur sti la mi lta ba/ dbang po dang nye dbang dang bcas pa'i lha rnams kyis mchod cing rjed 8pa dang gus par smra ba'i gnas su gyur to/ /de nas rgyal po'i bu de dag gis de'i gzugs dang /lang tsho dang / mdzes pa rjes su dran nas 'dod chags kyi rgyags pas7phyos te/rab tu byung bzhin du yang gsol ba 'debs so/ /de nas de dag gis gsol ba 75—488
