po rnams kyis bkur ste byas/ bla mar byas/ ri mor byas/ mchod pa byas te/ lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis mchod cing shes pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bsod nams chen ponyedang ldan pa/ na bza' dang / zhal zas dang / gzims cha dang / gdan dang / snyun gsos dang /sman zong rnams brnyes pa/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa mnyan du yod pa na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyisatshal khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe mnyan du yod pa na ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal rgyal po byed de/ de'i ring la 'byor pa dang / rgyas pa dang / bde ba dang /lo legs pa dang / skye bo dang mi mang pos gang ba dngas/ rtsod pa dang /'thab pa zhi ba dang / 'khrug pa dang / nang 'khrug dang / chom rkunasredang /mu ge dang / nad rnams med pa dang / 'bras sā7lu dang / bu ram shing dang / ba lang dang / ma he dang ldan par 'dug ste/ gnod pa med cing tsher ma dkrugs la bu gcig pa la bya ba bzhin du rgyal srid bskyangs so/ /de nas re zhig na de ⑧btsun mo dang lhan cig tu rtse zhing dga' la dga' mgur ⑨spyod do/ /de rtse zhing dga' la dga' mgur 7spyod pa las btsun mo la bu chags nas/ de zla ba brgyad dam dgu lon pa dang bu byung ste/ khye'u gos su chos gos tshon can gyon la dge sbyong gi cha lugs can tshe rabs dran pa zhig btsas so/ / de nas rteskyes ma thag tu dris pa/ ci mnyan du yod pa 'di kho na na bcom ldan 'das dang / shā ri'i bu dang / mod gal gyi bu dang / 'od srung dang /kun dga' bo la sogs pa nyan thos chen po rnams bzhugs sam zhes zer ro /75—539

de nas de'i ma0)ya mtshan du gyur te dga' bas rgyas nas smras pa/ bukhumanyan du yod pa 'di kho na na bcom ldan 'das dang nyan thos chen po rnams bzhugs so zhes byasar noso/ /de nas re zhig na5ba don de rgyal po gsal rgyal la gsol te khyod kyi sras gos su chos gos tshon can 'tshal ba dge sbyong gi cha lugs can tshe rabs dran pa zhig btsas te/ de'agebacom ldan 'das dang nyan thos chen po rnams ga la bzhugs pa yang med ne/do zhes byas so/ /de nas rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis bu de la phan gdags pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa bshos la spyan drangs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi tshogs kyis zham ring57byas te/ dge slong gi dge 'dun gyisams)mdun du bdar nas/ rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi bkad 9kyis ga la ba der gshegs te byon nas/ dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi gung la gdan tshabashams pa la bzhugs so/ /de nas ko skyes la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis bu pang par nyu2blangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar brims nas/ri/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gi bu 'di btsas ma thag tu bcom ldan 'das dang nyan thos chen po rnams dran lags so zhes gsol to6/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis (5bu de la sde snod lagasum pa khyod nad med par gyur cig ces bka' stsal to/ /de nas des nyu de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo51 zhes smras so/ /de nas rgyal po gsal rgyal mchog tu ya mtshan du gyur to/ /de nas gang gi tshe btsas nas lo bdun lon pa de'i tshe chos gos tshon can de dag nyid gyon bzhin du bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la rab tu byung ste/ des brtson pa dang / bsgrub pa dang /'bad pas phol59mig lnga pa'i 'khor ba'i 'khor lo 'di nyid g.yo zhing mi brtan 75wa 540

par7rig nas 'du byed kyi rnam pa thams cad snyilasheb dang / nyung ba dang /rnam par 'thor ba dang / rnam par 'jig pa'i chos can yin par rtsad chod de/nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs nas dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas te/dgra bcom pa khams gsum pa'i 'dod chags dang bral bar gyur nas gser dang bong bar mnyam pa/ nam mkha' dang lag mthilasadu 'dra ba'i sems dang ldan pa/ tsan dan sbangs pa lta bur bsil bar gyur pa/ rig pas sgo nga'i sbubs bcom pa/ rig pa dang / mngon par shes pa dang / so so yang dag par rig pa thob pa/ srid pa'i rnyed pa dang / chags pa dang / bkur sti la mi lta ba/ dbang po dang nye dbang dang bcas pa'i lha rnams kyis mchod cing rjed pa dang gus par smra ba'i gnas su gyur to/ /de nas dge slong dag the tsom skyes te/the tsom thams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa sde snod gsum pas las gang dag bgyis na des chos gos tshon can 'tshal ba dge sbyong gi cha lugs can tshe rabs dran bzhin du btsas te/ rab tu byung nas kyang dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du bgyis lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag7sde snod gsum pa nyid kyis sngon7tshe rabs gzhan dag tu tshogs rnyed cing rkyen grub pa dang 0ldan te dba' rgal bzhin du 'byung la/ gdon mi za bar 'ong ba'i las de dag byas shing bsags pas na/sde snod gsum pa nyid kyis las byas shing bsagasalgepa de dag gzhan su zhig gis nyams su myong bar 'gyur te/ dge slong dag las byas shing bsags pa rnams ni phyi rol gyi sa'i khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur/ chu'i khams dang /me'i khams dang / rlung gi khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur te/ las 75—541

dge ba dang mi dge ba byas shing bsags pa rnams hu)ni zin pa'i phung po dang /khams dang / skye mched rnams 'ba' zhig la rnam par smin par 'gyur ro/ /lus can dag gi las rnams ni/ /bskal pa brgyar yang chud mi za/ /tshogs shing dus la bab pa na/ /'bras bu nyid du smin par 'gyur/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na bskal pa bzang po 'di nyid la skye dgu'i tshe lo nyi khri thub pa na yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu gdul bya'ikhukha lo sgyur ba bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'od srung zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung ste/ der grong khyer bā rā ṇa salgen drang srong smra bsari dgas kyi nags na rten cing bzhugs so/ /de nas re zhig na rgyal po kṛ khri'ichu)bu drang srong smra bar song ngo / /de nas des sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sku skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis legs par brgyan pa/dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus mdzes par byas pa/ 'od 'dom gang gis brgyan pa/ nyi ma stong bas lhag pa'i 'od mnga' ba/ rin po che'i ri bo 'gro ba lta bu kun nas bzang ba mthong nas mthong ma thag tu de dad pa skyes so/ /dad pa skyes nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal te chos mnyan pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das kyis47spyan sngar 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i bsam pa dang / bag la nyal dang / khams dang / rang bzhin thugs su chud nas 'khor ba las skyo bar 'gyur ba'i chos52)de lta bu7bstan te/ de thos nas ci'akhor ba la nyes par lta ba dang / mya ngan las 'das pa la yon tan du lta bar gyur to/ /de nas rgyal po la gsol te④/ yab bdag bcom ldan 'das kyi 75—542

bstan pa la rab tu 'byungatubar 'tshal na gnang bar mdzad du gsol zhes byas so/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ khyod ring po mi⑧thogs par rgyal tshab tu dbang bskur dgos pas 'di ni ngas bcos su med do/ /bus smras pa/ rgyal srid nyes pa mang po dang ldan pa chos kyi dgrar gyur pa bdag la mi 'tshal gyisal/bdag ni bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la rab tu mi 'byung du mi gnang ngo / /de nas yab kyis ma gnang nas des zhag gcig dang gnyis dang / gsum nas zhag drug gi bar du kha 'tshos so/ /de nas de'i zla grogs rnams kyis rgyal po la gsol te④/ lha mkhyen parasnyimadzad du gsol/ sras 'di ni0rab tu byung na legs kyi de'u re 'dir 'gum na ma legs so/ /de nas rgyal pos gnang nas dam 'char bcug ste/ nam khyod sde snod gsum ma lobs kyi bar du nga dang phrad57)du ma 'ong cig ces bsgo'o/ /de nas re zhig na de yab kyis gnang nas/bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la rab tu byung ste/ des brtson pa dang /bsgrubalgepa dang / 'bad pas7ring po ma lon par sde snod gsum lobs te/rig pa dang grol bar smra bar techos ston par gyur nasatunye/ de 'di snyam du sems te/ ma la bdag gis sngon dam bcas pa gnyer dgum gor ma chag snyam nas de yab kyi thad du song ste phrad nas dris pa/ bu cung〈nyezad lobs pa lta yod dam/ des smras pa/ sde snod gsum lobs lags7so/ /de nas desalayab la chos de lta bu bstan te de thos nas rgyal po mgu bar gyur to/ /de nas dga' ba skyes te smras pa/ bu gcig khyod la ci dgos/ des smras pa/ bdag ni bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa spyan drangs la yo byad drug dbul bar 'tshal lo9/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ rgyal po'i pho brang ni rgya chesal 75—543

ci dga' ba7)gyis shig /de nas sde snod gsum pas bcom ldan 'das zhabs 'bring ②'khor dge slong ③nyi khri dang bcas te zhal zas bzang pos tshim par ① byas nas dge slong re re la yang yo byad drug drug phul lo/ /de nas zhabs la phyag 'tshalasanas smon lam btab pa/ bdag da ltar dka'atsho)bas rab tu byung ba thob ⑦nas de bzhin gshegs pa nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa la bkur sti byas pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba dang / sems bskyed pa dang / sbyin par bya ba'i chos yongs su gtong ba 'dis na (8 /bdag gang dang gang du skyes pa de dang deramatso)gos su chos gos tshon can gyon la dge sbyong gi cha lugs 'di dang ldan te tshe rabs dran par gyur cig ces byas so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus na rgyal po kṛ khri'i bur gyur pa gang yin pa de ni sde snod gsum pa 'di yin te/ rgyu de nyid kyis phyug po'i rigs su skyes te/ gzugs bzang zhing bltamadzon sdug la〈nyamadzes pa dang tshe rabs dran par gyur to/ /dge slong dag de ltar na las gcig tu nges par gnag pa rnams ni rnam par smin pa yang gcig tu 1stenges par gnag par 'gyur rol/ /las gcig tu nges par dkar ba rnams nirnyarnam par smin pa yang gcig tu nges par dkar bar 'gyur ro/ /las 'dren 8ma rnams ni rnam par smin pa yang 'dren skomar 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag de bas na las gcig tu nges par gnag pa rnams dang / las 'dren r+sha ma rnams spangs la/ las gcig tu nges par dkar ba rnams 'ba' zhig la gtad par bya ste/ dge slong khyed78kyis de ltar bslab par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas dge slong de dag yi /tsherangs te bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la 75—544

mngon par bstod do// //grags bshes zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po rnams dang / blon po chen po rnams dang / phyug po rnams dang / pho brang 'khor gyi mi rnams dang / tshong dpon rnams dang / ded dpon rnams dang / lha rnams dang / klu rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams dang / lha ma yin rnams dang ske/ nam mkha' lding rnams dang / mi 'am ci rnams dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis bkur sti byas/ bla mar byas/ ri mor byas/ mchod pa byas te/lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang ske/ mi 'am ci dang / sto 'phye chen po rnams kyis mchod cing shes pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bsod nams chen po dang ldan pa/ na bza' dang /zhal zas dang / gzims cha dang / gdan dang / snyun gsos dang / sman zong rnams brnyes pa/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa mnyan du yod pa na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal0)khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe mnyan du yod pa na ded dpon phyug cing nor mang la longs spyod che ba/ yongs su 'dzin pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ rnam thos kyi bu'i nor dang ldan pa/ rnam thos kyi bu'i nor dang 'gran pa zhig gnas pa des rigs mnyam pa las chung ma blangs nas/ de de dang lhan cig tu rtse zhing dga' la dga' mgur〈 spyod do/ /de'i tshe mu ge mi bzad pas gnod snopa byung ste slong bas kyang5bzas mi rnyed dol/ /ltas mkhan rnams kyis kyang char mi 'bab par bstan pa las re zhig na ded dpon de'i chung ma la bu chags nas/ de zla ba brgyad dam dgu lon pa dang bu byung ste/ khye'u gzugs bzang zhing bltashin sdug 75—545

la mdzes pa/ yan lag dang nying lag thams cad dang ldan pa zhig btsas nas gang gi nyin par khye'u de btsas pa de kho na'i hu)nyin par nas than pa med par gyur to/ /de nas de'i grags pas rigemanyan du yod pa mtha' dag tu rgyas par gyur to/ /de nas de btsas pa'i btsas ston byas nas khye'u 'di'i ming ji skad gdags zhes ming 'dogs par byed de(7/ nyerabadu rnams na re 'di'i grags pa kun du rgyas pas na de'i phyir khye'u 'di'i ming grags bshes zhes gdags so zhes zer ro/ /de nas khye'u grags bshes pang na 'tsho ba'i ma ma gnyis dang / nu ma snun rin)pa'i ma me gnyis dang / dri ma 'khru ba'i ma ma gnyis dang / rtse ba'i ma ma gnyis te ma ma brgyad la gtad nas/ de ma ma brgyad kyis 'o ma dang / zho dang / mar dang / zhun mar dang / mar gyi nying stso)khu dang / gzhan yang yo byad kyi khyad par bzang ngo cog gis bskyed bsrings te mtsho'i tho)nang gi pad ma bzhin du skye drag par gyur to/ /de nas gang gi tshe khye'u grags bshes cher skyes pa de'i tshe rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal du don zhig la song ngo / /de nas des sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sku skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis legs par brgyan pa/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus mdzes par byas pa/ 'od 'dom gang gis brgyan pa/ nyi ma stong bas lhag pa'i 'od mnga' ba/ rin po che'i ri bo 'gro ba lta bu kun nas bzang ba mthong nas/ mthong ma thag tu de dad pa skyes so/ /dad pa skyes nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la5kyephyag 'tshal te chos mnyan pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de la 'khor ba las skyo bar 'gyur ba de lta bu'i chos bstan pa mdzad de/ de thos nas 'khor ba la nyes par lta ba dang / mya ngan las 'das 75—546

pa la yon tan du lta bar gyur te pha ma la gsol nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la rab tu byung ste des brtsonanyepa dang / bsgrubashepa dang / 'bad pas phol mig lnga pa'i 'khor ba'i 'khor lo 'di nyid g.yo zhing mi brtan par rig nas 'du byed kyi rnam pa thams cad snyilasnyeb dang / ltung ba dang / rnam par 'thor ba dang / rnam par 'jig pa'i chos can yin par rtsad chod de/ nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs nas dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas te/ dgra bcom pa khams gsum pa'i 'dod chags dang bral bar gyur nas gser dang bong bar mnyam pa/ nam mkha' bang lag mthil du 'dra ba'i sems dang ldan pa/tsan dan sbangs pa lta bur bsilasnyibar gyur pa/ rig pas7sgo nga'i sbubs bcom pa/ rig pa dang / mngon par shes pa dang / so so yang dag par rig pa thob pa/ srid pa'i rnyed pa dang / chags pa dang / bkur sti la mi lta ba/ dbang po dang nye dbang dang bcas pa'i lha rnams kyis mchod cing rjed pa dang gus par smra ba'i gnas su gyur to/ /de'i mche ba gnyis las chu yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa 'byung7ste/ des na de la skom pa'i gnod〈pepa med de/gang gi tshe tsha ⑧ba'i dus su dge slong skom pa rnams gung skyems la dge 'dun gyi nang du 'du ba de'i tshe yang de mi 'ong ngo / /de nas de dang bshes pa'i dge slong rnams kyis dris pa/ ci'i phyir khyod la skom pa'i gnod pa med ces byas so/ /des smras pa/ bdag gi mche ba gnyis las chu yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa 'byung ste/ des na bdag lasheskom pa'i gnod pa med do/ /de nas dge slong dag the tsom skyes te/ the tsom thams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa grags bshes 'dis las gang dag bgyis na des gzugs 75—547

bzang zhing bltashin sdug lasamadzes pa dang / mchelo ba gnyis las chabasreyan lag brgyad dang ldan pa 'byung5gel/ rab tu byung nasapo)kyang dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du bgyis lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag grags bshes nyid kyis52sngon tshe rabs gzhan dag tu tshogs rnyed cing rkyen⑧grub pa dang ldan te dba' rgal bzhin du 'byung la/ gdon mi za bar7'ong ba'i las de dag byas shing bsags pas na/ grags bshes nyid kyis las byas shing chibasags pa de dag gzhan su zhig gis nyams su myong bar 'gyur te/ dge slong dag las byas shing bsags pa rnams ni phyi rol gyi sa'i khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur/ chu'i khams dang / me'i khams dang / rlung gi khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur te/ las dge ba dang mi dge ba byas shing bsags pa rnams ni zin pa'i phung po dang / khams dang / skye5nyamached rnams 'ba' zhig la rnam par smin par 'gyur ro/ /lus can dag gi las rnams ni/ /bskal pa brgyar yang chud mi za/ /tshogs shing dus la bab pa na/ /'bras bu nyid du smin par 'gyur/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na bskal pa bzang po 'di nyid la skye dgu'i tshe lo nyi khri thub pa na yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu gdul bya'i nyunyekha lo sgyur ba bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'od srung zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung ste/ de grong khyer bā rā ṇa sī rten drang srong smra ba ri dgas kyi nags na rten cing bzhugs so/ /de nas re zhig na tshong dpon gyi bu zhig dge slong rgan po zhig la birab tu byung ba las/ de yang le lo can zhig stesnyigazhan lasabasnyen 75—548

bkur byed mi 'dod do/ /de nas tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa rnams kyis gnas brtan de nyid kyis ①bsnyen bkur byed par bskos pa dang de bdag ②ni bsnyen bkur byed pa yin no snyam du rgyasacher 'dzin tege/ dge slongasaches rgan pa rnams kyi bsnyen bkur len par byed pas na⑥/ de'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams zad de phyis re zhig na nad kyis btab pa dang / gnas brtan gyis sman pa'i lung bzhin du sman mar blud nas de mtshan mo skom ste ci bya gtol med nas chu btung snyam ste bdag gi chu snod kyi drung du song na chu med par mthong ngo de bzhin du mkhan po dang / slob dpon dang / dge 'dun gyi drung tshang dus7)song na de dag kyangasachu med par mthong ngo / /de nas re zhig na chu klung zlog byed kyi 'gram du song na de yang chu med par gyur te/ de mi dga' bar gyur nas bdag gi tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa rnams skyo ba skyed pa dang / dad pas byin pa rtsi7bar bstan pa'i phyir chu klung zlog byed kyi pha rol7nyan shing zhig yod pa la 'dzegs te/ ras zhig der btags nas rang gi las rnams las bsams7)te las la rten cing 'dug go/ /de nas re zhig na phyi de nyin par nam nangs pa dang gtam de tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa rnams la bsnyad do/ /de nas de'i tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa rnams kyis skabs de thos nas mi dga' bar gyur te phan tshun du bsnyad do/ /de nas de'i mkhan pos chu byin na de yang ma mthong ngo / /de nas de mi dga' bar gyur〈nyenas bcom ldan 'das 'od srung la gsol te⑩/ bcom ldan 'das 'od srung gis gaṇ+ḍi rdungs7shig /ces bka' stsal to/ /de nas khang skyong gis gasnyi brdungasalgepa dang / sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun rnams 'dus so/ /grong khyer bā rā ṇa r+sāte/ 775—549

thog thag tu yang gtam de grags te sems can 'bum phrag du ma 'dus so/ /de nas re zhig na de'i mkhan pos gral dpon gyi mdun du 'dug tu bcug nas ril ba spyi blugs7chus bkang ste byinashenas/ bu chu 'di dge 'dun la brims shig ces byasasheso/ /de nas 'bras bu mngon sum du mthong ba des skyo bar gyur pa de nyid kyis bcom ldan 'das dang nyan thos rnams la dad pa〈gebaskyed nas bsam pa drag pos chu de dge 'dun la brims so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de la phan gdags pa'i phyir phyag glang po che'i sna lta bu brkyang nas 'jigs pa thams cad dbugs 'byin par byed pa'i phyag gis chu de bzhes te/ nyan thos chen po rnams kyis kyang blangs na 'on kyang zad par ma gyur to/ /dge 'dun thams cad la brims na yangatso)zad par ma gyur to/ /de nas lha dang mi rnams dad par byed pa'i cho 'phrul ya mtshan can de mthong nas srog chags 'bum phrag du mas bden pa mthong bar gyur to/ /de'i rgyud la yang dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams sorarnyuchud par gyur to/ /gang gi tshe nad sos pa de'i tshe des sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun chus mi brel bar byas te/ lo khri nyis stong gi bar du des dge 'dun la chu brims so/ /de nas phyis re zhig na 'chi ba'i dus la bab pa'i tshe smon lam btab pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba dang / sems bskyed pa dang / sbyin par bya ba'i57)chos yongs su gtong ba 'dis na/ bcom ldan 'das 'od srung gis bram ze'i khye'u bla ma la bram ze'i khye'umanyakhyod skye dgu'i tshe lo brgya thub pa na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa zhes bya bar 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan pa gang yin pa de bdag gis mnyes par byed par gyur cig /mi mnyes sku'oXpar byed par ma gyur cig /bdag gi mche 75—550

ba'i phrag ①nas kyang chu yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa 'byung bar gyur cig ces byas so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus na dge slong du gyur pa gang yin pa de ni grags bshes 'di yin te/ des lo khri nyis stong gi bar du dge 'dun la chu brims te smon lam btab pa des na tshe 'di la mche ba'i phrag nas7chu 'byung las/ rgyu de nyid kyis na dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas so/ /dge slong dag de ltar na las gcig tu nges par gnag pa rnams ni rnam par smin pa yang gcig tu nges par /④gnag par 'gyur ro/ /las gcig tu nges par dkar ba rnams ni rnam par smin pa yang gcig tu nges par dkar bar 'gyur ro/ /las 'drenatso)ma rnams ni rnam par smin pa7yang 'dren mar 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag de bas na las gcig tu nges par gnag pa rnams dang dulas 'dren ⑨ma rnams spangs la/las gcig tu nges par dkar ba rnams 'ba' zhig la gtad par bya ste/ dge slong khyed kyis de ltar bslab par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas dge slong de dag yi rangs te bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// //rdzus te skyes pa zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po rnams dang / blon po chen po rnams dang / phyug po rnams dang / pho brang 'khor gyi mi rnams dang / tshong dpon rnams dang / ded dpon rnams dang /lha rnams dang / klu rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams dang / lha ma yin rnams dang ske/ nam mkha' lding rnams dang / mi 'am ci rnams dang / lto7nya'aphye chen po rnams kyis bkur ste byas/ bla mar byas/ ri mor byas/ mchod pa byas 75—551

te/ lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis mchod cing shes pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bsod nams chen po dang ldan pa/ na bza' dang / zhal zas dang / gzims cha dang / gdan dang / snyun gsos dang / sman zong rnams brnyes pa nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha yul na shing gi rgyal po yongs 'du sa brtol gyi ①drung nas thag mi ②ring ba zhig na rdo leb snam bu dkar po ②lta bu'i steng du dbyar gnas par dam bzhes te/ sku skrun ④pa'i yum dang sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha gzhan dag la yang chos ston to/ /de'i tshe tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po ni (snyemanyan du yod pa na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na5yedabyar gnas par dam bcas so/ /de nas 'khor bzhi po rnams tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po ga la ba der dong ste lhags nasaspyo)tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po'i rkang pa la mgo bos phyag 'tshalashete phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /phyogs gcig tu 'khod nas tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos chos kyi gtam gyis yang dag par bstan/ yang dag par 'dzin du bcug /yang dag par gzengs stodapon/ yang dag par dga' bar byed do/ /chos kyi gtam rnam grangs du mas yang dag par bstan/ yang dag par 'dzin du bcug /yang dag par gzengs bstod/ yang dag par dga' bar byas nas cang mi zer bar 'dug go/ /de nas 'khor bzhi po hu)rnams stan rnyelas langs te bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar benas tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de8/ tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen 75—552

po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /btsun pa mod gal gyi bu chen po khyod kyis datultar bcom ldan 'das gang du dbyar gnas par dam bzhes pa chungasazad gsan⑧tam / tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos smras pa/ kye bdag gis ni bcom ldan 'das sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha yul na shing gi rgyal po yongs 'du sa brtol ④gyi drung nas thag mi ring ba zhig na rdo leb snam bu dkar po lta bu'i steng du dbyar gnas par dam bzhes te/ sku skrun⑧pa'i yum dang sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha gzhan dag la yang chos ston cing bzhugs so zhes thos so/ /de nas 'khor bzhi po rnams tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos smras pa la mngon par bstod cing rjes su yi rangs te (7rkang pa la phyag 'tshal ⑦nas stan ⑧las langs te dong ngo / /de nas 'khor bzhi po rnams dbyar zla ba gsum 'das nas tshe dang ldan pa mod shigal gyi bu chen po ga la ba der dong ste lhags nas/ tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po'i rkang pa la mgo bos phyag 'tshal 7te phyogs gcig tu 'khod nas tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos (nya'akhor bzhi po rnams chos kyi gtam gyis yang dag par bstan/ yang dag par 'dzin du bcug/yang dag par gzengs stod/rte/ yang dag par dga' bar byed do/ /chos kyi gtam rnam grangs du mas yang dag par bstan/ yang dag par 'dzin du bcug/yang dag par gzengs stoda'/ yang dag par dga' bar byas nas cang mi zer bar 7'dug go/ /de nas 'khor bzhi po rnams stan las langs te bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chenamagepo ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud 8de/ tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /btsun pa mod gal gyi bu chen po mkhyen par mdzad du gsol/75—553

bdag cag gis bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal ma mthong nas ring mo zhig lags te/bdag cag ni bcom ldan 'das mthong bas skom lags so/ /bdag cagatuni bcom ldan 'das mthong bar 'tshal te/ gal te btsun pa mod gal gyi bu chen po la gnod pa ma mchis na btsun pa med gal gyi bu chen po bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der gshegs te byon nas zhabs la phyag bzhes te gnod pa chung ngam/nyam nga ba chung ngam/ bskyod pa yang ngam/ 'tsho'am/ stobs dang ldan nam/bde ba dang ldan nam/ mi bde ba mi mnga' 'am/ bde ba la reg par gnas sam zhes gsol la 'di skad ces kyangashegasungs shig /btsun pa 'dzam bu'i gling pa'i 'khor bzhi po rnams bcom ldan 'das mthong bar 'tshal te/ 'di skad du btsun pa 'dzam bu'i gling pa'i mi rnams la ni gang gis 'dzam bu'i gling pa'i mi rnams bcom ldan 'das la bltakhub dang / thad du mchi ba dang /bsnyen bkur bgyi ba'i slad du sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha yul du mchi ba de lta bu'i rdzu 'phrul dang mthu ma mchis la/ sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams la ni gang gis sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams bcom ldan 'das la blta ba dang thad du mchi ba dang ske/ bsnyen bkur bgyi ba'i slad du 'dzam bu'i gling du mchiseb de lta bu'i rdzu 'phrul dang mthu mchis na thugs brtse〈peba'i slad du bcom ldan 'das sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha yul nas 'dzam bu'i gling du gshegs su gsol zhes mchi'o zhes mol du gsolage/ de nas tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos 'khor bzhi po rnams la cang mi smra bas khas blangs so/ /de nas 'khor bzhi po rnams kyis tshe dang ldan pa med gal gyi bu chen pos cang mi smra bar mekhas blangs par rig nas/tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po'i rkang pa la mgo bos phyag 'tshalasate stan775—554

las langs te dong ngo / /de nas tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos 'khor bzhi po rnams dong nas ring po ma lon par rig nas ji ltar sems mnyam par bzhag na dper na mi stobs po che'i hu)lag pa bskum pa las brkyang ba'am/brkyang ba las bskum pa bzhin du tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po5semanyan du yod pa nas mi snang bar gyur te/ sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha'ikhuyul na shing gi rgyal po yongs 'du sa brtolasnyigyi drung nas thag mi ring ba zhig na rdo leb snams)bu dkar po lta bu du'adug pa der son par 'gyur ba de lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das ni lha'i 'khor brgya phrag du ma'i gung la bzhugs te chos ston to/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa mod gal57gyi bu chen pos bcom ldan 'das lha'i 'khor brgya phrag du ma'i gung la bzhugs te chos ston pa mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang 'dzum7dmul te bcom ldan 'das ni ji ltar 'dzam bu'i gling na 'khor bzhi po rnams kyis gang ba bzhin du 'di na yang tu ༵'khor mang po dang bzhugs so snyam mo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po'i sems thugs kyis mkhyen nas tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /mod gal gyi bu 'di dag la ni rang dbang med de/ gang gi tshe ngasarwatedeng shig ces bsams na ni de'i tshe 'dong bar 'gyur ro/ /gang gi tshe ngas shog shig ces bsams na ni de'i tshe 'ong bar 'gyur tetunye/ sems kyis nga'i bsamasapa shes nas 'ong ba dang 'dong b.rasnyi'agyur ro/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas tshe 75—555

dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos lha'i 'khor thams cad la bltas ①te/bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa kye ma lha'i 'khor sna tshogs 'dus shing 'khod lags so/ /lha'i 'khor gyi nang na sangs rgyas la shes nas dad pa dang ldan te lus dang bral nas 'dir skyes pa'i lha de lta bu dag kyang mchis so/ /chos dang dge 'dun dang 'phags pa dgyes pa'i tshul khrims la shes nas dad pa dang0)ldan te lus dang bral nas 'dir skyes pa dag kyang mchis sonya/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos smras pa la 'thun par dgongs te tshe dang ldan pa med gal gyi bu chen po la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /mod gal gyi bu chen po byade ni de bzhin nocha/ /de ni de bzhin te kyi/ kye ma chos lha'i 'khor sna tshogs 'dus shing 'khod do/ /lha'i 'khor gyi nang na sangs rgyas tho la shes nas dad pa dang ldan te lus dang bral nas 'dir skyes pa'i lha de lta bu dag kyang yod do/ /chos dang dge 'dun dang 'phags pa dgyes pa'i tshul khrims la shes nas dad pa dang ldan te lus dang bral nas 'dir skyes pa'i lha de lta bu / mchodag kyang yod do/ /de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos smras pa la 'thun par bsams te/ tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /btsun pa mod gal gyi bu chen po de ni de57bzhin no/ /de ni de bzhin te/ kye'itsham lha'i 'khor sna tshogs 'dus shing 'khod do/ /lha'i 'khor gyi nang nasngonasangs rgyas la shes nas dad pa dang ldan te lus dang bral nas 'dir skyes pa'i lha de lta bu dag kyang yod do/ /chos dang dge 'dun dang 'phags pa dgyes pa'i tshul khrims la shes nas dad pa dang ldan te lus dang bral 75wa 556

nas 'dir skyes pa de lta bu dag kyang yod do/ /de nas lha'i bu gzhan zhiganyegis kyang bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po dang lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis smras pa la 'thun par bsams ②te/tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po la7'di skad ces smras so/ /btsun pa mod gal gyi bu chen po de ni de bzhin no/ /de ni de bzhin te/ kye ma lha'i 'khor sna tshogs 'dus shing 'khod do/ /lha'i 'khor gyi nang na sangs rgyas la shes nas dad pa dang ldan te lus dang bral nas 'dir skyes pa'i lha de lta bu dag kyang yod do/ /chos dang dge 'dun dang 'phags pa dgyes pa'i tshul khrims la shes nas dad pa dang ldan te lus dang bral nas 'dir skyes pa de lta bu dag kyang yod do/ /de nas lha kha cig stan las langs te bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de/bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bdag cag ni sangs rgyas la shes nas dad pa dang ldan te lus dang bral nas 'dir skyesasnyilags so/ /lha gzhan dgashegis kyang 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bdag cag ni chos dang dge 'dun dang 'phags pa dgyesalgepa'i tshul khrims la shes nas dad pa dang ldan te lus dang bral nas 'dir skyes〈)lags so/ /de nas der lha brgya phrag du ma dang / lha stong phrag du ma dang / lha 'bum phrag du ma bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar so so'i rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu brda sprod pa byas nas de nyid du mi snang bar gyur to/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos lha rnams dong bar rig nas bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar te/ bcom ldan 'dasasngorteg la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas/ bcom ldan 'das lamanya'adi 75—557

skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa 'dzam bu'i gling na 'khor bzhi po mchis pa rnams bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal ①te/ gnod pa chung ngam/ nyam nga ba nyung ngam/(7 bskyod pa yang ngam/ 'tsho'am/ stobs dang ldan nam/bde ba dang ldan nam/ mi bde ba mi mnga' 'amakye/ bde ba la reg pa la niganas sam zhes kyang mchis lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/mod gal gyi bu khyod dang 'dzam bu'i gling na 'khor bzhi posnyi'akhod pa rnams bde bar gyur4)cig mod gal gyi bus gsol pa/ btsun pa 'dzam bu'i gling na 'khor bzhi po mchis pa rnams ni bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal mthong bar 'tshal te 'di skad ces kyang mchi'o/ /btsun pas3)'dzam bu'i gling pa'i mi rnams bcom ldan 'das la nu/blta ba dang / thad du mchi59)ba dang / bsnyen bkur bgyi ba'i slad du sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha yul du mchi ba de lta bu'i rdzu 'phrul dang mthu ma mchis la / sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams la ni gang gis sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams bcom ldan 'das la blta ba dang / thad du mchi ba dang / bsnyen bkur bgyi ba'i slad du 'dzam bu'i gling du mchi ba de lta bu'i rdzu 'phrul dang mthu mchis na/ thugs brtse ba'i slad du bcom ldan 'das sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha yul nas 'dzam bu'i gling du gshegs su gsol zhes kyang mchi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mod gal gyi bu 'o na khyod 'dzam bu'i gling du song la 'khor bzhi po rnams la/ kye bcom ldan 'das ni da ste zhag bdun na sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha yul nas 'dzam bu'i gling du grong khyer snang ldan gyi 'dabakyi/ a pad dza ra'i nags su shing u dum bā nyunyara'i drung du gshegs so zhes sgronanyecig /de nas tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal 75—558

pa mnyan te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal )nas ji ltar sems mnyam par bzhag na②/ dper na mi stobs po che'i (gelag pa bskum pa las brkyang ba'am/ brkyang ba las bskum ④pa bzhin du tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha yul nas mi snang bar gyur te 'dzam bu'i gling du son par 'gyur ba de ⑤lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so / /de nas tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po 'dzam bu'i gling dulo)'ongs nas 'khor bzhi po rnams la sbranashepa/ kye bcom ldan 'das ni da ste zhag bdun na sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha yul nas 'dzam bu'i gling du grong khyer snang ldan gyi 'dabani/ a pad dza ra'i nags su shing u dum bā 1)ra'i drung du gshegs so zhes byas so/ /de nas zhag bdun lon pa dang bcom ldan 'das sum cu 3 tshom gsum pa'i lha yul nas 'dzam bu'i gling du grong khyer snang ldan gyi 'dab17/ a pad dza ra'i nags su shing u dum bā ra'i lha drung du gshegs so/ /gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das grong khyer snang ldan du gshegs pa de'i tshe srog7nyechags 'bum phrag du ma bcom ldan 'das la labalta ba'i phyir 'dus so/ /de nas der dge slong rdzus te skyes pa zhig byung ste/ des bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang gebacas pa dang / lha dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang ske/ mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po de dag bshos la spyan drangs nas/re zhig na gdugs tshod la bab pa dang sems bskyed ma thag tu lha'i tsogadan dar yug khyim chen pos g.yogs pa dag dang / lha'i zhal zas bza' 3 tshob dang bca' ba dag byung bar gyur to/ /de nas dge slong rdzus te skyes pa des bcom ldan 'das lha'i zhal zas kyis tshim par byas te/ lha dang / lha ma yin dang /75—559

nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po de dag la yangatubakur sti legs par byas so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i bsam7pa dang ske/ bag la nyal dang / khams dang / rang bzhin thugs su chud nas de ltar bu'i chos bstan pa mdzad de/ de thos nas dge slong rdzus te skyes pasarnyuphol mig lnga pa'i 'khor ba'i 'khor lo 'di nyid g.yo zhing mi brtan par rig nas 'du byed kyi rnam pa thams cad snyilams)ba dang / ltung ba dang / rnam par 'thor ba dang ske/ rnam par 'jig pa'i chos can yin par rtsad chod de/ nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs nas dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas te/ dgra bcom pa khams gsum pa'i 'dod chags dang bral bar gyur nas gser dang bong bar mnyam pa/ nam mkha' dang lag mthil ri nadu 'dra ba'i sems dang ldan pa/tsan dan sbangs pa lta bur bsil nabar gyur pa/ rig du)pas sgo nga'i sbubs bcoms9)pa/ rig pa dang / mngon par shes pa dang / so so yang dag par rig pa thob pa/ srid pa'i rnyed pa dang / chags pa dang / bkur sti la mi lta ba/ dbang po dang nye dbang dang bcas pa'i lha rnams kyis mchod cing rjed pa dang gus par smra ba'i gnas su gyur to/ /de nas dge slongasabyadag the tsom skyes te/the tsom thams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa rdzus te skyes pas las gang dag bgyis na de /1rdzus te skyes par gyur la/ 'dis sems bskyed pa'i mod la ci bsams pa dang / ci 'tshal ba de dag thams cad 'grub /gepar 'gyur ba 12lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag rdzus te skyes pa nyid kyis sngon tshe rabs gzhan dag tu tshogs rnyed cing rkyen grub pa dang ldan te chudaba' rgal bzhin du 'byung la/ gdon mi za bar 75—560

'ongatuba'i las de dag byas shing bsagasalgepas na/ rdzus te skyes pa nyid kyis las byas shing bsags pa de dag gzhan su zhig gis nyams su myong bar 'gyur te/dge slong dag las byas shing bsags pa rnams ni phyi rol gyi sa'i khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur/ chu'i khams dang / me'i khams dang / rlung gi khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur te③/ las dge ba dang mi dge ba byas shing bsags pa rnams ni zin pa'i phung po dngasre/ khams dang / skye mched rnams 'ba' zhig la rnam par smin par 'gyur ro/ /lus can dag gi las rnams ni/ bskal pa brgyar yang chud mi za/ /tshogs shing dus la bab pa na/ /'bras bu nyid du smin par 'gyur/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na bskal pa dgu bcu rtsa gcig pa la skye dgu'i tshe lo brgyad khri thub pa na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu gdul bya'ishes lo sgyur ba/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyilaston pa/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnam par gzigs zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung ste/de grong khyer gnyen ldan na rten cing bzhugs so/ /de nas re zhig na grong med pa dgon⑧pa'i gnas shig na dge slong lnga dbyar gnas par dam bcas pa las de'i nang nas dge slong gcig gis dge slong bzhi'i zhal to7byas nas/ de dag gis brtson pa dang / bsgrub pa dang / 'bad pas nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs nas dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas so/ /dge slong cig shos kyis ni de dag gi rkang pa la phyag 'tshal hunyenas smon lam btab pa1rte/ 'di ltar 'di rnams kyis bdag las brten te dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas pa'i 75—561

dge ba'i rtsa ba dang / sems bskyed pa dang / sbyin par bya ba'i chos yongs su gtong ba 'dis na bdag rab tu byung ste yo byad kyi khyad par dag gis brel bar ma gyur cig ces byas so/ /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus na dge slong zhal ta 1)byed par gyur pa gang yin pa de ni lardzus te skyes pa 'di yin no/ /gsol pa/ btsun pa rdzus te skyes pas las gang dag mibagyis na des rdzus te skyes lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na 4bskal pa bzang po 'di nyid la skye dgu'i tshe lo nyi khri thub pa na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa / skyes bu gdul bya'i rigakha lo sgyur ri rib/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'dasam7)'od srung zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byungs8)ste/ de grong khyer bā rā ṇa sī 9na drang srong smra ba 3 ri dgas kyi nags na rten cing bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe de /nyan tshong dpon zhig gnas pa de'i chung ma bu btsa' ba'i sna tshe sdug bsngal gyi tshor bas nyen nyu te nyam thag pa'i skad 'byin cing ngu ba dang / des de'i sgra thos nas mchog tu mi dga' bar gyur tetshe/ mya ngan gyi khang bur zhugs nas lag pa la skom tshugs skabacas te sems khong du 8chud cing 'dug pa las de'i 1 blo skyes pa/ ma la bdag bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la rab tu byung la/ ci nas bdag gis nams kyang 1shemangal du gnas pa nyams su myong bar ma gyur cig ces smon lam gdab nyu7gor ma chag snyamatshanus ste/ de skyo bar gyur pa de nyid kyis bcom ldan 'das 'od srung gi gsung py-i gerab la rab tu byung nas des na smon lam btab pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba dang sems bskyed pa 75—562

'dis na bdag gang dang gang du skye ba de 6)dang der rdzus te skye bar gyur cig / nams kyangasamangal dumasaganas pa nyams su myong bar ma gyur cig ces byas54)so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus na tshong dpon du gyur pa gang yin pa de ni rdzus te skyes pa 'di yin te/smon lam btab pa des na0)rdzus te skyes par gyur to/ /des der dbang po rnams yongs su smin par byas pa55)des ni da ltar dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas so/ /dge slong dag de ltar na las gcig tu nges par gnag pa rnams ni rnam par smin pa yang gcig tu nges par gnag par 'gyur ro/ /las gcig tu nges par dkar ba rnams ni rnam par smin pa yang gcig tu nges par dkar bar 'gyur ro/ /las 'drenadzo)ma rnams ni rnam par smin pa yang 'dren mar 87'gyur rol/ /dge slong dag de bas na las gcig tu nges par gnag pa rnams dang las 'drenas3)ma rnams spangs la/ las gcig tu nges par dkar ba rnams 'ba' zhig la gtad 7par bya ste/ dge slong khyed kyis de ltar bslab 11par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ dge slong de dag yi kyi rangs te bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// //mdzes pa zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po rnams dang ske/ blon po chen po rnams dang / phyug po rnams dang / pho brang 'khor gyi mi rnams dang / tshong dpon rnams dang / ded dpon rnams dang / lha rnams dang / klu rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams dang / lha ma yin rnams dang ske/ nam mkha' lding rnams dang / mi 'am ci rnams dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis bkur ste byas/ bla mar byas/ ri mor byas/ mchod pa byas 75—563

te / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyinatudang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis mchod cing shes pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bsod nams chen po dang ldan pa/ na bza' dang / zhal zas dang / gzims cha dang / gdan dang / snyun gsos dang / sman zong rnams brnyes pa/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa ser skya'i gnas nasko shing n+ya gro d+ma'idzasakun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe ser skya'im )gnas na shākya phyug cing nor mang la longs spyod che ba/ yongs su 'dzin pa yangs shing rgya che ba rnam thos kyi bu'i nor dang ldan pa/ rnam thos kyi bu'i nor dang 'gran pa zhig gnas pa des rigs mnyam pa las chung ma blangs nas / de de dang lhan cig tu rtse zhing dga' la dga' mgur ⑧spyod do/ /de rtse zhing dga' la dga' mgur57spyod pa las chung ma la bu chags nas/ de zla ba brgyad dam dgu lon pa dang bu byung ste/ khye'u gzugs bzang zhing blta7na sdug la mdzes pa/ mi'i kha dog las ni 'das/ lha'i kha dog ni ma thobasnyepa zhig btsas nas/ de btsas pa'i tshe shin tu rmad du byung ba du ma byung bar gyur te/de dag gis grong khyer ser skya'i gnas thog thag mdzes par byas so/ /de nas de btsas pa'i btsas ston byas nas khye'u 'di'i ming ji skad gdags zhes ming 'dogs par byed de/ nye du rnams na re 'di btsas pa7na grong khyer ser skya'i gnas mdzes par byas pasamatshan de'i phyir khye'u 'di'i ming mdzes pa zhes gdags so zhes zer ro/ /de nas khye'u mdzes pa pang na 'tsho ba'i ma ma gnyis dang /nu ma snun pa'i ma ma gnyis dang / dri ma 'khru ba'i ma ma gnyis dang / rtse ba'i ma ma gnyis te/ ma ma brgyad la gtad nas/ de ma ma brgyad kyis 'o ma dang /75—564

zho dang / mar dang / zhun mar dang / mar gyi nyingatukhu dang / gzhan yang yo byad kyi khyad par bzang ngo cog gis bskyed bsrings te mtsho'i nang gi pad ma bzhin du skye drag par gyur to/ /de nas gang gi tshe cher skyes pa de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das la blta ba'i phyir shing n+ya gro ṅgā'i⑧kun dga' ra bar52)song ngo de nas des sangs rgyas ④bcom ldan 'das sku skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis legs par brgyan pa/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus mdzes par byas pa/ 'od 'domasnyigang gis brgyan pa/ nyi ma stong bas lhag pa'i 'od mnga' ba/ rin po che'i ri bo 'gro ba lta bu kun nas bzang ba mthong nas/mthong ma thag tu des bcom ldan 'das la sems dga' ba bskyed do/ /de dga' ba skyes yinas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal ⑦te chos mnyan pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i bsama'abapa dang / bag la nyal dang / khams dang / rang bzhin thugs su chud nas 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi rtogs par 'gyur ba de lta bu'i chos bstan7te/ de thos nas khye'u mdzes pas 'jigamatshatshogs la ltarwateba'i ri'i rtse mo mthon po nyi shu ye shes rdo rjes bcom nas rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas te/ des bden pa mthong nas pha ma la gsol te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la rab tu byung nas/ des brtson pa dang / bsgrub hu pa dang ske/ 'bad pas phol mig lnga pa'i 'khor ba'i 'khor lo 'di nyid g.yo zhing mi brtan par rig nas 'du byed kyi rnam pa thams cad snyilachab dang / ltung ba dang / rnam par 'thor ba dang / rnam par 'jig pa'i chos can yin par rtsad chod de/ nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs nas dgra bcom pa nyid mngon 75—565

sum du byas te/ dgra bcom pa khams gsum pa'i 'dod chags dang bral bar gyur nas/ gser dang bong bar mnyam pa3)/ nam mkha' dang lag mthilakhudu 'dra ba'i sems dang ldan pa/ tsan dan sbangs pa lta bur bsil bar gyur pa/rig pas sgo nga'i sbubs bcom pa/ rig pa dang / mngon par shes pa dang /so so yang dag par rig pa thob pa/ srid pa'i rnyed pa dang / chags pa dang /bkur ste la mi lta geb/ dbang po dang nye dbang dang (7bcas pa'i lha rnams kyis mchod cing rjed pa dang / gus par smra ba'i gnas su gyur to/ /de nas dge slong dag the tshom 5)skyes te/ the tshom 6)thams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa mdzes pas las gang dag bgyis na deshegazugs bzang zhing / blta nan sdug la mdzes te/ mi'i kha dog las ni 'das/lha'i kha dog ni ma thob par gyur la/ 'di btsas pa'i tshe yang shin tu rmad du byung ba du ma byung bar gyur te/ de dag gis grong khyer ser skya'i gnas kun tu mdzes par bgyis nyurilags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag mdzes pa nyid kyis sngon tshe rabs gzhan dag tu tshogs rnyed cing rkyen grub pa dang ldan te dba' rgal bzhin du 'byung la/ gdon mi za bar 'ong ba'i las de dag byas shing bsags pas nas/ mdzes pa nyid kyis las byas shing bsags pa de dag gzhan su zhig gis nyams su myong bar 'gyur te/ dge slong dag las byas shing bsags pa rnams ni phyi rol gyi sa'i khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur/chu'i khams dang / me'i khams dang / rlung gi khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur te/ las dge ba dang mi dge ba byas shing bsags pa rnams ni zin pa'i phung po dang / khams dang / skye mched rnams 'ba' zhig la rnam par smin 75—566

par 'gyur ro/ /lus can dag gi las rnams ni/ /bskal pa brgyar yang chud mi za/ /tshogs shing dus la bab pa na/ /'bras bu7nyid du smin par 'gyur/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na bskal pa bzang po 'di nyid la skye dgu'i tshe lo bzhi khri thub pa na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu gdul bya'i〈kyekha lo sgyurabab bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyitswaston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'khor ba 'jig ces bya ba 'jig rten du byung ste/ de rgyal po'i pho brang grong khyer mdzes ldan na rten cing bzhugs so/ /de nas rgyal po mdzes pas de'i dbu skra dang sen mo'i mchod rten brtsigs so/ /de nas re zhig na de'i dus ston zhig byung ba'i tshe mdza' sde dag cig mchod7rten gyi drung du dong ba las/ de dag gis mchod rten de mthong nas7)dad pa skyes te me tog btags so/ /de dag gi nang nasamu mdza' sde bo7gcig na re bdag la ni ci yang med kyis1 )/ bdag ni ci yang 3)mi byed do zhes zer nas de 32mdza' sde de dag gi nang nas phyir byung ba las de 'gyod 35pa skyes te/ des me tog rnam pa sna tshogs btus nas mchod rten de nyid la 0phul lol/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag ji snyam 8du sems/de'i tshe de'i dus na mdza' sde bo 'gyod 7pa skyes nas yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'khor ba 'jig gi dbu skra dang sen mo'i mchod rten la me tog 'bulam ba gang yin pa nyunyade ni mdzes pa 'di yin no/ /dge slong dag mdzes pas ni las gzhan dag kyang byas shing bsags te/ dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na grong khyer bā rā ṇa sī tsho/)na tshong 3 )dpon zhig gnas pa des rang sangs rgyas 75—567

nad pa zhig mthong ngo / /de nas dad pa skyes te rkang pa la phyag 'tshalanyenas bsod snyoms kyang phul/ gos kyang phul lo/ /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/de'i tshe de'i dus na tshong dpon du gyur pa gang yin pa de ni mdzes pa 'di yin no//gzhan yang bcom ldan 'das 'od srungar+sā)gi ring la mi dbul po shing thun zhig tu gyur te/ de ri'i (gesul zhig tu shing thur song ba dang / des mchod rten zhig mthong na54)mchod rten de'i 'khor sa na rtswa dag kyang skyesadza so/ /de nas de dad pa skyes nas des tshogartswa rnams kyang phyung ste phyags ma thogs nas mchod rten dang mchod rten gyi 'khor sa phyags so/ /de nas zhabs la phyag 'tshalatswate smon lam btab pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba dang / sems bskyed pa 'dis na bdag gzugs bzang zhing blta50na sdug la mdzes par gyur cig /ma 'ongs pa'i dus na yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams mnyes par byed par gyur cig /mi mnyes par byed par ma gyur cig ces byas so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus na dbul po shing thun du gyur pa gang yin pa de ni mdzes pa 'di nyid tsheyin te/ des mchod rten dang mchod rten gyi 'khor sa phyags nyu1pa des na gang dang gang du skyes pa de〈nyedang der gzugs bzang zhing blta kyirten sdug la mdzes par gyur to/ /rgyu de nyid kyis na stud ltar yang dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas so/ /dge slong dag de ltar na las gcig tu nges par gnag pa rnams ni rnam par smin pa yang gcig tu nges par gnag par 'gyur ro/ /las gcig tu nges par dkar ba rnams ni rnam par smin pa yang gcig tu nges par dkar bar 'gyur ro/ /las 'drenacham rnams ni rnam par smin pa yang 'dren tsomar 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag de 75—568

bas na las gcig tu nges par gnag pa rnams dang las 'dren51)ma rnams spangs la / las gcig tu nges par dkar ba rnams 'ba' zhig la gtad 97par bya ste/dge slong khyed kyis de ltar bslab par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas dge slong de dag yi charangs te bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// // gang po la sogs pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa brgya pa/4) bam po nyi shu pa/ ka bsnyin zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po rnams dang /blon po chen po rnams dang / phyug po rnams dang / pho brang 'khor gyi mi rnams dang ske/ tshong dpon rnams dang / ded dpon rnams dang / lha rnams dang /klu rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams dang / lha ma yin rnams dang / nam mkha' lding rnams dang / mi 'am ci rnams dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis bkur ste byas/ bla mar byas/ ri mor byas/ mchod pa byas te/ lha dang /klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis mchod cing shes pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bsod nams chen po dang ldan pa/ na bza' dang / zhal zas dang / gzims cha dang / gdan dang / snyan gsos dang / sman zong rnams brnyes pa/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa mnyan du yod pa na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshalasnyikhyim bdag mgon57med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe lho phyogs na rgyal po rtogashon)ldan zhes bya bam1)rgyal po byed de / de'i 7ring la 'byor pa dang / rgyas pa dang / bde ba dang / lo legs pa dang / skye bo nyutedang mi mang pos gang ba dang / rtsod pa dang / 'thab pa zhi 75—569

ba dang / 'khrug pa dang / nang 'khrug dang / chom rkun dang / mu ge dang /nad rnams med pa dang / 'bras sā nyu)lu dang / bu ram shing dang / ba lang dang ske/ ma he dang ldan par 'dug ste/ gnod pa med cing tsher ma dkrugs la bu gcig pa la bya ba bzhin du rgyal srid bskyangs so/ /de nas phyis re zhig na de btsun mo dang lhan cig tu rtse zhing dga' la dga' mgur du spyod do/ /de rtse zhing dga' la dga' mgur rinaspyod pa las btsun mo la bu chags nas/ de zla ba brgyad dam dgu lon pa dang ri dbu byung ste/ khye'u gzugs bzang zhing blta5snyen sdug la mdzes pa yan lag dang / nying lag thams cad dang ldan pa zhig btsas sol/ /de nas de btsas pa'i btsas ston 6byas nas ka pi na riXzhes ming btags sol/ /de nas khye'u ka pi nan pang na 9'tsho ba'i ma ma gnyis dang / nu ma snun pa'i ma ma gnyis dang / dri ma 'khru ba'i ma ma gnyis dang / rtse ba'i ma ma gnyis te ma ma brgyad la gtad 1 nas/ de ma ma brgyad kyis 'o ma dang / zho dang ske/ mar dang / zhun mar dang / mar gyi nying /1khu dang / gzhan yang yo byad kyi khyad par bzang ngo cog gis bskyed bsrings te mtsho'i nang gi pad ma bzhin du 12skye drag par gyur to/ /gang gi nyin par rgyal po'i bu ka pi hurten btsas pa de kho na'i nyin par blon po khri brgyad stong gi bu yang btsas te/ thams cad kyang tshan sapo che'i stobs dang ldan pa sha stag go/ /de dag gi ming yang so so'i rkyen rkyen du 'tsham par btags so/ /de nas re zhig na rgyal po rtog78ldan shi nas de'i 'og tu bu ka pi tshan rgyal por bcug go/ /blon po'i bu khri brgyad stong po nyu de dag thams cad kyang rgyal po'i /8blon por bskos so/ /de nas phyi zhig na rgyal po ka pi na chen po blon po 19khri brgyad stong gis zhabs 'bring byas na )te ri 75—570

dgas shor du song ba dang des mdun logs dang rgyab stilogs su dpung chen po thams cad bltas nas blon po rnams la dris pa/ kwa'etshashed ltar nga'i dpung chen po 'di lta bu dag gzhan su la yod ces byas so/ /de nas blon po snyan par smra ba rnams kyis lha su la yang ma mchis so zhes byas so/ /de nas yul dbus nas tshong pa dag cig lho phyogs su song ba de dag gis rgyal po ka pisko na chen po la skyes phul lo / /de nas rgyal pos smras pa/ kye tshong pa dag yul de'i rgyal po su yin/tshong pa rnams kyis gsol pa/ lha yul kha cig na ni mang po tshogs pa dbang bgyid do/ /yul kha cig na ni rgyal po dbang bgyid do/ /de nas re zhig na rgyal po ka pi stin chen pos sa)mnyan du yod pa la sogs pa grong khyer chen po drug tu pho nya btang ste/ gal te khyod rdzi)'greng ba la bab pamanyan yang ma 'dug par myur du shegatso)shig /de ltar ma byas na chad pas cher gcod7)do zhes byas so/ /de nas tshig de thos nas grong khyer chen po drug na gnas pa'i rgyal po rnams 'jigs sna shing skrag la hu)mi dga' ste skyi bung zhes byas nas 'dus shing tshogs te gros 'thun par byas nas mnyan du kyi yod par lhags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du dong hurteste gtam de bcom ldan 'das la rgyas par gsol to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de dag dbugs phyung ste pho nya de nga'i thad du khug shig ces bka' stsal toci/ /de nas de dag gis pho nya la kho bo cag gi borgyal po'i yang rgyal po yod kyis 8re zhig 3 de'i spyan sngar mchi lha shig ces bsgo'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis (/rtepo nya 'ong bar thugs su chud nas rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal lha'i grong khyer bltam )na sdug dang 'dra bar 37rin po che 22sna bzhir sprul to/ /rgyal po chen po bzhi ni de'i sgo dpon lta bur bkod do/ /glang po che sa srung gi bu 75—571

lta bu dag dang / rta sprin gyi shugs can lta bu dag0)dang / shing7rta dga' byed sgra lta bu dag dang / mi gnod sbyin mi bzadas pa lta bu dag kyang bkod do/ /bcom ldan 'das nyid ni 'khor los sgyur 4)ba'i rgyal po'i cha lugs su sprul to/ /seng ge'i khri 'phang du ta la bdun tsam55)yod pa yang sprul te/ de la bcom ldan 'das bzhugs so/ /de nas pho nyas de lta bur mdzes pa dag mthong nas mchog tu ya mtshan du gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis phrin7yig bris nas pho nya de la bka' stsal pa/ rgyal po ka pi riman la nga na re phrinas yig mthong ba7kho na'i tshe gal te khyod 'greng ba la bab na yang ma 'dug par myur du shog shig /gal te ma 'ongs na nga dpung gi tshogs chen po dang 'ong ngo zhes gyis shig /de nas pho nya song ste 'irgyal po ka pi51na chen po la phrin hunyeyig dang kha than du btab pa7༄de dag thams7cad byas so/ /de nas rgyal po ka bsnyen chen po blon po khri brgyad stong gis zhabs 'bring7byas te hu mthar gyis song song nas mnyan du yod par phyin pa dang / nyi hu 'og gi rgyal po rnams kyis rgyal po ka pi tunyen chen po bsu nas de dag gis bkur sti chen pos grong zhu )khyer du gshegs su gsol te mnyel bso du stonas bcom ldan 'das la gsol to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de 'ong bar thugs su chud nas thams cad snga ma bzhin du sprul to/ /de nas rgyal po ka pi rdurten chen po rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal du song nas mthong ma thag tu de'i gzugs la gzugs kyi rgyags ri nyepa dang / dbang phyug la dbang phyug gi rgyags pa gang yin pa de med par gyur to/ /stobs kyi kyi)dregs pa ni da dung yod bzhin no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'jig rten pa'i dgongs pa bskyed de lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis dbang po'i gzhu khyer te 'ongs na legs so 75—572

snyam du dgongs nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa bskyed pa'i mod la lha'i dbang po brgyanyebyin gyis kha lo pa'i cha lugs kyis dbang po'i gzhusalaphul lo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyal po ka pi zhun chen po la byin na/ de rgyal po ka posnyin chen pos bteg⑧par yang ma nus na bdung b.rar+sā)lta ga la nus/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis lcags kyi rnga bo che bdun sprul te nyid kyis〈shegazhu de zla gam bzhin du bdungs nas gnamashemada' 'phangs te/ des lcags kyi rnga bo che bdun char thal phyung nas de las sgra byung ba/ nges par 'byung ba brtsamatshwa) par gyis/ /sangs rgyas bstan la sbyor bar gyis/ /'dam bu'i khyim la glang chen bzhin/ / 'chi bdag sde ni gzhom par gyis/ (7gang zhig chos 'dul 'di nyid la/ /bag yod spyod par byed pa ni/ /skye ba'i 'khor batshwa)rab spangs nas / /sdug bsngal zad par byed par 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba'i sgra byung nas sgra de yang 'og min gyi lha'i7)yul man chad du grag gos/ /de nas rgyal po ka pi bon chen po'i stobs kyicadregs pa de yang med par gyur te〈 〉de'i blo skyes pa/ e ma de ci zhig snyam mo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyal po ka pi /snyen chen po'i sems kyi rgyu ba thugs su chud nas 'khor los sgyur hunyeba'i rgyal po'i5) cha lugs mi snang bar mdzad de mdo 'di gsungs so/ /dge slong dag de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni stobs bcu dang ldan pa/mi 'jigs pa bzhis mi 'jigs pa/ khyu mchog gi gnas rgya chen po la dam bcas pa/ tshangs pa'i 'khor lo bskor ba/ 'khor gyi nang du yang dag pa'i seng ge'i sgra sgrogs pa ste/ 'di lta ste/ 'di yod na 'di 'byung la/ 'di skyes pas 'di skye bar 'gyur te/ 'di lta ste/ ma rig pa'i rkyen gyis 'du byed 75—573

rnams / 'du byed kyi rkyen gyis rnam par shes pa/ rnam par shes pa'i rkyen gyis ming dang gzugs/ ming dang gzugs kyi rkyen gyis skye mched drug /skye mched drug gi rkyen gyis reg pa/ reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba/ tshor ba'i rkyen gyis sred 3)pa/ sred pa'i rkyen gyis len pa/ len pa'i rkyen gyis srid pa/ srid pa'i rkyen gyis skye ba/ skye ba'i rkyen gyis rga shi dang / mya ngan dang / smre sngags 'don pa dang / sdug ༄gebasngal ba dang / yid mi bde ba dang / 'khrug pa rnams 'byung bar 'gyur te/ de ltar na sdug bsngal gyi phung po chen po 'ba' zhig po'ad)'di 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /'di lta ste/ 'di med na 'di mi 'byung la / 'di 'gags pas 'di 'gag par 'gyur te/ 'di lta ste/ ma rig pa 'gags53)pas 'du byed 'gag /'du byed 'gags pas rnam par shes pa 'gag /rnam par shes pa 'gags pas ming dang gzugs 'gag /ming dang gzugs 'gags pas skye mched drug 'gag /skye mched drug 'gags pasasnyireg pa 'gag /reg pa 'gags 6)pas tshor ba 'gag /tshor ba 'gags pas sred pa 'gag /sred pa 'gagasal/pas len pa 'gag /len pa 'gags pas srid pa 'gag /srid pa 'gags pas skye ba 'gag /skye ba 'gags pas rga shi dang /mya ngan dang / smre sngags 'don pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / yid mi bde ba dang / 'khrug pa rnams 'gag par 'gyur te/ de ltar na rin/sdug bsngal gyi phung po chen po 'ba' zhig po 'di 'gag par 'gyur ro/ /dge slong7)dag nga'i chos ni legs par gsungs pa/ gsal bar 1 sirnam par phye ba/ rgyu ba gcod pa/lha dang mi man cad nyu1la yang dag par legs par bstan pa yin kyi te/ de ltar chos ni lha legs par gsungs pa/ gsal bar rnam par phye ba/ rgyu ba gcod pa/75—574

lha dang mi man cadarkyal yang dag par legs parakhubastan pa la ni rigs kyi bu dad pas rab tu byung bas ston pa'i bstan pa la brtson par bya ba'i rigs pa kho na'o/ /sbyor bar bya ba'i rigs so/ /bag yod par bya ba'i rigs so/ /lus kyi sha khrag kun skams7te/ pagasalgepa dang / chu ba dang / rus pa 'ba' zhig lus pa ni sla'i⑤/ chos rnams la brtson 'grus brtsams pa 6) mthu dang ldan pa/ brtson 'grus dang ldan pa/ spro ba dang ldan pa/ mthu rtsal dang ldan57pa/ brtson pa mi 'dor bas5gyithob par bya ba gang yin pa desalam thob kyi bar du bar ma dor brtson 'grus gtang tshibar ni mi bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/le lo can ni sdug bsngal bzhin du gnas pa ste/ sdig pa mi dge ba'i chos kun nas nyon mongs par57byed pa/ yang srid par skye bar byed pa/ rims nad dang bcas pa(rte/ sdug bsngal gyi rnam par smin pa dang ldan pa/ phyi ma la skye ba dang ske/ rga shir 'gyur ba rnams dngam//'dres pa yin te/ de'i77ni don chen po yang yongs su nyams par 'gyur ro/ /brtson 'grus brtsams 8pa ni bde bar gnas pa ste/ sdig pa mi dge ba'i chos kun nas nyon mongs par byed pa/yang srid par skye bar byed pa rims nad dang bcas pa/ sdug bsngal gyi rnam par smin pa dang ldan pa/ phyi ma la skye ba dang rga shir 'gyur ba rnams dang ma 'dres pa yin te/ de'i ni ⑩don chen po yang yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag 'di lta ste/ ston pa yang mngon sum du bzhugs la nyi tshochos kyang ston te nye bar zhi bar byed pa/ yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar nyu byed pa17/rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu 'gro bar byed pa/ bde bar gshegs pas gsungs pa'i gsung rabasdo )'di ni snying khu btung bar 'os pa yin no/ /dge slong dag de bas 75—575

na bdag gi don dang / gzhan gyi don dang / gnyi ga'i don yang dag par mthong ba rnams kyis ni 'di la so so nas legs par bslab par bya ste/ ji ltar byas na0)bdag cag rab tu byung ba don yod pa dang / 'bras bu dang bcas pa dang ske/ bde ba skyed50pa dang / bde ba'i rnam par smin par 'gyur la/ gang dag gisagos dang / zas dang / mal cha dang / stan dang / nad gsos dang ske/ sman zong rnams bdag cag gis longs spyodam0pa de dag gi bkur ste de dag kyang ji ltar byas na 'bras bu shin tu che ba dang / phan yon che ba dang / byin che ba dang /(3) rgya che bar 'gyur ba skuzhig gu snyam du dge slong khyed kyis de ltar bslab par bya'o/ /chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bshad pa na rgyal po ka pi na chen po blon po khri brgyad stong gi 'khor dang bcas pas 'jig ④tshogs la lta ⑨ba'i ri'i rtse mo mthon ( )po nyi shu ye shes rdo rjes 9/stobacom nas rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas te/ bden pa mthong nas bcom ldan 'das kyi〈rtebastan pa la rab tu byung ste/ des brtson pa dang / bsgrubasngo pa dang / 'bad pas phol mig lnga pa'i 'khor ba'i 'khor lo 'di nyid g.yo zhing mi brtan par rig nas 'du byed kyi rnam pa gethams cad snyil geb dang / ltung ba dang / rnam par 'thor ba dang / rnam par 'jig pa'i chos can yin par rtsad chod de/ nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs nas dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas te(nya/dgra bcom pa khams gsum pa'i 'dod chags dang bral bar gyur nas gser dang bong bar mnyam pa nam mkha' dang lag mthil sna du 'dra ba'i sems dang ldan pa/tsan dan sbangs pa lta bur bsil /shebar gyur pa/ rig pas sgo nga'i sbubs bcom pa / rig pa dang / mngon par shes pa dang / so so yang dag par rig pa 75—576

thob pa/ srid pa'i rnyed pa dang/ chags pa dang / bkur sti la mi lta ba/dbang po dang nye dbang dang bcas pa'i lha rnams kyis mchod cing rjed pa dang gus paratusmra ba'i gnas su gyur to②/ /de nas dge slong dag the tshom skyes te/the tshom thams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa ka pikhunas las gang dag bgyis na desalgegazugs bzang zhing blta55)na sdug la mdzes pa dang / blon po khri brgyad stong gi 'khor dang bcas par tshan po)po che'i stobs dang ldan par gyur las/ rab tu byung nas kyang dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du bgyis lagasal/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag ka bshen nyid kyis sngon tshe rabasatshwa )gzhan dag tu tshogs rnyed cing rkyen grub pa dang ldan te dba' rgal bzhin du 'byung la/ gdon mi za bar 'ong ba'i las de dag byas shing bsags pas na ka pi5nyen nyid kyis las byas shing bsags pa de dag gzhan su zhig gis nyams su myong bar 'gyur te/ dge slong dag las byas shing bsags pa rnams ni phyi rol gyi sa'i khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur / chu'i khams dang / me'i khams dang / rlung gi khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur te/ las dge ba dang mi dge ba byas shing bsags pa rnams ni zin pa'i phung po dang / khams dang / skye mched rnams 'ba' zhig la rnam par smin par 'gyur ro/ /lus can dag gi las rnams ni/ /bskal pa brgyar yang chud mi za/ /tshogs shing dus la bab pa na/ /'bras bu nyid du smin par 'gyur / /dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na bskal pa dgu bcu rtsa gcig pa la skye dgu'i tshe lo brgyad khri thub pa na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde 75—577

bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu gdul bya'i shi)kha lo sgyurasnyib bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnam par gzigs zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung steris/ de rgyal po'i pho brang gnyen caldan na rten cing bzhugs so/ /de nas re zhig na ded dpon zhig gis rgya mtsho chen po'i nang nas rin po che mang po khyer te 'ongs nas des yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa zla ba gsum gyi bar du bshos la spyan drangs so/ /gtsug lag khang yang brtsigs nas phyogs bzhi'i dge 'dun la phul lo/ /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems / de'i tshe de'i dus na ded dpon du gyur pa gang yin pa de ni ka thamashen 'di yin no/ /dge slong dag ka pi nenas ni las gzhan dag kyang byas shing bsags te/ dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na grong khyer bā rā ṇa sbom non rgyal po tshangs pas byin zhes bya ba rgyal po byed de/ de'i ring la 'byor pa dang ske/ rgyas pa dang / bde ba dang / lo legs pa dang / skye bo dang mi mang pos gang ba dang / rtsod 8)pa dang / 'thab pa zhi ba dang / 'khrug pa dang ske/ nang 'khrugs9skudang / chom rkun dang / mu ge 1 dang / nad rnams med pa dang / 'bras sā 1 lu dang / bu ram shing dang / ba lang dang / ma ho dang ldan par 'dug ste/ chos dang ldan pa chos kyi rgyal po chos bzhin du rgyal po byed do/ /de phyi zhig na blon po khri brgyad stong gis zhabs 'bring 3)byas te/ skyed mos tshal / gyi shing rnams me tog rgyas la/ ngang pa dang / khrung khrung dang /rma bya dang / ne tso bodang / ri skegs dang / khu byug dang / shang shang te'u rnams skad 'byin pa'i nags khrod du song ba las des skyed mos tshal der rang 75—578

sangs rgyas nad pa zhig mthong nas/ des de la zla ba gsum gyi bar du phan pa'i zas kyis bsnyen bkur7byas so/ /yongs su mya ngan las na'adas pa'i 'og tu yang de'i sku gdung gi mchod rten brtsigs nas blon po'i tshogs dang bcas pas til mar gyis bskus te/ des na 'khor dang bcas pa tshanas po che'i stobs dang ldan par gyur 7to/ /gzhan yang sangs rgyas 'ob srung gi ring la rab tu byung ste/ des der dbang po yongs su smin par byas pa des na da 5ltar dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas so/ /dge slong dag de ltar na las gcig tu nges par gnag pa rnams ni rnam par smin pa yang gcig tu nges par gnag par 'gyur ro/ /las gcig tu nges par dkar ba rnams ni rnam par smin pa yang gcig tu nges par dkar bar 'gyur ro/ /las 'dren snyo ma rnams ni rnam par smin pa yang 'dren ⑦mar 'gyur ro/ /dge slong nadag de bas na las gcig tu nges par gnag pa rnams dang las 'dren 7rim rnams spangs la/ las gcig tu nges par dkar ba rnams 'ba' zhig la gtad par bya ste/ dge slong khyed kyis de ltar bslab par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ dge slong de dag yi nyu rangs te bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// //bzang ldan zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po rnams 11dang ske/ blon po chen po rnams dang / phyug po rnams dang / pho brang 'khor gyi mi rnams dang / tshong dpon rnams dang / ded dpon rnams dang / lha rnams dang / klu rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams dang / lha ma yin rnams dang ske/ nam mkha' lding rnams dang / mi 'am ci rnams dang / lto 'phye chen 75—579

po rnams kyis bkur sti byas/ bla mar byas/ ri mor byas/ mchod pa byas te / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis mchod cing shes pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bsod nams chen po dang ldan pa/ na bza' dang / zhal zas dang / gzims77cha dang / gdan dang / snyun gsos dang / sman zong rnams brnyes pa/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa mnyan⑧du yod pa na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /de nas gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas lo bcu gnyis lon te/ no/ lo bcu gnyis 'das nas grong khyer ser skya'i gnas su byon pa de'i tshe bre bo zas dang / bdud rtsi zas la sogs pa shākya stong phrag du mas bden pa mthong ste/ rgyal po zas gtsang masreni ma gtogasam5)so/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang skyonagis sras kyi legs pa de dag mthong nas mchog tu ya mtshan du gyur te de'i blo skyes pa/ gal te bdag gi bu rab tu ma byung du rin na ni 'di 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po mtha' bzhir rgyal ba / chos dang ldan pa/ chos kyi rgyal por 'gyur ba zhig na/ das④ni 'di thor tshugs can rab tu byung ba'i g.yog byas pa ni rab tu 3)mi mdzes kyis ⑨bdag gis shākya rnams/las khyim re mi re rab tu 'byung du gzhugs3tshegor ma chag snyam mo//de nas rgyal po zas gtsang nyi gis shākya thams cad bsdu ba'i phyir grong khyer du dril bsgrags so/ /de nas shākya thams cad 'dus pa'i nang du rgyal po zas gtsang gis smras pa/ kye shākya khyed rnams nyon cig /gal te gzhonatshwanyenu don thams cad grub pa rab tu ma byung du zin na yang khyed kho nas 'di la bsnyen bkur bya 75—580

dgos na/ da 'dinyerab tu byung gis7shākya khyim re mi rephubasnyen bkur bya ba'i phyir rab tu phyungasnyishig ces byas so/ /de nas bzang ldan dang / ma 'gags pa dang / nam gru dang / lhasasbyin la sogs pa shākya'i bu lnga brgya rab tu 'byung bar chasane'uso/ /de nas de dag gi 'bregatsomakhan bsnyen bkur byed pa nye bar 'khor des de dag rab tu 'byungam ba mthong nas ngus so/ /de nas shākya rnams kyis nye bar 'khor khyod ci'i phyir ngu zhes dris so/ /de nas des snying rje rje skad zer zhing sdug sdug skad zer la gte7zhing smra ste/ khyod rab tu byung na da bdag la 0tezas dang gos kyis (nyeskyong ba su zhig mchis/ de nas shākya rnams kyis smras pa(nye/ nye bar 'khor 'o na ras thing shig ces7byas so/ /de nas des ras bting nas shākya rnams kyis lus la thogs pa'i do shal dang / se mo do dang /nor bu dang / mu tigarwanyedang / be+e drur+ya77dang / dpung rgyan dang / sor gdub rnams phung po chenarwastepor srungasal te byin no/ /de nas 'bregaphu) mkhan nye bar 'khor gyis rab tu 'byung ba de dag kyang mthong la rgyan rnam pa sna tshogs la yang bltas nas tshul bzhin 2teyid la byed pa skyes te/ shākya 'di dag ni cho rigs dang / byad gzugs dang / lang tshomanyadang / 'byor pa dang ldan pa yin na/ 'on kyang btsun mo rnams dang / rgyan 'di dag mchil ma bzhin du bor nas rab tu byung na bdag ci yang mi bdog pa zhig gis da rgyan 'di dag khyim du bskur〈nyedu ci yod de/ 'di dag btang la bdag kyang 'di dag gi rjes su rab tu 'byung gor ma chag snyam mo/ /de nas 'bregs(2mkhan nye bar 'khor bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshalamanyete/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom 75—581

ldan 'das gal te bdag cag lta bu yang legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu 'byung 0)ba mchis la rab tu 'byung ba dang bsnyen ②par rdzogs shing dge slong gi dngos po 'thobs tu rung na/ bdag kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du tshangs par spyod pa spyad par 'tshal lo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong tshur shog ces byas pas5༄rab tu phyung ngo / /de nas bzang ldan la sogs pa shākya lnga brgya gedage slong gi cha lugs can rnams sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun la phyag 'tshal bar byas pa las de dag gis nye bar 'khor gyi rkang par6)ngo shes nas cho 7)rigs dang / byad gzugs dang / 'byor pa dang ldan pa'i phyir 48)nye bar 'khor la phyag 'tshal du ma btub 9tsho/nas/ der bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa bzang ldan la bka' stsal pa/ bzang ldan gang gi phyir nga'i bstan pa 'di la ni cho rigs dang / byad gzugs dang /tso lang tsho dang / dbang phyug dang / rigs bzhi rnam par dag pa dang sbyar ba med kyis /nya'adi la phyag 'tshol /2cig /de nas bzang ldan la sogs pa shākya lnga brgyas chos nyid btsan 12par byas nas sdong po 8rtsa ba nas bcad pa bzhin du rkang pa la phyag byas so/ /de dag gis rkang pa la phyag byas pa'i mod la sa chen po 'di rnam pa drug tu g.yos so/ /de nyu2nas der tshe dang ldan pa bzang ldan gyis brtson pa dang ske/ bsgrub pa 17dang / 'bad pas phol mig lnga pa'i 'khor ba'i 'khor lo 'di nyid g.yo zhing mi brtan par rig nas 'du byed kyi rnam pa thams cad snyilasngo rmeb dang / ltung ba dang / rnam par 'thor ba dang /18 rnam par 'jig pa'i chos can yin par rtsad chod de/ nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs nas dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas te/ dgra bcom pa khams gsum pa'i 'dod 75—582

chags dang bral bar gyur nas gser dang bong bar mnyam pa/ nam mkha' dang lag mthil ①du 'dra ba'i sems dang ldan pa/ tsan ②dan sbangs pa lta bur bsil〈bar gyur pa/ rig pas sgo nga'i sbubasasnyibacom pa/ rig pa dang /mngon par shes pa dang / so so yang dag par rig pa thob pa/ srid pa'i rnyed pa dang / chags pa dang / bkur sti la mi lta ba/ dbang po dang nye dbang dang bcas pa'i lha rnams kyis mchod cing rjed pa dang gus par smra ba'i gnas su gyur to/ /de yang bdag nyid che ba/ sdug cing phongs pa rnams la snying brtse ba zhig ste/ phyi zhig na 3)snga dro sham thabs dang chos gos bgos te lhungapo)bzed thogs nas mnyan du yod par spyod yul la chas so/ /de nas re zhig na ④rigs ngan zhig gi khyim du bsod snyoms la song ngo / /de'i tshe ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal glang po che'i gtso bo pad ma dkar po gcig pu zhes bya ba la zhon (8)te/kha lo pa rgyu0)ba'i bu ring po dang / bcom ldan 'das la blta7ba'i phyir chas pa las ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis bzang ldan dbang po zhi ba/ yidarwatezhi ba/sems mchog tu dul zhing nye bar zhi ba dang ldan la phyag dar khrod kyi gos gyon zhing kha zas ngan pa khyer te rigs ngan gyi khyim de nas phyir byung ba mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang kha lo patsha/)rgyu ba'i bu ring po la dris pa/ 'di dge slong bzang ldan ma yin nam/ kha lo pas smras pa/ lha bka' stsal pa bzhin te de lags so//de nas ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal 'khams〈rtenas brgyalatswate sa la lhungasnyingo / /de nas chus gtor ba dang phyir sangs te sems rtas nas kha lo pa 8rgyu ( tshoba'i bu ring pos bslang ngo / /de nas rgyal po gsal rgyal bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du song ste / bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal rtenas bcom ldan 'das la gsol 75—583

pa / bcom ldan 'das bdag gis ni rmad du byung ba zhig mthong ste/ shākya'i rgyal po bzang ldan de phyag dar khrod kyi gos gyon zhing kha zas ngan pa thogs te lha dang mi dad par bgyis pa'i0)spyod lam shin du zhi bas bsod snyoms blangs te rigs ngan gyi khyim nas slar byung ba de la bdag 'di snyam bgyid do/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa ni shin tu dul bar bgyid pa lags te/ de la bsten na 'di lta bur skyid de bar 3)mchis la bde bas ri(bskyed pa dag kyang 'di ltar tshul dul bar gyur pa ni ngo mtshar che'o snyam bgyid do/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rgyal po chen po bzang ldan 'di la ni ngo mtshar che ba gzhan yang yod kyis ④nyon cig /rgyal po chen po bzang ldan 'di ni dgon ⑧pa na gnas sam/shing drung na gnas sam/ khang57stong na gnas kyang rung ste/ kye〈pem re skyid/kye ma re skyid/ bdag rab tu ma byung ba tsam na rgyal po'i pho brang gi nang na 'dug ste/ blon po chen po 58)dang / grong rdal gyi mi dang yul gyis1)mi rnams kyis shin tu legs par kyi )bsrungs la/ ra ba dang / 'obs dang / sgo dang /gcan51rnams kyis bskyabs /gekyang snying gzhan la dogs ཿ/shing mi dga' la kun la yang khu 'phrig bo za bzhin te/ gnyid kyang mi 'ong ba las da ni bdag lus dang srog la yang mi lta bas/ gnas gang dang gang du yang bde bar 'dug tu yod do zhes dga' ba'i tshig lan gsum du rjod par byed do/ /de nas dge slong dag the tsom skyes te/ the tsom thams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa bzang ldan gyis sngon 8tshe rabs gzhan dag tu las gang dag bgyis shing bsags na des gzugs bzang zhing blta na sdug la mdzes pa dang ske/ rgyal po'i rigs phyug por skyes la/ rab tu byung nas kyang dgra bcom 75—584

pa nyid mngon sum du bgyis lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/dge slong dag bzang ldan nyid kyis sngon tshe rabs gzhan dag tu tshogs rnyed cing rkyen grub pa dang ldan te dba' rgal bzhin du 'byung la/ gdon mi za bar 'ong ba'i las de dag byas shing bsags pas na/ bzang ldan nyid kyis las byas shing bsags pa de dag gzhan su zhig gis nyams su myong bar 'gyur te/ dge slong dag las byas shing bsags pa rnams ni phyi rol gyi sa'i khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur/ chu'i khams dang / me'i khams dang / rlung gi khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur te/ las dge ba dang mi dge ba byas shing bsags pa rnams7ni zin pa'i phung po dang / khams dang / skye mched rnams 'ba' zhig la rnam par smin par 'gyur ro/ /lus can dag gi⑧las rnams ni/ /bskal pa brgyar yang chud mi za/ /tshogs shing dus la bab pa na/ /'bras bu nyid du smin par 'gyur / /dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na grong khyer bā rā ṇa sī ④na sprang po zhig gnas la (2)lus bkres shing nyam yichung bas non nas phan tshun du 'khor 'khor ba las bu mo khur7ba khyer bsnyizhig mthong ngo de nas sprang po des khur stib 'dod pa'i phyir bu mo de bsnyagasasngo 7te nan gyis khur (1ba cig phrogs nas phan tshun du bros so/ /bu mo de yang de'i〈nyephyi bzhin du〈nya'abrang bzhin no/ /de nas sprang po des tsham tshom med par chu klung zlog byed la 'bogs so/ /sangs rgyas rnams mi 'byung ba'i tshe na rang sangs rgyas sdug cing phongasalgepa rnams la snying brtse ba bas mtha'i gnas mal gyis 'tsho ba 'jig rten gyi yon gnas gcig pu rnams 'jig rten du byung hunyeste/ re zhig na rang sangs rgyas shig sprang po de'i mdun du 'ongs so/ /de nas sprang po des rang 75—585

sangs rgyas spyod lam zhi ba de mthong nas dga' bshechen po skyes te/ de dga' ba chen pos phyirang gi sdug bsngal dang bsngos50te rang sangs rgyas la khur ba de phul lo/ /de nas rang sangs rgyas des de'i dga' ba rgyasachen po bskyed pa'i phyir / ngang pa'i rgyal po 'dab grubam brkyang bamatho)bzhin du nam mkha' la mngon par 'phags nas/ cho 'phrul rnam pa sna tshogs bstan to/ /de nas sprang po des lha dang mi dad par byed pa'i cho 'phrul shin du rmad du byung ba de mthong nas sdong po rtsa ba nas bcad (8)pa bzhin du rkang pa la phyag 'tshal 7te smon lam btab pa/ bdag gis yon gnas brtul zhugs grub pa la phul ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba dang / sems bskyed pa dang / sbyin par bya ba'i chos yongs su gtong ba 'dis na bdag gang dang gang du skyes pa de dang der rigs mthon por skye ba dang ske/ 'di lta bu'i chos dag pathob par gyur cig /'di bas kyang ches77khyad par du 'phags pa'i ston pa nyurtedag mnyes par byed par gyur cig /mi mnyes par byed par ma gyur cig ces byas so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis 3)bka' stsal pa / dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus na sprang por gyur pa gang yin pa de ni bzang ldan 'di yin te/ des rang sangs rgyas la khur ba phul ba'i las de'i rnam par smin pas ni shākya'i rigs phyug por skyes so/ /gzhan yang sangs rgyas 'od srung gi ring la rab tu byung ste/ des der lo khri'i bar du tshangs skopar spyod pa'i gnas bsrungs pa 'des ni da ltar dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas so/ /dge slong dag de ltar na las gcig tu nges par gnag pa rnams ni rnam par smin pa yang gcig tu nges par gnag par 'gyur ro/ /las gcig tu nges par dkar ba rnams ni rnam par smin pa yang tsogacig tu nges 75—586

par dkar bar 'gyur ro/ /las 'drenatum rnams ni rnam par smin pa yang 'drenas mar 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag desabs nasalas gcig tu nges par gnag pa rnams dang las 'dren55)ma rnams spangs la/ las gcig tu nges par dkar ba rnams 'ba' zhig la gtad par bya ste/ dge slong dag57khyed kyis de ltar bslab par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/dge slong de dag yi 9)rangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// //yul 'khor skyong zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po rnams dang / blon po chen po rnams dang / phyug po rnams dang / pho brang 'khor gyi mi rnams dang / tshong dpon rnams dang / ded dpon rnams dang /lha rnams dang / klu rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams dang / lha ma yin rnams dang / nam mkha' lding rnams dang / mi 'am ci rnams dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis bkur ste byas/ bla mar byas/ ri mor byas/ mchod pa byas te / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis mchod cing shes pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bsod nams chen po dang ldan pa/ na bza' dang / zhal zas dang / gzims cha dang / gdan dang / snyan gsos dang / sman zong rnams brnyes pa/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa7yul gsus po che zhes bya ba na gsus po che'i nags khrod na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe yul gsus po che na rgyal po sgra mi snyan zhes bya ba rgyal po byed des / de'i ring la 'byor pa dang / rgyas spupa dang / bde ba dang / lo legs pa dang /75—587
