skye bo dang mi mang pos gang ba dang / rtsod pa dang / 'thab pa zhi ba dang /'khrug pa dang / nang 'khrug dang / chom rkun dang / mu ge dang / nad rnams med pa dang / 'bras sā7lu dang / bu ram shing dang / ba lang dang /ma he dang ldan par 'dug ste/ chos dang ldan pa chos kyi rgyal po chos bzhin du rgyal po byed do/ /de nas de'i nu bo'i bu yul 'khor skyong zhes bya ba gzugs bzang zhing bltasan sdug la mdzes pa/ yan lag dang nying lag thams cad dang ldan pa zhig yod pa de gdul ba'i dus la bab par bcom ldan 'das kyis gzigs nas snga dro sham thabs dang chos gos gsol te/ lhung bzed bsnams nas dge slong gi chadage 'dun (7gyis mdun gedu bdar cing dge slong gi tshogs kyis zhabs 'bringapo)byas te yul gsus po cher bsod snyoms la gshegs pa dang /yul 'khor skyong gis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sku skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis legs par brgyan pa/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus mdzes par byas pa/ 'od 'dom gang gis brgyan pa/ nyi ma stong bas lhag pa'i 'od mnga' ba/ rin po che'i ri bo 'gro ba lta bu kun nas bzang ba mthong nas/mthong ma thag tu de bcom ldan 'das la 8sems dga' bar zla gyur to/ /de dga' ba skyes nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal mite rab tu 'byung bar gsol ba btab bo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de la bka' stsal pa/bu khyod pha mas gnang ngam/ yul 'khor skyong gis gsol pa/ btsun pa ma gnangamanyunyalags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ bu de bzhin gshegs pa rnams sam/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i nyan thos rnams ni pha mas ma gnang bar rab tu 'byung ba'am/ bsnyen par rdzogs par mi mdzad do/ /de 75—588

nas yul 'khor skyong pha ma'i thad du song ste phyin nas sangs rgyas kyi bsngags7pa brjod de/ bdag gis ni bcom ldan 'das yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal srid rgyas pa dang / btsun mo drug khri spangs nas dbu skra bregs te chos gos snam sbyar gsol nas yul gsus po gecho 'di nyid na bsod snyoms lasargyu zhingasnyibazhugs pa mthong gis⑤/ bdag bcom ldan 'das rab tu byung ba'i rjes su rab tu 'byung bar gnang bar mdzad pa'i rigs so/ /de nas de'i pha ma gnyis kyis ma gnang ngo / /de nas de zhag gcig dang / gnyis dang / gsum nas drug gi bar du kha 'tshos so/ /de nas yul 'khor skyong gi pha ma gnyis bu yul 'khor skyong ga la ba der song ste phyin nas bu yul 'khor skyong la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bu yul 'khor skyong shes par gyis shig /khyod ni skyid de bar 'dug 'dug pa bde ba 'dod pa yin te/khyod kyis ④sdug ma myong ba yin la tshangs par spyod pa ni spyad par dka'o/ /dben par gnas pa ni dka'o⑨/ /gcig pu 'dug pa ni dga' bar bya 6 )dka'o / /dgon pa dang / nags khung dang / bas mtha'i gnas mal du gnas bca' ba ni yid la bsam par yang dkas(nya/ bu yul 'khor skyong7)'di nyid du 'dug la 'dod pa rnams kyang longs spyad par gyis shig /sbyin pa dag kyang byin cig /bsod nams dag kyang gyis shig ces de skad byas na yang hu)khyim bdag gi bu yul 'khor skyong cang mi zer ro/ /de nas khyim bdag gi bu yul 'khor skyong gi pha ma gnyis kyis nye du rnams la bskul te/ kye nye du rnams bu yul 'khor skyong slong mishig ces byas so/ /de nas khyim bdag gi bu yul 'khor skyong gi nye du rnams khyim bdag gi bu yul 'khor skyong ga la ba der dongs ste lhags nas 75—589

khyim bdag gi bu yul 'khor skyong la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bu yul 'khor skyong shes par gyis shig /khyod ni skyid de bar 'dug 'dug pa bde ba 'dod pa yin te / khyod ni sdug ma myong ba yin la tshangs par spyod pa ni spyad par dka'o/ /dben par gnas pa ni dka'o/ /gcig pu'u'adug pa ni dga' bar bya7dka'o//dgon pa dang / nags khung dang / bas mtha'i gnas mal du gnas bca' ba ni yid la bsam par yang dkasaris/ bu yul 'khor skyong khyod 'di nyid du 'dug la 'dod pa rnams kyang longs spyad par gyis shig /sbyin pa dag kyang byin cig /bsod nams dag kyang gyis shig ces de skad byas rlochin yang / khyim bdag gi bu yul 'khor skyong cang mi zer ro/ /de nas khyim bdag gi bu yul 'khor skyong gi pha ma gnyis kyis yul 'khor skyong gi 45dgrogs po rnams la 9)bskul te/ kye byis pa dag bu yul 'khor skyong slong (7shig ces byas so/ /de nas khyim bdag gi bu yul 'khor skyong gi grogs po rnams yul 'khor skyong ga la ba der dongasheste lhags nas khyim bdag gi bu yul 'khor skyong la 'di skad ces smras so/ /desamatho)yul 'khor skyong shes par gyis shig /khyod ni skyid de bar 'dug 'dug pa bde ba 'dod pa yin te/ khyod ni sdug ma myong ba yin la tshangs par spyod pa ni spyad par dka'o / /dben par gnas pa ni dka'o/ /gcig pu 1 ci'adug pa ni dga' bar bya nyunyadaka'o/ /dgon pa dang / nags khung dang / bas mtha'i gnas mal du gnas bca' ba r+sha ni yid la bsam par yang dkas3na/ des pa yul 'khor skyong khyod 'di nyid du 'dug la 'dod pa rnams kyang longs spyad 0par gyis shig /sbyin pa dag kyang byin cig /bsod nams dag kyang gyis shig ces de skad byas na yang khyim bdag gi bu yul 'khor skyong cang mi zer ro/ /de nas khyim bdag gi 75wa 590

bu yul 'khor skyong gi grogs po rnams yul 'khor skyong gi pha ma gnyis ga la ba der dong7ste lhags nas khyim bdag gi bu yul 'khor skyong gi pha ma gnyis la 'di skad ces smras so/ /yab yum gnyis mkhyen par mdzod cig /des pa yul 'khor skyong gum na ci rung gis7yang dag pa'i dad pas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu 'byung du stsol cig dang / gal te rab tu 'byungasab la dga' bar gyuratshu rmen ni gson por mchis na ni7khyod kyis gzigs par 'gyur grang / gal te dga' bar ma gyur na ni bu 'gro ba'i sa pha ma ma gtogs pa gzhan ma mchis so/ /pha ma gnyis kyis smras pa/ byis pa dag gal te bu yul 'khor skyong rab tu byung ba'i 'og tu nged dang phradakyidu 'ong na ni de bzhin du gnang ngo / /de nas khyim bdag gi bu yul 'khor skyong gi grogs po rnams khyim bdag gi bu yul 'khor skyong ga la ba der dongasheste lhags nas yul 'khor skyong la 'di skad ces smras so/ /des pa yul 'khor skyong khyedakurab tu 'byung bar ni pha ma gnyis kyis gnang mod kyi / gal te rab tu byung ba'i〈 )'og tu phrad51du 'ong〈nyan gdod〈nyeganang ngo zhes zer ro/ /yul 'khor skyong gis smras pa/ kye phrad par bgyi'o/ /de nas khyim bdag gi bu yul 'khor skyong khad kyis lus kyi mthu dang stobs bskyed nas/bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshalasate phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas khyim bdag gi bu yul 'khor skyong gis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bdag ni pha mas gnang lags na bdag legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu 'byung ba dang bsnyen par rdzogs shing dge slong gi dngos po 'thob78tu rung na bdag kyang / bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du 75—591

tshangs par spyod pa spyad par 'tshal lo zhes gsol nas/ rigs kyi bu yul 'khor skyong gis legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la7)rab tu byung〈peb dang bsnyen par rdzogs shing dge slong gi dngos po thob par gyur to/ /de de ltar rab tu byung nas des brtson pa dang / bsgrub55)pa dang / 'bad pas phol mig lnga pa'i 'khor ba'i 'khor lo 'di nyid g.yo zhing mi brtan par rig nas 'du byed kyi rnam pa thams cad snyilam /ba dang / ltung ba dang / rnam par 'thor ba dang / rnam par 'jig pa'i chos can yin par rtsad chod de/ nyon mongs pa⑥thams cad spangs nas dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas te/ dgra bcom pa khams gsum pa'i 'dod chags dang bral bar gyur nas gser dang bong bar mnyam pa/nam mkha' dang lag mthil du 'dra ba'i sems dang ldan pa tsan dan sbangs pa lta bur bsil56)bar gyur pa/ rig pas sgo nga'i sbubs bcom pa/ rig pa dang /mngon par shes pa dang / so so yang dag par rig pa thob pa/ srid pa'i rnyed pa dang / chags pa dang / bkur sti la mi lta ba/ dbang po dang nye dbang dang bcas pa'i lha rnams kyis mchod ri7cing rjed pa dang gus par smra ba'i gnas su gyur to/ /der bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/dge slong dag nga'i nyan thos kyi dge slong dgon pa pa na rnams kyi mchog ni 'di lta ste / dge slong yul 'khor skyong 'di yin no/ /de nas dge slong dag the tsom skyes te/ the tsom thams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/btsun pa yul 'khor skyong gis las gang dag bgyis na des phyug po'i rigs su skyes te gzugs bzang zhing bltamanyu)na sdug la mdzes pa dang / rab tu byung nas kyang dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du bgyis lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 75—592

bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag yul 'khor skyong nyid kyis sngon tshe rabs gzhan dag tu tshogs rnyed cing rkyen grub pa dang ldan te dba' rgal bzhin du 'byung la/gdon mi za bar 'ong ba'i las de dag byas shing bsags pas na/ yul 'khor skyong nyid kyis las byas shing bsags pa de dag gzhan su zhig gis nyams su myong bar 'gyur te/ dge slong dag las byas shing bsags pa rnams ni phyi rol gyi sa'i khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur/ chu'i khams dang / me'i khams dang ske/ rlung gi khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur te/ las dge ba dang mi dge ba byas shing bsags panyernams ni zin pa'i phung po dang / khams dang /skye mched rnams 'ba' zhig la rnam par smin par 'gyur ro/ /lus can dag gi las rnams ni/ /bskal pashebargyar yang chud mi za/ /tshogs shing dus la bab pa na/ /'bras bu nyid dulasmin par 'gyur/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na lus 'phags kyi rgyal po pho brang 'khor gyi misnyedang bcas pa pha rol gyi dmag tshogs byung ste/ ci bya gtol med nas nags khung du zhugs te/de nyi ma gegang la nyi ma'i 'od zer tsha bas gdungs nas dpung gi tshogs dang bcas te phan tshun 'khor 'khor nas lam yang ma rnyed do/ /sangs rgyas rnams 'jig rten du mi 'byung ba'i tshe na rang sangs rgyas sdug cing phongs pa rnams la snying brtse ba/ bas mtha'i gnas mal gyis 'tsho ba/ 'jig rten gyi yonas/gnas gcig pu rnams 'jig rten du 'byung ste/ re zhig na rang sangs rgyas shig dgon pa'i lam de na gnas pa des snying rje7bskyed nas lus 'phags kyi rgyal po de la lam yang bstan/ chu'i lteng ka yang bstan nas des rgyal po de 'khor dang bcas pa'i srog phangs pa bskyangs so/ /de nas rgyal po de dad pa skyes nas rang 75—593

gi grong khyer du khrid de zla ba gsum gyi bar du yo byad thams cad kyis bsnyen bkur byas so/ /mya ngan las 'das pa'i 'og tu yang de'i sku gdung gi mchod rten brtsigs nas smon lam btab pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba dang / sems bskyed pa dang / sbyin par bya ba'i chos yongs su gtong ba 'dis na bdag gis kyang yon tan 'di lta bu dag thob par gyur cig /'di bas kyang ches khyad7du 'phags pa'i ston pa rnams mnyes par byed par gyur cig /mi mnyes par byed par ma gyur cig ces byas so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus na rgyal por gyur pa gang yin pa de ni yul 'khor skyong 'di yin no/ /dge slong dag yul 'khor skyong gis ni las gzhan dag kyang byas shing bsags rin/te/ bskal pa bzang po 'di nyid la skye dgu'i tshe lo nyi khri thub pa'i na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu gdul bya'i ri kha lo sgyur55ba bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi56)ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'od srung zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung ste/ de grong khyer bā rā ṇa sī tsutshon drang srong smra ba ri58)dgas kyi nags na rten cing bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe grong khyer bā rā ṇa sī ༄9)na rgyal po kṛ tī / stargyal po byed de(lha/ de'i ring la 'byor pa dang / rgyas pa dang / bde ba dang /lo legs pa dang / skye bo dang mi mang pos gang ba dang / rtsod pa dang /'thab pa zhi ba dang / 'khrug pa dang / nang 'khrug dang / chom rkun dang /mu ge dang / nad rnams med pa dang / 'bras sā nyugelu dang / bu ram shing dang ske/ ba lang dang / ma he dang ldan par 'dug ste/ chos dang ldan pa chos 75—594

kyi rgyal po chos bzhin du rgyal po byed do/ /de nas de'i bu tha chungs0)drang srong smra bar song ba dang / lades sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sku skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis legs par brgyan pa/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus mdzes par byas pa/ 'od 'dom zhugang gis brgyan pa/ nyi ma stong bas lhag pa'i 'od mnga' ba/ rin po che'i ri bo 'gro ba lta bu kun nas bzang ba mthong nas/ mthong ma thag tu de bcom ldan 'das la sems dga' bar gyurasakyito / /dga' ba skyes nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te chos mnyan pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das 'od srung gis de la chos bstan te/ de dad pa skyes pas bcom ldan 'das 'od srung 'khor dang bcas pa la bsnyen bkur byas te skyabs su 'gro ba dang ske/ bslab pa'i gzhi7rnams blangs so/ /yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'i 'og tu yang mchod rten la gdugs bu chung btags so/ /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus na rgyal po'i bur gyur pa gang yin pa de ni yul 'khor skyong 'di nyid yin no/ /yul 'khor skyong gis ni las gzhan dag kyang byas shing bsags te/ dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na grong khyer bā rā ṇa sī sne)na bram ze las su rtsa ba rko ba zhig gnas pa de/ re zhig la rtsa ba skor song ste nags khrod du 'khor 'khor ba las des der rang sangs rgyas nad pa zhig mthong ngo / /de nas de dad pa skyes te de la bsnyen bkur byas nas gang gi tshe nad sos pa de'i tshe yang bshos gsol te smon lam btab pa/ bdag gis kyang yon tan 'di lta bu dag thob par gyur cig /'di bas kyang ches khyad par du 'phags pa'i ston pa mnyes par byed par gyur cig /mi mnyes〈pepar byed 75—595

par ma gyur cig ces byas so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus na rtsa ba rko ba'i bram zer gyur pa gang yin pa de ni yul 'khor skyong 'di nyid7yin te/ las de'i rnam par smin pas 6)'khor ba na nams kyang (7sdug bsngal myong ba med par (gegyur la da ltar yang rgyal po'i rigs phyug por skyes te/ gzugs bzang zhing blta55)na sdug la4)mdzes par gyur to/ /rgyu de kho nas dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sumatsha3)du byas so/ /dge slong dag de ltar na las gcig tu nges par gnag pa rnams ni rnam par smin pa yang gcig tu nges par gnag par 'gyur ro/ /las gcig tu nges par dkar ba rnams ni rnam par smin pa yang gcig tu nges par dkar bar 'gyur ro//las 'drenas ma rnams ni rnam par smin pa yang 'drenas47)mar 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag de bas nyu )na las gcig tu nges par gnag pa rnams dang las 'dren77ma rnams spangs la/ las gcig tu nges par dkar ba rnams 'ba' zhig la gtad par bya 32ste/ dge slong khyed kyis de ltar bslab par bya'otunye/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ dge slong de dag yi 8rangs te(ge/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do/ / gang po la sogs pa'i 〉rtogs pa brjod pa brgya pa las sdom gyi tshigs su bcad pa dgu pa rdzogs cu'i // //sdom ni/ /rab 'byor dang ni rgan po dang / /lag pa can dang 'de〈nyegus gsos / /'khor ba dang ni sbed pa dang / /mi sdug pa dang gang gā tho)pa/ /sen ringasalo byedang ni yang dag sdug /sde tshan dag tu bstan pa yin/ /rab 'byor 75—596

ces bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po rnams dang / blon po chen po rnams dang / phyug po rnams dang / pho brang 'khor gyi mi rnams dang /tshong dpon rnams dang / ded dpon rnams dang / lha rnams dang / klu rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams dang / lha ma yin rnams dang / nam mkha' lding rnams dang / mi 'am ci rnams dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis bkur ste byas/ bla mar byas/ ri mor byas/ mchod pa byas te/ lha dang / klu dang ske/ gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis mchod cing shes pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bsod nams chen po dang ldan pa/ na bza' dang / zhal zas dang ske/ gzims cha dang / gdan dang / snyun gsos dang / sman zong rnamasashibarnyes pa/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa mnyan du yod pa na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal lakhyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba /rin bzhugs so/ /de nas gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas ljongs so sor gdulasar ba'i skye bo rnams la phan gdags pa'i phyir nyan thos rnams bskos pa de'i tshe/bsam gtan pa gang yin pa de dag ni ri rab kyi bang rim la bsam gtan lhur byed cing 'khod do/ /de nas re zhig na bya'i rgyal po 'dab bzangs kyis55)rgya mtsho chen po'i nang nas klu'i phrumanyagu zhig blangs te⑦/ des de ri rab kyi bang rim gyi steng du phyung nas bza' bar brtsams so/ /de nas klu'i phru'ugu de 'chi ba'i tshe nyan thos chen po rnams la sems dga' bar byas te shi'o/ /de nas de shi nas mnyan du yod par bram ze 'byor pa ⑨zhes bya ba de'i chung ma chen mo'i 3 )75—597

stor zhugs nas/ de zla ba brgyad dam dgu lon pa dang bu byung ste/ khye'u gzugs bzang zhing blta7na sdug la mdzes pa zhig btsaso so/ /de nas desabatsas pa'i btsas ston byas nas khye'u 'di'i ②ming ji skad gdags zhes ming 'dogs par byed de'o)/ nye du rnams na re〈nyekhye'u 'di'i pha 'byor pa yin pas na de'i phyir khye'u 'di'i ming rab 'byor zhes gdags so zhes zer ro/ /de nas khye'u rab 'byor bskyed bsrings te cher skyes nas 3)de sngon gyi rgyu'i stobs dang shugs kyis spro thung ba dang khro ba dang / zhe gnag pa'i shas che bar gyur teni/de nas pha ma gnyis kyis srid srung las phyungs1)ste/ drang srong gi nang du rab tu phyung / )nas de yang de na bsam gtan lhur byed par gyur te nags khrod cig na rten cing 'dug go/ /nags khrod de na lha bden pa mthong ba zhig kyang gnas te/des de la snying rje bskyed nas rigs kyi bu 'di ni khro ba dang zhe gnag pa'i shas che bas khyad par thob par mi 'gyur gyis31ri/ bdag gis 'di bcom ldan 'das la bltar gzhug nyi go snyam mo/ /de nas lha des rab 'byor gyi mdun du sangs rgyas dang —/ chos dang / dge 'dun gyi bsngags pa brjod do/ /de nas rab 'byor bcom ldan 'das nyagebalta ba'i 'dod pa skyes munas lha de'i rdzu 'phrul gyi mthus bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du khrid do/ /de nas des sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sku skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis legs par tunyebargyan pa/dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus mdzes par byas pa/ 'od 'dom tsogang gis brgyan pa/ nyi ma stong bas lhag pa'i 'od mnga' ba/ rin po che'i ri bo 'gro ba lta 1 7bu kun nas bzang ba mthong nas/ mthong ma thag tu de'itsosems can rnams la zhe non pa'i sems gang yin pa de med par gyur to/ /de nas dga' ba 75—598

skyes te bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshalatunas chos mnyan⑧pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i bsam pa dang / bgashel nyalasadang / khams dang / rang bzhin thugs su chud nas 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi rtogs par 'gyur ba de lta bu'i chos bstan te/ de thos nas rigs kyi bu rab 'byor gyis 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo mthon po nyi shu ye shes rdo rjes bcom nas rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas te/ bden pa mthong nas de bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la rab tu byung ste/ des brtson pa dang / bsgrubalgepa dang / 'bad7pas byams pa bsgomashepas sems btul nas phol mig lnga pa'i 'khor ba'i 'khor lo 'di nyid g.yo zhing mi brtan par rig nas 'du byed kyi rnam pa thams cad snyil ⑧ba dang /ltung ba dang / rnam par 'thor ba dang / rnam par 'jig pa'i chos can yin par rtsad chod de/ nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs nas dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas te/ dgra bcom pa khams gsum pa'i 'dod chags dang bral bar gyur nas gser dang bong bar mnyam pa/ nam mkha' dang lag mthilasamedu 'dra ba'i sems dang ldan pa/ tsan dan sbangs pa lta bur bsil bar gyur pa/rig pas sgo nga'i sbubs bcom pa/ rig pa dang / mngon par shes pa dang /so so yang dag par rig pa thob pa/ srid pa'i rnyed pa dang / chags pa dang /bkur sti la mi lta ba/ dbang po dang nye dbang dang bcas pa'i lha rnams kyis mchod cing rjed pa dang gus par smra ba'i gnas su gyur to/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gyis gang nas shi 'phos pa dang / gang du skyes pa dang / las gang gis skyes pa bsams pa dang / des tshe rabs lnga brgya'i bar du klu las shi 75—599

'phos te klu 'ba' zhig tu skyes par mthong ngo / /de nas de'i blo skyes pa/bdag gis 'di ltar zhe snang gi rkyen bsgrubs pa des na bdag tshe rabs lnga brgyar klu 'ba' zhig tu skyes te/ de kho na'i phyir sdug bsngal0)chen po myong bar gyur gyis②/ da50ni cisanas bdag la gzhan dag gi〈nyezhe snang skye bar 'gyur zhing de dang ldan pas lus dang bral ba'i 'og tu ngan song ngan 'gro log par ltung ba ⑥sems can dmyal ba rnams su skye bar 'gyur ba de lta bur mi 'gyur bar bya'o snyam nas de nyon mongs pa med pa la gnasams)pa'i lam yang dag par blangs te gnas sol/ /de gang gi tshe dge 'dun gyi nang ngam/ grong ngam/ yul lam/ ljongs su bsod snyoms kyi phyir gnas par 'dod pa de'i tshe/ thog ma kho nar spyod yul la lta bar byedalo1)de/ bdag mthong na tha na grog spur yan chadam su yang sna 'ga' tunyezhig gi phyir sems sdang bar mi 'gyur grang snyam nas des spyod lam de btang ste〈rtegazhan du bsgyur nas/ des hunyesems can de dag gi sems dga' bar gyuras7te/ de midagra bcom pa/yin du zin kyang de lta bu'i nyam nga ba myong ngo / /de nas tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gyi blo skyes pa/ ma la bdag gis da ni〈 rmeskye bo mang po la phan gdags so snyam mo/ /de nas rdzu 'phrul gyis nam mkha' lding lnga brgya sprul te/ de dag mthong nas klu rnams skrag cing dngangs tsho/nyete mi dga' nas phan tshun du ci bya gtol med par gyur to/ /de nas rab 'byor gyis yang rdzu 'phrul gyi stobs kyis yongs su bskyabs so/ /de nas de dag sems dga' bar gyur nas byams pa'i lung phog go/ /de nas yang klu chen po'i gzugs su sprul nas nam mkha' lding lnga brgya gtses hurtete de dag kyang skrag nas byams pa'i lung phog ste(2 / des de ltar klu dang ni nam mkha' lding gi rigs lnga brgya lnga brgya 75—600

btul to①/ /de nas des ②bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag nga'i nyan thos kyi dge slong nyon mongs pa med par gnas pa rnams kyi mchog ni 'di lta ste/ rigs kyi bu rab 'byor 'di yin no/ /de nas dge slong dag the tsom skyes te/ the com thams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gyis las gang dag bgyis zhon des nyon mongs pa ma mchis par gnas pa'i mchog tu bstan lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag rab 'byor nyid kyis sngon tshe rabs gzhan dag tu tshogs rnyedatswacing rkyen grub pa dang ldan te dba' rgal bzhin du 'byung la/ gdon mi za bar 'ong ba'i las de dag byas shing bsags pasar+sā)na/ rab 'byor nyid kyis las byas shing bsags pa de dag gzhan su zhig gis nyams su myong bar 'gyur te/ dge slong dag las byas shing bsags pa rnams ni phyi rol gyi sa'i khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur/chu'i khams dang / me'i khams dang / rlung gi khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur te/ las dge ba dang mi dge ba byas shing bsags pa rnams ni zin pa'i phung po dang / khams dang / skye mched rnams 'ba' zhig la rnam par smin par 'gyur ro/ /lus can dag gi las rnams ni/ /bskal pa brgyar yang chud mi za/ /tshogs shing dus la bab pa na/ /'bras bu nyid du smin par 'gyur/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na bskal pa bzang po 'di nyid la skye dgu'i tshe lo nyi khri thub pa na/4) de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu gdul bya'i〈7)kha lo sgyur ba bla na 75—601

med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldanatu'adas 'od srung zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung ste/ de grong khyer bā rā ṇa sī na ②drang srong smra ba ri dgas kyi nags na rten cing bzhugs so/ /de nas der 'di rab tu byung ste / 'dis sbyin pa dang rab tudza sbyin pa dag byin nas lo khri'i bar du tshangs par spyod pa'i gnas bsrungs te smon lam btab pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba dang / sems bskyed pa dang / sbyin par bya ba'i chos yongs su gtong ba 'dis na ④bdag ma 'ongs pa'i dus su bcom ldan 'das 'od srung gis bram ze'i khye'u bla ma la/bram ze'i khye'u khyod skye dgu'i tshe lo brgya thub pa na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa zhes bya bar 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan pa gang yin pa de'i bstan pa la bdag rab tu byung nas nyon mongs pa med par gnas pa'i mchog tu gyur cig ces byas so/ /las gang dag gis klurarkuskyes zhe yin/ nyon mongs pa rnams ma spangs pa dang / dbang po rnams 'khrul ba dang / las kyi lam57rnams mthar thug 8)par ma byas pa dang / slob pa dang 3)mi slob pa'i dge slong rnams la snang ba'i sems bskyed nas sbrul gdug pa zhes bya ba'i tshig brjod de des na klur skyes so/ /des sbyin pa dang rab tu sbyin pa dag byin nas tshangs par spyod pa'i gnas bsrungs pa des ni da ltar dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas te/ nyon mongs pa med par gnas pa'i mchog tu bstan to / /dge slong dag de ltar na las gcig tu nges par gnag pa rnams ni rnam par smin pa yang gcig tu nges par gnag par 'gyur ro/ /las gcig tu nges par dkar ba rnams ni rnam par smin pa yang gcig tu nges par dkar bar 'gyur ro/ /las 'dren tshem rnams ni rnam par smin pa yang 'dren nyunyamar 'gyur 75—602

rol/ /①dge slong dag de bas na las gcig tu nges par gnag pa rnams dang las 'drenasam rnams spangs la/ las gcig tu nges par dkar ba rnams 'ba' zhig la gtad par bya ste/ dge slong khyed kyis de ltar bslab par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ dge slong de dag yimatsharangs te/bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// // gang po la sogs pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa brgya pa/④ bam po nyi shur kyigacig pa / rgan po zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po rnams dang ske/ blon po chen po rnams dang / phyug po rnams dang / pho brang 'khor gyi mi rnams dang / tshong dpon rnams dang / ded dpon rnams dang / lha rnams dang / klu rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams dang / lha ma yin rnams dang ske/ nam mkha' lding rnams dang / mi 'am ci rnams dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis bkur ste byas/ bla mar byas/ ri mor byas/ mchod pa byas te/ lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha'56)lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis mchod cing shes pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bsod nams chen po dang ldan pa/ na bza' dang / zhal zas dang / gzims cha dang / gdan dang / snyan gsos dang / smanashezang rnams brnyes pa/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas tes rgyal po'i khab na 'od ma'i tshal bya ka lan da 1)ka gnas pa na rten cing bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe rgyal po'i khab na tshong dpon phyug cing nyu )nor mang la longs spyod che ba/ yongs su 'dzin pa yangs77shing rgya che ba/ rnam thos kyi bu'i nor dang ldan pa/ rnam thos kyi bu'i nor dang 'gran pa zhig gnas pa des 75—603

rigs mnyam pa las chung ma blangs nas/ de de dang lhan cig tu ⑨rtse zhing dga' la dga' mgur spyod do/ /de de dang rtse zhing dga' la ④dga' mgur ⑧spyod pa las chung ma la bu chags nas bu ma byung bar re zhig na yang de nyid dang rtse zhing dga' la dga' mgur57spyod do/ /de rtse zhing dga' la dga' mgur7spyod pa las mngal na bu snga ma de 'dug bzhin du re zhig na ma'i stor de'i7bu snga phyir bcu byung yang bu dang po de ni mngal nyid na 'dug bzhin no/ /de nas re zhig na khyim bdag de'i chung ma des)na bar gyur nas de la rtsa ba dang / sdong bu dang /lo ma dang / me tog dang / 'bras bu'i nisman rnams kyis rim gro byas kyang nad de zhi bar ma gyur nas/ gang gi tshe de shi la thug pa'i nad kyis〈thebs te 'chir nye ba de'i tshe des khyim thab la smras pa/ jo bo mkhyen par mdzod cig /'di'i 1 )nang na bdag gi bu dang po mchis kyis tsho/1nam bdag gum pa na glo g.yas rol mtshon gyis dral te khye'u dang po nas mchis pa de phyungatshwa shig ces de skad smras nas / bsags pa kun ni tha mar zad/ /mthon po rnams ni tha mar nyilonye/ /phrad pa rnams ni tha mar 'bral/ /gson po rnams ni tha mar 'tshil/ /zhes smras te shi'o/ /de nas de shi nas gos sngon po dang / ser po dang / dmaratsopo dang / dkar po dag gis khyogs brgyan te bsil ba'i tshal gyi dur khrod du khyer nas sman pa'i rgyal po 'tsho byed bos so/ /rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer thog thag tu yang 'di ltar bud med che ge mo zhig la lo 'di snyed cig gi bar du bu mngal na 'dug 'dug ste/ de'i bu gzhan bcu byung yang thog ma'i bu mngal na 'dug pa de ma byung nas/ deng sman pa'i rgyal po 'tsho byed kyis shi ba de'i lto mtshon gyis dral te/ dang po'i khye'u mngal du 'dug pa de dbyung bar 'tshal7lo 75—604

zhes de skad du sgra grag go/ /sgra grag nas kyang srog chags 'bum phrag du ma dang shi)rdzogs byed la sogs pa ston pa drug po rnamasaphubasil ba'i tshal gyi50dur khrod du ltad mo la 'dus so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo song la dge slong rnams la 'di skad du bcom ldan 'das dur khrod rgyu zhing gshegs par bzhed kyis khyedasnyilas gang rmad du byung ba lta 'dod pa de dag gshegasasnyishig ces bsgo56)shig /de nas re zhig na bcom ldan 'das tshe dang ldan pa kun shes kauṇ+ḍi rgyaphudang / rlangs pa dang /ming chen dang / ma 'gags pa dang / shā ri'i bu dang / mod gal gyi bu dang /'od srung dang / kun dga' bo dang / nam gru la sogs pa nyan thos chen po rnams kyis zhabs 'bringasnyebyas te bsil ba'i tshal gyi dur khrod du gshegs so/ /skye bo'i tshogs kyis kyang bcom ldan 'das mthong nas go phye'o/ /de nas sman pa 'tsho byed kyis bud med de'i glo g.yas pa dral to0/ /de nas khye'u de rang byung nas spa dkar zhing yan lag gnyer mas gang btunya/ lus kyi phyogs cha rnams rgan shar gyur pa/ dbang po rnyis 3)pa/ rid de ba/ nyam stobs hunyechung bum/ zhig byung ngo / /de nas byung ma thag tu skye bo'i tshogs de dag la bltas nas tshig tu smras pa/ kye bla ma rnams sam/ bla ma lta bu rnams sam/ pha ma'am/mkhan po'am/ slob dpon rnams la tshig rtsub po ma zer cig /ji ltar bdag ma'i stor pho ba dang long ka gnyis kyi bar du lo drug cu 'dug 'dug pa de lta bu'i nyams myong bar7gyur ta re zhes smras nas cang mi zer bar 'dug go/ /der bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag 'di ltar srid pa tha ma pa'i sems can gyis kyang nyams 'di lta bu myong bar 'gyur gyisamatsha75—605

srid par skye ba thams cad kyis chog par gyis shig /srid7)par skye ba'i yo byadas thams cad kyis chog par gyis shig /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis khye'u desnyel bka' stsal pa/ khye'u khyod rgan po yin nam/ bcom ldan 'das bdag ni rgan po lags so/ /khye'u khyod rgan po yin nam/ bde bar gshegs pa bdag ni rgan po lags so/ /de nas gzhi de las de'i ming rgan po zhes btags sos/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis (7gzhi de las de lta bu'i chos bstan pa mdzad de⑥/de thos nas des (7)sems can brgya phrag mang po skyo bar gyur nas khyad par chen po thob bo/ /rgan po de yang lo bcu'i bar du khyim pa'i ༄nyaganas na 'dug 'dug nas lo bdun cu lon te bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la rab tu byung nas/ bya rgod kyi phung po'i 57ri la dge slong nyi shu rtsa lnga dang mthabs cig tu dbyar gnas par dam bcas so/ /de nas der dge 'dun gyi gnas brtan gyis so so skye bor〈spe 'dug bzhin du gang gis kyang skabs dbye bar mi bya'o zhes khrims bcas so/ /de nas re tsho zhig na zla ba gsum lon pa dang dge slong nyi shu rtsa bzhis dgra bcom pa nyid thob na rgan po gcig pu so so skye bo'i 1 so na 'dug go/ /de nas dge 'dun gyi gnas brtan gyis skabs 'byed pa byed pa'i nang du shin tu mang du brgyad bkag 1 nas tshogs kyi nang nas bskrad de btang ngo / /de nas des mtshon cha blangs te khang phugs su zhugs nas ngu zhing rnam pa du mar smre sngags bton te mismras pa/ nags tshal thams cad 'bar gyur nyu5te/ /ri rnams ser por gyur zin na/ /'on kyang da dung sdig pa'i sems/ /rnam par grol bar ma gyur to/ /phu chu dag gi sgra yang zhi/ /'bab chu dag kyang bri bzhin du/ /'on kyang da dung sdig pa'i sems/ /rnam par grol bar ma gyur to/ /sgo nga las〈 tsho75wa 606

skyes bya 'di dag /sgra skad gcamanyeyang chung gyur na/ /'on kyang da dung sdig pa'i sems/ /rnam par grol bar ma gyur to/ /nags tshal 'di dag lo ma ser//shing rnams 'dab ma lhags gyur na/ /'on kyang da dung sdig pa'i sems/ /rnam par grol bar ma gyur to/ /lung 'bogs pa yi miganas brtan rnams/ /phyogs phyogs dag tu dong zin na/ /'on kyang da dung sdig pa'i sems/ /rnam par grol bar ma gyur to/ /so so5)skye bor 'dug bzhin du/ /ston pa'i thad du ji ltar 'gro/ /don med gson pasko4)ci dgos kyis(5)/ /bdag ni mtshon 6)gyis lcebs te btang zhes zer ro/ /de'i skabs su sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis ni mi mkhyen pa'am/ mi gzigs pa'am/ mi rtogs pa'am/thugs su mi chud pa ci yang med la/ sangs rgyas78)bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa/ 'jig rten la phan 'dogs pa la zhugs pa/ srung 597ba gcig pa dang ldan pa/ gcig tu dpa' ba/ zla med pa/ gnyis su mi gsung ba7ske/ zhi gnas dang / lhag mthong la gnas pa/ rig pa gsum snang bar mdzad pa/ bslab pa gsum la legs par bslabs 31pa/ 'dul ba'i gzhi 12gsum la mkhas pa/ chu bo bzhi5snyelas rgal thab/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi'i zhabs kyi mthil shin tu brtan pa/ bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi la yun ring po nas 'dris par byasalgepa/ mi 'jigs pa bzhis mi 'jigs pa/ khyu mchog gi yang dag pa'i seng ge'i sgra chen po sgrogs pa/ yan lag lnga rnam par spangs pa/'gro ba lnga las yang dag par 'das pa/ yan lag drug dang ldan pa/ pha rol tu7phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs pa/ rtag tu gnas par bya ba drug la gnas pa/byang chub kyi yan lag bdun gyi me tog gis phyug pa/ lam yan lag brgyad pa 75—607

ston pa/ mthar gyis gnas pa'i hu)snyoms par 'jug pa dgu la mkhas pa/stobs bcu'i stobs dang ldan pa/ phyogs bcur grags pas kun tu rgyas pa/brgya phrag bcu pa la dbang byed pa bas kyang ches khyad par du 'phags pa rnams ni chos nyid kyis nyin dus gsum sematshan dus gsum du sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis 'jig rten la gzigs te/ su ni rgyad/ su ni dar/ su ni phongs shing 'dug /su ni nyam nga bar gyur/ su ni gnod pa dang ldan/ su ni phongs7pa dang /nyam nga ba dang / gnod pa dngasaldan/ su ni ngan song du gzholas/ su ni ngan song du 'bab/ su ni ngan song du bab/ su ni ngas ngan song nas phyung stekyimatho ris dang / thar pa dang / 'bras bu la gzhagadza par bya/ su ni 'dod pa'i 'dam du bying ba las lag nas drang bar bya/ su ni 'phags pa'i nor bdun med pa las 'phags pa'i nor bdun gyi dbang phyug la dbang nibyed du gzhug par bya/ su ni dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams ma bskyed pa las bskyed par bya/su ni dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams bskyedamanyunyezin pa las yongs sutshwa rusmin par bya/ su ni yongs su smin zin pa las rnam par grol bar bya snyam du ye shes gzigs pa 'jug gol/ /'dir smras pa/ rgya mtsho chu srin rnams kyi gnas/ /dus rlabs57yol bar 'gyur yang srid/ /gdul bar bya ba'i sras rnams la/ /sangs rgyas dus las yol ba med/ /de nas re zhig na sangs rgyas72bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs te rdzu 'phrul gyis kyang de'i thad du gshegs nas de dang 'thunatshwanyepa'i chos bstan te/ de thos nas tshe dang ldan pa rgan pos phol mig lnga pa'i 'khor ba'i 'khor lo 'di nyid g.yo zhing mi brtanasapar rig nas 'du byed kyi rnam pa thams cad snyil 7ba dang / lhung ba dang / rnam par 'thor ba dang / rnam par 75—608

'ejig pa'i chos can yin par rtsad chod de/ nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs nas dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas te/ dgra bcom pa khams gsum pa'i 'dod chags dang bral bar gyur nas gser dang bong bar mnyam pardzi/ nam mkha' dang lag mthil du 'dra ba'i sems dang ldan pa/ tsan dan sbangs pa lta bur bsil bar gyur pa/ rig pas sgo nga'i sbubs bcom pa/ rig pa dang /mngon par shes pa dang / so so yang dag par rig pa thob pa/ srid pa'i rnyed pa dang / chags pa dang / bkur ste la mi lta ba/ dbang po dang nye dbang dang bcas pa'i lha rnams kyis mchod cing rjed pa dang gus par smra ba'i gnas su gyur to/ /de nas rgan pos dgra bcom pa nyid thob nas bdag gis kyang gdul bar bya ba 'ga' lta yod dam snyam du bsamasalgepa dang / des tshong pa lnga brgya tsam rgya mtsho'i nang na srin po nag po'i rlung gis bskor cing 'dug pa mthong nas sdug bsngal dang phrad pa 'di dag bdag gis sdug bsngal de las yongs su bskyab par bya'o/ /'on tang ①de dag rgyabadag gis 'dul bar 'gyur ro snyam mo/ /de nas rgan po rdzu 'phrul gyis song nas 'jigs pa de las yongs su bskyabs7so/ /de nas de dag dad pa skyes te thams cad rab tu byung nas de dag la yid la byed pa'i lung phog gho/ de dag thams cad kyis brtson pa dang / bsgrub pa dang /'bad pas nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs nas dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas so/ /de nas de dag gi yon tan rnams sus kyangasami shes nas drug sde rnams 'phya bar gyur te/ rgan blun du 'dug la mi lnga brgya dang lhan cig 'khod cing drung du bzhag pas 'di dag kyang de dang 'dra bar dul bar mi 'gyur ro zhes 'dzer to/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo tshangs pa 75—609

mtshungs par spyod pa la mnyes gshin pa/ gzhan 1)la phan 'dogs pa la zhugs pas / tshe dang ldan pa gnas brtan gleng bar 'dod nas/ tshe dang ldan pa gnas brtan rgan po ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/ tshe dang ldan pa miganas brtan rgan po dang lhan cig tu mngon sum du ri yang dag par mgu bar 'gyur ba dang ske/ yang dag par dga' bar 'gyur ba'i gtam rnam pa sna tshogs kyis 'dres nas phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu ca'adug nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos gnas brtan rgan po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /gal te dris nas /snidri ba lung bstan pa'i phyir skabs phye na tshe dang ldan pa gnas brtan rgan po la bdag phyogs 'ga' zhig 'dri'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo dris shig dang thos nas 46)khyod la bsnyad par bya'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa gnas brtan rgan po dge slong dgon pa na gnas pa dang / shing drung na gnas pa dang / khang stong na gnas pas chos gang dag rgyun mi 'chad 7par yid la bya/ tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo dge slong dgon pa na gnas pa dang / shing drung na gnas pa dang /khang stong na gnas pas chos gnyis rgyun mi 'chad 8par yid la bya ste/ zhi gnas dang lhag mthong ngo / /gnas brtan zhi gnas kun du bsten cing bsgoms te mang du byas pas don gang dga'9nyams su myong bar 'gyur/ lhag mthong kun du bsten cing bsgoms te mang du byas pas don gang nyams su myong bar 'gyur/tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo zhi gnas kun du bsten cing bsgoms 1 rite mang du byas pas ni lhag mthong la brten te rnam par grol bar 'gyur ro/ /lhag mthong kun du bsten cing bsgoms 1 te mang du byas pas ni zhi gnas la brten te rnam par grol bar 'gyur ro/ / de nas 12tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo lha zhi gnas 75—610

dang lhag mthong yongs su bsgoms pa'i 'phags pa nyan thos thos pa dang ldan pa'i sems ni khams kyi sgo nas rnam par grol bar 'gyur ro/ /gnas brtan khams rnams gang dag yin/ tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo spong ba'i khams gang yin pa dang / 'dod chags dang bral ba'i khams gang yin pa dang / 'gog pa'i khams gang yin pa'o/ /gnas brtan gang spangs pa la spong ba'i (1)khams zhes50bya/ gang las 'dod chags dang bral ba la 'dod chags dang bral ba'i khams zhes bya/ gang 'gags pa la 'gog pa'i khams zhes bya/ tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo 'du byed thams cad spangs pa la spong ba'i khams zhes bya'o/ /'du byed thams cad las 'dod chags dang bral ba la 'dod chags dang bral ba'i khams zhes bya'o/ /'du byed thams cad 'gagasalgepa la 'gog pa'i khams zhes bya'o/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo ④gnas brtan rgan pos bshad pa la semangon par bstod de rjes su yi rangasam(rinas dge slong lnga brgya po ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/ dge slong lnga brgya po rnams la 'di skad ces smras sol/ /tshe dang ldan pa dag dge slong dgon pa na gnas pa dang / shing drung na gnas pa dang / khang stong na gnas pas chos gang dag rgyun mi 'chad ri par yid la bya/ tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo du2)dge slong dgon pa na gnas pa dang /shing drung na gnas pa dang / khang stong na gnas pas chos gnyis rgyun mi 'chad phyipar yid la bya ste zhi gnas dang / lhag mthong ngo / /tshe dang ldan pa dag zhi gnas kun tu bsten cing bsgoms te mang du byas pas midon gang nyams su myong bar 'gyur/ lhag mthong kun tu bsten cing bsgoms te mang du byas pas don gang nyams su myong bar 'gyur/ tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo zhi gnas kun du 75wa 611

bsten cing bsgoms te mang du byas pas ni lhag mthong la brten te ①rnam par grol bar 'gyur ro/ /lhag mthong kun du bsten cing bsgoms teltemang du byas pas ni zhi gnas la brtenasate rnam par grol bar 'gyur ro/ /tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo zhi gnas dang lhag mthong yongs su bsgoms pa'i 'phags pa nyan thos thos pa dang ldan pa'i sems ni khams kyi sgo nas rnam par grol bar 'gyur rol/ /tshe dang ldan pa dag khams rnams gang dag yin/ tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo spong ba'i khams gang yin pa dang / 'dod chags dang bral ba'i khams gang yin pa dang / 'gog pa'i khams gang yin pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa dag gang spangs pa la spong ba'i khams zhes bya/ gang las 'dod chags dang bral ba la 'dod chags dang bral ba'i khams zhes bya/ gang 'gags pa la 'gog pa'i khams zhes byab/ tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo 'du byed thams cad spangs pa la spong ba'i khams zhes bya'o/ /'du byed thams cad las 'dod chags dang bral ba la 'dod chags dang bral ba'i khams zhes bya'o/ /'du byed thams cad 'gags pa la 'gog pa'i khams zhes bya'o/ / de nas zhutshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo dge slong lnga brgya po rnams kyis bshad ⑥pa la mngon par bstod de rjes su yi rangasamacho1)nas bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal bte/ phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa dge slong dgon pa na gnas pa dang /shing drung na gnas pa dang / khang stong na gnas pas chos gang dag rgyun mi 'chad par yid la bgyi/ kun dga' bo dge slong dgon pa na gnas pa dang /75—612

shing drung na gnas pa dang / khang stong na gnas pas chos gnyis rgyun mi 'chad par yid la bya ste/ zhi gnas dang / lhag mthong ngo / /btsun pa zhi gnas kun du bsten0)cing bsgoms te mang du bgyis pas don gang nyams su myong bar 'gyur lags/ lhag mthong kun tu bsten7cing bsgoms te mang du bgyis pas don gang nyams su myong bar 'gyur lags/ kun dga' bo zhi gnas kun tu bstenashecing bsgoms te mang du byas pas ni lhag mthong la brten7te rnam par grol bar 'gyur ro/ /lhag mthong kun du bsten cing bsgoms te mang du byas55)pas ni zhi gnas la brten te rnam par grol bar 'gyur ro/ /kun dga' bo zhi gnas dang lhag mthong yongs su bsgoms pa'i 'phags pa nyan thos thos pa dang ldan pa'i sems ni khams kyi sgo nas rnam par grol bar 'gyur ro/ /btsun pa khams rnams gang dag lags/ kun dga' bo spong ba'i khams gang yin pa dang /'dod chags dang bral ba'i khams gang yin pa dang / 'gog pa'i khams gang yin pa'o/ /btsun pa gang spangs pa la spong ba'i khams zhes bgyi/ gang las 'dod chags dang bral ba la 'dod chags dang bral ba'i khams zhes bgyi/gang 'gags pa la 'gog pa'i khams zhes bgyi/ kun dga' bo 'du byed thams cad spangs pa la spong ba'i khams zhes bya'o/ /'du byed thams cad las 'dod chags dang bral ba la 'dod chags dang bral ba'i khams zhes bya'o/ /'du byed thams cad 'gags pa la 'gog pa'i khams zhes bya'o/ /btsun pa stonasapa dang nyan thos rnams 'di lta ste/ tshig gi mchog gis 3)'di kho na ltar don dang don du 'thun zhing 'dra ba dang / tshig dang tshig tu 'thun zhing 'dra ba dang / yi ge dang yi gerake'athun zhing 'dra ba ni ngo mtshar lags so/ /de 75—613

ci'i slad du0)zhe na/ btsun pa 'dir bdag gnas brtan dge slong rgan posag la ba der mchis nas/ gnas brtan dge slong ri rgan po la don 'di nyid tshig 'di rnams dang / yi ge 'di rnams kyis smras na yang / de ltar bcom ldan 'das kyis ji skad bka' stsal pa kho na bzhin du des bdag la don 'di nyid tshig 'di rnams dang / yi ge 'di rnams kyis smras pa'i lan btab stebya/ bdag gnas brtan dge slong rgan pos bshad pa la mngon par bstod de rjes su yi rangs ⑤nas/ dge slong lnga brgya po rnams ga la ba der mchis te/ dge slong lnga brgya po rnams la don 'di nyid tshig 'di rnams dang / yi ge 'di rnams kyis smras na yang / dam༄6)ltar bcom ldan 'das kyis ji skad bka' stsal pa kho na bzhin du de dag gis kyang bdag la don 'di nyid tshig 'di rnams dang / yi ge 'di rnams kyis smras pa'i lan me btab ste/ btsun pa ston pa dang nyan thos rnams 'di lta ste/ tshig gi mchog gis 'di kho na ltar don dang don du 'thun zhing 'dra ba dang 8ci/ tshig dang 9)tshig tu 'thun zhing 'dra ba dang / yi ge dang yi ger 'thun zhing 'dra ba de ni ngo mtshar lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo khyod kyis dge slong 3 cirgan po su yin shes sam / gsol pa btsun pa dge slong rgan po ni dgra bcom pa/ zag pa zad pa/bya ba byas pa/ byed pa byas pa/ khur bor ba/ rang gi don rjes su thob pa/srid par kun du sbyor ba yongs su zad pa/ yang dag pa'i shes pas sems shin tu rnam par grol ba lags so/ /dge slong lnga brgya po de dag thams cad kyang dgra bcom pa/ zag pa zad pa/ bya ba byas pa/ byed pa byas pa/ khur bor ba/rang gi don rjes su thob pa/ srid par kun du sbyor ba yongs su zad pa/ yang 75—614

dag pa'i7shes pas sems shin tu rnam par grol ba sha stag lags so/ /gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das dang / tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos dge slong rgan po dang ske/ dge slong lnga brgya po de dag glengs shing bsgrags pa de'i tshe dge slong dag the tsom skyes te/ the tsom thams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa rgan pos las gang dag bgyis na des lo drug cu'i bar du ma'i lto na mchis par gyur lags/ btsun pa las gang dag bgyis na des yid rtul bar gyur la rab tu byung nas dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sumasadu bgyis lags / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag57rgan po nyid kyis bsngon tshe rabs gzhan dag tu tshogs rnyed cing rkyen grub pa dang ldan te dba' rgal bzhin du 'byung la/ gdon mi za bar 'ong ba'i las de dag byas shing bsags pas na/ rgan po nyid kyis5nyalas byas shing bsags pa de dag gzhan su zhig gis nyams su myong bar 'gyur te/ dge slong dag las byas shing bsags pa rnams ni phyi rol gyi sa'i khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur/chu'i khams dang / me'i khams dang / rlung gi khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur te/ las dge ba dang mi dge ba byas shing bsags pa rnamasamardzo)ni zin pa'i phung po dang / khams dang / skye mched rnams 'ba' zhig la rnam par smin par 'gyur ro/ /lus can dag gi las rnams ni/ bskal pa brgyar yang chud mi za/ /tshogs shing dus la bab pa na/ /'bras bu nyid du smin par 'gyur / /dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na bskal pa bzang po 'di nyid la skye dgu'i tshe lo nyi khri thub pa na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar 75—615

gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu gdul bya'i0)kha lo sgyur ba bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'od srungasazhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung ste/ deshegrong khyer bā rā ṇa sriphun drang srong smra bkyiri dgas kyi nags na rten cing bzhugs so/ /de na tshong dpon gyi bu zhig gnas brtan zhig las rab tu byung ngo / /gnas brtan de ni dgra bcom pa 'dod chags spangs pa zhig go/ /de nas re zhig na yul der dus ston zhig byung nas dge slong gzhon nu des gnas brtan de bslang ste6)/ bzhengs la spyod yul gyi grong du bzhud do zhes byas so/ /gnas brtan gyis smras pa/ bu da dung sngas kyis〈pere zhig song la dge ba'i phyogs gyis shig /lan gnyis lan gsum gyi bar du dge slong gzhon nu'agyedes gnas brtan de bslang ste/ bzhengs la spyod yul gyi grong du bzhud ces byas na yang lan gnyis lan gsum gyi bar du gnas brtan gyis bu da dung sngas kyis57song la dge ba'i phyogs gyis shig ces byas so/ /de nas〈 sdudage slong gzhon nu lto 'dun nyu17can des ngag gi las rtsub po smras te/ khyod〈gelo drug cu'i bar du yang khyim nas ma byung shig /nga ni song zin no zhes byas sol/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis5nyebaka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/de'i tshe de'i dus na dge slong gzhon nur gyur pa gang yin pa de ni dge slong rgan tshipo 'di yin te/ des dgra bcom pa la sems snang bar byas nas ngag gi las rtsub po smras pa'icalas de'i rnam par smin pas ni lo drug cu'i bar du ma'i lto na 'dug 'dugatsogo/ /gzhan yang sngon hu rmechos la ser sna byas pa des ni shes rab 'chal par gyur to/snye/ /dbang po rnams tshegs 37chen pos yongs su smin par gyur to/ /des der bslabasas )pa dang / kha ton pa gebyas pa dang / phung po la 75wa 616

mkhas pa dang / khams la mkhas pa dang / skye mched la mkhas pa dang /①rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba la mkhas pa dang / gnas dang gnas ma yin pa la mkhas par byas pa des ni da ltar nga'i bstan pa la rab tu byung ste/ nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs nas dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum dusabyas so/ /dge slong dag de bas na ngag gi nyes pa spang ba'irnyuphyir 'bad par bya ste/ ci nas rgan po de so so'i skye bor gyur pa'i tshe'i〈nyes pa de lta bu dag mi 'byung bar bya'o / /de nyid kyis dgra bcom pa nyid thob pa'i yon tan gyi tshogs de lta bu ni (ltethob par bya stedu/ dge slong khyed kyis de ltar bslab par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ dge slong de dag yi stirangs te/bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// //lag pa can zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po rnams dang ske/ blon po chen po rnams dang / phyug po rnams dang / pho brang 'khor gyi mi rnams dang / tshong dpon rnams dang / ded dpon rnams dang / lha rnams dang / klu rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams dang / lha ma yin rnams dang ske/ nam mkha' lding rnams dang / mi 'am ci rnams dang / lto 'phye57chen po rnams kyis bkur sti byas/ bla mar byas/ ri mor byas/ mchod pa byas te/ lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang mi 'am ci dngashe/ lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis mchod cing shes pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bsod nams chen po dang ldan pa/ na bza' dang ske/ zhal zas dang / gzims cha dang / gdan dang / snyan gsos dang /sman zong rnams brnyes pa nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa mnyan du yod 75—617

pa na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe mnyan du yod pa na tshong dpon phyug cing nor mang la longs spyod che ba/ yongs su 'dzin pa yangs shing rgya che ba rnam thos kyi bu'i nor dang ldan pa/ rnam thos kyi bu'i nor dang 'gran pa zhig gnas7pa des rigs mnyam pa las chung ma blangs nas/ de de dang lhan cig tu rtse zhing dga' la dga' mgur 2spyod do/ /de rtse zhing dga' la dga' mgur7spyod pa las chung ma la bu chags nas/ debasazla ba brgyad dam dgu lon pa dang bu byung ste/ khye'u gzugs bzang zhing bltadzaban sdug la mdzes pa/ mdog bzang ba/ gser gyi kha dog can/ yan lag dang nying lag thams cad dang ldan pa/ rang bzhin gyis tshe rabs dran pa zhig btsas so/ /de nas des rang gi lag pa bzung ste/'o byed cing mthang (6)la 'jor bar byed la 'khyud tsho/par byed de tshig tu smras pa/kye ma bdag gi lag gu gnyis shin tu yun ring mo zhig nas gdod rnyedashedo/ /kye ma bdag gi lag gu gnyis shin tu yun ring mo zhig nas gdod rnyed do zhes zer rol/ /de nas de btsas pa'i btsas ston byas nas khye'u 'di'i ming ji skad gdags gte zhes ming 'dogs par byed de/ de'i mnye du rnams na re 'di btsas ma thag tu lag pa bzung ste 'o byed cing mthang 31la 'jor la 'khyud5)par byed pas na de'i phyir khye'u 'di'i ming lag pa can zhes gdags so zhes zer ro /de nas khye'u lag pa can pang na 'tsho ba'i ma ma gnyis dang / nu ma snun pa'i ma ma gnyis dang / dri ma 'khru ba'i ma ma gnyis dang / rtse ba'i ma ma gnyis te/ma ma brgyad la gtad 1snyenas/ de ma ma brgyad kyis 'o ma dang / zho dang /mar dang / zhun mar dang / mar gyi nying chukhu dang / gzhan yang yo byad kyi 75—618

khyad par bzang ngo cog gis bskyed bsrings te mtsho'i nang gi pad ma bzhin du skye drag par gyur to/ /de nas gang gi tshe yul der 'jigs pa zhig byung ba de'i tshe skye bo'i tshogs 'jigs par gyur te hu)phan tshun du ci bya gtol ②med nas rdzas rnams sbed par byed do/ /khye'u lag pa can ni lag pa gnyis sbed par byed de/skye bo'i tshogs la yang 'di skad du/ kye yon gnas rnams la sems sdang bar ma byed cig /tshig rtsub po ma zer cig /kye'ubadag gi lagadzageg gnyis shin tu yun5nyering mo zhig nas gdod rnyed do zhes zer ro/ /de nas phyi zhig na khye'u lag pa can rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal du song ba dang / des sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sku skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis legs par brgyan pa/dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus mdzes par byas pa/ 'od 'dom 6)gang gis brgyan pa/ nyi ma stong bas lhag pa'i 'od mnga' ba/ rin po che'i ri bo 'gro ba lta bu kun nas bzang ba mthong nas/ mthong ma thag tu des bcom ldan 'das la sems dga' bar byas te/ dga' ba skyes nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal te chos mnyan pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis mede'i bsam52)pa dang / bag la nyal dang /khams dang / rang bzhin thugs su chud nas/ 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi rtogs par 'gyur ba de lta bu'i chos bstan te/ de thos nas lag pa can gyis 6'jig tshogs la lta03 ba'i ri'i rtse mo mthon77po nyi shu ye shes rdo rjes bcom 12nas rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas te/ des bden pa mthong nas pha ma la gsol te bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la rab tu byung nas32/ des brtson pa dang / bsgrub r+sāpa dang / 'bad pas phol mig lnga pa'i 'khor ba'i be75—619

'khor lo 'di nyid g.yo zhing mi brtan par rig nas 'du byed kyi rnam pa thams cad snyilatub dang / ltung ba dang / rnam par 'thoraskrub dang / rnam par 'jig pa'i chos can yin par rtsad chod de/ nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs nas dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas te/ dgra bcom pa khams gsum pa'i 'dod chags dang bral bar gyur nas gser dang bong bar mnyam pa/ nam mkha' dang lag mthilashedu 'dra ba'i sems dang ldan pa/ tsan dan sbangs pa lta bur bsilasnyibar gyur pa/ rig pas sgo nga'i sbubs bcom pa/ rig pa dang /mngon par shes pa dang / so so yang dag par rig pa thob pa/ srid pa'i rnyed pa dang / chags pa dang / bkur sti la mi lta ba/ dbang po dang nye dbang dang bcas pa'i lha rnams kyis mchod cing rjed pa dang gus par smra ba'i gnas su gyur to/ /de dgra bcom pa nyid thob par gyur kyang de bzhin du dge slong rnams la chos ston te/ kye yon gnas rnams la sems snang bar ma byed cig6) /tshig rtsub po ma zer cig /kye ma bdag gi lag gu gnyis shin tu yun ring mo zhig nas gdodar rnyed do zhes zer ro/ /de nas dge slong dag the tsom skyes te/the tsom thams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa lag pa can gyis las gang dag bgyis shing bsags na des dgra bcom pa nyid thob lags na yang de bzhin du kye ma bdag gi lag gu gnyis shin tu yun ring mo zhig nas gdod rnyed do zhes mchisnyelags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis7bka' stsal pal/ dge slong dag gang dgacha'adi ni las kyi tsho/nya'abras bu mngon sum du mthong ba yin no/ /des ci las bsams te de skad zer ba khyed nyan par 'dod dam/btsun pa mnyan tu)par 'tshal lags so/ /dge slong dag lag pa can nyid kyis 75—620

sngon tshe rabs gzhan dag tu tshogs rnyed cing rkyen grub pa dang ldan te dba' rgal bzhin du 'byung la/ gdon mi za bar 'ong ba'i las de dag byas shing bsags0)pas na/ lag pa can nyid kyisakhulas byas shing bsags pa de dag5gugazhan su zhig gis nyams su myong bar 'gyur te/ dge slong dag las byas shing bsags pa rnams ni phyi rol gyi sa'i khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur/ chu'i khams dang ske/ me'i khams dang / rlung gi khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur te/las dge ba dang mi dge ba byas shing bsags pa rnams ni zin pa'i phung po dang /khams dang / skye mched rnams 'ba' zhig la rnam par smin par 'gyur ro/ /lus can dag gi las rnams ni/ /bskal pa brgyarasayang chud mi za/ /tshogs shing dus la bab pa na/ /'bras bu nyid du smin par 'gyur/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na/ bskal pa bzang po 'di nyid la skye dgu'i tshe lo nyi khri thub pa na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu gdul bya'i stikha lo sgyur ⑦ba bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'od srung zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung gho/ de grong khyer bā rā ṇa srilo)na drang srong smra ba tsori dgas kyi nags na rten cing bzhugs so/ /re zhig na de na dge slong gnyis77shig mdza' zhing 'dug ste/ de'i nang na gcig ni dgra bcom pa yang yin la mang du thos pa yang yin no/ /cig shos ni so so'i skye bo yang yin la thos pa yang nyung ngo / /de la dgra bcom pa mang du thos pa de ni kun gyis〈nyeshes pa/ bsod nams chen po dang ldan pa/ gos dang / zas dang / mal cha dang / stan dang /1snye nad 75—621

gsos dang / sman zong rnams brnyes 3)pa/ g.yar 'dren pa mang du rnyed pa zhig ste/ gang du g.yar drangs pa der des bludage slong mdza' bo de phyi bzhin 'brang ba'i dge sbyong du khrid dori / /re zhig na nyi ma gcig cigashedagra bcom pa de yanga'i g.yar drangs te 'gro bar chad pa las phyi bzhin 'brang ba'i dge sbyong de btsal na ma rnyed do/ /de nas de mi snang nas des (6)dge slong gzhan zhig khrid pa dang / re zhig na der 58)dge slong gzhon nu sems rgod 6)pa dag gis 'di skad ces smras te/ bye/ btsun pa dag gzigs dang / des phyi bzhin 'brang ba'i dge sbyong 31'di yang deng ma khrid de gzhan khrid do zhes byas so/ / de nas hurtede khros te dgra bcom pa la sems sdang bar byas nas ngag gi las rtsub hunyepo smras te/bdag gis phyin cad thude'i lhung bzed bkrus su zin na bdag gi lag pa 'di gnyis med par gyur cig7ces byas so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus na dge slong mdza' bor gyur pa gang yin pa de ni lag pa can 'di skoyin te/ des dgra bcom pa la sems sdang bar byas te ngag gi las rtsub po 1 smras pa des na nyu2tshe rabs lnga brgyar lag pa med par gyur to/ /phyis snying nas 'gyod pa skyes te nyes pa la nyes so zhes 'thol thegezhing bshags shu )te rnam par phye zhing bsal 41bar byas pa des ni lag pa thob par gyur to/ /des der bslabs pa dang / kha ton da du byas pa dang / phung po la mkhas pa dang / khams la mkhas pa dang / skye mched la mkhas pa dang /rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba la mkhas pa dang / gnas dang gnas ma yin pa la mkhas par byas pa des ni da ltar dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum cadu byas so/ /dge slong dag de ltar na las gcig tu nges par gnag pa rnams ni rnam par smin 75—622

pa yang gcig tu nges par gnag par 'gyur rotu/ /las gcigasho tu nges par dkar ba rnams ni rnam par smin pa yang gcig tu nges par dkar bar 'gyur ro//las 'drenasnyem rnams ni rnam par smin pa yang 'drenasemar 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag de bas na las gcig tu nges par gnag pa rnams dang las 'dren ri5)ma rnams spangs la/ las gcig tu nges par dkar ba rnams 'ba' zhig la gtad par bya ste/ dge slong khyed kyis de ltar bslab par bya'o/ /bcom ldan5nya'adas kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ dge slong de dag yi〈perangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// //'de gus gsosasnyizhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po rnams dang / blon po chen po rnams dang / phyug po rnams dang / pho brangasashetsho'akhor gyi mi rnams dang / tshong dpon rnams dang / ded dpon rnams dang /lha rnams dang / klumo7rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams dang / lha ma yin rnams dang / nam mkha' lding rnams dang / mi 'am ci rnams dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis bkur ste byas/ bla (nyamar byas/ ri mor byas/ mchod pa byas te/ lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'bye chen po rnams kyis mchod cing shes pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bsod nams chen po dang ldan pa/ na bza' dang / zhal zas dang / gzims cha dang / gdan dang / snyun gsos dang hunye/ sman zong rnams brnyes pa/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa mnyan du yod pa na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe mnyan du yod pa na bram ze 75—623

phyug cing nor mang la longs spyod che ba/ yongs su 'dzin pa yangs shing rgya che ba/rnamanyethos kyi bu'i nor dang ldan pa/ rnam thos kyi bu'i nor dang 'gran⑧pa zhig gnas pa des rigs mnyam pa las chung ma blangs nas/ de de dang lhan cig tu rtse zhing dga' la dga' mgurakhuspyod do/ /de rtse zhing dga' la dga' mgur spyod pa las chung ma la bu chags nas/ de zla ba brgyad dam dgu lon pa dang bu byung ste/ khye'u mdog ngan pa/ blta55)na mi sdug pa/ byad ngan pa7zhig btsas te/ de btsas ma thag tu de'i ma'i nu ma gnyis la 'o ma med par gyur to/ /re zhig na bram ze des de'i ma ma gzhan zhig bkug na de'i 'o ma yang khye'u de'i las kyi rnam par smin pas med par gyur to/ /de nas gang gi tshe de'i phyir 'o ma 'byung ba'i thabs sbyar ba thams cad las kyang 'o ma mi 'byung bar gyur pa de'i tshe de 'de gus gsos nas de'i ming 'de gus gsos 'de gus gsos zhes bya bar btags so/ /de bsod nams/chung bar grags shing bsod nams chung ba zhig ste gang gi tshe de cher skyes pa de'i tshe lto gang yang mi rnyed do/ /de nas des dge slong sham thabs legs par gyon pa/ gos ④legs par bgos pa dag lhung bzed bung ba'i mdog ltar ④gnag pa thogs nas mnyan du yod par bsod snyoms la 'gro la/ de dag kyang lag pa yang bkang / lhung bzed kyang bkang ste phyir byung7ba mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang de bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la rab tu 'byung bar 'dod par gyur nas des 37pha ma la gsol te bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la rab tu byung ngo / /de rab tu byung yang lto gang yang mi rnyed nas de skyo bar gyur pa de nyid kyis brtson pa dang / bsgrubalgepa dang / 'bad pas phol mig lnga pa'i 'khor ba'i 'khor lo 'di nyid g.yo zhing mi brtan par rig 75—624

nas 'du byed kyi rnam pa thams cad snyilatub dang / ltung ba dang / rnam par 'thor ba dang / rnam par 'jig pa'i chos can yin par rtsad chod de/ nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs nas dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas ②te/dgra bcom pa khams gsum pa'i 'dod chags dang bral bar gyur nas gser dang bong bar mnyam pa/ nam mkha' dang lag mthilakhudu 'dra ba'i sems dang ldan pa/ tsan dan sbangs pa lta bur bsil bar gyur pa/ rig pas sgo nga'i sbubs bcom pa/ rig pa dang / mngon par shes pa dang / so so yang dag par rig pa thob pa/ srid pa'i rnyed pa dang / chags pa dang / bkur ste la mi lta ba/ dbang po dang nye dbang dang bcas pa'i lha rnams kyis mchod cing rjed pa dang gus par smra ba'i gnas su gyur to④/ /de nas phyis re zhig na bcom ldan 'das kyi dri gtsang khang 'phyagasapa la zhugs te/ des de phyags nas sham thabs dang chos gos bgos te lhung bzed thogs nas mnyan du yod par bsod snyoms la song ngo / /de nas des bsod snyoms bzang po mang7po dag rnyed de/des de'i dbang po rnams dang 'byung ba chen po rnams tshim par gyur to/ /de nas de dbang po tshim par gyur nas bsam ⑦gtan dang / rnam par thar pa dang ske/ snyoms par zhugasalgepa rnams kyis mtshan7rangs par 'das par byas sol/ /de nas de'i blo skyes pa(nya/ ma la thabs 'di ni bzang po zhig gis5)bdag gis dge slong gi dge 'dun la gsol ba gdabatshwanyebo snyam mo/ /de nas des78dge slong gi dge 'dun thams cad la gsol ba btab pa8/ btsun pa dag78bdag ni bsod nams chung ste/ gang gi tshe dri gtsang khang du phyag dar bgyis nas bsod snyoms la mchis pa de'i tshe gdod 'drangs par gyur 7te/ de bas na 75—625

bdag la dge 'dun gyis yo)thugs brtse〈mibar mdzod la gzhan sus kyang dri gtsang khang du phyag dar mi mdzad par gsol zhes byas so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi dri gtsang khang du sus kyang phyag dar mi bya'o zhes dge 'dun gyis 0khrims bcas nas des bag yangs ④su dri gtsang khang phyags pa'i 'og tu mnyan du yod par bsod snyoms la 'gro bar byed do/ /de'i tshe na tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu yang 'khor lnga brgya dang rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal du dbyar gnas par dam bcas nas mnyan du yod par lhags te ston pa la gus pa bskyed dunas dri gtsang khang du phyag dar byas so/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa 'de gus gsos kyis tshor nas des smras pa/ gnas brtan khyod kyis dri gtsang khang du phyag dar byas pa ni bdag gi ltor bsnun par bsasrogaso/ /gnas brtan gyis smras pa ci nyes/ 'de gus gsos kyis57)smras pa/ gnas brtan gang gi tshe bdag gisasngo dri gtsang khang du phyag dar ma byas pa de'i tshe bdag gis bsod snyoms mi rnyed do/ /de nas gnas brtan shā0)ri'i bus smras pa/ gal te de lta bon bdag ga zhig tu g.yar drangs kyis 11 khyod snying ma chung shig dang / bdag gis der khyod la kha zas sbyin par bya'o / /de nas gnas brtan shā ri'i bu 'khor lnga brgya dang bcas pa'i spyan 'dren 'ongs nas 'de gus gsos kyang de dag nyusnyedang lhan cig tu chas so/ /de nas gang gi tshe khyim bdag de'i sgo dang nye ba zhig tu phyin pa de'i tshe 'de gus gsos kyi las kyi rnam par smin pas khyim der thab tsho mo chen po byung ngo / /de nas tshe dang ldan pa 'de gus gsos 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag bsod nams chung ba'i phyir thab thumo byung ngo snyam mo/ /de nas phyir log stesnyigatsug lag khang du song nas smyung 7bar 'dug go/ /de nas phyi de nyin par tshe dang ldan pa shā 75—626

ri'i bus smras pa/ khyod ci'i phyir ma 'ongs/ des smras pa/ bdag bsod nams chung ba'i phyir der thab ①mo ji ltar byung ba gnas brtan gyis mi mkhyen tam / de nas gnas brtan shā ri'i bus de'i nyin par mdun du bcug ste/khyim de'i nang du song nas dge 'dun gyi khrod du 'dug na kha yang / g.yas g.yos su hu )ni kha zas brims la de la ni 'drim (ri)pa'i mis kyang brjed nas sbyor de dge 'dun gyi khrod de kho nar lan gnyis su smyung bar gyur to/ /de nas re zhig na gtam de gnas brtan kun dga' bos thos soX/ /thos nas kyang 'de gus gsos la smras pa/ 'o na khyod rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal 'di nyid du 'dug shig dang bdag gis khyod kyi zas khyer te 'ong ngo zhes byas so/ /gnas brtan kun dga' bo ni bcom ldan 'das las chos kyi phung po brgyad khri lobs pa dang dge slong gzhan dag las nyi khri lobs pa de lta bu'i dran pa dang ldan pa yin na48)/'de gus gsos kyi las kyi sgribalo)pas gnas brtan kun dga' bos kyang brjid par gyur te 0der yang de nyu1lan gsum smyung bar gyur to/ /de nas zhag bzhi lon pa'i tshe gnas brtan kun dga' bos bsgrims te bsod snyoms byin na/ de yang phyir 'gro ba'i tshe khyirwahernams kyis phrogs 12te der yang de lan bzhi smyung 7bar gyur to/ /de nas zhag lnga lon pa'i tshe gnas brtan mod gal gyi bu chen pos thos nas〈ge'ade gus gsos kyi phyir bsod snyoms blangs nas rdzu 'phrul gyis chas pa dang / 'de gus gsos kyi las kyi rnam par smin pas bya'i rgyal po nam mkha' lding gi 'dab lcagapha gis bsnun nas rgya mtsho'i nang du bor te der yang de 1 tsholan lnga smyung bar (2gyur to/ /de nas zhag drug lon pa'i tshe gnas brtan shā ri'i bus thos nas de 'di snyam du77sems te/ ma la bdag kho nas 'de gus gsos 75—627

kyi bsod snyoms blang0)gor ma chag snyam mo/ /de nas gnas brtan shā ri'i7bus de'i bsod snyoms blangs nas khyim de nyid du mi snang bar byas te 'de gus ⑧gsos kyi gnas khang gi sgor 'ongs so/ /de nas57'de gus gsos kyi las kyi rnam par smin pas sgo de yang brag gis 'khor bar gyur to/ /de nas gnas brtan shā ri'i bus rdzu 'phrul gyis chasgo dbye'o snyam nas lhung bzed ⑥de sa la bzhag pa dang / de yang 'de gus gsos kyi las kyi rnam par smin pas thurashedu dpag tshad brgyad khri'i 'og na gser gyi sa gzhi (kyeyod pa'i steng du song nas/de las kyang gnas brtan shā ri'i bus rdzu 'phrul gyis phyung nas zas de khar gzhug go snyam steshezas de khar bcug na de'i las kyi rnam par smin pas kha de med par phyi la bor bar ⑩gyur to/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bumanya'ade gus gsos la skal brwartemed par shes nas skyo bar gyur te/ /der yang btsun pa de lan drug smyung bar gyur to/ /de nas zhag bdun lon pa'i nyinatshwanyepar tshe dang ldan pa 'de gus gsos kyis sems can rnams skyo ba bskyed pa dang / las rnams chud mi za bar bstan pa dang / las kyi stobs gleng ba'i phyir lhung bzed thal bas bkang ste / sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi spyan sngar 'dug nas chu dang bskyos〈hete 'thungs nas phung〈gepo'i lhag ma med pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su yongs su mya ngan las 'das so/ /de nas dge slong rnams kyis de mthong nas skyo bar gyur te de'i sku gdung lam 7sku gdung gi mchod pa byas so/ /de nas dge slong dag the com skyes te/ the tsom thams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun5nyepa 'de gus gsos kyis las gang dag bgyis na des〈pedagra bcom pa nyid thob par gyur kyang zhagasu )drug sgyung bar gyur te75—628

nas zhag bdun pa'i gdugs la phung po'i lhag ma med pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i7dbyings su yongs su mya ngan las 'das lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis55)bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag 'de gus gsos nyid kyis7sngon tshe rabs gzhan dag tu tshogs rnyed ①cing rkyen grub pa dang ldan te dba' rgal bzhin du 'byung la/gdon mi za bar 'ong ba'i las de dag byas shing bsags pas〈nyen/ 'de gus gsos nyid kyis las byas shing bsags pa de dag gzhan su zhig gis nyams su myong bar 'gyur te/ dge slong dag las byas shing bsags pa rnams ni phyi rol gyi sa'i khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur/ chu'i khams dang / me'i khams dang ske/ rlung gi khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur te/ las dge ba dang mi dge ba byas shing bsags pa rnams ni zin pa'i phung po dang / khams dang /skye mched rnams 'ba' zhig la rnam par smin par7'gyur ro/ /lus can dag gi las rnams ni/ /bskal pa brgyar yang chud mi za/ /tshogs shing dus la bab pa na/ /'bras bu nyid du smin par 'gyur/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na grong khyer bā rā ṇa sgyusnyen khyim bdag cig gi chung ma dad pa dang ldan la dge zhing bsam pa bzang ba zhig 'dug pa de rgyun mi 'chad par dge sbyong 17dang ske/ bram ste ze dang / bkren pa dang / sdug cing phongs71pa dang / slong ba rnams la sbyin pa dag5)byed do/ /phyis de'i khyim thab shi nas re zhig na de'i bu bdag gi khyim gyi bdag por gyur to/ /de yang ser sna can/ 'jungs pa/yo byad la kun tu 'dzin pa/ khā la yang gtor ma mi ster ba zhig ste/ de dge sbyong〈nyedang / bram ze dang / bkren pa dang / sdug cing phongs pa dang /slong ba rnams mthong narnyusems sdang bar byed do/ /de'i ma ni sngon gyi lugs 75—629

bzhin du dge sbyong sna)dang / bram ze dang / bkren pa dang / sdug cing phongs pa dang / slong ba rnams la sbyin pa dang rab tu sbyin pa dag sbyin par byed do②/ /de nas de'i bu ser snas non pa des smras pa/ yum bdag ma dad kyis7sbyin pa ma sbyinam nicig /des smras pa/ bu gcig khyim 'di namar khyim gyi lugs kyis delayin no/ /de nas des 7)logs shig tu zan na phog ste bzhag na 'on kyang de zan gyi phyed ni sbyin par byed do/ /phyed ni bdag nyid za'o/ /de nas ser snas non cing khro bas bsgribs pa'i blo can des 9)yang dang yang du bkag ste/ thabs ji lta bus bkag kyang de dgag 1 rim nus nas ma la smras pa/ yum bgyi ba zhig mchis kyis 11khyim gyi phug tu bzhud cig /de 12nas rang bzhin gyis drang ba de khyim gyi phug tu song ngo / /de nas des sgo bcad de 12nyi ma gcig zan bcad 8nas des smras pa/ bu bdag bkres geso/ /de nas des 7tshig rtsub po smras te thal ba 'gom cig ces byas 1 so/ /de nas re zhig na nyam nga zhing mi bde la gnod pa dang phrad pa 1 des snying rje rje skad du khus btab kyang zhag drug gi bar hu/smyung du bcug ste ma btang nas shi'o/ /'on kyang ser snas bsgribs da nopa de ma dang bral ba la 'gyod pa med do/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis 37bka' stsal pa/dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus na khyim bdag gi bur gyur pa gang yin pa de ni 'de gus gsos de'adi yin te ci/ des ma la gnod pa byas pa'i las de'i rnam par smin pas bskal pa gcig gi bar du sems can dmyal ba chen po mnar med par skyes so/ /rgyu de kho nas da 2 ltar dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas kyang 5smyung bar gyur te ni thal ba zos nas yongs su mya ngan las 'das so/ /dge slong dag 'de gus gsos kyis ni 2 las gzhan dag kyang 75—630

byas shing bsags te/ dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na ①gong khyer bā rā ṇa sī ②na bram ze lha la rten pa bā rā ṇa sī dun gnas pa'i bram ze dang /khyim bdag dang / skye bo thams cad kyisarnyukun du bkur ste bya ba dang / bla mar bya ba dang / ri mo bya ba dang / mchod cing bkur ba zhig yod rga/ /chos nyid kyis na sangs rgyas rnams 'jig rten du mi 'byung ba'i tshe rang sangs rgyas sdug cing phongasalgepa rnams la snying brtse'ub dang〈nye / bas mtha'i gnas mal gyis 'tsho ba/ 'jig rten gyi yon gnas gcig pu rnams 'jig rten du 'byung ste/ re (7zhig na rang sangs rgyas gcig cig bā rā ṇa sī na (gebasod snyoms la song ba dang / de der lag pa yang bkang / lhung bzed kyang bkang ste phyir byung ba bram ze des mthong nas/ de ser sna skyes te lhung bzed bltas〈rtetshur khyer shog ces byas so/ /nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams ni ma bsams 8par shes pa mi 'jug ste btsun pa des bstan to/ /de nas des sa la pho nas rkang pas bsnun to8/ /de nas rang sangs rgyas de sgyung bar 'dug kyang bram ze de 'gyod pa ma skyes so/ /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus na bram zer gyur pa gang yin pa de ni 'de gus gsos 'di yin no/ /gzhan yang bcom ldan 'das 'od srung gi ring la rab tu byung ste/ des der tshangs par spyod pa'i gnas bsrungs pa des na da ltar dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas so/ /dge slong dag de ltar na las gcig tu nges par gnag pa rnams ni rnam par smin pa yang gcig tu nges par gnag par 'gyur ro/ /las gcig tu nges par dkar ba rnams ni rnam par smin pa yang gcig tu nges par dkar bar 'gyur ro/ /las 'dren ma rnams ni rnam par smin pa yang 'dren5)75—631

mar 'gyur ro①/ /dge slong dag de bas na las gcig tu nges par gnag pa rnams dang las 'dren⑧ma rnams spangs la/ las gcig tu nges par dkar ba rnams 'ba' zhig la gtad par bya ste/ dge slong khyed kyis de ltar bslab par bya'o / /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ dge slong de dag yi charangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// //'khor ba zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po rnams dang ske/ blon po chen po rnams dang / phyug po rnams dang / pho brang 'khor gyi mi rnams dang / tshong dpon rnams dang / ded dpon rnams dang / lha rnams dang / klu rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams dang / lha ma yin rnams dang ske/ nam mkha' lding rnams dang / mi 'am ci rnams dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis bkur sti byas/ bla mar byas/ ri mor byas/ mchod pa byas te / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phyesechen po rnamasasnyikyis mchod cing shes pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bsod nams chen po dang ldan pa/ na bza' dang ske/ : zhal zas dang / gzims cha dang / gdan dang / snyun gsos dang / sman zongashernams brnyes pa/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa mnyan du yod pa na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshesamanyan du yod pa na khyim bdag phyug cing nor mang la longs spyod che ba/ yongs su 'dzin pa yangs shing rgya che ba/rnam thos kyi bu'i nor dang ldan pa/ rnam thos kyi bu'i nor dang 'gran pa zhig 75—632

gnas pa des rigs mnyam pa las chung ma blangs nas/ de de dang lhan cig tu rtse zhing dga' la dga' mguratuspyod do/ /de rtse zhing dga' la dga' mgur〈kyespyod pa las chung ma la bu chags nas/ de zla ba brgyad dam dgu lon pa dang bu byung ste/ khye'u gzugs bzang zhing bltasan sdug la mdzes pa/ yan lag dang nying lag thams cad dang ldan pa zhig btsas te/ de btsasalgem thag tu khyim gyi52mi rnams la bltas nas tshig tu smras pa/ kye ma 'khor ba ni sdug bsngal ba'o/ /'khor ba ni mchog tu sdug bsngal ba'o zhes smras nas cang mi zer bar 'dug go/ /de nas de btsas pa'i btsas ston byas nas khye'u 'di'i ming ji skad gdags zhes ming 'dogs par byed de/ nye7du rnams na re 'di btsas ma thag tu 'khor ba 'khor ba zhes sgrogs pas na de'i phyir khye'u 'di'i ming 'khor ba zhes gdags so zhes zer ro/ /de nas khye'u 'khor ba pang na 'tsho ba'i ma ma gnyis dang / nu ma snun pa'i ma ma gnyis dang / dri ma 'khru ba'i ma ma gnyis dang / rtse ba'i ma ma gnyis te ma ma brgyad la gtadasnyenas/ de ma ma brgyad kyis 'o ma dang / zho dang ske/ mar dang / zhun marashedang / mar gyi nying khu dang / gzhan yang yo byad kyi khyad (7par bzang ngo cog gis bskyed bsrings te mtsho'i tu nang gi pad ma bzhin du skye drag par gyur to/ /de nas de mthar gyis〈nyecher skyes pa dang /de rang bzhin gyis tshe rabs dran pas skye bo'i tshogs la chos ston te/ kye bla ma rnams dang / bla ma lta bu rnams dang / pha ma dang / mkhan po dang / slob dpon rnams la tshig rtsub pocham zer cig /'khor ba ni sdug bsngal ba'o/ /'khor ba ni mchog tu sdug bsngal ba'o zhes zer ro/ /de nas phyis re zhig na phan tshun du 'khyam du song song ba las rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal du phyin nas/ des 75—633

sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sku skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyisanyelegs par brgyan pa/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus mdzes par byasalgepa/'od 'dom dugang gis brgyan pa/ nyi ma stong bas lhag pa'i 'od mnga' ba/rin po che'i ri bo 'gro ba lta burnyukun nas bzang ba mthong nas/ mthong ma thag tu bcom ldan 'das la sems dga' bar gyur to/ /de dga' ba skyes nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la〈gephyag 'tshal56)te chos mnyan pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de la 'khor ba las skyo 7bar 'gyur ba'i chos bstan 8)pa mdzad de/ de thos nas khye'u 'khor ba 'khor ba'9)la nyes par lta tshib dang / mya ngan las 'das pa la yon tan du lta bar gyur te pha ma la gsol nas bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la rab tu byung ste/des brtson pa dang / bsgrubasngo1pa dang 32/ 'bad pas phol mig lnga pa'i 'khor ba'i 'khor lo 'di nyid g.yo zhing mi brtan par rig nas 'du byed kyi rnam pa thams cad snyil geb dang / ltung ba dang / rnam par 'thor ba dang / rnam par 'jig pa'i chos can yin par rtsad chod de/ 8nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs nas dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas te/ dgra bcom pa khams gsum pa'i 'dod chags dang bral bar gyur nas gser dang bong bar mnyam pa/nam mkha' dang lag mthil du 'dra ba'i sems dang ldan pa/ tsan dan sbangs pa lta bur bsil bar gyur pa/ rig nyusnyepas sgo nga'i sbubs bcom pa/ rig pa dang /mngon par shes pa dang / so so yang dag par rig pa thob pa/ srid pa'i rnyed pa dang / chags pa dang / bkur sti la mi lta ba dbang po dang nye dbang dang bcas pa'i lha rnams kyis mchod cing rjed pa dang / gus par smra ba'i gnas su 75—634

gyur to/ /denyedagra bcom par gyur kyang dge slong rnams la chos ston te②/ tshe dang ldan pa dag bla ma rnams dang / bla ma lta bu rnams dang / pha ma dang /mkhan po dang / slob dpon rnams la tshig rtsub po ma zer cig /'khor ba ni sdug bsngal ba'o/ /'khor ba ni mchog tu sdug bsngal ba'o zhes zer ro/ /de nas dge slong dag the tsom skyes te/ the tsom thams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa 'khor bas las gang dag bgyis na des tshe rabs lnga brgya'i bar du ma'i lto nas gum pa'i ro byung la/ rab tu byung nas dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du bgyis lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag 'khor ba nyid kyis sngon tshe rabs gzhan dag tu tshogs rnyed cing rkyen grub pa dang ldan te dba' rgal bzhin du 'byung la/ gdon mi za bar 'ong ba'i las de dag byas shing bsags pas na/ 'khor ba nyid kyis〈milas byas shing bsags pa de dag gzhan su zhig gis nyams ④su myong bar 'gyur te / dge slong dag las byas shing bsags pa rnams ni phyi rol gyi sa'i khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur/ chu'i khams dang / me'i khams dang / rlung gi khams ⑤la rnam par smin par ⑥mi 'gyur te/ las dge ba dang mi dge ba byas shing bsags pa rnams ni zin pa'i phung po dang / khams dang / skye mched rnams 'ba' zhig la rnam par smin par 'gyur ro/ /lus can dag gi las rnams ni/ /bskal pa brgyar yang chud mi za/ /tshogs shing dus la bab pa na / /'bras bu nyid du smin par 'gyur/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na bskal pa bzang po 'di nyid la skye dgu'i tshe lo nyi mekhri thub pa na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa 75—635

dang ske/ zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/skyes bu gdul bya'i7kha lo sgyur ba bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'od srung zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung ste/ de grong khyer bā rā ṇa 'ishen drang srong smra ba ri dgas kyi nags na rten cing bzhugs so / /de'i tshe grong khyer bā rā ṇa r+sāshen tshong dpon gyi bu zhig gnas brtan zhig las rab tu byung ngo / /gnas brtan de nisnyedagra bcom pa 'dod chags spangs pa zhig go/ /de nas re zhig na yul der dus ston zhig byung ngo / /de nas dge slong gzhon nu des gnas brtan gede bslang ste/ bzhengs la spyod yul gyi grong du bzhud do zhes byas so/ /gnas brtan gyis smras pa/ bu da dung sngas kyis re'uzhig song la dge ba'i phyogs gyis shig /lan gnyis lan gsum gyi bar du dge slong gzhon nu des gnas brtan de bslang ste bzhengs la spyod yul gyi grong du bzhud ces byas na yang ⑦/ lan gnyis lan gsum gyi bar du gnas brtan gyisal / bu da dung sngas kyisashesong la dge ba'i phyogs gyis shig ces byas so/ /de nas dge slong gzhon nu lto 'dun tu )can des ngag gi las rtsub pos hunyesmras te/khyod tshe rabs lnga brgya'i bar du yang gson por khyim nas phyir〈nyem byung7shig /nga ni song zin no zhes byas so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus na dge slong gzhon nur gyur pa gang yin pa de ni 'di yin te'i/ des dgra bcom pa la semasatsosnang bar byas nas tshig rtsub po smras pa'i las de'i tsho/ tshornam par smin pas tshe rabs lnga tunyebargya'i bar du ma'i lto nas shi ba'i ro byung nas/ da ltar mir skyes te de dran nas 'khor ba ni5)sdug bsngal ba'o/ /'khor ba ni mchog tu sdug bsngal ba'o zhes zer ba 75—636
