'khob ①tu kun du gnas te/ la la ni grong khyer bzang byed ces bya ba na'o/ /la la ni mud gi⑧mi ka zhes bya ba'i yul na'o/ /la la ni bu ram shing 'phel zhes bya ba'i grong khyer nal gnas so/ /de'i tshe de'i dus na khyu mchog byin de'i bar du khyim ma byas pa dang / de la gcer bu pa rnams kyis smras pa/ mgon med zas sbyin gyi bu mo ma ga d+ma ④bzang mo zhes bya ba gzugs bzang ba/ blta na sdug pa/mdzes pa/ skye bo dam pa rnams dang 'dra ba zhig yod do/ /ji srid des thos pa dang bdag nyid gcer bu pa'i cha byad du byas te mnyan yod du song ngo ji tsam na khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyi khyim du slong ba'i phyir zhugs pa dang /des bu mo de mthong ngo / /mthong ba'i mod kho na la bu mo de la kun du chags par gyur la/ de der bslangs pa'i tshe zhwa'i5nyanang du blangs so/ /de nas bu mo des log par spyod pa de mthong ba dang / 'di ni shes bzhin53)med par slongs mo len to zhes bgad doni/ /de nas khyu mchog byin de ngo tsha bar gyur pa dang /bu ram shing 'phel gyi grong khyer du song ste pha la smras nas des bu mo de blangs7so//mgon med zas sbyin gyis bcom ldan 'das huX la zhus pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gzhan du na gang gi tshe ma ga dhā bzang mo 'di bu ram shing 'phel du song na rab tu byung ba rnams kyi bya ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi bya ba byed par 'gyur ro/ /yang ji srid cig na khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis nye du rnams la yang 31)go bar byas nas byin pa dang bu ram shing 'phel du khyer ro/ /ji tsam na dus gzhan zhig gi tshe khyim de na gcer bu pa rnams zan za ba dang /de la sgyug mos smras pa/ de ring bdag cag gi khyim na mchod gnas rnams bshos gsol gyis〈hetshur shog /mchod gnas rnams la ltos shig /ma ga dhā 75—798

bzang mos de thos pa dang dga' ba dang / mgu ba dang / rangs pa dang /yid bde ba skyes te bsams pa/ nges par btsun pa shā ri'i bu'am/ mod gal7gyi bu chen po la sogs pa nyan thos chen po rnams byon par gyur to snyam nas de yid rab tu dga' ba dang / 'jigs pa med par song ba dang / gcer bu nags kyi ma he 'dra ba/ skra7rnams btogasalgepa/ phug ron gyi phru gu 'dra ba'i gcer bu pa7rnams mthong ngo / /mthong ba dang de'i med la ma ga dhā bzang mo ngo tsha ste/ de gdong gzhan du bltas pa dang / de la sgyug mo des smras pa/ bu mo khyod ci'i phyir yi mug par gyur/ des smras pa/ gang 'di lta bu mchod gnas yin na mchod gnas5snyem yin pa go ji lta bu zhig yod par 'gyur/ de la des smras pa/ bu mo khyod la 'di bas ches khyad par du 'phags pa'i ston pa 'ga' zhig yod dam bu mos smras pashebadag gi pha'i gtsug lag khang rgyal byed kyi tshal na sangs rgyas zhes bya ba'i ston pa bzhugs te/ de ni rgyu ba dang / mi rgyu ba'i 'jig rten gyi mchod gnas yin no/ /khyod kyi ston pa de ji5ni'adra ba zhig /smras pa/ bdag gi ston pa btso ma'i57tshogs ltar ser/ /btso ma'i nya stagaser ltar shin tu dri ma med/ /tshul khrims rnam hunyadag shes rab shin tu dag /'jig rten gsum na mnyam med 'gro las 'phags/ /de thos ma thag tu sems rab tu dga' bar gyur nas smras pa/ bu mo nged cag hurternams la bcom ldan 'das de sang bstan par nus sam/ ma ga dhā bzang mos smras pa/ bshos gtsang rnams sbyor cig dang / sang bcom ldan 'das spyan drang bar bya'o/ /ji 15tsam na de rnams kyis smras pa/ bshos gtsang rnams sbyar gyis tshekhyod kyis bcom ldan 'das sang spyan drongs shig /de nas ma ga dhā bzang mos khang pa'i yang tog 8gi 75—799

steng du mngon par 'dzegs ①nas phyogs gang na bcom ldan 'das bzhugs pa'i phyogs〈der thal mo sbyar te phyag 'tshalashenas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi yon tan rjes su dran te/ me tog rnams gtor cing ⑤spros kyang btul7nas gser gyi bum pa'i chus bcom ldan 'das spyan drang ba'i phyir gser gyi bum pa'i chu yang stengs so/ /snying rje ba'i tshig 'di skad ces kyang smra ste④/ bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa/ bdag ni ri dgas dngashe'adra bar gyur cing mtha' 'khob na mchis te⑨/ dkon mchog gsum dang bral bar gyur pa la rjes su gzung (2 bar mdzad cing dge slong gi dge 'dun dang bcas pa yi'adir gshegs par mdzad du gsol/ yang 'di skad ces kyang smras te/ tshul khrims rnam dag shes rab shin tu dag /dad ldan snying po nyan thos che rnams kyis/ /mgon med gyur pa bdag la rjes gzung〈rteba'i/ /don mdzad thugs rjes gshegs par mdzad du gsol/ /ji tsam na me tog dang spos dang gser gyi bumachapa'i chu'ang nam mkha' la hu ) 'phags par gyur to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyang de'i tshe nang du yang dag 'jog las bzhengs nas 'khor rnam snyibazhi la chos ston to / /gser gyi bum pa'i chu de yang bcom ldan 'das kyi 3)spyan sngar be+e drur+ya'i ( bhesdong bu bzhin du rnam par gnas so/ /me tog de bcom ldan 'das kyi steng gi nam mkha' la khang pa brtsegs pa bzhin du gnas so/ / dri ngad5)spos kyang sprin brtsegs pa bzhin du gnas par gyur to/ /de nas de mthong ba dang / tshe dang ldan pa 17kun dga' bos bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das spyan 'dren pa 'di ga las mchis/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/kun dga' bo dpag tshad brgya drug cu ga ) rtsa gsum na/ bu ram shing 'phel gyi 75—800

grong khyer yod pa nas 'ongs so/ /kun dga' bo grong khyer de ni mu stegs pa rnams kyis bzung ba yin pas rdzu 'phrul gyi rnam par 'phrul pas 'gro bar bya'o zhes dge slong rnams la tshul shing brims shig /ji tsam na tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos rgan pa'i gnas mtha' nas bzunganyenas tshul shing brims te/ 'di skad ces kyang smras sokho/ /sang bu ram shing 'phel gyi grong khyer du 'gro bar bya ste/grong khyer de ni mu stegs pa rnams kyis yongs su bzung bas khyod bcag rnams las gang rdzu 'phrul thob pa des tshul shing long shig④ /ji srid cig na rgan pa'i mtha' nas tshul shing len par brtsams so/ /yang de nasnyeganas brtan gang po zhes bya ba ༅yod de de g.yang rdzu 'phrul ma thob par lag pa brkyang ⑧ste tshul shing len par brtsams pa dang / de la tshe dang ldan pa7kun dga' bos smras patso/gnas brtan mgon med zas sbyin gyi khyim du 'jug pa ma yin gyi/ gzhan dusngo gledapag tshad brgya drug cu rtsa gsum na/ bu ram shing 'phel zhes bya ba'i gnas yod de/ der 'gro dgos so/ /de 'di snyam du semes te/ ngas ni thog ma med pa'i dus nas goms pa'i nyon mongs pa 3)ni spangs na/ mu stegs pa rnams dang thun mong du gyur pa'i rdzu 'phrul lta zhig hunyedaka' ba ji 9zhig yod nas bskyed par mi bya snyam nas des kyang dus de nyid du rdzu 'phrul bskyed pa dang / ji srid du tshul shing gnyis pa ma brims 8pa de srid du des glang po che'i sna 'dra ba'i lag pa brkyang ste tshul shing〈nyeblangs so/ /ji tsam na tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos rgan pa'i mtha' logs su 'dug ste〈gesmras pa/ gang gis7)rdzu 'phrul gang thob pa des bu ram shing 'phel zhes bya ba'i grong khyer du 'gro bar bya'o3) / /de nas nyi ma gnyis pa la nam nangs te dge slong rnams rdzu 'phrul gyi rnam par 'phrul pas yang 75—801

dag par chas so/ /de nas rgyal po chen po bzhi yang mnyan yod gang na ba der mngon par blta bar brtsams0)so/ /ji50tsam na bar skabs der kun shes kauṇ+ḍi n+ya ③zhes cibya ba ④rta'i shing rta la zhon te glog 'gyusnyiba'i snang ba ston cing dal burnyudal bus char rab tu 'bebs57te/ de lta bu'i rang gi rdzu 'phrul rnam par ston cing 'ong ngo / /de nas ma ga dhā bzang mo'i bdag pos de mthong ba dang dris pa / ma ga dhā bzang mo 'di khyod kyi ston pa de yin nam/ des smras pa/ 'di ni kun shes kauṇ+ḍi rgyar zhes bya ba yin te/ 'di ni bcom ldan 'das kyis chos kyishe'akhor lo dang po bskor ba na/ 'dis thog mar bdag med pa mngon sum du byas pa de thog mar 'ongs pa 'di yin no/ /bar skabs der gnas brtan 'od srung nyu )chen pos brag gi ri chen po shing sna tshogs pa rnam pa brgyas khyab pa bya rnam pa sna tshogs kyis khyab paX/1/ me tog sna tshogs pas 1)yang dag par khebasarwanyepa/g.ya' chu sna tshogs kyis 7nye bar mdzes par byas pa mngon par sprul te 8stong gi nam mkha' las 'ong ngo tso/ /de nas khyim bdag des de mthong nas smras pa/ma ga dhā bzang mo 'di khyod kyi ston pa de yin nam/ des de la smras pa/ 'di ni 'od srung chen po zhes bya ba yin te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis sbyangs pa'i yon tan la gnas par 3 smra ba rnams kyi mchog tu gsungs pa stenyushe/ 'dis gcig gis ma tshang ba'i glang dor stong bor zhing / ser skya bzang mo skye bo dge ba rnams dang mtshungs pa dang / dbyig dang gser mang po mchil ma'i thal ba bzhin hurtespangs nas mngon par byung ste rab tu byung ba de ni 'ong ba 'di yin no/ /bar skabs der tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus seng ge'i shing rta mngon par sprul te/steng gi nam mkha' la rdzu 'phrul gyis 'ong ngo / /de nas khyim bdag des de mthong 75—802

ba dang dris7pa/ ma ga dhā bzang mo gang seng ge'i shing rtas 'ong ba 'di khyod kyi ston pa de yin nam/ de nas〈des de la smras pa/ 'di ni dge slong shā ri'i5)bu zhes bya ba yin te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis shes rab dang ldan pa rnams kyi mchog tu bstan pa yin te/ 'di ma'i mngal du zhugs pa sa/tsam gyis 'dzam bu'istor gling thams cad kyi rtsod par smra ba rnams las rgyal bar gyur57to/ /'di ni ston pa gnyis pa/ mchog gnyis pa/ chos kyi sde 9)dpon/ chos kyi 'khor lo rjes su skor ba de ni seng ge'i shing rtas 'ongs pa 'di yin no/ /de'i rjes thogs nyid la tshe dang ldan pa mod gal 6)gyi bu chen pos glang po che sa srung 'dra ba'i glang po'i rgyal po mngon par mesbrul te/ steng gi nam mkha' la rdzu 'phrul gyis 'ong ngo ske/ /de nas khyim bdag des de mthong nas/ ma ga dhā bzang mo la dris 31pa/gang glang po'i rgyal po hurtes srung 'dra ba'i glang pos 'ong ba 'di khyod kyi ston pa de 32yin nam/ des de la smras pa/ 'di ni dge slong mod galas0gyi bu chen po zhes bya ba yin te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis rdzu 3ge'aphrul can rnams kyi mchog tu bstan pa ste/ 'di'i rdzu 'phrul gyis lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyirdzasarnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzangs hunyerkang pa'i mthe bos kun du sgul lha ba dang / 'dis klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang nye dga' bo gnyis btul ba de glang po'i shing rtas 'ong ba 'di yin no/ /bar skabs der tshe dang ldan pa ma 'gags pas shing rta'i 'phang lo tsam gyi pad ma thams cad gser las byas pa/ be+e drur+ya'i 16sdong bu can dngul gyi ge sar5) dang ldan pas stomangon par sprul te/ rdzu 'phrul gyis 2rtenam mkha' las 'ong ngo / /de nas khyim bdag des de mthong ba dang dris pa/ ma ga dhā bzang mo 'di khyod kyi ston pa de yin nam/ des de la smras pa/ 'di ni dge slong ma 75—803

'gags pa zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das kyis lha'i mig dang ldan pa rnams kyi mchog tu bstan pa ste0)/ 'di ni bsod nams kyi stobs kyis yongs su bzung bas snod tshos pas5migang ba lnga brgya sgo na gnas pa dang / cung zad bsams pa tsam gyis chos gos dang / bsod snyomasashedang / mal stan dang / nad kyi rkyen sman dang / yo byad rnams 'byung ba la spyod pa de pad ma'i shing rtas 'ong ba 'dir )yin no/ /bar skabs der tshe dang ldan pa gang pos nam mkha' lding gi shing rta mngon par sprul te/ rdzu 'phrul gyis steng gi menam mkha' las 'ong ngo / /de nas khyim bdag des dris pa ma ga dhā bzang mo nam mkha' lding gi shing rtas 'ong ba 'di khyod kyi ston pa de yin nam/ des de la smras pa/ 'di ni dge slong gang po zhes bya ba bcom ldan 'das kyis chos ston pa rnams kyi mchog tu bstan pa de nam mkha' lding gi shing rtas 'ong ba 'di yin no/ /bar skabs der tshe dang ldan pa rta thul spyod lam rab tu zhi bas 'ong ngo / /de nas khyim bdag des de la dris pa/ ma ga dhā bzang mo gang lhung bzed lag na thogs te spyod lam rab tu zhi bas 'ong ba de khyod kyi ston pa yin nam/ des de la smras pa/ 'di ni dge slong rta thul zhes bya ba yin te/ 'di'i spyod lam rab tu zhi bas glang po che smyon pa btul ba dang / 'di'i spyod lam rab tu zhi ba mthongakhebs 'phags pa shāsari'i bus bden pa mthong bar gyur te/ de mngon par byung nas bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la rab tu byung ngo / /rab tu byung nas kyang dgra bcom pa nyid thob pa de spyod lam rab tu zhi bas 'ong ba 'di yin no/ /bar skabs der tshe dang ldan pa nye bar 'khor gyisashegaser gyi ta la'i nags mngon par sprul te / rdzu 'phrul gyis steng gi nam mkha' las 'ong ngo / /de nas khyim bdag des 75—804

de la dris pa/ ma ga dhā bzang mo gang gser gyi ta la'i nags la rten cing 'ong ba 'di khyod kyi ston pa de yin nam/ des de la smras pa/ 'di ni dge slong nye bar 'khor zhes bya ba bcom ldan 'das kyis 'dul ba 'dzin pa rnams kyi7mchog tu bstan⑧pa yin te/ 'di la shākyasalnga brgya tsam rab tu byung ba rnams kyis do shal dang / gdu bu dang / dpung rgyan dang / gser gyi gdugs la sogs pa'i rgyan rnams dang / gos rnams kyi phung po chen po mdun du bzhag pa dang /'dis de mthong ba dang skyo ba chen po skyes te/ de dag thams cad mi rtag par shes nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la rab tu byung ngo / /rab tu byung nas kyang dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas pa de gser gyi ta la'i nags la rten nas 'ong ba 'di yin no/ /de nas bar7skabs der tshe dang ldan pa kā kyā yalgena'i bu chen pos be+e drur+ya'i mkhang pa brtsegs pa mngon par sprul te/ rdzu 'phrul gyis nam mkha' las 'ong ngo / /de nas khyim bdag gis dris pa/ ma ga dhā bzang mo bai drur+ya'i〈khang pa brtsegs pa na 'dug ste 'ong ba 'di khyod kyi ston pa de yin nam/ des de la smras pa/ 'di ni dge slong kā t+yā ya na'i bupo)chen po zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das kyis mdo sde pa dang bye brag tu smra ba rnams kyi mchog tu bstan pa de bai drur+ya'i 7khang pa brtsegs pa'i nang du 'dug nas 'ong ba 'di yin no/ /bar skabs der tshe dang ldan pa gsus po ches khyu mchog gi shing rta mngon par sprul nas/ rdzu 'phrul gyis steng gi nam mkha' las 'ong ngo de nas khyim bdag des (1dris pa/ ma ga dhā bzang mo gang hu)khyu mchog gi shing rta la zhon te 'ong ba 'di khyod kyi ston pa desgo/steyin nam/ des de la smras pa/ 'di ni dge slong gsus po che zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das kyis rig pa thob pa rnams 75—805

kyishemachog tu bstan pa desakhyu mchog gi shing rtas 'ong ba 'di yin no/ /bar skabs der tshe dang ldan pa srung ladabang gi bu ngang pa'i shing rtas steng gi nam mkha' las rdzu 'phrul gyis 'ong ngo / /de nas khyim bdag des dris pa/ ma ga dhā bzang mo gang ngang pa'i shing rtas 'ong ba 'di khyod kyi ston pa de ④yin nam/des de la smras pa/ 'di ni dge slong srung zhu)dbang gi bu zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das kyis snying rje la gnas pa rnams kyi mchog tu bstan pa de 'di yin te/'di yichu bo gang gā rgal ⑦bar 'dod pa na dmangs ④mo 'dug shig 7ces smras pa dang tu )/ tshig de'i rjes thogs nyid la ri bo brtsegasamanyapa bzhin du gnas te/rnam pa thams cad du mi 'bab par byed pa de ngang pa'i shing rtas 'ong ba 'di yin no/ /bar skabs der tshe dang ldan pa rna ba bye ba nyi shu ri nags kyi tshogs la 'chag cing 'dug pa de 'chag bzhin du 'ong ngo / /de nas khyim bdag des dris pa / ma ga dhā bzang mo gang nags shing brgya dag gis khyab pa'i nags 'di la 'chag cing 'ong ba 'di khyod kyi ston pa de yin nam/ des de la smras pa/ 'di ni dge slong rna lha can zhes bya ba bcom ldan 'das kyis brtson 'grus rtsom tshogepa rnams kyi mchog tu bstan pa yin te/ 'di skyes pa tsam gyis rna ba bye ba nyi shu ri ba dang bcas par skyes pa dang / gang gi rkang mthil gyi 'og nas sor bzhi tsam gyi gser gyi 8spu yang dag par skyes pa dang / gang 'di dang po'i zan la kār ṣā pa ṇa 7lnga brgya zad par byas pa dang / gang bcom ldan 'das snyung ba dang / mod gal hu9gyi bu chen pos bshos gtsang nye bar blangs pa dang / gang gi dris 'od ma'i tshal thams cad7)kun du gang ba na32/ rgyal po gzugs can snying pos mnams (rtenas mchog tu ngo mtshar skyes te/ gang gi rkang pa gnyis bzhag pa tsam 75—806

gyis sa0)'di rab tu g.yos pa dang / gang zhig rab tu byung nas 'chag sarashe'achag pa na de'i rkang pa gnyis las khrag byung ba zags7pa khu7rnams 'thung ba de 'chag cing 'ong ba 'di yin no/ /bar skabs der tshe dngatsoldan pa sgra gcan 'dzin 'khor los sgyurakheba'i cha lugs su9)mngon par sprul te 'ong ba dang / de nas khyim bdag des dris pa/ ma ga dhā bzang mo gangs 'khor los sgyuralo1)ba'i cha byad kyis 'ong ba 'di khyod kyi ston pa de yin nam/ des de la smras pa/ 'di ni bcom ldan 'das kyitshwakye sras bcom ldan 'das kyis〈nyebaslab pa 'dzin pa rnams kyi mchog tu bstan pa yin te/ 'dis yab kyis7spangs pa'i dpal ston par byed cing 'khor los sgyur hu)ba'i cha lugs kyis rin po che sna bdun dang ldan pa bu stong gis yongs su bskor te/ gza'apha/stedang rgyu skar dang skar ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'i zla ba lta bu dang / rgyal po'i lam bzung 8nas 'gro ba 8mi'i bdag po lta bu dang ske/ chu bo stong phrag gi chu 'bab pas kun tu 'gengs pa'i rgya mtsho lta bu dang /'jigs pa dang nad dang mya ngan sel ba'i skye dgu skyong ba chen po lta bu dang /ri dgas kyi nang na seng ge lta bu dang / bya rnams kyi nang na nam mkha' lding lta bu dang / thams cad sel ba'i nyi ma dang / gling bzhi la dbang ba'i 'khor los sgyur 3nyeb dang / chos bzang na mig stong7)ldan pa chos skyong ba lta bur 'ong ba yin no/ /de bzhin du la la ni 'bar bar byed pa dang / la la ni char 'bebs pa5) dang / de bzhin du cho 'phrul sna tshogs pa ston cing 'ong ba yin no//la la sa las 'phags pa dang / /la la nam mkha'i gzhi la gnas/ /la la stan ni sprul byed de/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan pa'i mthu la ltos/ /de ltar bcom ldan 'das kyi slob ma rnams yang dag par song ba dang / de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 75—807

'od gang gis 'dzam bu'i7gling thams cad gser btso ma'i mdog 'dra ba'i 'od kyis gang ba de lta bu'i 'od bkye〈pezhing / mnyan yod nas brtsams te bu ram shing 'phel gyi bar 'dir ni'od kyi dkyil 'khor chen po bkye bas gang du'ang ④mig gis mi mthong ba med pas thams cad kyis mthong bar gyur to⑤/ /bcom ldan 'das kyang nam mkha' la gshegs pa dang / lag na rdo rje ni snam logs nas 'greng ༄7ngo / /gnas gtsang ma pa rnams ni steng nas so/ /'dod pa na spyod pa'i lha rnams ni 'og nas so/ /g.yon logs nas ni brgya byin no/ /g.yas nas ni tshangs pa'o/ /de bzhin du gtsug phud lnga pa dang / shin tu dga' 3)dang mig sbyin la sogs pa 1)dri za rnams pi bang (2 dang gling bu dang rnga dang rdza rnga la 11sogs pa rol 12mo'i bye brag snyan pa rnams rdung nyurtezhing / me tog dang ske/ bdug pa dang / dri dang / phreng〈 byeb rnams kyang 'thor〈nyezhing 'byor pa chen pos gshegs te/ bar skabs der bcom ldan 'das kyis〈srog chags stong phrag bdun cu mi rtsa bdun bden pa la thog mar rab tu bkod par hunyemadzad nas de'i 'og tu bu ram shing 'phel gyi grong khyer du gshegs te/ grong khyer de na yang sgo bcwa 19brgyad yod pa dang / der bcom ldan 'das kyis sangs rgyas bcwa〈 )brgyad 21sprul par mdzad nas sgo re re zhing sangs rgyas zhi snang bar gyur pa nas bcom ldan 'das ma ga dhā bzang mo'i khyim du gshegs so/ /de nas skye bo'i tshogs chen po de rnams kyis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ma mthong ste/ de rnams 2/khros nas de'i khyim bshig shustepar brtsams so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis grong khyer de thams cad shel nigegyi rang bzhin du byin gyis brlabs te/gang khyim thams cad du'ang dgasangs rgyas kyi sku bzhugs par mthong bar mdzad do//75—808

ji srid7bu ram shing 'phel du ma ga dhā bzang mo la sogs pa'i srog chags ( brgya stong du ma rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la me tog dang dri dang / phreng 5)ba dang /spos rnams kyis mchod pasabyas so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang ma ga dhā bzang mo la sogs pa'i skye bo'i tshogs chen po de rnams la gang zhig thos na ma ga dhā bzang mo la sogs pa'i srog chags brgya stong du ma rnams kyis bden pa mngon dus⑤mthong ba thob par gyur pa de lta bu'i chos bstan pa mdzad cing / 'khor de thams cad kyang sangs rgyas la gzhol ba dang / chos la bab 6)pa dang / dge 'dun la 'bab 9)par gyur to/ /yang dge slong rnams the com po)skyes te/ the tsom ⑨thams cad gcod par mdzad pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/bcom ldan 'das ji srid du sdum ga dh+wa bzang mo mchis nas srog chags brgya stong du ma mtho ris7medang thar pa la gzhol bar gyur pa dang / 'dis sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa bgyis pa ni ngo mtshar che'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/da lta rte'aba' zhig tu ma zad de/ 'das pa'i dus na 'dis sangs rgyas kyi bya ba byas pa de nyon cig /dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na skye dgu'i tshe lo nyi khri thub pa na/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'odam3 srung zhes bya ba/rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen skopa/skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur ba bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten du byung ste/ yang dus 8de'i tshe grong khyer bā rā ṇa sī nyunyan rgyal po kṛ tī hu)zhes bya ba rgyal po byed de/ de'i bu mo gser gyi phreng ba dang ldan pa zhig btsas te/ de'i ming yang gser phreng can 3)zhes bya bar btags so/ /ji srid cig na bu mo de cher skyes par gyur pa dang na zla 75—809

gzhon nu ma lnga brgya thams cad tsho1)kyang gzhon nu mas bskor cing thabs cig ②tu yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung la bsnyen bkur7byed de/ de la dad pa yang dag par thob pas yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'od srung la 4)ji srid 'tsho'i 95)bar du chos gos dang / bsod snyoms dang gzims cha dang snyan gyi rkyen sman dang / yo byad rnams kyis bsnyen bkur byed do / /yang dus de'i tshe rgyal po kṛ khris 6)mtshan gcig la rmi (pelam bcu mis te/des smras pa/ glang po che'i rgyal po skar khunga'ispunas byung ba na mjugashem phra mo thogs pa dang / skom 1 ripa'i phyi nas khron pa snyegs par rmi ba 3medang / phye bre gang dang mu tig bre gang tshong byed pa dang / tsan dan dang shing rin mnyam〈rtepar byed pa dang / kun dga' ra ba me tog dang 'bras bu phun sum tshogs pa ma byin par len pa rnams kyis phrogs pa dang / glang po che the2phru gus spos kyi glang po 'jigs par byed pa dang / spre'u 3 rimi gtsang bas gos pas gzhan la skud pa dang ske/ spre'u 12rgyal por dbang bskur bar mthong ba dang / ras gcig mi bcwa/brgyad kyis dras nyu kyang ma ral ba dang / skye bo'i tshogs chen po gcig tu 'dus nas 'thab pa dang / rtsod pa dang g.yul 'gyed pa dang mtshang 32'dru bar gyur pas 'jigs pa mthong ngo / /de nas rgyal po de sad pa dang 'jigs shing skrag la ri17skyo bas nga'i 'tsho ba'i srog gi 2 bar chad du gyur pa'am(1/ rgyal srid las nyams par mi 'gyur ram snyam ste/ des bram ze rmi ltas sa kyi mtshan ma ston shes pa rnams bsdus nas de rnams la mi lam de rnams smras so/ /de rnams kyang gser phreng na can la zhe sdang ba yin pas de rnams kyis smras pa/ lha khyed nu tshol thams cad kyi nang na thugs su byon pa de'i snying dang me la sbyin sreg zhigegi mchod sbyin 75—810

mdzod cig /de nas rgyal po de yi mug pas bsams 3)pa/ thams cad kyi nang na nga la sdug pa ni nga'i gser phreng ②can yin no/ /gser phreng ri can gyis de thos pa dang / de yang mkhas pa yin pas rgyal po de'i gan du song ste phyin nas smras pa/ lha nyi ma shar na sgron masnyime'i 'od dgos pa ci mchis yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'od srung 'di drang srong smra ba ri dgas53)rgyu ba na bzhugs te der gshegs la zhus shig dang / bcom ldan 'das des khyed la ji ltar lung ⑥bstan pa de bzhin du khyed kyis zung shigamer /de nas rgyal po kṛ khris()grong khyer bā rā ṇa sīr (9)nga deng bcom ldan 'das de'i drung hu )du 'gro'o zhes dril chen po bsgrags nas de 'khor brgya stong du ma dang /gser phreng (nyecan de dang thabs cigatshwa tu bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te chos mnyanatshwa pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dug go/ /ji srid cig na rgyal po kṛ tī 8stan las langs te bcom ldan 'das gang na ba nyusnyeder thal mo sbyar ba btud nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'dir dgung gcig tshal bdag gis rmi lam bcu khums pa/ glang po che skar khung nas byung ba na/ de'i mjug hu ma thogs pa la sogs pa snga ma bzhin te/bcom ldan 'das kyis 3)mi lam de'i 'bras bu 'dir bdag la lung bstan du gsol / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rgyal po chen po ma 'jigs shig /khyod kyi yul 'khor nyams par mi 'gyur la/ srog gi bar chad du yang mi 'gyur gyisanyunye/ rgyal po chen po gzhan du na ma 'ongs pa'i tshe skye dgu'i tshe lo brgya thub pa na shākya thub pa zhes bya ba yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'byung 75—811

stel/ de'i phyi ma'i dus na nyan thos rnams lus ma bsdams pa/ sems ma bsdams pa/ tshul khrims ma bsdams pa/① shes rab ma bsdams pasa'argyung bar 'gyur te/ de rnams gnyen gyi tshogs spangs nas rab tu 'byung bar 'gyur te / de nasalgegatsug lag khang rnams su khyim gyi 'du shes 'jog pas chags par 'gyur te/ glang po che skar khung nas byung ba na de'i mjugasem thogs pa ni de'i snga ltas yin no/ /rgyal po chen posamakhyod kyis skom pa'i phyi nas khron pa snyegs par ⑥mi lam du mthong ba gang yin pa de ni de rnams gtsug lag khang gi nang na lhan cig gnas pa rnams la chos ston par 'gyur yang de rnams nyanashepar 'dod par mi byed cing yid la mi 'jog ste/ de'i snga ltas ni 'di yin no/ /rgyal po chen po (2)khyod kyis phye bre stigang dang mu tig bre gang tshong byed par tunye rmi lam du mthong bsngoḥgang yin pa de ni de nyid kyi nyan thos rnams te/ gang bza' ba tsam gyi don du dbang po dang stobs dang byang chub kyi yan lag rin po che rnams yang dag par ston par7)'byung bar 'gyur te de'i snga ltas ni 'di yin no/ /rgyal po chen po khyod kyis tsan dan dang shing mnyam por tshong byed par mi lam du mthong ba gang yin pa de ni de nyid kyi nyan thos rnams mu stegs kyi hunyetshig gang yin pa rnams bzung nas sangs rgyas kyi bka' dang snyoms pa tso 'byung bar 'gyur te de'i snga ltas ni 'di boyin no/ /rgyal po chen po khyod kyis kun dga' ra ba 'bras bu phun sum tshogs pa ma byin par len pa rnams kyis phrogs par rkyo/)mi lam du mthong ba gang yin pa de ni hunyede nyid kyi77nyan thos lus ma bsdams pa/ sems ma bsdams pa/ tshul khrims ma bsdams pa/ shes rab ma bsdams pa rnams 'byung bar 'gyur te/ de rnams dge 'dun rnams kyi me tog gi bye mchog dang /75—812

'bras bu'i mchog rnams 'tsho ba'i phyir dge 'dun las ①bcad nas khyim pa rnams la ster bar 'gyur te/ de'i snga ltas ni 'di ②yin no/ /rgyal po chen po khyod kyis glang po phru gus spos kyi glang po ①'jigs par byed par 9 )mi lam du mthong ba gang yin pa 'di ⑤ni de nyid kyi nyan thos rnams tshul khrims 'chal ba/sdig pa'i chos can de rnams gang dge slong tshul khrims dang ldan pa/ dge ba'i chos can rnams zil gyis gnon par byed par 'gyur te de'i snga ltas 6 yin no/ /rgyal po chen po khyod kyis spre'u mi gtsang bas gos pas gzhan la skud par rmi lam du mthong ba gang yin pa 'di ni de nyid kyi nyan thos latshul khrims 'chal ba/sdig pa'i chos can rnams 'byung bar 'gyur te/ de rnams kyis tshul khrims dang ldan pa rnams la skur pa 'debs par 'gyur te de'i snga ltas〈yin no/ /rgyal po chen po khyod kyis spre'u rgyal por ⑨dbang bskur bar mthong ba gang yin pa de ni dus de'i tshe rmongs pa rnams rgyal por dbang bskur bar 'gyur te 3 )de'i snga 37ltas yin no/ /rgyal po chen po khyod kyis ras gcig mi bcwasko/nyebargyad kyis dras〈nyekyang ma ral bar mi lam du 3stemathong ba gang yin pa de ni de nyid kyi bstan pa sde bcwa nyidabargyad du gyes par gyur kyang rnam par grol ba'i ras ni ral bar bya bar nyi mi nus 1 te de'i snga ltas yin no/ /rgyal po chen po khyod kyis skye bo'i tshogs chen po 38gcig tu 'dus nas 'thab pa dang rtsod pa dang g.yul 'gyed pa dang / mtshang 'dru bar rmi lam du mthong ba gang yin pa de ni de nyid kyi bstan pa rtsod pas nub par 'gyur te de'i snga ltas yin no/ /rgyal po chen po de ltar mi bzad pa rnams ma 'ongs pa'i dus na 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa / gang bcom ldan 'das yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung wa 75—813

la'ang51)rgyal po kṛ khri7dang / gser phreng〈bcan gyis thar pa'i cha dang 'thunakyipa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams bskyed pa yin no/ /dge slong dag 'di ji snyam du semasal/ de'i tshe na gser phreng7can gang yin pa de ni ma ga dhā bzang mo 'di nyid yin te/ de'i tshe yang 'disalosangs rgyas kyi bya ba byas te/ da ltar yang 'di 'ongs nas sangs rgyas kyi bya ba byas so/ /yang dge slong rnams the comasheskyes nas/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa gser phreng can gyis lasam3)ci zhig bgyis na57)gser gyi phrengatshwa )ba btags par skyes/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag 'di nyid kyis las byas pa yod de / sngon byung ba na71)zhing pa gzhan zhig gi chung mar gyur te(rte/ rang sangs rgyas kyi mchod rten la kha dog sna tshogs pa'i me tog rnams kyitshwanyephreng ba byas nas btags te/ las de'i rnam par smin pas gser gyi phreng ba btagasalgepar skyes so / /de bas na dge slong dag las gcig tu gnag pa rnams kyi rnam par smin pa ni gcig tu gnag pa yin la/ gcig tu dkar ba rnams kyi rnam par smin pa ni gcig tu dkar ba yin te/ 'dren )snyem rnams kyi rnam par smin pas ni 'dren hu tshoma'o / /dge slong dag de bas na las /snyegacig tu gnag pa rnams dang 'dren〈nyem rnams ni du )spangs la/ las gcig tu dkar ba rnams la mngon par brtson par bya ste/ dge slong dag khyed rnams kyis de ltar bslab par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / dge slong rnams (tebacom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do/ /ma ga dhā bzang mo'i rtogs pa brjod pa rdzogs so rte// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po dharma shrī bha dra 2gedang / zhu zhu)chen gyi lots+tsha ba dge slong tshul 75—814
